# 701: This Is a Swordsman Worthy of Respect, Kartana! (Two-in-One Chapter)

"Fine, then you choose one of the little ones to help you."

Johan forced himself to perk up, smiling meaningfully at Tapu Bulu.

Speaking, he threw out Poké Balls, summoning all his little ones.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar had a mischievous smile, standing with arms crossed without moving, but from the shadow beneath its feet, shadowy tentacles extended out, waving at Tapu Bulu.

Seeing this scene, Tapu Bulu's eyes immediately widened, then instinctively backed away.

Then looking at Ninetales, that freezing cold aura made Tapu Bulu immediately pass without thinking.

What it disliked most was the cold.

Looking again at the silly-smiling Dragonite waving its small wings, with its three-meter height, round belly and short arms, one look...

Clearly not good at scratching itches, pass.

Just as it looked toward Tinkaton, it saw her swaying her twin tails, gently placing her hammer on the ground.

Thud!!

The dull sound, plus the ground shaking, made a drop of cold sweat appear on Tapu Bulu's forehead.

"Cha?" Tinkaton smiled gently, pointing at herself.

Tapu Bulu waved its hands repeatedly.

Its gaze moved again.

The robust but still snoring Urshifu with a snot bubble - this looked like a good itch-scratcher, but... it was sleeping.

Tapu Bulu hated being disturbed while sleeping most, so it wouldn't disturb someone else who was sleeping.

Next was Ceruledge beside Urshifu.

Clang!!

Sharp blades wreathed in ghostly blue flames, those flames that seemed to burn souls made Tapu Bulu skip past again.

"Moo!!"

It couldn't help standing up.

Not one normal one!

Don't you have a single normal Pokémon?

"Bangi?"

Tyranitar, sitting on the ground, clapped and stood up, leaving a very obvious butt print, pointing at itself.

Is it me?

I'm great at scratching itches!

Looking at that butt print, Tapu Bulu's eye twitched.

The only somewhat decent-looking Snivy was holding its head high, looking at it disdainfully from the side.

Noticing Tapu Bulu's gaze, Snivy directly bared its teeth.

"Sni! (#`皿)"

Choose me and I'll definitely strangle you later!

Tapu Bulu: "..."

Forget it!

[Never... never mind.]

Tapu Bulu took a deep breath.

"Never mind? Want to look at these few more?"

Johan took out more Poké Balls, summoning Regieleki and Regidrago.

"Regi—"

"Drago—"

Tapu Bulu's expression froze.

It waved repeatedly at Johan.

Forget it, for an itch scratch, no need to risk half its life.

Johan couldn't help but find it amusing.

He knew perfectly well what his Pokémon were like. Honestly, in the entire Pokémon world, besides himself, probably no one else would dare let them help scratch itches.

Tapu Bulu slowly floated up, then turned head-down, dug a depression in the ground, waved its arms, and threw an unknown seed into it.

Clang! Clang! Clang!

The bell on its tail swayed and rang, emerald green light flowed from its body, then gradually injected into the soil.

"Sni?" Snivy couldn't help narrowing its eyes, watching this scene.

This bull has some skills?

The next moment.

Rustle rustle rustle—

In the rustling sounds, the seed Tapu Bulu planted quickly took root and sprouted, growing branches. In just a few breaths, it had grown into a towering tree covered in snow-white flowers.

This was the ability Johan envied most.

Then Tapu Bulu landed beside the thick trunk, pressed its back against the rough bark, and began rubbing "huff huff."

"Moo~"

Tapu Bulu made comfortable sounds.

Johan's expression was strange.

If you had this method, why didn't you use it earlier?

Was it necessary to make things so difficult?

But the next second.

The expressions of Johan's Pokémon all changed, and the rubbing Tapu Bulu immediately crouched down, hooves supporting the ground, assuming a push-up position.

Whoosh—

A bright white arc flashed across the tree trunk Tapu Bulu had been using to scratch its itch.

Crack—

Immediately after, that thick trunk was directly cut into two sections out of nowhere!

The smooth cut even made the upper half of the trunk slide down the cut surface, crashing heavily to the ground.

Bang!!

Raising a large cloud of dust.

"This is..." Johan was stunned.

"Moo..."

Tapu Bulu seemed unsurprised by this scene, floating up with a helpless expression.

This was why it wanted Johan and the others to help scratch its itch instead of growing trees to scratch itself.

"Goka..."

Ceruledge's eyes flickered with flame.

Since it hadn't been particularly focused on Tapu Bulu's scratching, Ceruledge hadn't seen the earlier scene happen.

But that perfectly even cut on the trunk, and the slight sharpness remaining in the air, made Ceruledge realize something. Its twin blades trembled slightly, emitting faint ringing sounds.

"Moo!!"

Tapu Bulu made a low sound. After brief helplessness, anger couldn't help rising in its heart.

Once or twice was fine, but appearing every time it wanted to scratch an itch, that feeling...

The feeling of being suddenly interrupted while scratching halfway was even more uncomfortable than not scratching at all, and much more so.

Slice! Slice!

Out of nowhere, cutting waves appeared one after another, as if small gaps had appeared in the air, leading to unknown places.

In the middle of those gaps, a small figure was finally locked onto by their vision.

At first glance, it looked like a child's origami toy, with a humanoid structure, its head folded into its body, with a yellow four-pointed star cut out in the center that looked like both a mouth and eyes.

Its slender single-layer paper arms were like two blades that could cut through anything, gleaming with cold light.

Cut another boring thing!

"Found it, Rotom!" The Rotom Pokédex activated zoom photography, finally getting a clear shot of that guy in the air. Even Gengar rarely refrained from messing around.

"As expected, Kartana." Johan said softly.

"Begin recording!" The Rotom Pokédex started its information collection, analysis, and recording functions.

Johan, in his capacity as International Police Chief Inspector, named this creature.

"Code name: UB04: Blade. Name: Kartana, Drawn Sword Pokémon, Grass and Steel-type. Its body is thin as paper and can become a sword that cuts through everything. Danger level: Extremely high!"

He had already reviewed some UB materials collected by the "UB Task Force."

Besides UB01: Symbiont provided by the Aether Foundation and UB02: Expansion that Johan had subdued, the "UB Task Force" mainly targeted UB05: Glutton, also known as Guzzlord.

Supposedly it came to the Pokémon world with Anabel ten years ago, hiding somewhere in slumber, only recently showing signs of awakening.

Since Kartana was appearing for the first time, Johan directly took over "naming rights."

"Record! Record! Rotom!"

The Rotom Pokédex recorded the information and footage while sending real-time updates to the "UB Task Force."

At the same time.

At "UB Task Force" headquarters on Melemele Island, Anabel and Dr. Burnet received the Rotom Pokédex's "live broadcast."

"Another Ultra Beast? UB04: Blade, Drawn Sword Pokémon, Kartana?" Anabel frowned tightly.

"Obviously no Ultra Wormhole appeared..."

Dr. Burnet's hands rapidly typed on the keyboard.

After repeated confirmation, there were indeed no signs of Ultra Wormhole opening.

The "UB Task Force's" current main objective was to stably lock onto every Ultra Wormhole opening and develop Poké Balls capable of capturing Ultra Beasts.

Otherwise, even if they defeated Ultra Beasts, being unable to capture or return them was just wasting time.

In this regard, the "UB Task Force" had cooperated with the Aether Foundation.

This would normally be quite difficult.

But after Teacher Johan provided Buzzwole to assist research, development made breakthrough progress.

Whether real-time monitoring of Ultra Wormhole openings or Beast Ball development, both were approaching success.

Yet even so, they still couldn't capture this Kartana's appearing Ultra Wormhole.

"Perhaps..." After hesitating briefly, Anabel said: "It arrived in the Pokémon world before we came."

Such Ultra Beasts were rarer but not nonexistent, like the UB05: Glutton, Guzzlord they'd always been wary of.

"Possible." Dr. Burnet nodded.

She began receiving information collected by the Rotom Pokédex.

"Wait, that Pokémon is—"

But then Dr. Burnet noticed the Pokémon confronting Kartana.

"Ula'ula Island's Guardian Deity, Tapu Bulu!" Anabel said in a deep voice.

On screen.

Tapu Bulu confronted Kartana, emerald green light flowing from its body as the ground beneath it rapidly grew a large patch of verdant grassland.

Grassy Surge, Grassy Terrain!

Swish—

Kartana's arms merged, becoming a sharp blade, the yellow four-pointed star on its head flickering as if expressing something.

"Moo!!"

Tapu Bulu's eyes were serious, its hooves colliding at its chest, making "clop clop" sounds like horse hooves.

The next moment.

Both rushed toward each other simultaneously.

No intense collision sounds, no flashy moves, just after an extremely fast flash, both crossed paths.

"Moo..."

Tapu Bulu's serious and angry expression became helpless.

It looked down at its own body.

The originally intact body suddenly burst with bright white arcs, accompanied by crisp cutting sounds, instantly becoming covered in dense cutting wounds.

Even the surrounding air, the energy it released, and the Grassy Terrain were all completely severed!

However, Tapu Bulu didn't fall, just slowly landed on the ground. Misty green light appeared again, rapidly healing its wounds.

But Kartana seemed to have just done something trivial, slowly turning around, expression cold, blade returning to arm form.

Cut another boring opponent!

"Worthy of being the swordsman Kartana that can cut through any enemy." Johan clicked his tongue.

Tapu Bulu had encountered an Ultra Beast that severely countered it.

As a large, powerful but unable-to-scratch-its-own-back, typical "heavy" Pokémon, facing Kartana - only palm-sized, extremely fast with sharp blades.

While not having attribute disadvantage, it was clearly outmatched in agility.

Of course, though Kartana could wound Tapu Bulu, it couldn't defeat Tapu Bulu with its strong recovery ability. Neither could truly deal with the other.

It's just that attack-specialized Kartana held more initiative.

Tapu Bulu looked at Johan.

[This is my second trouble.]

Kartana had come to Ula'ula Island several years ago. Initially it cut whatever it saw. Though it was in the wild without causing much commotion, it put many wild Pokémon in danger.

So Tapu Bulu, as Guardian Deity, had to find Kartana, and in the end...

Well, Tapu Bulu was completely entangled by Kartana.

Because in Kartana's view, Tapu Bulu was an opponent worth cutting.

But Tapu Bulu was naturally lazy and trouble-averse. After seeing Kartana stop harassing other places and wild Pokémon, it ignored Kartana.

But it could be lazy - Kartana couldn't.

Hence the earlier scene. Whenever Tapu Bulu grew trees, Kartana cut them, just to force Tapu Bulu to fight it properly for a satisfying cutting session.

"Swish..."

Kartana stood proudly in the air, wind blowing across its body, making paper-like fluttering sounds.

Its height was only thirty centimeters, but its spirit couldn't be measured by height. Its goal was to cut through everything - whether matter, energy, or even space.

Kartana could cut through space!

It was thanks to this ability that it could independently cut open the space between Ultra Space and the Pokémon world, traveling to this strange world, to the Alola region.

All to find opponents worth cutting.

But obviously, Tapu Bulu's lazy nature greatly dissatisfied Kartana.

However.

Following Tapu Bulu's gaze, Kartana finally noticed Johan and his Pokémon's presence.

So many powerful Pokémon!

Kartana's spirits lifted.

More opponents to try cutting!

"Swish!"

The airborne Kartana's form trembled slightly, then vanished from sight.

Here it comes!

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar wasn't panicked at all. It hopped on its little legs, then instantly disappeared from its original position.

In Johan's aura, he "saw" the blade-wielding Kartana and the charging chubby Gengar cross in the air like Tapu Bulu and Kartana had before.

Both Pokémon's movements stopped.

"Swish!"

Kartana's expression was cold, somewhat disdainful.

Its blade returned to arm form.

"Ka-kaah!!"

Gengar showed "terror," its chubby body cleanly cut in half!

Split right through the middle of its belly!

"Swish..."

Cut another boring opponent.

Kartana's gaze swept over Johan's other Pokémon again.

As for Gengar...

A guy that couldn't even withstand one cut and was sliced in half wasn't worth looking back at.

The only thing puzzling Kartana was - even though Gengar was cut in half, why did the human below and its companions all look unconcerned?

So cold-hearted?

But then Johan said while holding his forehead: "Alright, Gengar, stop playing."

"Ka-kaah!"

Behind it came Gengar's giggling.

Hm?

Kartana spun around sharply.

It saw the purple chubby waving one hand at it while grabbing its cut-off "lower half" with the other, squishing it back together.

Squish, squish?!

"Ka-kaah~~"

Gengar looked down at its little feet, gently wiggling them as if checking for problems.

Seeing its feet still responded normally, it patted its belly with a "relieved" expression and sighed deeply.

Kartana: "?"

Johan smiled and shook his head, beckoning to Gengar. The chubby floated back with a giggling expression under Kartana's confused gaze.

"Ka-kaah~"

This old man was so scared~ Really thought I was cut in half~

That mischievous look brought laughter from Johan and the little ones.

"Ceruledge." After flicking the purple chubby's forehead, Johan called out.

"Goka!"

Ceruledge stepped forward, looking up at airborne Kartana, flames rising in its eyes.

Speaking of who had the strongest battle desire facing Kartana, it was definitely Ceruledge.

As fellow "sword" users, fellow swordsmen, Kartana's agile movements and sharp cuts made Ceruledge excited beyond measure.

Johan naturally had his own plans for sending out Ceruledge.

Ceruledge's fighting spirit was one aspect. Kartana being a Grass and Steel-type Ultra Beast with 4× Fire weakness was another.

Most importantly.

This Kartana probably had at least ordinary Champion main Pokémon level strength.

For Ceruledge, it was definitely a great opponent.

With 4× type advantage, even if somewhat stronger, it had fighting chance.

"Swish!!"

Facing Gengar's "trickery," Kartana was obviously angry, raising its hand to point at Johan. An almost tangible pressure formed into a blade slashing forward, its sharpness making Johan immediately feel like needles on his back.

"Goka!"

But Ceruledge swept its blade toward the incoming blade.

Clang!!

Like metal clashing against metal, accompanied by sparks, Kartana's pressure blade was deflected aside.

Thud—

Landing on the ground, leaving a thin but deep sword mark.

"Swish?"

Kartana looked at Ceruledge, its four-pointed star opening and closing slightly, expression gradually becoming serious.

From Ceruledge's body, it sensed the aura of a fellow swordsman, an unstoppable momentum to cut through everything.

Kartana's body slowly descended from the air, reaching eye level with Ceruledge. Its paper-thin arms rotated slightly like a sword gathering power in its sheath, battle intent gradually emerging within.

"Swish!"

You're not bad!

Ceruledge also slowly raised its blade, pointing at Kartana, eyes narrowing as the ghostly blue flames in them became more intense.

Just "not bad"?

Hum—

The blade turned with a buzzing sound, ghostly blue flames immediately covering it.

Arms and blades crossed before its face.

It had trained, grown, and fought so hard - it wanted more than just "not bad"!

Such an evaluation...

You're not giving me face!

Ghostly blue flames suddenly burst from Ceruledge's eyes as its form swayed slightly, leaving only scorched footprints.

"Swish!"

Kartana's expression became solemn instantly.

So fast!

Seeing ghostly blue arc light flashing toward it, Kartana immediately merged its arms into a sword, charging at Ceruledge without hesitation.

Sizzle—

Sparks flew instantly. Amid ear-piercing grinding sounds, Ceruledge and Kartana crossed paths.

So fast a sword!

So sharp a sword!

Both Ceruledge and Kartana thought simultaneously.

Thud!

Standing apart, Ceruledge's black-purple armor showed a clean cut.

While on Kartana's paper sword, ghostly blue flame danced.

Ceruledge and Kartana hadn't reacted much yet, but nearby Tinkaton showed a "heartbroken" expression first.

Not worried about Ceruledge, but distressed about Ceruledge's armor.

Don't break it...

"It's fine." Though Johan also felt "pain," it was just one cut.

After their brief initial clash, both Ceruledge and Kartana took their opponent more seriously.

"Swish!!"

Energy similar to Ultra Wormholes appeared around Kartana, its momentum climbing.

Ability: Beast Boost!

[Beast Boost: Pokémon with this ability randomly increase one stat except HP when they defeat an opponent with an attacking move!]

But clearly Kartana's current situation differed from normal "Beast Boost."

It seemed that as battle time continued, its energy would gradually increase!

"Cheating..."

However, Ceruledge didn't retreat due to Kartana's momentum change, calling out lowly.

"Goka!"

Crack—

A fissure opened in its black-purple armor, ghostly blue flame tongues licking out from the crack.

Armor Shed!

Physical Defense decreased while Speed greatly increased!

"Cha!" Tinkaton gripped its hammer handle tightly.

Now even Johan felt pain.

But for Ceruledge and Kartana, this was just the beginning!

In an instant.

Clang!!

Ceruledge and Kartana turned simultaneously in perfect sync, slashing their blades at each other.

Sparks flew, blades rang!

Kartana's single sword and Ceruledge's twin swords deadlocked, ghostly blue flames surging.

"Swish!"

Fire was what Kartana hated most, and this bone-deep ghostly blue flame made it feel like its whole body was burning.

In the second collision, despite Beast Boost's enhancement, Kartana not only gained no advantage over Ceruledge but was also painfully burned by Ceruledge's flames.

Ceruledge also noticed Kartana's condition, seeing the slight scorching on its blade, then looking down at its own twin swords.

After brief consideration.

It looked at Johan.

Johan also saw another crack appear in Ceruledge's armor, forcibly suppressing his heartache and nodding slightly:

"Do what you want to do."

"Goka!"

Getting Johan's approval, feeling Johan's unconditional trust, endless power surged in Ceruledge's heart. It gently rotated its sword edge.

Hum—

The ghostly blue flames on its twin swords dissipated.

Seeing this, Kartana paused, seemingly not expecting Ceruledge to withdraw its flames voluntarily.

But when it looked at Ceruledge and their gazes met, Kartana immediately understood—

The "worthy to cut" opponent it had been seeking had finally appeared!

"Swish!!"

Kartana's momentum gained another Beast Boost enhancement.

Facing a true swordsman, it had to show a swordsman's spirit!

Though Ceruledge had been attacking before, now as respect—

Kartana's gaze became stern, its form like wind and lightning, rapidly shooting toward Ceruledge.

While Ceruledge might be inferior to Kartana in strength, defense and other aspects, in pure speed it even had advantage!

Clang!!

Another blade clash.

Without flame interference, in pure collision, Kartana gained huge advantage!

Despite its seemingly small form, it burst with extremely strong pressure.

Though its blade pressed against Ceruledge's blades, there seemed to be abundant "sword qi" around them.

"Shadow Claw!" Johan called out timely.

Though Ceruledge chose not to use flames, that didn't mean no other moves.

It really wanted to spar with Kartana in swordsmanship.

"Goka!"

Ceruledge's blocking blade thrust upward, creating space, while its other blade slashed at Kartana.

Ghostly chill made Kartana feel considerable threat.

However.

At this moment, Kartana's originally merged blade arms split in two, returning to dual arm form.

Or more accurately, dual blades!

Clang!

Kartana's left arm-blade clashed with Ceruledge's right sword.

Suddenly.

Kartana's expression calmed.

"Swish..."

Twin swords are used like this.

One sword rides the wind, one sword breaks waves. Feel it, my opponent!

Clang!!

Ceruledge was somewhat surprised.

It thought Kartana used single-sword style, not expecting... it was also dual-sword style!

But facing Kartana's sudden fierce attack, Ceruledge could only raise both swords to barely parry.

Clang! Clang! Clang!

Each of Kartana's strikes carried terrifying buzzing, flying sparks, and Ceruledge's sword trembling.

As if allowing this continued slashing would break even Ceruledge's twin swords.

This time, Tinkaton was truly nervous.

Broken armor could be repaired - just more materials and its skilled craftsmanship.

But if Ceruledge's swords broke, repair wouldn't be a matter of just money.

"Ceruledge..."

Johan's aura had completely spread, merging with Ceruledge's aura, seeing the battlefield situation clearly while making trainer and Pokémon completely unified.

Constant defense wasn't what a swordsman should do, but if defense had purpose, that was different.

"Do you see clearly?" Johan murmured.

Ceruledge didn't respond, just stared intently at Kartana, working hard to parry while flames in its eyes grew brighter.

Simultaneously.

Ceruledge's momentum began rapidly climbing.

Swords Dance!

Using parrying force to execute Swords Dance!

The ringing was masked by blade collision sounds.

But this wasn't all!

Ceruledge's own strength also quietly improved through repeated parrying.

Battle was indeed the best path to improvement.

Kartana was also surprised by Ceruledge's changes.

"Sunlight is perfect - Sunlight Blade!"

After familiarizing with Kartana's swordsmanship, it was counterattack time!

"Goka!"

The flames accumulated in Ceruledge's body compressed to extremes at this moment, surging like volcanic eruption.

It hadn't violated its earlier "promise" by releasing flames outward.

It just converted this power into explosive force!

Simultaneously.

The single-strike style secrets learned from Bear Instructor were fully displayed!

"Goka!!"

Take this sword!

Ceruledge deflected Kartana's twin swords with one strike, its retreating steps briefly stopping before surging forward. Its blade covered with brilliant blazing energy slashed out.

Kartana's expression shook, feeling this sword's power.

"Swish..."

This sword...

Clang!!!

After the ringing, small Kartana crashed into the ground like a cannonball, the entire ground bulging then collapsing thunderously.

Rumble—

Was it over?

Watching the "livestream," Anabel and Dr. Burnet were shocked by the scene, wondering.

However, the next instant.

Boom!!

Kartana burst from the ground, twin swords still sharp, momentum climbing to an even higher peak!

This moment's Kartana had reached ordinary Champion ace Pokémon level!

It gazed intensely, pointing its sword at Ceruledge, crying out.

"My opponent, hold nothing back - let me see your strongest sword!"

Strongest sword?

Ceruledge and Johan exchanged glances.

Hiss...

White vapor escaped from beneath Ceruledge's mask.

Blade turned.

Roar!!

Flames, more intense than before, rose from its blade.

One sword punishes evil, one sword subdues souls!

Beneath Ceruledge's feet, spiraling ghostly blue flames burned upward, seeming to carry countless spirits.

At this moment, heaven, earth, and sun all seemed to dim.

"Ceruledge!"

Johan and Ceruledge's eyes opened wide simultaneously, blue aura surging.

Bitter Blade!

"Goka!"

Twin swords, Brilliant Strike!

Instantly.

Speed reached its peak, aura surged to its limit - single-strike style secret, Twin Sword Brilliant Strike!

"Swish!!"

Excellent!

Kartana's heart shook greatly. Facing Ceruledge, it advanced instead of retreating, twin swords covered in sunlight, fearlessly meeting the attack!

Sunlight Blade!

One black, one white. One dark, one bright.

Clang!!!

Crossing paths.

Victory decided!

"Goka!"

Ceruledge cried in pain, chest armor cracking with a vicious gap, falling to one knee.

"Swish..."

Kartana calmly turned around, looking at Ceruledge with satisfied expression.

This trip was worth it.

Hiss!!

Flames suddenly rose as it fell lightly to the ground.

Eyes spinning.

"Goka..."

This is a swordsman worthy of respect...

Ceruledge swayed as it stood, eyes showing respect.

Johan clutched his chest, full of pain.

Not physical pain - financial pain.

How much rare metal and materials would this battle cost...

However, seeing Ceruledge's satisfied expression, confident surging appearance, and its strength improvement.

Forget it.

Johan sighed lightly.

Worth it too.

Then he picked up the "livestreaming" Rotom Pokédex, looking at the shocked Anabel:

"Am I approving the requisition or are you?"

# 702: What Did You Do to Tapu Bulu? (Two-in-One Chapter)

"Uh..."

Anabel was stunned for three seconds before understanding what Teacher Johan meant by "requisition."

Having worked as a Frontier Brain at the Battle Frontier in Hoenn, she understood some of the Hoenn League's "customs," plus having known and worked with Teacher Johan for so long, she'd heard some "rumors."

So after a brief moment of stunned silence, she immediately said:

"I'll write it, I'll approve it."

With the strength Kartana had displayed, it really wasn't something any random Master-level trainer could handle. Anabel herself had no confidence at all, even with all her Pokémon out.

Moreover, though Teacher Johan wasn't yet a Champion, Anabel could still recognize Champion-level strength.

Just using some relatively precious materials, metals, or funding to "hire" such an existence to solve their troubles - this was simply a godsend.

If other leagues knew about this, believe it or not, dozens of phone calls would immediately blow up Teacher Johan's phone?

"Alright then, you keep busy and try to develop Poké Balls that can capture UBs as soon as possible." Johan said with a gentle smile, then ended this "livestream."

Most of the data about Kartana had already been sent to Anabel and Dr. Burnet through the Rotom Pokédex.

Dr. Burnet became busy again as well.

Meanwhile.

Johan put down the Rotom Pokédex, fed Ceruledge some stamina-restoring energy cubes, handed it over to the "heartbroken" Tinkaton, then walked toward Kartana.

"Swish..."

Kartana had regained consciousness, though it still looked quite listless, sitting dejectedly on the ground.

Noticing Johan approaching, it called out softly to indicate that once it recovered its condition and stamina, it would leave.

It had come to the Alola region to find opponents worth cutting.

Now that it had found one, it was satisfied.

However, while it could easily slice through space, cutting through the spatial barrier between the Pokémon world and Ultra Space wasn't something it could do casually with a single sword strike - it needed to find weak points between the two spaces.

"No rush."

Johan crouched down, taking out some condition-restoring energy cubes. "If you're willing, you can stay longer and spar more with Ceruledge on swordsmanship."

Having already gotten one Buzzwole, Johan didn't mind having another Kartana.

The "UB Task Force" would cover the feeding costs anyway.

At least from the clash between Kartana and Ceruledge just now, Johan had seen room for Ceruledge's improvement.

Training partners - the more the merrier.

Especially training partners funded by someone else.

Ceruledge could still learn some moves from Kartana, like X-Scissor and such.

"Swish?"

Kartana looked toward Ceruledge.

"Goka!" Ceruledge raised its blade in respect.

Though these two Pokémon had just fought intensely, neither had gotten truly angry. Instead, they both seemed to appreciate each other.

Seeing Ceruledge's stance, Kartana thought briefly, then nodded as well.

As it had indicated earlier, first it needed to recover its condition.

Second, slicing through space required timing - it couldn't just wave its hand and open a passage between the Pokémon world and Ultra Space. There needed to be spatial pathways first.

Otherwise it wouldn't be Kartana, but a sun/moon deity - even the space deities didn't have that kind of ability.

Seeing Kartana agree, Johan was in a very good mood.

Look, he'd gained another assistant for food prep.

After handling this, Johan finally looked toward Tapu Bulu.

He found it sitting lazily with Gengar, eating... popcorn?

Johan: "..."

"Moo..."

Noticing Johan's gaze, Tapu Bulu showed a friendly smile.

It had witnessed the entire Ceruledge VS Kartana process and was equally amazed by both Pokémon's strength.

Since Johan had helped it solve its biggest "trouble," it naturally wouldn't go back on its word.

"Ninetales." Johan called softly.

"Oowoo~"

Ninetales half-closed its eyes, and island aura belonging to Ula'ula Island, guided by its Fairy Aura, slowly formed pink threads that wrapped around.

At the same time.

Tapu Bulu's stance also indicated its agreement for Johan to retrieve the "Fairy Plate."

With just one more guardian deity to "convince," Johan could complete the main objective of this Alola trip.

Crunch— crunch—

Tapu Bulu's popcorn-eating motion suddenly paused as it looked toward Ninetales with some puzzlement and curiosity.

The puzzlement was the same as Tapu Koko's - how had Xerneas taught this technique?

The curiosity was wondering what kind of benefits Ninetales would gain if it could truly borrow the aura power from all four islands.

Others might not know how the island aura of the Alola region came to be, but as an island guardian deity, Tapu Bulu was very clear about it.

At this moment, Tapu Bulu felt someone beside it and looked back to see Johan with a full smile.

Tapu Bulu's heart skipped a beat.

With such a shady smile, what are you planning?

"Ahem." Johan coughed lightly. "Tapu Bulu, let's discuss something."

"Moo?"

Tapu Bulu instinctively put a little distance between itself and Johan.

It felt that smile wasn't simple, and what he wanted to say wasn't simple either.

Johan said with a relaxed expression:

"Actually it's nothing major, just want to ask for your help planting some seeds, simple germination and growth is fine."

[Really?]

Tapu Bulu's voice echoed in Johan's mind.

[Just this one thing?]

It thought Johan was going to ask it to help train Snivy.

As a Grass-type legendary, Tapu Bulu could naturally sense Snivy's uniqueness.

But honestly, Tapu Bulu disliked trouble, and teaching Pokémon was the kind of troublesome thing it usually wasn't willing to do.

But stimulating seeds to germinate and grow was much simpler - this was also what it was best at.

"Right, just this one thing." Johan's smile became even more gentle.

After staring at Johan for a long while and confirming he wasn't lying, Tapu Bulu relaxed slightly and waved its thick arm.

[That's simple.]

"Gengar!" Johan looked uncommonly excited as he called out.

"Ka-kaah!"

The well-prepared Gengar immediately brought out a box, but it wasn't filled with energy cubes - it was seeds Johan had prepared long ago.

Originally intended for planting on his own island.

Now it seemed...

He could completely have Tapu Bulu first make these seeds germinate and grow, at least to the sapling stage, then transplant them to his own island.

Even, if Tapu Bulu was willing, it could directly mature these seeds, saving him considerable time.

[Um, there are quite a few...]

Looking at the whole box of seeds, Tapu Bulu said somewhat helplessly.

[But it's fine, considering you helped...]

"Ka-kaah!"

Before it could finish, Gengar brought out another box of seeds.

[Uh...]

Then.

"Ka-kaah~ Ka-kaah~"

In Gengar's happy humming, box after box of seeds was brought out.

Tapu Bulu: "..."

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar seemed to suddenly remember something, held up one finger, then carefully took out a more special box from the shadows.

Clearly, it was a box of "Revival Herb" seeds!

Revival Herb was a medicinal plant that could pull Pokémon back from "near-death" status, working similarly to Max Revive, or rather it was one of the materials for making Max Revive.

However, Revival Herb was extremely difficult to cultivate and had very high requirements for environment and nutrients.

The Unova region produced Revival Herb because it had Landorus, who governed fertile soil, and Johan had tried growing Revival Herb before but always failed.

Of course, back then he didn't have his island yet.

Gengar had long wanted to taste what Revival Herb was like.

Tapu Bulu's eyes widened.

[Are you treating me like an old bull?]

Right after saying this, it saw Gengar point at the wooden bull horns on its head, the meaning unmistakable.

Tapu Bulu: "..."

"Thank you so much, you're working hard, Tapu Bulu."

Johan very thoughtfully brought out many boxes of energy cubes.

"These can help you restore and replenish energy."

How considerate of you.

Tapu Bulu couldn't help but grumble internally.

But having agreed to something, not doing it properly wouldn't be the style of an island guardian deity...

So.

Tapu Bulu picked up some seeds and began planting and nurturing them. Plump seeds quickly took root and sprouted, soon becoming lush green saplings.

"Sni?"

Snivy watched Tapu Bulu's movements and couldn't help approaching to observe its every action.

It thought of the "Miracle Berry" tree in the center of the island. If it could learn something from Tapu Bulu, it might be able to better help that tree.

"Sni..."

Grassy Terrain plus Grass Knot?

Plus... reverse Giga Drain?

Giga Drain could be reversed?

Snivy pondered thoughtfully, also mimicking Tapu Bulu's actions by burying a seed, then channeling Grass-type energy as grass spread from its feet.

Grassy Terrain!

Then came Grass Knot.

The seed slowly wriggled, roots and buds growing, breaking through the ground and slowly extending.

Not "Grass Seed" or a pure move, so the seed's growth speed was undoubtedly much slower than imagined.

Watching Tapu Bulu already nurture five seeds while the seed in front of it had only grown a few centimeters, Snivy pursed its lips.

"Sni..."

Reverse Giga Drain...

How to reverse this move?

It looked at Tapu Bulu again, watching it quickly nurture energy while thinking and mimicking.

In terms of learning ability, Snivy was quite outstanding.

Originally it didn't know Giga Drain, but now it had learned it.

Suddenly.

After learning Giga Drain, Snivy had a sudden realization.

"Sni..."

Reverse Giga Drain, reversing, going opposite... isn't that Contrary?

As if a light bulb went off, Snivy grasped the key, green light emanating from its hand, then through Contrary, bit by bit infusing Grass-type energy into the small sapling that could barely be called a berry tree.

For a moment.

The grass around Snivy's feet began growing rapidly, the originally two-three centimeter grass gradually growing to over ten centimeters.

And the sapling in front of it also grew at visible speed, quickly surpassing Snivy's height, exceeding one meter!

Though this growth speed couldn't compare to Tapu Bulu's, the commotion still caught the attention of both Johan and Tapu Bulu.

After a brief moment of surprise, Johan showed a gratified smile.

"This little guy..."

Ula'ula Island.

Atop Mount Lanakila.

Snow flew through the air, the entire world seemingly wrapped in silver, with a figure and an agile snow spirit walking leisurely through the blizzard.

"The temperature here is almost as cold as the Crown Tundra, isn't it?"

Johan pressed down his hat to prevent it from being blown away, looking at the white expanse before him and speaking softly.

The howling cold wind carried goose-feather snow, making it difficult for ordinary people to walk in such conditions, let alone survive.

This was a paradise for Ice-type Pokémon.

"Oowoo..."

Ninetales' azure eyes flickered as its gaze swept around, seeming to search while also reminiscing.

A slightly melancholic emotion spread from its body.

Johan didn't speak.

He just gently placed his palm on Ninetales' neck, stroking slowly and gently.

"Oowoo~"

Ninetales came back to its senses, gently nuzzling Johan with its head, its tail curling around his arm.

Breathing out slightly, ice crystals floated in the air.

No matter what its past had been, no matter what it had experienced, now it just wanted to stay with Johan, protect him, and grow and improve together with him.

If needed, it would spare no effort to help Johan achieve his goals and fulfill his wishes!

This was what it most wanted to do now!

As if hearing Ninetales' call, or perhaps sensing extremely strong Ice-type energy, the snow on the ground shifted slightly, and a crystal-like head poked out.

Blinking pure eyes with some curiosity.

It was clearly an Alolan form Sandshrew.

Like Alolan Vulpix and Ninetales, Alolan Sandshrew had originally been ordinary Sandshrew, but due to environmental changes and survival needs, they had been forced to migrate to the snowy mountains.

To adapt to the snowy mountains and extremely cold weather, Alolan Sandshrew gained Ice-type attributes.

Their originally rock and soil-adapted tan hard shells became ice-crystal covered, slowing their movement speed, but on ice or in snow, they became much faster than original Sandshrew.

Besides Ice-type, to be able to dig through solid ice, Alolan Sandshrew also gained Steel-type attributes.

However, their overly hard armor made them lose the ability to curl up and protect themselves, making their bellies their greatest weakness.

"Oowoo~"

Ninetales smiled with crescent eyes, greeting it friendly.

Rustle rustle—

A larger Alolan Sandslash suddenly emerged from the ice cave, showing little reaction to Ninetales, but immediately pressed the curious Sandshrew back down upon seeing Johan.

With some snow tumbling, the opened ice cave was buried again.

The mother protected her child very well...

Johan smiled, not minding.

He just looked at Ninetales and asked: "Want to look for your family?"

Though Ninetales had only followed Johan for a year, it had been wandering for many years before that.

With so many years passed, the seemingly unchanging peak of Mount Lanakila had actually undergone great changes.

"Oowoo~"

Ninetales seriously shook its head.

It had always wandered alone, until it met Johan and Gengar and the others.

Pulling Johan's hand, Ninetales walked toward the mountain's base.

Its family had always been by its side!

"Hm?"

Johan was startled, then understood Ninetales' thoughts and showed a gentle smile.

"However, should we go look at the 'Never-Melt Ice'?"

Under the warm farewell of Sophocles' parents, Johan stood at Sophocles' family doorstep saying goodbye.

"Sophocles has been trouble for you, thank you for taking care of him, Teacher Johan."

"This child is usually rather lazy, please supervise him more, Teacher Johan. If he causes trouble, please don't hesitate to discipline him strictly so he can learn his lesson."

Little chubby Sophocles stood between his parents, feeling somewhat indignant listening to their words but not knowing what to say, only struggling to maintain his smile.

"Sophocles is a very outstanding child." Johan smiled. "He's extremely talented with electronics. I believe he'll definitely become a remarkable inventor in the future."

Maybe Sophocles didn't have as much talent as a trainer as Penny, Flannery, Roxanne and others, and couldn't compare to Steven, but in electronics... his talent was no less than Volkner's.

"Really? Thank you so much, Teacher Johan."

Hearing Johan's praise of their child, though Sophocles' parents still seriously hoped Teacher Johan would teach strictly, they couldn't help showing heartfelt smiles.

No parents didn't want their children to succeed.

Though there wasn't so-called cramming or oppressive education, parents' expectations for their children to improve wouldn't change.

It's just that before the big goal of hoping children could become better, they added the premise of hoping children could be happy and joyful.

After repeatedly declining Sophocles' parents' invitations to stay, Johan walked on the fields outside Malie City's outskirts in a very good mood.

Actually.

His home visit purpose was partly to go to various islands and also for the artificial island where the Aether Foundation was located, and partly hoping to get parents like Sophocles, Kiawe, and Mallow to respect their children's own choices more.

Being trainers was certainly good, but their hobbies were equally important.

Now it seemed.

Their parents were all much more open-minded than he had imagined.

"Dragonite."

After walking some distance, Johan threw out a Poké Ball.

"Draaa~~"

"Let's go see how Tapu Bulu's 'work' is going."

Dragonite flapped its wings, happily carrying Johan back to above the Ruins of Abundance.

From far away.

He could hear huge thunder-like snoring sounds and see a patch of lush green scenery.

Johan's expression was strange.

Tapu Bulu was currently lying on the ground fast asleep, with several scattered energy cubes and seeds nearby, as if it had suddenly fallen asleep while "working."

"Ahem."

Landing beside Tapu Bulu, he coughed lightly with some embarrassment.

However, Tapu Bulu still showed no signs of waking up.

"Ceruledge." Johan called out. "How long has it been sleeping?"

"Goka?"

Not far away, Ceruledge, who was sparring swordsmanship with Kartana and had also been left by Johan to "supervise," shrugged.

I don't know.

"Swish!"

Kartana was equally unclear.

Well then.

It seemed Tapu Bulu was truly exhausted.

Though he still had a large batch of seeds that hadn't been planted, just from Tapu Bulu's diligent labor this one day, the harvest of berry tree saplings was quite substantial.

Even more than the saplings transplanted from the Crown Tundra's Ballimere Lake grassland.

"Thank you for your hard work."

Johan sighed lightly, his conscience seeming to stir as he put away the remaining seeds, then placed several more boxes of energy cubes.

With his own Pokémon, he dug up these varied berry tree saplings one by one.

Just this digging work was no small project.

"Phew—"

As the moon rose, Johan straightened his back, wiping sweat from his forehead and breathing out deeply.

All the saplings had been stuffed into Gengar's shadow, waiting to be planted once they returned to Hoenn.

Then he would truly harvest a large berry orchard!

"Getting closer and closer to becoming a berry tycoon."

Johan was in quite a good mood.

"Let's go, time to head back."

Looking at the moon hanging high in the night sky, Johan thought briefly but decided to return to Melemele Island.

Buzzwole was still at the Pokémon school on Melemele Island. Though Professor Kukui was watching it, it was better to return.

After placing the sleeping Tapu Bulu on what looked like a softer patch of grass, he dismissed the thought of waking it up.

He left several boxes of energy cubes as thanks.

"Thank you, Tapu Bulu." Johan said sincerely.

"Moo~ Moo~ zzZ"

"We'll come again next time."

The sleeping Tapu Bulu might or might not have heard this, as its snoring suddenly stopped, then resumed after a while.

Melemele Island, in the "bear-infested" forest.

"This kind of life is comfortable, but... it's really boring~"

Jessie lay on a pile of berries with messy hair, her whole belly seeming to have grown a size.

"And every day it's just berries and Honey, I'm getting a bit tired of it."

James took a bite of a crisp Sitrus Berry, saying while chewing.

"Wobb?"

At this moment, Bewear, who was collecting firewood in the forest, raised its head, looking in a direction with some puzzlement in its eyes, then realization.

Immediately, it dropped the firewood in its hands and rushed toward the tree hollow at incredible speed.

Under the shocked gazes of the trio, it picked them up.

"Wait, wait! What are you doing?!" Jessie cried out in alarm.

"Flying! We're flying—" James suddenly had a feeling both familiar and strange.

"Where are we going, meow?" Meowth gripped the thick arms tightly.

"Wobb~ buffet—↓"

Falling!

"We're going to fall into the ocean—"

Splash!!

Large splashes immediately rose from the sea surface.

However, the expected feeling of being surrounded by seawater didn't come. When they cautiously, slowly opened their eyes, they saw...

"Water, water walking!" ×3

It was actually holding them and running directly across the sea surface at incredible speed.

Melemele Island.

Pokémon School, Teacher Johan's faculty residence.

"Buzz! (′▽`〃)"

Buzzwole faced a mirror, admiring its own figure full of violent aesthetics with satisfaction.

Perfect! Too perfect!

Professor Kukui held the mirror, yawning loudly with tears squeezing from his eyes.

Then he saw... a bear-like Pokémon suddenly leap into the middle of the full moon, seemingly holding something in its arms.

Hm?

Professor Kukui rubbed his eyes.

"I must be too tired, I'm actually seeing a Bewear flying in the sky? And holding several people?"

While muttering, he looked toward the moon again.

Sure enough.

Besides the full moon, there was nothing there.

"Teacher Johan hasn't returned from his home visit yet? What a conscientious and responsible teacher..."

Professor Kukui sighed with admiration.

Such a good teacher, why wasn't he from their Alola Pokémon School?

If Teacher Johan was from Alola... Kukui didn't dare imagine how wonderful that would be.

He wouldn't have to worry himself sick over the Alola League anymore.

Bang—

The door was pushed open.

He's back?!

Professor Kukui perked up, looking toward the door.

Along with him was Buzzwole, who had been admiring itself for over three hours.

However.

It wasn't Johan who appeared at the door, but Dr. Burnet.

"Buzz! (′▽`〃)"

Dr. Burnet gasped heavily, first instinctively striking a pose and responding to Buzzwole: "Buzz!"

Then she looked at Professor Kukui.

"Teacher Johan hasn't returned yet?"

"No." Professor Kukui was startled, seemingly sensing Burnet's urgency and couldn't help asking: "What's wrong?"

Dr. Burnet pursed her lips and said gravely:

"I'm afraid... something big is about to happen!"

Ula'ula Island, high altitude.

"Slower, Dragonite, we're not in a hurry..."

Johan lay on Dragonite's back, gripping the harness tightly and keeping his voice low.

"Draaa~"

Dragonite obediently called out, slightly reducing its speed.

At this moment, Johan's phone suddenly rang.

The caller ID showed an unfamiliar number.

But considering he didn't have the habit of giving his number to people casually, after brief hesitation, he still pressed the answer button.

Soon, a voice he'd heard just this morning came through the phone.

"Don't tell me you stayed on Mount Lanakila until now and just came down? Your phone was unreachable the whole time!"

It was actually Ula'ula Island's Island Kahuna Nanu!

"Eh? Mr. Nanu has my contact information?"

Brief silence.

Johan continued:

"The Alola region's communication network is still a bit poor, especially in more dangerous places with complex environments. I know a very good construction team, I wonder if..."

The entire Alola region hadn't been extensively developed, which for Team Rocket was undoubtedly an excellent development location.

"I know who you know too!" Nanu said irritably.

Right.

Johan realized.

When Nanu was an International Police officer, he had a rather complex relationship with Team Rocket's leader Giovanni. Even after retiring from the front lines, they still had contact.

Nanu quickly realized he'd said too much.

So he quickly changed the subject and asked gravely:

"What did you do to Tapu Bulu?"

"Uh..."

How did this involve Tapu Bulu again?

"It's fine." Johan laughed awkwardly.

Sleeping so soundly.

The kind that couldn't be woken no matter how hard you tried.

"What happened? How does Mr. Nanu know that Tapu Bulu is, um, sleeping?"

"Sleeping?" Nanu was somewhat bewildered.

At this moment, the Rotom Pokédex suddenly floated out of Johan's pocket.

"Incoming video call, Rotom!" the Rotom Pokédex said.

Hm?

Was it a no-signal area just now?

Why did both phone calls and video calls come in as soon as they flew over?

Bzzt—

After brief blurriness, Anabel's image appeared on the Rotom Pokédex, with a tall woman with long blonde hair and a mature aura standing beside her.

Aether Foundation President, Lillie's mother, Lusamine?!

"Teacher Johan, your phone was busy, so I could only video call you."

Anabel spoke quickly, as if something important had happened, not even introducing the Aether Foundation President Lusamine beside her.

With a phone call on one side and the Rotom Pokédex floating in front of him, Johan finally realized that something big might have happened without his knowledge.

It couldn't be...

That Necrozma had awakened, could it?

This soon?

However, Anabel didn't give Johan much time to guess, instead switching the screen view.

He saw:

Under the cloudless night sky, beneath the bright moonlight, jagged rocky mountains stood tall, with a towering massive altar particularly prominent.

A cross-shaped giant altar with a circular disc at its center, bathed in moonlight and faintly emanating a soft glow.

Below was a bottomless water pool surrounding the altar's location, with special carvings and structures on the platform beneath the altar.

Altar of the Sunne!

At first glance, Johan recognized it as the ancient Altar of the Sunne located in Poni Canyon on Poni Island in the Alola region!

This was the entrance to Ultra Space's Ultra Megalopolis, and also where Solgaleo and Lunala first arrived in the Alola region.

However.

At this moment, on this seemingly peaceful altar, three Pokémon of different appearances were flying.

They were the guardian deities of the Alola region!

Tapu Koko, Tapu Lele, and Tapu Fini!

Only Ula'ula Island's guardian deity Tapu Bulu was missing.

Embarrassment flashed across Johan's face for a moment.

No wonder Nanu thought he'd done something to Tapu Bulu - so this was why...

Three of the four island guardian deities suddenly gathering at the Altar of the Sunne, with Tapu Bulu not appearing, was itself a very strange thing.

However...

The island guardian deities gathering together.

Something big was about to happen!

"At least it's not Necrozma awakening." Johan secretly breathed a sigh of relief.

Speaking of which, when Necrozma awakened, the "widespread lethargy" debuff it brought was quite an obvious characteristic.

"Ahem."

Johan said: "I'll bring Tapu Bulu with me."

# 703: Great Ultra Beast Invasion! (Two-in-One Chapter)

Originally prepared to go back to sleep, he was stubbornly called back.

As soon as he returned to the sky above the Ruins of Abundance, he saw Tapu Bulu carefully raising its head, looking around as if searching for something.

"Draaa~"

Dragonite gently landed as Johan's voice followed.

"Tapu Bulu."

Thud!

Tapu Bulu, who had just propped itself up, stiffened its entire robust body upon hearing this call, then collapsed to the ground as uneven snoring sounds slowly began.

Johan: "..."

Look how much it scared the "child."

"Alright, I won't make you till the fields anymore."

Johan irritably patted Tapu Bulu and continued:

"The other three island guardian deities have all gathered at the Altar of the Sunne in Poni Canyon on Poni Island. Didn't you sense it?"

Hearing this, Tapu Bulu slowly "woke up," looking stunned as it listened to Johan's words.

"Moo?"

It had been busy planting and nurturing all along, with considerable energy consumption.

Plus it hadn't been pretending earlier - it had truly fallen asleep, so it really hadn't sensed any special situation.

After Johan's reminder, Tapu Bulu slightly raised its head, spirit renewed, immediately looking toward Poni Island's direction.

"Moo!"

Indeed.

Johan sighed inwardly.

But Ula'ula Island was the farthest from Poni Island in the entire Alola region. Getting there would probably take some time.

"Can you still fly?" Johan asked.

Tapu Bulu didn't respond with words but proved with actions, directly flying toward Poni Island's direction.

"This guy..."

Johan didn't know if it truly had no stamina left or was faking it. He immediately climbed back onto Dragonite and chased after Tapu Bulu.

Catching up with Tapu Bulu, Johan lowered his head close to Dragonite, using aura to communicate and ask:

"Tapu Bulu, can you tell me what you sensed, what's happening?"

Tapu Bulu looked somewhat puzzled at Johan, who was pressed close to Dragonite with a slightly pale face.

But it didn't ask questions, instead answering Johan's question in a deep voice.

[Aura, or rather space. At the Altar of the Sunne, there are very strong spatial fluctuations accompanied by intense aura surges.]

Space? Aura?

Could it be...

"Is it Solgaleo and Lunala?"

From the previous phone call and video, it wasn't hard to tell that Anabel and others showed no signs of "lethargy," first ruling out Necrozma.

The only things that could cause such a disturbance seemed to be the sun deity Solgaleo and moon deity Lunala, right?

[You know about Solgaleo and Lunala?]

Tapu Bulu didn't immediately answer the question but looked at Johan with some surprise.

"I once met Solgaleo in space... I'm not sure if I really saw it or if it was a dream or hallucination. It entrusted me with some things. As for Lunala... I've fought it."

When the Ultra Demon Hoopa went out of control, it summoned nine legendary Pokémon at once, including Lunala.

[You've fought Lunala?!]

This time Tapu Bulu was truly shocked.

Because no one understood the power of Solgaleo and Lunala better than these island guardian deities.

This guy who made it "till fields" had actually fought Lunala?

Johan smiled.

"Small matter."

Tapu Bulu: "..."

Damn, he got to show off!

After a period of silence, Tapu Bulu spoke again.

[You said Solgaleo entrusted you with some things?]

"Probably." Johan wasn't too certain either.

Probably...

Tapu Bulu was already powerless to complain.

Only then did it finally talk about what it had sensed.

[Using your human terminology, massive Ultra Space fluctuations appeared at the Altar of the Sunne. There should be very strong, or rather very many Ultra Wormholes opening.]

Very strong?

Very many?

It seemed they'd have to get there to confirm.

But as long as it wasn't Necrozma, the trouble shouldn't be too big.

Probably.

Poni Island, Poni Canyon.

On the valley beside the Altar of the Sunne, precise instruments were set up, with dozens of Charjabug connected to wires, supplying electrical current.

Dr. Burnet and Aether Foundation President Lusamine were rapidly operating the instruments.

Several aircraft were parked nearby, with Anabel directing International Police and their Pokémon to unload more equipment from the planes.

"Dr. Burnet, President Lusamine, the situation..."

Anabel couldn't help but ask.

She looked toward the Altar of the Sunne across from them, where three island guardian deities were hovering around the altar, seemingly waiting for or worrying about something.

Professor Kukui stood at the canyon's edge, trying to contact Tapu Koko on the Altar of the Sunne across the wide, deep canyon, but getting little response.

"Thanks to Teacher Johan letting us investigate UB02: Expansion, that is Buzzwole, our monitoring system was able to make a breakthrough."

Dr. Burnet said without looking back.

As the Aether Foundation's president and herself an outstanding researcher, Lusamine stared intently at the instrument screen and said:

"If nothing unexpected happens, extremely dense and massive Ultra Space fluctuations will appear here."

"Ultra Space fluctuations?" Anabel frowned slightly.

"Either a huge Ultra Wormhole, or... many Ultra Wormholes!" Lusamine said gravely.

Her hands trembled slightly, and her eyes, hidden from Anabel as she faced the screen, contained barely suppressible excitement.

Perhaps because she knew her own state, Lusamine quickly lowered her head and continued operating the instruments.

Either a huge Ultra Wormhole or many Ultra Wormholes - wouldn't that represent...

"This is a massive invasion of Ultra Space into our world?" Anabel asked for confirmation.

Though she didn't want to admit it.

After a pause in her movements, Dr. Burnet still nodded:

"Most likely, yes."

!!

Anabel's heart tightened involuntarily.

The appearance of a single Ultra Beast could bring considerable impact to the Alola region.

She had previously witnessed the battle between Teacher Johan's Ceruledge and Kartana, plus Buzzwole's strength...

It could be said that every Ultra Beast that came to the Pokémon world displayed incredibly powerful strength.

It was hard to imagine what kind of destruction would occur to the Alola region if a large group appeared.

"Why is this happening? What caused it?" Anabel asked again.

Though Ultra Wormholes had appeared sporadically before, most only opened briefly before closing.

Most situations involved no Ultra Beasts appearing.

And the few times Ultra Beasts descended, they appeared one by one, and the Ultra Wormholes would close quickly.

Why would such a big disturbance suddenly occur this time?

"We currently don't know the cause."

Lusamine suddenly stood up, a rubber band appearing in her hand as she tied her waterfall-like golden hair back.

Turning to the Aether Foundation members getting off another aircraft, she ordered:

"Move quickly, assemble it!"

"Understood!"

Faba, the Aether Foundation branch chief wearing a white lab coat and large light-green sunglasses, responded.

Under his command, Aether Foundation members rapidly assembled more precise and complex instruments on site.

"This is..."

Looking at the Aether Foundation's actions and the instruments being assembled, Anabel was stunned.

Lusamine had already tied her hair and put on a white lab coat, saying with slight excitement:

"I'm going to start attempting."

"Attempting?"

"Attempting to create special Poké Balls capable of capturing UBs!"

This was one of the Aether Foundation's important projects. Though they'd been unable to break through certain technical barriers before, the collection of data from Buzzwole and Kartana had solved the difficulties.

Though creating Poké Balls capable of capturing UBs was still no simple matter.

But at this moment, in this area where Ultra Space aura fluctuations were becoming increasingly dense, it was undoubtedly a good opportunity!

Even if the production costs might be extremely high.

But the Aether Foundation really wasn't short of money.

After learning the specific situation, Anabel had to gather forces.

The International Police of the "UB Task Force" and the League police forces like Officer Jenny from Poni Island went without saying.

But these forces were fine against ordinary wild Pokémon or common criminals and Pokémon poachers, but against potentially powerful Ultra Beasts, they seemed insufficient.

As for top-level trainers...

Anabel looked at the petite Hapu, who had just become Poni Island's acting Island Kahuna, feeling somewhat helpless.

Hapu was the granddaughter of former Poni Island King Sofu, and with Sofu's teaching plus inheriting several of her grandfather's Pokémon, her strength was indeed not weak.

However, Hapu hadn't yet gained Tapu Fini's recognition, and being truly young, she hadn't officially become the Island Kahuna.

But ultimately.

Hapu was still Poni Island's current "main person in charge," but due to inexperience and youth, she seemed somewhat flustered and at a loss.

Additionally.

There were Ula'ula Island's Island Kahuna Nanu and Akala Island's Island Kahuna Olivia.

Nanu needn't be mentioned - he was the one who had originally discovered and saved her, her former supervisor's supervisor. He was currently leaning against an instrument yawning while playing with his kendama.

Whether he hadn't slept well during his afternoon nap or not, Nanu looked completely listless.

As for Akala Island's Island Kahuna Olivia... she seemed very capable and was the first to approach Anabel to ask about the situation.

"Miss Anabel, the current situation is... ah!"

She'd only taken a few steps.

Thud!!

Her high heel stepped on a stone on the ground, and she fell face-first directly down.

Anabel's expression at that moment was: Σ(っ°Д°;)っ

"Kahuna Olivia, are you alright!"

Before Anabel could help her up, Olivia had already pushed herself up from the ground, rubbing her reddened cheek and laughing: "I'm fine, I'm fine, I'm used to it already, hahaha—"

This Island Kahuna's biggest characteristic was easily tripping on flat ground.

You couldn't call it a personality problem - she looked quite sharp and even wore high heels.

But from when she arrived here until now, she'd already fallen four times!

Thud!

After a few more steps, she fell again.

Well, the fifth time.

Even her Pokémon Lycanroc seemed completely indifferent, apparently long accustomed to it.

If Johan's Dragonite were here, it would definitely consider Olivia a kindred spirit.

Both fellow "flat-ground fallers"!

Anabel held her forehead.

With four Island Kahunas total, the three present were all like this, filling Anabel with helplessness.

The current Alola League hadn't been established yet, so the Island Kahunas and Anabel, as International Police Inspector, were the highest-ranking people present.

Plus the Inspector's special authority, Anabel was essentially the overall supervisor.

Originally, except for Poni Island's acting Island Kahuna Hapu, neither Nanu nor Olivia could leave to protect their own islands, just like Hala on Melemele Island.

But because Ula'ula Island still had Molayne and Acerola, and Akala Island had Kiawe, plus considering Hapu's youth, both had come.

Melemele Island's Hala had also said he would send someone more capable than himself to assist. Initially thinking it was Teacher Johan, Hala later clarified it wasn't, but the person still hadn't arrived...

"Everyone."

Anabel took a deep breath, conveying the information she'd gotten from Dr. Burnet and President Lusamine to the three exactly as received.

Hapu tensed her face, clenching her fists.

Though young and inexperienced, Hapu was the first to speak up.

"I will definitely, definitely protect Poni Island!"

This was the place her grandfather had protected his whole life, and where she was born and loved, so she would use all her strength!

Olivia comfortingly patted Hapu's shoulder, saying seriously:

"Don't worry, we're all here too."

Nanu yawned loudly, tears squeezing from his eyes as he said lazily:

"Hasn't Johan arrived yet? If he comes, there shouldn't be any problem."

"Teacher Johan..." Anabel looked at her phone helplessly: "The signal's lost again."

The Alola region's infrastructure was still too poor. It really needed more development, at least getting the communication network properly set up.

But in the current Alola region, as head of the "UB Task Force," Anabel only had authority over the Island Kahunas when facing UBs. She didn't have authority to develop the Alola region.

The Alola League needed to be established quickly.

Just then.

The three island guardian deities on the Altar of the Sunne suddenly stopped their hovering and looked up simultaneously.

"They're coming!"

Dr. Burnet, operating the instruments, suddenly shouted.

On the instrument screen, the grid-like spatial display showed depressions, collapses, and special spatial fluctuations.

This represented the opening of Ultra Wormholes!

Instantly.

Everyone and every Pokémon became tense.

What exactly would descend?

"Not just one!" Dr. Burnet exclaimed: "Not just one Ultra Wormhole!"

As soon as she spoke.

Hum—

A hole emitting special light slowly opened in the night sky, with spiral-shaped spatial passages appearing.

Immediately after.

As if a floodgate had opened, one after another, Ultra Wormholes of various sizes appeared above the Altar of the Sunne.

The people below gaped in shock.

Of course, there were also those who seemed exceptionally excited besides shocked, like Aether Foundation President Lusamine and Branch Chief Faba.

"Quick! Record everything, collect information - Ultra Beasts are about to appear!" Faba ordered.

Lusamine, creating special Poké Balls, looked at the sky with some fanaticism, not speaking but accelerating the production process.

"What UBs will they be..." Anabel gripped her Poké Ball.

After the Ultra Wormholes opened wide, there was a brief calm.

As if time in the entire world had stopped, everyone watched the Ultra Wormholes with worry, anticipation, fear, or unease, wondering why nothing was coming out yet.

The unknown was often most frightening.

In this silence, only the flying sand of Poni Canyon made sounds.

Suddenly.

Hum—

A bright silver, syringe-like long needle suddenly pierced out from one of the Ultra Wormholes.

This sudden appearance made everyone's hearts skip a beat.

Then.

The Ultra Wormhole seemed to flicker as the metal needle swayed slightly, and a purple, wasp-like yet dragon-like creature squeezed out!

Its massive size, deep purple body, bat-like wings, dragon-like head, strong and powerful arms, and wasp-like abdomen with three needle structures - two short, one long - gleamed menacingly under the moonlight.

Naganadel!

If Johan were here, he'd definitely recognize this Ultra Beast emerging from the Ultra Wormhole as the Poison Pin Pokémon, Poison and Dragon-type Naganadel!

Its body length exceeded four meters, with a massive size looking extremely aggressive, especially the sharp long needles at its abdomen's tip.

"UB: Stinger!" Anabel immediately called out, coding this never-before-seen Ultra Beast and marking it by its abdominal needles as its most obvious identifier.

As soon as Naganadel burst from the Ultra Wormhole, its technologically advanced blue eyes swept around.

It immediately noticed the three island guardian deities below and sensed this place's somewhat familiar... aura!

"ROAAR!!!"

A roar.

Echoed throughout the canyon.

[Leave this place!]

[This is not where you belong!]

[Return to your Ultra Space!]

The three island guardian deities faced the roaring Naganadel, immediately speaking up and unhesitatingly charging forward.

Sensing the threat.

"ROAAR—!!!"

Naganadel roared again and launched an attack without hesitation.

From its thick, hard needle holes, deep purple liquid with a strong stench shot out, rapidly weaving into a massive poison web in the air, enveloping the three island guardian deities.

Though the island guardian deities differed in form, appearance, and abilities - Electric-type Tapu Koko, Psychic-type Tapu Lele, and Water-type Tapu Fini - they all shared Fairy-type attributes, making them all weak to Poison-type attacks!

And Naganadel's specialty was poison!

Moreover, being Poison-type meant it was no longer so afraid of Fairy-types as a Dragon-type.

Sizzle—

Golden arcs burst from Tapu Koko's body as it became a golden arrow piercing toward the toxic web.

Light appeared in Tapu Lele's eyes as psychic power erupted, enveloping all three guardian deities.

Tapu Fini surged with powerful water jets, also aiming to destroy the toxic web.

However.

Before the three island guardian deities' attacks could hit, more sharp needles emerged from the other opened Ultra Wormholes in the night sky.

"So many?!" Anabel's expression immediately changed.

The next second.

Thud— Thud—

Before these Naganadel had fully emerged from the Ultra Wormholes, streams of thick purple poison shot toward the three island guardian deities.

The dense toxic attacks instantly corroded through Tapu Lele's psychic barrier, landing on the three island guardian deities.

Though not causing substantial damage, the toxic poison made purple toxic hazes appear on the three island guardian deities.

They were poisoned!

Caught completely off-guard!

Immediately after.

One after another, Naganadel squeezed out of the Ultra Wormholes.

Their numbers exceeded ten!

This staggering quantity.

But this still wasn't the end.

After all the Naganadel had flown out of the Ultra Wormholes, more creatures similar to Naganadel but obviously much smaller, with needles on their heads instead, emerged from the Ultra Wormholes.

Poipole!

Naganadel's previous evolutionary stage.

After flying out, they also spat streams of thick purple poison from their mouths.

"UB: Sticky!"

Anabel threw out Poké Balls while naming this group of Poipole.

Ten, twenty, thirty, forty...

The numbers made Anabel's heart sink.

Such a massive Ultra Beast group... if each one showed strength like the initial Naganadel, then perhaps...

This would no longer be just a crisis involving Poni Island, but a massive crisis threatening the entire Alola region, even the entire Pokémon world!

However.

Anabel soon breathed a sigh of relief.

She found that though these "UB: Sticky" were more numerous, their strength seemed far inferior to the "UB: Stinger."

More like...

A migration, or rather an assault, by powerful evolved Pokémon in a group protecting weaker, unevolved members!

Evolution forms existed among UBs?

This was another new discovery!

But obviously, now wasn't the time to focus on this.

Even if these "UB: Sticky" were weaker, they were still Ultra Beasts and equally dangerous.

Moreover, it was such a massive group.

Not to mention the dozen or so "UB: Stinger" that were clearly formidable.

Even the island guardian deities couldn't break through the poison barrier this group of "UB: Stinger" had woven.

On one hand, the island guardian deities were indeed countered by Poison-types.

On the other hand, these Naganadel's attack range was absurdly long.

Even at over a hundred meters distance, the Naganadel's poison could still threaten the guardian deities.

In this situation, a row of Naganadel plus a large group of Poipole flying in the sky, continuously spewing poison, was like facing artillery and rifle formations with unlimited ammunition.

Breaking through?

With aerial advantage.

Unless they could withstand the poison attacks, they'd hardly have a chance to counterattack.

If there were a top trainer specializing in Steel-type Pokémon present, the situation might be slightly different.

But the problem was, there wasn't a single top trainer specializing in Steel-types.

But if this continued.

Even with the Alola region's support, the three island guardian deities probably couldn't hold out.

So they had to fight, and fight quickly!

Just then.

"Magnezone, Zap Cannon!"

A shirtless trainer wearing an exaggerated mask threw out a Poké Ball and shouted.

A beam filled with metallic luster shot from bottom to top, tearing open a gap in the impenetrable toxic "web."

"The Royal Masked Man?" Anabel looked somewhat surprised.

Was this the helper stronger than Kahuna Hala had mentioned?

Noticing Anabel's gaze, Professor Kukui, who had hurriedly changed equipment to become the Royal Masked Man, grinned showing white teeth and gave her a thumbs up.

With someone firing the first "shot," human trainers finally began joining the battle.

Even if poisoned and affected by toxins, they had to fight back!

Anabel: "Salamence, Draco Meteor! Mismagius, Shadow Ball!"

Nanu: "Honchkrow, Hurricane! Persian, Thunderbolt!"

Olivia: "Probopass, Zap Cannon!"

Hapu: "Flygon, Steel Wing! Claydol, Hyper Beam!"

Whether Anabel or Nanu, their countermeasures against airborne opponents were indeed concerning.

Olivia and Hapu needn't be mentioned - one specialized in Rock-types, the other in Ground-types, neither ideal for aerial combat.

Boom!!!

Kukui's Magnezone opened a gap first, with Anabel and the others' Pokémon quickly following up.

Massive explosions erupted in the sky.

"ROAAR!!!"

The lead Naganadel that had first emerged roared, and all the airborne Naganadel immediately moved into action.

The lead Naganadel folded its wings, surrounded by surging poison, charging toward the three island guardian deities!

Venoshock!

The already poisoned guardian deities were inevitably weakened.

Poison-type Pokémon showed completely different battle stances when facing poisoned versus unpoisoned opponents.

Once opponents were poisoned, moves like Venoshock and Poison Jab could "punish" them.

While stalling for time, opponents would gradually lose their ability to resist.

The lead Naganadel seemed to understand the guardian deities' abilities, keeping the battle airborne, not landing or approaching ground level, preventing the guardian deities from displaying their true strength.

It actually managed to single-handedly hold off the three poisoned guardian deities with its own power!

Its strength was at least that of an ordinary Champion's ace Pokémon!

The other dozen or so Naganadel, though weaker, united to present a near "legion" formation.

Moreover, several could withstand Anabel and others' Pokémon attacks.

Even Professor Kukui's Magnezone could barely manage self-preservation in this situation.

But besides these Naganadel, there was also the group of Poipole.

Their numbers already exceeded the International Police Anabel had brought, even exceeding the Aether Foundation's combat personnel.

In just moments.

Except for the few Steel-type Pokémon, almost all the Pokémon in battle had been poisoned!

Instantly.

Deep purple toxic fog almost filled the entire Poni Canyon area.

No one had expected the situation to become like this.

Even knowing about the Ultra Wormholes forming...

Who knew so many Ultra Beasts would appear?

And all Poison-types that could fly with tactical coordination!

The Joy and "medical team" on site, plus the Aether Foundation's support team combined, couldn't keep up with treating all these poisoned Pokémon.

Anabel immediately used her Inspector authority to sound the alarm throughout the Alola region, summoning trainers, especially top-level trainers, to support Poni Island.

But support would take considerable time to arrive.

By then, the situation was unpredictable...

"Flygon!"

Hapu cried out as her Flygon, after struggling twice, finally succumbed to the Naganadel's poison and crashed to the ground.

With Flygon's defeat, the League's defensive line was breached.

Sizzle!!

Tapu Koko's Thunderbolt hit the lead Naganadel, earning a pained cry, but it very rationally didn't press the attack, instead quickly pulling back.

Only seeking to entangle and stall, not to defeat the three island guardian deities.

"Damn it, just flying around up there, and so high!" Olivia angrily kicked a stone on the ground.

Hapu tensed her face, pursing her lips, her small face full of anxiety.

This was now a matter concerning the entire Alola region.

Another drawback of the Alola region not having a League was revealed.

Without League authority for coordination, all of the Alola region's four islands' combat power couldn't be quickly assembled in a short time.

Now they could only stall.

Stall until the island guardian deities dealt with the lead Naganadel.

Most importantly, they knew too little about this group of Ultra Beasts, being caught completely off-guard with many Pokémon poisoned as a result.

If they could have learned about these Ultra Beasts' characteristics earlier, they wouldn't be so passive.

Of course.

In the air, Anabel and others couldn't do anything about the Naganadel and could only defend passively, but if they came down... it would be a different story.

But the fear was that without their entanglement and stalling, this group of Naganadel and Poipole would fly to other islands or scatter, creating real trouble.

Just then.

"Gengar, Shadow Ball! Dragonite, Dragon Rush!"

A familiar voice came from the distance.

Anabel's eyes lit up, and Nanu also exhaled slightly, putting one hand in his pocket with a slightly relaxed expression.

The "big guy" had arrived.

"Teacher Johan!" Anabel said with delight.

"Ka-kaah!"

The mischievous Gengar appeared behind a Naganadel without anyone noticing, launching a Shadow Ball.

Then Dragonite, transformed into a blue-purple dragon, heavily struck it.

Boom!!!

Just as Anabel and others had been caught off-guard, this Naganadel was also caught completely off-guard.

It lost its ability to battle!

And fell from the sky.

Witnessing this scene, all the Naganadel paused briefly before roaring angrily in unison at Gengar and Dragonite.

"ROAAR—!!!"

Fury blazed in their eyes.

Even the seemingly small Poipole burst into angry roars.

But Gengar maintained an unmoved expression, picking its nose and placing its hand beside its ear, tilting its head in a listening pose.

"Ka-kaah?"

Haven't eaten? This old ghost can't hear you~

Others might not understand the specific information about Naganadel and Poipole, but Johan... was quite clear about it.

Information gaps could also be reflected in combat power.
