# 704: Johan: "I Can Represent!" (Two-in-One Chapter)

"Teacher Johan!"

Seeing Johan slowly descending from the sky while holding onto Tapu Bulu's hoof, Anabel and the others immediately breathed a sigh of relief.

When truly facing major events, the pressure on those standing at the forefront was enormous.

Though Anabel and the others weren't afraid of trouble, they feared that their insufficient abilities might lead the Alola region into crisis.

Now with Teacher Johan's arrival, regardless of anything else, at least they had a reliable backbone to stabilize everyone's hearts.

Thud—

Johan, with a slightly pale complexion, landed steadily and exhaled lightly.

"Moo~"

Tapu Bulu looked at him with a slightly strange expression, as if it had discovered some "secret."

Johan didn't look at it, avoiding having any "clues" seen through. He caught his breath slightly and steadied his footing.

Standing on solid ground was still reassuring.

So this was the feeling of 'as long as I stand upon the earth, I will not be defeated,' Johan thought.

I must have been "influenced" by Boss Giovanni's "Mysteries of the Earth."

Yes, that's right!

"Rotom, record!" Johan said softly.

"Understood, Rotom!"

The Rotom Pokédex floated out, activating its filming and analysis functions to start recording.

The happiest time was when Gengar went out to battle, because then no one could interfere with its filming.

At the same time, Anabel and the others also gathered around.

Johan recognized Anabel and Nanu, and though he hadn't met Hapu and Olivia face-to-face, he could roughly guess their identities. However, the "Royal Masked Man" hiding not far away...

Seeming to notice Johan's gaze, Professor Kukui grinned showing his white teeth, somewhat panicked as he gave him a thumbs up.

Why does Teacher Johan's gaze seem strange?

He couldn't have been seen through, right? Probably not, probably wasn't seen through... Professor Kukui felt uneasy.

Fortunately, Johan nodded slightly then looked away, subsequently greeting Anabel and the others.

Meanwhile, Anabel also briefly explained the course of events and developments, as well as the troublesome situation they currently faced.

On the other side.

Aether Foundation President Lusamine gently wiped her forehead, looking at the descending Johan.

"So this is the 'legendary' Teacher Johan?"

"President Lusamine, if this continues, we won't be able to hold out much longer." Faba hurriedly approached.

For some reason, he felt "danger" in his heart, especially when President Lusamine looked toward Teacher Johan.

As if his title as "President Lusamine's most trusted person" was slowly being lost.

Lusamine withdrew her gaze, looking at the Naganadel and Poipole in the sky, her eyes showing some fervor.

Then she quickly lowered her head again, operating the instruments.

"Soon, it'll be completed very soon!"

"President Lusamine, do you need my help?" Faba asked.

"Put those materials into the instruments."

"Right away!"

Faba happily did the "manual labor."

"That's basically the situation." Anabel quickly explained the simple course of events.

Actually, the on-site situation was quite clear, so she didn't need to explain too much.

Johan had originally harbored some worry that a Solgaleo or Lunala might appear, which would make things quite troublesome.

Now with this group of Naganadel and Poipole...

Though their numbers were troublesome, at least Johan had somewhat guessed the reason for their appearance here.

However.

While they were briefly communicating, the group of Naganadel in the sky had already reacted and launched attacks without hesitation at Gengar and Dragonite, who had defeated their companion!

The reason they were strong, the reason they had such coordination, was because they were sufficiently united!

"ROAR!!!"

Roars rose and fell.

Johan immediately put away his complex thoughts.

Just as Anabel had described earlier, this group of Naganadel and Poipole flew high in the sky, relying on their extremely long attack range, poison's special properties, plus their own agility, making them very troublesome and difficult to handle.

Even for Johan.

Facing Naganadel flying so high, he would find it somewhat troublesome.

But only "somewhat."

Five Naganadel, after breaking free from their opponents' entanglement, immediately raised their metal needles and shot out poisonous liquid containing deadly toxins at Gengar and Dragonite.

Facing the thick poison, Gengar picked its nose and put on a completely unconcerned attitude.

"Teacher Johan, be careful!"

Seeing this, Hapu couldn't help but call out in warning.

She didn't know what the title "Teacher Johan" meant, but seeing how much Anabel and Uncle Nanu valued and respected him, he certainly wasn't an ordinary trainer.

It's just that her Flygon had earlier fallen to the poisonous siege, so she called out in warning.

Though Anabel and the others trusted Teacher Johan, they had also witnessed the Naganadel's strength. If he were enveloped by these toxins, Gengar might be fine, but Dragonite...

After being poisoned, battling would become very troublesome.

In fact.

Johan understood the power of deadly poison better than any of them.

In terms of poison-using tactics and strategies, he wasn't boasting, but all the people present combined might not match him.

But hearing Hapu's warning and seeing the slightly worried expressions of Anabel and the others, Johan still smiled slightly to reassure them.

Then.

They watched as...

"Ka-kaah!"

Seeing the poison getting closer, Gengar couldn't help but grin mischievously, then grabbed its mouth with one hand above and one below, pulling hard!

Gengar's mouth immediately opened wide.

In one gulp, it swallowed all the poison!

"Ate, ate, ate it?" Hapu's eyes widened.

Even Anabel, who knew Johan's capabilities, couldn't help but open her mouth in shock upon seeing this scene, not knowing what to say.

Olivia and Nanu exchanged glances, both seeing astonishment in each other's eyes.

Gulp—

Gengar's swallowing sound was a bit loud.

No way.

Really eating it?

"Ka-kaah~ (´∀`)"

Gengar patted its belly and licked its tongue.

So delicious!

Hum—

A light purple glow appeared on Gengar's body, but quickly disappeared.

At this moment, not only were Anabel and the others below dumbfounded, but even the opposing Naganadel and Poipole were stunned.

What was this situation?

Whether Naganadel or Poipole, this was the first time they'd seen such a thing.

"Heh." Johan chuckled lightly.

The deadly poison that Anabel and the others found most troublesome could probably only fill a gap in Gengar's teeth.

"ROAR!!!"

Seeing this, the Naganadel refused to believe it and again aimed at Gengar, their needles spewing out even more, thicker, and stronger toxins than before.

However, the result was the same - Gengar opened its mouth and swallowed all the poison.

"Ka-kaah?"

Got any more?

Gengar looked at the Naganadel with slight expectation.

The Naganadel: "..."

Just kidding, we've been nibbling on Arbok poison fangs like jelly since we were little, alright?

Though Poison-type wasn't Gengar's most proficient attribute, if you ignored Gengar's Poison-type attribute because of this... well, those opponents who were badly poisoned when battling Gengar would have something to say.

"ROAR!!!"

By this point, the Naganadel understood.

Their most prized poison was useless against Gengar.

Fortunately, they weren't purely Poison-type Pokémon.

Following one Naganadel's call.

Hum hum hum—

Streams of dense Dragon-type energy began gathering, accompanied by intense energy fluctuations, like energy cannons being set up.

But sensing this Dragon Pulse power, Dragonite became somewhat excited.

"Draaa!!!"

It called out energetically, and surging Dragon-type energy immediately appeared on its body.

"Extreme Speed!"

Johan commanded without hesitation.

Whoosh—

Dragonite and Gengar almost simultaneously disappeared from their original positions, vanishing from the Naganadel's sight.

When the Naganadel were searching for their traces.

They only saw a thick arrow tinged with greenish light shooting toward them at extreme speed.

Outrage!

What Anabel and the others found most troublesome was the Naganadel's poison, aerial advantage, and speed, right?

And speed was what Dragonite feared least!

Bang!!!

Dragonite solidly struck a Naganadel's belly, instantly shattering its charged Dragon Pulse!

"Ninetales, Tinkaton, Tyranitar."

Johan threw out Poké Balls in succession.

"Oowoo—"

"Bangi!!!"

Snow slowly fell as the surrounding temperature plummeted.

Sand gradually flew up, churning within the wind and snow, the two forces seeming to merge together.

The sandstorm made the snowstorm larger, while the freezing made the sand particles harder and more painful when they hit.

"Cha?"

Seeing the sky full of Naganadel and Poipole, Tinkaton's eyes lit up. She immediately grabbed stones that Tyranitar had just condensed from beside its feet.

Raising her hammer, she threw without hesitation, not even aiming.

Just kidding, aim?

Didn't she see the sky was full of targets?

Flying high was one thing, but this hammer girl was also professional at "bird hunting" - it was instinct, carved into her bones.

"Oowoo!"

Ninetales crouched on all fours, a strange aura flowing toward it like veins.

Having experienced the auras of Melemele Island and Ula'ula Island, it was already accustomed to this aura power, quickly absorbing and converting it into its own strength.

In the already cold region, the temperature continued to plummet.

A wind and snow that connected the sky and ground suddenly surged.

Some weaker Poipole, just under this suddenly dropping temperature, began swaying and falling toward the ground.

Flying high?

No problem, the higher you fly, the colder it gets.

"Bangi!"

Tyranitar roared skyward.

This was a barren great canyon, a desert - its territory!

In the "Desert Tyrant's" territory, you still want to be arrogant?

The sandstorm that originally couldn't quite reach the height instantly swept upward, and more Poipole couldn't withstand the sandstorm's assault and slowly fell.

"So incredible..." Acting Island Kahuna Hapu swallowed and said quietly.

They all had no way to deal with this group of Naganadel flying so high, at most sending some flying Pokémon or those with longer attack ranges to respond.

But even with long attack ranges, by the time attacks reached high altitude, not only had their speed decreased, but how much power remained was unknown.

The Naganadel were actually the same.

But the Naganadel had the advantage of numbers, allowing for large-area coverage, plus poison didn't need much impact force - the focus was on the poison's strength.

But now.

Those that could fly took flying stances to strike.

Those that couldn't fly... could also interfere and attack through other means.

Moreover.

Whether Gengar, Dragonite, or Ninetales, Tinkaton, and Tyranitar, all displayed powerful explosive force, posing huge threats to the Naganadel and Poipole.

"Is this the strength of a Champion-level trainer?" Olivia also sighed.

As natives of the Alola region, being Island Kahunas or Island Kings already represented the highest combat power of their region.

But when seeing the strength Johan displayed, they still deeply felt the gap between the Alola region and outside regions.

So this was the top-level combat power a region should truly possess.

They had been too arrogant, too self-satisfied.

Perhaps the Alola region really should establish an Alola League and connect more with the outside world, allowing both the region's average strength and top-level strength to improve.

Professor Kukui didn't know what they were thinking, but if he did, he'd be very grateful to Johan, as this would greatly reduce the resistance to establishing the Alola League.

At the same time, he might also say... don't use Teacher Johan as a reference - his "standard" was too high.

But just when they thought Teacher Johan was already going all out, Johan threw out two more Poké Balls.

"Regieleki, Regidrago!"

"Regi—"

"Regi—!!!"

One electric, one dragon - the two Regis made their grand entrance.

Since this wasn't formal combat anyway, exceeding the Pokémon count didn't matter.

Regieleki and Regidrago's strength was quite reliable.

This still wasn't enough.

"Victini, Marshadow!"

"Vii~"

"Marsha?"

Victini, who had been invisible on Johan's shoulder, and Marshadow, hiding in his shadow, both came out.

"Good grief."

Nanu, who had been relatively calm on the side, couldn't stay calm anymore after seeing Johan's moves.

Two Regis, two Mythical Pokémon, plus Johan's own Pokémon, and the true strength these Pokémon hadn't fully displayed yet - such a lineup...

Even facing legendary first-tier deities, they'd have the ability to fight head-on, right?

Not to mention Johan had so many friends and his reputation as a "legendary tamer."

"N-nine?"

Compared to Nanu knowing about these Pokémon, Hapu and Olivia were more concerned about the numbers.

The number of Pokémon a trainer could simultaneously command was limited, because a person's energy and reaction ability were limited.

Six was the theoretical limit for the number of Pokémon a trainer could command, based on years of experience.

Any more would require establishing a legion centered around one or more Pokémon, like Agatha did.

The number of Pokémon Teacher Johan had summoned at once had reached nine!

And it seemed he was commanding them quite smoothly.

They once again felt the strength gap between themselves and top-level trainers from outside the Alola region.

Whether from the Pokémon's strength perspective or the trainer's ability perspective, there was a gap.

Originally, the dozen or so Naganadel seemed difficult to handle not only because they cooperated, but also because each one's individual strength wasn't weak.

But now...

It seemed like no problem at all.

So all of them together really weren't as good as one Teacher Johan.

This was why so many regions and leagues competed to recruit Teacher Johan... Professor Kukui sighed inwardly.

If Teacher Johan was willing, he'd also want to recruit Teacher Johan to the soon-to-be-established Alola League.

By then, forget Champion - he'd be fine with giving Teacher Johan the League President position too!

But if Johan knew Kukui's thoughts, he might pack up and run away overnight.

Champion and League President?

And in a newly established league?

With so many big and small matters, it would definitely drive Johan crazy.

"Gengar!"

While these people's thoughts were churning, Johan called over Gengar.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar emerged from the space behind him, tongue licking the corner of its mouth, swallowing a drop of poison.

The purple chubby patted its belly, somewhat regretful.

Not even half full.

These Naganadel stopped using Poison-type moves, what a pity.

"Come, let's go meet that Naganadel leader." Johan patted its head and smiled.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar's sneaky eyes rolled, saliva secreting in its mouth.

The Naganadel leader?

That poison must taste... even better, right?

Taking Gengar with him, Johan circled around to where the Naganadel leader was entangled with the four island guardian deities.

Earlier, it was the Naganadel leader dragging down the island guardian deities, preventing them from interfering with the other battlefield.

Now it was reversed - the four island guardian deities were dragging down the Naganadel leader, preventing it from affecting Johan's "cleanup."

"ROAR!!!"

The Naganadel leader was quite anxious, but even though its strength was great, it had only barely been able to hold off three island guardian deities before.

Now with all four island guardian deities gathered, just to hold it back, it naturally had no possibility of breaking through the encirclement.

However, seeing Johan and Gengar approach, the Naganadel leader gradually became more violent.

It saw clearly.

It was because of this human's appearance that the battle situation was directly reversed.

If not for this human...

"Tapu Koko! Tapu Bulu! And Tapu Lele, Tapu Fini, let me communicate with this guy." Johan shouted loudly.

"Moo?"

The four island guardian deities looked at each other.

Tapu Lele and Tapu Fini were meeting Johan for the first time, while Tapu Koko and Tapu Bulu, after exchanging glances, represented the four island guardian deities in agreeing to Johan's request.

Johan smiled slightly in thanks.

"Naganadel!"

Using aura, Johan's voice echoed in the Naganadel leader's mind.

"ROAR!!!"

Facing Johan, the Naganadel leader was filled with rage, roaring angrily.

Johan ignored this rage and continued:

"So, your group came to the Pokémon world, came to the Alola region, to find a habitat, right?"

Hearing this, the Naganadel leader was stunned.

It looked around - the four island guardian deities hadn't relaxed their vigilance.

The Gengar beside Johan that looked carefree and playful also made it feel enormous threat.

It knew that with just its own power, it couldn't do anything to this human.

However, it also became curious and puzzled about Johan's words.

Suppressing its anger, using telepathy, the Naganadel's voice also echoed in Johan's mind.

"How do you know, needleless one?"

To Naganadel, beings were divided into those with needles and those without.

As expected.

Johan sighed inwardly.

In the original Sun and Moon anime, Ash's Poipole belonged to a group of Poipole in Ultra Space, with their leader also being a Naganadel. Originally it should have been extremely powerful, but had become particularly weak due to age.

Actually, in the original Ultra Space, it was a sunny, resource-rich world like the Pokémon world, inhabited by large numbers of Ultra Beasts.

The Ultra Beasts lived particularly comfortable and affluent lives.

But due to a massive asteroid's appearance, Necrozma in Ultra Space had to use itself to oppose the huge asteroid to protect Ultra Space.

Though it ultimately succeeded in shattering the asteroid, this also caused its own energy to be depleted, all light to disappear, and it fell into slumber.

From that time, Ultra Space gradually lost its light, the entire space becoming extremely dark.

Without light, plants began withering, no longer producing fruit, and the Ultra Beasts in Ultra Space lost the food they needed to survive.

The old Naganadel in the anime had once said that it should have led the group to find a new, developable habitat, but it was too old and weak to do so, which was why it sent out Ash's Poipole.

Now, obviously this group of Naganadel living in Ultra Space, having lost their food source, was looking for new habitat.

Whether by coincidence or intention, they had passed through Ultra Wormholes to reach the Alola region.

The scarcity of resources and food made them particularly united.

To survive, they also used all their strength - one being able to hold off three guardian deities was the best proof.

But unfortunately, due to Johan's appearance, their battle plan failed.

Johan didn't answer the Naganadel leader's question, but raised a new question.

"So, Necrozma fell into slumber to oppose the asteroid?"

The Naganadel leader was stunned again, looking at Johan with some disbelief.

"How do you know this too?"

Hearing this, Johan's heart relaxed slightly.

Good.

It was most likely the "anime version" of Necrozma.

If it were the special manga or game version of Necrozma, things would probably be much more troublesome.

This time, Johan answered the question.

"Because I have some understanding of Ultra Space, of the world you live in, of Necrozma."

"Are you from Ultra Megalopolis?" the Naganadel leader quickly asked.

Hm?

Johan frowned.

Wasn't it the anime version?

Why was there still Ultra Megalopolis?

After asking, the Naganadel leader showed even stronger hostility than before.

Sensing this hostility, Johan temporarily set aside his inner doubts and waved his hand:

"Don't misunderstand, I'm not from Ultra Megalopolis, just..."

After thinking, Johan took out the Thousand-Universe Wrist from his inner pocket.

"I'm Arceus's messenger, so I understand more things."

"Arceus?"

The Naganadel leader looked puzzled.

It looked at the Thousand-Universe Wrist in Johan's hand, sensing its aura, its eyes slowly widening.

This aura felt very strange, something it had never sensed before.

But from the Thousand-Universe Wrist, it also sensed... an aura similar to Necrozma's sacred presence, a kind... of ability and aura that seemed like it should belong to whoever created this world.

Johan also looked at the Thousand-Universe Wrist in his hand.

Didn't recognize Arceus?

Had it never seen one, or simply didn't exist?

Whether Ultra Space was one of the universes created by Arceus remained questionable.

However...

One llama, one mule - obviously a good match.

Plus, Arceus nearly fell due to an asteroid, and Necrozma had to fall into slumber due to an asteroid - this was also mutually reflective.

Case closed.

Whether the Pokémon world or Ultra Space, asteroids were the greatest "enemy" of all legendary Pokémon!

After seeing the Thousand-Universe Wrist, the Naganadel leader put away its puzzlement.

But still stared seriously at Johan.

"So, what do you want to say, needleless human? You want us to go back, right?"

Going back meant starving to death. Here... there might still be a chance to fight.

As long as they could leave some "seeds," the group might not be without the possibility of prosperity again.

"No, no, no."

Johan waved his hand again.

Using aura to release goodwill.

"Precisely because I understand, I know what kind of situation you're facing."

Knowing that the Naganadel and Poipole might starve to death if they went back, Johan wasn't cruel to that extent.

"Hm?" The Naganadel leader was stunned.

Johan continued: "I mean, I know you need a place to reproduce and thrive. Going back, you'll face a world of darkness and barren land."

"So, I mean, you can stay temporarily."

Stay?

"Temporarily?" The Naganadel leader also caught the key word.

"Of course." Johan smiled and spread his hands. "If your world recovers, and you still want to stay here, we welcome that too."

"Recover?" The Naganadel leader looked dejected and lost, saying dejectedly: "It's impossible to recover."

"It will recover." Johan was quite certain.

At the latest, when Ash started his journey, it would recover.

But now wasn't the time to worry about this. He said:

"Whether it recovers or not, you can stay. We can provide you with a habitat."

Hearing this, the Naganadel leader looked deeply at him.

But still didn't relax its guard, asking gravely:

"So, what do we need to pay? Labor? Mounts? Enforcers? Or... test subjects?"

It didn't doubt whether Johan could represent so many people present in making this decision.

Test subjects?

Johan frowned.

People from Ultra Megalopolis also used Naganadel or Poipole for experiments?

No wonder the Naganadel leader had shown such great hostility earlier...

"No, none of that is needed. What you need to do is simply not cause destruction, live quietly and peacefully. We can provide you with food needed to maintain your lives."

He paused.

"Of course, if you're willing, you can also provide some labor in exchange for resources. This depends on your own will."

Johan believed he currently had the authority to represent most people present in making this decision and giving this promise.

Not just because of strength, but also because of the positions he held.

"Just... just these?"

"Just these."

The Naganadel leader's eyes became somewhat dazed.

Then what had they been fighting so hard for just now?

After a long silence, the Naganadel leader's voice became much gentler.

Only then did Johan hear it was actually a female voice.

"I... how can we trust that what you're saying isn't deceiving us?"

Hearing this, Johan breathed out.

Alright.

He held the Thousand-Universe Wrist in one hand and fumbled in his jacket pocket with the other.

"I swear by the name of Arceus's messenger, Aura Guardian, Rainbow Hero, Partner of the Sky, Person of Truth and Ideals, Companion of Destruction, Fighting Master, International Police Inspector, Pokémon Soul Master..."

"...that I will keep my word."

The Naganadel leader: "..."

This... such a long string?

You have many titles, you win...

But it still asked for confirmation:

"Can you represent those humans?"

Johan didn't look back, but said with certainty:

"I can represent!"

If he couldn't represent them at this point, wouldn't all his efforts, becoming stronger, and growing be for nothing?

Anyway, even if the Alola region disagreed, he'd just take them all to Hoenn.

Let Hoenn suffer temporarily.

If even the Hoenn League wasn't too happy about it, then don't blame him for taking them all to Team Rocket.

Boss Giovanni would definitely be very pleased.

The Naganadel leader cautiously looked at the four guardian deities, then slowly descended toward the ground.

The island guardian deities looked at each other, finally looking at Johan.

Johan nodded slightly, giving them a "don't worry" look.

Looking at the "proof items" in Johan's hands, they also chose to believe.

Damn, he got to show off again!

Until the Naganadel leader landed on the ground without being attacked, its anxious heart relaxed somewhat.

"Eat this, recover some strength." Johan took out the universal energy cubes.

The Naganadel leader sniffed lightly. Though very different from Ultra Space food, it was still quite enticing.

After brief hesitation, it opened its mouth slightly.

Johan tossed the energy cube in.

With chewing, swallowing, and feeling the body's changes, the Naganadel leader's eyes gradually brightened.

"Delicious!" Its gaze toward Johan changed again.

Johan smiled: "Then, how about having your people come down first? We'll provide food and recovery medicine."

After brief hesitation, the Naganadel leader chose to trust Johan again.

"Roar—"

The Naganadel and Poipole in the sky looked at each other, then descended toward where it was.

Johan took out large amounts of food, sighing inwardly.

They were all pitiful creatures. Forget it, I'll report a bit less for these expenses.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar rubbed its hands together and approached the Naganadel leader with a grinning expression.

Facing the Naganadel leader's puzzled gaze, it stated its purpose.

That, um, could you let this old ghost... taste your poison?

The Naganadel leader: "..."

"Whew!"

Lusamine breathed out deeply, staring fervently at the freshly made "Ultra Ball" in her hands.

Though she'd failed many times and wasted many materials, she'd finally succeeded!

She looked somewhat fervently at the Naganadel and Poipole.

# 705: Reverse World and Fairy Plate! (Two-in-One Chapter)

"Teacher Johan?"

Seeing the Naganadel and Poipole put away their battle stances and gather around the Naganadel leader in front of Johan, Anabel and the others also hurried over.

"It's fine now."

Johan said to Anabel and the others.

Hearing this, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.

If Teacher Johan said so, then it was most likely really fine.

"However..."

There was more?

Johan then briefly explained the agreement he had reached with the Naganadel leader.

"I've agreed to this on behalf of the International Police and Pokémon League." Johan said.

"I see..."

Anabel had thought there would be some twist.

So this group of Naganadel and Poipole had come to the Pokémon world to find a new home and habitat. If they had known this from the start, perhaps the fighting wouldn't have begun at all.

Ultimately, this group of Ultra Beasts were also living beings. After learning about the harsh living conditions the Naganadel originally faced, it was impossible to forcibly drive them back and leave them to their fate.

Moreover, the Naganadel seemed to possess telepathic abilities. If they could use their understanding of Ultra Space, it would be greatly beneficial both for Ultra Beast research and for the "UB Task Force" to further understand Ultra Space.

At the very least.

Even if there were no benefits.

With Teacher Johan's status and strength, he was completely qualified to represent the International Police and the entire League among those present.

Of course, the current Alola League hadn't been established yet. If the Naganadel and Poipole wanted to stay in the Alola region, they still needed the Island Kahunas' approval, as they were the real people in charge of the Alola region right now.

"What do you Island Kahunas think?"

Johan naturally knew this, so he looked at Nanu and the other two and asked.

It would naturally be best if they could stay in the Alola region. After all, this place had abundant resources, and though it was a region composed of islands, the resources were quite rich.

Nanu directly waved his hand.

"Don't ask me, whatever you decide is fine."

As both an Island Kahuna and former International Police officer, he had no objections to Johan's decision.

Olivia and Hapu exchanged glances.

"We'll go with what Teacher Johan decides." both said in unison.

"I, I can also represent Master Hala in agreeing."

At this moment, Professor Kukui, who had secretly changed back into his normal clothes, came running over while panting and said.

Ultra Beasts and Ultra Space were both dangers and opportunities. Such a group of powerful Naganadel and Poipole, as long as they behaved themselves, would definitely bring huge benefits to the Alola region.

Others might not know where the Alola region's Z-Moves came from, but as a Pokémon move professor, Kukui actually had some guesses.

With all four Island Kahunas agreeing, there was no problem.

Johan nodded, "Of course, I also promised them that if Ultra Space - that is, their homeland - recovers in the future, they can decide for themselves whether to go or stay."

"No one can deny a heart that wants to return home." Professor Kukui said.

Everyone had no objections.

Subsequently.

The focus of discussion turned to where to temporarily house this group of Naganadel and Poipole.

This was indeed a problem.

Because if something went wrong, if the Naganadel and Poipole rioted, the trouble that would bring... would be enormous.

After all, Teacher Johan couldn't stay in the Alola region all the time.

"If everyone doesn't mind, they could live in Aether Paradise."

This was suggested by Aether Foundation President Lusamine with a smile.

"Aether Paradise? That's indeed a good place. I've heard that Aether Paradise has special conservation areas that simulate many different natural environments."

Akala Island's Island Kahuna Olivia's eyes lit up as she spoke.

For most residents of the Alola region, the Aether Foundation was a very good foundation that helped wild Pokémon in need every year.

Not only providing free housing, protection, and food, but also regularly providing physical and mental check-ups.

Many residents of the Alola region took pride in being able to work at the Aether Foundation.

And from the surface, the Aether Foundation was indeed an organization that benefited the Alola region.

Olivia's understanding of the Aether Foundation was actually similar to most Alola region residents.

Young Hapu was about the same.

But Anabel and Nanu couldn't help but exchange glances.

They actually hadn't found any problems with the Aether Foundation, but... Johan's several inquiries and requests for Aether Foundation materials had made them pay more attention and speculate.

Upon hearing this, Johan immediately smiled and said:

"Let's have them live in a natural environment instead. We shouldn't trouble the Aether Foundation and President Lusamine - this isn't a small expense."

Just kidding.

Let this group of Naganadel and Poipole go to Aether Paradise?

Until he figured out what kind of person the Lusamine in front of him was, Johan would absolutely not agree.

If she was like the anime version of Lusamine, that would be fine - at most she was someone who lacked care for her own children and was completely devoted to research, somewhat single-minded but still righteous.

But if she was the Lusamine from the special manga or games...

Then sending the Naganadel and Poipole to Aether Paradise would be like sheep walking into a tiger's den.

Who knows, after a while some of the group might go missing and become specimens or collectibles.

Then he, Johan, would become the person who couldn't keep his word.

Lusamine smiled: "Teacher Johan, don't worry. Our Aether Foundation has a budget every year specifically for supporting and helping Pokémon in need. This aspect really doesn't require..."

Before she could finish, Johan said:

"After all, these are relatively dangerous 'UBs.' This matter should be temporarily handled by the 'UB Task Force' for now."

Hearing Johan say this, Anabel understood his meaning and immediately agreed:

"That's right. Our 'UB Task Force' also needs these UBs to cooperate with some simple research, and it would allow us to better understand the world the UBs live in."

After a pause, she added:

"As for funding, I think headquarters shouldn't have any problems with that."

With her status and authority, there should be no problem, especially with Teacher Johan's support.

Hearing them say this, President Lusamine's eyes flickered, and she said somewhat regretfully:

"If that's the case... if Teacher Johan and Director Anabel need help from our Aether Foundation, please feel free to ask."

"Of course."

Anabel nodded.

Regarding UB research and studies of Ultra Wormholes and Ultra Space, the "UB Task Force" did indeed need to cooperate with the Aether Foundation.

After all, they had been researching for many years and possessed more technology and data than the "UB Task Force."

"Then..."

Lusamine took out a specially made, deep blue, mesh-patterned Poké Ball - the freshly made Ultra Ball!

"This is what we developed by combining the 'UB Task Force' data with our own data, completed by Dr. Burnet and Faba - a Poké Ball capable of capturing UBs, or rather Ultra Beasts. I call it the Ultra Ball."

Johan's gaze fell on the Ultra Ball in her hand.

Currently, the Pokémon world understood too little about Ultra Beasts, and ordinary Poké Balls simply couldn't capture Ultra Beasts.

Perhaps after gaining some deeper understanding, ordinary Poké Balls would also be able to capture Ultra Beasts, but regardless, the success rate would always be inferior to Ultra Balls.

And the Ultra Ball patent was now in the Aether Foundation's hands.

This meant that in the future, if the Pokémon world truly established connections with Ultra Space, any trainer wanting to capture Ultra Beasts would consider cooperating with the Aether Foundation.

"From a safety perspective, wouldn't it be better for Teacher Johan to capture that UB: Stinger leader?" Lusamine suggested.

This suggestion was considered good by even Anabel and Nanu.

But Johan refused again.

"I don't think that's necessary."

Hm?

He smiled and walked to the Naganadel leader's side. Under everyone's gaze, under the Naganadel leader's gaze, he gently placed his palm on its broad head.

"The bridge between humans and Pokémon isn't built with Poké Balls, and the trust between humans and Pokémon isn't ensured by Poké Balls either."

"Roar..."

The Naganadel leader stared blankly at Johan.

It listened to Johan's words and felt trust from him - strong trust.

As if the verbal agreement they had reached earlier was already an established fact.

"Trust is mutual, right?"

The trust established between humans and Pokémon was sometimes actually stronger than trust between humans.

"Roar~~"

It nodded gently.

At this moment, it also established absolute trust in Johan.

Lusamine and the others also stared at him blankly.

"Perhaps this is the difference between us and Teacher Johan." Anabel said softly.

Professor Kukui smiled: "This is what a 'Champion' is."

Olivia, Hapu, and the others also nodded slightly.

Nearby, Faba disdainfully curled his lips.

What trust, what bonds - how could they be as reliable as technology and data?

Data never lied!

Lusamine looked at Johan with a somewhat complex expression, put away her various complicated thoughts, and stepped forward while lightly smoothing her hair.

"In that case, this Ultra Ball is a gift for Teacher Johan."

The current technology for making Ultra Balls wasn't completely perfected yet, plus the materials wasted earlier - it wasn't an exaggeration to say this Ultra Ball was worth over several million Pokédollars!

"This..."

Before he could refuse, Lusamine had already placed the Ultra Ball in his hand.

"When you have the chance, please visit Aether Paradise, Teacher Johan."

"I will."

Johan rubbed the Ultra Ball in his hand and smiled.

"Lillie is my student. I'm currently doing home visits and should be going to Aether Paradise soon."

"Home visits?" Lusamine was stunned. "Teacher Johan is Lillie's teacher?"

"President Lusamine didn't know?"

Johan asked in return.

Lusamine smiled somewhat awkwardly: "Lillie hasn't had time to tell me yet. She lives outside and doesn't come home often."

Johan naturally knew about this.

"Then I'll wait for Teacher Johan's visit at Aether Paradise."

After saying this, she didn't say anything more and turned to instruct Faba and the Aether Foundation staff to pack up the equipment and return.

Today they had not only created the Ultra Ball and pacified the Naganadel and Poipole groups, but also collected large amounts of information and data about Ultra Beasts, which needed to be organized and researched as soon as possible.

Meanwhile, Johan, after discussing with Anabel and the others, decided to temporarily house this group of Naganadel and Poipole on Melemele Island.

On one hand, Melemele Island had decent combat power.

Even setting aside Johan, there were still Hala, the Royal Masked Man, Anabel, and the "UB Task Force."

On the other hand, it was close by, allowing better pacification and research, while Melemele Island had sufficient resources.

Actually, Professor Kukui and the others didn't know about the "Bear God's" existence - if they knew, they'd probably be even more at ease.

Speaking of which, on the way here earlier, he seemed to have seen the "Bear God's" shadow?

Johan's mind conjured the image of Bewear carrying the trio while running across the sea.

He shook his head.

Was Bewear also here for this group of Naganadel and Poipole?

He walked toward the guardian deities who hadn't left yet.

"Moo~"

With the Naganadel withdrawing their toxins and Tapu Bulu's healing, the other three island guardian deities had recovered about seventy to eighty percent.

Seeing Johan approach, the island guardian deities turned their attention to him.

"Everyone's here."

Tapu Koko and Tapu Bulu exchanged glances.

[Can't you come up with a more substantial opening line?] Tapu Koko said irritably.

"Haha..."

Johan laughed awkwardly.

"Since everyone's here, how about..."

Tapu Koko and Tapu Bulu knew what he wanted and began briefly explaining to Tapu Lele and Tapu Fini.

Tapu Fini was Poni Island's guardian deity. During the earlier battle with the Naganadel, Ninetales had actually already absorbed part of Poni Island's aura.

There wasn't much to say about this.

Actually, honestly speaking.

If Johan and Ninetales really wanted to forcibly absorb portions of each island's aura, with the strength Johan had displayed, they couldn't stop them even if they wanted to.

His willingness to consult their opinions was already quite respectful to them as island guardian deities.

As for the "Fairy Plate"...

The four island guardian deities gathered together to discuss.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar grinned mischievously, tiptoed, tilted its ear, and moved closer to eavesdrop, while making various strange expressions at Johan to convey "information."

Johan couldn't help but smile at this.

Soon, Tapu Koko floated over representing all the island guardian deities.

[Johan, we can return the Plate.]

Whew—

Johan breathed a sigh of relief.

Finally settled.

However, why did he feel like... the debtor was more arrogant than the creditor?

[Actually, we've been borrowing the Plate's power for a reason, mainly for the Alola region's stability. Please forgive us.]

Tapu Koko's attitude was surprisingly good.

"Is it because of Necrozma?" Johan asked tentatively.

[Yes, but not entirely. But that's not important anymore. We have a request.]

A bad premonition immediately arose in Johan's heart.

They're not asking me to kill Necrozma, are they?

Tapu Koko didn't beat around the bush and said:

[Recently, the Alola region's Ultra aura has been very unstable, with Ultra Wormholes and Ultra Space being unusually active. We hope you can guard the Alola region for a while.]

Hm?

Not Necrozma after all...

So Necrozma was truly sleeping in Ultra Space, not Mount Lanakila?

"But you also know, I'm not from Alola." Johan spread his hands somewhat helplessly. "I can't always stay in the Alola region."

He would eventually leave.

[Yes, we know. However, we also sense that the Sun God and Moon God are awakening. Once they wake up, everything will be fine.]

Solgaleo and Lunala were awakening?

Johan thought of his recent encounter with Solgaleo in space with Rayquaza.

At that time, Solgaleo had asked him to come to the Altar of the Sunne, and he had come.

It seemed...

Besides the Naganadel and Poipole, nothing else had happened?

"Soon?"

[Very soon.]

As they spoke, Tapu Koko and the other three guardian deities simultaneously looked toward the towering cross monument of the Altar of the Sunne.

[We can sense that the Moon God has awakened, but isn't in this world.]

"Not in this world means..." Johan suddenly realized: "The Reverse World?!"

What he now called the "Reverse World" wasn't referring to Giratina's "Distortion World," but simply the "Reverse World" - an independent world outside the Pokémon world, or rather one that could be seen as the "shadow" of the Pokémon world.

It was almost identical to the Pokémon world, with the biggest difference being reversed day and night and different time.

The "Reverse World" had closer connections to "Ultra Space" than the normal world did.

Like the world Ash and Pikachu entered that was occupied by Guzzlord and nearly destroyed Melemele Island and the Pokémon School - that was actually the "Reverse World."

The intense collision from Tapu Koko and Pikachu's battle accidentally shattered the fragile space and entered the "Reverse World."

Not only did they meet Zeraora's trainer Dia, but they also encountered the shiny Tapu Koko.

After defeating Guzzlord together, Ash returned to the original world with the help of both Tapu Koko.

To be honest, the "Reverse World" was more like a future version of the Pokémon world, where that world and "Ultra Space" were almost completely connected. The Melemele Island there was actually also called "Ultra Megalopolis."

The residents of Ultra Space, or rather the residents of Ultra Megalopolis, might also be the Alola residents of the "Reverse World."

In this world, the altar before them was called the "Altar of the Sunne," while in the "Reverse World," it should be called the "Altar of the Moone."

"So the massive Ultra aura fluctuations that appeared earlier, causing so many Ultra Wormholes to open, was actually because Lunala from the 'Reverse World' awakened, affecting this world's space?"

Johan somewhat understood.

Tapu Koko showed some surprise, looking at Johan with some amazement.

[You're much smarter than I imagined.]

"Ka-kaah!" Gengar nearby felt indignant.

This old ghost is the smartest!

Even though I didn't understand what you were talking about, this old ghost refuses to accept it!

Johan pressed down the purple chubby's head, stuffed it back into the shadows, and frowned slightly.

So Bewear came running not because of the Naganadel, but because it sensed Lunala's awakening?

"Tsk, why create some multiverse setting out of nowhere? This is damn complicated..." Johan couldn't help complaining.

[What?]

Tapu Koko didn't catch Johan's muttering.

"Nothing."

Johan waved his hand. "Alright, I understand. I'll help handle some of the Alola region's Ultra Beast problems until both Solgaleo and Lunala wake up."

If it was just Ultra Beasts, Johan felt confident he could handle them.

As for staying in the Alola region for a long time...

Worst case scenario, he'd have to trouble Giratina or ask little Hoopa for help.

Moreover.

Currently, it was just that the passage between the Alola region and Ultra Space was unstable, with only some powerful Ultra Beasts able to come through.

When things stabilized later, even Ultra Beasts that passed through Ultra Wormholes wouldn't all be so formidable.

By then, he believed the Alola region's trainers could handle the troubles themselves.

If Necrozma awakened and restored Ultra Space's light, the Ultra Beasts wouldn't need to leave their homeland to come to the Alola region, and things would be completely stable.

[Then we're counting on you.]

Tapu Koko expressed gratitude on behalf of the island guardian deities.

Subsequently.

The four island guardian deities gathered together, and strange energy burst from their bodies.

At the same time, Tapu Koko also briefly explained the "Fairy Plate's" role in the Alola region.

[The Plate's power stabilized the aura and to some extent blocked Ultra Space and Ultra Wormholes...]

The island guardian deities formed a circle, slowly flying above the Altar of the Sunne.

[But as time passed, the Alola region's aura completely stabilized, and Ultra Space and Ultra Wormholes could no longer be blocked...]

Hum—

Brilliant light appeared at the center of the four island guardian deities.

At the same time.

On the altar, a surge of vigorous life force rose up, and a pink plate wrapped in rich Fairy aura slowly materialized.

Johan unconsciously held his breath.

The Plate!

Complete!

And it seemed to be made of different material than Tyranitar's fragments, in a much more mystical state - like diamond, gemstone, amber, jade... yet seemingly none of these.

From its original meters in width and height, it slowly descended and shrank until it became palm-sized, radiating brilliant colorful light.

The Fairy Plate!

Gulp—

"Bangi..."

Tyranitar looked at the beautiful plate and couldn't help swallowing.

Then felt somewhat regretful.

Why wasn't it the Ground Plate or Rock Plate?

The Dark Plate would work too...

[The Fairy Plate contains infinite life mysteries and endless energy. If you use its power, please be careful, careful, and more careful.]

Tapu Koko admonished.

Only by truly possessing the Fairy Plate could one understand the infinite mysteries contained within.

Even as island guardian deities, as Fairy-type Pokémon, the four island guardian deities couldn't fully utilize the Plate's power - they could only borrow it.

And Arceus had seventeen more such Plates!

Otherwise, just in terms of "stats," Arceus would be far inferior to Necrozma, let alone Eternatus.

"I understand."

[Speaking of which, after your Ninetales mastered Xerneas's Fairy Aura, it's indeed very compatible with this Plate.]

This was probably one of the reasons Arceus had instructed Johan to retrieve the Plate.

Not just for its own body, but also for his Pokémon.

So to speak.

With this absorption of aura from the Alola region's four islands, plus the "Fairy Plate's" assistance, perhaps... Ninetales might even surpass Gengar and reach Champion-level strength first!

The only pity was that Ninetales couldn't Mega Evolve.

With Johan's "cheats" fully activated, Gengar actually already had strength surpassing Champion level.

Gengar, do you feel the pressure... Johan thought somewhat gleefully.

[Please convey our gratitude to Arceus and Xerneas for us.]

"Of course."

Just as he finished speaking, Johan paused.

Wait.

Xerneas had just transformed into a tree and fallen asleep - who knew how long it would take to wake up.

After the last Ultra Demon Hoopa incident, Arceus also seemed to have fallen asleep, not knowing how long this nap would last.

So this Plate...

The warm, palm-sized "Fairy Plate" fell into Johan's hands.

Just from contact.

He felt the surging life force from it.

The aftereffects from his previous "burst mode" using Mega Evolution, Terastalization, and Z-Moves in succession seemed to be completely recovering under the Plate's power.

Others had things like "Thunderbolt training," "Machamp training," "Onix training," and he had made progress from the original "Paralysis training" and "Poison training" to "Fairy Plate training"...

Johan thought somewhat dramatically.

"Maybe in the future I can use Gengar's 'Musou' as a normal state..."

After thinking, he put the "Fairy Plate" in his jacket pocket with the Thousand-Universe Wrist, Gene Wedge, Rainbow Wing, Silver Wing, and others.

He'd study how to use the Plate's power to help Ninetales and Tinkaton improve when he got back.

Unfortunately, the Plate could only assist Ninetales and Tinkaton in training, not directly boost them to level 99 just by wearing it.

This was still somewhat different from Sword and Shield.

Without their swords and shields, Zacian and Zamazenta could only be sword dog and shield dog. With their swords and shields, they were legendary heroes with maxed levels.

Johan looked at his hammer girl.

Wonder if... hammer girl could modify the Plate?

Or could hammer girl use swords and shields?

Tapu Koko looked at Johan with a somewhat strange expression.

What was this guy thinking?

Why did his expression seem so "dangerous"?

[Ahem, Tapu Lele asked me to tell you that you can absorb Akala Island's aura yourselves without greeting it.]

After speaking, Tapu Lele nodded slightly at Johan before disappearing from the Altar of the Sunne.

Immediately after, Tapu Koko also transformed into a golden arc of light and disappeared.

"Tapu Fini..."

"Fin~"

Tapu Fini called out softly and also disappeared from the altar.

"Ka—"

"Moo!!!"

Tapu Bulu's body trembled, then fled toward Ula'ula Island like it was escaping.

Hide!

Must hide for a while!

Johan: "..."

He awkwardly touched his nose.

"Come on, is running really necessary? I'm not going to eat you."

He had originally thought Tapu Bulu and Tapu Fini, one planting trees and one watering, would work well together.

Unfortunately, both guys ran faster than when facing Necrozma.

"But temporarily this is enough. I got enough tree saplings this time - any more and I couldn't handle them. I'll come find Tapu Bulu again next time."

The flying Tapu Bulu seemed to sense strong "malice" and nearly stumbled into the ocean.

Hurry, hurry! This is life or death—

"Naganadel."

Johan then returned to the Naganadel and Anabel and the others.

They had also noticed the light emanating from the Altar of the Sunne earlier, but seeing that Teacher Johan didn't seem inclined to explain, they didn't ask.

Probably something between Teacher Johan and the island guardian deities.

"Johan." The Naganadel leader's voice echoed in Johan's mind.

"Rest up a bit first. We'll take you to your temporary new home in a while. If you're satisfied, settle in temporarily." Johan said.

"Thank... thank you..."

Johan then looked at Anabel and said:

"I'll write this report."

Since he had taken on this "troublesome job," he shouldn't push Anabel to the front to handle it.

"Alright." Anabel didn't object.

In her view, after this incident and Johan's contributions in several previous major disasters, the International Police headquarters and even League headquarters should make their stance clear.

Once or twice could be brushed off with various excuses.

But with so many accumulated...

Teacher Johan should be promoted to "Chief Inspector"!

The only Chief Inspector in the entire Pokémon League who wasn't from the Jenny family!

Going further up would be "Commissioner" - the highest official of the entire Pokémon League's International Police department.

That is, Teacher Johan was now definitely among the top brass of the International Police, with only one Commissioner above him.

Of course, Johan himself didn't know about these things.

"Professor Kukui." Johan walked toward Kukui with a smile. "Where did you run off to earlier?"

Seeing Johan's somewhat teasing gaze, Professor Kukui broke out in a cold sweat.

Oh no, could he have been... discovered? Shouldn't have been, should he not have been seen through...

At sea.

"Where, where are we going?!" Jessie wiped the water droplets from her face.

"We turned around? Hm? We turned around?!"

James noticed that Bewear had changed direction.

Seemed to be heading back.

"Could it be taking us for a post-meal walk, meow?" Meowth voiced what all three were thinking.

"What a strange feeling—" ×3

# 706: You Wouldn't Want Groudon to See This Recording, Would You? (Two-in-One Chapter)

Night, Melemele Island, Pokémon School faculty housing.

After sending the Naganadel and Poipole to Melemele Island and temporarily entrusting them to Anabel, Johan returned to his residence.

"I feel like I could fall asleep the moment I close my eyes..."

Johan lying on the bed felt his eyelids fighting.

Today had truly been busy from morning to night - no, from morning to midnight.

Actually, the main issue was...

He had ridden Dragonite for too long.

It was almost 3 AM now.

However, after struggling for a while, Johan still sat up.

"Ninetales." He called softly.

"Oowoo?"

Ninetales, also lying on the bed, slightly raised its head, its azure eyes showing some questioning.

Johan fumbled in his jacket pocket and took out the freshly warmed "Fairy Plate."

The pink plate emanated a strange life aura and contained unimaginable power.

"You keep this first, explore it a bit. When we figure it out, we'll share it with Tinkaton." Johan said.

"Oowoo~"

Ninetales looked at that pure and rich Fairy-type energy, hesitated briefly, then curled its tail around the plate and put it away.

When not in battle, the changes brought by the plate wouldn't be that quick, after all Ninetales' own strength was definitely not weak.

But the benefits to Ninetales would certainly be enormous.

"When we get a chance, maybe we can have an internal ranking battle before taking on the 'Champion Road.'" Johan thought.

Seeing Gengar secretly watching Ninetales from the ceiling, Johan smiled.

Look, the purple chubby had also sensed the "threat." With the "Fairy Plate's" enhancement, Ninetales' strength would definitely see a huge improvement.

Such "pressure" might become an opportunity for Gengar to break through Champion level.

If Gengar's normal strength could surpass Champion level, then with various enhancement methods, its power... could probably steamroll through the Hoenn League.

"Keep it up, Gengar." Johan said as he lay down again.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar playfully made an "OK" gesture.

Johan chuckled softly.

He absolutely trusted Gengar. From when he first met it as a Gastly until now, he had never needed to urge Gengar to work harder - what he just said was only a joke.

"Gengar, lights out."

"Ka-kaah~"

Speaking of which, did he forget something?

Ula'ula Island.

Guzma struck a cool pose, half-crouching at Po Town's port, enjoying the sea breeze and moonlight.

"Seriously, is that Teacher Johan guy coming today or not? Does he want his boat back or not?"

Team Skull's only officer, the delinquent girl Plumeria, shouted angrily.

A nearby Team Skull member who seemed somewhat cultured complained: "Golbat wearing pretty feathers."

"What's that supposed to mean?" everyone asked in unison.

"Really thinks it's some kind of bird!"

This earned a chorus of approval.

Guzma ignored his subordinates, feeling his phone vibrate. Taking it out, he saw it was Lusamine and immediately became serious.

Standing up and waving to have two people watch the port, he pressed the answer button while walking back to Po Town.

"It's me..."

The next day.

Akala Island.

"Teacher Johan, please try this - it's our restaurant's specialty, also my dad's proudest Pineap Berry juice."

Inside Aina's Kitchen, Mallow enthusiastically served Johan the restaurant's specialty.

Behind her, the green-haired couple smiled warmly with some anticipation.

"Mm, delicious!"

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar gave a thumbs up, not stingy with praise either.

Seeing this, Mallow's father relaxed and hurried forward: "As long as Teacher Johan likes it. Our Mallow... please take care of her."

"Dad, don't get so excited." Mallow quickly stepped forward.

Mallow's father also realized he was being a bit excessive.

But there was no helping it.

Others in the Alola region might not know much about Teacher Johan, but ever since Mallow and Lana went to Canalave City in Sinnoh and met Teacher Johan, with Mallow's influence, their whole family had paid attention to Teacher Johan.

The more they paid attention, the more they realized how amazing this Teacher Johan was!

Not only as a trainer showing extremely strong power, having even dealt with several waves of legendary Pokémon.

More importantly, he was a genuine teacher with the title "Pokémon Psychologist" and was known as a "Tactical Master" and "Soul Master."

Being strong in battle didn't necessarily make someone a good teacher.

But being both powerful and actually a teacher - there weren't many like that in the Pokémon world.

How could Mallow's parents not be excited that such an amazing teacher had come to the Alola Pokémon School?

Learning that Teacher Johan was doing home visits, they had prepared early.

However, Johan wasn't known for being a strict teacher, and he quickly got along well with Mallow's parents.

"Mallow is a very lively child, a girl full of energy..."

"Thank you so much for taking care of her, Teacher Johan..."

Akala Island, Ohana Town, Ohana Ranch.

This was Kiawe's family ranch, also the largest ranch on all of Akala Island.

On the wide plains with lush grass, light streamed through clouds creating golden waterfall-like threads scattered across the grassland, outlining distinct light and shadow boundaries.

Groups of Tauros ran freely on the grassland, fully displaying their natural talents.

In the Alola region, Tauros were not only transportation-type Pokémon but also stars of "Tauros Competitions," similar to horse racing in other regions.

Kiawe's family ranch housed over three hundred Tauros, reportedly including many "Tauros Competition" star contestants.

"The Tauros in the Alola region are much more gentle and stable in temperament compared to Tauros in other regions."

Johan walked along the ranch fence.

A dark-skinned couple followed beside him - Kiawe's parents, Sima and Amara.

Kiawe's father Sima smiled: "This is probably related to the Alola region's climate."

As a large ranch owner, Sima looked quite refined, wearing a blue shirt and narrow-framed glasses.

In contrast, Kiawe's mother Amara was robust and capable, with a "strong and powerful" yet generous and forthright appearance.

Similar to Mallow's parents, Sima and Amara also knew about Teacher Johan.

After all, as a large ranch owner, selling products to outside regions was essential.

Johan nodded: "Though every region has a history of riding Tauros, the Alola region seems to be the earliest."

"Teacher Johan knows about this too?" Sima asked with some surprise, pushing up his glasses.

"I also have the heart of a ranch owner, and I've had some exchanges with Grandpa Fuego in the Sinnoh region." Johan said with some self-deprecation.

"Teacher Johan also has a ranch?" Amara asked curiously.

"Uh, sort of." Johan rubbed his chin, joking: "If having two Gogoat counts, haha..."

Kiawe's parents Sima and Amara exchanged glances, both seeing the same meaning in each other's eyes.

Sima immediately said: "If Teacher Johan doesn't mind... we could cooperate."

Cooperate?

Amara also hurried to say: "Compared to Tauros, our ranch's Miltank and Mudbray are actually more famous, especially Miltank's Moomoo Milk - it sells out every time."

Miltank could be seen everywhere on the ranch. Johan estimated there might be over five hundred!

Keep in mind, these weren't cows - Miltank produced far more Moomoo Milk than regular cows.

This was already one of the few large Miltank ranches in the Pokémon world, second only to Whitney's "Goldenrod Ranch" in Goldenrod City in Johto.

As for Mudbray, though they didn't produce anything like Moomoo Milk, both Mudbray and their evolution Mudsdale were typical cargo-carrying Pokémon.

Mudsdale was famously slow but had exceptional endurance, load capacity, and cargo-hauling ability.

Throughout the Alola region, Mudsdale and Mudbray were among the greatest helpers for every farming household.

On ranches, having Mudbray and Mudsdale to help transport and carry goods could greatly save labor.

Ultimately.

Though Kiawe's family was in animal husbandry, in terms of actual "industry," except for Lillie, Kiawe's family was the wealthiest.

"We could first provide Teacher Johan with some Miltank and Mudbray. When your ranch is established, you can pay us back." Sima said.

This was essentially "breeding loans."

Keep in mind, Miltank were purely female Pokémon with no corresponding male counterparts, making wild ones very rare.

Johan had actually considered raising Miltank.

After all, his "big babies" consumed huge amounts of Moomoo Milk daily.

He just hadn't found a "source" for Miltank, or rather hadn't had the energy to deal with it yet - he hadn't even finished planting trees.

But...

"Maybe later, there'll definitely be opportunities in the future." Johan politely declined Kiawe's parents' good intentions.

The two were truly well-meaning.

However, Johan couldn't accept such kindness while serving as Kiawe's teacher.

Whether it was his own conscience or concerns about gossip.

Just like when he was Steven's teacher, he wouldn't accept Steven's gifts of precious metals - it was Johan's bottom line as a teacher.

Of course, after returning later, he would try to cooperate with Kiawe's family ranch in a more equal manner.

Kiawe's parents showed some disappointment.

But immediately afterward came respect.

They understood Teacher Johan's meaning.

"Gengar!"

Johan suddenly shouted.

Gengar, who was lying in the ranch, jumped.

"What are you staring at Miltank for?" Johan hurried over.

"Ka-kaah..." Gengar grinned sheepishly, poking its fingers while the nearby Miltank was already sweating nervously.

Sima and Amara exchanged glances.

Sima sighed: "Really is a good teacher..."

Amara agreed: "We must have Kiawe study hard with him!"

Akala Island, Konikoni City.

"Teacher Johan," Lana greeted politely, "good afternoon."

Behind her, two little girls with blue fluffy hair who looked eighty percent like Lana peeked out curiously at Johan.

They were Lana's sisters, Harper and Sarah.

"Teacher Johan." Lana's father was a fisherman with excellent fishing skills, but... he couldn't catch fish. He and Johan had met in Canalave City.

"Want to cast a line together?"

Lana's father laughed heartily, extending an invitation.

As fellow "fishing enthusiasts," such an invitation was equivalent to card players asking for "a game."

"Of course!"

Johan's eyes lit up slightly, but he quickly asked: "Are there many Magikarp in this area?"

"Not many!"

Lana answered.

Since Lana's father rarely caught fish, he couldn't answer this question.

"Not many is good, not many is perfect..."

Magikarp were too "domineering." In the Pokémon world's waters, except for some special places, their presence was nearly ubiquitous, which truly gave Johan headaches.

So Johan, as a teacher, and Lana's father, as fellow "fishing buddies," sat on the reef chatting casually.

They discussed both Lana's studies and personality, as well as fishing techniques.

"Ka-kaah..."

Gengar watched this scene enviously.

"If Gengar doesn't mind, you can use this fishing gear." Lana's mother smiled gently, taking out a fishing set they had prepared.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar's eyes lit up. After thanking her and taking the fishing rod, it ran off happily to find a spot away from Johan.

It didn't want to fish with those two "eyebrow pencils"!

Meanwhile, Lana took her two sisters and the visiting Mallow and Kiawe to her "secret fishing spot."

"Gengar~"

Lana waved at Gengar.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar immediately understood her meaning and happily followed with a grin.

"Wow! Teacher Johan's having great luck today!"

Seeing Johan's tight fishing line, Lana's father couldn't help but exclaim.

But as Johan swung his "Super Rod," a large Magikarp immediately traced a beautiful arc through the air.

Finally landing with a "splat" on the reef, energetically performing "Splash" and splashing Johan's face with water droplets.

Johan wiped his face and asked expressionlessly:

"You said there weren't many Magikarp..."

Where was "not many"?

He felt like he could gather seven Magikarp to summon Gyarados if he kept fishing!

Lana's father looked envious: "Magikarp are great - they're relatively rare in the Alola region."

He still hadn't caught anything.

On the other side.

"I got one! I got one!" Mallow shouted excitedly.

"That's right Mallow, pull it up in one go!" Kiawe cheered energetically.

Mallow took a deep breath and pulled hard on the fishing rod. Soon a lively Carvanha was pulled ashore.

"It's a Carvanha! They're fierce~" Lana said.

"Ka-kaah!"

Suddenly, Gengar also pulled hard on its fishing rod, and a Sharpedo flew up.

"Whoa! Sharpedo!"

"My turn too, watch this!" Kiawe also felt his rod moving and pulled hard, but found it was very light, then...

A Wishiwashi lay flat on the shore, its eyes sparkling weakly.

"Why is mine a Wishiwashi?"

Wishiwashi were famously weak Water-type Pokémon, but supposedly had very delicious meat and were a delicacy that all carnivorous Pokémon in the sea wanted to taste.

Johan: "..."

He looked at the fat Magikarp beside him.

Indeed, people's joys and sorrows were not universal.

"Away you go!"

Johan threw the Magikarp back into the sea.

At the same time.

"Wow! What a big fish!" Mallow suddenly pointed at the sea surface and exclaimed.

In the ocean, a huge black shadow was waving its tail, appearing in the waters where they were fishing.

Roughly speaking, this "giant fish" was at least eight meters long!

Maybe even nine or ten meters!

Johan's heart skipped.

Lana, big fish, it couldn't be...

"It can't be..."

He stood up abruptly, quickly running toward Lana and the others, about to call Gengar to take the kids away from the seaside, but then gradually stopped.

He patted his forehead.

"I'm definitely overthinking this..."

"It's also Wishiwashi!" Lana said calmly, her eyes showing strong interest.

"Wishiwashi?" Kiawe looked at the palm-sized, powerless Wishiwashi at his feet with only its eyes still sparkling, then at the huge shadow in the sea.

This size difference was a bit much, right?

"Wishiwashi are schooling Pokémon." Johan slowed his pace and explained.

"Though they look weak individually, when they unite, they become very powerful."

The Rotom Pokédex floated out: "Wishiwashi, Small Fry Pokémon, Water-type. In critical moments, their eyes become moist as if crying, but it's actually a signal calling for companions. Danger! Danger, Rotom!"

"It's a Wishiwashi school - quite rare indeed." Lana's father also walked over.

Individual Wishiwashi were very weak, at most 20 centimeters long with only a pitiful base stat total of 175.

But when large numbers of Wishiwashi gathered together, using their "Schooling" ability to combine into one entity, they became a terrifying existence over eight meters long that could compete with Wailord.

After gathering into one individual, their theoretical base stat total reached a staggering 620!

This was a rare, true "group Pokémon" in the Pokémon world, also an excellent example of "Pokémon legions."

Like Elite Four Agatha's "Ghost Legion" and the "Gengar Legion" that Gengar had assembled when fighting Ultra Demon Hoopa.

Only the Wishiwashi's method of unity was more excellent and perfect than "Ghost Legion" and "Gengar Legion."

"Kiawe, quickly put the Wishiwashi back." Mallow said somewhat fearfully.

"Oh, right!"

Kiawe reacted and hurriedly put the Wishiwashi in his hand back into the sea.

After the Wishiwashi returned to the ocean, the huge shadow seemed ready to leave.

At this moment, Lana seriously picked up her fishing rod and bucket, pulling over a small boat docked nearby.

"Popplio!"

She and Popplio got on the boat together.

"Lana, what are you..." Mallow asked.

"It's a rare Wishiwashi school - I'm going to catch them!"

"Eh?!" Mallow and Kiawe exclaimed.

"Dad, Teacher Johan, please allow me to do this!" Lana said seriously to Johan and her father.

Before Johan could speak, Lana's father laughed heartily: "Go ahead! As a daughter of the sea, go bravely!"

"Yes!"

Lana immediately set off in the boat, chasing after the Wishiwashi school.

Johan looked at Lana's father with a somewhat strange expression. Are you serious about that encouragement?

But honestly, Johan was quite confident.

After all, this was the girl who could catch even Kyogre - a mere Wishiwashi school shouldn't be a problem.

But for safety, Johan still gave Gengar a look.

Gengar understood, put down its fishing rod, took a deep breath, pinched its nose, and jumped into the sea.

Gengar was also curious about how Wishiwashi schools cooperated.

If it could learn this...

Maybe it could try forming a "Gengar Gundam" in the future!

Just thinking about it was exciting.

"Lana looks gentle, but she's actually a very strong-willed girl, and she's very confident about fishing." Johan said.

So-called gentle on the outside but strong on the inside - this was probably it.

In this respect, she was somewhat like his little Cynthia, and would probably achieve great things in the future.

"Hahaha—" Lana's father laughed proudly.

"I hope Teacher Johan can guide Lana more in the future." Lana's mother also said timely.

They could tell that Teacher Johan liked or rather appreciated Lana, which was undoubtedly something to be happy about.

"I can definitely do it!"

Lana on the boat kept encouraging herself while hooking bait and casting, her movements skilled and fluid.

Underwater.

Johan used Gengar's "perspective" to see the enormous Wishiwashi school.

Underwater, Gengar grinned mischievously and rolled its eyes. Suddenly its crimson eyes flashed, and a small Wishiwashi at the tail of the school stopped in confusion, separated from the school.

Gengar immediately mimicked the appearance of a Wishiwashi, "gurgling" as it followed up, replacing that small Wishiwashi's position.

Move: Skill Swap!

Wishiwashi's exclusive ability: Schooling!

The small Wishiwashi: "???"

Question marks like Slowpoke's appeared above its head.

Johan's mouth twitched.

That's so like you, Gengar.

Successfully infiltrating the "enemy" and going undetected.

It's just...

From the sea surface, the originally perfect form of the Wishiwashi school suddenly had a swollen part of its tail, as if something foreign had mixed in.

Unfortunately, Gengar only "replaced" a Wishiwashi at the tail. If it had replaced one at the head, it might have been able to help bite the hook.

"Ka-kaah~"

I'm a fish~ I'm a fish~

At the same time.

Deep in certain waters of the Alola region, around Akala Island, a tremendously huge Pokémon that had become the ocean overlord of this area, a big guy, opened its eyes.

Thinking back to swimming all the way from Lavaridge Town to the Alola region.

It had originally thought it was temporarily avoiding "trouble" by coming to some backwater place.

After arriving, it discovered...

This wasn't a backwater place at all - it was paradise!

Rich resources, abundant seafood, delicious food, no opponents that could challenge its position!

This was so pleasant, it didn't want to return to Hoenn!

That's right.

This awakened ocean overlord was none other than the legendary Sea Basin Pokémon, super-ancient Pokémon - Kyogre!

What kind of terrible place was Hoenn? Not going back! Not even dogs would go back!

Just now, the awakened Kyogre caught the delicious scent of Wishiwashi, and they had very "considerately" gathered together.

Waiting for it to come feast!

The happy Kyogre swayed its body, which had grown a size rounder, swimming toward the Wishiwashi school.

"Dark clouds! It's going to rain!"

Sharp-eyed Mallow noticed dark clouds gathering on the distant sea surface, apparently moving toward them.

"Another Wishiwashi school!"

Kiawe also noticed another huge black shadow appearing on the sea surface.

It also seemed to be approaching Lana, or rather, approaching the hooked Wishiwashi school.

"The shape seems a bit different..." Kiawe added.

Hm?

Johan, who had just sat down and was about to try his luck at Lana's "secret fishing spot," looked in the direction they indicated and was slightly stunned.

Why did this second "Wishiwashi school's" silhouette look so familiar?

A bit like his old friend Kyogre?

The first thing that came to Johan's mind was an image of Wishiwashi schools forming into Kyogre's shape.

This actually wasn't uncommon.

Forget "Wishiwashi Kyogre" - there were also "Wishiwashi Rayquaza," "Wishiwashi Groudon," "Wishiwashi Zygarde," and even Necrozma and Arceus had Wishiwashi versions.

They could form anything.

The second thought was...

Lana's bait was really effective - caught one school and attracted another.

It wasn't until the third thought that he suddenly realized.

Wait!

Could this actually be the real Kyogre?

"Gengar!"

Using aura to connect with Gengar, through Gengar's "vision," Johan actually "saw" the Sea Basin Pokémon speeding through the ocean depths - Kyogre!

It really is you, fathead fish!

Also sensing the aura from Kyogre was the Wishiwashi school that had just taken the bait.

You could have Wishiwashi schools unite and show tough attitudes when facing other Pokémon, but having them unite to directly face Kyogre...

Didn't Kyogre need to save face?

Splash splash—

The massive Wishiwashi school quickly scattered.

Lana, feeling the fishing rod's weight lighten, was stunned and blinked twice.

"Eh?"

Seeing this, Kyogre couldn't let the "buffet" escape and immediately opened its mouth to bite.

"Gengar!"

Johan stood up abruptly. Under the confused gazes of the others nearby, he immediately threw out a Poké Ball, summoning Dragonite.

While climbing on, he used aura to command Gengar.

"Sludge Bomb!"

With such a wide-open mouth, it would be rude not to give it some poison.

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar was having fun when Kyogre suddenly came to cause trouble. It was also unhappy. Seeing the scattered fish school, the annoyed Gengar immediately threw a glob of thick purple poison into Kyogre's mouth.

Hm?

Kyogre was about to quickly swallow the remaining Wishiwashi when it got a mouthful of poison, nearly making it vomit.

Inertia prevented it from eating the Wishiwashi, but instead it ended up biting the fishing hook the Wishiwashi school had spit out.

Lana on the boat was still regretting the Wishiwashi school's escape when she suddenly felt an even more terrifying force from her fishing rod, startling her into gripping it tighter.

"Big one!"

Johan, arriving on Dragonite, had a strange expression.

How was it...

That Kyogre was destined to never escape the fate of being caught?

"Rotom." Johan called.

"Rotom?"

"Ahem." Clearing his throat, Johan adjusted his glasses: "Start filming, prepare to record."

If it really got caught, this footage could be used to manipulate the fathead fish for life!

Fathead fish, you wouldn't want Groudon to see this recording, would you?

"Understood, Rotom! Beginning filming, Rotom!" The Rotom Pokédex didn't understand but still activated its camera function.

At this moment.

On the sea floor.

Kyogre was staring at Gengar, big eyes meeting small eyes.

Gengar was picking its nose with an annoyed expression.

Kyogre's eyes were full of suspicion and uncertainty.

What did this mean?

It had already hidden in the Alola region, yet they were still pursuing relentlessly?

Was it really necessary to hunt it down?

Even deliberately using a school of Wishiwashi to lure it?

How many legendary Pokémon had been called this time?

Kyogre's body slightly surfaced, its eyes appearing above water. If it saw even a shadow of Groudon or Rayquaza, it would turn and run immediately.

But what puzzled Kyogre was.

There weren't any!

No Groudon, no Rayquaza, not even Darkrai!

Hm?

None?!

Now I'm getting excited!

"Ky-Kyogre?!"

Lana finally realized that what had taken the bait wasn't a Wishiwashi school, but the Kyogre she had dreamed of catching!

The others on shore also reacted at this moment.

"Kyogre!?"

"How could Kyogre appear here?"

Anyone who followed Teacher Johan knew about the Sea Basin Pokémon Kyogre.

After all, it had nearly destroyed all of Hoenn along with Groudon.

But no one expected the legendary Pokémon Kyogre from the Hoenn region to appear in the Alola region.

Mainly because the legendary Pokémon of the Alola region - whether the Sun God Solgaleo, Moon God Lunala, or even Necrozma - were all absent from Alola.

Nothing existed that could threaten it, nothing that could drive it away.

"Lana!"

Johan threw out another Poké Ball, and Ninetales gracefully landed from the air, immediately freezing the sea surface for them to stand on.

Dragonite then also landed.

"Teacher Johan!" Seeing Johan appear beside her, the somewhat panicked and nervous Lana immediately felt reassured, her tension and pressure greatly reduced.

"Don't be afraid, I'm here." Johan comforted her.

"Yes!!"

Lana nodded vigorously.

After the brief nervousness and fear passed, came thick excitement - intense excitement.

Kyogre!

"I'll definitely use all my strength to catch it!"

Johan was somewhat surprised by Lana's condition.

This little girl really was a fearless calf unafraid of tigers.

Johan looked at Kyogre on the sea surface not far away, still biting the fishing hook, and suddenly smiled with some curiosity:

"Kyogre, you've gotten fat, hey."

Kyogre: "???"

"Whaaale—!!!"

Instantly, the sea surface began surging. Its body swayed lightly, immediately raising towering waves, and the rain in the sky turned into a downpour in moments.

Though Johan was "provoking" Kyogre, he didn't underestimate it.

Fathead fish...

Perfect for testing Gengar and Ninetales' progress during this time!

As a "touchstone," perhaps it could serve as an opportunity.

Also to see how Ninetales would perform after gaining the "Fairy Plate."

Johan himself didn't realize.

For the first time, facing the first-tier legendary Sea Basin Pokémon Kyogre alone without help or protection from legendary friends, he actually felt little fear and instead developed thoughts of challenging and battling it.

This was perhaps a change in inner, subconscious confidence that came from his and his Pokémon's efforts and growth.

Kyogre?

Come and fight!
