# 707: Kyogre VS Dual Legends! (Two-in-One Chapter)

"Whaaale!!!"

As they say, when enemies meet, their eyes blaze with hatred.

At least, in Kyogre's eyes, Johan belonged in the "enemy" category.

Back in Hoenn, it was precisely because of this guy's appearance and interference that it and Groudon failed to seize the Rainbow Stone, thus missing the chance to gain more powerful strength and possibly surpass Rayquaza in one fell swoop.

Later, in Lumiose City in Kalos, after being summoned by Ultra Demon Hoopa, it was severely beaten by the legendary Pokémon Johan had called.

Though in a sense, Johan had actually saved and helped it, but...

It hurt so much! The beating was so painful!

If I can't provoke you, can't I at least hide?

For this reason, Kyogre had even left the familiar Hoenn waters.

But it never expected that even in the remote Alola region, this guy would still "haunt" it relentlessly, even using its newly beloved Wishiwashi to "lure" it!

After confirming Johan had no legendary Pokémon helping him, Kyogre's courage grew, deciding to vent its previously suffered grievances!

However, it had also made up its mind.

Considering Johan had helped it somewhat in Lumiose City, it would at most give Johan a little lesson, not going too far, treating it as...

Treating it as the great Sea Basin Pokémon's mercy!

Yes, that's right!

Akala Island, in the waters off Konikoni City, dark clouds gathered and lightning churned.

Fierce winds and rain rolled with the waves, appearing turbulent, but actually much smaller than the commotion Kyogre had caused when it first awakened in the Hoenn region.

However, even so, once Kyogre unleashed its power without restraint, it would definitely cause unnecessary destruction to Konikoni City, so...

"Lana, can you still hold on?" Johan asked.

"Yes!" Lana gripped the fishing rod tightly, her voice resolute.

"Good." Johan smiled, but still reminded her: "If you can't hold on, don't force yourself. Tell me immediately - after all, this is Kyogre!"

"Okay!"

Lana naturally followed Teacher Johan's instructions.

"Let's go! We'll head to more distant waters so we don't cause too much impact on the coastline!"

Speaking, Johan pulled Lana from the small boat, placed her on his bicycle's back seat, and rode across the ice surface created by Ninetales toward the distant waters.

"Lana! Teacher Johan!" Mallow cupped her hands like a megaphone and called out from shore.

"It's fine." Lana's father looked very relieved.

"Uncle, you're really calm." Kiawe wiped his sweaty palms.

Lana's father smiled: "That's Teacher Johan!"

If you asked who in the current Pokémon world was most reassuring when facing legendary Pokémon, it would definitely be Teacher Johan!

Moreover...

"Lana is very strong-willed about fishing. Stopping her now might make her regret it for life." Lana's mother showed worry but still chose to support her.

"Exactly!" Lana's father put away his smile. "A daughter of the sea must face storms and tempests!"

You could see that Lana's parents were actually quite worried about her.

But on one hand, this was Lana's own wish, which they acknowledged and supported.

On the other hand, as Lana's father said, wasn't Teacher Johan there? There probably wasn't a safer opportunity to encounter Kyogre than this, right?

"Whaaale!!!"

Seeing Johan and them "run" without fighting directly, Kyogre's arrogance grew even more. It became bolder, directly swaying its tail, stirring up waves to chase after them.

The stance looked like...

Being dragged by Lana's fishing hook and line, depleting Kyogre's stamina.

"Is, is Lana really trying to catch Kyogre?" Mallow and Kiawe were shocked.

Rumble—

Dark clouds gathered in a whirlpool shape, torrential rain poured down, and lightning crashed, instantly turning the sea area into daylight. In the surging waves, the hideous sea beast emerged.

"Ninetales!" Johan steered his bicycle, Rotom's turbine at full power. "I want this rain to never fall again!"

"Oowoo—"

Running lightly, Ninetales howled, and snow-white color immediately appeared in its azure eyes.

The temperature dropped suddenly and dramatically.

Even the newly evolved Tyranitar could block Primal Groudon's "Desolate Land" - how could it lose to Kyogre?

Moreover, this was Kyogre without Primal Reversion and poisoned!

Instantly.

The torrential rain quickly froze into ice, transforming into goose-feather snow falling, and the entire sea surface took on a pristine white color.

"Whaaale!!!"

Feeling the weather power being overridden, Kyogre was slightly shocked.

But at this point, it had chased right up to Johan and Lana, and with one big wave, it could roll them into the vast ocean.

As the Sea Basin Pokémon, on land they might be restrained, but in the ocean...

Did it really think its beating in Lumiose City was because it couldn't fight?

You try being a fish in the desert and see how much you can accomplish!

As for now...

This guy was definitely using weather interference to lure it, creating opportunities to increase distance!

Hmph! I'm not that blockhead Groudon - how could I be so smart yet still fall for it?

Just weather.

I'll let you have it!

One wave to kill you! Crush you!

"Whaaale!!!"

Kyogre immediately manipulated seawater, raising a wave dozens of meters high, flapping its fins to drive even larger amounts of water, bringing terrifying visual impact and extremely strong pressure.

"Teacher Johan!"

Seeing the massive wave, Lana gripping the fishing rod pursed her lips, her face pale with nervous whispers.

"Don't be nervous."

Johan stopped the bicycle, and together with Ninetales beside him, looked up at the towering wave and the behemoth riding it.

Purple patterns glowed on Kyogre's body, its eyelids fully open, and its orange pupils filled with fierceness.

"Ninetales." Johan breathed out lightly.

"Freeze the world!"

Ninetales' expression became serious, its crystalline tails spread out, and extremely cold breath surged from its mouth.

Crack crack crack—

The surrounding air seemed to freeze, and light blue ice crystal snowflakes appeared from nowhere, as if constructing a slide made of ice flowers.

The moment that extremely cold breath touched the towering wave.

Time seemed to freeze.

Ice crystals bloomed from where the cold breath and wave met, rapidly spreading in all directions, accompanied by the crisp, clear sound of ice formation.

In an instant.

The entire dozens-meter-high wave seemed about to be frozen into a huge ice sculpture.

Horror flashed through Kyogre's eyes.

Such a massive wave, actually... in such a short time, was about to be frozen?!

No way!

Kyogre angrily opened its mouth, ignoring the spreading poison on its body, spewing out an extremely turbulent and compressed Hydro Pump, its unreserved powerful impact aimed at Johan and Ninetales.

One shot to blow you away!

Boom!!!

Massive water immediately engulfed Ninetales, Johan, and Lana completely!

Kyogre's face showed some satisfaction.

As long as I stand upon the ocean, I am invincible!

However, its happiness lasted less than a second. When the water dispersed, it found that under the protection of ice walls and Aurora Veils, they were completely unharmed!

Moreover, an aura emanated from Ninetales that made even Kyogre feel a chill down its spine.

A pink plate emitted crystalline light, floating above Ninetales' head.

The Fairy Plate!

"Oowoo..."

Ninetales looked at the cracked ice wall and countless shattered Aurora Veils, its eyes full of wariness.

So close...

They were almost completely destroyed.

"Earth Power!"

"Oowoo!"

Ninetales, crouching on the ice surface, raised its head, and aura flowed from both Akala Island and the Fairy Plate into its body simultaneously.

Its momentum climbed at a terrifying speed, transforming into extremely cold aura as the surrounding sea surface continuously froze.

Kyogre, positioned atop the frozen wave, vaguely sensed something wrong.

Wrong!

Very wrong!

This guy wouldn't have a single Ninetales face it alone, would it?

Though it admitted this Ninetales had greatly surprised it, but...

The chill down its spine became more obvious and piercing!

"Whaale!"

Kyogre suddenly turned around.

It saw a sneaky Gengar that had somehow appeared behind it!

When did that happen?

"Ka-kaah?"

Discovered by Kyogre, Gengar was momentarily stunned, then showed a somewhat embarrassed smile.

What are you embarrassed about?!

"Gengar—"

Below, Johan's clothes fluttered in the cold wind, his black hair seeming to frost over and turn slightly white.

In his hand, he held a stone emitting rainbow light.

"Mega Evolution!"

Hum!!!

Brilliant rainbow light completely enveloped Johan and Gengar, their hearts instantly synchronized, bursting with incredibly powerful and mysterious strength - the power of the heart!

"Ka-kaah!!!"

In the rainbow light, Gengar completed its Mega Evolution, quickly transforming into Mega Gengar, the Mega Evolution symbol flashing briefly beneath the golden eye on its forehead.

Mega Evolution's power came from Key Stones and Mega Stones, but essentially it was the bond between trainer and Pokémon, the compatibility between hearts, the integration of wills.

Other Pokémon's Mega Evolution could bring tremendous ability enhancement.

The depth of bonds determined the strength of Mega Evolution.

The bond between Johan and Gengar...

They believed they wouldn't lose to any trainer-Pokémon pair in the Pokémon world!

Moreover, after absorbing and digesting some Rainbow Stone power, Gengar's Mega Evolution benefits had been further enhanced!

This was a result where one plus one was greater than two.

Mega Gengar instantly broke through the "Champion" level restraints, reaching a higher plane!

If we had to define what was above Champion level, it would be - Legendary!

Moreover.

There wasn't just one Pokémon on the field that had broken through the "Champion" level.

Ninetales, using the "Fairy Plate's" power in actual combat for the first time, felt the perfect compatibility between the "Fairy Plate" and itself, especially after using "Earth Power."

Fairy Aura had already filled the entire sea area!

Legendary!

Legendary!

Legendary!

This was a complete plate!

"Let's go, Gengar, Ninetales!" Johan's eyes, along with Mega Gengar's and Ninetales', simultaneously locked onto Kyogre!

Come and fight, Kyogre!

Sensing that strong battle desire and fearless tough momentum, Kyogre finally understood at this moment...

It seemed to have underestimated this human and his Pokémon.

Legendary Pokémon?

When weak, they indeed needed legendary Pokémon's protection, but after becoming strong, they dared to face legendary existences directly.

This was the meaning of becoming stronger!

Putting away its contempt and disdain, Kyogre's gaze became cold and stern, suspended above the frozen sea, six light blue orbs appearing around its body.

At this moment, it seemed the ocean's power was added to its body - the tremendous water pressure from ten thousand meters deep in the primordial sea, and the surging turbulence of raging currents.

Indigo light continuously accumulated, finally forming beams that would annihilate everything, shooting toward Ninetales and Mega Gengar respectively!

Johan's consciousness also tensed to the extreme at this moment.

Kyogre VS Dual Legends!

The moment to test "Legendary" quality had arrived!

"Ninetales! Nature's Madness!"

"Oowoo!!!"

Ninetales, wearing the "Fairy Plate," suddenly raised its upper body, angrily striking down with both paws three times on the ice surface.

Bang! Bang! Bang!

Pink aura energy immediately swept out, transforming into brilliant light, surging toward Kyogre!

Sensing the commotion, Tapu Lele, who had just appeared at the edge of Akala Island's Konikoni City waters, saw this scene and widened its eyes, mouth agape.

This move... which Tapu taught it?

How did it feel like it had more presence than when it used it itself?

Boom!!!

Fairy Aura carrying the Fairy Plate, using nature's fury as an impact to directly face Kyogre's Origin Pulse, the terrifying collision crashed together, light enveloping the entire sea area.

The frozen sea surface's ice crystals instantly shattered into powder, floating down, as the terrifying impact force seemed to explode a brilliant yet dangerous flower in the ocean!

At the same time.

"Gengar! Maximum power, Shadow Ball!"

"Ka-kaah!"

A super-massive Shadow Ball like a black sun covered the sky, obscuring the dark clouds, seeming to merge with them - it was Mega Gengar's energy release and the manifestation of Gengar and Johan's will.

Also three Origin Pulse impacts, the enormous Shadow Ball met them without reservation.

Hum—

No explosive sounds occurred, nor did brilliant light appear.

Soundless and traceless.

As if...

Origin Pulse and the giant Shadow Ball mutually dissolved and cancelled each other out at this moment, finally disappearing without trace.

Only the faint indigo glow and gradually dispersing thick black mist announced what had happened here.

"Look everyone!"

On shore, Mallow, Kiawe and others widened their eyes, pointing with trembling hands.

"Teacher Johan is really fighting Kyogre one-on-one!"

Tapu Fini, behind them, witnessed the entire process and unconsciously shrank its neck. Even without the "Fairy Plate," this human's strength was enough to demand their attention.

Perhaps...

At this moment, Tapu Fini somewhat admired Tapu Koko's wisdom - returning the "Fairy Plate" while "binding" such combat power to the dangers Alola was about to face.

Wise indeed...

At this moment on the ocean.

All the rain, snow, waves, and ice crystals had disappeared without trace.

The entire ocean seemed like ice cream that someone had scooped out with a spoon.

"Whaaale!!!"

Kyogre, suspended above the ocean, showed long-lost excitement in its eyes.

At this moment, it forgot its "grudge" with Johan, forgot its earlier plans, forgot it was facing two Pokémon it had originally considered "ordinary."

It only felt that the previous fight with Groudon hadn't been satisfying, being controlled by Ultra Demon Hoopa hadn't been satisfying, but perhaps now...

Excitedly waving its fins, trying to further strengthen Origin Pulse's impact.

However.

On its blue-purple body, an increasingly dense purple poison haze suddenly appeared.

Kyogre's expression suddenly stiffened.

Fighting one against two, splitting Origin Pulse into two was already a desperate measure, and due to the split, it was even showing signs of being suppressed.

But as the poison's effects became stronger, its power also lost momentum.

Such strong poison!

The thought flashed through its mind.

Boom!!!

The "Fairy Aura" transformed "Nature's Madness" from the front.

The impossibly huge Shadow Ball from behind.

Like a sandwich, they... engulfed it!

Boom!!!

Two forces, one bright and one dark, one brilliantly shining and one dimly restrained.

Ninetales breathed out lightly, the "Fairy Plate" fell and disappeared, its tail curling around Johan's arm as it confidently faced the explosion's center.

All previous timidity had transformed into absolute confidence.

"Ka-kaah! (^o^)b"

Gengar's Mega Evolution light faded as it gave a thumbs up, eyes twinkling as it grinned at Johan and Ninetales.

We're really amazing!

Splash!!!

The massive creature crashed into the ocean with a "boom," shaking up waves as the "scooped out" seawater began refilling, forming whirlpool-like backflow, and Kyogre seemed to disappear in the vortex.

Johan felt the coolness from his arm, looked at Ninetales beside him, then at Gengar floating in mid-air patting its round belly, and slowly broke into a big smile.

Unknowingly.

The former Gastly that used to compete with him for instant noodles, the little Vulpix that often hid under cabinets and coffee tables, had now grown to this extent.

Directly facing Kyogre!

Suppressing Kyogre!

Though it was a poisoned Kyogre, though it was... Kyogre without Primal Reversion, it was still a legendary super-ancient Pokémon, the Sea Basin Pokémon!

At this moment, even with Johan's temperament, he couldn't help but want to howl.

With the "Fairy Plate's" assistance and "Mega Evolution," both Ninetales and Gengar had broken through the "Champion" level, reaching the higher "Legendary" tier!

And this.

Was still far from their endpoint!

Ninetales had just received the "Fairy Plate" and was using its power for the first time in actual combat. Its own normal strength hadn't reached legendary level yet.

Gengar was the same, having only used "Mega Evolution" without additional Terastalization, Z-Moves, etc.

Perhaps with Terastalization and Z-Moves added, Gengar alone might be able to face Kyogre directly.

If its normal strength could improve further...

Go ahead, call Rayquaza! I'll let you call Rayquaza!

Splash splash—

Rushing water wet the ice under Johan's feet, bringing him back from his pride and satisfaction.

Looking at the dazed Lana beside him, he quickly called: "Now's the chance, Lana!"

"Hm? Yes!"

Lana also returned to her senses at Johan's voice. The fishing line swirled in the whirlpool, and the force from the rod hadn't disappeared.

There was still a chance!

Now was the opportunity!

Seize this hard-won chance Teacher Johan had created!

"Haa!"

Lana shouted, yanking the fishing rod with all her strength, using every fishing technique her father had taught her to the fullest.

At the same time, Johan's aura penetrated deep into the sea, into the whirlpool, transmitting to the still-recovering Kyogre:

"Come up, I'll cure your poison and restore your stamina."

Kyogre was stunned, feeling the force of the fishing hook in its mouth.

If Johan hadn't mentioned it, it would have forgotten about the hook.

Its mind raced.

Great opportunity!

Why should Groudon be able to establish friendly relations with this human while it couldn't?

I can too!

I can be patriotic too - wait, I can be a good guy too!

The goodwill transmitted through aura wouldn't lie.

Swaying its fins.

Kyogre actively followed the fishing line, bursting from the water, the transparent line dripping with water droplets creating beautiful arcs in the air.

Click— click— click—

The Rotom Pokédex's recording function stayed on while also activating photo mode for snapshots.

Johan nodded secretly.

With this footage, Kyogre... was his.

"Antidote."

Johan threw several prepared Pecha Berries, which Kyogre swallowed in one gulp.

The ocean gradually calmed.

"La-Lana really caught Kyogre?" Mallow covered her mouth.

Lana's parents nearby had moist eyes, proud of their daughter.

Lana's two sisters, Harper and Sarah, looked at their sister with worship.

"Teacher Johan defeated another legendary Pokémon..." Kiawe murmured.

Anyone with eyes could see.

The reason Lana could "catch" Kyogre was purely due to Teacher Johan's help.

But no matter what.

"Anglers" only looked at results and catches, not the process - just ask if you went home empty-handed!

On the calm sea surface.

Johan removed the small fishing hook from Kyogre.

"Kyogre, you've gotten fat from lack of exercise." Johan looked at Kyogre, which was smaller overall but obviously more "robust," and couldn't help teasing.

Kyogre, with half its head above water, glanced at Johan irritably.

Always bringing up sensitive topics.

[This isn't Hoenn after all.]

Only in Hoenn waters could Kyogre display one hundred percent of its power.

"I understand."

Johan nodded.

He paused before saying: "When you've had enough fun, go back to Hoenn."

Hm?

Kyogre's eyes showed confusion.

Johan looked at the gradually clearing clouds above and said softly:

"Alola might become turbulent soon. Solgaleo, Lunala, and even Necrozma might appear. You don't want to be ganged up on, do you?"

As an outsider, Kyogre would inevitably become the first target of attack.

Solgaleo?

Lunala?

Kyogre showed some disdain.

Pfft, let them try finding me in the ocean.

But upon hearing Necrozma, Kyogre quickly put away its disdain and nodded slightly.

[Since you put it that way, I'll reluctantly go back.]

Johan smiled.

Groudon who'd rather die than fly, flexible Kyogre, mechanically devoured Rayquaza - the Hoenn trio of fools was complete.

"Take these for the road."

Johan brought out some energy cubes.

Kyogre obediently opened its mouth.

Hm?

Its eyes immediately widened.

No wonder that brainless Groudon became so agreeable.

No wonder that arrogant Rayquaza was willing to let people ride it.

You guys...

Why didn't you mention such delicious food earlier?!

Sunset.

Watching Kyogre's retreating figure and the sea surface returning to calm.

Lana's family, Mallow, Kiawe and others felt... like it was all a dream.

But they all coincidentally looked at Teacher Johan standing at Lana's "secret fishing spot" with his rod facing the wind, and all coincidentally smiled.

Hehe, this is our teacher, hehe...

"Achoo!"

Johan holding the fishing rod sneezed, making the rod shake.

He rubbed his nose.

"Got too much seawater earlier? Caught a cold? That shouldn't be possible..."

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar offered the "Spell Tag," indicating Johan should wipe his nose.

"No thanks." Johan said without turning back.

Use the "Spell Tag" to wipe his nose?

Hmph!

Gengar, if you want a new one just say so, don't try to trick me!

Hearing this, Gengar pouted.

Damn!

Other people's trainers were easy to fool, but why was their Johan so hard to trick?

Johan proudly looked at Ninetales, petting its head.

He smiled:

"About time. I think... we should have some confidence in clearing the 'Champion Road' now. What do you think?"

"Oowoo..."

Ninetales showed some hesitation.

Give it another year and it should be quite confident. Right now there might still be some risk...

Better work harder in the remaining days!

"Got one!"

Johan perked up, feeling the force from his fishing rod.

"This time it definitely can't be Magikarp. I'll eat..."

A fat, golden Magikarp traced a beautiful arc under the sunset.

Johan: "..."

The Alola region's infrequent information transmission had one benefit.

Even after Johan accomplished such an earth-shaking "feat" as "defeating Kyogre," when he returned to school, Professor Kukui and Principal Samson Oak acted like nothing happened.

Only after being quietly informed by Mallow, Kiawe, and Lana did Professor Kukui show a shocked expression.

But he didn't stay shocked long.

Because Johan went straight to the "bear-infested" forest.

The next day.

Setting off again to visit the artificial island Aether Paradise in the Alola region for the final home visit.

Mallow, Kiawe, Lana, and chubby Sophocles, out of curiosity about Aether Paradise and anticipation of whether Teacher Johan would cause another big incident, all went along.

Considering the somewhat large group of children, plus Johan's first visit, Professor Kukui's girlfriend Dr. Burnet went with them.

At the same time.

Aether Paradise, having received the news, prepared for reception by directly sending a helicopter!

In terms of wealth, it could barely compete with Steven.

On the plane.

Johan gently stroked Ninetales' fur.

"Did you absorb Akala Island's island aura?"

"Oowoo~"

Ninetales nodded lightly.

With the island aura, the "Fairy Plate," and the collision with Kyogre, Ninetales had now reached ordinary Champion ace Pokémon level without borrowing the "Fairy Plate."

Only one step away from "Legendary."

As for Gengar...

After the collision with Kyogre ended, the purple chubby suddenly told Johan it was sleepy.

Gengar - with infinite energy, active day and night - actually said it was sleepy?

It was now curled up in Johan's shadow, fast asleep.

"Maybe Kyogre gave too much 'experience.'" Johan joked with his own speculation.

But he had a feeling, a rather strong feeling.

Perhaps...

When Gengar woke up, this purple chubby might give him a big surprise.

Maybe its normal strength would break through to "Legendary."

Then the "Champion Road" would really be a sure thing.

After all, the "Champion Road" was like a competition where Pokémon could only carry one item and use one enhancement method. Obviously, stacking more buffs on Gengar wouldn't work.

Otherwise, forget about stacking buffs on Gengar - believe it or not, Gengar might even call Spectrier over?

Performing a "Ghost-Horse Unity!"

Add Mega Evolution, Z-Moves, etc...

The image was too beautiful, too scary to imagine.

"Maybe I should prepare a new 'Spell Tag' as a gift..." Johan thought.

Give Gengar a little surprise too.

"Teacher Johan, we're almost there." Dr. Burnet said.

As a special consultant to the "UB Task Force" and senior advisor to the Aether Foundation, Dr. Burnet was quite familiar with the Aether Foundation.

In the distance.

They could see the artificial island suspended above the sea surface.

Unlike the natural scenery of the Alola region's four islands, Aether Paradise was filled with modern and technological aesthetics.

A large high-rise building was the center of all Aether Paradise.

The front was the Aether Foundation's core structure, while the "smaller" villa behind was where Lusamine and Lillie's family lived.

Even compared to Steven's family, it was no less impressive.

The helicopter soon landed at Aether Paradise's helipad.

Just after getting off the plane.

A luxury car was already waiting at the helipad.

"Teacher Johan!"

Seeing Johan and all her classmates, Lillie ran down happily, swinging her tied-up golden ponytail.

The driver was Lillie's family butler, James, who usually took care of Lillie and her brother's daily needs.

A refined-looking elderly man around fifty.

Reportedly.

This seemingly ordinary butler was actually a skilled Pokémon trainer.

"Lillie!"

Mallow and others immediately went to greet her, curiously looking around Aether Paradise - this was their first visit too.

"Teacher Johan, Dr. Burnet, and Miss Lillie's classmates." James said politely: "President Lusamine is already waiting for you."

Getting in the luxury car.

Listening to the kids chattering, Johan leaning against the car window unconsciously frowned.

"What's wrong, Teacher Johan?"

Noticing his expression, Dr. Burnet quietly asked.

Johan came to his senses, smiling and shaking his head lightly.

Rubbing a tuft of pink fur in his hand, looking at the scenery flashing by outside the window.

"I don't know why, but I have a feeling of... familiarity."

"Familiarity?" Dr. Burnet was stunned. "Have you been here before, Teacher Johan?"

Johan could only say:

"Maybe... it's just my imagination."

# 708: Lusamine and Big Brother-in-Law (Two-in-One Chapter)

"You three, go clean the first floor."

Aether Foundation Branch Chief Faba looked kind on the surface, but whether in words or actions, he appeared quite arrogant.

And he indeed had capital to be proud.

"Yes, Mr. Faba."

Facing him were two people and one Meowth - subordinates Faba had just recruited yesterday.

Originally, he was only curious about the talking Meowth and planned to study it, but surprisingly these three turned out to be remarkably useful.

No matter what he assigned them to do, they could complete it simply, quickly, and meticulously.

Look, such a large building - cleaning an entire floor only required two people plus one Meowth, saving him countless labor costs that could be used for his more private and secretive research.

Getting a satisfactory response, Faba put his hands behind his back and muttered somewhat indignantly:

"Just a teacher, having some strength doesn't warrant such grandeur..."

Before leaving the room, he suddenly turned around and emphasized:

"Remember, your task scope is only the first floor. Whether it's the second floor, third floor, or the basement below, you're not allowed to enter."

After speaking, before turning to leave he couldn't help muttering: "Though you don't have clearance to enter anyway."

After Faba left, the two people and cat finally looked up.

It was none other than Team Rocket's trio!

After Johan couldn't obtain complete information about the Aether Foundation through the "UB Task Force," he made two preparations.

One was sending the trio to work undercover at the Aether Foundation.

As for how they got in and how they went undercover, Johan didn't care - with the trio's abilities, they had plenty of methods.

Indeed.

Originally, the trio wanted to use the "Sweet Honey" and berries stored from Bewear to earn some funds and build a submarine to secretly infiltrate the Aether Foundation. But before their stall had been open long, they were spotted by Faba and brought back.

Watching Faba's departing direction, Jessie was the first to lose her temper, rolling up her sleeves and cursing:

"What is he?! Daring to badmouth Teacher Johan - if you really faced Teacher Johan, you wouldn't have time to cry!"

"Exactly! Exactly!" James chimed in.

Faba showing disdain for them was one thing, but what was he to dare look down on Teacher Johan?

If not for having a mission and decent wages, they would have beaten him up long ago!

After venting their dissatisfaction, the trio finally observed the first floor of Aether Paradise's largest building.

It was truly large and would definitely take time to clean, but...

"That green-haired guy said not to go to the second floor, third floor, or basement, meow." Meowth rubbed its chin, stating confidently: "I suspect Bewear's child might be on one of those floors, meow!"

"Right!"

Jessie, still not fully cooled down, looked around: "Should we go to the second floor first or the basement?"

"I just saw that guy come up from the basement, acting all secretive..." James said.

"Then let's go to the basement first!" Jessie decided.

As for the security doors requiring ID verification to stop them...

Sorry, doors had never been obstacles for Team Rocket's trio.

Meowth quickly dealt with the security door leading to the dark basement.

The trio sneakily infiltrated.

Meanwhile.

Johan and his group successfully arrived at Aether Paradise. Under butler James's guidance, they came to Lusamine's home located behind Aether Paradise.

At the entrance, they met Faba and Wicke, who seemed to be waiting there.

Wicke was the Aether Foundation's assistant branch chief, with a position similar to Lusamine's secretary, managing Aether Paradise's affairs large and small, like the entire Aether Foundation's head housekeeper.

"Alola, welcome everyone to Aether Paradise." Faba said with a smile.

"Alola, welcome everyone." Wicke also had a face full of smiles.

Seeing the two, Lillie politely bowed: "Thank you both for coming to welcome us."

Wicke smiled gently: "Lillie, everyone, we've been waiting for you."

Faba said with some teasing: "You seem to have not come to Aether Paradise for a long time, Miss Lillie."

Lillie's cheeks reddened slightly, saying somewhat embarrassedly: "Didn't I say not to call me Miss anymore?"

"But Miss is Miss." Faba had his hands behind his back.

"Speaking of which, where is Mother?" Lillie asked.

"Madam has been waiting inside for some time." Wicke said.

Their conversation was just watched silently by Johan and Dr. Burnet, while Sophocles, Mallow and others kept going "wow, wow" in amazement.

Faba couldn't help but curl his lips, lowering his voice to mutter to himself:

"Really rude, ill-mannered bunch of brats, the teacher must be the same..."

Others naturally couldn't hear such muttering, but for Johan with aura abilities, it was like someone badmouthing him right in front of him.

He couldn't help but laugh in anger.

"Teacher Johan, Madam said she's sorry she couldn't greet you personally due to busy affairs, but she asked that if you arrived, you could go directly to the study to find her."

After Wicke finished speaking, she said to Lillie and others:

"Lillie, take your friends to tour Aether Paradise first."

Then she opened the door, making a welcoming gesture to Johan.

Faba curled his lips.

Johan approached, Wicke led Lillie, Dr. Burnet and others away, and Faba's eyes rolled as he immediately pressed his ear to the door, wanting to hear what they'd chat about.

What if it threatened his position?

But listening and listening, Faba realized.

Wait, the people were chatting in the study - listening at the door was useless.

Just as he came to his senses.

Turning his head.

He saw a purple chubby also pressed against the door like him, "eavesdropping."

Hm?

Faba was immediately stunned.

Gen-Gengar?

Gengar also noticed Faba had discovered it, grinning and "friendly" greeting Faba with a wide smile.

"Ka-kaah~ Ψ(｀▽)Ψ"

Then Gengar phased through the door.

As for Faba... he froze in place.

Gengar inside the door winked twice at Johan, who chuckled lightly - everything was understood without words.

Faba?

Johan admitted he was... a talent in research, and among villain scientists, his ability might only be second to Team Plasma's Colress.

His greatest invention was probably participating in Ultra Ball development and the "Type: Null Project"!

Speaking of Type: Null, not many might know it, but its evolved form Silvally was quite well-known - nicknamed "Little Arceus"!

It could change its type at will according to "Memory discs," just like Arceus's plates.

Just creating Pokémon, and copying Arceus to create Pokémon at that, was quite an achievement.

Of course, Faba only participated in the project, not creating it completely independently - how much he contributed was unknown.

Compared to Colress, who could control Kyurem and successively developed "Colress Machines" that could fuse Kyurem with the black and white dragons and merge Necrozma with the sun and moon gods, there was still some gap.

Moreover.

In Johan's view, while Faba had some cunning, his brain didn't really seem like a scientist's.

"Just give him a little lesson." Johan said softly, his mood brightening.

Our Teacher Johan, or rather our Johan family, was famously petty.

Knock knock—

Gently knocking on the study door.

"Please come in."

Pushing the door open.

Lusamine, dressed in a short skirt with tight white pants wrapping her long legs, dressed as usual, sat at her desk busily reviewing something.

She really didn't look like a mother of two children.

Seeing Johan enter, she showed a gentle smile and put down her pen.

"Teacher Johan, sorry for not greeting you personally due to busy affairs."

Speaking, she made a welcoming gesture.

Johan didn't stand on ceremony, sitting across from her.

A Clefable carrying coffee walked in.

"I heard Teacher Johan likes coffee very much? This is our Alola region's specialty, I hope you'll enjoy it."

"Clef~"

Clefable politely placed the coffee in front of Johan.

"Thank you." Johan smiled and thanked Clefable.

"Clef~"

Clefable bowed slightly, also showing friendliness toward Johan.

After delivering coffee, it prepared to leave, then by the door, saw Johan's Gengar.

"Ka-kaah? (tilts head)"

"Clef? (tilts head)"

Gengar seemed to see its "original form," while Clefable seemed to see its "shadow," unconsciously looking down at its own shadow.

Hadn't become sentient...

"President Lusamine, no, I should say Lillie's parent."

After drinking some coffee, Johan got straight to the point:

"Lillie's grades are excellent, especially in theory - almost perfect scores in every subject, but regarding Pokémon..."

Lusamine's expression remained unchanged, maintaining her smile.

"Lillie has been quite resistant to Pokémon since childhood, harboring fear toward Pokémon..."

Before she finished, Johan suddenly interrupted:

"Is that so?"

He looked at Lusamine, his voice becoming more serious as he asked:

"Has Lillie really feared Pokémon since childhood?"

He emphasized the words "since childhood."

Hearing this, Lusamine was stunned. She naturally heard the questioning tone in Johan's voice, but she was more puzzled - could Teacher Johan, as an outsider, understand her daughter better than herself?

But thinking carefully, it seemed...

Lillie didn't fear Pokémon as a child and even raised a Cleffa.

Then... when did Lillie start fearing Pokémon?

Seeing Lusamine's expression, Johan was both angry and amused.

A mother could neglect her child to this extent, truly...

"Teacher Johan." Lusamine suddenly spoke.

"Hm?"

Lusamine pressed her temples with both hands, gently rubbing with a tired expression, saying in a somewhat low voice:

"Could you help me with a favor?"

A favor?

Johan leaned back slightly against the chair back, gesturing:

"Please speak."

"As Aether Foundation President, our Aether Foundation wants to hire you as a special consultant." Lusamine said.

Special consultant?

"This is a 'favor'?" Johan frowned.

He came for a home visit, not job hunting, and certainly not...

How did the topic suddenly change while chatting?

"No, what I mean is..." Lusamine chose her words carefully, "I want to ask Teacher Johan to help me explore Ultra Wormholes and Ultra Space!"

Johan looked up at Lusamine, noticing she showed some obsession and strong persistence.

"Whew—"

Johan breathed out lightly. Before he could speak, Lusamine continued:

"After the UB invasion incident on Poni Island, I realized that perhaps Teacher Johan, you might be the person who could best help me achieve my goal."

"What do you want to do?" Johan frowned, slowly sitting up straight with a serious expression.

Lusamine seemed not to notice his expression change, a curve appearing at the corner of her mouth as she said softly but firmly:

"I want... to enter Ultra Space!"

!!!

"This isn't a joke, President Lusamine." Johan said gravely.

"I know, I understand."

Lusamine looked directly at Johan, saying with certainty: "That's why I want to specially hire you, Teacher Johan. With your strength and ability, if even you can't do it, I think few people in the entire Pokémon world could."

Originally cooperating with Lusamine was actually Team Skull's Guzma.

But comparing Guzma to Teacher Johan?

Being able to put these two names together was somewhat overestimating Guzma.

Especially after witnessing Teacher Johan's strength at Poni Island's Altar of the Sunne and his pacification of the entire UB: Stinger group, Lusamine was full of admiration for such talent.

"Let's talk about it later..." Johan rubbed his temples.

Ultra Space was no joke.

Though the anime's Aether Foundation had indeed developed special protective suits and made further research into Ultra Space and Ultra Wormholes.

But...

The existence of Ultra Megalopolis and Necrozma sleeping in Ultra Space made Johan dare not underestimate Ultra Space.

Lusamine smiled slightly.

"Commission fee... no, deposit - fifty million Pokédollars."

Johan: "..."

He stared wide-eyed at Lusamine.

Come on, are you really testing a public servant like this?

This time.

I must say no to evil money!

"I'll consider it..."

Lusamine's smile grew wider. Just as she was about to speak, Johan raised his hand to stop her.

He said with "difficulty":

"Lillie's parent, let's talk about Lillie's issues first!"

Lusamine came to her senses, opening her mouth but not knowing what to say.

Regarding Ultra Wormholes, Ultra Space, and the Aether Foundation, President Lusamine could talk at length - whether Johan wanted to discuss development or new research, she knew everything inside and out.

But talking about Lillie...

After a long silence, Lusamine sighed lightly.

"Lillie's problem, I remember now. I used to find many people to help her, but..."

She brushed back her scattered hair.

"Actually... not interacting with Pokémon is quite good. In this world, not everyone has to become a Pokémon trainer, right?"

Indeed.

Even in the Pokémon world, not everyone could become a trainer.

But...

"Lillie likes Pokémon." Johan said with a stern face, his words decisive.

"Does she like them?"

Lusamine murmured.

"If she doesn't like them, why would she attend Pokémon School? If she doesn't like them, why would she study Pokémon knowledge so hard? If she doesn't like them... haven't you, as Lillie's mother, asked her whether she likes them and why she's afraid?"

Johan stared into Lusamine's eyes.

Under Johan's gaze, Lusamine weakened and was stunned for a while before responding:

"Teacher Johan, you really are a responsible, earnest, trustworthy good teacher."

After sighing to not lose composure, Lusamine said:

"I asked. Faba said that Lillie and Gladion got lost in the research lab at the time, slept there overnight, and perhaps had nightmares. When they found them the next day, Lillie became..."

"So you still didn't ask." Johan crossed his arms.

"I... they were just children, Faba..."

Johan didn't speak further but directly stood up.

Under Lusamine's puzzled gaze, Johan glanced at her and said:

"I can help Lillie, but facing a child, I need consent from her guardian."

Lusamine looked at Johan. Before she could speak, Johan immediately said:

"Then I'll take it that Ms. Lusamine agrees."

Lusamine: "?"

Johan straightened his clothes, standing up to walk toward the study door.

Looking at Gengar, who was staring at Clefable, he lightly patted its head and said irritably:

"What are you standing there for? Keep up!"

After seeing the parents of Mallow, Lana, and Kiawe, then meeting Lusamine, Johan as a teacher was truly somewhat angry.

"Oh..."

Lusamine behind the desk instinctively shrank her neck, standing up and responding softly.

"Ka-kaah?" Gengar turned its head in confusion, looking at Lusamine and pointing at itself.

Eh? Wasn't Johan calling it?

Then under Johan and Gengar's stunned gazes, Lusamine trotted up, following behind Johan.

"Coming, Teacher Johan, but... where are we going?"

Johan: "?"

Aether Paradise, first floor.

"This is where everyone works." Wicke smiled as she introduced.

"The second floor is the simulation area, home to many Pokémon."

"The third floor is..."

"Eh? Miss Wicke, where does this lead to?" Energetic girl Mallow curiously pointed at the opened door leading to a dark passage in the corner.

"The basement research lab door? How could...?"

Wicke looked surprised.

The basement research lab was classified territory of the Aether Foundation - how could the door be wide open?

Could it be that Faba guy left too hastily and forgot to close the door?

"This, this place..."

Seeing the basement passage, Lillie's expression immediately became unnatural, fear showing in her eyes.

"Lillie, what's wrong?" Attentive Lana noticed Lillie's condition.

"Everyone, this is Aether Paradise's secret..."

Wicke's words weren't finished.

Boom!!!

A loud sound suddenly came from the passage leading to the basement research lab, changing everyone's expressions.

Burnet and Wicke exchanged glances and ran into the passage.

The kids looked at each other, then followed.

Lillie bit her lip, watching everyone go in. After brief hesitation, she gritted her teeth and followed.

"Damn! Damn! Damn bastard! How dare you toy with me, the dignified Aether Foundation Branch Chief!"

Faba patted his somewhat sore neck, looking at Johan and Lusamine leaving together, shouting angrily.

Beep beep!

Suddenly.

An alarm on him went off.

Faba's expression changed.

The research lab!

Taking out his device, switching to the research lab's camera, he just saw Lillie's group entering the basement.

"Oh no!"

Faba immediately couldn't care about his pain, quickly running toward the research lab.

"Hm? Not here?"

Lusamine looked at the empty first floor with some confusion.

Then she smiled apologetically at Johan:

"Teacher Johan, please wait, let me check."

Speaking, she took out her phone and called Faba.

"Faba, help me see where Lillie and the others are touring now?"

"Lu-President Lusamine!" Faba's heavy breathing came through the phone, "They might have gone to the second floor, or possibly the third floor. The monitoring equipment had some problems, I'm rushing to fix it!"

"The second floor?"

Lusamine hung up, looking up toward the second floor direction, saying to Johan:

"Teacher Johan, Lillie and the others might have gone to the second floor..."

But Johan seemed not to hear, walking toward the basement direction.

"Ka-kaah~ Ka-kaah~"

Gengar waved at Lusamine.

"The basement?"

Lusamine was surprisingly "obedient," also following.

Just before Johan and Lusamine headed to the research lab, while they were still sitting and talking in the study.

In basement B2, Faba's exclusive research facility.

Boom!!!

A youth in black tight-fitting clothes with a red fanny pack at his waist and a golden tuft of hair on his forehead, looking somewhat non-mainstream or rebellious, clenched his fist.

Beside him, an Umbreon's Shadow Ball broke the cage mechanism in front.

Click—

Steam rose as the cage slowly opened.

Accompanied by heavy metal collision sounds, a four-legged creature resembling a beast slowly walked out.

Its front feet were like claws, back feet like paws, and fish-like tail made it look quite mismatched.

Most eye-catching was undoubtedly the huge metal helmet on its head with axe-like structures, appearing extremely heavy.

The youth became especially emotional seeing this creature.

"Type: Null!" he shouted loudly.

"Roar..."

A sound came from under the heavy metal mask.

"Sorry, Type: Null, I actually believed Faba's lies!"

Guilt appeared on the youth's face, but he quickly became energetic: "He's not here today, let's leave quickly!"

This youth was none other than Lillie's brother, Lusamine's other child - big brother-in-law Gladion!

"Roar!"

Type: Null approached the youth. Despite looking fierce and menacing, it showed no hostility toward the youth, appearing quite friendly instead.

"Let's go!"

Gladion immediately led Type: Null away - it would be trouble when Faba returned.

However.

When Gladion brought Type: Null and Umbreon to quickly leave the research lab, they happened to encounter Lillie's group who had come down hearing the commotion.

"Gladion?" Wicke looked at the "young master" with confusion.

"Brother?" Lillie was also somewhat surprised.

But the biggest reaction was Gladion himself: "Lillie, why are you here?"

Suddenly, his expression changed dramatically as he stepped in front of Type: Null.

But it was too late.

Seeing Type: Null's fierce appearance, Lillie was struck like lightning, freezing in place with a pale face, trembling all over, her eyes full of deep terror.

"Lillie!"

Seeing Lillie sway and about to fall, nearby Mallow and others immediately surrounded her for support.

"Quick! Call a doctor!" Wicke hurriedly shouted.

Burnet carefully helped Lillie sit on the ground, looking at the self-blaming Gladion, seeming to understand that this Lillie's brother knew why Lillie was like this.

So she asked:

"What's Lillie's condition?"

"How could you bring Lillie to the basement!" Gladion roared angrily.

But his heart was full of self-blame.

He never expected Lillie and the others would suddenly enter the basement research lab and encounter Type: Null, which had become Lillie's "nightmare."

At this time.

"Lillie!"

Lusamine, who had just arrived with Johan, saw Lillie sitting stiffly on the ground with a face full of fear, and hurriedly ran over.

"Madam Lusamine." Wicke respectfully called out.

But Gladion showed hostility, pulling Lillie into his arms and extending his hand to stop Lusamine from approaching.

"Don't come closer!"

"Gladion, you!" Lusamine was somewhat stunned, but still asked: "Gladion, what's wrong with Lillie?"

"What's wrong?" Gladion laughed bitterly, "Isn't it all thanks to Mother?"

"Me?"

Lusamine was even more stunned.

She had just arrived - what did it have to do with her?

"Wasn't it because you indulged Faba, letting him arbitrarily open Ultra Wormholes, causing Lillie to be attacked..."

"Faba... arbitrarily opened Ultra Wormholes?" Lusamine was even more shocked.

Nearby Wicke and Burnet had similar expressions.

Opening Ultra Wormholes?

Gladion roared: "Didn't you want to meet Ultra Beasts? Isn't this what you hoped for? Even if Lillie was attacked by Ultra Beasts, you still wanted to see them - isn't that the kind of person you are?!"

"Gladion!" Lusamine's voice immediately rose.

But Gladion didn't coddle her, shouting even louder:

"She suddenly became unable to touch Pokémon - didn't you find that strange at all?!"

Today, this was the second person to ask her such a question.

Lusamine was stunned.

"No matter how Faba concealed and deceived, have you ever listened to us? Didn't you prefer to believe Faba? Lillie even had to seal her own memories for this, and as her mother, you..."

Gladion vented all the resentment he'd accumulated over the years.

After all, even as her son, he rarely got to see Lusamine normally.

"I, I..." Lusamine's lips trembled.

"Stop with the 'I, I, I' - move aside!"

Johan's irritated voice came as he walked to Lillie's side.

"Who are you?" Gladion frowned, looking at Johan warily.

"Teacher Johan!"

"Teacher Johan came!"

Nearby Mallow and others had been watching a "family drama" and only now noticed Johan had arrived.

"Teacher Johan..." Gladion's eyes slowly widened.

He had heard some rumors about Teacher Johan.

This was a very powerful man!

His usually strong mother Lusamine actually made way when she heard Teacher Johan's irritated words.

"Big broth... ahem, Gladion, there's one thing you got wrong. Lillie's memories weren't self-sealed."

Johan gently held the little girl in front of him.

Being a teacher really broke his heart.

"Not self-sealed?" Gladion and Lusamine showed shocked expressions.

"Though I'm not a psychic, as a psychology teacher, I can only say... what a crude memory alteration method."

Because of Lillie's "breakdown," in her terror, some memory "traces" were completely exposed.

Gladion and Lusamine looked at each other.

"Since you don't know, let me 'show' you."

Johan called softly: "Ninetales."

"Oowoo~"

Ninetales leaped out of its Poké Ball on its own. Understanding Johan's intent, psychic light immediately appeared in its eyes.

Connecting to the Rotom Pokédex, it displayed the scene of Lillie being attacked by Nihilego.

Faba arbitrarily opening Ultra Wormholes, Nihilego appearing, attacking Lillie, being saved by Silvally, Faba erasing Lillie's memories...

"Damn! Damn! Damn!"

Watching the monitor, Faba was sweating profusely. He had just run into the basement research lab and saw this scene on the monitor.

His eyes swept around.

He discovered Team Rocket trio quietly preparing to leave.

"You!"

He sternly stopped the three, shouting somewhat frantically: "Now! Go in and cause destruction! The bigger the commotion, the better! Give me a chance to take Miss Lillie away!"

"Us?"

The trio slowly turned around, pointing at themselves.

Fight whom?

Teacher Johan?

"As long as you can bring Miss Lillie back, I can use Hypno's power again to further erase Miss Lillie's memories!"

Faba muttered his plan like rambling.

"Erase, memories..." Jessie's face darkened as she repeated flatly.

"As long as you cause destruction, I won't pursue your responsibility and will give you special bonuses!"

"Erase, memories..." James also lowered his head, repeating calmly.

"You're..." Meowth gritted its teeth with a dark expression.

"What kind of joke is this?!" ×3

"So~naaan~si~!"

Bear!

Flames seemed to rise from their bodies.

"What do you think we are, bastard!" ×3

Faba looked at them in shock.

"Can't stand it anymore, get him!" Jessie immediately rolled up her sleeves.

"Get him!" James also shouted.

"Beat him to death, meow!" Meowth was first to attack with its special move Fury Swipes!

"Arbok!"

"Weezing!"

"UB01: Symbiont?"

"Ultra Wormholes?"

"Faba!"

Having witnessed the "entire process," Lusamine, Wicke, Gladion and others called out with various expressions.

"Lillie!" Lusamine took Lillie, holding her in her arms, pressing her head against hers, crying and repeating full of guilt: "I'm sorry, I'm sorry Lillie..."

Recovering and facing her memories, Lillie felt Lusamine's embrace.

"Mother..."

"Thank goodness..." Gladion sat on the ground, breathing a sigh of relief.

Seeing Type: Null behind him again, Lillie no longer showed fear, even revealing gratitude and guilt.

If not for her, Silvally wouldn't have been sealed, much less imprisoned by Faba.

While everyone was immersed in joy and gratitude for Lillie's recovery, Johan and Gengar stood aside, stroking their chins and rubbing gently, their expressions... somewhat serious.

"Why... do I think I saw... Colress from the other end of that Ultra Wormhole in Lillie's memory?"

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar was also somewhat uncertain, hesitantly nodding.

# 709: Intra-Team Battle - Who's the "Emperor" and Who's the "Little Brother"! (Two-in-One Chapter)

"Champion Road!"

"How many years has it been since someone challenged the 'Champion Road'?"

"Teacher Johan! It's Teacher Johan! He's actually going to challenge the 'Champion Road'?"

"No, we should put it differently - Teacher Johan is finally going to challenge the 'Champion Road'!"

Online.

The Hoenn League finally announced that Johan was preparing to challenge the Hoenn League's Champion Road, causing an immediate uproar on the internet.

Actually, the Hoenn League didn't need to announce it - after all, preparing for the "Champion Road" wasn't a small matter, and with so many staff members involved, it was impossible to keep it completely secret.

As for which trainer was challenging the Champion Road... in the entire Hoenn region, it wasn't hard to guess.

After all, besides Teacher Johan, who else had the qualifications?

Steven?

Still a bit young - maybe in another year or two he'd have a chance.

Previously, these were just speculations. Though they caused some commotion, it wasn't major - mostly discussed within the Hoenn region.

But with the Hoenn League's official announcement on the entire League's website, this official statement completely confirmed the previous "rumors."

One stone stirred up a thousand waves.

Since the Pokémon League's establishment, the "Champion Road" had been the goal and direction for all trainers with lofty ideals.

But the stronger one became, the more one understood the difficulty of the "Champion Road."

And clearing the "Champion Road" meant assuming the position of "Champion"!

The League hadn't seen a trainer clear the "Champion Road" for a very long time.

There were actually quite a few people challenging the "Champion Road," but almost none who cleared it.

The reason Johan's planned Champion Road challenge caused such a sensation was that many people realized... Teacher Johan might actually be able to clear the "Champion Road"!

And this possibility wasn't low!

For a time.

The topic's popularity remained high, with countless admiring trainers heading to the Hoenn region, wanting to witness Teacher Johan's conquest of the "Champion Road."

Even in the relatively information-isolated Alola region, this news quickly spread.

Three days after the home visits ended.

"That's all for today's class."

Johan smiled as he announced the end of class.

Energetic girl Mallow immediately asked impatiently: "Teacher Johan, is it true that you're going to challenge the 'Champion Road'?"

Johan was startled by this.

"The news reached Alola already?"

"What's the 'Champion Road'?" Kiawe looked confused.

"Using our Alola region's customs as an analogy, it's... the Grand Trial!" Sophocles explained.

"Grand Trial!" Kiawe shot up, eyes blazing with fire.

In the Alola region, the island challenge was a very important custom, even considered a "coming-of-age ceremony."

Trainers whose age and abilities met the requirements would all challenge the island challenge ritual, touring the entire Alola region.

The island challenge was divided into three stages.

The first stage involved touring the islands, challenging trials set by the island captains, with the ultimate goal of defeating each island's Totem Pokémon.

The second stage involved challenging trials set by each island's Kahuna, with each Kahuna's trial methods, objectives, and completion standards being different - called the Island Challenge Grand Trial!

Completing the second stage of the island challenge would mark someone as a candidate for future Kahuna!

The third stage, also the most difficult, was called the "Ultimate Trial" or the Island Challenge Grand Grand Trial.

Participants had to consecutively challenge all four Kahunas and achieve victory.

The "Grand Grand Trial" had only one completion standard: defeat all Kahunas through battle.

Its difficulty... far exceeded the second stage by more than one level.

It was said that those who passed the Grand Grand Trial would be granted the title "King of Alola"!

But to date, in the entire history of the Alola region, those who completed the Grand Grand Trial could be counted on one hand, and in recent decades, no one had even dared attempt it.

However, like the Champion Road, the Grand Grand Trial was the ultimate goal pursued by every idealistic young trainer in the Alola region.

"Grand Grand Trial..." Johan's mouth twitched.

This naming...

If there were a fourth stage, would they call it "Grand Grand Grand Trial"?

When the Alola League was eventually established, this so-called "Grand Grand Trial" would be replaced by the League's "Champion Road."

But Sophocles' explanation was roughly accurate.

"Since everyone already knows." Johan leaned against the podium, crossed his arms, and smiled: "I'll announce it now - I'll be taking a few days off."

Taking leave?

A few days?

Preparing for just a few days before challenging the "Champion Road"?

When others participated in the Island Challenge Grand Trial, they prepared for a long time, even measured in "years."

"Teacher Johan, are you confident?" Lana couldn't help asking quietly.

"Confidence? A little bit, I suppose."

Johan gestured with his index finger and thumb showing "a little bit."

"Teacher... will you come back?" Lillie asked the question everyone was concerned about.

Though Teacher Johan had only taught for a few days, undeniably, everyone really liked and respected this humorous yet powerful teacher.

"I will."

This time Johan's answer was quite certain.

"I promised Kukui that regardless of success or failure, I'll return to continue teaching before Rustboro Pokémon Academy's new term starts."

The Alola region was so nice.

Beautiful scenery.

Sunshine, beaches, bikinis.

Berries, crops, Revival Herbs.

He still planned to find Tapu Bulu again to help cultivate another batch of saplings, and after the temporary teaching ended, to borrow some Miltank and Mudbray from Kiawe's ranch.

Hearing this, the kids all breathed sighs of relief, though they still felt somewhat regretful.

Too bad Teacher Johan wasn't a permanent teacher at the Alola school...

"Anyway, study well - I'll be checking when I return." Johan smiled.

After that home visit, Lillie's memories had recovered, she fully faced herself and Silvally, and could touch Pokémon again.

This made her very grateful to Johan, though she couldn't think of how to express her thanks.

Facing Johan's reminder, she nodded seriously.

After temporarily ending his teaching duties, Johan left the school.

Entering the "Bewear Territory" forest, he found Bewear.

At this time, Bewear had already found its child, Stufful.

As for who found it... naturally it was the trio lying on a pile of berries in a tree hollow, enjoying themselves.

That day they cornered Faba and caught him completely off guard, giving him a thorough beating.

However, Faba's strength wasn't actually weak, especially his Alakazam and Hypno - otherwise he couldn't have easily erased Lillie's memories.

Using Alakazam's "Teleport," Faba escaped from Aether Paradise and remained missing.

Anyway, the Aether Foundation, International Police, and League police were all searching for him throughout the Alola region.

But with Alola's abundant forests and complex terrain everywhere, if Faba really wanted to hide, finding him quickly wouldn't be easy.

Johan didn't pay much attention to such a "small fry."

With Faba's intelligence, he'd deliver himself sooner or later.

After Faba disappeared, Team Rocket's trio found Bewear's child Stufful in the second floor's ecological area.

Through its explanation, they finally understood.

Stufful had been trapped under a fallen tree during an outing and couldn't move, later discovered by Wicke and Aether Foundation members who rescued it and brought it to Aether Paradise for care.

This was why Bewear couldn't find its child no matter how hard it searched.

Regardless.

Now mother and daughter were reunited, the trio had made great contributions, their relationship with Bewear was even stronger, and Johan promised to apply for bonuses for them.

For the trio, every day during this period was wonderful.

Johan sought out Bewear hoping it would help watch over the Naganadel group that had temporarily relocated to Melemele Island.

"Garruu~"

Bewear followed Johan to the Naganadel's temporary habitat.

This area wasn't small, surrounded by simple fences - not hoping these fences could contain the flying Naganadel, just to make the area division more obvious.

At the entrance, the "UB Task Force's" temporary base was also stationed here, facilitating Ultra Beast research.

Several large tactical tents served as the "UB Task Force" base.

Seeing Johan arrive with Bewear, the busy International Police officers all saluted respectfully, eyes full of respect and admiration.

"Teacher Johan."

Anabel had already learned of Johan's plan to temporarily return to Hoenn, and knowing he'd come here before leaving, she immediately approached.

Johan, holding the clingy Stufful, smiled and introduced:

"Anabel, this is the Bewear I mentioned."

Then he told Bewear:

"This is one of our own. If she encounters any trouble later, please lend a hand for my sake."

"Garruu~"

Bewear nodded expressionlessly, its gaze sweeping over the entire "UB Task Force" base and the area with a nest like a small mountain or beehive.

Might there be honey in there?

"Teacher Johan..." Anabel looked at the "unremarkable" Bewear, pulling Johan aside to quietly ask:

"Is this Bewear really that powerful?"

"Garu!"

Hearing this, Stufful in Johan's arms was the first to express "dissatisfaction," struggling to show Anabel, but Johan held it firmly.

Honestly, though still just a Stufful, this little guy's strength was already surprisingly great, inheriting its mother's terrifying arm strength - it might become another "Bear God" in the future.

"There, there~ Be good~"

Johan took out several energy cubes to pacify the little one.

He said seriously to Anabel: "If nothing unexpected happens, it's 'Legendary' level."

"Le-Legendary?!" Anabel's eyes widened, looking at Bewear in disbelief.

An ordinary wild Pokémon could possess "Legendary" strength?

This...

How were trainers supposed to feel about this?

"Anyway, enemies the Island Guardians can defeat, it can defeat. Enemies the Island Guardians can't defeat, it can also defeat. Heaven and earth, riding waves and diving deep."

"If you really encounter unsolvable trouble, just find it. For my sake, it probably won't refuse to help."

Johan said.

Anabel gulped.

No wonder... no wonder Teacher Johan had the Naganadel move to Melemele Island.

So there was such a "great deity."

But why hadn't many people known about this before?

"I understand!" Anabel took a deep breath, suppressing her inner shock before nodding seriously.

Teacher Johan was lending her a "trump card."

To prevent certain troubles.

Like another Ultra Beast invasion, or the Naganadel group rioting.

"How are they doing?" Johan also looked at the huge nest like a small mountain, asking.

"Very cooperative." Anabel said. "And they show no signs of overstepping boundaries, just working hard to establish roots. When they need anything, they notify me in advance."

"I'll go see them."

Returning Stufful to Bewear, Johan followed Anabel into the "Naganadel Territory."

Upon entering.

The Poipole playing happily in the territory immediately noticed him.

Soon.

When Johan and Anabel entered the Naganadel's huge nest, all the Naganadel and most Poipole had gathered here.

The Naganadel leader even landed on the ground, waiting for Johan's arrival.

"Thank you, thank you for your help, Johan." The Naganadel leader's voice immediately echoed in Johan's mind.

Johan waved his hand, smiling: "We're friends - friends help each other."

"Yes, friends!"

The Naganadel leader strongly agreed with this designation.

"Naganadel, I..." Johan then briefly explained to the Naganadel leader that he'd be leaving for a while.

He also expressed that he would return, and if the timing was right and Ultra Space recovered, he would help them return home.

This earned the Naganadel leader's heartfelt gratitude once again.

Moreover...

"Roar—"

It gently flapped its wings.

Immediately, two robust Naganadel who clearly weren't weak came to its side.

"Johan, these are our group's strongest 'warriors.' Let them accompany you to protect your safety."

"ROAR—!!!"

"ROAR!!!"

The two Naganadel called out excitedly.

Cold sweat appeared on Johan's forehead.

Was this finding him bodyguards, or finding them permanent meal tickets?

He quickly said:

"No, no need. Cough I mean, I have sufficient ability to protect myself, and my partners will ensure this. I appreciate the gesture."

Firmly declining.

Just kidding.

He was already overwhelmed caring for his current team.

His "money-eating beasts" were one thing, but he still hadn't solved the "food" problem for Regieleki and Regidrago.

Only Buzzwole and Kartana got "reimbursement support" from the International Police.

For this return to Hoenn, Johan hadn't planned to bring Buzzwole and Kartana back - he'd let them temporarily stay in the Naganadel territory.

With the Naganadel and "UB Task Force" watching them, plus Bewear as the "final line of defense," it was quite secure.

"I see..." the Naganadel leader said with some regret.

After handling various matters big and small.

Johan finally boarded the plane back to Hoenn.

Seven days remained until his agreed fifteen-day deadline with Drake.

The final eight days still required some preparation - it was the "Champion Road" after all, so he needed to show some respect.

Moreover.

The saplings and crops dug up from Alola, plus the saplings Tapu Bulu had helped cultivate, all needed to be transplanted to his island quickly.

Especially those Revival Herb seedlings.

They'd wilt if left too long.

Those were all treasures.

While Johan was returning to Hoenn, atop Mt. Silver at the Pokémon League headquarters, an internal meeting was also taking place.

"Everyone." Drake, representing the Hoenn League, stood up behind the screen, grinning broadly:

"I think this is my last time participating in meetings. Working with you all has been very pleasant - until we meet again."

Drake's smugness made many League officials present feel envious and jealous.

Damn it!

Teacher Johan, being from Hoenn, ultimately chose the Hoenn region!

Moreover, judging by Drake's tone, he seemed certain Teacher Johan could clear the "Champion Road."

Though indeed, few people doubted it.

Actually, all regional officials understood that forget about Teacher Johan being able to clear the "Champion Road" - even if he fell a little short, everyone appropriately relaxing some conditions wouldn't be questioned.

After all, not every region had requirements as strict as the Kanto League.

They were all regional "treasures" - being nominated to challenge the "Champion Road" was itself a statement.

Unlike other regions, Elite Four Bertha representing Sinnoh didn't harbor such envy or jealousy.

On one hand, she felt their little Cynthia wasn't much inferior.

On the other hand...

Hmph! Whether Johan would really stay in Hoenn permanently remained to be seen.

"I didn't expect my first collaboration with Elite Four Drake to be the last." Professor Kukui, representing the Alola region at the meeting's end, smiled.

The Alola League's application had officially passed headquarters review!

In other words, theoretically, the Alola League was already established.

Founded by Professor Kukui!

But currently, the Alola League only had Professor Kukui.

This meeting mainly introduced the Alola League to everyone and discussed various support and assistance matters from other regions for the Alola region and League establishment.

"Hahaha—" Drake laughed. "Professor Kukui, you'll work very well with Johan."

Professor Kukui smiled, essentially acknowledging Drake's statement.

"If there's opportunity, we in Galar would also like to invite Teacher Johan to assist with teaching in Galar."

Representing the Galar League, Chairman Rose sat at his desk, smiling.

Meeting participants weren't just Champions and Elite Four members - more accurately, participating in meetings was the League President's "job," then Champions, finally Elite Four members representing Champions.

Like the Galar region, Chairman Rose of the Galar League always participated.

The Johto League, Unova League, and Kalos League were all the same.

Strictly speaking, Kukui also participated as a President.

Among Champions participating, only Paldea League Champion Nemona attended.

But actually, Nemona wasn't just Champion but also Paldea League President.

Those represented by Elite Four members included Kanto's Agatha, Hoenn's Drake, and Sinnoh's Bertha - all veteran generation members, with the League internally undergoing generational transition.

"Chairman Rose, for teaching assistance, our Paldea applied earlier than your Galar." Paldea Champion and President Nemona also smiled.

Paldea region's Naranja Academy had much deeper cooperation with Hoenn's Rustboro Pokémon Academy than some Galar schools.

Of course, Galar emphasized battling industry but was relatively ordinary in school construction.

Hearing this, Rose smiled without further comment.

"Everyone."

At this moment.

The League Police Chief, also the highest authority over League Police and International Police, Officer Jenny, who had personally attended the meeting, spoke:

"Based on Teacher Johan's series of contributions, we're preparing to promote him to Chief Inspector."

Chief Inspector!

Second only to the highest authority, and the only Chief Inspector not from the Jenny family!

Officer Jenny had actually discussed this matter, and everyone had already been surprised.

So after brief silence, voices of "agreement" arose.

The League Police Chief was actually equal in rank to attending League Presidents and Champions, so Chief Inspector was one level below Champion.

But at special times, a Chief Inspector's authority might even exceed a regional Champion's!

Because Champions could only represent one region, while Chief Inspectors had authority to command police forces across multiple regions, even including Elite Four members!

Definitely top police brass!

But...

Honestly, with Teacher Johan's "influence," even without being Chief Inspector or Champion, he already had these things.

So really, not many people felt there were major issues.

Hoenn region.

Rustboro City offshore island.

Though he'd only been away a few days, the island had undergone considerable changes.

In fact, the island now had a new appearance every day.

As soon as Johan returned to Rustboro City, he immediately headed straight for the island.

First, he released the four Combee, giving them a stable living environment and abundant flower beds for honey collection.

Combee had some competitive relationship with Pokémon like Beautifly, but got along better with Butterfree.

Moreover, the island's current flower beds were obviously abundant enough to avoid any conflicts.

The Combee would definitely continuously produce Sweet Honey in the future, adding another output to the island farm - Johan was quite pleased.

When the female Combee among them evolved into Vespiquen, the Combee group would enter rapid development, probably not taking much time.

"Bug-type Pokémon reproduction is really fast..." Johan sighed.

Compared to Tauros, Miltank, or Mudbray, Bug-type Pokémon reproduced much faster. As long as the Combee evolved, within a year at most, they'd reach considerable scale.

After settling the Combee.

Johan had Gengar bring out all the saplings, Revival Herb seedlings, and tea tree saplings.

"Lombre, please help water them."

First soaking the saplings before planting work.

This batch of saplings and seedlings was no less than the previous batch, destined to be another "major project" that couldn't be completed in one day.

However, before transplanting, Johan had already tallied this batch of saplings and seedlings.

After all, most were cultivated with Tapu Bulu's help.

As a legendary Pokémon governing "abundance," having Tapu Bulu work almost from dawn to dusk channeling energy, and only cultivating to sapling stage rather than maturity, the quantity was quite considerable.

The consumption was greater only when cultivating "Revival Herbs."

Plus what Johan dug himself.

In total: 123 berry tree saplings, 20 Revival Herb seedlings, 30 tea tree saplings, plus various other crops...

Directly more than doubling the island's berry trees!

Not counting the unique "Miracleberry" sapling, berry trees alone exceeded 200, reaching 203!

Already comparable to small farms.

Among these 123 saplings, the largest portion was Leppa Berry trees - 63 saplings!

Because Johan "customized" based on his berry consumption, and Leppa Berries were famously high-consumption, they were most numerous.

Next were the basic healing berries: Cheri, Pecha, Rawst, Aspear, Persim, and Pinap Berries - 10 each, totaling 60.

These were all basic berries, while Persim and Pinap Berries were characteristic to the Alola region.

It wasn't that Johan didn't want more "advanced" berries.

On one hand, Tapu Bulu indicated that different berries had different cultivation difficulties - the more "advanced" the berry, the more energy it consumed, resulting in fewer quantities.

On the other hand.

Johan still prioritized satisfying his daily berry consumption needs first.

Anyway, he could find Tapu Bulu again later.

Far away in the Alola region, Tapu Bulu sneezed continuously, waking from sleep with a chill down its spine.

"Just waiting for them to bear fruit." Johan was full of motivation.

Of course.

What needed doing now was first planting these berry tree saplings.

The previous batch of berries had already adapted to the new environment, and with Amoonguss's wood carvings and the Gogoat's efforts, they not only adapted but showed obvious growth.

Growth was quite promising.

As for that most special "Miracleberry"...

"Snivy~"

Currently, Snivy stood before the sapling shorter than its shin, eyes closed, mind recalling the scene of Tapu Bulu cultivating saplings.

Reverse-effect move "Giga Drain," feeding back to the sapling.

Don't mention it.

Though not fully learning Tapu Bulu's method, Snivy had already established some connection with this sapling, and the effect was quite good.

In Johan's aura vision...

Snivy and the sapling seemed to establish some special connection - Snivy could cultivate the sapling, while the sapling... was actually feeding back to Snivy!

"Feels like discovering a 'perpetual motion machine' - you two are 'cheating.'"

Johan couldn't help sighing internally.

Miracleberry sapling - the sapling of "Miracleberry," source material for "Rare Candy" that could raise Pokémon levels!

In the entire Pokémon world, perhaps only the Crown Tundra had one remaining tree - this island's might be the second.

"It won't be like Mew and the Tree of Beginning, will it?"

Probably not.

No matter how miraculous, Miracleberries couldn't compare to the Tree of Beginning.

"This Champion Road could be good training for Snivy."

Though island construction and berry planting were important.

Johan's main goal returning this time was still the "Champion Road."

So after returning, Johan temporarily assigned the island's sapling planting task to the Dugtrio and Gogoat.

He himself dove into Rustboro Pokémon Academy's special training grounds the next day with his Pokémon.

Along came the eager Indeedee-F.

Under Mewtwo's "guidance," Indeedee-F's psychic abilities had improved considerably.

Moreover, regarding the "Champion Road," Indeedee-F was also eager to try - Johan, having promised it, naturally brought it along for preparation.

However, before preparation.

Johan decided to first assess his Pokémon's current levels.

So-called assessment naturally meant the long-anticipated intra-team tournament.

Or rather, a "family hierarchy" challenge tournament.

Deciding who was "emperor" and who was "little brother."

So after arriving at the training ground, Johan threw out all his Poké Balls, summoning all his Pokémon.

Even including Regieleki, Regidrago, invisible Victini, and Marshadow who disliked meeting strangers.

Of course, they weren't participating - they'd observe with Johan.

With ten Pokémon total, including Indeedee-F and Rotom, Johan divided his Pokémon into two teams - Team One and Team Two.

Team One consisted of Gengar, Ninetales, Tinkaton, Dragonite, Urshifu, and Ceruledge.

Team Two was Tyranitar, Snivy, Indeedee-F, and Rotom.

However, it wasn't that Team One only fought Team One and Team Two only fought Team Two - Team Two could also challenge Team One.

A simple ranking tournament.

Also to let everyone gain clearer understanding of each other's strength, enabling better cooperation and improvement.

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar immediately raised its hand, eagerly preparing for battle.

Then Johan grabbed it and pressed it beside him.

You purple chubby going first would eliminate any point in "ranking."

"First, let's agree - everyone uses regular abilities, no enhancements, I won't assist with aura either. As for moves... use your judgment."

Johan set the ground rules for everyone.

"Indeedee~"

Indeedee-F smiled gently, rubbing its palms.

Requesting to battle!
