# 710: Champion Road, Officially Begins! (Two-in-One Chapter)

Sunset dusk.

Rustboro Pokémon Academy, special training grounds.

In the ravaged training field, the little ones had various expressions, their excitement not yet completely faded.

And the new ranking for Johan's team was officially announced.

In order: Gengar, Ninetales, Tinkaton, Dragonite, Urshifu, Ceruledge, Tyranitar, Indeedee-F, Snivy, and Rotom.

What surprised Johan most was undoubtedly Gengar.

Maybe it had accumulated enough, or maybe after fighting Kyogre, it had gained massive "experience."

After a good sleep, it had actually achieved a major breakthrough in strength.

Legendary!

Successfully crossing the Champion threshold and reaching a completely new height.

If using game levels as a "setting," then Gengar's current level was probably... ninety!

You had to know that in the games, even Red when he first became Champion only had Pokémon around level eighty-five.

Of course, a team of eighty-five versus one at ninety was quite different conceptually.

However, "levels" were just Johan's own vague estimates for measurement, satisfying his little quirk as a "gamer."

In any case.

Gengar had reached "Legendary" level in one leap!

Even in its normal state, it could probably wrestle with Bewear now.

And Gengar's major breakthrough naturally secured its position as leader of the "outlaw squad."

Next was Ninetales.

After obtaining auras from Alola's four islands plus the "Fairy Plate," Ninetales' strength entered a rapid growth phase.

However, both the aura power and "Fairy Plate" had only been acquired recently, plus with many matters in the Alola region, Ninetales hadn't had time to properly digest and convert them.

Currently, without using the "Fairy Plate," its strength was somewhere between... above ordinary Champion ace Pokémon but not yet reaching "Legendary" level.

Perhaps.

These few days, plus the tempering of the "Champion Road," could let it advance further!

Then Johan would truly wield dual "Legendary" Pokémon!

Combined with their respective enhancements.

Even "first-tier gods," perhaps even those fully powered "first-tier gods," might be worth challenging.

Of course, while Ninetales temporarily ranked second in strength, in family hierarchy it was equal to Gengar, even able to suppress Gengar.

Who told Gengar to always feel somewhat intimidated by Ninetales?

As for third-place Tinkaton and fourth-place Dragonite.

Actually, Dragonite was slightly stronger than Tinkaton. Even without activating "Outrage" mode, it still had "Extreme Speed" - wait no, Outrage.

But unfortunately.

As a Fairy and Steel-type Pokémon, Tinkaton naturally countered Dragonite.

Moreover, Dragonite barely qualified as a "big bird."

It met all the criteria.

So Dragonite could only temporarily rank behind Tinkaton.

But if Dragonite had Johan's assistance and activated "Outrage" mode, or even went berserk with double "Outrage," its strength could even threaten Ninetales!

Even though Ninetales was Fairy and Ice-type.

After all, Dragonite's luck in battle really made Johan think he was blessed by fortune each time.

However, in team battles.

Everyone fought without real intensity, and without enhancements, comparing only normal strength.

Ultimately.

Enhancements and going berserk weren't unique to Johan and his Pokémon - what you had, others had too.

Tinkaton's strength had somewhat plateaued temporarily.

But no matter.

Once Ninetales figured out the "Fairy Plate," Tinkaton would also benefit considerably.

As for Master Bear...

Dragonite was at a type disadvantage against Tinkaton, but had a major advantage against Urshifu.

Similarly.

Urshifu also had type advantage when facing Ceruledge.

Moreover.

Ceruledge's "one-strike style secrets" were personally taught by Master Bear.

They were too familiar with each other, too understanding.

However, Ceruledge had also improved. Sparring swordsmanship with Kartana had enhanced Ceruledge's strength.

Combined with "life fire" recovery.

Ceruledge withstood pressure from the "reserve" Tyranitar.

Speaking of Tyranitar, it was really threatening the "first team."

Its strength had already reached Champion level!

Combined with "Precipice Blades," it nearly caused Ceruledge to stumble.

This made Johan quite pleased.

Though consuming so many diamonds, meteorites, and ores was indeed excessive, Tyranitar's strength improvement was visible.

If paired with "Mega Evolution," even if Ceruledge switched to "cannon form" plus Johan's aura assistance, victory remained uncertain.

Especially with Tyranitar having type advantage.

Only because Ceruledge was too familiar with Tyranitar's sandstorms, plus Ceruledge mastered aura - otherwise the sandstorm alone would be very troublesome.

Tyranitar's progress and pursuit once again made Ceruledge and Urshifu feel pressure.

Indeedee-F was quite surprising to Johan.

Under Mewtwo's guidance, Indeedee-F's strength had indeed improved greatly, especially its psychic control.

If Indeedee-F's psychic power was ten, it could previously only use about six.

But after Mewtwo's guidance, Indeedee-F could now use eight or even nine!

Moreover.

Years of continuous high-quality energy cube nurturing, plus after Johan learned Indeedee-F's wishes, he provided many materials helpful to Psychic-type Pokémon.

Indeedee-F's strength now exceeded ordinary Elite Four main Pokémon level, just short of ordinary Elite Four ace Pokémon.

A real surprise.

As for Snivy...

The little one was indeed working hard.

But unfortunately it hadn't evolved yet, creating an innate gap.

Fortunately, the non-combat "photographer" Rotom was at the bottom, preventing proud Snivy from ranking last.

However, this first participation in "team ranking battle" made Snivy realize its shortcomings.

Just from its expression, Johan felt its determination to become stronger.

It also made Snivy develop some anticipation for "evolution" for the first time.

Originally, Snivy was indifferent about evolution.

After all, evolved or not, its former opponents couldn't beat it.

Even against Serperior, whom it once considered a rival, it maintained the attitude of... I don't need to evolve to beat you.

But after joining the team and witnessing Johan's Pokémon and partners' strength, its mindset changed.

Especially after several major events where everyone could help while it barely had chances to appear, further stimulating its pride.

Therefore, its indifferent attitude toward evolution gradually became more positive.

Johan could sense this.

Though Snivy didn't say so, if a trainer couldn't sense this much, Johan wouldn't be qualified as a Pokémon psychologist teaching Pokémon psychology.

However, the "Forest's Blessing" that Calyrex mentioned made Snivy's evolution much more difficult than other Pokémon.

So Johan decided.

To help Snivy, during this "Champion Road," whenever within Snivy's limits, he'd let it battle more.

Intensive training.

As for Rotom.

It was more like "making up numbers."

The little one had no thoughts about ranking last.

It just hoped to capture more good scenery and photos, trying to reduce Gengar's interference.

Small as it was, its thoughts were small too, very easily satisfied.

Team ranking battle ended.

Overall.

Besides Gengar's breakthrough and Indeedee-F's strength display, nothing much exceeded Johan's expectations.

As a trainer, he had clear understanding of his Pokémon's abilities and strength.

Team battles served two purposes.

First, letting everyone become more familiar with each other.

Second, slightly adjusting the little ones' mindset.

With "Champion Road" approaching, a few days to adjust to optimal condition was sufficient.

Clap clap!

Johan clapped, drawing the little ones' attention.

"I've made a simple 'seven-day sprint' plan. Come listen - I'll make arrangements."

These seven days, besides tree planting, would probably be spent in training grounds.

Some respect was due to the "Champion Road."

Time passed busily and fulfillingly.

During these days.

Though the Hoenn League's announcement of Teacher Johan's "Champion Road" challenge sparked intense online discussion.

And as the "Champion Road" opening approached, discussions became more heated, but this didn't affect Johan's rare complete focus on training.

His various friends, students, and seniors.

Though concerned, none called or visited to inquire.

Giving Johan sufficient time and space.

Until the day before "Champion Road" opened, Elite Four Drake representing the Hoenn League came to escort him to the "Champion Road."

"Why did you come personally, sir?"

In the café.

Johan handed Drake hot tea - Drake didn't like coffee.

"This is wild tea I picked in Alola, roasted myself. Please try it."

Hearing it wasn't Gengar-brewed tea, Drake sighed in relief.

"How's preparation going?" Drake asked, taking a small sip with brightening eyes. "Not bad."

Johan smiled.

"Honestly, if you hadn't come, I'd have almost forgotten the time."

"Hahaha—"

Drake laughed heartily, clearly in excellent spirits.

Or rather, he'd been in good spirits lately.

Finally.

Finally he could confidently pass the burden to young people. He was gratified and satisfied.

The only shortcoming was not knowing when Steven would take office, so he could confidently set down his burden completely and sail off adventuring!

"I came for two reasons: bringing you there, and explaining 'Champion Road' precautions."

"Oh?"

Johan raised an eyebrow.

The "Champion Road" had precautions?

Wasn't it just fighting all the way through until defeating all Elite Four?

Drake then briefly explained.

Originally, "Champion Road" opening would have many top trainers participating, first requiring tournament-style rounds, with only qualifiers earning access.

Because it wasn't just for Champion position, but also Elite Four positions.

But this "Champion Road" was opened specifically for Johan alone, so that stage was skipped.

However, this eliminated a "consumption" stage.

"There's that too..."

"So to shut some people up, the 'Champion Road' will be entirely livestreamed." Drake smacked his lips.

"Livestream?" Johan was startled.

"You needn't worry about that." Drake waved dismissively, showing a teasing smile. "Anyway, some 'surprises' have been prepared for you."

Johan's expression turned strange.

Surprises?

Hopefully not shocks.

You couldn't move legendary Pokémon to the Champion Road, surely?

"There are some rules to tell you."

Drake cleared his throat, setting down his teacup.

"First, after entering 'Champion Road,' usable recovery items will be limited in quantity."

Actually, "Champion Road's" original purpose wasn't just selecting a Champion, but letting trainers and Pokémon truly experience their limits.

"However, there will be temporary Pokémon Centers in some locations where Nurse Joy can help with recovery. But after entering the 'Elite Four Territory,' there won't be any, so save recovery items for then."

"Second, each Pokémon can only use one type of item."

After pausing, Drake looked at him:

"You might not know - recently, headquarters classified 'Mega Evolution Stones' as Pokémon items."

Limited recovery items meant nothing to Johan.

You could limit recovery item quantities, but could you limit Pokémon food?

His energy cubes inherently restored condition and stamina, just with slower effects and speed.

Moreover, with Indeedee-F accompanying, its "Heal Pulse" move was a mobile "simple Pokémon Center."

Plus Ninetales' 'Fairy Aura,' Ceruledge's "life fire," Snivy's 'Forest's Blessing' - recovery really wasn't concerning.

As for classifying "Mega Evolution Stones" as items...

Johan's expression turned strange.

Felt like the League was "targeting" him.

But acceptable.

Within acceptable range.

Anyway, the "Fairy Plate" was also an item, right?

"Finally, Pokémon numbers..." Drake looked at Johan, stopping mid-sentence.

"Hm?"

"Forget it." Drake waved his hand. "For you it's the same, and there are temporary Pokémon Centers along the way for switching anyway. Bring however many you want."

Johan smiled.

Limit to six Pokémon?

Where there's policy, there are countermeasures.

How many Pokémon he brought really wasn't anyone's business.

"Are there move restrictions?" Johan asked.

"Moves?"

Drake was puzzled, then said: "What move restrictions would there be? Except some special tournaments limiting move numbers, normally there wouldn't be move restrictions..."

"I mean, moves." Johan emphasized again, looking seriously at Drake.

Drake finally understood, his expression becoming strange.

Illegal moves, huh?

"Currently, no such regulation." Drake said.

You think everyone's Pokémon are like yours with so many illegal moves?

"Then it's fine."

"Johan, remember the request Glacia and I made before?" Drake suddenly asked.

"After the Twin Gods incident?" Johan was puzzled why Drake mentioned this.

"Good you haven't forgotten." Drake showed a meaningful smile.

Drake's smile seemed strange somehow.

Johan turned: "Gengar, Drake's tea is finished. Quick, pour tea."

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar cheerfully responded.

Floating over.

Holding the Sinistea teapot, pouring tea for Drake.

"This, this teapot?" Drake clearly recognized the Sinistea, face stiffening.

"No problem, Sinistea is very safe, and makes tea more flavorful. You found the taste good too, right?"

Drake's mouth twitched. "...Why don't you have some?"

"I prefer coffee." Johan showed a mischievous smile.

That's what you get for being mysterious with me, old man.

Drake: "..."

August 24th, Friday.

Hoenn region, Ever Grande Island.

The Hoenn League headquarters sat at Ever Grande Island's northernmost point, while "Champion Road's" beginning was at the southernmost point - Ever Grande City.

Golden sunlight spread throughout Ever Grande City's Ever Grande Stadium.

This was where the Hoenn region held League Conferences.

According to League rules, any League Conference champion could challenge the "Champion Road" - hence the stadium's location.

Conference champions just needed to register their teams and climb the stairs behind to enter "Champion Road."

However.

Conference champions were still just conference champions. Winning conferences didn't guarantee strength for "Champion Road."

Therefore, except for very few who challenged "Champion Road" immediately after winning conferences, most conference champions postponed this qualification.

Waiting until they had stronger power and confidence before challenging.

Today.

No League Conference was held, but the stadium was packed, with tsunami-like cheers rising wave after wave from the circular venue.

These were spectators here to watch Teacher Johan challenge the "Champion Road."

In the stadium center, no battle field or referee remained - only a huge screen focused on one person.

Black tailored suit, black hair and eyes, refined golden monocle.

Under countless gazes, he stepped up the stairs.

"Teacher Johan!!"

"Johan-baby, go for it!!"

"Sweep the 'Champion Road,' become Champion!"

"Johan-baby, when will you be Hoenn Champion? Right now!"

"..."

Countless cheers and shouts expressed support for Johan.

Numerous helicopters, Magnemite cameras, Rotom drone cameras circled in the air around Johan.

Johan walked relaxedly to the stairway top.

After turning to wave at all his supporters, he stepped through the gate.

The "Champion Road" officially began!

The first stage.

Walking from Ever Grande Stadium to the "Elite Four Fortress" established by League headquarters.

During this.

Countless powerful wild Pokémon would become Johan's greatest obstacles.

"It's started!"

"Finally started!"

"Livestream! Where's the director? Switch cameras quickly! Do you know how?"

"..."

Whether live spectators or online viewers, all stared intently at screens.

"Champion Road" had a five-day time limit. Failing to reach the "Elite Four Fortress" from Ever Grande Stadium within five days meant challenge failure.

With "Champion Road's" opening, the League's official website forum exploded with heated discussion.

"I heard 'Champion Road' wild Pokémon are all strong?"

"Strong? You probably still lack clear understanding of 'Champion Road.' It's not just strong - it's dangerous!"

"Moreover, 'Champion Road' wild Pokémon often aren't alone, but live in groups - encountering one might mean facing many!"

"And they're extremely vicious with strong territorial awareness. Though maybe not as dangerous as Mt. Silver, it's close."

"Supposedly, though these wild Pokémon can be caught, most cases make bonding with trainers very difficult."

"More than that - some forcibly caught Pokémon even attack and injure trainers they consider weak before returning on their own!"

Some "experts'" comments made many without accurate "Champion Road" concepts realize this place's danger.

Didn't they see that even during the Twin Gods incident, when Kyogre awakened from the sea, it directly detoured around Ever Grande Island to enter Hoenn?

If even Kyogre had to detour, imagine the danger level.

Perhaps to verify these "experts'" words, the director very "thoughtfully" switched to footage of wild Pokémon clashing on "Champion Road" while Johan had just entered without battles yet.

A extremely fierce Salamence facing a Mightyena that accidentally entered its territory directly unleashed an unreasonable Hyper Beam.

Rumble!!!

The massive commotion and move power made many spectators gasp.

"Holy crap!"

"That strong? I feel like if I went in... I might not survive five minutes."

"This is just the tip of the iceberg. Why else call it 'Champion Road'?"

Maintaining such an area required countless Rangers from the League.

Even Elite Four work specifically included "maintaining Champion Road."

Johan had previously helped handle one of its troublesome matters.

And the League allowing powerful trainers to train in "Champion Road" was itself a maintenance method.

"Champion Road."

Johan exited the stadium, looking at this "primeval forest" before him, clicking his tongue.

According to Drake's intelligence.

Hoenn region's Ever Grande Island "Champion Road" could mainly be divided into several key areas.

What he now entered was the "Ascending Forest."

As the name suggested.

This was an uphill path.

"Give intelligence but not detailed?"

Johan pouted, throwing out Poké Balls.

"Snivy~"

Snivy appeared at his feet in red light.

Along with Indeedee-F.

"Indeedee~"

Upon appearing, Indeedee-F's psychic power spread from its body, covering surroundings to prevent sudden danger while curiously exploring this strange environment.

"Snivy?"

Seeing this towering primeval forest, Snivy was briefly stunned.

From this forest, it sensed the purest and most vigorous "forest aura" it had ever faced.

Unconsciously.

Its breathing seemed to sync with the forest's "breathing."

Even Snivy's body was covered in faint green luminescence.

Hm?

Noticing Snivy's change, Johan was somewhat surprised.

So "Forest's Blessing" still needed to return to forests.

Next opportunity, he could take Snivy to the Tree of Beginning to see what happened.

"Let's go."

Johan waved.

"Five-day limit - aim to reach the destination in two days."

Camping overnight in such a place felt unsettling.

Not unsettling about personal safety, but unsettling for the wild Pokémon inside.

One more night meant one more day of suffering for them.

"I'm so kind..."

"Indeedee~"

Hearing this, Indeedee-F followed Johan closely while psychically floating out a plate.

On it sat freshly brewed hot coffee and exquisite small pastries.

"Thank you, Indeedee."

Johan smiled, taking the coffee and pastries, eating while entering "Ascending Forest."

This scene left spectators stunned.

Wait.

Teacher Johan, are you here to challenge "Champion Road" or go on a picnic?

So well prepared?

This really wasn't Johan's arrangement, but Indeedee-F's own preparation.

In its view.

Taking care of Johan was its duty.

This made Johan somewhat regretful.

Regretful he hadn't brought Indeedee-F earlier - life would have been so much more comfortable.

Compared to "troublemaker" Gengar's group, Indeedee-F was truly... too considerate!

"This kid..."

Through the screen, in the "Elite Four Fortress," Drake, Glacia, Sidney, and Phoebe sat in the lounge watching the livestream.

Seeing Johan so leisurely, Drake couldn't help complaining.

Looking at the fruits on the table, they suddenly seemed less appetizing.

Who exactly was challenging the "Champion Road"?

"When will Teacher Johan arrive? I'm getting nervous..." Phoebe rubbed her palms.

Elite Four being nervous about "Champion Road" challenges was a first.

"About to enter Heracross territory?" Glacia also wanted Mauville City cakes but still asked.

"Yes."

A nearby staff member quickly responded.

As soon as he spoke.

Movement appeared in the livestream.

From the forested slope ahead came roaring.

"Heracross—!!!"

With heavy footsteps, a Heracross emerged from the forest - armored in hard carapace, extremely robust limbs, especially massive horns gleaming ominously, clearly formidable.

"Ah, sorry for disturbing your meal."

Johan politely greeted and apologized, then took out cake: "Want some?"

"Heracross!"

But Heracross showed no communication intent, unlike gentle Heracross from other regions. It directly attacked.

Its massive horn aimed at Johan like a bulldozer, causing slight ground tremors as it charged.

"Tsk."

Johan remained calm.

"Indeed, 'Champion Road' wild Pokémon are hard to communicate with, let alone capture and bond."

"Champion Road" Pokémon retained wild Pokémon's purest ferocity, like ancient times when humans couldn't yet capture Pokémon.

"Indeedee~!"

Standing with Johan, Indeedee-F called softly as a strange field emanated from it, rapidly spreading outward.

Surrounding leaves and bushes seemed covered in light purple gauze.

Psychic Terrain!

"Indeedee, Psychic." Johan bit into cake, speaking calmly.

"Indeedee!"

Blue light appeared in Indeedee-F's eyes as it raised its palm, pale blue psychic power bursting forth.

Bang!!!

Heracross's Megahorn seemed to hit a hard, solid wall, producing a dull thud.

"Expanding Force."

"Indeedee!!!"

Indeedee-F's voice rose excitedly.

As its palm fell from above, invisible psychic force poured down from Heracross's head.

Thud—

Directly pressing it into the ground, even embedding it in soil.

Heracross looked shocked at the seemingly gentle Pokémon opposite.

What power was this...

Bang! Bang! Bang!

However.

Not just this Heracross - forest Heracross that hadn't appeared but entered Psychic Terrain were all pressed to the ground by powerful psychic force.

Unable to battle!

"This, this, this is over already?"

"Holy crap, one raise, one press - not just this Heracross, but all forest Heracross not yet visible were pressed down!"

"If I hadn't just seen those wild Pokémon battles showing their power, I'd almost think I could do it too."

"Feels like numbers are meaningless against Indeedee..."

As Johan resumed his journey, defeating the Heracross group marked the true beginning of this "Champion Road" challenge!

"Snivy!" Snivy puffed its cheeks.

Johan chuckled.

"Alright, next time you go first."

Just starting, just warm-up - no rush.

He looked forward to the "surprises" Drake mentioned.

# 711: Forest's Blessing, Light of Evolution! (Two-in-One Chapter)

Hoenn region, Champion Road, Ascending Forest.

Towering trees blocked most of the light, with dappled spots of light flickering faintly.

The closer to the mountaintop, the more serious Johan's attitude became as he walked the path.

Beside him, Indeedee-F and Snivy remained alert to their surroundings.

After passing through the Heracross group, they had encountered several more wild Pokémon attacks.

All were defeated by Snivy and Indeedee-F respectively.

It had to be admitted that the "Champion Road" was so intimidating not just because of the final Elite Four and Champion - the first stage's journey alone was enough to block most trainers.

No wonder so many top trainers whose strength had plateaued chose to train on the "Champion Road."

Rustle rustle rustle—

The forest leaves suddenly showed irregular swaying.

The next second.

Forest sounds abruptly ceased, and the entire woods seemed to fall into some eerie silence.

"The real deal is coming." Johan lowered his voice.

From the audience's perspective, they could already see the Pokémon launching this attack - a Hydreigon radiating vicious aura with an extremely fierce appearance!

After brief silence, it suddenly struck!

"Roar!!!"

Sound before sight.

Three attacks representing ice, fire, and electricity flew from the forest.

Rumble!!!

"Indeedee!"

Indeedee-F's expression suddenly became serious as it dropped both arms, instantly creating a transparent barrier to block this surprise attack.

However, even blocking the frontal assault, the scattered aftershocks still left vicious marks around Johan.

Ice, charring, scattered earth.

A pseudo-legendary Pokémon!

And extraordinarily powerful!

Seeing the destruction caused by Hydreigon's attack aftershocks, the audience's hearts jumped to their throats.

They immediately understood.

Perhaps this Hydreigon was the most important and powerful "boss" of this "Ascending Forest."

"I can feel this Hydreigon's power even through the screen."

"Not just a pseudo-legendary, but a powerful pseudo-legendary!"

"Dark and Dragon types have quite an advantage over Indeedee-F. Teacher Johan should summon other Pokémon now, right?"

The audience voiced their opinions.

Meanwhile, the League's filming team - Magnemite cameramen and Rotom drone cameras - all locked onto this location.

Moreover, the League's special medical team was already prepared on helicopters.

Seeing its attack blocked, Hydreigon roared furiously, wings beating violently as it charged toward Johan.

Three heads' massive jaws looked extremely vicious, wrapped in thick Dark-type energy.

Crunch!

"Snivy!"

Johan called out lightly.

"Snivy!"

Snivy, already prepared, immediately extended its vine whips toward Hydreigon.

Facing the "weak" Snivy, Hydreigon arrogantly showed disdain.

But when the vine whips approached with their sharp whooshing sound and wind that made even its face sting, Hydreigon realized... damn it, this Snivy was playing possum!

One misjudgment handed over the initiative.

Crack!!!

The vine whip didn't strike Hydreigon but wrapped around its mouth, forcibly tightening and interrupting Hydreigon's Crunch.

However, this Hydreigon that could become "boss" in an area where all wild Pokémon were very powerful naturally had rich strength and battle experience.

So the moment Snivy's vine whip wrapped around its mouth, the Dark-type energy dispersed instantly, transforming into rich Dragon-type energy that immediately enveloped its entire body.

Dragon Rush!

"Tsk." Feeling Hydreigon's change, Johan couldn't help clicking his tongue.

On one hand, he marveled at this "Champion Road" Hydreigon's quick reaction, already matching Pokémon commanded by trainers with rich battle experience.

On the other hand, he sighed that "Champion Road" truly lived up to its name, designed to test, wear down, and train challengers' will, strength, and ability. This Hydreigon's strength probably already reached ordinary Elite Four main Pokémon level or above.

Wild Pokémon growing to this level wasn't easy.

Of course.

Having witnessed Bewear in the Alola region, such a Hydreigon couldn't give him "surprises."

"Snivy, Leaf Storm!" Admiration aside, Johan's movements and reactions were never slow.

"Snivy!"

Standing on the ground, Snivy was dragged across the earth by the vine whip, carving two deep furrows.

But despite being small, the little one showed no fear.

Moreover.

Hydreigon's arrogance and previous disdain toward it stirred Snivy's inner pride.

I, Snivy, won't allow such arrogant beings to exist.

Rustle rustle rustle—

Forest leaves shook violently. Snivy simply released its power struggle with Hydreigon, its tail swirling as countless leaves danced and swirled toward it.

Instantly, a tornado of leaves swept toward Hydreigon.

Boom!!!

"Roar!!!"

Breaking free from the vine whip's restraint, Hydreigon's three massive jaws opened again, roaring while three blazing fire columns swept forward.

Flamethrower!

What Hydreigon excelled at was ultimately special attack, and against Grass-types, Fire-type was naturally the best approach.

Johan watched Snivy, his aura clearly sensing a faint connection establishing between Snivy and the surrounding forest, his heart stirring.

"Snivy, again - Leaf Storm!"

"Indeedee-F, Helping Hand!"

"Indeedee~!"

Indeedee-F seemed to sense Snivy's fighting spirit and naturally gave its all to help its teammate. Gentle light fell on Snivy, granting it stronger power.

Simultaneously, the "Contrary" ability also gave Snivy's special attack a huge boost.

Leaf Storm swept out again.

Boom!!!

Leaves against flames - surprisingly matched again!

This time, even Hydreigon was surprised.

But Snivy wasn't satisfied with Hydreigon's surprise. Its short tail swayed again, surging Grass-type energy bursting forth.

At its feet, clusters of grass sprouted, and surrounding leaf rustling became increasingly obvious.

Once more.

Leaf Storm!

"Snivy!!!"

At this moment, Snivy's special attack had reached the maximum through "Contrary" ability!

Countless leaves fell from the forest, wrapped in shimmering green light, the leaves traced spiraling arcs in the air, charging toward Hydreigon.

Hydreigon didn't sit idle. Dodging was definitely too late, but it refused to believe it couldn't match such a small Snivy.

Three massive jaws snapped shut, with wisps of blazing flames seeping through its teeth.

Draco Meteor!

Rumble!!!

The explosion again created massive commotion, the resulting shockwave nearly knocking Snivy over.

Hydreigon was also sent flying backward!

"Indeedee-F, Psych Up." Johan said softly.

"Indeedee~"

Light blue energy waves appeared in Indeedee-F's eyes as it "copied" Snivy's momentum fluctuations onto itself.

[Psych Up: Through self-hypnosis and suggestion, gain the same stat changes as the target!]

With three Leaf Storms, Snivy's special attack had been maximized, and through Psych Up, Indeedee-F gained identical stat boosts.

Special Attack, maxed!

"Dazzling Gleam."

"Indeedee!!!"

Indeedee-F's aura rapidly climbed as it called out excitedly. A brilliant beam of light shot from its fingertip, dispersing the explosion's smoke and striking the unstable Hydreigon.

Unfair - how did it become two-on-one?!

Boom!!!

Hydreigon was swallowed by Dazzling Gleam's light, sent flying solidly.

Thud—

Falling to the ground with spiraled eyes, unable to battle.

"Snivy!"

Snivy extended its vine whip, hovering before Indeedee-F.

"Indeedee~"

Indeedee-F smiled gently with some excitement, lightly tapping Snivy's vine whip.

Clap—

Great cooperation.

"One Dazzling Gleam KO'd Hydreigon?"

"Snivy and Indeedee-F - one with Contrary for strengthening and combat, the other either using screens for defense or pairing Psych Up for one-hit kills. Such good coordination."

"Wait, this Snivy could actually face such a strong Hydreigon head-on without falling behind?"

"Heh! Haven't you heard Teacher Johan's nickname? These are Pokémon specifically for beating babies. The last Larvitar, during its consecutive evolution, could fight Groudon!"

"..."

Another uproar among the audience.

Rescue teams began moving.

Naturally for Hydreigon and the wild Pokémon Johan had previously defeated.

But Johan suddenly began quickening his pace.

Snivy and Indeedee-F with +6 special attack.

Shouldn't he maximize their advantage?

"Indeedee-F, Expanding Force!"

A group of Ariados fell in succession.

"Snivy, Leaf Storm!"

Graveler and Golem hiding in rock piles were swept away.

Though still unobstructed as before.

The visual impact was far beyond previous comparisons.

Sweep!

Sweep!

Sweep!

Regardless of what Pokémon or groups, none could withstand the Indeedee-F and Snivy combination.

"If this were a game, I could max out all Pokémon levels here."

Really no better "grinding" spot than here.

"Others said the early 'Champion Road' was boring - the hell was boring about this? So exciting!"

Someone posted on the livestream forum.

"Obviously! Previous 'Champion Road' challengers, confident or not, who didn't sneak around conserving stamina? Who charged through like Teacher Johan?"

"It's only been an hour since defeating Hydreigon, but he's already covered twice the distance."

"Whoa! Just swept another group of Breloom - so fierce."

Meanwhile.

On the "Champion Road."

Johan chose to accelerate for two reasons.

One was indeed because of Indeedee-F and Snivy's special attack boosts, and neither currently faced stamina crises.

The other was Johan's keen sense that Snivy had established resonance with this rarely-trodden primeval forest.

The more they battled, the more power Snivy wielded, the stronger this resonance became, and the mysterious connection grew more stable and solid.

The green luminescence on Snivy's body became increasingly obvious.

Only Snivy itself hadn't noticed.

Instead, it was completely immersed in battle's joy and excitement.

It didn't even notice that besides Contrary and Leaf Storm's stat boosts, its own strength and aura were also improving through repeated battles and clashes.

Of course, while Snivy didn't notice, Johan and Indeedee-F sensed it clearly.

Therefore.

Whether Johan or Indeedee-F, both silently yielded the main battle, or rather main damage dealer position, to Snivy.

"Snivy!"

Snivy slashed out dozens of wide leaves, instantly defeating the blocking Pokémon.

Rustle rustle rustle—

Forest leaves swayed, as if cheering, as if celebrating.

Here, they had crossed the "Ascending Forest" and entered the "Sleeping Forest."

"Woo woo woo!!!"

Leaves and branches shook violently again, accompanied by noisy calls as Vigoroth after Vigoroth swung their arms, rapidly shuttling through the forest toward them.

Vigoroth?

Ground tremors.

Still manageable.

Indeedee-F's Psychic Terrain instantly spread and covered the surrounding forest.

Glowing green points like fireflies emerged from the forest one after another, quickly merging into Snivy's body.

And Snivy's aura began climbing with this forest power infusion.

Hm?

This was...

The same connection method Snivy had with the "Miracleberry" tree?

Similar to... Tapu Bulu drawing power from its cultivated plants to strengthen itself.

"Forest's Blessing..."

Johan murmured, suddenly understanding and feeling moved.

Viridian Forest's blessing was Viridian Power.

The stamina-drained Slaking suddenly exerted force, forcibly breaking Snivy's Giga Drain energy restraints, suppressing "Truant" limitations.

"Ka-kaah! (Д)σ"

Unable to battle!

Has my spirit - not bad!

Hum—

Evolution light!

Servine!

# 712: The True "Champion Road" Officially Begins!

Hyper Voice!

"Take it, Dragon Dance!"

Dragon Dance?

Couldn't dodge.

Hydro Pump!

During this.

Clearly.

Tyranitar excelled at frontal combat.

Inside the "Elite Four Fortress."

After all, he'd done a mission here once.

In the distance.

He could already see the "Elite Four Fortress."

Lighting another fire, cooking again.

But he wouldn't skip rest for this so-called "sensation" and immediately challenge the Elite Four.

Really treating the Elite Four like babies?

Forget everything else.

Just Drake alone posed certain threats to Johan.

The journey's clashes and battles had also drained much energy.

Waiting while fresh versus tired could easily cause upsets.

Eat well, soak in hot springs, rest beautifully overnight, recharging energy.

Though the underwater volcano had cooled, it created natural hot springs.

With a pot of steaming curry...

Life couldn't be more comfortable.

This made screen-watching audiences "curse" again.

"Champion Road"?

No, vacation road!

They'd prepared everything, but Johan "retreated"?

"I understand! This is tactics! Teacher Johan's psychological tactics!"

"Exactly! Previously the Elite Four had rested advantage, now it's reversed - the Elite Four don't know when Johan will challenge, so they became the more nervous ones!"

"Right, seeing Teacher Johan eating delicious curry and soaking in comfortable hot springs, what do you think the fortress Elite Four feel?"

"Holy crap! Is that it?"

"So dirty! Psychology people have 'dirty' hearts!"

"..."

Forum "experts" provided reasonable analysis of Johan's behavior.

Really sounded convincing, as if it were true.

Splash splash—

Hot spring water flowed as Tyranitar "splash" burst from the surface, making fierce expressions.

"Alright, go play yourself."

Johan leaned against the pool edge, splashing Tyranitar's face.

Since learning to swim, Tyranitar had become very fond of playing in water and swimming.

A Desert Tyrant liking water was somewhat unreasonable, right?

"Tyranitar~"

Tyranitar grinned, swimming away.

The Magnemite cameras and Rotom drones had returned.

After confirming Johan had no special habit of challenging Elite Four at midnight, today's livestream ended.

Johan contemplated tomorrow's Elite Four battle formations.

Dark, Ghost, Ice, and Dragon types.

The phone rang.

Caller ID showed Cynthia.

The whole world knew Johan was challenging "Champion Road" - how could his girlfriend Cynthia not know?

"Won't disturb your rest, will it?" Cynthia's voice remained gentle.

"Of course not, just Elite Four..." Johan grinned.

"Seeing your confidence reassures me."

"Watch tomorrow - I'll demonstrate, then you can beat up Flint and the others this way..."

"Mm..."

The next day.

Sunny skies.

Having slept in and rested well, Johan emerged from his tent with somewhat messy hair.

As soon as he appeared, Magnemite cameras and Rotom drones swarmed over.

Compared to yesterday's journey completion, today's "Champion Road" attention was higher.

Ultimately.

Though the pre-Elite Four journey was difficult, many people could actually complete it.

With enough caution and proper Pokémon stamina distribution, plus avoiding difficult Pokémon groups, even taking several extra days, one could walk from the conference venue to the "Elite Four Fortress."

The "Champion Road's" true difficulty lay in challenging the four Elite Four!

No Pokémon Centers midway, limited recovery items, only successfully challenging all Elite Four and Champion counted as success!

This was the real test moment.

Thud!!!

The "Elite Four Fortress" gates were forcefully pushed open.

Properly dressed Johan stood at the entrance, light and shadow streaming in.

Clang clang clang—

Lights inside the fortress lit up one by one, completely illuminating the entire battle field.

By the second-floor railings.

Hoenn League Elite Four - Sidney, Phoebe, Glacia, and Drake - walked out smiling.

The true "Champion Road" officially begins!

# 713: The Runner-Up's Value Is Still Soaring!

Amid the audience's cheers.

The Elite Four battles of the "Champion Road" officially began!

After Hoenn region's four Elite Four members - Sidney, Phoebe, Glacia, and Drake - made their initial appearance and completed the "meeting ceremony" between challenger and gatekeepers with Johan.

Three Elite Four members withdrew while Sidney walked to the opposite side of Johan's field.

Bright lights completely illuminated the entire battlefield. Magnemite cameras and Rotom drones had all withdrawn, as the venue had comprehensive built-in cameras covering every angle.

"Teacher Johan, I've actually been looking forward to battling you for a long time." Sidney, with his mohawk hairstyle and hands in his pockets, looked quite like a small-time punk.

In fact.

Sidney had indeed once been a delinquent youth who played rock music, later reformed and worked hard, now becoming one of Hoenn region's Elite Four!

His preferred tactics and fighting style was all-out offense.

He believed offense was the best defense.

"Come on, Elite Four Sidney!"

Johan was actually quite familiar with all four of Hoenn League's Elite Four, so no excessive small talk was needed.

Let's battle!

Battle was the best form of communication between Pokémon trainers!

Hearing this, Sidney smiled happily and satisfiedly.

This was the battle he anticipated, and what he believed a Champion should possess.

Fearless of everything, facing everything head-on, respecting opponents tactically while strategically looking down on them, displaying the confident disdain befitting a Champion.

In the quiet first room of the "Elite Four Fortress," under brilliant lights, the atmosphere gradually intensified.

A Rotom flew from the room, holding red and blue flags, announcing loudly:

"The battle follows 6-choose-4 singles rules. When one side has four Pokémon unable to battle, the match ends!"

Rotom had become increasingly common nowadays.

Johan's Rotom Pokédex had, to some extent, promoted the spread of "Rotom technology."

The 6-choose-4 singles battle differed slightly from Johan's expected rules, but the impact wasn't significant.

"First, Elite Four Sidney, summon your Pokémon!" Rotom referee raised its flag.

As the "gatekeeper," Sidney threw a Great Ball without hesitation. "Go, Grimmsnarl!"

Red light flashed as a troll Pokémon appeared on the field - just as its name suggested, covered in thick dark purple fur with exposed parts showing striking green, humanoid in appearance with an exceptionally robust and defined physique.

Grimmsnarl?

Johan's eyebrow twitched.

He wasn't unfamiliar with Hoenn League's four Elite Four members, but he didn't recall Sidney having a Grimmsnarl.

It seemed the Elite Four might all have hidden trump cards...

Looking at the somewhat "ugly" Grimmsnarl with particularly prominent muscles, information about this Pokémon species flashed through Johan's mind.

Grimmsnarl, the Bulk Up Pokémon, Dark and Fairy dual-type, first registered in Galar region's Pokédex, only male, corresponding to the female-only Hatterene.

Johan wasn't unfamiliar with this Pokémon.

Because Grimmsnarl's abilities and moves had once made it comparable to "annoying cotton," perfectly matching Johan's preferred tactical style.

After brief consideration, Johan threw his Poké Ball.

"Go, Urshifu!"

"Garruu~"

With a roar, the similarly thick-furred Urshifu appeared on the field.

In terms of presence alone, Urshifu surpassed Grimmsnarl by more than a notch.

The muscular Grimmsnarl felt considerable pressure seeing the equally muscular Urshifu.

"Champion-level battle power right from the start?" Sidney immediately felt intense pressure.

"Battle begin!" Rotom referee's flag dropped.

"Grimmsnarl, Fake Out!" Sidney struck first.

With the priority move Fake Out's boost, Grimmsnarl moved incredibly fast, strange energy bursting from its body as it immediately appeared beside Urshifu and quickly struck.

Clap!

Fake Out could cause opponents to temporarily "flinch."

"Grimmsnarl, Thunder Wave!"

Seeing Fake Out take effect, Sidney immediately called out again.

Zzzzt—

Fluffy golden electric currents quickly formed in Grimmsnarl's hands, flying rapidly toward Urshifu.

If hit by Thunder Wave, Urshifu would enter "paralysis" status, potentially losing bodily control in certain situations.

However.

Johan half-closed his eyes, suddenly shouting: "Wake up!"

Urshifu's tightly closed eyes suddenly snapped open with sharp pupils, surging momentum coursing through its entire body, fur flowing as its aura completely changed between one second and the next.

If the closed-eyed Urshifu was like a towering wave ready to crash down wave after wave.

Then the open-eyed Urshifu was an erupting volcano, no superfluous movements - pure volcanic eruption from the start.

"Sucker Punch, dodge!"

Urshifu suddenly stepped forward, dark aura appearing as it actually dodged the fluffy golden current just before Thunder Wave could hit.

Sidney's pupils contracted slightly, looking somewhat surprised.

Breaking free from "flinch" status so quickly?

And actually avoiding Thunder Wave...

You had to know his Grimmsnarl's ability was Prankster!

When using status moves, it gained "priority" boosts, making moves faster like the earlier Fake Out.

But this wasn't a game after all.

Priority didn't represent absolute speed advantage, especially with the distance between them providing considerable margin for error.

Most importantly...

Urshifu's strength exceeded Grimmsnarl's by far!

"Close in!"

Using Sucker Punch to avoid Thunder Wave, Urshifu quickly advanced toward Grimmsnarl under Johan's direction.

Witnessing this scene, audiences immediately began discussing.

"Whoa! Prankster Grimmsnarl - I seem to see Teacher Johan's shadow in Elite Four Sidney."

"Yeah, and I see Elite Four Sidney's shadow in Teacher Johan too!"

"These two are switching fighting styles?"

Everyone knew Teacher Johan was famously "dirty," with mind-numbing tactics emerging endlessly.

And Sidney?

His battle philosophy was "offense is the best defense."

But look now.

Elite Four Sidney was using underhanded tactics while Teacher Johan and Urshifu launched an offensive - weren't they like they'd switched identities?

While audiences discussed, the battle didn't pause at all.

"Grimmsnarl, Reflect!" Sidney's expression became serious. Though Thunder Wave missing surprised him, his tactical direction remained unchanged.

But shockingly.

Before Sidney could give commands, Johan's voice already rang out.

"Brick Break!"

To others' ears, they heard Brick Break before Reflect.

"Here it comes! Teacher Johan's signature prediction!"

"Directly predicting Elite Four Sidney was preparing Grimmsnarl to use Reflect?"

"Too familiar - can only say Teacher Johan knows these tactics too well!"

"Using 'dirty tactics' in front of a 'dirty person' - isn't this totally giving away predictions?"

The audience immediately erupted.

Predictions, read switches... these similar predictive judgments and commands undoubtedly demonstrated tactical ability and were awe-inspiring highlights in battles.

That said.

Predicting an Elite Four member was still somewhat exaggerated.

But for Johan, it wasn't difficult.

Prankster Grimmsnarl had low possibility as a main damage dealer, more likely serving as disruption and support.

Facts proved the Fake Out into Thunder Wave was indeed disruption/support tactics.

Crack—

Grimmsnarl's just-erected Reflect was shattered by Urshifu's palm strike.

The falling palm didn't stop.

It struck Grimmsnarl's body.

Bang!!!

Powerful, unreasonable force sent Grimmsnarl flying directly.

At this moment, Sidney truly felt the pressure of actually battling Teacher Johan.

This was completely different from spectating.

But Elite Four were still Elite Four - Sidney's ability was unquestionable as he immediately changed tactical strategy.

"Wrap around it, Play Rough!"

Mid-flight Grimmsnarl's fur grew rapidly, quickly wrapping toward Urshifu. Its flying form stopped abruptly under the fur's pull.

Even the flying force and momentum could make Urshifu lose balance, while Grimmsnarl used this pulling force to counterattack.

Play Rough!

A Fairy-type move.

Four times super effective against Urshifu!

Even with a strength gap, this Play Rough definitely wasn't something Urshifu could easily withstand - it would certainly pay a significant price.

But then.

Urshifu actually closed its eyes.

The next second.

Surging water currents appeared around it!

Aqua Jet!

The water's impact broke free from Grimmsnarl's fur restraints!

Seeing this, Sidney's heart jumped, knowing Grimmsnarl and his tactics were completely seen through, immediately deciding without hesitation.

"Grimmsnarl, Parting Shot!"

Play Rough interrupted, distance briefly opened, Grimmsnarl gave Urshifu a stream of Pokémon language "output," making Urshifu laugh angrily before transforming into black light and returning to its Poké Ball.

[Parting Shot: Lower opponent's Attack and Special Attack, then switch with own Pokémon!]

Combined with Prankster, Grimmsnarl's Parting Shot was no different in speed from moves like "Bug resistance" or "Water resistance."

This was also the final conclusion of Prankster Grimmsnarl tactics.

Unfortunately.

In Sidney's tactical planning this time, besides the initial Fake Out and final Parting Shot working normally, all intermediate tactics and strategies were dismantled one by one by Teacher Johan.

"Indeed, competing in tactics with a 'tactical master' really feels like showing off before experts." Sidney said self-deprecatingly, holding his Great Ball.

Then he immediately rallied his spirits.

He'd use what he excelled at most!

Throwing the Great Ball.

"Mightyena!"

"Howl—!!!"

In red light, the fierce Mightyena appeared and roared mightily.

Intimidate!

Grimmsnarl's Parting Shot plus Mightyena's "Intimidate" ability - if both took full effect, they'd directly lower Urshifu's Attack by two stages!

Equivalent to halving Attack.

However.

Johan's family Pokémon feared momentum and psychological attacks like "Intimidate" least of all.

In terms of spirit and psychology... Johan's family had no cowards!

"Garruu—!!!"

Urshifu's eyes opened again, facing Mightyena's roar without any retreat, roaring back as faint blue aura power flowed around its body.

"Urshifu, Bulk Up!"

No switching meant gaining initiative.

Urshifu tensed its entire body, quickly calming the irritation caused by Grimmsnarl's Parting Shot, recovering its fallen momentum.

This time, Sidney remained unaffected with resolute will and attitude.

"Mightyena, Play Rough!"

What Urshifu feared most was still Fairy-type moves.

"Howl!!!"

Mightyena's four limbs moved powerfully, showing fierce fangs as it pounced directly at Urshifu.

Anyone could immediately sense Sidney's tactics and fighting style had changed.

Becoming more suited to himself.

This was the true Dark-type Elite Four Sidney!

Head-on collision?

Johan's mouth curved slightly.

Head-on collision was also what they liked!

"Urshifu, Close Combat!"

Urshifu feared Fairy-types, but Mightyena also feared Fighting-types.

Let's see.

Who would give in first!

"Garruu!"

Urshifu's eyes sharpened. Facing the charging Mightyena, it didn't retreat or dodge, counter-charging instead.

Bang!!!

Both sides instantly clashed.

Sharp fangs bit while powerful claws struck.

Fists, knees, elbows... the entire body was a weapon as Urshifu completely ignored Mightyena's attacks, only unleashing its power with Close Combat in overwhelming, continuous waves upon Mightyena!

Secret Art - Rapid Strike Style!

Bang bang bang—

Intense collisions accompanied dazzling movements. With Urshifu's final Surging Strikes, Mightyena flew backward, rolling several times on the ground before barely stopping.

"Howl..."

Mightyena swayed, struggling to stand.

But finally.

Eyes rolling back, it still "thudded" to the ground.

Roar—!!!

Spectators in seats, at venues, and watching screens leaped up with gaping mouths.

"One-shot? K.O.?"

"Earlier Grimmsnarl still seemed to be trading blows evenly, though at disadvantage, but..."

The three Elite Four watching from behind had completely different attitudes from the audience, full of praise and nodding continuously.

"Sidney returned to himself."

Drake's attitude differed completely from audiences', full of approval.

Glacia also nodded. "The opponent is Johan after all - better to be yourself than use unfamiliar methods."

Phoebe looked at her two seniors somewhat confused.

Drake smiled, explaining: "Mightyena losing is normal - the raw strength gap can't be ignored, plus type disadvantage."

One was Elite Four level, one Champion level, plus type disadvantage - wasn't a K.O. normal?

"The key is Sidney's collision wasn't without effect." Glacia continued, pointing at the panting Urshifu on screen.

Though not STAB, Play Rough still damaged Urshifu.

Phoebe had some realization.

Right.

That was Teacher Johan, the "Champion Road" challenger. What they needed to do was never defeat Teacher Johan, but weaken and wear him down as much as possible.

Thereby making him display even stronger power.

The best result would be forcing him to desperation for higher, stronger outbursts.

Also to let the Elite Four better understand their "Champion's" strength.

In terms of attrition, what Sidney and Mightyena just did was actually quite good.

Phoebe looked at Drake again.

She'd heard Elite Four Sidney was once a delinquent who went astray, ultimately pulled back personally by Drake and, under Drake's encouragement, step by step reached his current Elite Four position.

Though no longer a delinquent, some temperament remained.

What was a "delinquent's" temperament?

Persistent harassment!

You could beat him, but he'd definitely bite off a piece of flesh from you!

Though using this to describe Elite Four Sidney now wasn't quite appropriate, it perfectly fit the current situation.

"You did well, Mightyena." Sidney recalled Mightyena, switching Poké Balls without hesitation and throwing again.

"Roar—!!!"

A dark blue shark suddenly appeared on the field.

Sharpedo!

Sidney's third Pokémon was Water and Dark-type Sharpedo. Upon appearing, water currents wrapped around it, granting agile movement ability on the field.

"Leer!"

Fierce eyes glared with chilling gaze.

"Attack, Urshifu!"

Johan was also completely immersed in battle, mind connected with Urshifu.

"Sucker Punch!"

"Garruu!!!"

Urshifu's eyes turned red as it roared, stepping forward like a cannonball charging out.

Its resolute attacking attitude was intimidating.

Secret Art - Single Strike Style!

But this didn't include Sidney and Sharpedo.

"Sharpedo, Take Down!"

Wrapped in water currents, Sharpedo's speed was equally fast, leaping out and rolling forward like a tsunami.

Another direct collision!

Audiences clenched their fists watching.

Boom!!!

Fist and Sharpedo's head collided most directly.

Massive impact made Sharpedo grit its teeth in pain.

Urshifu also unconsciously frowned.

Several cuts opened on its fist.

Those were wounds from Sharpedo's "Rough Skin."

Rough Skin - when receiving contact moves, the attacker takes rebound damage from the skin.

Johan had already perceived Sidney's mentality change and tactical shifts.

So he had some guesses about Sharpedo's ability.

With "Rough Skin" ability, every attack on Sharpedo would inevitably suffer rebound damage from that skin.

The more times, the more self-damage accumulated.

This was why Johan didn't have Urshifu use Close Combat to directly overwhelm it.

Otherwise, a full Close Combat combo might let Urshifu K.O. Sharpedo again, but it would inevitably suffer unavoidable rebound damage.

Now.

His guess was confirmed.

So...

"Grab it, Urshifu!" Johan's eyes focused.

Sidney was stunned.

Grabbing Sharpedo at this moment?

"Garruu!!!"

Urshifu grabbed the flying Sharpedo's fins, pressing it hard toward the ground.

"Sharpedo, Aqua Jet!" Sidney called urgently.

The water wrapping Sharpedo instantly became fierce.

But Urshifu seemed to ignore everything, its palm scraped painfully by "Rough Skin" showing no intention of loosening.

"Just like that, Dynamic Punch!" Johan shouted.

Urshifu roared and bellowed, gripping the fin tightly as terrifying waves emerged from its palm, grabbing Sharpedo and pressing toward the ground.

Boom!!!

Instantly.

The entire field's ground let out a wail, shaking violently once before suddenly collapsing.

Spider web-like cracks appeared, raising clouds of dust.

"Garruu!!!"

Urshifu released its grip, arm movements stirring airflow to disperse dust.

In the ruins, Urshifu stood among the wreckage, looking down disdainfully at the grounded Sharpedo, ignoring the vicious scratches on its palms and back.

Drip, drip—

Blood drops fell into water, creating ripples reflecting Urshifu's silhouette.

Suddenly clenching its fist.

Arms spread, roaring!

"Garr—uu!!!"

Momentum and fighting spirit had reached their peak.

Sidney's Sharpedo, though not reaching Champion level, was at Elite Four level's peak!

Ordinary Elite Four ace Pokémon's strength level!

Just one step from Champion level.

Much stronger than the previous Grimmsnarl and Mightyena.

But...

Still a K.O.!

Dominating K.O.!

Since your "Rough Skin" would cause more rebound damage with more hits, then... one move to finish you!

In just dozens of minutes.

Urshifu consecutively defeated three Pokémon, growing braver with each battle!

"Whew—"

Even Sidney was inevitably affected by Urshifu's momentum, taking several deep breaths before slowly recovering.

"So Teacher Johan's strength has reached this level..."

This was just one Pokémon, yet it nearly swept through three...

But he quickly rallied.

If a trainer with such strength became Hoenn League Champion, it would be Hoenn League's fortune, Hoenn people's blessing!

What he needed to do.

Was display his true Elite Four strength.

And show everyone Teacher Johan's power!

"It's up to you, Absol!"

In the venue, the "Disaster Pokémon" Absol moved gracefully, fluffy fur flowing like wings as it landed on the field.

Seeing Absol, Johan immediately understood.

He'd thought Sharpedo would be Sidney's Mega ace, so he had Urshifu work hard to K.O. Sharpedo.

Partly because of "Rough Skin," partly because of Mega Evolution speculation.

Now it seemed...

"Absol—"

Sidney regained momentum, lifting his eyes as he turned the electric guitar on his back to his chest, fingers dramatically strumming the strings.

Clang—

Electric sounds exploded.

The Key Stone embedded within burst with brilliant rainbow light.

"Mega Evolution!!!"

"Absol!!!"

In the long cry, evolution's rainbow light instantly scattered, the Mega Evolution symbol flashing briefly.

Inverted white fur like wings, scattered fur "puffed" open - Mega Absol!

Champion level!

Mega Absol possessed solid Champion-level Pokémon strength!

Just this Mega Absol alone showed Hoenn League's Elite Four had real ability.

Johan looked at Urshifu.

"Garruu!"

Urshifu's momentum didn't diminish at all, its battle desire even stronger.

This made Johan understand Urshifu's will.

It still wanted to fight!

Johan's mouth curved.

Though if Urshifu won again, it might achieve a complete Elite Four sweep, Master Bear was clearly battle-addicted.

As a trainer, what else could he do?

Naturally indulge it.

"Absol!" Sidney called out. "Perish Song!"

"Absol—"

The "Disaster Pokémon" issued its final "ultimatum," declaring "disaster's" arrival!

Light, bell-like sounds rang out, making one feel as if in a dreamlike world.

This song would gradually make listening Pokémon lose battle will, ultimately losing battle ability and falling.

Johan's eyebrow twitched.

Actually opening with Perish Song directly?

Losing battle will...

Urshifu?

"Heh." Johan grinned, then suddenly called out sternly: "Urshifu, crush through - Close Combat!"

Let's see whether their Master Bear loses battle desire first, or Mega Absol falls first!

"Garruu!"

Bang—

The ground exploded.

Urshifu burst forward, swinging punches upward!

"Absol, Double Team!"

Hum—

Shadows separated from Absol's body, creating convincing illusions making it difficult to distinguish real from fake.

"Urshifu, focus!" Johan called.

Urshifu's eyes closed and opened, faint blue light flashing briefly.

Aura!

Invisible aura force swept across all doubles.

Found it!

Mega Absol's heart jumped.

"Disaster beast" instinct made it realize it might... be "seen through" by Urshifu!

Sure enough.

As soon as this thought arose.

It saw Urshifu charging toward it.

Mega Evolution connected Sidney's and Absol's wills - what Mega Absol perceived, Sidney already knew.

While marveling at Teacher Johan's and Urshifu's strength, he quickly reacted.

Since dodging was impossible, then collision!

Protect-type moves were useless against Urshifu.

"Absol, Sucker Punch!"

"Absol!"

Mega Absol's shadows all vanished as it faced Urshifu directly, suddenly pouncing.

Bang!!!

Claws and fist collided head-on.

Boom—

A terrifying shockwave immediately spread.

All sand and dust scattered completely.

Mega Absol felt Urshifu's terrifying current power and surging battle desire.

Urshifu also felt Mega Absol's strength, understanding this was the strongest opponent encountered this round.

But...

Strong was perfect!

Strength only increased the desire to overcome!

"Garruu!"

Urshifu growled low as power suddenly exploded.

Secret Art - Single Strike Style!

Under Mega Absol's surprised gaze, Urshifu's fist pushed aside its claws.

Next second.

Urshifu advanced instead of retreating, closing in.

Secret Art - Rapid Strike Style!

Close Combat fists immediately fell like violent storm.

Bang bang bang—

"Garruu!!!"

Splash—

Water silently wrapped around fists.

Secret Art - Rapid Strike Single Strike Style!

An entire Close Combat combo unleashed without reservation, the final punch striking hard.

Boom!!!

Mega Absol flew like a cannonball, instantly passing by Sidney and crashing into the wall behind him.

For a moment.

Whether the battle scene or audiences watching the livestream, all fell silent.

Mega Absol stayed on the wall for one second, then slid down with a "thud."

Crack—

On that wall, centered on the crater Mega Absol created, spider web-like cracks rapidly spread.

If not for the "Elite Four Fortress's" reinforced walls and fields, it would have collapsed by now.

Mega Evolution energy dispersed like unraveling silk.

Sidney stood in place, stunned for a while before slowly accepting reality.

Sighing: "Worthy of Teacher Johan... I lost."

Though Grimmsnarl theoretically had some stamina left, facing such an Urshifu... it was meaningless.

He frankly accepted defeat.

Looking at the heavily panting, sweat-covered Urshifu, he couldn't help showing amazement again.

One Pokémon.

Just one Pokémon had directly swept through his four Pokémon as an Elite Four member.

"Congratulations, Teacher Johan."

Sidney recalled Absol and walked to the field center, shaking hands with Johan.

"I hope Teacher Johan won't hold back in subsequent battles either."

Hearing this, Johan smiled slightly, seemingly seeing through Sidney's "thoughts," nodding: "Of course, this is the 'Champion Road'!"

"Heh." Sidney also smiled, showing "relief."

If this was the kind of Champion, he Sidney would be the first to acknowledge it.

Thud!!!

Battle ended. In the broken wall's "wail," the door to the second room opened.

"Teacher Johan, you can rest briefly before entering." Sidney said.

"Good."

Johan didn't refuse.

He simply helped Urshifu treat its injuries.

Though Urshifu had swept four opponents, Mega Absol's appearance made Johan not dare underestimate the Elite Four at all.

Teacher Johan passing the "Elite Four Fortress's" first checkpoint caused massive waves outside.

The focus wasn't on defeating Elite Four Sidney.

After all, he was someone expected to become Hoenn Champion - if he couldn't even beat the first Elite Four member, there'd be no need for any "Champion Road."

The focus was that Teacher Johan had only sent out Urshifu to sweep Elite Four Sidney's four Pokémon!

"A complete sweep?"

"I, I originally thought... Teacher Johan liked fighting 'baby cups,' but now it seems..."

"Good grief! Did Teacher Johan treat the 'Champion Road' like a 'baby cup'?"

"I! Silver Conference Runner-up, Guderian!"

"Damn! 'Guderian's Boomerang' is back - its value is still soaring!"

# 714: This Is Scientific!

Teacher Johan~"

Phoebe, with healthy bronze skin, wearing an Alola-style beach dress and tube top, short black hair adorned with two bright red flowers, showed a friendly smile.

"I didn't expect it would be our turn so soon."

Phoebe didn't blame Sidney for inadequate "consumption" - she simply felt Teacher Johan's strength from Sidney's battle with him.

After all, as a cooperative partner and work colleague, Phoebe clearly understood Sidney's abilities.

However, as an Elite Four member, when it came time to battle, she showed no weakness or fear.

You should know that among Hoenn League's four Elite Four members, Phoebe was actually the youngest, but in terms of Elite Four ranking... Phoebe actually ranked above Sidney.

Even though Sidney, who specialized in Dark-types, had type advantage over Phoebe who specialized in Ghost-types.

It was said.

Phoebe, who grew up on "Mt. Pyre," actually possessed a special ability to communicate with Ghost-type Pokémon like telepathy.

She also had considerable Ghost-type Pokémon affinity.

At such a young age, she'd already secured her Elite Four position.

Only because Phoebe had lived on "Mt. Pyre" for years and only recently received her grandparents' permission to come down the mountain, lacking social experience and knowledge, otherwise... she could become a strong contender for Champion in the future.

But precisely because of this, Phoebe's responsibilities in the League were... somewhat lighter than Sidney's.

Glacia had a lot of pressure.

"Long time no see, Phoebe." Johan smiled.

When Drake had "tricked" him into representing at League headquarters for League meetings, Phoebe was the first person to greet him at the meeting.

Johan had a very good impression of Phoebe.

A naive, kind, and capable girl.

Hearing this, Phoebe smiled even more happily, saying:

"However, before the battle begins, I still need to represent my grandparents and 'Mt. Pyre' in thanking Teacher Johan."

After speaking, she bowed deeply.

Johan was somewhat surprised, but after thinking, he understood.

Phoebe's grandparents living on "Mt. Pyre" were actually the guardians of Hoenn region's "Red Orb" and "Blue Orb."

Later stolen by Team Magma and Team Aqua.

Johan's defeat of Groudon and Kyogre prevented them from causing excessive damage to Hoenn region, helping her grandparents alleviate their guilt to some extent.

Johan waved slightly.

"I only did what every League trainer with the ability would do."

"That may be so." But Phoebe remained serious. "But Teacher Johan, you taught me what 'responsibility' means."

Seeing the two had chatted enough, Rotom referee appeared again with flags.

Still 6-choose-4 battle rules - when either side had four Pokémon unable to battle, the match would end.

Phoebe threw her first Great Ball without hesitation.

"Please, Sableye!"

In red light, a small, strange-looking Pokémon appeared on the field - entirely purple with diamonds embedded in its body, and diamond-shaped eyes.

"Sableye~"

Upon appearing, Sableye affectionately came to Phoebe's side, looking timid yet intimate as it hid behind Phoebe, peeking at Johan.

Phoebe smiled gently, crouching to pat Sableye's head.

"Mm! Mm! Alright, I understand~"

"Okay, let's do this~"

She appeared to be happily communicating with Sableye.

Johan's expression was strange as he witnessed this scene. "Seems like you really can 'commune' with Ghost-type Pokémon, Phoebe."

"Huh? Commune?"

Phoebe was stunned, then smiled charmingly: "Scientific society - there's no 'communing' or 'mediums.' We believe in science, Teacher Johan."

Johan's expression became even stranger.

Science?

You, someone who can communicate with Ghost-type Pokémon without barriers...

Moreover, in the Pokémon world with so many bizarre Pokémon, what "science" was there to speak of?

"Sableye~"

After communicating with Phoebe, Sableye cheerfully ran onto the field.

Putting aside his thoughts.

Johan also took out a Poké Ball, briefly considering before throwing it.

"Go, Dragonite!"

"Dragonite~!"

The robust Dragonite flapped its small wings, appearing on the field.

It looked at the small Sableye, rubbing its eyes.

Sableye seemed to feel underestimated, immediately taking a deep breath and puffing out its chest to show it was very brave!

Seeing Dragonite, Phoebe was stunned.

"Battle begin!" Rotom referee's flag suddenly dropped.

"Sableye, Fake Out!"

Phoebe's opening move was identical to Sidney's.

"Sableye!"

Shadows quickly spread from under Sableye's feet as black palms appeared behind Dragonite with a "clap."

Dragonite's body made scale collision sounds.

The "Multiscale" ability was also broken!

"Sableye, Taunt!"

Landing one hit, Phoebe and Sableye didn't dare delay, quickly issuing the second command.

Sidney's battle had already shown her.

Sableye grinned with a sly smile, its diamond eyes showing cunning and provocation.

Strange power emanated from Sableye, falling on Dragonite and restricting some status moves it could use.

Teacher Johan's Pokémon were extremely difficult to break psychologically - the "flinch" effect from Fake Out was probably worrying.

Facts proved Phoebe's judgment was correct.

After brief confusion, Dragonite regained clarity, but Sableye's Taunt successfully restricted Dragonite again.

"Dragonite!!!"

Dragonite looked displeased.

Its small wings flapped rapidly, stirring fierce winds.

But Phoebe directly took out a Great Ball, shooting red light to recall it before Dragonite's winds could strike.

Switch!

Johan, who witnessed the entire process, raised an eyebrow.

Really was...

The "standard" fighting style of Ghost-type Pokémon trainers.

Prepared Phoebe quickly threw her second Great Ball, and what appeared was - Banette!

Switching in gave Johan and Dragonite the initiative.

Johan naturally wouldn't waste such an opportunity.

Restricted by Taunt.

But Dragonite's destructive power remained.

"Dragon Rush!"

Johan vaguely guessed Phoebe's tactics and strategy, but... remained unmoved.

Sometimes.

Tactics could bridge strength gaps.

But if tactics were seen through, their effectiveness would greatly diminish.

"Banette!" Phoebe stared intently at Dragonite. "Trick!"

Hum—

Though switching in, Banette moved quickly, strange power emanating from its body, forming between itself and Dragonite to exchange their held items.

Dragonite naturally carried "Dragon Fang," while Banette carried "Choice Scarf"!

Roar!!!

The audience erupted.

"'Trick Scarf'? This tactic looks familiar!"

"Obviously, this is a tactic our 'dirty' Teacher Johan has used!"

"Tsk, the boomerang hit Teacher Johan himself."

"Then why use 'Taunt'? Wouldn't it be better to just use Fake Out then switch to Banette's 'Trick'? Maybe Dragonite would use status moves like Dragon Dance."

"You're dumb - the Elite Four need to wear down and defeat Teacher Johan's Pokémon as much as possible. If really restricted to 'Dragon Dance,' wouldn't Teacher Johan just switch?"

"True..."

"But Teacher Johan doesn't seem surprised at all."

Now Dragonite could still attack, just greatly restricted to only using Dragon Rush.

But...

Johan grinned.

Indeed the 'Trick Scarf' tactic.

According to Phoebe's estimation, his first Pokémon would likely be Gengar or Tyranitar, which counter Ghost-types.

Through "Trick," she could swap away their Mega Evolution Stones.

But she probably didn't expect Johan to lead with Dragonite.

However, even with Dragonite, the tactic could still work.

But if seen through, then...

"Dragonite—!!!"

Dragonite's Dragon Rush wasn't negatively affected at all, even gaining speed from "Choice Scarf," making its descent faster!

"Banette, Curse!" Phoebe quickly called out.

However.

Boom!!!

Dragonite, wrapped in blue-purple dragon energy, crashed down at speeds exceeding Phoebe's expectations.

"So fast!" Phoebe's expression changed.

After losing "Choice Scarf's" speed boost, Banette couldn't successfully use Curse.

Whoosh—

In rising dust, Dragonite flapped its small wings, slightly tilting its mouth as it flew backward, dispersing the rolling smoke.

In the cracked ground ruins, Phoebe's Banette already lay with swirled eyes.

Unable to battle!

One-shot!

"Holy crap, one Dragon Rush K.O.? That brutal?"

"Honestly, Dragon Rush's accuracy... Teacher Johan's Dragonite's luck is still amazingly good."

"Feels like... it's still the raw strength gap between the two Pokémon that's too large."

Indeed.

This audience member hit a key point.

Dragonite's strength far exceeded Phoebe's Banette!

You had to know Dragonite's current strength reached ordinary Champion ace Pokémon level!

For horizontal comparison, that was like Unova region Champion Alder's second Volcarona's strength.

And Phoebe's Banette?

Ordinary Elite Four main Pokémon level.

The gap wasn't small.

Moreover, it gained "Choice Scarf's" speed boost.

Absolute strength difference plus seen-through tactics - even if tactics succeeded, it could be overcome.

"Dragonite!!!" Dragonite called out excitedly.

"Don't tilt your mouth." Johan couldn't help reminding. "Looks ugly."

"Dragonite..."

Phoebe recalled Banette with her Great Ball, saying softly:

"You did well, Banette."

Though the planned "Curse" couldn't be used, the "Trick" tactic succeeded in restricting Dragonite to only Dragon Rush.

Though not as restrictive as locking onto moves like Extreme Speed, at least... Dragon Rush had low accuracy.

Then she took out her third Great Ball, seriously throwing it.

"Please, Chandelure!"

Poof!!!

Blue ghostly flames rose as the crystal chandelier-like Chandelure hovered in the field, its yellow eyes making Dragonite feel slightly uneasy.

However.

In this situation, Johan had nothing to hesitate about.

Already locked to "Dragon Rush" - what was there to hesitate about?

Just charge!

"Dragonite, again - Dragon Rush!"

"Dragonite—"

Dragonite shot toward the sky, powerful blue-purple Dragon-type energy instantly enveloping its entire body, transforming into a dragon shape as it charged directly at Chandelure.

Phoebe tensed.

She naturally felt the strength gap.

However.

In Phoebe's view, this "Champion Road" was both a test for Teacher Johan and a test for herself as an Elite Four member!

She immediately waved grandly.

"Chandelure, Trick Room!"

No matter how fast Dragonite was, simultaneous action would give Chandelure space and opportunity to use moves.

Hum—

The dark transparent field instantly spread outward from Chandelure.

Dragonite also crashed down from above.

Though Trick Room's expansion made its speed obviously decrease when entering the covered range.

But this time difference and distance gap weren't enough for Chandelure to use moves again.

Boom!!!

Another rumbling.

Seemingly identical to before.

"Could it be another K.O.?"

"Dragon Rush hit twice consecutively."

"Feels like it'll end with Teacher Johan's Dragonite using Dragon Rush four times for another sweep."

"Is this Champion-level strength? Really terrifyingly strong..."

Audiences stared intently at screens.

First time deeply feeling Teacher Johan's overwhelming strength.

The "Champion Road" was actually a process for League residents to gradually understand "Champions."

Whoosh—

Dragonite flew backward again.

Its body seemed to burn with flames, which it quickly patted out with chubby palms.

Breathing a sigh of relief.

Close call.

Almost got burned by those flames.

In another ruins, Chandelure was no different from the previous Banette, eyes swirled.

Unable to battle!

Exaggerated!

Ridiculous!

Even made people think "I could do it too."

Phoebe bit her lips, recalling the defeated Chandelure, sighing inwardly.

Too bad Chandelure's "Flame Body" didn't inflict "burn" status on Dragonite.

Otherwise, Chandelure would have perfectly completed its mission...
