Only could say Teacher Johan's Dragonite had really good luck.

"Enough setup, Phoebe." Johan suddenly spoke.

Hearing this, Phoebe looked at Johan, stunned, then smiled and scratched her head:

"Really completely seen through by Teacher Johan."

Johan smiled slightly.

Taunt restricted Dragonite's enhancement, Trick and "Choice Scarf" restricted Dragonite's move variety, Trick Room restricted Dragonite's speed.

Originally should have included Curse continuously weakening Dragonite's stamina, Will-O-Wisp or "Flame Body" ability halving Dragonite's Attack.

Looking at the whole thing.

Though Phoebe had lost two Pokémon.

Her tactical planning was really excellent.

Step by step, calm and unhurried.

If Dragonite's Dragon Rush missed even once.

Or if Johan hadn't seen through Phoebe's tactics and didn't have Dragonite "locked" to Dragon Rush, the results would be completely different.

If facing a Champion whose observation and judgment weren't so detailed and accurate, Phoebe might really take down several.

As a young trainer who'd been Elite Four for less than two years, her talent was visible.

Moreover, her tactics and fighting style perfectly matched Ghost-type Pokémon characteristics - cunning and changeable.

Phoebe put away her smile, taking out her final Great Ball.

Taking a deep breath.

"Then... it's up to you, Dusknoir!"

Completely black with ghost-like lower body, broad and powerful arms and palms, a single crimson eye flashing, emanating thick ghostly aura throughout.

"Ka-kaah?"

Even Johan's Gengar couldn't help emerging for a look.

This guy... not bad.

"Ka-kaah..."

Gengar gently tugged Johan's clothes, pointing at Phoebe.

"Mm, I noticed."

After Dusknoir appeared, Phoebe also faintly emanated a light ghostly aura, seeming to resonate with Dusknoir and strengthening Dusknoir's presence.

Simultaneously, Dusknoir emanated extremely strong pressure.

Still talking about science... Johan internally complained.

Dusknoir was supposedly a Ghost Pokémon that could freely travel between the Pokémon world and spirit world, characterized by slow speed but extremely strong defenses among Ghost-types.

Phoebe's previous setup seemed to be for this Dusknoir?

"Dusknoir!"

Phoebe called out: "Will-O-Wisp!"

Poof poof poof—

Blue ghostly flames appeared between Dusknoir's spread arms, shooting toward Dragonite.

Trick Room gave Dusknoir faster speed!

"Dragonite!"

Johan called lightly.

"Dragonite—"

Dragonite understood, wings suddenly beating as rich blue-purple Dragon-type energy covered its entire body, displaying exaggerated dragon wings.

But instead of immediately diving, it wrapped around itself.

Bang! Bang! Bang—

Blue flame sparks scattered.

Dusknoir's Will-O-Wisp was actually blocked by Dragon Rush's "dragon armor"!

"This isn't scientific..." Phoebe pouted.

Moves were dead, but the Pokémon using moves and people creating tactics were alive.

"Dragonite!!!"

Dragon wings spread again as Dragonite dove down once more.

"Dusknoir, don't clash directly - Shadow Sneak!"

Hearing this, Dusknoir's crimson eyes flashed as it slashed open nearby space, immediately disappearing from Johan and Dragonite's sight.

"Dragonite?"

Looking at the empty field, Johan and Dragonite's expressions were slightly strange.

Shadow Sneak?

One of their Gengar's best moves.

"Behind!" Johan called lightly.

Dragonite folded its wings, turning to strike behind.

Just then a space crack appeared as Dusknoir threw punches.

Bang!!!

Most direct collision.

Also seemingly the first real direct clash since Johan and Phoebe's battle began!

Boom!!!

Blue-purple dragon energy around Dragonite dispersed as it flew backward.

Dusknoir reacted more severely, groaning dully as its body staggered, nearly crashing to the ground before barely stabilizing.

"Worthy of Teacher Johan..."

Phoebe sighed internally.

"Dragonite." Johan spoke again, waving grandly. "Dragon Rush!"

"Dragonite!!!"

Dragonite quickly stabilized, folding wings to charge again.

"Dusknoir!"

Phoebe lightly clenched her fist: "Disable!"

The "Choice Scarf" carrying ghostly energy from Banette immediately turned against Dragonite, tightening around its neck.

Instantly.

Dragonite felt intense suffocation.

But this attack and suffocation not only didn't stop Dragonite's movement, but further triggered its ferocity.

"Dragonite..."

Blood threads filled its eyes.

Within the original blue-purple Dragon-type energy, traces of light blue appeared.

Speed suddenly increased!

Under Dusknoir's shocked, horrified gaze, it struck solidly.

Boom!!!

Massive rumbling accompanied violent ground shaking.

This time, Dragonite didn't coolly fly out dispersing dust, but stepped out from the debris step by step.

Simultaneously.

On its body, obvious mottled burn marks were visible.

"Burn" status!

Dusknoir lay in ruins, unable to battle!

But before falling, it managed to use Will-O-Wisp at close range, inflicting "burn" status on Dragonite.

Dragonite's current condition was obviously much worse than at the start.

"Whew—"

Phoebe wiped fine sweat from her forehead.

Too bad Destiny Bond came too late.

But inflicting "burn" on Dragonite was decent.

Johan looked deeply at Phoebe.

Really excellent.

He increasingly appreciated this young Elite Four member.

Why could some Elite Four members, whose strength didn't seem particularly strong, display brief legendary-blocking power at crucial moments?

By maximizing Pokémon coordination and synergy, achieving far greater than the sum of parts.

Johan also understood why Phoebe, despite being much younger than Sidney, becoming Elite Four more recently, and being type-disadvantaged, could rank above Sidney.

In full 6v6 battles.

Phoebe's tactical level might exceed Sidney's.

Pokémon coordination plus her special Ghost-type communication ability let her better present tactics and strategies.

Simultaneously.

Johan understood another thing.

All of Phoebe's preparation wasn't specifically for Dusknoir, but for Sableye!

"The last one - go, Sableye!"

While Johan pondered, Phoebe had already recalled Dusknoir and summoned Sableye again.

Full-condition Sableye!

Coming full circle.

"Sableye!"

Sableye hunched over, staring intensely at the poor-condition Dragonite.

Its teammates' efforts, it would definitely...

"Come back first, Dragonite." Johan smiled, taking out a Poké Ball to recall Dragonite.

Sableye: "?"

Phoebe: "?"

What about the promised sweep?

"Go, Tyranitar!"

"Tyranitar!"

Heavy as a small mountain, Tyranitar crashed onto the field, spreading arms and roaring.

Seeing Sableye, its eyes immediately brightened.

Diamonds!

And so many...

Phoebe: "..."

This was the final battle, yet still sending Tyranitar.

Teacher Johan, are you being unsporting?

"Phoebe, your tactics are excellent." Johan said seriously. "To show respect, I won't hold back either."

Phoebe: "..."

Switching to Tyranitar?

Besides Trick Room, wasn't everything before useless?

No.

It still consumed Teacher Johan and Dragonite's condition.

"Sableye—"

Phoebe sighed lightly, beautiful eyes becoming stern: "Mega Evolution!"

Brilliant light bloomed in the small battle room.

Crack crack crack crack—

Crystal and diamond clusters appeared at Sableye's feet. In evolution light, its appearance didn't change much, but a huge, deep red gem containing mysterious aura appeared in its hands!

Mega Sableye!

"Ty-Tyranitar..."

Seeing Mega Sableye, Tyranitar opened its mouth and couldn't help swallowing.

Deadly... this guy looked... really delicious.

Mega Sableye: "?"

Sableye's speed wasn't outstanding, but with "Prankster" ability, it was manageable.

But Mega Sableye's speed base stat was only 20 points - less than half of Dusknoir's!

Trick Room was truly meant for it.

After Mega Evolution enhancement plus Phoebe's special ability boost, Mega Sableye's strength undoubtedly reached Champion level!

"In that case, Tyranitar—"

Johan took out his Key Stone: "Mega Evolution!"

"Tyranitar—!!!"

Dinner time!!!

In roaring, bathed in Mega Evolution's brilliant energy and light, Tyranitar quickly transformed into Mega Tyranitar!

Mega Sableye immediately felt spine-chilling cold.

Mishearing, right?

Din-dinner?

"Sableye, rush forward - Brick Break!"

Four-times Fighting-weak Mega Tyranitar without "Weakness Policy" required seizing its weakness for fierce attacks.

Watching "food" charge toward it, Mega Tyranitar felt saliva rapidly secreting.

"Focus, Tyranitar!"

If Johan weren't on field, he'd definitely bonk Tyranitar's head.

"Crunch!"

"Tyranitar!!!"

This perfectly matched what Mega Tyranitar most wanted to do, immediately opening its massive jaws with dark aura, biting down hard.

Bang!!!

Tyranitar didn't budge; Mega Sableye staggered backward, looking somewhat fearfully at Mega Tyranitar.

Wait.

Why do I really feel it wants to eat me?

"Tyranitar!" Johan smiled, suddenly waving. "Precipice Blades!"

Precipice Blades?

Phoebe's expression changed dramatically.

Others might not know what "Precipice Blades" was, but as Hoenn League Elite Four, how could Phoebe not know?

Though she'd seen Teacher Johan's Tyranitar use this move before, seeing videos versus witnessing firsthand felt completely different.

"Tyranitar!!!"

In Mega Tyranitar's roaring, Phoebe became dazed, seemingly seeing that proud red giant beast under scorching sun again.

Rumble—

Ground shook violently.

"Sableye, quickly dodge with Sucker Punch!" Phoebe urgently called.

Next second.

A massive fiery red rock spike seemingly wrapped in magma instantly erupted from the ground. The terrifying heat plus massive impact and coverage meant even though Sableye immediately used Sucker Punch, it couldn't completely evade.

Boom!!!

The entire "Elite Four Fortress" wailed.

That enormous rock spike actually pierced through the reinforced ceiling, bursting through the "Elite Four Fortress" dome!

You had to know.

This was a house specially reinforced so Elite Four could battle with peace of mind.

Fortunately.

Though Mega Sableye was affected, it wasn't precisely hit. Standing on the rock spike, enduring scorching heat and pain, it charged toward Mega Tyranitar.

"Sableye!" Phoebe took a deep breath, suppressing inner shock: "Focus Punch!"

Hum—

Dark red energy already gathered in Mega Sableye's red gem completely unleashed after approaching Mega Tyranitar!

"Tyranitar, Crunch!"

Both called simultaneously.

The two Pokémon clashed without hesitation.

Bang!!!

Instantly, the entire room seemed to fall silent.

Dust just rose.

Then immediately dispersed.

Mega Tyranitar's feet gripped the ground, carving two deep furrows.

It opened its mouth with fierce eyes.

Mega Sableye's brilliant red gem was firmly clamped in its jaws.

"Tyranitar—"

Dull sound.

Phoebe's heart trembled lightly.

Good thing Mega Sableye's gem was extremely hard, incomparable to ordinary diamonds and gems - the manifestation of minerals Sableye accumulated from years of eating...

Just as this thought appeared.

Crack!!!

A crack appeared on the red gem, then quickly spread throughout.

Mega Sableye hung from Mega Tyranitar's mouth, seeing this... eyes immediately rolling back.

Finished!

It really wants to eat me!

Tyranitar caught the falling, defeated Sableye.

"Tyranitar?"

Crunch—crunch—

Watching this scene, Phoebe's gaze was vacant as she murmured:

"This isn't scientific..."

Johan's eye twitched as he coughed lightly, telling Phoebe:

"Cough Phoebe, I think you're right - we should believe in science."

Our Tyranitar eats minerals and diamonds, so doesn't Mega Sableye's gem count as a type of mineral?

It counts.

So being able to bite through it - this is very scientific, right?

Phoebe: "..."

# 715: Explosion Is the Ultimate Art!

"Tactically, there wasn't really any problem."

Johan was treating Dragonite and Tyranitar's injuries.

Tyranitar was actually fine - though it took two punches from Mega Sableye, Crunch had offset much of the damage.

However, Tyranitar's mood was obviously somewhat dejected.

Head drooping, whimpering softly.

Mega Sableye's extremely "appetizing" red gem had disappeared after it released Mega Evolution.

This green fatty was clearly disappointed.

But it still scared Phoebe's just-awakened Sableye, which immediately hid from Tyranitar.

Probably would feel uneasy seeing Tyranitar-type Pokémon in the future.

Johan's Gengar, however, was looking at the diamonds and gems embedded in Sableye's body with shifty eyes, plotting something unknown.

Compared to Tyranitar, Dragonite's injuries were slightly more serious.

But after treating the "burn" wounds, recovery was actually manageable.

Definitely no chance for the next battle, but might have opportunity the battle after.

"Mm..."

Hearing Teacher Johan's evaluation, Phoebe, who was comforting Sableye, showed a happy smile.

Ghost-type Pokémon differed considerably from other types.

Ghost-type Pokémon mostly had cunning, changeable abilities with diverse tactics and strategies. Though they could charge head-on, this obviously didn't suit Ghost-type Pokémon's inherent characteristics.

"Really?"

Phoebe's eyes brightened.

What was Teacher Johan's signature Pokémon?

Undoubtedly Gengar.

Besides Gengar, Teacher Johan also had Ghost-type Pokémon like Ceruledge and Rotom, so he must have unique understanding of Ghost-types.

Patting Dragonite and Tyranitar lying on the ground enjoying massages.

"Let's go. Don't keep Elite Four Glacia waiting too long."

"Won't Teacher Johan rest a bit more?" Phoebe asked.

"About enough."

Thud—

The door to the third battle room opened wide.

Sidney, Phoebe, Glacia, Drake.

Hoenn League's four Elite Four members.

Among them, Sidney and Phoebe could actually be considered the younger generation.

Sidney was slightly older than Johan, while Phoebe was about the same age, just appearing more like a naive girl due to her short time away from the mountain.

Elite Four Drake naturally represented the League's older generation.

He was contemporaries with Professor Oak, Elite Four Agatha, and Champion Alder.

Glacia represented the League's backbone generation.

She was considerably older than Johan, Sidney, and Phoebe. Though possibly somewhat negligent in Pokémon training and battles due to handling League affairs, her strength was definitely much greater than Sidney and Phoebe's.

When Johan entered the third battle room, Glacia, wearing elegant lady's attire and white gloves, already stood on one side of the battle field.

"Elite Four Glacia..." Johan smiled in greeting.

This was an absolutely important figure indispensable to the Hoenn League.

Glacia's face also showed a light smile. After glancing at Johan, she said softly:

"Ten million Pokédollars."

"Huh?" Johan was stunned.

"The second battle room you just destroyed, especially the reinforced ceiling you pierced through - repairs alone will cost at least ten million Pokédollars." Glacia looked at him meaningfully.

Johan: "..."

Wait.

Was this intimidation?

Breaking out in cold sweat...

Seeing Johan's appearance, Glacia covered her mouth and laughed lightly.

"Don't worry, you don't need to pay."

"I have no intention of using this to restrain your battle. You don't need to worry about repairs here for now." Glacia added.

But the meaning was...

For now you don't need to worry.

When you become Champion someday, all these big and small matters will be your concern.

Then we can relax~

Johan felt great "pressure."

"Ha, haha..." He naturally heard the meaning in Elite Four Glacia's words, laughing dryly.

Thinking internally...

If I really become Champion, wouldn't I decide who does what? Worst case, aren't there still Steven and Wallace?

At absolute worst, learn from Champion Alder and just "run away"?

"Alright, let's battle." Glacia smiled sweetly.

Rotom referee floated out.

Reaching here.

Meant Johan only faced two more checkpoints.

The "Champion Road" was already more than halfway complete. Just passing these remaining two checkpoints would undoubtedly mean completing this "Champion Road."

But neither Johan nor the livestream audience would think the remainder was easy - rather, they'd consider every subsequent step the true test of the "Champion Road"!

Glacia threw her Poké Ball without hesitation.

They'd battled before.

Only then Johan could merely be considered emerging talent. Though showing good potential, he was far from Champion level.

Moreover, Glacia hadn't sent out main Pokémon then.

But this time...

"Bring down snow, Vanilluxe!"

Appearing like two ice creams connected together, entirely snow-white and crystalline, with cute smiles on both heads - the Ice-type Pokémon Vanilluxe appeared on the field.

With its appearance.

From ice crystal straws like cookie decorations in ice cream, milky white frost mist emerged.

Instantly.

Snowflakes began falling in the battle room, quickly growing larger and filling with howling blizzard.

"Snow Warning" ability!

This was the same Pokémon type Glacia had summoned during her initial battle with Johan.

But obviously not the same one.

Because this Vanilluxe's strength was... at least ordinary Elite Four ace Pokémon level!

Stronger by far!

Just the suddenly dropping temperature in the battle room was proof enough.

Johan threw his Luxury Ball without hesitation.

"Then it's you, Ceruledge!"

Poof—

Blue ghostly flames spiraled upward.

In the firelight, wearing deep purple armor and wielding two flame-wreathed swords with face covered by helmet - Ceruledge appeared on the field.

Glacia smiled with narrowed eyes, obviously recognizing the Ceruledge Johan summoned was the same Charcadet from their first battle.

"Goka!"

Ceruledge swung its blade edge, flames dispersing and restraining, but surrounding falling snowflakes melted with "hiss" sounds before approaching, then vaporized.

Ice and fire.

Before battle began, collision had already occurred.

Whoosh—

Rotom referee's flag dropped.

Battle begin!

"Ceruledge, Flame Charge!" Johan rarely attacked first.

Johan had sufficient understanding of snow weather and snow teams.

Without using Tyranitar to seize weather control, quickly resolving the snow team's weather setter was very necessary.

Of course.

Also due to time with Ninetales and practicing "snow weather" core tactics together, Ceruledge was actually quite familiar with snow weather and blizzards.

"Goka!"

Following Johan's call, Ceruledge crossed its twin swords as surging blue ghostly flames rose around it.

Bang!!!

Snow and ground exploded, leaving two scorched marks as Ceruledge charged forward.

"Vanilluxe, Aurora Veil!"

Glacia's opening was one of snow teams' most useful moves.

Transparent film descended with refractive halos making it appear quite solid.

But next moment.

Aurora Veil was severed by twin blades, firelight flashing directly to Vanilluxe's front, swinging down.

Bang!!!

Blizzard quickly formed crystalline clear armor on Vanilluxe's body.

Snow weather granted Ice-type Pokémon stronger physical defense - demonstrated here.

Aurora Veil's weakening plus snow crystal armor's reduction meant though Ceruledge struck Vanilluxe, it didn't deal sufficiently fatal damage.

When Ceruledge wanted to continue pursuing, red light shot out, recalling Vanilluxe.

Switch!

Whether snow teams, sun teams, rain teams, etc., weather setters naturally needed protection as long as possible.

Glacia wasn't foolish enough to have Vanilluxe clash directly with Ceruledge now - that would be too obviously throwing.

She took her second Poké Ball from her waist without hesitation.

"Go, Walrein!"

"Walrein—"

Azure blue body, bulky but agile robust physique, two huge sharp tusks - overall outline not much different from ordinary walruses.

Walrein was Water and Ice dual-type, obviously meant to counter Fire-type Ceruledge.

More importantly.

Glacia's Walrein likely had "Thick Fat" ability.

[Thick Fat: When receiving Ice and Fire-type move attacks, provides better protection, halving received move power!]

Plus snow weather's physical defense boost and still-lingering "Aurora Veil"...

Resistance nearly maxed out.

But Johan wasn't surprised.

He'd done sufficient research on Glacia.

Moreover.

He best understood what snow teams feared - what weather teams feared!

"Ceruledge, Sunny Day!"

Johan commanded gravely, waving grandly.

"Goka!"

Hearing this, Ceruledge raised its arms high, then struck down hard.

Clang!!!

Twin blades collided in the blizzard, sparks scattering as surrounding temperature began rising, blizzard quickly weakening, warm sunlight falling from the battle room above.

However, with Vanilluxe present and its "Snow Warning" ability boost, plus Ceruledge not specializing in weather, it might not win weather control.

But with Vanilluxe now switched out, this was undoubtedly the best time to seize weather.

Once snow weather was replaced by sunny weather.

Aurora Veil relying on snow weather and snow's physical defense boost would all crumble.

Moreover, under sunny weather, Walrein's Water-type moves would be greatly reduced, significantly lowering threats to Ceruledge.

Glacia's expression changed slightly.

She wasn't surprised Ceruledge could use Sunny Day - she was somewhat surprised that...

Vanilluxe carrying "Icy Rock" with "Snow Warning" should have created extremely stable snow weather, not so easily replaceable.

At least not this quickly.

"Walrein, Hail!"

"Roar—"

The switched-in Walrein belatedly used Hail, roaring.

Attempting to contest weather with Ceruledge.

However.

Hiss—

Golden firelight rose from Ceruledge's body, making its temperature even more blazing.

Blessed Fire!

Though Walrein's desperate resistance slowed snow's disappearance, it would ultimately be replaced.

Mind racing.

Witnessing this, Glacia knew the situation was hopeless and immediately changed strategy.

"Walrein, Hydro Pump!"

Abandoning weather contest, striking first while opponent used Sunny Day!

A massive, turbulent water column surged from Walrein's mouth, crashing toward Ceruledge.

Before sunny weather fully formed, deal sufficient damage first!

The water column surged.

Overwhelming power!

Glacia's Walrein had clearly reached Champion level - at least ordinary Champion Pokémon standard!

This was definitely significant power against Ceruledge.

Boom!!!

Water flow.

Instantly engulfed Ceruledge.

And sunny weather formed at this moment.

"Goka!"

In the surging water column, pale green light suddenly appeared.

The water column was split in half by this green blade.

Aqua Cutter!

"Ceruledge!" Johan called low. "Solar Blade!"

Facing the water column, Ceruledge took a deep breath, fearlessly raising twin swords to charge upward.

Emerald blade aura became increasingly obvious and sharp.

Snow weather disappeared, Aurora Veil and ice crystal armor lost effect.

Sunny weather replaced it, water flow thinned, sunlight intensified.

Under Walrein's incredulous, shocked gaze, it struck down hard.

Bang!!!

Green light suddenly exploded as Grass-type energy completely unleashed.

Walrein suffered massive slashing damage, staggering backward.

With one strike gaining advantage, neither Ceruledge nor Johan would stop there.

"Ceruledge, Solar Blade!"

Pressing the advantage.

Hum—

Ceruledge turned its blade edge as bright sunlight again gathered on twin swords.

Raising sword to close in.

"Walrein, Ice Fang!"

At this close distance, dodging was unrealistic, high-power moves might not work, Water-type moves were further restricted.

Sharp tusks covered in ice layers like bright transparent ice swords.

"Goka!"

Perfect!

Fire flashed in Ceruledge's eyes, excitement showing.

Its sparring and learning with Kartana wasn't for nothing.

From Kartana, Ceruledge not only greatly improved swordsmanship but gained further understanding of "Solar Blade."

Long sword wrapped in sunlight.

Slashing out.

Golden light like silk threads wrapped around Walrein's tusks.

Clang!!!

Blade ringing trembled.

Walrein's movement stiffened, body freezing in place.

Its two slender but sharp tusks wrapped in ice crystals actually...

Broke?!

Swoosh—

Another sword fell.

Walrein flew backward, crashing heavily to the ground with a "thud."

Eyes swirled.

Unable to battle!

"Whew—"

Ceruledge stood with twin swords, straightening and exhaling lightly, a wisp of white mist mixed with blue fire slowly emerging.

Crack—

On its armor.

A crack appeared.

"You little brat, really showing no mercy..." Glacia complained while recalling Walrein.

As for Walrein's broken tusks...

She wasn't too concerned.

Walrein tooth loss was normal - teeth might even fall out when eating hard ice, but would quickly regrow.

Even in some regions, Walrein tusks were precious like ivory.

Looking at the fire-blazing Ceruledge.

After brief consideration, Glacia summoned Vanilluxe again.

Snow replaced sunny weather once more.

"Vanilluxe, Aurora Veil!"

"Ceruledge, Taunt!"

Both called simultaneously.

But Ceruledge's Taunt forcibly interrupted Vanilluxe's Aurora Veil.

Prediction!

Having experienced Vanilluxe's trouble once, Johan naturally wouldn't let such trouble reappear.

"Ceruledge, Bitter Blade!"

Swoosh—

The blue flame-wrapped blade missed again.

Glacia recalled Vanilluxe once more.

"Tsk..." Johan couldn't help clicking his tongue.

But actually Glacia's expression wasn't relaxed either.

Ceruledge's strength was formidable.

In full team battles, she wouldn't find Ceruledge so troublesome, but in singles... Fire-type's dominance over Ice-types was truly headache-inducing.

This was trouble all type-specialist trainers faced.

Why did so many trainers specialize in one type?

One reason was some trainers particularly loved certain types - like Flint, Aaron, Steven, Lance (crossed out).

Another reason was specializing in one type made trainers' energy, resources, and abilities simpler and easier to develop.

But single-type specialization's problems were obvious.

Encountering type-advantage trainers was very troublesome.

Why didn't everyone mix types like Johan, Cynthia, and Leon?

Corresponding to single-type specialization, raising Pokémon this way was much more difficult.

Different types required different resources, materials, TMs, etc. for training, different training plans, greater energy investment.

Moreover, trainers had harder time achieving success.

But if truly cultivated and developed...

The upper limit was indeed much higher than single-type specialization.

Like Johan.

His first team Pokémon had all reached Champion level or above, so regardless of which type specialist he faced, he could find countermeasures.

Especially when individual Pokémon strength was sufficient.

This was why Johan could have Urshifu sweep Elite Four Sidney's four Pokémon.

No matter how troublesome.

The battle must continue.

Ice and Steel-type Alolan Sandslash.

Best offense was defense!

"Bitter Blade!" Johan's expression serious, aura spreading.

Bang!!!

Sandslash's attacks.

Rapid Strike Style?

Triple Axel!

Each successful hit doubled the next attack's power.

Ceruledge retreated at speeds exceeding Sandslash's expectations, making its final claw miss.

?

But Glacia quickly understood.

Weak Armor!

Continuous attacks maxed Ceruledge's speed too!

Even becoming much faster than Sandslash!

Poof—

Ceruledge quickly retreated, suddenly disappearing in snow and mist.

Or rather.

Disappeared in snow and water vapor from heat rapidly vaporizing ice.

Trouble!

Glacia alarmed, urgently calling: "Sandslash, Ice Punch pursuit - find it!"

Hide-and-seek in snow!

Snow weather was also most familiar to Johan and his Pokémon family.

When Sandslash broke through blizzard and water mist, it saw... a golden-red light point suddenly appearing in the thick mist ahead.

High temperature!

Johan grinned.

You have snow weather physical defense boost, Sandslash excels in physical defense?

Then...

He raised his hand, pointing directly at Sandslash, shouting:

"Armarouge, Armor Cannon!"

Bang!!!

Flames became cannonballs, instantly piercing a vacuum trajectory through snow, golden-red firelight bursting forth, surrounding mist and blizzard completely dispersing.

Armarouge with golden cannon aimed intently, golden flames dancing in its eyes, form sliding backward.

Boom!!!

Fire soared skyward.

Blazing high temperatures.

Actually incinerated all snow and ice in the entire field!

Sandslash took a direct hit.

Lost battle ability!

Hiss—

The blazing golden cannon barrel steamed with scorching white smoke, making sounds when contacting snowflakes.

This round.

Audiences focused intently on screens, breathing involuntarily held.

Only after seeing Alolan Sandslash lose battle ability did they slowly exhale.

"Could Teacher Johan sweep Elite Four Glacia too?"

"That's not impossible!"

"Facts prove... I really could do it!"

Isn't it just getting swept?

Like who couldn't.

But audiences' words weren't looking down on Glacia - precisely because they knew Glacia's formidability, it better highlighted Teacher Johan's strength.

Through "Champion Road," everyone more clearly understood his power.

Snow weather continued.

Glacia recalled Sandslash, gently brushing her hair, somewhat helplessly saying:

"Seems still difficult to cause you much attrition."

"Elite Four Glacia, you're..."

Everyone's so familiar - is this necessary?

But before Johan finished speaking, Glacia summoned her fourth Pokémon.

"Go, Glalie!"

This was Elite Four Glacia's signature Pokémon.

As expected...

"Glalie—"

Elite Four Glacia gently touched the Key Stone at her chest, bursting with rainbow light connecting to Glalie's Mega Evolution Stone, resonating together.

"Mega Evolution!"

Mega Glalie's appearance didn't differ much from Glalie, except its originally mouth restrained by solid ice armor dislocated open, and a sharp blue-black ice horn grew from its forehead, extremely prominent.

Hiss—

Streams of cold air became substantial ice fragments and crystals, drifting from Mega Glalie's mouth.

Supposedly, Glalie's extremely low temperature caused surrounding air moisture to condense into ice crystals, creating this phenomenon.

Additionally, after Mega Evolution, Glalie's ability became "Refrigerate," similar to "Pixilate" and "Aerilate" - when using Normal-type moves, they became Ice-type with increased power.

"Glalie, Giga Impact!" Glacia waved grandly, calling sternly.

Gurgle gurgle—

Glalie growled low, body immediately becoming ball-like, wrapped in pale blue Ice-type energy, rapidly charging toward Armarouge.

Mega Glalie's speed wasn't slow to begin with, plus Giga Impact and rolling boost made speed reach maximum.

"Armarouge, dodge!"

Even Fire-types didn't want to take such attacks.

Just wait for Mega Glalie's Giga Impact to end - it would briefly enter body stiffness, naturally creating counterattack opportunity.

However, even with "Weak Armor" triggered and extremely fast Armarouge, in flying snow and accumulated snow, was gradually closed in on by Mega Glalie.

Suddenly.

Johan noticed the faint smile appearing on Elite Four Glacia's face.

His heart jumped in alarm.

A bold guess arose.

Not really...

However.

Just as this thought emerged, Mega Glalie and Armarouge indeed closed to a certain distance.

He heard Elite Four Glacia's soft but firm command:

"Glalie."

"Explosion!"

Holy crap!

Giga Impact plus Explosion?!

Though Mega Glalie with "Refrigerate" ability perfectly suited "Explosion" tactics, you said something about going easy?!

At this moment.

Johan finally reacted.

Before entering the "Elite Four Fortress" on the "Champion Road," the four Elite Four had made arrangements.

Hydreigon was Sidney's work, giant Salamence was Elite Four Drake's arrangement. Originally he wasn't clear who prepared Slaking or why another Elite Four seemed unprepared...

But this scene immediately made him understand.

Slaking was probably borrowed from Norman by Phoebe, and Glacia's arrangement was precisely those Pokémon in "Boulder Forest" who would "Explode" at the slightest provocation!

"Armarouge!" Johan immediately couldn't care about anything else, aura blue light in his eyes as his voice rang in Armarouge's mind.

Hastily.

Psychic power mixed with aura force appeared beside it.

Boom!!!

Brilliant white light accompanied countless piercing ice spikes, like a massive thorn-covered sphere exploding, instantly engulfing itself, Armarouge, and half the arena.

The massive rumbling and explosion shook the entire battle room.

Livestream audiences also widened their eyes, incredulously watching this scene.

As thick ice mist gradually dispersed.

Explosion's surroundings were covered in thick ice layers, as if suddenly transported to ice spike glaciers.

Dimly visible.

Johan's aura first sensed Armarouge's figure - covered in ice fragments, supporting its knees, breathing heavily.

At the last moment, fortunately Johan sensed Elite Four Glacia's abnormality early and warned Armarouge in time.

Though too late for Protect, the hastily constructed psychic-aura barrier somewhat weakened Explosion's impact.

Moreover.

In seemingly frozen Armarouge's extinguished charcoal body center, a golden flame burned.

Blessed Fire!

Most importantly.

Facing seemingly insurmountable, life-threatening crisis, "Blessed Fire" was further "activated."

It showed increasingly vigorous trends!

"Blessed Fire" was obtained when Ceruledge was still Charcadet, but always remained just a wisp. Though helping many times, it was never... enough.

When Charcadet evolved into Ceruledge, this "Blessed Fire" gained some strengthening, but changes afterward were minimal.

This time, possibly because Ceruledge/Armarouge's strength reached sufficient level, or facing insurmountable danger.

Subconsciously, self-protectively, it further stimulated "Blessed Fire" to become vigorous.

Of course, possibly both reasons.

But regardless, for Ceruledge/Armarouge, this was opportunity.

Opportunity to further catalyze "Blessed Fire"!

Eh?

Should he thank Elite Four Glacia instead?

Ice mist gradually dispersed.

Audiences finally barely saw the field situation.

Seeing the vicious ice spikes and thorns on ground, walls, and ceiling, they gasped.

Such terrifying "Explosion"!

But Armarouge still stood on field, though in extremely poor condition, swaying like a candle in wind, seemingly about to fall anytime.

"Goka..."

With Armarouge's low groan and body sway, it slowly fell backward.

Hum—

Red light shot out.

Johan's Luxury Ball recalled Armarouge.

"Armarouge... lost battle ability?!"

"Holy crap! Worthy of Elite Four - actually defeated one of Teacher Johan's Pokémon!"

"Explosion! Explosion is the ultimate art!"

Audiences were in uproar.

Much more impressive than Elite Four Phoebe.

Elite Four Phoebe only made Teacher Johan switch Pokémon, but Elite Four Glacia... defeated one of Teacher Johan's Pokémon!

Compared to audiences' shock, Glacia was equally surprised.

She wasn't surprised Armarouge lost battle ability - she was surprised she could sense Armarouge hadn't truly lost battle ability.

That life-filled "Blessed Fire" only she on-site could feel.

Couldn't even one-shot this?

Even seemed like Armarouge had some transformation?

Such strength and ability...

Glacia was very satisfied.

If this was the strength of their Champion - Hoenn's blessing!

Of course.

If he could work harder at his job, that would naturally be best.

# 716: VS Elite Four Drake, Champion Showdown! (Two-in-One Chapter)

"Vanilluxe, unable to battle!"

As Rotom referee raised its flag.

"So the winner is, Johan!"

This battle with Glacia officially came to an end.

The final result.

Johan defeated Hoenn's Ice-type Elite Four Glacia at the "cost" of Ceruledge!

For the upcoming battle against Drake, Ceruledge had no ability to participate.

Too decisive, too sudden.

However.

"Elite Four Glacia, that was really... 'surprising.'"

Glacia smiled charmingly: "I originally wanted to see more from you, but now it seems I'm still quite lacking."

Johan couldn't help shaking his head.

No need for that - why probe his depths?

"But it's fine." Glacia's smile remained unchanged. "Though Drake is unreliable, doesn't work diligently, and always wants reimbursements, his strength is unquestionable."

That was Drake's strength!

During Hoenn League's period without a Champion, it was Drake's strength that prevented major incidents.

Just by defeating Elite Four Drake, with Hoenn League's Champion position originally vacant, Teacher Johan could directly ascend to Hoenn League's "Champion throne" on the spot!

Moreover.

Elite Four Drake's strength was evident.

He was absolutely Hoenn League's pillar.

This battle was destined to be a peak showdown!

Under audience attention.

Teacher Johan finally reached the "Elite Four Fortress's" final battle room.

Thud! Thud!

On the big screen, both combatants' portraits appeared.

Blue side: Hoenn League, Dragon Elite Four, Drake!

Red side: Hoenn League, Pokémon Psychology Teacher, Johan!

Rules remained 6-choose-4 singles mode, unlimited move numbers, but limited held items and enhancement methods (Mega Evolution, Z-moves, Terastallization) usage.

Waiting for battle to begin.

The "Elite Four Fortress's" final battle room.

Walls, dome, pillars all carved with various Dragon-type Pokémon, appearing solemn and dignified.

Ethereal and melodious, agile and graceful.

Ninetales!

Sandstorm?

Ninetales' fur gently swayed, snow-white ice crystals scattering around it.

But Johan didn't choose to switch Ninetales.

More switching would fall into passivity and disadvantage.

Rather than switch, better let Ninetales continue.

Though type-disadvantaged, that didn't mean its attacks couldn't damage Duraludon.

More importantly...

In strength, Ninetales had absolute advantage!

"Nature's Madness!" Johan commanded sternly.

"Oowoo!!!"

Ninetales crouched, surrounding aura rippling with pink Fairy-type energy, making the opposing Duraludon feel uncomfortable.

Thud! Thud! Thud!

Earth's veins trembled. Under Ninetales' "Fairy Aura" expansion, seemingly a life force belonging to earth merged into Ninetales' body.

Ninetales' momentum also wildly climbed at this moment.

Elite Four Drake and Duraludon immediately realized something was wrong.

"Duraludon, Flash Cannon!"

Hum—

Duraludon raised both arms, metallic energy frantically gathering and compressing at its chest, finally becoming a straight beam shooting toward Ninetales.

Boom!!!

Rumbling accompanied impact, large amounts of snow and ice crystals flying.

Drake and Duraludon stared intently at the hazy center of impact, breathing involuntarily slowing.

When snow mist gradually dispersed, seeing the unharmed, agile elegant spirit in the snow again, Drake's eyes widened, subconsciously exclaiming:

"Legendary?!"

# 717: Champion, Johan! (Two-in-One Chapter)

Drake hadn't reached "Legendary" level.

Though Drake was from the older generation, and his abilities and experience in battle weren't inferior to Professor Oak, Mustard, or Alder, compared to them, Drake still fell somewhat short.

His shortcoming was that Drake hadn't become a Pokémon trainer very early.

Initially, Drake was actually a sailor like the young Captain Stern, dreaming of conquering the seas.

But due to an accident - a maritime incident - Drake survived only with a Dragonite's help.

From then on, he felt the unconditional kindness from Pokémon, so he resolved to become a trainer, a Dragon-type Pokémon trainer.

Therefore, compared to those others, Drake started relatively late.

However, though Drake hadn't reached "Legendary" level, that didn't mean he hadn't seen it.

Master Mustard from Galar region, hailed as the strongest Champion in history with eighteen consecutive years undefeated, was Drake's friend.

And Master Mustard had "Legendary" level powerful Pokémon in his youth.

Seeing this again.

After initial shock, Drake's expression became somewhat gratified.

Legendary was good, legendary was perfect...

If Hoenn League's Champion was a genuine battle legend, then Hoenn League would have no worries for decades to come.

Hm?

Then Drake noticed a palm-sized pink stone tablet emanating strange misty radiance floating from Ninetales' body.

An item?

What item was this?

It felt filled with sacred, holy aura and extremely strong life force.

Having never seen Arceus and the Plates, Drake couldn't immediately recognize this "Fairy Plate."

Actually, even those who'd seen Arceus and the Plates might not recognize it.

After all, the current "Fairy Plate" differed considerably from the Plate appearance in some people's memories.

More importantly.

Who could imagine that a trainer, an ordinary Pokémon, could possess and use Plates that supposedly only the legendary Creator God could have!

Legend said those were condensed power from this world's universal origin.

"Ninetales—"

Johan adjusted his glasses, gently raising his hand: "Moonblast!"

"Oowoo—"

Ninetales raised its head and sang, in the vast blizzard, a bright moon suddenly hung high, brilliant moonlight blooming pure radiance.

Hum—

A beam of bright moonlight fell down.

Directly striking Duraludon.

Next second.

Boom!!!

Where Duraludon stood, massive rumbling erupted, terrifying shockwaves spreading outward.

The misty blizzard scattered completely.

Duraludon let out a heavy, pained cry, its massive body swaying violently before crashing heavily to the ground.

Thud—

Eyes swirled.

Unable to battle!

Roar!!!

Seeing this, audiences rose, uproarious sounds connecting.

"One-shot? K.O.?!"

"Elite Four Drake's Duraludon wasn't even weak to Fairy-type, yet was one-shotted?!"

"That Duraludon was so strong though..."

"Leg-Legendary? Elite Four Drake just said 'Legendary,' right?"

"Above Champion, Legendary?!"

Everyone showed shocked and stunned expressions.

Galar region, Isle of Armor.

"Legendary?!"

Leon watched the TV screen, intense shock in his eyes.

As Mustard's disciple, Leon was naturally familiar with the "Legendary" level, having seen his master's true strength.

So he clearly knew "Legendary" was existence above Champion, a more difficult height to reach.

"Little Johan's really excellent~"

Mustard cheerfully drank tea. Though long retired, watching this battle between Elite Four Drake and Johan, his heart actually stirred with restless feelings.

How many years since this feeling appeared?

"Master!"

Leon suddenly looked intensely at his master Mustard, calling out.

"Hmm?" Mustard turned.

"After watching this match, please battle me for special training!"

Seeing Leon wasn't discouraged but instead more motivated, Mustard was briefly stunned then showed a gratified smile.

"Alright, Leon."

This was his proud disciple - accepting defeat but not giving up.

"The future belongs to the young generation~" Mustard muttered with some sentiment.

Sinnoh region, Mt. Coronet.

Inside a temporarily built ice shelter.

"Holy crap! Teacher Johan is awesome!"

Flint made a huge fuss, staring intently at the livestream on his phone screen.

To avoid affecting Teacher Johan's "Champion Road" preparation, he, Cynthia, Lucian, and Aaron, though concerned, hadn't disturbed Johan.

Instead, they'd gathered at Mt. Coronet where Cynthia trained to watch the "Champion Road" livestream together.

"Teacher Johan has left us behind..."

Nearby Lucian pushed his sunglasses, quite sentimental.

Besides some envy, he felt no jealousy.

After all, that was Teacher Johan. If it were someone else - like Flint - Lucian might feel indignant, but toward Teacher Johan, he couldn't feel jealous, only admiration.

Cynthia also watched the screen silently, just with a slight smile.

The stronger Johan was, the happier she naturally felt.

But beyond happiness, Cynthia also felt some pressure.

Not only caught up to by Johan but surpassed by him - as a strong woman, she was also unyielding.

Lucian suddenly felt inexplicable chills rising from his tailbone.

Slightly turning his head.

Noticing the boss's expression.

His heart immediately tightened, forcing a smile: "Cough, boss, the Mt. Coronet signal has gotten better..."

"Recently construction crews have been installing signal bases throughout Mt. Coronet range." Cynthia said casually.

"Legendary! Teacher Johan is amazing!" Aaron suddenly jumped up.

The three were used to this - today his reaction was actually fast.

"I see." Lucian understood. "That construction team is impressive, working on Mt. Coronet."

Mt. Coronet, Sinnoh region's highest mountain, nearly dividing the entire Sinnoh region in half.

Supposedly.

In ancient times, before continental plates moved, Mt. Coronet and the Mt. Silver range in Kanto-Johto were actually the same mountain range.

Mt. Silver's danger was well-known - even Champion Red chose to train there.

Mt. Coronet's danger level was imaginable.

Otherwise Cynthia wouldn't choose Mt. Coronet for special training.

Moreover, Mt. Coronet currently had many unexplored areas.

Being able to work in such dangerous, complex, extremely cold conditions showed this construction team's capability.

Cynthia lightly brushed her golden hair, smiling.

"After Johan's 'Champion Road' ends, you'll accompany my special training."

"We? Us?" Lucian looked at Flint, then pointed at himself.

Cynthia nodded slightly.

"All three of you, together."

Lucian: "..."

Looking up.

At the white snow falling outside.

Really want to work overtime - overtime makes me happy.

Johto region, Blackthorn City.

"Johan's pulled ahead!" Lance wore his crimson cape, also watching Hoenn League's "Champion Road."

Clair pouted, muttering: "Monster..."

Clearly a year ago when Johan battled her, she only needed to send second-string Pokémon.

But after one year...

She probably couldn't even beat Johan's second-string Pokémon now.

She'd thought her cousin Lance was impressive enough, but then appeared an even more abnormal "monster."

"You're planning to train in Dragon's Den depths?" Clair probed.

"No."

Lance smiled and shook his head.

Dragon's Den's deep Dragon-type Pokémon were certainly formidable, but...

Facing only Dragon-types couldn't satisfy his "needs."

You had to know.

Though Kanto League's Champion position was also undecided with Elite Four handling most affairs, if he wanted to challenge the "Champion Road" as one of Kanto League's Elite Four, he'd only face three people.

But whether Elite Four Agatha or Elite Four Bruno, none were easily defeated.

Not to mention Lorelei, who quite countered him.

"I'm planning to travel with Bruno." Lance said.

Meeting more formidable trainers, seeing more powerful wild Pokémon, enriching his and his Pokémon's battle experience while possibly catching some appealing Pokémon.

"I'll go with you!" Clair said.

"Don't be ridiculous." Lance reached to pat Clair's head. "You're Blackthorn Gym's Leader, how can you easily..."

Slap!

Clair directly knocked Lance's hand away.

"Hmph!"

Standing up.

"Yes yes yes, you're Elite Four, you're impressive, hmph!"

After speaking, she walked away huffily, leaving Lance helplessly behind.

Kanto region, Viridian City, Team Rocket base beneath Viridian Gym.

After treating his chronic illness, Giovanni's mood and mentality had improved considerably.

Recently he'd either been quietly observing son Silver's changes or handling Team Rocket reforms and "Rainbow Rocket Corporation" matters.

Eating cookies from his desk while watching TV broadcasts.

"Legendary?"

Giovanni's face couldn't help showing a smile.

He was naturally familiar with Legendary level.

Because among his Pokémon, some were "Legendary."

"Faster than expected. Is it that item? But it should be soon..."

A successor with "Legendary" Pokémon strength - Giovanni felt more confident about Johan.

Moreover, thinking about Johan's future identity as both Hoenn League Champion and Team Rocket's secret director was quite interesting.

Who knew what the League would think later.

However.

Using Johan's identity and strength, Team Rocket could better reform.

Perhaps soon, Team Rocket and its members could openly appear in sunlight...

But this was destined to be a long, difficult path. Due to identity issues, he could only complete part of it. Final reforms would definitely need someone with official League identity, high status, and sufficient influence.

Johan was undoubtedly the best choice.

Giovanni pressed the desk button.

A video call screen appeared.

"Matori, after 'Champion Road' ends, transfer the 'Corporation's' dividends and bonuses to Johan's account first."

"Understood!" Matori immediately responded.

Her cheeks slightly reddened as she carefully asked: "Boss, are the cookies good?"

Giovanni was stunned, glancing at the cookies in his hand, slightly nodding:

"Not bad."

Bang!!!

"Flygon, unable to battle!"

Rotom referee lowered its flag, announcing the result.

Duraludon being one-shotted by Ninetales was partly due to Ninetales' strength, partly because Elite Four Drake was somewhat surprised by Ninetales' displayed power.

So, taking advantage of Duraludon's defeat to switch, Drake again summoned Flygon, attempting to seize weather control.

Though risky with low success rate, it was worth trying.

But the result was predictable.

Flygon failed and lost battle ability.

This was unavoidable.

Because Drake's remaining two Pokémon were completely countered by Ninetales.

"Whew—"

Elite Four Drake exhaled.

Even he felt pressure.

But asking him to give up and surrender was impossible.

This wasn't about so-called dignity, Elite Four bottom lines, or refusing to lose, but as a trainer's respect and seriousness toward battle and confrontation.

If opponents were strong and one chose to give up and surrender, then many battles would be unnecessary.

What competitions, conferences - why bother?

Just compare trainers' Pokémon strength directly then rank them!

Pokémon battles were places where miracles could erupt.

So many type-disadvantage victories, so many weak defeating strong - this was what made Pokémon battles truly appealing and thrilling.

Perhaps younger generation trainers were more "rational," but as an older generation trainer, Drake had his own persistence.

If one didn't dare boldly challenge the stronger, how could one's own strength become stronger?

Elite Four Drake smiled.

Surging battle intent rose in his heart.

He'd almost forgotten how long since he'd felt this excitement and anticipation when facing battles and challenges.

People age, but hearts don't!

"Go, Salamence!!!"

After recalling Flygon, Elite Four Drake unhesitatingly threw his final Poké Ball.

"Roar—!!!"

Salamence, his old partner, could sense Drake's inner turbulence.

And it itself wasn't one to surrender easily.

So what if opponents were stronger? So what about type disadvantage?

This was exactly the situation to fight!

Crimson wings, azure skin, sharp eyes showing no fear of Ninetales.

Johan looked at the appearing Salamence, at the passionate Elite Four Drake, feeling somewhat infected by them.

Setting aside "Champion Road," setting aside elder status, purely from battle perspective.

This was absolutely a respectable opponent!

So facing such an opponent...

Johan took out his Luxury Ball, shooting red light to recall Ninetales after two battles.

"Must also give sufficient respect..."

Murmuring, Johan's eyes sharpened, throwing out his ball.

"Gengar!"

"Ka-kaah~!"

Gengar immediately emerged from Johan's shadow, after several flashes, landing on the field.

Finally my turn to appear!

From "Champion Road" start until now, this was Gengar's first appearance.

"It's Teacher Johan's ace, Gengar!"

"Finally letting cute Gengar appear?"

"Teacher Johan really... shows no respect for elders..."

"Rather than respecting elders, Teacher Johan gave Elite Four Drake absolute respect!"

"Ace vs ace, no problem!"

Seeing Gengar appear, audiences immediately cheered excitedly.

Teacher Johan's Ninetales had shown "Legendary" level strength - so as Teacher Johan's "ace," what was Gengar's strength?

"Legendary!"

Seeing Gengar, Drake took a deep breath, solemnly speaking.

Indeed!

If Ninetales reached "Legendary" level through the "Fairy Plate," then Johan's Gengar was naturally "Legendary"!

Two Legendary-level Pokémon!

This already... had the style of Mustard, the "strongest Champion in history."

"Good! Excellent!"

Elite Four Drake's face was flushed, captain's coat fluttering, gently pressing his hat brim.

"Salamence—"

"Roar—!!!"

Salamence fearlessly roared, sound waves rolling up snow, wings beating as it soared skyward.

"Mega Evolution!"

Hum!!!

Bond power opened by Key Stone, converted by Mega Evolution Stone, brilliant rainbow light enveloping Salamence, its appearance changing in evolution light.

"Bonds..." Johan murmured watching this scene.

Decades of partnership and companionship - the bond depth between Salamence and Elite Four Drake needed no words.

This was power absolutely not inferior to most Pokémon and trainers, and Salamence's momentum wildly climbed during evolution.

If Elite Four Drake's Salamence previously was just short of ordinary Champion ace Pokémon level, then now...

Solidly Champion peak!

"Roar!!!"

Crimson crescent wings spread wide, brilliant light completely dispersing, Mega Evolution symbol flashing briefly.

This moment.

Whether surrounding snow, falling snowflakes, or the room's magnificently carved pillars, all were dyed blood red.

As if a blood-colored moon had risen high.

Mega Salamence!

"Roar—!!!"

Roaring shook the entire venue.

Fierce winds dispersed the last blizzard.

"Ka-kaah..."

Gengar gaped, watching this scene, couldn't help smacking its lips.

This guy's kinda handsome...

"Come, Johan!" Elite Four Drake and Mega Salamence were completely united in will, staring directly at Johan, seriously saying:

"Let us see your true strength!"

True strength?

Johan's expression was slightly strange.

Then don't limit enhancement methods and usage...

Though thinking this internally, out of respect for Elite Four Drake, Johan's hand already gripped his Key Stone.

"Elite Four Drake, as you wish!"

Hum—

"Gengar—" Johan shouted, coat tails fluttering.

"Ka-kaah~!"

Gengar grinned mischievously.

Toward mid-air Mega Salamence, it gently wagged its finger.

I admit you're kinda handsome, but compared to me... you're still lacking!

Johan and Gengar's expressions seemed to overlap.

"Mega Evolution!!!"

"Ka-kaah!!!"

Rainbow light connected Johan and Gengar.

Speaking of bonds, Gengar and I are confident we won't lose to anyone!

Hum—

Suddenly.

Thick black mist spread from Gengar's feet, black fog mixed with thunderous roars, black lightning and mist raging around like disaster descending.

Mega Gengar!

Black clouds instantly spread.

Covering the blood moon scene Mega Salamence's evolution had created, black mist completely enveloping and wrapping this place!

"This is Mega Evolution?!"

"Unknowing people would think some legendary Pokémon descended!"

"Is this Teacher Johan's true strength?"

"Too exaggerated..."

Audiences watched the livestream scene in shock.

Elite Four Drake and Mega Salamence, directly facing Mega Gengar, felt the greatest pressure.

Was "Legendary" level Pokémon Mega Evolution this exaggerated?

"Ka-kaah!!!"

When all commotion quieted, Mega Gengar winked at Mega Salamence.

See? I'm explosively handsome!

"Salamence!" Though Drake felt pressure, he could still battle, even unhesitatingly attacking first.

"Hyper Voice!"

"Roar—!!!"

Mega Salamence roared, rolling sound waves becoming layered sound waves, instantly unleashing.

Normal-type move Hyper Voice theoretically couldn't damage Ghost-type Mega Gengar at all.

But after Mega Evolution, Salamence's ability became the rare "Aerilate"!

[Aerilate: Normal-type moves become Flying-type with increased power!]

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar plugged its ears, grimacing.

Your voice is too ugly!

Hearing this, Mega Salamence's cheeks reddened, anger flashing in its eyes.

Who's comparing voice beauty with you?!

If you're so good-sounding, then try it!

For a moment, Mega Salamence increased Hyper Voice output.

"Ka-kaah?"

Mega Gengar put hands on hips, looking unconvinced.

Johan, mind-connected, immediately rejected its idea.

"No using Perish Song!"

There weren't just two people and two Pokémon present - there was also Rotom referee!

If the referee got knocked out, who would announce results?

Moreover.

Johan seriously suspected.

Gengar's Perish Song might even affect livestream audiences through the broadcast.

After all, Perish Song's sound waves would be captured by livestream and transmitted to all audiences.

If that happened...

It would probably cause the biggest "disaster" since League "Champion Road" existed.

Mega Gengar's eyes rolled.

Can't use Perish Song?

I have other methods!

Hmph!

Mega Gengar put hands on hips, puffing its round belly, taking a deep breath, then cupping hands like a megaphone, similarly shouting loudly.

"Ka-kaah—!!!"

Psychic power became substantial sound waves, accompanied by extremely harsh noise, vibrating outward.

Psychic Noise!

Mega Salamence's eyes widened.

That's it?

Still competing whose voice sounds better?

"Salamence, now's the chance - Double-Edge!" Drake waved grandly.

Taking advantage of Mega Gengar using Psychic Noise, forcefully break through and close in - this was their only chance to win.

Gengar was typically high special attack, high speed but poor stamina, and physical defense wasn't outstanding.

While Mega Salamence had both physical and special attack but favored physical attack.

Closing distance for physical breakthrough was the only way to possibly bridge their raw strength gap.

Only by forcing close to Gengar could they have continued fighting chances.

Otherwise...

Long-range attack trading, Mega Salamence definitely wasn't the opponent.

Moreover, Drake had some understanding of Johan's Gengar - that super-large Shadow Ball was very troublesome.

"Roar—!!!"

Mega Salamence beat its wings, suddenly wrapping in pale blue energy, charging toward Gengar at extreme speed like a jet.

"Get serious." Johan's expression became stern. "Ice Punch!"

Get serious?

Ice Punch?

Audiences were confused.

This sentence seemed fine at first glance, and against Dragon and Flying-type Mega Salamence, Ice-type move Ice Punch could indeed achieve four times effectiveness, but...

The target was Gengar!

But soon.

Audiences realized their shallow knowledge.

Crack crack crack—

The extremely cold field temperature granted Mega Gengar faster Ice-type move execution speed, its spike-covered palm immediately covered in frost.

Facing directly charging Mega Salamence, Mega Gengar unhesitatingly swung its punch.

Bang!!!

The frost-covered fist solidly struck Mega Salamence's head, ice fragments immediately flying.

"Hold on Salamence, charge through!" Drake shouted fiercely.

"Roar!!!"

Mega Salamence's eyes filled with bloodshot veins, violent, frenzied aura bursting from its body, blood-colored airflow intertwining with pale blue Flying-type energy, enveloping its entire body.

Outrage!

Rage brought absolutely powerful strength. Mega Salamence endured discomfort and pain, withstanding Ice Punch's attack, again erupting power.

Bang!!!

A blood-colored arc flashed.

Mega Salamence had already reached behind Mega Gengar.

Unlike the violent Mega Salamence, Mega Gengar's expression seemed somewhat dazed.

"Suc-succeeded?!"

Most people couldn't help thinking this.

But Elite Four Drake frowned.

Something was wrong...

Bang—

Suddenly.

"Mega Gengar" suddenly exploded and dispersed like black mist, merging into surrounding darkness.

Shadow?

Wait!

How could shadows use moves?

Teacher Johan, this... isn't legal, right?

"Ka-kaah?"

From nearby shadows, Mega Gengar mischievously poked out its head.

Johan's face also showed a cunning smile.

Combining with Gengar's will, influenced by Gengar again.

"Elite Four Drake, I have no intention of holding back..."

This was respect for Drake!

Though his Gengar indeed liked punching, in this level of battle, it obviously wasn't a good occasion.

But if just for confusing opponents, no problem.

Gengar was a Ghost-type Pokémon, tactics emphasized cunning changeability and unpredictability. Johan and Gengar developed this to the extreme.

"Gengar!"

Johan's expression became truly serious this time.

Just as he'd be influenced by Gengar, Gengar would also be influenced by him. Mega Gengar immediately put away its playful, mischievous expression.

"Maximum power, Shadow Ball!"

"Ka-kaah!!!"

Mega Gengar shouted, raising both hands.

The shadows and black mist enveloping and covering the entire battle room seemed attracted by a black hole, frantically gathering toward Mega Gengar's hands.

Finally condensing at extreme speed into a substantial black orb.

"Salamence!!! Double-Edge!!!"

Drake and Mega Salamence were also united in will, actually using their stubborn will to briefly suppress Outrage's negative effects.

Carrying anger and violence, Mega Salamence suddenly turned, crying out as it soared skyward.

The massive black orb.

Mega Salamence wrapped in blue-red energy.

At the field's mid-air.

They collided.

Rumble—!!!

Instantly.

Massive impact aftershocks spread like an earthquake, the battle room's reinforced pillars, walls, dome, and floor were all shaken apart and overturned.

The commotion made the already-finished Glacia, Phoebe, and Sidney appear, each summoning Pokémon to use moves against the aftershocks, reducing "Elite Four Fortress" damage.

Rotom referee turned pale, hiding in a corner trembling.

"These two guys..." Glacia's face darkened.

Screen-watching audiences had all stood up, holding their breath, staring intently at screens.

Until the "rumbling" noise gradually faded, and Salamence, having shed its Mega Evolution energy, lay in the ruins with rolled eyes.

"Sal-Salamence unable to battle, so the winner is—challenger Johan!" Rotom referee tremblingly floated out, announcing the final result.

Silence.

Silence.

Still silence.

After a very long silence.

Boom!!!

The stadium, livestream, forums... instantly exploded.

"Teacher Johan—"

"Teacher Johan is awesome (voice crack)!!!"

"Champion! Champion!!!"

"We are—Champions!!!"

Drake walked over helplessly.

"You kid don't know to go easy on elders."

Though saying this, his face was full of smiles.

Johan coughed lightly: "Cough, that... Elite Four Glacia told me to do this."

Glacia: "???"

Both looked at each other and smiled, knowing it was a joke.

"Congratulations, Johan." Elite Four Drake extended his hand, quite gratified.

Johan was about to speak when Drake immediately changed his words:

"No, congratulations, Champion."

Champion?

Johan inevitably was stunned, looking at his Gengar.

Just became Champion?

When he first came to the Pokémon world, that seemingly unreachable place was finally reached?

"Hello, please register your team information in the Hall of Fame."

A prepared staff member led Johan to the device in the deepest part of the "Elite Four Fortress," registering Pokémon information.

Originally only six Pokémon could be registered, but at Johan's request, all his Pokémon information was registered.

Gengar, Ninetales, Tinkaton, Dragonite, Urshifu, Ceruledge, Tyranitar, Servine, Indeedee-F, Rotom!

Simultaneously, Johan and his Pokémon completed photos together.

The stadium and online erupted again.

Registering Hall of Fame information also meant—

Officially becoming Champion!

Hoenn League, Champion, Johan!
