# 718: Champion Duties (Two-in-One Chapter)

A new Hoenn League Champion was born!

Under the attention of all, using the most orthodox method, challenging the "Champion Road" and defeating the Elite Four!

In just under two days, this feat was accomplished.

And this would be viewed in the future as the key turning point, or rather starting point, of "the younger generation taking over League responsibilities"!

Of course, that was for later.

At this moment, Johan, having completed Champion information registration in the Hall of Fame, received the Champion's cloak from Elite Four Drake under the gaze of Glacia, Phoebe, Sidney, and numerous Hoenn League officials.

Rustle—

The cloak fell upon his shoulders.

Hoenn League Champion, Teacher Johan, officially took office!

Besides online excitement, audiences at Ever Grande Stadium, also the Champion inauguration ceremony venue, gave their greatest cheers.

Bang!!!

Fireworks and celebratory displays bloomed in brilliant colors.

"Teacher finally became Champion."

Steven, who'd come to the scene, rarely showed some excitement, applauding with everyone.

Steven naturally knew his teacher's "go-with-the-flow" personality, never having much desire for Elite Four or Champion positions.

Though Steven always felt his teacher completely qualified and capable of becoming Elite Four or Champion, with teacher not expressing interest, he as a student couldn't say much.

Now.

Seeing teacher finally become League Champion, shouldering the important burden of protecting all of Hoenn region, he suddenly felt... like his wish for teacher's success had come true.

He felt genuinely happy.

"We're Champion students now! Roxanne, we're Champion students!" Flannery appeared much more excited than Steven and Roxanne.

Of course, the happiest were definitely Kanaz Pokémon Academy's leadership, especially Principal Martin.

Having specially come to the scene, he was so happy he couldn't control himself, while envious, jealous looks from other school colleagues filled him with pride.

Our academy's teacher is Champion!

Question.

In the entire Pokémon world, what school could have such "faculty strength"?

Even the historic Orange Academy in Paldea region only had an Elite Four art teacher at most - how could it compare to our Kanaz Pokémon Academy?

"The next person wanting to challenge the Champion will have to seriously consider their abilities." Roxanne, holding books, replied.

Next person to challenge the Champion?

In Flannery's mind appeared scenes of consecutively challenging Elite Four, then challenging Teacher Johan...

No, the scene was too "bloody" - didn't dare think about it.

Could anyone really accomplish such a feat?

Previously many said Kanto League's "Champion Road" was the most difficult in all Leagues.

But now it seemed... Hoenn League would probably take the "most difficult" position.

"But I think Teacher Johan might not serve very long." Wallace smiled.

Noticing looks from Flannery and Roxanne, he explained:

"Just my guess."

But somehow, hearing him say this, whether Steven, Flannery, or Roxanne, all felt... it really might be like that.

Perhaps in two or three years, Teacher Johan might announce retiring from Champion position.

At this moment, Johan under the spotlight, while maintaining a standard smile and taking commemorative photos with League officials, was thinking—

When would be appropriate to choose retirement?

He might be the only person who, just becoming Champion, was already considering retirement.

League work was visibly that much - detailed down would definitely be more, too complex. He definitely wasn't "official" material.

Johan had self-awareness.

Meanwhile.

His Pokémon on his Poké Ball belt were communicating across Poké Balls or shadows.

"Ka-kaah~" Gengar hung upside down in its Luxury Ball.

Became Champion, but why doesn't it feel that exciting? Could it be... my mentality has grown again!

"Oowoo~" Ninetales lay gracefully.

Feel like I can improve further, combining "Nature's Madness" with Ice-type power...

"Cha!" Tinkaton polished its hammer's smooth surface.

Precious hammer, precious hammer, who's the world's best 'smith'? Aha! It's me!

"Dragonite~" Dragonite squinted, patting its round belly.

In that final battle facing so many Dragon-type Pokémon, yet didn't get battle time? Really shouldn't have slept...

"Garruu~" Urshifu sat cross-legged, hands on knees, muttering.

Nature hasn't given gifts for so long...

"Goka!" Ceruledge suddenly opened its eyes, golden firelight flashing in its eye sockets.

Recovered!

"Indeedee~" Indeedee hummed a little tune.

This time finally had "battle satisfaction"~

"Servine!" Servine puffed its cheeks, eyes proud and haughty.

This doesn't count! Next time I'll clear it again!

"Tyranitar?" Tyranitar yawned and sat up, scratching its head.

Eh? Still not dinner time?

"Vii~"

"Marsha~"

Victini and Marshadow stared at each other, then smiled and high-fived.

We're too awesome~

Click click click—

Rotom Pokédex mixed into media frantically taking photos.

"Commemoration! Must commemorate, Rotom!"

People gradually left, still excitedly discussing previous battles and Teacher Johan's record of consecutively defeating four Elite Four members.

Johan also continuously received many congratulatory messages and calls.

Including one from Cynthia.

"Congratulations, Champion~" Cynthia teased.

"Haha—" Johan laughed awkwardly. "You should be about ready too, right?"

Originally Cynthia had said she'd challenge Sinnoh League first, but Johan "overtook her," becoming Hoenn League Champion first.

"Mm, about ready." Cynthia said somewhat ambiguously.

After witnessing Johan's "Champion Road," Cynthia substituted herself and found some strength gap between herself and Johan.

But this didn't discourage her - instead made her more motivated.

So after finishing this call with Johan, she prepared to begin special training.

"I'll come cheer you on in person!"

"Good!"

After chatting a while longer, Johan was called to receive prizes.

Actually rather than prizes, it was more like... Champion benefits.

As Hoenn League's "financial manager," League treasury keys had always been in her hands.

"Champion, your prizes." Elite Four Glacia said teasingly.

Handing over a list.

The first line read—

"Master Ball?"

Johan was stunned scanning the list.

"This thing really exists?"

He'd heard of Silph Company's "Master Ball" more than once, but this was Johan's first time seeing it personally.

Glancing at the tray's purple-white colored ball with letter "M" carved in the center and red transparent glass structures on both sides, it was exactly like the Master Ball in his memory.

In games, without cheats, this was precious.

Only one obtainable per playthrough.

One of the most precious consumable items in the entire Pokémon world!

"Silph Company's highest technological product, supposedly capable of 100% capture rate for all Pokémon, but specifically... unknown." Elite Four Glacia said.

"Unknown?"

Glacia shrugged. "Silph Company only produced so many. Though you're not the first to get one, people have indeed used Master Balls to catch Pokémon before, but... too few samples."

True.

With limited Master Ball quantities, naturally couldn't be used casually like regular Poké Balls.

The few existing usage records indeed showed no failures in catching Pokémon, but as Glacia said, too few samples to confirm true 100% success rate.

Actually.

Most who obtained Master Balls... treated them as "collectibles."

So precious, unless absolutely necessary, no real meaning in using them.

Collection value might exceed actual value.

"Supposedly Professor Oak has one too. If you get the chance, you could discuss with him." Glacia said.

Professor Oak's Master Ball?

Vision continued down.

"Sacred Ash?"

Another good item!

For actual battle item use, "Sacred Ash" had similar effects to "Max Revive" and "Revival Herb."

The difference was "Sacred Ash" not only restored full HP but also all status conditions.

"Max Revive" only restored HP, while "Revival Herb" additionally lowered Pokémon-trainer intimacy due to bitterness.

But "Sacred Ash's" true purpose was actually outside battles.

As everyone knew.

Pokémon losing battle ability in combat was just exhaustion, fatigue, or demoralized will.

Through special medicine, items, or Pokémon Center healing, full recovery was possible.

But "Sacred Ash" could restore vitality and rejuvenate Pokémon truly facing death!

Supposedly.

When Ho-Oh revived the three Pokémon in "Brass Tower," what scattered was "Sacred Ash," thus creating the three legendary beasts Raikou, Entei, and Suicune.

Of course, Ho-Oh's "Sacred Ash" effects couldn't compare to trainer-used "Sacred Ash."

But this was definitely a life-saving "divine item."

True life-saving!

"Hoenn has such good stuff?" Johan was quite surprised.

Elite Four Glacia looked pained, saying irritably: "Only one!"

"Won by a predecessor from Johto League's tournament."

"Won?"

Johan was puzzled.

"What competition? Such amazing rewards?"

Casually pocketing the small bag of "Sacred Ash," Johan asked with some interest.

Glacia looked at him meaningfully: "You'll know soon enough."

Why... such an ominous feeling?

Additionally.

One "Ice Z," one "Poison Z" - two precious Z-Crystals total.

"Considering you already have Mega Evolution Stones for Gengar and Tyranitar, two Z-Crystals as substitutes." Glacia said.

"Not bad."

Johan happily accepted.

At least twenty million Pokédollars worth.

And both were Z-Crystals his Ninetales and Gengar could use.

When truly short on money, selling these two could provide some relief.

"Do you want to rest a day, or hold the 'Elite Four Meeting' as Champion today?" After giving "benefits," Glacia crossed her arms, asking.

Elite Four Meeting?

Johan's expression was strange.

Already having him convene this level of meeting?

Felt so high-level, seemingly unreachable.

But Johan knew this couldn't be postponed.

Didn't Glacia say - either rest a day or convene now.

Rest a day?

Round trip to Kanaz City wouldn't leave much time.

What must come will come.

Taking a deep breath, then slowly exhaling, Johan said helplessly: "Then now."

Glacia suddenly stood, seriously: "Yes, Champion!"

Johan: "..."

Hoenn League Headquarters, top floor, Elite Four Meeting Room.

"Stop playing, Gengar. This thing can save lives at crucial moments."

Johan, sitting in the head seat, looked at the purple fatty crouching in the corner and said irritably.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar turned around sheepishly, hands behind its back, pouting and starting to whistle.

But white dust was obviously stuck around its mouth.

Johan's cheek twitched.

"You little rascal, you didn't eat the 'Sacred Ash,' did you?"

"Ka-kaah~ Ka-kaah~"

Gengar waved its hands repeatedly, gesturing "just a little bit."

No way, I just wanted to see if it was really that effective, hehe...

Johan: "..."

Shaking his head.

"Enough already, don't really use it all up, then when I need it I'll find it empty."

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar immediately stuffed the small bag of "Sacred Ash" into its shadow, then drew a "cross" on its chest and clasped hands slightly bowing - a funny appearance of swearing to both God and Buddha.

It just wanted to see why "Sacred Ash" could save truly dying Pokémon.

If it could figure out "Sacred Ash's" principle, it might even replicate it - then Johan wouldn't need to worry about "dying" casually!

Though Johan didn't know exactly what this shifty-eyed purple fatty was thinking, he could roughly guess.

Just about to speak when the meeting room door was pushed open.

Elite Four Drake, Elite Four Glacia, Elite Four Phoebe, and Elite Four Sidney - Hoenn League's four Elite Four members successively entered.

Around the small round table sat five chairs.

Johan as Champion sat at the head, the other four naturally representing Hoenn League's four Elite Four.

"Hey, an 'Elite Four Meeting' with a Champion - really the first time." Lively Phoebe couldn't help sighing as soon as she sat down.

Such words.

But Drake, Glacia, and Sidney all smiled.

With a Champion, whether Hoenn League or this "Elite Four Meeting" was finally "complete."

In the future, even if the sky fell, there'd finally be someone taller to hold it up.

However, Johan had just become Champion and wasn't familiar with Hoenn League and "Elite Four Meeting" procedures, so Glacia temporarily continued hosting duties.

"We mainly need to discuss 'Champion Celebration' arrangements, 'Champion-Elite Four work redistribution' matters, and—"

"Wait, wait!"

Johan quickly straightened.

No way.

Champion-Elite Four work redistribution?

Starting with such "heavy" topics?

How eager were they to redistribute work after his appointment?

"That, cough, I'm not familiar with our League's systems and situations. Let me have a few days?" Noticing four people's looks, Johan coughed lightly.

Drake, Phoebe, and Sidney were manageable, but Elite Four Glacia's eyes immediately sharpened.

Right after he finished speaking, Glacia directly produced a thick stack of documents, placing them before him.

"This contains our Hoenn League's systems and some simple current Elite Four task and work distribution lists." She said expressionlessly.

Johan subconsciously scanned it.

Elite Four Phoebe's responsibilities: Managing archaeological teams, research teams, and all major matters related to Ghost-type Pokémon.

Though less work, no real problems.

After all, Phoebe was typically capable but naive, with only some archaeological foundation.

But she was willing to work - with a few more years of training, she'd definitely become another "expert" comparable to Elite Four Glacia.

Elite Four Sidney's responsibilities: Guarding Mauville City Game Corner and managing Hoenn region "thug organizations."

Hm?

Johan thought he'd misread, couldn't help scanning again for confirmation.

After confirming he hadn't misread... silently produced a Slowpoke-style question mark above his head.

?

Elite Four Drake's responsibilities: Handling any major incidents.

At first glance, seemed like a "firefighter" - going wherever problems arose, showing Drake shouldering great responsibility.

But thinking carefully revealed...

How to define "major incidents"?

Did only events like Groudon and Kyogre's chaos count as major, or what qualified?

If these "major incidents" were determined by Drake himself, then wouldn't that be...

Johan silently took a breath.

Looking at Elite Four Glacia's final responsibilities:

Financial manager, Hoenn League Gym assessment, Hoenn League Investigation Department coordination, Hoenn League Special Mobile Unit command, Hoenn League meeting coordination, Hoenn League tournament preparation and management...

Holy... crap?

Johan couldn't help producing another question mark.

The simple task distribution on one page - Drake, Phoebe, Sidney each had one line, while Elite Four Glacia occupied... most of the page.

He looked at Elite Four Glacia imperceptibly, inevitably showing deep "sympathy" in his eyes.

This was really...

The capable work harder!

Then Johan reacted.

This wasn't "Champion-Elite Four work redistribution" at all - this was Elite Four Glacia desperately seeking someone to "share the burden."

No wonder the other three looked teasing.

Johan lowered his eyes, thoughts flashing.

This was more thrilling than Pokémon battles.

Quickly.

Johan casually flipped through the thick stack of documents, coughed twice, and said:

"That, I can't possibly read all these documents at once, and I need time to understand these affairs, so... cough cough, what I mean is—"

Slap—

Elite Four Glacia's hand pressed on the documents, making a sound.

Drake, Phoebe, and Sidney instinctively shuddered.

Drake, who'd been sitting boldly upright, straightened his posture. Sidney, who'd been casually crossing his legs, lowered his feet. Phoebe hung her head, stuck out her tongue, then quietly winked at Johan with a "take care" look.

Johan: "..."

Good grief.

This was the Hoenn League head steward's "authority"!

Glacia said expressionlessly, only uttering two words.

"Deadline."

"I—"

Johan also straightened.

"I'm still International Police Inspector, promised to help handle some homeless UB issues in Alola region. Let me finish handling Alola's UB incidents first."

A decent excuse.

Glacia stared at him for a while before slowly saying:

"Fine."

Having "persisted" so many years, didn't matter a few more days.

"Second matter, Champion Celebration." Glacia said again.

For any region and League, Champion appointment was extremely important.

Previously, when networks and communications weren't so developed, regional residents only knew through "Champion Celebrations" - oh, the Champion changed.

But now...

"Skip the Champion Celebration." Johan said.

"Time-consuming, labor-intensive, and would cost considerable League funds. It's not decades ago anymore - just announce on the League website."

Glacia, Drake, and the others exchanged glances, all somewhat surprised.

"Champion Celebrations" concerned a Champion's "honor" - exclusive Champion "treatment."

Teacher Johan was so understanding?

While Johan's thoughts were...

He probably wouldn't serve as Champion for many years - then hold another "Champion Celebration"?

He couldn't help thinking.

What about Champions who served only minutes?

"You're sure?" Glacia asked again.

Johan lowered his voice, leaning slightly sideways.

"That, can it be converted to cash?"

Glacia's expression darkened while Drake, Phoebe, and Sidney smiled.

"No!"

"Then I'm sure." Johan shrugged.

Wouldn't do time-wasting, money-wasting things.

"What do you think?" Glacia looked at the other three.

"Johan's quite responsible. Since he doesn't care, the League shouldn't waste money." Drake said.

Phoebe and Sidney naturally had no objections.

"Fine then."

Glacia, still serving as "head steward," decided again.

"One more thing."

After pausing, Glacia produced another document, placing it before Johan.

"This is?"

While asking, he curiously opened the document.

Seeing a title - Pokémon World Championship!

Immediately closed the document.

Looking questioningly at Elite Four Drake.

Drake smiled and nodded, raising an eyebrow: "When I and Glacia approached you, you personally agreed."

Johan: "?"

He recalled after the Kyogre-Groudon incident ended, Drake and Glacia had visited him together, hoping he'd do something.

Hadn't thought much of it then.

Never expected... they'd buried this trap until now?!

"You two..." Johan said somewhat through gritted teeth: "Really long-term vision..."

Glacia seemed not to hear the "sarcasm" in Johan's words, saying flatly: "Weren't you curious where our 'Sacred Ash' came from? That was a prize from the World Championship hosted by Johto League."

Good grief.

"So this World Championship venue is Galar region?"

"Not entirely correct." Drake replied.

"Hm?"

Drake explained:

"At the last general League meeting, applications by Galar League Chairman Rose and Paldea League Chairman-Champion Nemona were approved."

"So this Pokémon World Championship will be held in both Galar and Paldea regions."

Two regions?

Dynamax versus Terastallization showdown?

"Good things" really came one after another...

"As our Hoenn League's representative, you not participating wouldn't make sense." Drake added, teasing openly.

Johan's mouth twitched.

Still Hoenn League's representative.

Believe it or not, I'll write a "resignation letter" when I get back?

"Each League will have at least one representative - except Alola League still uncertain, totaling eight people, called 'Eight Masters.'" Glacia also said.

So this was the Eight Masters system...

Alola region was truly pitiful.

But understandable.

Alola League was currently just a makeshift organization with Champion and Elite Four positions still undetermined.

"Of course, the Pokémon World Championship doesn't limit participants - anyone can register, just need to raise their score to 'Great Ball Class' to qualify for tournament advancement."

The so-called "Eight Masters" were just eight people in "Master Ball Class."

Before competitions began, there'd be "Master Replacement Battles" where some "Great Ball Class" contestants could challenge the eight "Eight Masters."

Differed from Johan's memory of "Eight Masters Tournament" but not by much.

Eh?

Suddenly.

Johan thought of something.

If he used "preparing for Pokémon World Championship" as an excuse, couldn't he "delay" Elite Four work redistribution again?

After the World Championship ended, he might have arranged affairs and could retire, passing to Steven.

He gently rubbed his chin.

But this way, Elite Four Glacia might explode.

After brief consideration, he had another idea.

Could first have Steven "familiarize" himself with business.

Steven was still only "reserve Elite Four" - as his student, handling teacher's affairs as proxy was reasonable, right?

The only trouble might be Drake's long-awaited retirement having to be postponed again.

No choice.

Could only trouble Drake again.

Thinking this.

Johan couldn't help giving Drake a "sympathetic" look, making Drake uncomfortable.

"You little rascal, what bad ideas now?"

"Only Boss Giovanni truly knows my heart!"

Hoenn League Headquarters building, Champion's office.

Johan sat in the comfortable Champion's chair, looking at transfer information just received on his phone, mood immediately brightening.

"Rainbow Rocket Corporation" dividends, special advisor salary.

Total fifty million Pokédollars!

This was just dividends from "Rainbow Rocket Corporation's" or rather its dangerous construction division's startup stage, already so much.

"Today, let's splurge!"

Johan waved grandly.

"Ka-kaah?"

Pokémon throughout the spacious Champion's office, touching and examining various novelties, all looked over.

Especially Gengar, immediately floating to Johan's side, rubbing its palms expectantly.

Big dinner tonight?

"Right!" Johan said proudly.

The little ones gathered around, chattering about where to eat and what to eat.

Johan smiled "boldly": "League Headquarters Staff Cafeteria Grand Hotel!"

Gengar's black mist surged, silently producing a dark question mark.

"?"

"Hahaha—"

Johan rubbed the little fatty's head, dispersing its condensed question mark.

"Just kidding."

He walked toward the only quiet spot in the office - Ceruledge sitting cross-legged on the ground with flames flowing around its body.

During the battle with Glacia, Ceruledge's "Blessed Fire" had changed.

Still hadn't fully awakened.

Crouching before Ceruledge, he immediately felt rushing heat waves.

But these heat waves had little burning sensation, instead... contained vibrant life force.

Unlike the "Fairy Plate's" natural-seeming, refreshing life energy, this was...

As if it would first burn you completely, then grant life force for rebirth.

Precisely Ho-Oh's signature Blessed Fire!

Seeming to sense Johan's attention, or perhaps having absorbed enough, Ceruledge opened its eyes with flame flickering in its pupils.

"Goka?"

"How do you feel?" Johan asked.

"Goka..."

Ceruledge scratched its head, indicating... didn't feel much different, just that its recovery ability might be stronger.

If injured in battle or stamina consumed, recovery speed would be faster.

The more severely injured, the more stamina consumed, the faster recovery speed, and flame power... might also increase.

Johan's eyes brightened hearing this.

Blaze ability?

Self-recovery version of Blaze?

Hadn't expected Ho-Oh's "Blessed Fire" could be strengthened after being given to Ceruledge through Entei.

This meant "Blessed Fire" completely belonged to Ceruledge, fully "digested" and transformed into its own power.

However, according to Ceruledge's description.

Its "Blessed Fire" only affected itself - for others, it only had burning effects.

"Bit inferior to Entei's 'Blessed Fire,' but enough!"

Johan was very satisfied with this result.

His Pokémon's illegal abilities had grown stronger again.

"Let's go."

Johan patted Ceruledge's shoulder, solid armor clanging.

Tinkaton had forged Ceruledge's armor quite well, just that after real battles, the armor always cracked.

Fortunately, Tinkaton was skilled at armor repair.

"Time for a real feast!"

"Ka-kaah!"

"Tyranitar!"

Gengar, Tyranitar, and other little ones immediately cheered.

# 719: Teacher Johan's 'Tea Party' (Two-in-One Chapter)

"Steven, it's up to you."

In the Hoenn League Champion's office, Johan said with a serious expression to Steven.

"Teacher..."

Steven's expression was somewhat embarrassed.

His teacher had just become Champion and was already preparing to "run away" after only two days?

Anyone would be confused facing this situation.

And as the teacher's student, his coursework wasn't even finished yet, but he had to handle Champion duties?

Johan's expression was serious as he gently patted Steven's shoulder.

"Steven, teacher is doing this for your own good. Haven't you always been conflicted about being a trainer versus family business? This time, let you experience it properly - I believe you can make a better role choice."

League Champion or Devon Corporation president.

"Teacher, I'm actually not conflicted anymore..." Steven said helplessly in a small voice.

Johan directly pretended not to hear.

"Don't worry, there's actually not much to do right now. Elite Four Glacia is still mainly handling Hoenn League's affairs. You just need to attend some meetings in my place when you have time."

That's because he'd been avoiding responsibilities quickly, so work redistribution was temporarily postponed.

However...

Steven was already someone Hoenn League planned to focus on cultivating. Whether in strength or ability, he was absolutely top choice.

It was only because of Johan's sudden emergence that, otherwise, within a year at most, the Hoenn League Champion position would definitely belong to Steven.

Though Johan was currently Champion and Steven only a reserve Elite Four member, if he temporarily helped Johan as proxy, Elite Four Glacia would probably be happy to let Steven shoulder more responsibilities.

But this had little to do with Johan.

Good luck, Steven! Johan silently cheered for his student.

"That's what you say."

Steven obviously understood this point, but current Johan was both Champion and teacher - couldn't argue with him.

Johan didn't give him another chance to refuse, saying:

"I now have to handle something important."

Hm?

Something important?

Steven's thoughts were attracted by this statement, following Johan to the desk.

He saw Johan solemnly pull out a blank document, then begin writing.

The title was - "Teacher Johan's Pokémon Psychology Research Platform and Ecological Environment Construction Project Application"

This was...

Steven was stunned.

Research facility?

He suddenly remembered.

His teacher, besides being an educator and League Champion, was also a researcher of considerable reputation.

Was teacher establishing his own research facility?

But watching, Steven's expression gradually became strange.

Good grief, this was an island construction project application!

Though he had to admit, some project clauses and objectives Johan wrote were quite constructive.

For example, building a safe, stable, and peaceful ecological zone that could make wild Pokémon emotions more stable, verifying wild Pokémon psychological changes under different environments, researching wild Pokémon psychological cognition and changes toward ecological zones, etc.

But this was... island construction!

After writing several pages eloquently.

Johan briefly reviewed it and felt satisfied.

Then...

Teacher Johan changed pens, using the same handwriting to write "Approved" in the final column and signed his name.

Steven: "..."

What an eye-opener.

Self-filling project applications and self-approving?

Left hand to right hand?

"Help me give this application to Elite Four Glacia later." Johan coughed lightly.

After all, Elite Four Glacia was still serving as Hoenn League's "financial manager."

Financial power was certainly tempting, but those dense numbers were daunting.

Johan felt perhaps his other student Penny might be a good choice, just unsure if her father Peony would agree to Penny working for Hoenn League after graduation.

"I'm going?" Steven pointed to himself.

"You understand this area better than me."

Steven took the document and couldn't help looking skyward.

Actually, in other Leagues, Champion and Elite Four duties weren't so numerous, because besides Champion and Elite Four forming the military structure, Leagues also had presidents and directors forming administrative structures.

But in Hoenn League, this "administrative structure" was more like a subsidiary system to Champion and Elite Four.

Mainly because there wasn't a strong League president.

Like in Galar region, with strong League Chairman Rose, the Champion's authority was much smaller, so Elite Four assistance wasn't needed.

Facing such a strong chairman, Peony, who already had conflicts with him, couldn't stand it and resigned from Champion position.

This situation only improved after the Eternatus incident when Rose fell and Leon took over.

In Paldea region, Nemona served as both League Chairman and League Champion, with more concentrated authority.

More commonly was like Kanto League.

Chairman and Elite Four jointly handled affairs - Chairman responsible for administrative matters, Elite Four responsible for battle affairs and dangerous events requiring combat.

Sinnoh League was similar to Hoenn League.

This was why Sinnoh League's Elite Four Bertha, like Elite Four Glacia, desperately needed more "workhorses."

"Overtime Lucian" emerged accordingly.

Speaking of which League was most relaxed for Champion or Elite Four, definitely Kalos League.

Kalos League's chairman wasn't strong, but Kalos League's former Champion and Elite Four weren't strong either - more like a clocking-in work cooperation model.

So...

If someone strong and power-loving served as Champion in Hoenn League, it would be extremely satisfying.

Like being a country's prime minister, controlling both military and government.

People like Johan...

Actually more suited to Kalos League's "leisurely style."

But overall, in the Pokémon world, truly few people were enthusiastic about power.

Mainly because though the Pokémon world had constant minor disasters, there were no truly powerful opposing forces. If there were powerful enemy countries comparable to entire Leagues, or multiple ones, things would be different.

"Teacher Johan!"

"Champion Johan!"

"Champion!"

Walking through League headquarters building, everyone who saw Johan greeted him respectfully and politely.

The "Champion Road" was the most orthodox Champion inauguration "ceremony," and Johan's "Champion Road" demonstrated his extreme strength, earning everyone's heartfelt respect.

Johan smiled and nodded in response to all greetings.

"My face is getting stiff."

After leaving the League building, Johan rubbed his cheeks.

But just as he left the building, alarm sounds suddenly rang throughout, red warning lights flashing in every corner.

Hm?

Level one alert?

Johan looked back at the lobby, where originally composed League staff immediately became tense, quickening their movements and pace.

Just became Champion two days ago and already encountering level one alert?

Johan's cheek twitched.

Then his phone rang.

The caller ID showed Elite Four Glacia.

"Johan." After answering, Glacia's serious voice came through.

"What happened?" Johan couldn't help asking.

What major incident could occur in Hoenn region?

"Command center." Glacia said. "Come see for yourself!"

Call ended.

Johan took a light breath, sighed, and quickly walked toward the command center.

"Champion Johan!"

"The Champion's here!"

Seeing Johan push through the door, command center staff and League officials visibly relaxed.

This was the difference between a League having a Champion versus not.

With Champion present, the backbone was there. Champion represented not just a position, but a League's highest combat power.

Steven, Phoebe, Sidney, and Glacia were all currently in the command center.

"What's wrong?"

Johan didn't bother with pleasantries, walking to the group while asking.

"Teacher, it's Groudon and Kyogre..." Steven's expression was serious.

"Display the scene footage." Glacia told staff.

Groudon and Kyogre?

Johan was stunned.

Then on the command center's large screen, he saw live-filmed footage of a Hoenn region sea area.

The entire sky was divided into bright and dark halves - one side with dense clouds and heavy rain, the other with blazing sun and intense light.

On the sea surface.

One side had turbulent waves rolling dozens of meters high, atop which a blue-headed, massive fish-like Pokémon looked menacing.

Wasn't that the fat-headed fish, Kyogre!

On the opposite side.

The sea had rising water vapor and churning magma, with a colossal being half-submerged knee-deep in the ocean - the flightless Groudon!

"Groudon—!!!"

"Kyogre—!!!"

The two directly faced off on the ocean.

After all, this wasn't some anime, game, or manga where after plot resolution, these two would never clash or conflict again.

Hoenn region wasn't small, but truly speaking, wasn't that large either.

Even counting sea area, the possibility of these two giants meeting existed.

For Hoenn region.

The biggest trouble was probably these two who inevitably fought whenever they met.

Glacia said gravely: "For a while, Groudon and Kyogre hadn't encountered each other. Don't know how they met again this time."

Legendary Pokémon Groudon and Kyogre in the vast ocean - Hoenn League couldn't conduct real-time monitoring.

Though Groudon couldn't fly, its swimming ability... was surprisingly good.

After all, it once slept in underwater caverns.

Listening to Glacia's explanation, Johan's face showed embarrassment.

They hadn't met before because Kyogre had been active in Alola region's waters.

Later Johan beat it up and sent it back to Hoenn.

Just didn't expect them to meet so soon after returning.

Technically, this was his fault.

Fortunately they met at sea with no surrounding islands or land, otherwise several small islands sinking would be considered light.

Need to establish rules for these two...

"Johan, can you still contact Rayquaza? Or other legendary Pokémon?" Glacia looked at him, asking.

"Regardless, we should stop these two from fighting, otherwise they might affect all of Hoenn." Steven said.

Phoebe and Sidney nodded, Sidney also abandoning his casual attitude: "Elite Four Drake is on scene, but he alone can't handle these two giants."

Even without Primal Reversion, Groudon and Kyogre's power was beyond most trainers' ability to face.

Johan exhaled lightly.

"I'll handle it."

No one objected.

Last time Kyogre and Groudon clashed, Johan could be said to have resolved it.

"Are you planning to summon Rayquaza? The black and white dragons? Or..." Glacia couldn't help asking.

"No need."

Johan showed a confident smile.

"No need?"

Everyone was stunned.

"I am—"

Johan turned, striding toward the command room door.

"Champion!"

"Ka-kaah~!"

Gengar cooperatively emerged from shadows, holding the cloak representing Hoenn League Champion, draping it over Johan's shoulders.

Cloak fluttering, Gengar followed closely behind.

Everyone looked at each other.

Somehow, they suddenly felt... very reassured, as if the problem was already solved.

Phoebe's eyes filled with admiration.

This was... Champion!

Hoenn League's helicopter flew over the vast ocean.

The sea surface was turbulent, one side with dark clouds, the other with clear skies, forming a sharp light-dark boundary.

"Teacher Johan, why not fly directly?"

In the cabin, Phoebe asked curiously.

At Teacher Johan's Dragonite's speed, no helicopter needed, right?

"Don't ask."

Johan pulled open the cabin door with a "whoosh," nearly stumbling out, saying darkly.

Steven's face showed an understanding smile.

He knew his teacher's "characteristics."

"Dragonite!"

Johan threw a Poké Ball, summoning Dragonite.

"Dragonite—"

Leaping onto Dragonite's back, he flew toward the two giants below preparing to fight.

Steven, Phoebe, and Sidney also summoned Pokémon and descended.

"Kyogre!!!"

Massive water flows gathered before Kyogre.

"Groudon!!!"

Groudon showed no fear, roaring angrily as scorching firelight flickered.

Just as they were about to really fight.

"Groudon, Kyogre!"

Johan riding Dragonite descended from above, shouting loudly.

"Groudon?"

"Kyogre?"

Hearing the familiar voice, Groudon and Kyogre looked toward Johan in unison.

Splash—

The water flow before Kyogre dispersed, the flames before Groudon also scattered.

"Groudon..."

Groudon looked like a child caught by parents after making a mistake, showing embarrassment and scratching its head.

Kyogre looked at Groudon, then at Johan, the turbulent sea gradually calming, surging waves slowly subsiding.

"Groudon, Kyogre, we need to talk."

Johan released friendly aura, conveying his intent.

"Groudon?"

"Kyogre?"

Groudon and Kyogre looked at each other.

Next second both showed disdainful, mocking expressions.

Talk with this fat-headed fish (flightless guy)?

Johan's smile remained: "I'll treat you to food."

While speaking, Dragonite also descended.

Meanwhile, Phoebe, Sidney and others descending together couldn't help exchanging glances.

Really calmed down?

Last time when Groudon and Kyogre caused disaster, communication wasn't this easy.

Now they'd become so "reasonable"?

If Rayquaza, Groudon, and Kyogre - these three dangerous beings - all established good relationships with Teacher Johan, wouldn't Hoenn region become completely stable?

Everyone saw surprise in each other's eyes, then looking down again, they froze.

Ninetales had appeared beside Johan, standing on frozen sea surface.

And Kyogre and Groudon had both obediently... come onto the ice?

Moreover, a table was set before Johan with Gengar beside it...

"Tea-brewing?"

Phoebe looked stunned, watching Gengar use Polteageist and Sinistea to brew tea for Groudon and Kyogre!

The table also had energy cubes, macarons, Poffins and other treats.

Seeing this, everyone had the same thought - Teacher Johan's tea party?

After eating some food.

Groudon and Kyogre lowered their voices, describing the cause of this conflict.

Actually no real cause.

These two giants were fine when not meeting, but once they met, no reason needed - just fight.

The entire "conversation" lasted a long time.

Finally, Johan produced a map of Hoenn region, then used a pen to draw a line centered on Kanaz City or his island, dividing all of Hoenn into upper and lower halves.

"From now on, the upper half is Groudon's activity range, the lower half is Kyogre's activity range."

As "mediator," Johan directly assigned activity zones to the two legendary Pokémon.

"Groudon..."

"Kyogre..."

This made both Groudon and Kyogre dissatisfied. They were legendary Pokémon, indeed having decent relationships with Johan for whatever reasons.

But that didn't mean Johan could act like a "boss" and directly designate their activity ranges.

But Johan's words weren't finished.

He pointed his pen at his island, then said:

"Additionally, I'll periodically hold 'tea parties' on the island, sharing delicious food like this time, with naturally larger quantities."

Hm?

Hearing this.

Groudon and Kyogre simultaneously stated - you're the boss, you decide.

"If you encounter disputes and troubles again, come near this island and I'll help resolve them, but no private resolution allowed. You understand my meaning."

Johan's attitude was quite firm this time.

No choice.

If Groudon and Kyogre fought every time they met... he'd really be busy.

Moreover, from Johan's understanding of these two, they'd definitely conflict when together, wouldn't rationally comply just because someone set rules or mediated.

Rayquaza had "mediated" so many times, beating them down each time, yet these two still continued fighting when they met.

So, simply assign them zones.

As for "Teacher Johan's tea party" expenses, naturally League would bear them.

Maintaining Hoenn League stability - such burden was far less than funds needed to restore Hoenn region damage.

"Take these with you."

Johan produced two exquisite devices - positioning trackers!

"Don't break them. With these I can find you immediately and notify you both about 'tea party' timing."

Hearing this, Groudon and Kyogre's eyes began sparkling, carefully storing these relatively tiny devices.

For the League, the hardest part was precisely locating Groudon and Kyogre's positions.

Knowing their whereabouts could prevent many incidents.

"Alright, dismissed."

Johan clapped, announcing the end of this "emergency tea party."

Groudon and Kyogre looked at each other again, then simultaneously snorted and turned away, heading toward their assigned zones.

After the two giants calmed down and surrounding seas and skies recovered.

All Hoenn League personnel who witnessed the process sighed in relief.

Good that they didn't fight.

After Groudon walked some distance on the sea surface, it suddenly heard sounds behind.

"Tyranitar!"

Old Johan's family Tyranitar was swimming, showing its dark green head, swimming toward Groudon.

"Groudon?"

Groudon looked puzzled.

It recognized Tyranitar - wasn't this the one that snatched weather control from it for a few seconds during its first awakening?

And learned its Precipice Blades!

"Tyranitar—"

Tyranitar created a sand platform beneath its feet, approaching Groudon under its puzzled gaze.

Then...

Thud thud thud—

Box after box of energy cubes were placed before Groudon.

"Groudon!"

Seeing these energy cubes, Groudon's eyes brightened with disbelief.

"Tyranitar!"

Tyranitar grinned, right fist hitting left chest, then pointing at Groudon with a "you understand" look.

"Groudon!"

Groudon mimicked, right fist hitting left chest, pointing at Tyranitar.

Understood, brother!

A thought arose—

Though Johan seemed fair before, he was still favoring me! These delivered energy cubes were proof of "friendship"!

"Groudon~"

Brother come here, let me tell you, Precipice Blades should actually...

Meanwhile.

"Ka-kaah~ gurgle gurgle gurgle~"

Deep in the ocean, Kyogre preparing to find a resting place was found by Gengar.

Like with Groudon, Gengar playfully produced masses of energy cubes from shadows, placing them before Kyogre.

"Kyogre?"

Kyogre immediately realized—

The wise adapt to circumstances. Johan still valued me! Last time I admitted fault, this time he's secretly "favoring" me. Should have joined Johan earlier!

Thinking this, its eyes rolled twice.

How did Groudon establish good relations with Johan?

Wasn't it because of Tyranitar and Groudon's relationship? Groudon could teach Tyranitar Precipice Blades, so what about itself...

What? Johan had no Water-type Pokémon?

No problem.

Anyway, its Origin Pulse was energy utilization, and this Gengar was also skilled in energy attacks.

Johan's Gengar was already unreasonable - being slightly more unreasonable had what problem?

Thinking this.

"Kyogre—"

Gengar, let me tell you, energy actually...

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar's eyes rolled craftily, immediately understanding Kyogre's meaning, seriously "discussing" with it.

It had long felt its giant Shadow Ball, though powerful, had questionable continuity.

Small Shadow Balls could be released continuously, but not large ones.

Kyogre's Origin Pulse shooting six light beam bursts like a revolver was quite good...

Once again calming Groudon and Kyogre, preventing their near-fight.

More importantly.

Assigning them activity zones and placing tracking devices on both.

This finally allowed Hoenn League to monitor both legendary Pokémon's positions in real-time, preventing future crises.

For such results, Hoenn League personnel felt not just relief but surprise.

Johan finally left League headquarters, returning to Kanaz City.

"Really most comfortable at home."

Johan lay on his bed, comfortably closing his eyes.

Ding dong—

Doorbell rang.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar immediately stuffed the small Shadow Ball it had just formed into its mouth, making a muffled "bang" sound, floating to the door and peeking out its head.

After confirming the visitor, it playfully opened the door.

The visitor was Penny.

Sonia and Penny came to Hoenn to study together.

However, during summer vacation, Sonia returned to Galar region due to tasks and projects assigned by her grandmother Professor Magnolia, while Penny stayed since going to Galar wasn't better than staying in Hoenn.

Usually when free, she'd help at the café.

Or sit alone in corners, tinkering with her computer.

Her group of Eevees had become one of the "signatures" of Johan's café.

When Johan previously considered utilizing Penny's talents for Hoenn League financial matters, he'd contacted her.

"What's wrong, Penny?"

Johan emerged from the bedroom, seeing Penny's somewhat heavy expression, asking after brief confusion.

Since coming to Hoenn, Penny's introverted, taciturn nature couldn't be said completely improved, but had gotten much better. Usually her face occasionally showed smiles, and she spoke slightly more.

Penny, carrying her Eevee backpack and holding a small laptop, pursed her lips and walked to the coffee table.

Setting down the computer and opening it, she lightly tapped the keyboard.

Displaying a chat window.

Contents between Penny and her sister Peonia.

The last message was from Peonia - "We're in trouble!"

Hm?

Penny looked at Johan, hesitating before saying: "Teacher, I'm worried about them."

Speaking of which.

Recently when Johan visited Crown Tundra, whether at Freezington, Crown Shrine, Giant's Bed, or Split-Decision Ruins, he hadn't encountered Peony and Peonia.

He'd assumed Peony and Peonia had finished investigating Crown Tundra.

After all, Champion Peony's strength was there, so he didn't think much of it.

But now it seemed...

Peonia's message timestamp was three hours ago.

When Johan was handling the Groudon-Kyogre incident.

Penny's fingers tapped the keyboard again.

Displaying a Galar region map with a red dot marked in Crown Tundra.

"This is sister's last message location, but now..."

She pressed enter - the red dot disappeared.

"I can't track their location, and they haven't contacted me for a long time. This was the most recent."

Penny bit her lips, worry evident.

Johan gently patted her head twice, comforting:

"It's fine. Mr. Peony is Champion, and Champions... think about your teacher."

The comforting, joking words made Penny's expression relax considerably.

She naturally knew teacher's strength.

"I'm not worried about him, just sister... sister isn't strong."

True.

Johan inwardly agreed.

If Peony and Peonia accidentally separated, danger was possible.

"Don't worry, I have friends in Crown Tundra too. I can ask..."

Seeing Penny's eyes, Johan paused briefly, then smiled:

"Never mind, let's investigate the situation ourselves."

Penny was stunned.

"Ourselves?"

"You didn't go home to Galar during summer vacation. This time teacher will take you back for a visit." Johan's voice was gentle.

As a teacher.

Sometimes, he hadn't shown enough care for his students.

Penny wasn't like Steven, Roxanne, or Flannery - her inner self was more sensitive.

Seeing Teacher Johan wasn't joking, Penny packed her laptop, stood up, and nodded seriously.

"Mm!"

On the Champion's exclusive aircraft provided by Hoenn League.

"Mr. Peony said they'd investigate Crown Tundra, but didn't specify what exactly." Johan asked.

In games, Peony said he'd investigate legendary Pokémon in Crown Tundra, but was often possessed by Calyrex for communication, making Johan initially think Peony wanted to investigate Calyrex.

However, after contacting Calyrex and asking about Peony, he learned... Peony hadn't disturbed Calyrex's slumber.

And when Calyrex just awakened from sleep, despite possessing "omniscient" abilities, it actually didn't know much about things it didn't focus on.

"Supposedly, a... legendary Pokémon from legends."

But regarding Johan's question, Penny didn't know much either.

Legendary Pokémon - there were many in Crown Tundra.

Calyrex was legendary, the Regis were legendary, Galarian forms of the three legendary birds were also legendary.

Honestly.

Besides Calyrex, few others should pose major threats to Peony, right?

Couldn't be the sword-shield duo, right?

Those two weren't even awakened yet.

Once at Crown Tundra, asking Calyrex would reveal everything.

With Calyrex having recaptured the black and white steeds and restored its power, it should know Peony and Peonia's whereabouts.

# 720: Calyrex's Prophecy and the Metal Ruins (Two-in-One Chapter)

Misty fog combined with white snowy mountains - everywhere was pure white.

Coming to Crown Tundra for the second time, Johan was already familiar with it, while Penny was filled with curiosity about this world completely covered in ice and snow.

Her father and sister came here to explore and investigate?

Getting off the train, Johan didn't enter Freezington but headed straight for Crown Shrine.

In the vast Crown Tundra, finding two people would be no different from finding a needle in a haystack.

Asking Calyrex was the fastest and best choice.

"Let's go, we're heading to the mountaintop." Speaking while stepping on thick snow with "crunch crunch" sounds, Johan walked ahead.

Beside him, Ninetales followed.

Penny didn't speak, just silently followed behind Johan.

A Poké Ball at her waist opened by itself, and a Glaceon landed on the snow.

"Glaceon~"

Glaceon obviously loved this environment, and when it saw Johan's Ninetales, its eyes immediately brightened, calling softly as it quickly ran to Ninetales' side.

"Oowoo~"

Ninetales' eyes curved slightly, its tail gently stroking Glaceon's head.

They were obviously familiar with each other.

"Glaceon~o(〃'▽'〃)o"

Glaceon's face reddened slightly, looking happy.

For it, Ninetales was like a legendary "goddess" - someone it admired and tried to approach and learn from.

Heading upward.

Even with Ninetales and Glaceon present, Crown Tundra still had many powerful Pokémon, and accidentally entering their territory inevitably caused some conflicts.

After all, Crown Tundra was to Galar region what Mt. Coronet was to Sinnoh region.

However, after witnessing Ninetales' or Glaceon's power, most wild Pokémon would obediently retreat.

Ninetales needn't be mentioned.

Even without borrowing the "Fairy Plate's" power, its strength had reached Champion level peak. With the "Fairy Plate" and daily energy intake, training, and battles, it would surely undergo qualitative change.

Penny's Glaceon was actually quite strong too, already surpassing ordinary Gym Leader main Pokémon strength.

This made Johan once again sigh at Penny's talent and ability.

Such strength at such a young age - at minimum she'd be Elite Four level in the future...

Eevee Elite Four?

That would be quite interesting.

Neighing—

When Johan and the others reached the mountainside, suddenly two high-pitched horse neighs came from above.

Then.

They saw two supremely magnificent horse-like Pokémon, one black and one white, one treading on snow and one galloping through mist, racing toward them.

Hoofbeats rapidly approached.

Clop clop, clop clop—

Noticing these two Pokémon, Glaceon and Penny's expressions immediately changed.

"Legendary Pokémon?!"

The legendary aura was unconcealed. Penny and her Glaceon immediately felt tremendous threat and pressure, showing careful and wary expressions.

But she wasn't particularly nervous inside.

After all, standing beside her was the man called "Legendary Pokémon Man," someone who could calm Groudon and Kyogre's conflict with just a few words - her teacher, Hoenn League Champion, Teacher Johan!

"Ka-kaah?"

Hearing the commotion, Gengar emerged from Johan's shadow, looking at the two galloping horses before immediately cupping its hands around its mouth like a megaphone, shouting loudly:

"Ka-kaah—"

Then vigorously waving hello.

Hm?

Seeing Gengar's reaction, Penny and Glaceon were both stunned.

Then they noticed not only Gengar, but Teacher Johan and Ninetales also showed no tension or seriousness.

"Don't worry." Johan smiled. "They're old friends."

These two horses, one black and one white, were naturally Calyrex's two beloved steeds, legendary Pokémon Spectrier and Glastrier!

Old friends?

"Ka-kaah~"

Suddenly.

Gengar mischievously floated up, flying toward Spectrier and grabbing the black reins hanging from Spectrier's body in mid-air, then with extremely skilled and synchronized movements, flipped onto Spectrier's back and pulled the reins.

Neighing—

Spectrier's front hooves raised high, neighing loudly.

Ghost and steed as one!

Gengar grinned, holding the reins and controlling Spectrier as it descended below.

Meanwhile.

Glastrier, carrying swirling snow, slowly stopped before Johan. The rolling blizzard quickly calmed as it stamped its hooves, snorted, and lowered its head submissively.

"Long time no see, Glastrier, Spectrier."

Johan reached out to pat Glastrier's neck. The white mane that should have been bone-chillingly cold became soft and cool without any cold sensation.

Checking his pocket.

He pulled out an ice radish.

Glastrier immediately rejoiced, taking it in one bite and "crunch crunch" eating it up.

Johan also took the opportunity to grab the reins, flipping onto Glastrier's back and gently stroking the white mane on its neck.

"Good boy~"

Glastrier snorted, concentrating on eating the ice radish.

Penny and Glaceon beside them, watching Gengar riding Spectrier and Teacher Johan mounting Glastrier, couldn't help thinking—

There are only wrong names, never wrong nicknames.

Truly worthy of being "Legendary Pokémon Man" Teacher Johan.

Johan extended his hand toward Penny, smiling: "Stop dazing, let's go."

Penny's cheeks reddened slightly as she lowered her head, grasping Teacher Johan's hand. With a pull, she also sat on Glastrier's back.

Glastrier snorted disapprovingly again.

It was willing to be ridden by Johan, but that didn't mean just anyone could sit on its back...

But this newly expressed displeasure was eliminated after Johan stuffed another ice radish in its mouth.

Neighing—

As Johan and Gengar pulled the reins, Spectrier and Glastrier reared their front hooves and ran toward Crown Tundra's mountaintop Crown Shrine.

"Ka-kaah~"

Sitting on Spectrier's back holding the "bond reins," Gengar appeared very excited, relying on Spectrier's fast speed to run around in the sky, having a great time.

"Ghost and steed as one..." Johan shook his head with some teasing.

Previously when Gengar's strength hadn't reached legendary level, borrowing the "bond reins" and Spectrier's power could display quite exaggerated strength.

Now that Gengar's normal strength had already reached legendary level, combined with Spectrier, plus Mega Evolution and other enhancement methods...

His Gengar was truly becoming more and more unreasonable...

Crown Tundra, Crown Shrine.

"Johan, long time no see."

Sensing Johan and the others' arrival, Calyrex, who had sent Spectrier and Glastrier to welcome them, now stood before the dilapidated Crown Shrine waiting.

Seeing Johan, it smiled in greeting.

Penny, sitting behind Johan, inevitably looked at Calyrex with curious, surprised eyes.

This "cauliflower" seemed to be...

The wood carving she and Sonia had given Teacher Johan - its carved subject seemed to be this being before them.

Galar region's legendary ancient ruler, the god of abundance?!

But Penny's understanding of Calyrex was limited to this. She didn't even know Calyrex's specific name, just thought it looked somewhat like a rabbit and somewhat like cauliflower.

"Actually it hasn't been that long."

Johan smiled as he and Penny dismounted.

Gengar was still leading Spectrier around the sky.

Calyrex smiled, and seeing the airborne Gengar and Ninetales beside Johan, its eyes brightened.

"Grown stronger again?"

"Just lucky, just lucky."

Showing off before others was one thing, but before Calyrex... better be modest.

"This is..." Calyrex also didn't dwell on strength matters, looking at Penny instead.

"This is Penny, my student. Calyrex, might need to trouble you. The situation is..."

After briefly introducing Penny, Johan recounted their reason for coming to Crown Tundra again.

"I see..."

After hearing Johan's account, Calyrex nodded thoughtfully.

It had an impression.

Last time Johan had asked about Peony and Peonia.

But at that time it had just awakened and was still recovering, so hadn't "seen" them.

"Wait a moment."

Calyrex's eyes immediately showed psychic radiance, its deep pupils seeming to contain vast starry skies and countless world fragments.

Johan didn't speak, just waited silently.

Penny seemed to understand what Teacher Johan and Calyrex were doing, hope appearing in her eyes.

Honestly.

She and Peony weren't actually very close.

Peony and her mother had separated when she was very young. Sister Peonia went with Peony while she stayed with her mother.

Only a few years ago did she learn she had a father who was also Galar region's Champion.

But...

Penny's personality was already formed. She had no deep feelings for this so-called father.

But Peonia, whose personality was completely opposite - lively and cute - had quite a good relationship with her.

Her first Pokémon Eevee was a gift from sister Peonia, which began her love for Eevee-type Pokémon.

"Found them."

While Penny was reminiscing, Calyrex's eyes flashed as it pointed to Johan's pocket.

"Rotom, Rotom?"

Rotom Pokédex floated out looking confused.

What, what's happening?

But quickly, as Calyrex's psychic power infused it, Rotom Pokédex immediately switched to Galar region's Crown Tundra map.

"Coordinate information imported, Rotom!"

A red dot flashed on the map.

The location didn't deviate much from where Penny had previously tracked through messages.

"Navigation, Rotom." Johan immediately said.

"Understood! Beginning navigation, planning route..." Rotom Pokédex's map showed complex, intricate route lines.

But it planned for quite a while.

"Route planning complete, navigation activated, Rotom!"

"Proceed straight north one kilometer..."

Then a straight line appeared on the map between Crown Tundra's mountaintop and the coordinates.

Following the line's direction, Johan looked and his mouth twitched.

That was a damn cliff!

Rotom seemed to finally realize this, hurriedly saying:

"Replanning route! Route planning... route planning..."

Bzzt, bzzt—

Electric arcs jumped on Rotom Pokédex.

"Alright, alright Rotom, stop navigating or you'll crash." Johan quickly called a halt.

Crown Tundra had few paths to begin with, and map information was pitifully scarce. This was quite difficult for the little guy.

"Hooray, Rotom..."

Rotom immediately breathed a long sigh of relief.

That route planning had consumed ten percent of its power.

"Take Glastrier and Spectrier along. With them, there are no obstacles within Crown Tundra's range." Calyrex said.

Pausing, it looked at Johan and continued:

"That place is not peaceful."

Not peaceful?

Johan had some guesses.

After all, this seemed to be something even Peony couldn't handle.

But he didn't believe there was anything in Galar region that two Champions present couldn't handle.

Unless Eternatus revived.

But obviously even if Eternatus revived, it couldn't appear in Crown Tundra, on Calyrex's territory.

"Good!" Johan nodded, accepting Calyrex's goodwill.

"By the way Johan, how's your Snivy doing?" Calyrex suddenly asked.

Snivy?

Last time Johan had asked Calyrex to help look at Snivy, learning about Snivy's "Forest's Blessing" from Calyrex.

"It's evolved, now it's Servine." Johan smiled.

Then he took out a Poké Ball, summoning Servine.

"Servine?"

Servine's eyes were haughty, arms crossed.

"Evolution is good." Calyrex said with some relief.

Hm?

Though evolution was indeed good, but...

Why did Calyrex's words sound strange?

"Johan." Calyrex's voice suddenly became somewhat heavy. "While helping you sense your two friends' location, I saw some images."

"Images?"

"Darkness will once again shroud the land..."

Johan's heart jumped.

Darkness?

Shrouding the land?

"Darkest Day?"

Eternatus?!

"You know?" Calyrex was somewhat surprised.

"That, it shouldn't be now, right?" Johan interrupted Calyrex's words, asking tentatively.

Calyrex shook its head, making Johan sigh in relief.

Right.

Logically Eternatus shouldn't awaken now.

Though Galar region's Galar Particles were already quite active, and he'd seen Dynamax wild Pokémon appear more than once, those were just signs of Eternatus awakening.

"Within a few years, it shouldn't happen." Calyrex said.

A few years...

In a few years, it would be about time for Ash's journey.

By then Johan should have resigned as Champion and started early retirement.

"However..."

Calyrex's expression became hesitant and conflicted.

It looked at Johan seriously, taking a deep breath before saying: "As Galar's King, should I just watch that disaster descend again?"

Johan remained silent.

He actually wanted to say—

Calyrex, thousands of years ago you were Galar's King. After thousands of years, Galar region's people have long forgotten you, even...

But Johan didn't say it aloud.

He saw responsibility in Calyrex.

Regardless of whether others remembered it, it wouldn't forget its identity.

League Champions were the same, weren't they?

He himself was Champion!

Resolve Eternatus's threat in advance?

Looking at the current situation...

This would be touching Rose's reverse scale.

Angering Rose would be tantamount to declaring war on all of Galar region.

Actually.

The current Johan, though still wary of Eternatus, no longer feared and worried like before.

On one hand, due to his own strength increase. As his little ones grew stronger, even facing legendary Pokémon, even legendary first-class gods, they weren't without fighting power.

On the other hand, he had more friends. If worst came to worst, he could call more people to help.

The difference was just how much destruction and impact it would cause to Galar region.

"This matter is quite troublesome and tricky. It involves not just the 'Darkest Day' but many other aspects." Johan said.

Calyrex nodded.

"I understand. I just mean this and tell you about possible dangers. After all, I've been... out of touch with Galar region too long."

It wasn't a hothead, it was wise!

Based on observations and understanding of Galar region after awakening, it guessed...

If it went out now, it would probably be treated as a legendary Pokémon creating disaster and danger, hated by everyone.

Temporarily parting with Calyrex, Johan and the others mounted Glastrier and Spectrier again, heading toward the coordinates Calyrex provided.

Riding on Glastrier's back, holding the reins, Johan was expressionless but his mind raced.

Calyrex had sensed Eternatus's revival, even possibly "seen" those images.

Johan wasn't surprised by this.

Because this would happen anyway.

What he pondered was Calyrex's words—

Since they knew disaster would occur, must they wait for it to happen before facing and resolving it?

If it were the former Johan, he would definitely try to avoid such trouble.

But after so many events, Johan gradually understood - some things couldn't be avoided.

Especially as his strength grew, the less he could avoid them.

Because when the sky fell, the tall ones held it up, and he was now one of the "tall ones."

In that case...

"Before I lacked strength and ability, but now it's different."

Still wait for disaster to come knocking?

"Better to... give 'disaster' a house call..."

Rather than wait for disaster to erupt, better to trigger it himself. The harm caused would be less and more controllable.

This was Johan's first time actively seeking "trouble."

It had to be said, this was also change brought by changes in strength and status.

"But to deal with Eternatus, it's best to have the sword and shield dogs present - that would make fighting much easier."

After all, in original history, Zacian and Zamazenta together defeated the powerful Eternatus.

Perhaps Calyrex and other assistance were also involved.

"Moreover, with the sword and shield dogs present, their identity as 'legendary heroes' could largely eliminate negative impacts from possibly angering Rose..."

For Calyrex, Galar region residents had mostly forgotten, but for the legendary 'heroes' who supposedly saved Galar region from 'Darkest Day'...

Well, they didn't know much either.

And there were some deviations.

Most Galar region residents vaguely knew of 'heroes' who saved Galar region, seemingly humans wielding sword and shield.

This was the fault of the "credit-stealing" Galar royal family.

"So if conditions allow, first need to clear the names of sword dog and shield dog?"

Too troublesome.

Johan pressed his temples.

"If worst comes to worst, learn from Flint and just charge through." He couldn't help complaining aloud.

"Charge?"

Penny, sitting behind Johan, saw her teacher's worried expression and thought her sister and father were in great trouble, feeling somewhat worried.

Hearing Teacher Johan say "charge," she couldn't help asking.

"Uh, nothing."

Johan waved his hand.

Anyway, the biggest problem was—

Rose was Galar League Chairman, viewing Eternatus as the "savior who could save Galar's future." How could they bypass Rose to resolve Eternatus without it going berserk?

Better take down Rose too!

I choose Leon as the next Galar League Chairman - he says he'll take us to the moon! (crossed out)

Neighing—

"This is it, Rotom!"

At a snowy area in Crown Tundra's northern foothills, Rotom Pokédex stopped navigation.

The temperature here was actually much warmer than Crown Tundra's mountaintop.

According to the map, continuing north would enter a vast forest - this dense primeval forest separated Crown Tundra from true Galar region.

Passing through this primeval forest northward would reach Galar region's "starting town" Postwick.

Or Slumbering Weald!

At this moment.

Everything was plain colored, snow-white. The eye couldn't detect anything special.

"Ka-kaah~"

Then Gengar emerged from the thick snow ahead, dark purple body dotted with some snowflakes and ice crystals.

It showed an exaggerated expression, pointing beneath the thick snow.

It was ruins!

"Ruins?"

Johan was somewhat surprised.

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar returned to Spectrier's back, tightening the reins.

Neighing—

Spectrier reared its front hooves high, neighing loudly.

As its hooves came down.

Bang!!!

The ground shook slightly as large amounts of snow began collapsing and sliding, clearly about to form an avalanche.

"Neigh!!!"

Glastrier intervened then, extremely cold aura surging from its body, frigid air sweeping toward the about-to-slide snow.

In just a few breaths, the about-to-slide snow solidified again.

This was legendary Pokémon power - they could invoke nature's might, something ordinary Pokémon couldn't match.

Regarding cold air or strength, Johan's Ninetales didn't fear Glastrier and could even dominate it.

But for this about-to-collapse snow, though Ninetales could also stop it... it wouldn't appear as effortless as Glastrier.

This wasn't about strength but legendary Pokémon power.

After most snow was solidified by Glastrier and a small portion collapsed, it revealed an ancient ruins entrance.

"If it's this kind of avalanche, it could indeed trouble Peony." Johan said softly.

Ruins built from gray-white bricks, yet those seemingly ordinary bricks faintly showed metallic luster.

"Cha?"

"Tyranitar?"

Tinkaton and Tyranitar ran out on their own, looking at the ruins with different expressions.

One gripped its hammer while lightly rubbing, the other silently swallowed.

Seeing these two's reactions, you knew these bricks definitely contained metal elements and minerals.

"Show some restraint."

Johan recalled these two with their Poké Balls.

Normally it would be fine.

But don't demolish the ruins and bury her father and sister while the daughter's watching.

But then Johan wondered.

Why would these ruins' bricks contain metal elements?

One or two blocks would be fine, but seemingly every block contained quite a bit.

Clang clang clang—

Tapping lightly.

The stone bricks actually produced metal-like sounds.

"Interesting."

Perhaps this was why Peony and Peonia entered these ruins.

Peony was a Steel-type Champion after all - he'd be quite curious about ruins filled with metal elements.

Having come this far, naturally they had to go in and look.

Rumble—

The door slowly opened, very heavy with harsh metal scraping sounds.

As soon as the door opened and light entered, they saw...

A tiger-headed Lairon standing in an incredibly wide, huge hall, turning its head to stare blankly at Johan, Penny, and Gengar appearing at the entrance.

"Lairon!!!"

The slow-to-react Lairon suddenly shivered, as if startled, running toward a hole in the wall corner.

Bang!!!

But obviously the little guy panicked too much, stumbling face-first after just a few steps.

And seemingly because the floor was very slippery, it slid some distance.

Only after stopping did it get up again and run into the wall corner's hole.

That cute appearance made one want to laugh.

"Places rich in metal elements are paradise for Steel-type Pokémon." Johan said.

"So big..."

Penny stared blankly at the incredibly huge hall before them, much larger than any ruins she'd seen.

Like a dwelling built for giants.

"Indeed not small, even bigger than Split-Decision Ruins." Johan nodded in agreement.

Split-Decision Ruins sealed the ancient giants Regidrago and Regieleki - already considered large ruins, but this one was even more exaggerated.

Bang!!!

As the two entered, the door that had been pushed open a crack slowly closed.

The huge hall immediately fell into darkness.

"Gengar."

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar rubbed its finger, producing a heart-shaped flame.

Weak light barely illuminated three meters around them.

This brightness...

"Teacher, should I have Jolteon..."

Before Penny finished speaking, Gengar mischievously swallowed that flame.

Next second.

Hum—

The purple fatty became like a lightbulb, body glowing white and illuminating the entire hall.

Penny: "..."

Gengar-brand flashlight?

"Rotom! (_)"

Watching this, Rotom's eyes lit up.

What was this?

This was a top-tier fill light!

Even Johan couldn't help his mouth twitching.

"'Flash' Gengar..."

This was real flash!

Spectrier beneath Gengar felt like a lamp stand.

"Teacher, the signal is completely blocked."

Recovering, Penny looked at her laptop.

"It's fine."

In the huge hall, walls were carved with many patterns, appearing quite mystical.

Though there were many large and small holes around, probably left by wild Steel-type Pokémon, the real passage was only one, leading to unknown directions.

"Let's tour the ruins first. If we can't find them, then check these passages wild Pokémon created."

Johan spoke while walking toward the passage over ten meters high.

He also reminded:

"Penny, stay close. If even Mr. Peony finds it troublesome and tricky, this place might be more dangerous than imagined."

"Mm!"

Penny pursed her lips, staying close behind Johan.

Entering the passage.

They could clearly see obvious bite marks and scratches on both walls - traces left by wild Pokémon.

This ruins was like a buffet restaurant for Steel-type Pokémon.

"Cha~!"

"Tyranitar!"

Tinkaton and Tyranitar ran out again.

This time Johan didn't recall them since both had regained "rationality."

With Tyranitar's appearance and its tyrant aura released, many wild Pokémon with curious, malicious, or friendly intentions all stopped their thoughts and disappeared into holes on both sides.

Saving trouble.

Smooth passage.

The ruins' size exceeded expectations.

"Map creation, Rotom~ Map creation!" Rotom Pokédex diligently outlined the ruins' map.

After walking about an hour through various halls and chambers, Johan and the others reached what should be the ruins' deepest room.

"Wait."

Johan stopped Penny and the Pokémon about to continue forward.

Facing Penny's puzzled look, Johan gazed at this huge room, looking at the patterns on surrounding walls with amazement and realization.

"Unown."

"Unown?" Penny was stunned.

Johan didn't explain, muttering to himself: "If it's Unown, that would make sense..."

With Unown's bizarre, mysterious abilities, without sufficient understanding or preparation, even Champions could get lost in dreams and illusions Unown created.

"Ka-kaah!"

"Flash" Gengar suddenly pointed toward a corner of the huge room.

There, a Pokémon with metallic luster throughout its body, seeming both liquid and solid, with shoulders, palms, feet, chest, and head all appearing as various-sized nuts, stood there.

Emanating fearsome aura.

Seeing this Pokémon, Johan exclaimed in surprise.

"Melmetal?"
