# 724: Zacian and Zamazenta! (Two-in-One Chapter)

Hm?

Hearing the voice that suddenly rang in his mind, Johan was briefly stunned before immediately reacting.

Zacian and Zamazenta?

They were pleading for these two?

For these two idiots, they needed to plead?

Not appearing earlier or later, but now?

Johan looked at Gengar imperceptibly.

How could Gengar not understand Johan's meaning? Its eyes rolled craftily as it grinned mischievously.

Next second.

Bang! Bang!

Sordward and Shielbert, without any surprise, fell straight to the ground, eyes rolled back, foaming at the mouth, bodies slightly convulsing.

"Sirfetch'd!"

Sirfetch'd raised its large leek sword, and the wild Pokémon that had gathered to support it cheered at this scene.

"Sirfetch'd—"

An ethereal, melodious call rang out.

The forest seemed to tremble lightly, the already pervasive mist becoming more hazy, but before Johan and the others, the mist gradually opened a bright path.

Babbling streams, winding paths, broken ancient archways - an old altar loomed in the distance.

Two figures slowly appeared.

They had similar silhouettes that, just from their shadows, looked like two tall wolves.

As the mist slowly dispersed and their forms became clearer, Johan saw their true appearance.

On the left, covered in thick blue drooping mane with wound-like markings on its body, like a battle-scarred warrior - these "wounds" were proof of its countless battles. One of its ears seemed to be missing a piece.

On the right, covered in dark red fur that wasn't drooping but appeared sharp and angular, also with battle "wounds" and a missing piece of ear, with warrior helmet-like fur on its head.

Zacian!

Zamazenta!

The legendary heroes who defeated the 'Darkest Day,' the legendary Pokémon Zacian and Zamazenta!

What Johan often called the sword dog and shield dog.

"So it was you two talking." Seeing them, Johan showed a look of realization.

"Sorry, didn't react in time." Johan shrugged.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar also mimicked his gesture, looking at the two unconscious people at its feet and kicking them irritably.

Serves you right for being arrogant! For treating Pokémon as lowly creatures! For showing off!

Zacian and Zamazenta: "..."

The two legendary Pokémon looked at each other, both seeing some helplessness in the other's eyes.

"However." Johan spoke again, adjusting his glasses. "I'm actually curious - when they fled in panic, you appeared, but when they were bullying the wild Pokémon in Slumbering Weald, where were you?"

When saying this, Johan's tone had become slightly unfriendly.

"Ka-kaah~(▼皿▼)σ"

Gengar floated to Johan's side, putting on sunglasses and also staring at Zacian and Zamazenta.

As long as these two's answer didn't satisfy Gengar, the purple fatty truly wouldn't mind having a fight with them.

So what if they were legendary Pokémon? So what if they were legendary heroes?

If they were just empty titles, actually unable to protect the weak and instead bullying them, Gengar really wouldn't give them a pleasant face or be polite.

Tinkaton shouldering its hammer and Servine with crossed arms felt the same.

Having seen many legendary Pokémon, plus their own strength improvements, whether Gengar or Tinkaton weren't actually that afraid of legendary Pokémon anymore.

Zacian and Zamazenta looked at each other again.

They knew Johan and his Pokémon had misunderstood them.

But there was no choice...

Zacian sighed lightly, stepping forward.

A female voice rang in Johan's mind.

[We also just awakened... sensing the aura on its body.]

Their gaze fell on Tinkaton.

"Cha?"

Tinkaton shouldering its hammer pointed at itself.

Me?

Then pointed at its hammer.

Or my hammer?

Zamazenta also stepped forward, glancing at the two foaming on the ground.

Zamazenta's voice was male.

[Though we don't like them either, and this isn't their first time in this forest, but... we owe a debt to someone, and we must acknowledge it.]

When they fought against Eternatus that had released the 'Darkest Day,' the "King of People" had given them considerable help.

The "King of People" was the ancestor of Sordward and Shielbert, one of their former companions.

As for...

After a thousand years, the "King of People's" descendants becoming like this was something they hadn't expected.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar scratched its bottom, sniffed carefully at its hand, then asked aloud.

So, to repay the debt, you want to fight with me, with us?

Zacian shook its head.

[No, you spared their lives. We've done what we could, and the debt is repaid.]

Johan rubbed his chin thoughtfully.

So Zacian and Zamazenta asking him to show mercy meant sparing their lives?

That was quite a misunderstanding.

Though Johan wanted to teach them a lesson, that didn't mean killing them.

That would violate Pokémon League laws.

Moreover...

Sometimes living was more painful than dying.

"Ka-kaah~~"

Gengar also looked enlightened.

So we weren't on the same frequency.

Do you ancient Pokémon always talk about "killing"? Too cruel...

Zacian and Zamazenta: "..."

Ancient and modern times were quite different.

"Gengar, strictly speaking, you're also an ancient Pokémon." Johan couldn't help teasing.

"Ka-kaah?! Σ(°ロ°)"

Zamazenta spoke gravely:

[To answer your other question - if we were awake and saw their behavior, we would definitely stop it. This has nothing to do with debts, it's a bottom line.]

That was acceptable... Johan nodded inwardly, his impression of the "two dogs" improving considerably.

Zacian and Zamazenta walked before Johan and Gengar.

Zacian lowered its head slightly.

[Respected Arceus...]

"Just call me Johan. This is Gengar, Tinkaton, Servine." Johan introduced simply.

After brief hesitation, Zacian nodded.

[Johan, we sense the 'Darkest Day' may descend again. We... request your help.]

"Zamazenta..." Zamazenta growled softly, also lowering its head to meet Johan's eye level.

"The 'Darkest Day'? Calyrex's premonition was right." Johan said thoughtfully.

[Calyrex?]

Zamazenta was stunned, then asked seriously: [Has it awakened and recovered?]

"That's right."

Hearing this, both Zacian and Zamazenta showed slight relief.

[That's wonderful news!]

After the fierce battle with Eternatus, whether they or Calyrex had fallen into long slumber.

Now hearing Calyrex had awakened and recovered, as former battlefield companions, Zacian and Zamazenta were happy.

"So your current state... sorry."

After apologizing, Johan gently waved his hand in front of him, his palm passing directly through Zacian and Zamazenta's bodies without any sensation.

Zacian and Zamazenta's forms briefly distorted before returning to normal.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar's eyes lit up, curiously extending its hand to pass back and forth through the two legendary Pokémon's phantoms.

"As expected, you haven't recovered."

Zacian nodded.

[Therefore we hope you can help us prepare for the 'Darkest Day' that may appear again soon.]

"Have us help repair your sword and shield?" Johan already had some guesses, so asked directly.

[Yes.]

As Zamazenta nodded, its body shifted slightly, revealing the altar behind them that wasn't shrouded in mist.

On the altar, among withered branches and fallen leaves, the decayed, rust-covered sword and shield lay quietly.

"Cha?"

Tinkaton's gaze was immediately drawn to the sword and shield, directly shouldering its hammer and passing through Zacian and Zamazenta to reach the altar.

Johan, Gengar, and Servine also walked over.

Zacian and Zamazenta didn't speak, silently following behind.

Rustle—

Tinkaton waved its hand to brush away the covering leaves and dust, fully revealing the decayed sword and shield.

"Cha..."

Tinkaton smacked its lips.

Fine metal, such a waste leaving it here...

"Meltan! Meltan!"

Meltan stuck to the hammer chimed in agreement, waving its arms excitedly.

Melt them! Melt them!

Zacian and Zamazenta's foreheads broke out in cold sweat.

Melt... melt them?

This was somewhat different from expectations?

"Ahem." Johan coughed lightly. "Tinkaton, we're repairing them, not melting them."

If the former Zacian and Zamazenta were independent Pokémon.

Then in that battle against the 'Darkest Day' thousands of years ago, taking up sword and shield, they had already fused with this sword and shield.

This was similar to how Calyrex needed to ride its two beloved steeds to fully display its power.

The difference was.

Glastrier and Spectrier were alive, while the sword and shield were inanimate objects.

Given more time, Zacian and Zamazenta might slowly recover from the post-battle exhaustion seal, gradually reactivate the sword and shield, and regain their power.

But they weren't sure if the 'Darkest Day' would give them such time.

So.

If the sword and shield could be repaired first, their power could also feed back to Zacian and Zamazenta, allowing them to awaken from the seal early.

"Cha..."

Repair...

Tinkaton had an epiphany.

This was also its specialty!

"Meltan! Meltan!"

Specialty! Specialty!

Johan shook his head, picking up the decayed sword and shield from the ground, holding the sword in one hand and shield in the other.

Honestly.

Slightly heavy, but lighter than expected, and being rusted and decayed, there was no mystical feeling.

Suddenly.

A thought stirred in Johan's mind.

Aura!

The aura in his body immediately flowed through his arms into the sword and shield under his guidance.

Hum—

The sword and shield in Johan's hands trembled lightly, two phantoms emerging from them, showing their original appearance.

Hm?

Seeing this, both Zacian and Zamazenta looked puzzled.

This...

They both felt the sword and shield's power seemed to be activated.

Johan nodded with understanding.

As expected, with aura, he could more or less activate some of the sword and shield's power.

On the other side.

Sordward and Shielbert, foaming and lying on the ground, seemed affected by the sword and shield's power or aura, actually struggling to open their eyes.

They looked toward the altar.

Seeing Johan holding the sword and shield, they were also stunned.

A ray of sunlight, without mist obstruction or forest leaves blocking, shone down, leaving an orange gentle beam in the air that fell on Johan.

At this moment, he was holding sword and shield.

This moment.

The first thought in Sordward and Shielbert's minds was... Ancestor! Their great ancestor! The King of Galar, King of People!

That figure overlapped with their ancestor's statue in their memories.

That's right!

It was their ancestor!

Who else besides their ancestor could simultaneously wield sword and shield and display their power?

Great ancestor...

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar suddenly appeared beside them, somewhat surprised they had awakened.

Did I go easy? Or had it been so long since hypnotizing humans that I misjudged the force?

Immediately gave each another Dark Void.

Their legs kicked hard, eyes rolled back, foaming at the mouth, falling unconscious again, worse than before.

Gengar clapped its hands, nodding satisfactorily.

This time, don't expect to wake up for three to five days, and might leave some unpleasant aftereffects when they do.

Meanwhile.

The sword and shield phantoms faded, returning to their decayed, rust-covered appearance.

"Originally they should look like this. You've seen the molds for these sword and shield." Johan told Tinkaton.

"Cha~"

Tinkaton nodded with realization.

So it was that sword and shield.

Decayed like this, couldn't recognize them at first glance.

Then Johan said to Zacian and Zamazenta: "We'll try, but can't guarantee."

And still didn't know how long repairing these sword and shield would take.

Anyway, it was what Tinkaton was passionate about.

[Al-alright...]

Only then did Zacian and Zamazenta react, subconsciously nodding.

"Cha~"

Tinkaton took the decayed sword and shield, placing them next to its hammer. With two "clangs," the sword and shield attached to the hammer.

Seeing this, Zamazenta's eye twitched.

"Then we'll go first."

Johan brought Tinkaton and Servine away from the altar, mist spreading again to cover it.

Zacian and Zamazenta walked toward two decayed statues on the altar's other side, slowly approaching them.

[Sister, our sword and shield, they won't...]

Zamazenta looked back toward where Johan and the others left.

[Should... not be that bad...]

Zacian said hesitantly.

Leaving the altar, with mist covering behind them again, the previously mist-shrouded Sirfetch'd and wild Pokémon seemed not to notice what had happened.

They only cheered after seeing Sordward and Shielbert defeated.

"Sirfetch'd!"

After excitement and joy, Sirfetch'd quickly walked before Johan, eyes burning with intense battle desire.

Please battle me!

It looked at Gengar, Tinkaton, and Servine with burning eyes, as if seeing rare treasures.

Challenging the strong was its lifelong pursuit.

Its earlier fearless behavior against Sordward and Shielbert, protecting Slumbering Weald's wild Pokémon, and desire to challenge the strong all earned Johan and Gengar's respect.

"Servine!"

The usually proud Servine stepped forward, beckoning to Sirfetch'd.

Even Servine acknowledged Sirfetch'd's attitude, considering it a worthy opponent.

Moreover, in terms of strength...

Though Sordward and Shielbert themselves lacked ability, their Pokémon had real strength. Sirfetch'd defeating them one against two showed it had at least Elite Four main Pokémon strength with rich battle experience.

Make your move!

"Cha..."

Tinkaton sighed regretfully.

Busy with sword and shield, Servine got there first.

"Sirfetch'd!!!"

Hearing this, Sirfetch'd bowed solemnly, then took up sword and shield.

Be careful!

As soon as it finished speaking, Sirfetch'd unhesitatingly launched an assault, grasping its long sword and quickly rushing Servine, the large leek sword slashing out.

Fury Cutter!

The Bug-type move Fury Cutter had base power of only 40, but consecutive hits would double the move's power until reaching a terrifying 160!

This showed Sirfetch'd's battle experience and judgment were quite good.

Facing Grass-type Servine, Bug-type moves were undoubtedly an excellent choice.

"Servine!"

Servine remained calm, quickly retreating while two vines extended from behind, lashing toward Sirfetch'd.

Bang!!!

Vine and large leek sword collided, separating immediately.

The other vine was blocked by Sirfetch'd's leek shield.

"Sirfetch'd!"

Sirfetch'd wasn't affected by the vines in its charge. It judged Servine was definitely best at special attacks, and close combat was optimal against special attackers!

Fury Cutter!

Servine's eyes narrowed slightly, taking a deep breath. The previously shot vines actually passed over Sirfetch'd, wrapping around tree trunks behind it.

Next moment.

To Sirfetch'd's surprise, the retreating Servine suddenly stopped on the ground, then using the vines' contraction, counter-attacked at even faster speed.

Close combat?

Sirfetch'd was delighted.

Gripping its large leek, it slashed out.

Fluorescent green leaves appeared on Servine's arm, quickly extending into a leaf blade.

Leaf Blade!

Bang—

The sharp leaf blade and straight large leek sword collided head-on.

Both Pokémon flew back from the opposing forces.

Sirfetch'd used its body control to stumble two steps and stabilize.

Its expression was somewhat surprised, looking down at its large leek sword, which actually had a slash mark - nearly cut in half!

Wasn't it supposed to be a special attacker?

It had seen Servine's previous Leaf Storm - such power...

It also knew swordsmanship?

Servine used two vines wrapped around tree trunks to land on a branch, expression equally serious.

This Sirfetch'd's strength was truly formidable.

As for swordsmanship...

When Ceruledge and Kartana practiced swordplay, watching a few times could always teach something.

Though not learning everything, just picking up some basics was enough for occasional use.

On a nearby rock.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar grabbed a handful of popcorn and stuffed it in its mouth, then handed the bucket to Johan beside it.

Johan looked at the popcorn, confirmed there was no chili added, then pinched a few pieces and tossed them in his mouth.

"No wonder Servine always watched Ceruledge and Kartana practice swordplay - turns out it learned Leaf Blade."

When Servine hadn't evolved yet, in its Snivy stage, it actually relied on its speed and flexible vine use for close combat.

Only later developing Leaf Storm, plus its "Contrary" ability and this species' original traits, did it gradually shift toward special attacks.

But forgetting physical attacks entirely wasn't realistic.

Probably would end up with a dual-blade style.

A more reliable dual-blade style than Gengar's.

"Cha~"

Tinkaton took the popcorn, ate two pieces itself, and fed one to Meltan.

"This feels like watching an action movie..." Johan laughed.

"Servine!"

After testing Leaf Blade, given the current distance between them, Servine wouldn't insist on close combat, immediately glowing.

Rustle—

Surrounding forest leaves rustled.

Leaves scattered and swirled, gathering toward Servine, spiraling into a tornado and roaring out.

Leaf Storm!

"Sirfetch'd!"

Here it comes!

Sirfetch'd's expression immediately became solemn, dark red Fighting-type energy gathering on its large leek sword and leek shield.

Detect!

Boom—

The tornado-like storm swept over. Sirfetch'd held its leek shield high, large leek sword flailing, constantly producing clanging sounds of sharp leaves colliding with the sword, accompanied by flying sparks.

By blocking with the leek shield and precise cutting with the large leek sword, Sirfetch'd actually completely blocked Servine's Leaf Storm!

Of course.

As the price.

Sirfetch'd's shield was cut to tatters by sharp leaves, though its large leek sword, imbued with more Fighting-type energy, remained intact.

Looking at its large leek, Sirfetch'd's expression was serious.

Continuing like this, its large leek wouldn't hold up.

In that case...

"Sirfetch'd!!!"

Sirfetch'd suddenly raised its large leek sword, eyes showing faith, reverence, and fervor.

Large leek! Grant me power!

Hum—

Brilliant light bloomed on both Sirfetch'd and its large leek sword. It leaped high, holding the sword like a lance and hurling it with all its might.

The lance was like a shining meteor, cutting through the air toward Servine.

"Servine!"

Servine's eyes flashed with surprise. That locked-on feeling made it seem impossible to dodge, realizing this was Sirfetch'd's ultimate move.

Meteor Assault, Sirfetch'd's signature move, also one of Fighting-type's most powerful secrets!

If it couldn't be avoided.

Then there was no need to dodge!

Servine lowered its head slightly, holding its breath...

Rustle, rustle—

Forest leaves shook violently, wave after wave of green energy gathering toward Servine as if summoned, rolling energy and leaves weaving together into a tornado storm.

Leaf Storm!

Servine's special attack had reached its peak.

Plus Slumbering Weald's assistance, its current power...

Rumble—

The rolling storm spiraled and surged, a brilliant lance advancing frantically through the tornado, fierce winds and rapid rain, the lance emerging like a dragon.

Point breaking surface - Sirfetch'd was confident.

"Servine!"

Well done!

Servine called out, brilliant light bursting from its body.

Surrounding forest leaves quickly sprouted and grew, fresh tender leaves rapidly emerging, surging with tremendous vitality that then quickly fed back.

Point breaking surface was good.

But if the surface was too hard, it couldn't be broken easily!

Maximum power, Leaf Storm!

Boom!!!

Leaves instantly swept all areas, power immediately skyrocketing. Sirfetch'd's piercing lance met tremendous resistance, though still advancing like breaking bamboo, but...

Sharp leaves like a meat grinder shredded Sirfetch'd's large leek sword to powder!

And Leaf Storm.

Swept over Sirfetch'd.

Boom—

"Ptui ptui ptui—"

Gengar spat out leaves mouthful by mouthful, its popcorn bucket completely covered in thick leaves.

"Ka-kaah!"

The purple fatty irritably turned to look behind, seeing Johan holding it, blocking the Leaf Storm's aftershock.

Seeing Gengar now covered in leaves like it had become a Grass-type Pokémon, Johan couldn't help laughing.

While laughing loudly, his eyes also showed some undisguised surprise.

Servine and the "magical berry" trees on his island, using Giga Drain and "Contrary" ability feedback through the fruit trees, promoting their growth while also growing itself.

This inspiration from Tapu Bulu's method was actually applied by Servine in battle.

Using "Forest's Blessing" and this positive feedback burst allowed Servine to completely overwhelm Sirfetch'd.

This was something even Johan hadn't expected.

So sometimes they really needed to let his Pokémon fight freely on their own, battle worthy opponents - they might gain unexpected rewards.

Johan could barely imagine how much Servine's strength would improve after evolving into Serperior.

"Sirfetch'd—"

Sirfetch'd eagerly offered a plump berry to Servine.

"Servine!(▼皿▼)"

Servine glanced at it sideways, distancing itself from Sirfetch'd and sitting beside Johan.

Seeing this, Sirfetch'd immediately wilted like a defeated soldier.

Even its newly acquired large leek sword and nearby leek shield wilted.

It looked to the sky with tearful eyes.

"Sirfetch'd..."

Heartbroken...

Servine: "..."

"Servine!(#｀皿)"

Weirdo!

Servine turned its head away, not looking at this Sirfetch'd that became so eager after being beaten up.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar somehow appeared beside Sirfetch'd, directly putting an arm around its shoulder.

"Sirfetch'd!" Sirfetch'd looked wary.

I'm not interested in males! Especially male ghosts!

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar irritably slapped its head, then eyes rolling, lowered its voice.

I want to make a deal with you!

"Sirfetch'd?"

Deal?

Gengar pointed at the large leek sword in Sirfetch'd's hand and the leek shield beside it, then at itself.

Look, you have leeks, I have connections. You give me your leeks, I'll help sell them. We'll split fifty-fifty - ninety-ten, I take ninety, you take ten. How about it?

"Sirfetch'd!!!" Sirfetch'd immediately jumped up.

Holding its large leek sword with both hands.

This is a leek, this is faith! Faith can't be measured by money!

"Ka-kaah!" Gengar remained calm, waving its hand.

Fine, fine, seventy-thirty for me!

"Sirfetch'd!"

Deal!

Sirfetch'd shook Gengar's hand.

It had grown a whole field of leeks anyway, but couldn't use them all itself, other Pokémon didn't eat them, and if only it ate them...

Felt like they were getting pickled.

"Ka-kaah~()σ" Gengar pointed at Sirfetch'd.

You thick-browed honest-looking one, didn't expect such "heavy" thoughts.

"Sirfetch'd, sirfetch'd, sirfetch'd~" Sirfetch'd laughed loudly, looking quite pleased.

Gengar also laughed, just somewhat "craftily."

Johan nearby couldn't help shaking his head.

Making deals with Gengar?

Gengar took seventy percent without contributing anything, still acting like Sirfetch'd got a good deal - truly being sold and helping count the money.

"Sirfetch'd, you really won't come with us? On my island, I could specifically set aside land for you to grow leeks." Johan asked with a smile.

"Sirfetch'd!"

Hearing this, Sirfetch'd solemnly shook its head.

Its gaze swept around Slumbering Weald.

The Pokémon here need me more!

"I respect your choice."

Johan didn't force it - originally just a tentative invitation, but Sirfetch'd's persistence was quite heartwarming.

Just a shame to lose "emergency rations."

"Please help throw these two guys out." Johan glanced at Sordward and Shielbert still on the ground.

"Sirfetch'd!"

Sirfetch'd patted its chest, the raised fur on its back slowly settling, feeling like it had somehow dodged a "disaster."

"Champion Peony... Mr. Peony?"

Galar region, Hammerlocke City. Leon, looking hurried, unexpectedly encountered Peony, Peonia, and Penny just leaving the station.

"Leon?"

Seeing Leon, Peony was also surprised, then laughed heartily:

"Here to spar with Raihan again?"

"No." Leon also smiled. "I heard Teacher Johan came to Galar and is in Postwick. I'm going to find him for a battle!"

"Johan."

Peony wasn't surprised by Leon wanting to challenge Johan - very fitting for Leon's personality.

So he said seriously: "He's very strong."

"I know." Leon nodded. "I watched Teacher Johan's 'Champion Road.' I want to confirm how big the strength gap between Teacher Johan and me is."

He wondered if he still qualified to make Teacher Johan summon that Eevee...

"What about you, Mr. Peony?" Leon asked. "I heard you went to Crown Tundra exploring."

Hearing this, Peony's expression immediately became serious.

His expression change surprised Leon while making him serious too.

"I'm investigating the recent inexplicable Galar Particle dispersal."

Leon was stunned.

"Investigation? Hammerlocke City?"

"That's right."

Leon also took the inexplicable Galar Particle dispersal very seriously.

He stepped closer, lowering his voice: "Any leads?"

Peony looked at Penny.

Penny pursed her lips, saying: "Hammerlocke City's energy output data has problems."

# 725: Nebby and Guzzlord! (Two-in-One Chapter)

"Time to slip away."

On the Champion's aircraft traveling from Galar region to Alola region, Johan leisurely drank coffee.

Anyway, Peony's lead had been temporarily planted.

With Peony's personality, plus Leon's personality, they might be able to investigate Rose and Eternatus's situation.

Then they could use a more legitimate method to "handle" the Eternatus incident.

Of course, there was also the prerequisite of repairing Zacian and Zamazenta's sword and shield.

With the Warrior of the Sword, Warrior of the Shield, and even Calyrex as main forces, he and his Pokémon could just cheer from the sidelines.

However, repairing the decayed sword and shield wasn't a matter of one or two days according to Tinkaton.

On one hand, the decay was indeed severe - just removing the rust and corrosion would take considerable effort.

On the other hand, whether the sword or shield, the materials used were very special - not just any metal could repair them.

The best method was naturally to use those metals produced by Meltan after absorbing the remnants from Melmetal's split in Tinkaton's possession as repair materials.

As for the Iron Plate material fused in the sword and shield, no replenishment was needed since Iron Plate fragments wouldn't rust and were quite well preserved.

But...

Everything else was manageable.

Getting Tinkaton to hammer metal into its hammer was absolutely no problem, but getting it to give up acquired metal was like making Gengar spit out food - difficult.

Especially when the situation wasn't extremely urgent.

And even if Tinkaton was willing, it first had to familiarize itself with these Melmetal metals' properties and conditions, first fusing part into its own hammer.

Then Meltan could also produce more Melmetal metals through absorption.

Since it required time and was the same anywhere, Johan naturally brought his little ones to Alola.

Having promised Lillie and Lana to return and continue teaching until summer vacation ended, he had to keep his word.

Moreover...

In terms of environment, no matter how protected Galar region was, it couldn't match Alola region with only a small portion developed.

Clang! Clang! Clang—

"Tinkaton, take it easy. We're on a plane - don't punch a hole through it." Johan couldn't help his cheek twitching at the "clang clang clang" sounds, reminding it.

Having finally become Champion and applied for an aircraft, he couldn't afford to pay for damages.

Recently Tinkaton was excited every day, even exhilarated.

Getting two Iron Plate fragments and considerable Melmetal metals meant it was either forging or on the way to forge every day.

"Speaking of which..."

Johan rested his chin on his hand.

"The sword and shield materials are almost identical to Tinkaton's hammer materials after this, so Tinkaton's strength..."

Would probably gain massive improvement like Zacian and Zamazenta, right?

Johan's expression was strange.

His Pokémon really were getting weirder one by one.

There were those that grew stronger by gnawing diamonds and meteorites, like Tyranitar.

Those that grew stronger through energy exchange with special plants, like Servine.

And others like gnawing charcoal, sleeping, sensing earth's energy...

Now confirmed was one that grew stronger by forging.

Each more outrageous than the last, each more unreasonable.

Looking at it this way...

Gengar had become the most "normal"?

Good grief.

"Ka-kaah?"

Noticing Johan's gaze, Gengar raised its Polteageist and grinned at him.

Want some?

Johan quickly shook his head, looking away with a self-deprecating smile.

He must be crazy to think Gengar was "normal."

All the abnormality in Johan's family started with Gengar.

"Cha!"

Hearing this, Tinkaton wiped its forehead and nodded, telling Johan to rest assured - its forging skills were... invincible!

Clang!!!

Crack—

As the hammer fell, a crack appeared in the cabin.

Johan's expression immediately changed.

"Cha~ Cha~"

Mistake, mistake~

Tinkaton laughed sheepishly, quickly producing ordinary metal to repair the crack.

"Meltan~ Meltan~"

Mistake, mistake~

Meltan mimicked, saying the same.

Johan: "..."

Actually, Johan found Meltan quite strange too.

Logically, he hadn't captured this little thing, but as long as Meltan attached to Tinkaton's hammer, it somehow didn't prevent him from recalling Tinkaton into its Luxury Ball.

As if Meltan could merge with Tinkaton's hammer.

It was fine normally, but if during battle he threw a Poké Ball and summoned both Tinkaton and Meltan, would that be legal or illegal?

Others summoned one Pokémon per Poké Ball, while he summoned two...

Alternative version of "Parental Bond"?

Tinkaton mom, Meltan baby?

"About to arrive at Alola's Melemele Island, Rotom!"

Rotom driving the aircraft announced through the speakers.

Sunshine, beaches.

Melemele Island's scenery was still beautiful, just the summer sun was a bit too harsh - a moment's inattention could cause sunburn.

So the beach was almost empty now, with any people hiding under umbrellas.

"It'll be fine when the sun starts setting."

Johan already had "experience."

Changing into standard Alola attire, wearing a sun hat, riding a bicycle, after parking the aircraft in Professor Kukui's backyard, Johan headed to the Alola Pokémon School.

"Teacher Johan!"

"It's Teacher Johan!"

Just riding into school, students recognized him, casting admiring, awed, respectful gazes.

Clearing the "Champion Road" and displaying powerful legendary-level Pokémon were reasons for their admiration.

Throughout the Pokémon world, countless students and trainers had made him their idol, their goal and direction for effort.

"Teacher Johan?!"

Similarly hearing the commotion, Mallow and Lana, who were active on the playground, trotted over.

Like other students, both were filled with reverence for Johan.

"Why aren't you in class? At this time..." Johan checked his phone. "Shouldn't you be having Pokémon Basics?"

Hearing this, Lana lowered her head while Mallow said:

"Teacher Johan, you don't know - Professor Kukui hasn't returned to school for two days. Recently all our classes have been taught by Principal Samson Oak alone, and he can't handle it all by himself."

"Two days without returning to school?" Johan was stunned.

Even if establishing Alola League consumed Professor Kukui's energy, given his personality, he shouldn't neglect school for League construction, right?

Professor Kukui knew these school children might be Alola's future.

Otherwise he wouldn't be one of the school's only two teachers, much less invite Johan to teach temporarily.

"Seems like something important happened." Lana said softly.

"Something important?"

"That day we saw Professor Burnet come find Professor Kukui. He was still teaching class but immediately announced self-study and left." Mallow said.

Hearing this, Johan rubbed his chin twice.

Seemed something important really happened - leaving in the middle of class.

"Let me ask."

Johan stepped aside to call Anabel.

The call connected quickly.

"Hello? Teacher Johan, you're back in Alola?" Anabel's voice carried strong joy.

But the background sounded quite noisy.

"What's wrong? Are you battling?" Johan heard the commotion, asking.

"Yes."

Anabel didn't deny it, getting straight to the point: "Teacher Johan, please come quickly. A powerful Ultra Beast has invaded, and we're... having trouble handling it."

Powerful Ultra Beast?

Besides Buzzwole, Kartana, and Naganadel, the powerful Ultra Beasts were probably just Pheromosa and Guzzlord, right?

The others.

Like Blacephalon, Xurkitree, Nihilego - these could only be called special in ability, not necessarily that strong.

"I understand."

Coming to Alola region and immediately having "work" - life was really getting better... Johan complained internally, hanging up.

Anabel quickly sent coordinates.

"You two go back and study properly, don't wander around outside." Facing Mallow and Lana's curious and somewhat eager gazes, Johan's expression became serious.

The situation's scale was still uncertain.

But bringing two kids would definitely be inconvenient.

"Understood..."

Mallow pouted but had to agree.

Johan turned his bicycle around. "Rotom, navigate to coordinates."

"Understood, Rotom! Navigation starting!"

The coordinate location was on Melemele Island, so no aircraft needed.

"Go straight, continue straight, Rotom!"

On the vast Melemele Sea, a bicycle traveled on ice at high speed.

Johan's expression was speechless.

Really let Rotom have fun navigating, riding freely on the sea surface.

Ninetales followed beside the bicycle, continuously freezing a winding crystal ice path on the sea surface for the bicycle.

The coordinates Anabel sent Johan were on a small island outside Melemele Sea.

No wonder though they were on the same Melemele Island, Mallow and others knew nothing about what happened.

Soon.

An island slowly appeared in view.

This island had solid, massive reefs on three sides, with only one side directly touching the sea, facing away from Melemele Island.

If battle erupted here, as long as it wasn't too large-scale, it indeed wouldn't affect Melemele Island.

However.

As Johan approached, they heard commotion - "bang bang" sounds coming from the island.

Quite a commotion.

Seemed the battle was intense.

With some curiosity, Johan rode his bicycle around the massive reefs to the island's other side.

He saw.

On the barren island, Anabel, Professor Kukui, Island Kahuna Hala, and numerous Melemele Island Captains, International Police, League Police, even Aether Foundation battle team members.

They each brought their Pokémon, battling in rising dust.

Even at the island's edge was a ship with Pokémon Center markings - a "medical ship."

Three Nurse Joys with their Comfey, Blissey, and medical staff were busy on the ship, treating wounded in time.

"Such a big operation..."

Honestly.

Even Johan was seeing such a large operation for the first time, even medical backup so complete - completely ready for war.

Given this scale, he could almost determine what opponent made Anabel and others so serious.

"Guzzlord—"

Fierce roaring came from the island.

Then, vacuum-like hurricane winds swept surrounding dust, rocks, even Pokémon's moves into a fierce maw!

As dust cleared, the source of commotion appeared in Johan's sight.

An incredibly massive body like a dark, heavy pumpkin with an enormous yellow mouth, even two hands extending from that giant maw.

It also had numerous bat or vampire elements - wings, cape-like hard black exterior skin, accompanied by intense malice and overwhelming presence.

Indeed.

Guzzlord!

Using Anabel's UB Taskforce numbering, this should be UB-05: Glutton!

"Guzzlord!!!"

Guzzlord roared skyward, its mouth-like hands grabbing nearby rocks and tossing them into its mouth.

With "crunch crunch" sounds, rocks were like candy in its mouth.

Moreover, its actions and behavior completely ignored the trainers and Pokémon on the island.

But if any Pokémon dared get too close or attack it, Guzzlord didn't mind swallowing that Pokémon or their moves whole.

Direct attacks couldn't avoid Guzzlord's mouth, side attacks couldn't break its incredibly hard skin.

This wasn't fighting an Ultra Beast - this was clearly team raiding a Boss, the ultimate kind where damage dealt couldn't match its recovery rate.

"Careful!"

Shouts came from the island.

Guzzlord's suction forced surrounding trainers and Pokémon to retreat, avoiding being drawn in.

When Guzzlord chewed, they attacked again, but effects were minimal.

"Teacher Johan?"

Nurse Joys on the medical ship noticed Johan arriving by bicycle, calling out joyfully.

Johan smiled and waved, while approaching the island and asking:

"Nurse Joy, what's the situation?"

The three Nurse Joys saw Teacher Johan's sunny smile, blushing slightly.

But still explained:

"We don't know clearly either. Supposedly it's UB-05: Glutton with abnormally powerful strength that suddenly descended on Melemele Island. Director Anabel and Kahuna Hala took great effort to lure it here."

"But this guy's too strong. Ordinary Pokémon attacks either can't cause damage or get eaten by it."

"But we can't not attack, otherwise this guy goes berserk and runs around. It once went into the sea and nearly ate all the nearby coral and wild Pokémon..."

The three Nurse Joys explained the general situation one by one.

"Thank you."

Johan, having passed the medical ship, waved thanks.

Through the three Nurse Joys' words, he understood the situation.

This Guzzlord wasn't originally here - it was deliberately lured here to reduce damage to Melemele Island.

Continuous attacks weren't just to defeat this Guzzlord, but because without attacks as "food," Guzzlord would rampage seeking food.

Were you trying to defeat it or charging it up?

Constantly feeding Guzzlord moves was like "raising" it.

After two days, this Guzzlord's "Beast Boost" ability was probably maxed out.

But couldn't blame Anabel and others.

No choice.

Guzzlord Ultra Beasts were like this, especially those coming through Ultra Wormholes with already powerful strength.

Attacks were ineffective, but not stopping it would cause immeasurable destruction.

Leaving this Guzzlord alone might soon turn Melemele Island into "Ultra Megalopolis" - destroyed by one Guzzlord.

One sufficiently powerful Guzzlord could completely destroy an island single-handedly.

"Teacher Johan!"

The Nurse Joys' calls also caught the island trainers' attention.

Finally landing on the small island, Anabel immediately came over.

Anabel didn't waste words, getting straight to the key points.

"Two days ago, Poni Island's Poni Canyon, the Altar of the Sunne suddenly showed activity. A strange Pokémon appeared on the altar, and we brought it to Melemele Island's research facility..."

"Wait, wait."

Johan quickly raised his hand. "Altar of the Sunne? Strange Pokémon?"

Seemed the Nurse Joys didn't know enough - how did this involve the Altar of the Sunne and other Pokémon?

"A... cotton candy-like, tiny, very cute little one." Anabel showed Johan photos on her phone.

"Nebby?!"

Seeing the photo, Johan instinctively exclaimed.

"Nebby?" Anabel looked puzzled.

Johan waved his hand.

"Scientific name 'Cosmog,' a very... rare Pokémon."

He didn't explain much about "Nebby's" name and origins since it would take too long.

But Nebby's appearance made Johan pensive.

Altar of the Sunne?

The so-called "Nebby" was actually the initial form of Alola region's legendary Pokémon Solgaleo and Lunala - Cosmog.

It possessed the ability to open "Ultra Wormholes" and teleport instantly.

Nebby's appearance meant...

"Teacher Johan?" Seeing Johan lost in thought, Anabel waved her hand before him.

Johan refocused. "Oh, thought of something else. Continue."

Anabel nodded seriously:

"We brought little, Cosmog back to the research facility. Professor Burnet discovered Cosmog seemed to possess power to trigger 'Ultra Aura,' but before we could experiment, this guy suddenly appeared near the research facility."

"Not from an 'Ultra Wormhole'?"

"No."

Anabel's expression was serious. "If an 'Ultra Wormhole' opened, with our current research information and equipment, we should be able to detect it. This guy was somehow sleeping on Melemele Island."

After pausing, she continued:

"And this guy's target seemed to be Cosmog. Later we prepared to transfer Cosmog, but the little one teleported and disappeared. After that..."

What happened next was roughly the same as what the Nurse Joys described.

Though Cosmog possibly opening "Ultra Wormholes" was important, Guzzlord's appearance forced Anabel and others to temporarily focus on this massive creature.

With its displayed strength, appetite, and destructive power, if left alone, not just Melemele Island but all of Alola region might be devoured - just a matter of time.

They never knew such a powerful Ultra Beast lurked on Melemele Island.

Though puzzled why this guy had been quiet before...

Obviously now wasn't the time to think about such things.

After listening, Johan clicked his tongue twice, saying softly: "If this guy was lured to 'Bear Forest,' there probably wouldn't be so much trouble."

"What?" Anabel didn't hear clearly.

"Nothing."

If it were Urshifu, it could probably beat it down before maxing "Beast Boost." Now though...

Johan looked at the massive mountain-like Guzzlord. Though many reasonably strong trainers and Pokémon were around, those attacks... were just feeding it.

Only Kahuna Hala and a few of Anabel's Pokémon could pose slight threat to Guzzlord.

Some, but not much.

"With maxed 'Beast Boost,' this reached legendary level, right?"

"Beast Boost" ability let Ultra Beasts continuously strengthen all abilities except HP during battle.

Logically it should only boost one stat.

But sometimes Ultra Beasts didn't follow logic, like this Guzzlord.

Anabel smiled bitterly. "Probably... really is. Initially 'Glutton' wasn't this exaggerated, but to lure it to this island..."

No choice either.

Couldn't blame them.

This Guzzlord had obviously been on Melemele Island for a long time. Without opening "Ultra Wormholes," they couldn't send it back.

Using Beast Balls to capture required defeating it first.

"Let me try." Johan said.

"Good!" Anabel was immediately delighted.

With Teacher Johan here, they could relax.

In the "Champion Road," Teacher Johan's Gengar and Ninetales displayed legendary-level strength, shocking everyone.

Someone online said Teacher Johan might break the League's youngest legendary trainer record.

Johan didn't care much about this since he knew Red and Blue were already traveling.

"Guzzlord—!!!"

Guzzlord roared loudly, mouth opening wide.

Gastro Acid!

"Careful!"

"Energy attacks! Energy attacks!"

"First unit, retreat! Retreat!"

Every time Guzzlord swallowed something, it showed furious emotions. If needs weren't immediately satisfied, it would attack randomly or begin indiscriminate feeding.

But as Guzzlord's awakening time lengthened, its displayed strength and appetite improved tremendously.

Even with medical ship support, they could barely hold on.

"Snow? It's snowing?"

"Weren't we using Sandstorm tactics? How come nobody announced switching to snow?"

"Can snow fill its stomach?"

Suddenly falling snow and plummeting temperature surprised surrounding trainers.

"Snow can't fill its stomach." A figure emerged from hazy snow with an Alola-characteristic Ninetales beside him.

"But snow can freeze its stomach!"

"Oowoo—"

Ethereal howling rang out.

The previously "gentle" snow instantly became violent, fierce winds carrying large snowflakes as surrounding temperature rapidly dropped.

Six-petaled ice crystals appeared on rocks and sand, even water vapor in the air blooming into beautiful geometric snowflakes.

Blizzard!

Terrifying snow forced everyone to distance themselves.

"This is..."

"Teacher Johan?!"

"Teacher Johan? Champion?!"

"Champion!"

In the blizzard, Johan stood smiling.

"Thank you all for your hard work. Leave the rest to me."

Boom!!!

The blizzard exploded, scattering crystal fragments. That massive dark-skinned mountain-like Guzzlord, that powerful and violent being, was now...

"Fro-frozen?!"

Whoosh—!!!

Only those who truly witnessed this Guzzlord's power, saw it treat energy, moves, attacks as food and swallow everything, could understand its strength.

And the helplessness facing such a fierce Pokémon.

And now.

This Guzzlord actually didn't swallow the snow and blizzard but froze!

This meant it was definitely effective attack!

Worthy of Teacher Johan!

Everyone had this thought.

Crack—

But next second.

A crack appeared in the ice covering Guzzlord.

The crack grew larger, spreading numerous spider-web fine cracks nearby.

Oh no!

Boom—!!!

Ice shattered, snow mist flying.

"Guzzlord!!!" Guzzlord roared in pain, venting its anger freely.

Hum—

Light pink mist suddenly spread toward it.

Guzzlord instinctively opened its mouth to eat the pink mist, but after one taste, it spat out disgustedly.

Misty Terrain!

Ptui!

"Ninetales, Nature's Madness!"

"Oowoo—"

A palm-sized pink plate appeared above Ninetales' head. It crouched on all fours as earth's veins gathered with surging life energy, Ninetales' aura visibly rising.

"Ka-kaah~"

While Guzzlord was disgusted and angry, and Ninetales gathered plates and Nature's Madness, Gengar appeared before Guzzlord, waving at it.

"Guzzlord—gulp!"

Guzzlord was about to roar again when Gengar tossed it an energy cube.

Hm?

"Ka-kaah?" Before Gengar appeared floating Sinistea and Polteageist. The little fatty poured cups for itself and Guzzlord, making an inviting gesture.

Shall we chat?

However.

After tasting the energy cube, Guzzlord completely ignored Gengar and directly bit at it.

"Guzzlord!!!"

"Ka-kaah..."

Seeing this, Gengar sighed regretfully, shrugging at Guzzlord.

Gave you a chance, but you couldn't grasp it.

Bang—

Gengar along with its Polteageist and Sinistea all dissolved into black mist.

Next second.

In Guzzlord's vision appeared a brilliant orb emitting moon-like radiance.

Hm?

Moon?

Eat it!

Giant mouth opened and closed, swallowing the Moonblast from Ninetales whole.

Surrounding trainers had strange, complex expressions.

Because next second.

Rumble!!!

The just-closed giant mouth suddenly opened wide again, brilliant light bursting from within as its seemingly bottomless health bar instantly emptied.

Health bar deletion technique!

As a Dark and Dragon-type Ultra Beast, Guzzlord was indeed very strong, but...

4x weak to Fairy!

And being 4x weak to Fairy while catching light orbs barehanded made little difference from surrendering.

Actually couldn't blame Guzzlord since this was their species' fighting style.

Swallow what could be swallowed in one gulp; what couldn't be swallowed still had to be tasted.

So even in Ultra Space, Guzzlord were far fewer than other Ultra Beasts, but those existing were mostly quite strong.

Because weak ones mostly fell during the "tasting" process.

Bang—

The massive Guzzlord crashed into ruins with a "bang," mouth open with wisps of white smoke emerging.

Guzzlord's aura also became weak.

Without "Beast Boost's" exaggerated enhancement, this Guzzlord's true strength returned to Champion level.

Anabel and others knew too little about Guzzlord Ultra Beasts.

Missing the optimal timing, otherwise things wouldn't be so difficult.

But it protected Melemele Island.

Both had pros and cons.

Whoosh—

A Beast Ball flew over, landing on Guzzlord and blooming with milky white light like silk threads, drawing the massive Guzzlord inside.

"It's over?"

Surrounding trainers looked at each other.

This big guy that made them feel completely unable to handle - just like that?

So.

This was a Champion's true meaning to a region?

"I don't recommend studying this Guzzlord - it's easy to lose control." Johan seriously told Anabel, holding the Beast Ball containing Guzzlord.

"Mm..."

Though curious about Guzzlord and wanting to study it, she chose absolute trust in Johan's words.

"But 'Ultra Wormholes' don't open randomly..."

"So next we need to 'chat' about Nebby."

With Nebby suddenly appearing, was the "Radiant One" far behind?

# 726: This Boomerang Came Back So Fast? (Two-in-One Chapter)

Welcome to the large-scale "parent-child" entertainment project - Where Did Nebby Go!

Having subdued the not-too-bright Guzzlord into a Beast Ball, the crisis it brought was essentially resolved.

However, this was only temporary.

After all, according to Johan's knowledge, at Ash's "Manalo Conference," three Guzzlord appeared at once - one black original color and two white shiny variants, all extremely powerful.

One of them even directly defeated Professor Kukui's ace Lucario when he was in his "Royal Mask" identity.

You had to know that Professor Kukui as "Royal Mask" had solid Champion-level strength. Even if not among the top-tier Champions, having traveled various regions, Professor Kukui's strength was quite impressive.

This showed why Guzzlord was the most troublesome Ultra Beast besides the legendary ones.

It was only because the "Ultra Wormholes" hadn't closed yet, plus Z-moves combined with Ultra Aura could deal greater damage to Ultra Beasts, that it was knocked back into the "Ultra Wormhole."

Otherwise, the first "Manalo Conference" might not have known how to conclude.

Precisely because of this, Guzzlord's data would definitely be extremely valuable.

But considering safety, plus Guzzlord wasn't communicable like Buzzwole or Kartana, Johan still had Anabel give up researching Guzzlord.

The most important thing now was finding Nebby.

"But if that child really mastered Teleport and naively teleports everywhere, how can we find it?"

Anabel obviously understood Nebby's importance - after all, it could trigger opening "Ultra Wormholes."

But they'd barely had Nebby for any time, and Professor Burnet hadn't conducted much research yet. Locating Nebby's position wasn't easy.

"You do your attempts, I'll go ask some 'acquaintances.'" Johan said.

The Guardian Deities should know where Nebby might have gone.

"Alright." Anabel nodded.

"Oh right." Johan suddenly thought of something. "Do you have Poké Beans? Get me a few cans of Poké Beans."

Nebby was still a baby, perpetually sleepy, innocent and naive, uninterested in most foods except Poké Beans.

"Poké Beans?" Anabel was puzzled.

"I have some here." Professor Kukui said. "Usually prizes for the children."

"I have some too." Professor Burnet added. "The sweet taste is quite nice for replenishing sugar."

"Me too."

"I have some..."

With everyone chiming in, they actually gathered quite a can of Poké Beans from many trainers.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar took the can to collect them one by one, looking at the full can of colorful pretty little beans, couldn't help tossing one in its mouth.

Let me see what's so tasty about these little things.

Just putting it in its mouth, Gengar's eyes brightened slightly, smacking its lips twice.

You know what.

The taste was actually pretty good.

It tossed two more in its mouth.

Felt better than popcorn!

"Don't eat them all - they have important use." Johan irritably tapped Gengar's head.

"Ka-kaah..."

Gengar blinked twice.

Doesn't hurt~ Not one bit~

Melemele Island, Bear Forest.

Not knowing where Tapu Koko had run off to - when Guzzlord was rampaging earlier, the Guardian Deity Tapu Koko wasn't around either.

Unconsciously coming to Bear Forest.

Thinking, since he was here anyway, he'd greet Bewear first.

And see if the trio was still around.

But before reaching Bewear's tree hollow residence, passing through a dense bamboo grove, he encountered a sudden situation.

Bang! Bang!

Fruit pits traced arcs through the bamboo grove, getting smashed by a Pangoro below holding a bamboo stick.

"Garruu!"

Three Pangoro looked fierce and menacing, with several Pancham hiding behind them, vigilantly watching the treetops at the boundary between bamboo grove and forest.

There.

About twenty agile figures nimbly shuttled between branches, occasionally throwing fruit pits or even berries.

"Ka-kaah..."

So extravagant...

Seeing those thrown berries, Gengar couldn't help commenting.

"It's a group of Primeape." Johan said after seeing those figures.

"Primeape, Pig Monkey Pokémon, Fighting-type, a species that lives in stable groups with very coordinated teamwork, Rotom!"

Rotom Pokédex appeared timely, showing its presence.

But as Rotom Pokédex said, Primeape were group-living Pokémon with strong cohesion, having a "boss" in their groups responsible for coordinating everything.

Whether finding food, distributing food, competing for territory, fighting enemies, etc.

And opposing them, naturally needless to say, were Principal Oak's "signature" Pokémon, Pangoro.

Johan wasn't interested in these two groups' territorial battle - just happened to encounter it.

In the Pokémon world, especially in wild environments, competition between Pokémon was quite common, particularly for territory.

Even in cities rather than wild areas, fights between stray Pokémon over territory and turf weren't uncommon.

His own Gengar had become the undisputed "boss" among Rustboro City's stray Pokémon.

However, Johan was somewhat curious.

Logically, Pangoro's active range was bamboo groves, while Primeape's territory would definitely be in forests rich with fruit trees. How would these two groups have friction?

Primeape fighting Ambipom and Aipom over territory would be more common, right?

"Let's go."

Seeing Primeape and Pangoro about to fight, Johan pressed down on Gengar's head as it enjoyed watching excitement, preparing to leave.

"Bewear~"

Then, a familiar figure suddenly appeared in their sight.

It was "Bear God" Bewear approaching quickly with Stufful on its back.

It took quick steps, appearing between Pangoro and Primeape at extreme speed.

Then expressionlessly, effortlessly caught a Pangoro's iron fist and a berry thrown by the Primeape leader.

"Bewear!"

Bewear's appearance immediately made both Pangoro and Primeape lose their fighting spirit and desire.

Didn't expect Bewear also served as "mediator" in the forest.

"Bewear!"

Bewear waved, and both Pangoro and Primeape glared at each other before backing down and retreating.

Having ended this dispute early, Bewear obviously noticed Johan's presence long ago, appearing before Johan in quick steps.

A huge shadow completely enveloped him.

That intense pressure made Johan's forehead break out in cold sweat.

"It's... been a while, Bewear..."

Steel-like arms delivered a bear hug without warning.

"Don't! I'll break, really going to break—"

Crack—

Johan's face immediately paled, being held firmly in Bewear's embrace.

"Bewear~" Stufful also seemed happy, climbing from Bewear's back to Johan's head.

"Vii~"

Victini appeared, greeting it friendly.

"Bewear~" Stufful also happily waved at Victini.

Bewear finally loosened its arms, putting Johan on the ground with a satisfied expression, patting his shoulder approvingly - that look seemed to say:

Not bad! Worthy of someone I value - not many in this world can take my hugs!

Johan gasped deeply, feeling like he'd barely come back to life.

Helplessly twitching his mouth corner.

"Why are you here? Looking for food?" The recovered Johan asked.

"Bewear~" Bewear shook its head, pointing toward a nearby small hill, leading Johan and the others there.

Walking along, lively Stufful explained to Johan and the others why Pangoro and Primeape were fighting.

It was because of the guy hidden in that hill.

Hidden guy?

Soon.

Johan saw the "guy" Stufful mentioned.

A "bamboo" sticking its head out from the hill.

"Bamboo?"

Johan was stunned, then seemed to think of something, saying with some surprise: "Celesteela?!"

Was this the Ultra Beast Celesteela that Mamane accidentally discovered buried in this hill in the anime?

That one with an incredibly massive body and exaggerated weight, shaped like bamboo yet rocket-like launching Pokémon?

"Bewear~"

Bewear walked to that "bamboo," somehow producing a bucket of water and some berries and food, directly watering around the "bamboo."

These nutrients were quickly absorbed by the "bamboo."

"Really is Celesteela..."

Now Johan understood why Pangoro and Primeape were fighting, and what Stufful meant.

It was this Celesteela.

This was an Ultra Beast that accidentally came through "Ultra Wormholes" to Melemele Island two hundred years ago.

Where it took root and grew, it would heavily absorb nutrients from surrounding soil, preventing nearby plants from growing.

This Celesteela's rooted location was right at the boundary between bamboo grove and forest, preventing both bamboo and trees from growing normally.

So.

Pangoro thought Primeape did something bad, while Primeape thought Pangoro planted some bad bamboo.

If not for Bewear periodically watering Celesteela and providing nutrients, even fewer plants would grow nearby.

"Bewear?"

After watering Celesteela, Bewear suddenly turned, seriously looking toward the bamboo grove behind.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar also seemed to sense something, looking toward the bamboo grove.

A boy with cool golden bangs wearing sharp black practical clothing approached with a Pokémon having a huge axe on its head.

Seeing the visitor, Johan raised an eyebrow.

Brother-in-law and Type: Null?

"Bewear, he's someone I know." Johan quickly told Bewear.

Preventing Bewear from attacking directly - with Gladion's small frame, even with Type: Null, he'd definitely only end up flat against "Bear God."

"Bewear~"

Hearing this, Bewear nodded expressionlessly, but the threatening aura it unconsciously released lessened considerably.

Soon.

Hurried Gladion brought Type: Null through the bamboo grove to near the hill, also seeing waiting Johan and Bewear.

"Teacher Johan?"

Gladion seeing Johan was obviously stunned, clearly not expecting Johan to appear here.

"Long time no see, Gladion." Johan smiled warmly.

Usually known for coldness and maturity, Gladion seemed somewhat nervous seeing Johan, opening his mouth and struggling before saying:

"Long... long time no see, Teacher Johan!"

As someone who helped his sister, vindicated Type: Null, and cleared the "Champion Road" as Hoenn League's new Champion, Gladion genuinely respected and even revered him.

Not exaggerating, Teacher Johan could be considered Gladion's idol, like many young trainers - his goal to chase and become.

"Why are you here?" Seeing Gladion seemed nervous, Johan found it somewhat amusing.

In the anime, Gladion as Ash's seventh-generation rival gave Ash considerable trouble.

Among Ash's historical rivals, Gladion was also quite powerful and competitive.

But ultimately, he was still just a little kid.

"I..." Gladion looked at Type: Null beside him, gradually calming his excited emotions.

"It's Type: Null. Two days ago it suddenly became very agitated, so I brought it away from 'Aether Paradise.' After somehow searching around, Type: Null brought me here."

"Honestly... I'm not really sure why Type: Null wanted to bring me here."

"Hm?"

Type: Null brought Gladion here?

Currently Type: Null's gaze was fixed on where Celesteela's massive body was buried.

Seeing this, Johan's heart stirred.

Two days ago...

Wasn't that when Anabel said Nebby just appeared at Altar of the Sunne?

Right, in the anime, when Nebby first appeared, Gladion's Type: Null did show agitation.

Though separated by great distance, Type: Null could still sense Nebby's appearance. Now coming here, could it be...

Johan's heart moved.

He produced a Poké Ball.

"Tyranitar!"

"Tyranitar!!!"

Tyranitar in dark green heavy armor appeared roaring on the hill.

"Dig this open, keep the noise down, don't startle the guy below, and be gentle - might cause violent explosion otherwise."

Hearing this, Tyranitar's expression tightened.

Violent explosion?

Looking at Johan and confirming he wasn't joking, Tyranitar rubbed its palms together and stuffed some diamonds in its mouth.

"Tyranitar!"

Shouting twice as if cheering itself up, its claws began rapidly moving.

The small slope immediately disappeared at visible speed, and the buried Celesteela slowly revealed itself.

"This is..."

Seeing Celesteela's gradually revealing form, Gladion was stunned.

"Ultra Beast, UB-04: Blaster, Celesteela." Johan said calmly.

"This is a Pokémon that rooted here two hundred years ago..."

After simple explanation, Gladion swallowed hard. "Two hundred years? Contains large amounts of combustible gas, will explode?"

"Don't be nervous. Tyranitar's very careful, and Celesteela's personality is quite gentle among Ultra Beasts - otherwise it wouldn't have rooted here for two hundred years." Johan smiled reassuringly.

Gladion sighed in relief, nodding.

Clang!

Suddenly, a sound of claws hitting metal erupted.

Whoosh—whoosh—whoosh—

Slight breezes brushed past their ears.

Gladion slowly turned his head.

He saw...

Teacher Johan, Gengar, Bewear, and Stufful had somehow reached behind large trees dozens of meters away, lined up from top to bottom showing just their heads.

Gladion: "..."

A drop of cold sweat slid down his and Type: Null's foreheads.

Run, or not run?

"Tyranitar..."

Tyranitar held a metal rock, scratching its head.

Thought it was all dirt, but actually dug up some rare ore - profit~

Tossed it in its mouth.

Chewing while continuing to dig.

"Ahem, actually, it's quite safe." Johan and Bewear returned as if nothing happened.

Gladion: "..."

Don't know who was running so fast just now...

A small episode didn't affect Tyranitar's digging.

Soon, Celesteela revealed most of its form.

Extremely massive body, at least nine meters tall, more than twice the size of Johan's Tyranitar.

At first glance somewhat like bamboo, but completely metal "bamboo," with obvious thruster structure at its legs.

Its body was divided into three parts, seemingly unconnected in the middle yet definitely whole.

In Celesteela's massive body's central hollow part, a palm-sized little one resembling a nebula, with deep purple to light blue gradient coloring, was sleeping with closed eyes in an adorable pose.

"Cosmog..."

Seeing this little one, Type: Null's expression immediately became serious.

Even Bewear, after brief shock, became somewhat serious.

"Really here."

Johan was briefly stunned before chuckling.

This guy was the protagonist of the large-scale series "Where Did Nebby Go" - Nebby, Cosmog!

"Didn't expect this little one would hide with Celesteela."

But thinking about it made sense.

Being targeted by Guzzlord, Nebby definitely wanted to find shelter.

Coincidentally.

Though buried, this Celesteela was undoubtedly very powerful.

Moreover, being buried was better for hiding, more concealed.

Most importantly.

This was "Bear Forest" with "Bear God" Bewear's protection - even Guzzlord couldn't do anything to Bewear.

The little one might be naive, but instincts for seeking fortune and avoiding disaster remained, being formerly legendary Solgaleo.

"Pew?"

Seemingly sensing gazes, Nebby cutely rubbed its eyes twice, yawned long, then looked toward Johan and the others.

"Pew!"

Nebby's body shook.

Discovered!

Immediately prepared to use Teleport and leave again.

"Little one." But Johan called out, opening his palm to reveal Poké Beans inside.

"Pew?!"

About-to-escape Nebby immediately flashed, appearing before Johan, looking at the Poké Beans in his hand, drooling uncontrollably.

"Ka-kaah~"

Nearby Gengar had a realization.

So these candies were prepared for this little guy.

"Here."

Giving the little one a Poké Bean, Nebby immediately happily squinted, becoming very happy while chewing.

"Pew~ pew~!"

Moreover, after approaching Johan, the little one finally sensed something both familiar and strange about Johan, as if... they'd known each other long ago.

"So Type: Null was looking for this little one..."

Seeing Nebby, Gladion understood.

Couldn't help being curious about this little one.

What kind of Pokémon was this to make Type: Null react so strongly?

Or was this also an Ultra Beast?

But it looked far too harmless.

"Ka-kaah~" Gengar held some Poké Beans, "luring" the little one over.

It felt this little one was very similar to itself, very compatible.

Look, both round and cute, both purple, clearly cut from the same mold.

So Gengar thought this "little brother" had to be recruited.

With Poké Beans, plus the inexplicable familiarity about Johan, Nebby gave up teleporting away, immediately floating toward Gengar.

Then in Gengar's hands...

Got rolled round, pinched flat, shaped into various forms.

"Pew?" Nebby was completely unaware, just looking at Gengar puzzledly.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar retracted its head, black mist emerging from its body, transforming into a large "Nebby."

"Pew! Pew!"

Seeing this, Nebby immediately became excited, clapping.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar smiled as it picked up the little one.

How about it? Want to learn? Let me teach you!

"Pew!"

Having just called Anabel to tell them Nebby was found, Johan turned back to see...

His Gengar and Nebby were "transforming" together.

Only Nebby obviously wasn't as skilled as Gengar, not transforming very accurately.

But Gengar indicated... no problem!

It produced a Koffing costume, putting it on Nebby, then transformed into Weezing.

"Koffing~"

"Pew pew~"

A Nebby-version Koffing and Gengar's fat Weezing called out to Johan together.

Johan: "..."

How did it feel like just turning around once, Nebby... was completely influenced by Gengar?

"Bewear~"

Stufful also wanted to join but was held firmly by Bewear, who seriously advised—

Those near ghosts become dark, those near bears become red!

Johan: "..."

"Teacher Johan, what is it doing?" Gladion asked curiously.

"Nebby..."

Johan briefly explained some basic information about Nebby, though not elaborating on its final evolution being Solgaleo.

"So it's that Pokémon that might open 'Ultra Wormholes'!" Gladion realized.

He'd heard some intelligence about Nebby from his mother Lusamine.

"Anabel and the others are coming. This Celesteela's problem can be resolved then too."

With Nebby, they should quickly research opening "Ultra Wormholes."

Then some Ultra Beasts stranded in Alola region could successfully return to Ultra Space.

Gladion pursed his lips and nodded.

Standing aside, seemingly struggling for a while, he finally made up his mind, looking at Johan seriously:

"Teacher Johan, could you battle me?"

Battle?

Hearing Gladion's sudden battle request, Johan was stunned.

Did he... give people too deep an impression of "liking to play in baby cups"?

Gladion was genuinely a "baby," not even ten years old. Though mature in personality, but...

With his strength, even adding Type: Null, Johan felt even sending Rotom could easily sweep them.

Johan patted his head, asking:

"Why?"

"Because I want to become Teacher Johan's student!"

Hearing this, Johan didn't know whether to laugh or cry.

Who said becoming my student required battling me first?

This was some deep-rooted thinking among Pokémon world trainers - whatever you wanted to do... battle first, never wrong!

Right or wrong, battling was never wrong.

Like card players, yo-yo players, top players, racing players.

But Johan really wasn't interested in "bullying" Gladion.

He looked at Type: Null beside Gladion, smiling: "Then you're my student now. Come to Pokémon School tomorrow to register."

"Ah, huh?"

Gladion obviously didn't expect...

That simple?

Johan shrugged slightly. "Don't overthink things, kid."

Seeing Gladion seemed to dislike the term "kid," Johan continued: "I know you have ambitions, but sometimes, really don't put too much pressure on yourself. Your age doesn't need to bear so much."

Father missing, mother Lusamine alone supporting the entire family and massive Aether Foundation. Though Gladion would complain about Lusamine neglecting sister Lillie, he never complained about Lusamine neglecting himself.

In Gladion's view, he was the family's only boy, the future only man, naturally having to shoulder responsibilities for mother and sister.

"But I..."

Gladion was about to say something when Johan, sitting on the grassy hill, patted the grass beside him, indicating he should sit and talk.

After brief hesitation, Gladion sat beside Johan.

"You put too much pressure on yourself, which makes your Pokémon put more pressure on themselves too. Have you considered them?"

"Pokémon?"

Gladion was stunned, looking at Type: Null beside him.

Did I put great pressure on Type: Null?

Johan gently tapped Type: Null's metal helmet, making "clang clang" sounds.

"Was it originally like this?"

Though a question, the negative implication was obvious.

This sentence precisely struck a chord deep in Gladion's heart.

What Type: Null originally looked like, others might not know, but having witnessed it save sister Lillie, he was clear.

This wasn't Type: Null's original appearance!

However, after that incident, it was deemed a "failure" by Faba, fitted with restraints, becoming Type: Null.

"I've read Faba's materials. He didn't leave methods to unlock the restraints..." Gladion tried explaining but was stopped by Johan's smiling gesture.

"Do you think that with its and your power, you can't forcibly break the restraints?"

"Our... power..."

"You consider many things - protecting mother, protecting sister, protecting other Pokémon, becoming mature, having responsibility..."

Johan counted on his fingers.

These things weren't wrong, even excellent thoughts, but were these really things a not-even-ten-year-old kid should consider?

Comparatively, Ash seemed much more brainless.

In fact, most of Ash's "rivals" were smart like Gladion, but what were the results?

Children should act like children - be happy, cry, cause trouble, achieve merit.

Why did the League allow ten-year-olds to capture Pokémon and travel?

Wasn't it because children's innocence sometimes actually matched Pokémon's simplicity better?

Johan continued counting.

"So Type: Null also considers - should I really break free from restraints? What if I can't control myself after breaking free and hurt you and those you care about? Am I really a 'failure'..."

"Such considerations - do you think Type: Null has them?"

Gladion instinctively looked at Type: Null.

Type: Null also instinctively avoided Gladion's gaze.

This action represented many things.

Gladion's expression became complex.

So it really was my influence on Type: Null?

"Trainers and Pokémon mutually influence, learn from, and grow with each other."

Johan sighed softly, turning to look at his purple fatty, seeing...

Gengar was sharing Poké Beans with Nebby.

"Ka-kaah~"

One for you, one for me, one for me, one for me, and one for you...

See how fair I am?

"Pew~" Nebby looked at the small pile of Poké Beans before it, nodding happily.

Johan: "..."

He and Gengar were definitely "accidents"!

Looking away.

Gladion's expression kept changing.

Had to admit, Gladion was indeed smart, understanding Johan's meaning.

He suddenly stood up, looking at Johan with burning eyes - that gaze... made Johan feel somewhat like a certain fire-playing explosion-head.

His heart couldn't help jumping.

"Teacher Johan, please battle me!" Gladion said excitedly.

Johan somewhat bewilderedly produced a question mark.

Johan: "?"

Gladion clenched his fists. "Though I don't know how to do what Teacher Johan said, I understand one thing..."

"When I challenged Teacher Johan earlier, I considered too much - what if I lose, what if I can't become your student, what if I can't get your recognition. But now I know - I want to battle you, so I want to challenge. Win or lose, I want the process, not the result!"

Johan: "..."

How did it feel like a boomerang circled around and hit himself?

And boomeranged back so fast?

"Bewear~"

Bewear nearby silently gave Johan a thumbs up.

Amazing rhetoric that trapped yourself - worthy of someone I recognize!

Johan: "..."

"Look, Anabel and the others are coming!"
