# 727: Legendary, Ninetales! (Two-in-One Chapter)

"Before today's class begins, let's first welcome our new student!"

Johan stood beside the podium, lightly clapping his hands.

Below, Kiawe, Sophocles and the others looked bewildered.

New student?

"Teacher, where's the new student?" Mallow asked curiously.

Johan smiled and gestured slightly toward the door. Gladion, with his cool golden bangs, walked in carrying a small backpack with a stern expression on his face.

"Big brother?"

Seeing Gladion, Lillie was the first to cry out in surprise.

She never expected that the so-called "new student" Teacher Johan mentioned would be her own brother Gladion.

But didn't big brother dislike school and have no faith in the Alola Pokémon School?

"So it's Lillie's brother Gladion!" Mallow said in surprise.

The others had similar expressions.

Johan smiled: "Since everyone knows each other, there's no need for lengthy introductions. Gladion, please take your seat."

Although the class size was small, the classroom was large enough. Gladion sat in the back row, alone in his own row.

"The teacher had some business to attend to, so I was away for a few days. Now let's test what you've learned during this time." Johan smiled.

"No way—!"

Immediately there was a chorus of groans.

Their beloved new Hoenn League Champion, hailed as one of the important leaders of the young generation in the Pokémon world - Teacher Johan - was starting with a test again?

Only Lillie remained the most composed in the entire class. Even her brother Gladion showed some nervousness when he heard "test."

"These are all very basic questions. Lillie, please distribute the test papers."

"O-okay."

Johan discovered that he seemed to be gradually developing a liking for this feeling of arranging tests.

The students below were all scratching their heads and thinking hard, while Johan leisurely crossed his legs and sat beside the podium, flipping through the "Book of Fear."

Like Giovanni's "Mysteries of the Earth," Elite Four Agatha's "Book of Fear" always yielded different insights when read from time to time.

Time passed quickly.

When Lillie collected the test papers according to Johan's instructions, everyone's expressions were different.

Kiawe lay collapsed on his desk in despair, Sophocles clasped his hands together praying to "Celesteela," Lana had a thoughtful expression, while Mallow was biting her pen and gritting her teeth.

Gladion had a strange expression, and only Lillie remained composed.

Looking at their expressions, Johan could roughly guess how this test went.

Just as he was about to speak—

Buzz—

The space in front of the podium suddenly distorted.

Then Nebby suddenly appeared out of nowhere on the podium.

Hm?

Johan couldn't help but be stunned.

The little ones below with their various expressions were also immediately drawn to Nebby.

"What Pokémon is this?"

Except for Gladion and Lillie, the others obviously didn't recognize Nebby.

"Pew~"

Nebby yawned long at Johan, then curled up on the podium and fell asleep.

Seeing this, Johan's eye twitched. He took out his phone and sure enough saw Anabel's call coming in right on time.

"Teacher Johan—"

Before Anabel finished speaking, Johan said: "Yeah, it came to me."

"As expected."

Hearing this, Anabel immediately breathed a sigh of relief.

Following Johan's suggestion, Anabel and the others used Poké Beans to temporarily "control" Nebby, having it cooperate with some research and investigations.

At first everything went very smoothly - as long as there were Poké Beans, Nebby, who was obsessed with them, was quite cooperative.

But once Nebby ate its fill, or rather, yawned and started getting drowsy, it would directly use Teleport and disappear from the research facility.

So Anabel immediately called Johan.

As expected.

Nebby teleported to Johan's vicinity and then brazenly started sleeping.

"As long as it's not lost, that's good." Anabel sighed in relief.

"But Nebby's power really can open 'Ultra Wormholes'! And it's not the chaotic way that Faba opened them - according to Professor Burnet, it can guarantee the stability of the passage!"

When saying this, Anabel was obviously somewhat excited.

After all, since the "UB Task Force" was established, they could only deal with Ultra Beasts that suddenly appeared in the Alola region. If not for inventing Beast Balls, they wouldn't even have ways to deal with Ultra Beasts.

But even with Beast Balls, at most they could only defeat Ultra Beasts and capture them in Beast Balls, yet had no way to handle them afterward.

This was still when facing some not-too-strong Ultra Beasts. If the Ultra Beast was too powerful, like the previous Guzzlord, they couldn't even capture it in a Beast Ball.

But if they could master the technology to open "Ultra Wormholes," they could forcibly send some Ultra Beasts back to "Ultra Space." This was actually more manageable than capturing them.

Furthermore.

As a "Faller," Anabel was actually quite curious about her own origins and background. If she could enter "Ultra Space," she might be able to determine her origins.

"Don't get too excited too early, Anabel."

Johan waved his hand, signaling the little ones to study on their own first, then walked out of the classroom with his phone, saying:

"Perhaps, within 'Ultra Space,' there aren't only Ultra Beasts. What if there are also humans there, and these humans all have ill intentions?"

"Moreover, if we rashly open 'Ultra Wormholes' not knowing where they lead, it's fine if nothing happens, but what if there happens to be a group of powerful Ultra Beasts on the other side?"

Anabel was silent for a while.

Actually, what Johan said, she had naturally considered as well.

It's just...

Sometimes, you have to take the first step.

"So I've decided that I'll be among the first batch to open 'Ultra Wormholes' and enter for exploration." Anabel said.

"Don't be hasty." Johan said helplessly, "Let me first communicate with those Ultra Beast friends, then consider what to do."

Although Anabel and the others knew limited information about 'Ultra Space,' there were still Buzzwole, Kartana, and the Naganadel colony, right?

Afraid that Anabel might act impulsively due to curiosity about her background, Johan added, "This is an order."

As Chief Inspector, he was already Anabel's direct superior.

"Yes." Anabel was actually quite restrained.

"How's Celesteela doing?" Johan asked again.

"According to Professor Burnet, Celesteela has gathered enough fuel and will most likely launch tonight."

"Tonight? Got it."

Ending the call.

Walking back to the classroom, he saw the group of little ones had already gathered around the podium, carefully observing Nebby with curiosity.

Even Gladion, though he didn't come closer, kept his gaze fixed on Nebby.

Seeing Johan return, they immediately scattered like birds and ran back to their seats.

"Stop being curious. Go prepare individually - tonight I'll take you on a field trip. Aren't you all curious about Ultra Beasts? I'll take you to see them." Johan said with a smile.

"Ultra Beasts?!"

"Field trip?"

"Long live Teacher Johan!"

The little ones all became excited.

Gladion still maintained his "mature" appearance, but Johan felt that after spending time with such an interesting group of little ones, Gladion would eventually be "assimilated."

He just didn't know what it would be like when Ash came to the Alola region in the future and encountered this group of classmates and possibly "evolved" Gladion.

It would definitely be interesting.

Whoosh—whoosh—

Ceruledge's charcoal fire continuously ignited high-temperature flames, heating metal to a golden-red color, while Tinkaton worked hard nearby, sweating profusely.

With Ceruledge's cooperation, Tinkaton's metal forging speed improved significantly, and it also helped Ceruledge better master its own flames - truly killing two birds with one stone.

Ordinary flames really couldn't melt these "Melmetal metals" that Tinkaton needed.

Ceruledge's flames contained part of the "Life Fire," plus its own strength, so it could manage it.

And this was also training for its flame control.

However, with Ceruledge being pulled by Tinkaton to serve as "labor," Kartana, who had finally waited for Johan and the others to return, could only teach Servine swordsmanship on the side.

Fortunately, Servine's learning ability was strong. Even though its strength was a bit inferior to Kartana's, it still gave Kartana a great sense of accomplishment in teaching.

It couldn't help but develop an illusion.

It felt that perhaps it had the qualifications to become a "genius teacher"?

"This is 'Celesteela'? This must be 'Celesteela,' right?!"

A group of little ones surrounded the quiet Celesteela, with Sophocles almost unable to contain his excitement.

Celesteela perfectly matched the legend of "Celesteela" he had heard about, which he was passionate about.

"Shouldn't we send it back to 'Ultra Space'?" Professor Burnet operated precision instruments, looking at the terrifying gas and energy accumulated within Celesteela.

If this energy were allowed to explode, it would probably burn down all the surrounding forests, right?

This risk... was indeed quite large.

"It's fine."

Johan was quite confident.

Never mind that Celesteela was just heading toward the moon - even if it really wanted to release that terrifying energy, he was confident he could suppress it.

As for why not send Celesteela back to "Ultra Space"...

Johan had always respected the wishes of Pokémon themselves.

Although Celesteela had never communicated with him, when the moon rose, the smile that appeared on its stiff, unchanging face wouldn't lie.

It was just that smile that felt somewhat "eerie," giving people a chilling feeling.

"The moon is about to rise overhead."

A round, white moon hung high in the night sky like a white jade plate, its bright moonlight illuminating the surroundings like daylight.

Today was a full moon.

In Johan's mind, he couldn't help but think of a song.

"Ah-oh-ee, ah-oh-ee~~"

"It's coming!" Professor Burnet said in a low voice.

Sophocles and the others had already retreated to a safe distance, while Celesteela, which had been lying on the hillside, slowly straightened its body.

Buzz—

When the full moon reached overhead, at the moment when the moonlight was most brilliant, Celesteela's thrusters made sounds.

"Ninetales." Johan called softly.

"Oowoo~"

Ninetales' nine tails gently swayed as it breathed out.

Crack crack crack—

Layer upon layer of ice crystals immediately appeared around Celesteela, encircling it to ensure that the heat and energy released by its thrusters during launch wouldn't cause any damage to the surroundings.

"Ultra Wormhole!"

Suddenly, Professor Burnet's expression changed as she called out.

Anabel and the others immediately became tense.

An "Ultra Wormhole" appearing at this time?

Could there be some Ultra Beast about to emerge from the "Ultra Wormhole"?

If it collided with Celesteela, then...

"Pew?"

Nebby in Johan's arms rubbed its eyes twice, yawned, and waved toward the direction where the "Ultra Wormhole" was opening.

"Pew~ pew~"

Looking very happy.

Johan immediately understood, patting the little one's head and signaling Anabel and the others to remain calm.

Soon.

The "Ultra Wormhole" opened, and a bat-like Pokémon flew out from it, while the "Ultra Wormhole" quickly closed with its appearance.

"Lunala?!" Anabel and the others exclaimed.

After Lunala appeared, it flew directly to high altitude, "merging" with the bright moon.

Buzz—

Under the moonlight's illumination, it immediately emanated a white glow like moonlight, and Lunala's body gradually became bright and snow-white.

Full Moon phase!

Whenever I see the moon, I'll think of me!

As Lunala transformed into "Full Moon phase," the surroundings seemed to become dim, the originally bright world becoming dark and gloomy.

Even the light emitted by instruments and lamps gradually turned gray-white.

"Pew~ pew~!"

Nebby seemed very excited, waving its nebula-like hands at Lunala.

Lunala, glowing with white light all over its body, cast its crimson gaze on Nebby and nodded slightly.

For some reason, Johan felt it seemed to be nodding at him rather than Nebby.

The next second.

Buzz—

Pure white moonlight scattered down from Lunala, refracting onto Nebby.

"Pew~~"

Nebby comfortably narrowed its eyes, its body slowly floating up, and under the moonlight's illumination, it actually began emanating brilliant white light.

"This is..."

Anabel and the others, as well as the kids, all watched this scene in amazement.

"Evolution?!"

Johan looked at Lunala in the sky, then at Nebby bathed in Lunala's moonlight, understanding in his heart.

So Lunala took advantage of when the moon was brightest and fullest to come out and bestow part of the "light" to Nebby, assisting its evolution?

As everyone knew, the "light" in the Alola region was actually "Ultra Aura," which was Necrozma's power.

Whether Solgaleo, Lunala, or Necrozma, they all needed such "light" - this was their source of power.

"Oowoo..."

Ninetales beside Johan also watched this scene, observing Lunala and Nebby's use of "Ultra Aura," and a thin... radiance gradually emerged from its body.

In its snow-white fur, a palm-sized plate faintly appeared.

"Luna?"

Lunala, who was contentedly watching Nebby's evolution, was also attracted by the commotion on Ninetales, showing surprise in its eyes.

Besides them, there was actually another Pokémon that knew how to use "light," how to use "Ultra Aura"?

A thoughtful look flashed through its eyes.

Lunala, originally preparing to withdraw its moonlight, instead cast the moonlight onto Ninetales again.

Buzz—

Instantly.

Ninetales also emanated a pure white glow, just like Lunala's moonlight.

However, this moonlight wasn't concentrated at one point, but spread and extended in all directions.

The people around watched this scene in confusion and shock.

At this moment, they seemed to be in a pure white world.

The moon disappeared, Lunala's glow and Nebby's evolution light all vanished, leaving only that holy Ninetales, like a spirit of "light."

"Oowoo—"

Ninetales raised its head slightly and howled.

The power of the moon seemed to become substantial at this moment, becoming a moon that fell to earth, dispelling the surrounding darkness, its snow-white fur flowing.

This seemed to say...

"Light" was never something that belonged exclusively to any one Pokémon - it belonged to everyone!

"Mom, I think I... saw three moons..." Kiawe murmured.

At this moment.

All the residents of Melemele Island felt a light different from the sun illuminating the entire island.

"So beautiful." Lillie's eyes were full of Ninetales' image, feeling that this kind of Pokémon was so touchable.

"Is this the power between trainers and Pokémon?"

Gladion also watched this scene, looking at the holy Ninetales and Teacher Johan standing beside it with a gentle smile, thinking of his Type: Null and gaining new understanding of Teacher Johan's words.

So the power of trainers and Pokémon could really achieve things completely beyond ordinary imagination...

The pure white moonlight lasted for an unknown duration.

It could have been an instant, or it could have been eternal.

Until Lunala's glow faded and it returned to its original appearance.

It looked deeply at Johan and Ninetales, nodded slightly again, then disappeared into an "Ultra Wormhole" once more.

And the "Moonblast" on Ninetales also gradually dimmed.

"Oowoo..." Ninetales gave a low, soft cry, fatigue appearing on its face, its tails and fur drooping, but its eyes were brighter than ever.

It suddenly looked at Johan.

Meeting it were gentle eyes and a warm palm, as Johan sighed with a slight "sour" feeling:

"Our little Ninetales has grown up too..."

The little Vulpix that once hid in garbage dumps, timid beyond measure, had now reached the point where it could stand on its own.

The "Ultra Aura" absorbed from the four islands of the Alola region had completely become Ninetales' own power at this moment.

The "Fairy Plate" that hadn't been in hand for long also became "obedient" at this moment.

And Ninetales' power had completed its transformation in that instant.

Legendary!

Johan could clearly feel that Ninetales' current power had reached legendary level!

Even without borrowing the power of the "Fairy Plate," it was genuine legendary tier.

Moreover.

Johan had a feeling...

With Ninetales condensing "Ultra Aura" into itself, it might produce a Z-Crystal exclusive to Ninetales.

A... Z-Crystal that even he had never seen, matching Ninetales' "Moonblast."

Just like the "Pikashunium Z" that Ash's Pikachu possessed.

"Oowoo~"

Ninetales' head gently rubbed against Johan's palm, its dependence not weakened at all by its improvement in strength.

"You've worked hard." Johan smiled.

Perhaps when truly facing Necrozma, Ninetales could give it a big "surprise."

Lunala probably also thought of this step, which was why it gave more "light" to Ninetales.

With Lunala's glow gone and Ninetales' light faded, the full moon in the sky became bright again.

Rumble rumble—

In the rumbling sounds, Celesteela, which had been building up for so long, finally began to launch.

The surging flames were blocked by Ninetales' ice wall, and accompanied by ground tremors, it slowly rose like a rocket, moving faster and faster toward the moon.

Its face showed a satisfied smile.

Having seen three moons and about to head to the moon it had waited for two hundred years to reach, Celesteela's heart was filled with happiness at this moment.

"'Celesteela' has launched!" Sophocles shouted.

A childhood story had become reality.

The evolutionary glow on Nebby also faded, and its appearance changed considerably.

The originally nebula-shaped Nebby had transformed into a "cocoon"-like form, and its overall size had also become smaller.

The entire nebula seemed divided into three layers - the outermost golden hard shell, the middle layer resembling a nebula, and the innermost layer showing a black core, as if something was brewing within.

Nebby's face was now visible on that core, eyes closed as if sleeping.

It really had evolved into Cosmoem.

Watching Cosmoem floating down toward him, Johan's expression immediately changed.

Oh no!

Don't look at how Nebby had become smaller in both size and form after evolving into Cosmoem - its weight had reached an extremely exaggerated level, weighing over a ton!

And this was still the upper limit that the Pokédex could record, not representing Cosmoem's limit.

In the Pokémon world, the only two Pokémon whose weight reached 999.9kg in the Pokédex were Cosmoem and Celesteela.

And he wasn't Ash...

He wouldn't be crushed to death, would he?

"Cosmo~"

Cosmoem smacked its lips twice. Although sleeping, it seemed to recognize Johan, and when it landed in Johan's hands, it wasn't as heavy as expected.

Hm?

Are you also like "Mjolnir," like Tinkaton's hammer, capable of "self-adaptation"?

"Cosmo~"

Cosmoem smacked its lips twice again.

In the night sky.

The stars, which had become dim due to the bright moon, became clear again.

Stardust seemed to scatter down, gathering onto Cosmoem, making it grow rapidly in invisible ways.

"This is... the 'Star Cocoon'?"

Professor Burnet snapped out of her trance from Ninetales' previous holy moonlight and couldn't help but speak upon seeing the descending Cosmoem.

"Star Cocoon?" Anabel, Lillie, Gladion and the others looked over.

"So Nebby, no, Cosmog evolves into the 'Star Cocoon'..."

Professor Burnet murmured, then noticing everyone's gazes, explained:

"In ancient Alola, the King of Alola called it the 'Star Cocoon' and built the Altar of the Sunne to worship it."

Unlike Cosmog, Cosmoem had appeared in ancient Alola.

"So that's how the Altar of the Sunne came to be." Everyone suddenly understood.

So Nebby was a legendary Pokémon?

Cosmoem would bathe in starlight, extensively absorb dust from the atmosphere to grow, working hard to create evolutionary energy with its core.

Johan wasn't unfamiliar with these things.

Because Nebby, or rather Cosmoem, needed to go to the Altar of the Sunne and, under the ritual of the four Island Guardian Deities, activate the power in the Altar of the Sunne to evolve into Solgaleo.

At this moment, Johan also understood why Lunala had suddenly appeared to help Nebby evolve.

Probably...

Lunala had also sensed that Necrozma's awakening was imminent, and it needed Solgaleo's power to confront that powerful existence that extremely countered them.

Should they wait for Nebby to evolve into Solgaleo?

Johan stroked his chin thoughtfully.

Didn't seem necessary?

Before Necrozma had Solgaleo's or Lunala's power, it wasn't called Necrozma - it was just "UB: Black."

With base stats of only 600 points, not even comparable to Wishiwashi.

About the level of Zygarde's fifty percent power.

With his Pokémon's current strength, dealing with one "UB: Black" seemed... not too difficult?

If one of Lunala or Solgaleo got involved and was captured by "UB: Black," becoming Dusk Mane or Dawn Wings form, that would be more troublesome.

Of course, if Necrozma fully recovered and reached terrifying base stats of 754 points...

Johan would probably have to flee.

Leaving aside Eternamax Eternatus, the "Blinding One" Necrozma with base stats of 754 points was the ultimate among Pokémon.

Compared to it, Arceus with "only" 720 base stats seemed more like a tool for the plates.

Cough.

Having this thought, Johan quickly muttered "slip of the tongue, slip of the tongue" in his mind.

Arceus with a complete set of plates still reigned supreme over all Pokémon.

Moreover, Arceus had so many avatars - this world was just one of them.

However, Johan had made his decision.

He approached Anabel and Professor Burnet, saying: "Nebby is very well-behaved now and can help open 'Ultra Wormholes.' For the first exploration into 'Ultra Wormholes,' I'll lead the team."

Anabel immediately perked up.

Teacher Johan leading the team?

Perfect!

"Leave it to me!"

Professor Burnet reached out to take the sleeping Nebby from Johan's hands, but discovered...

She couldn't lift it at all!

"Haha! Leave this 'heavy lifting' to me!" Professor Kukui felt it was time to show his strength and rolled up his sleeves.

He exerted force suddenly.

Nebby didn't budge!

Hm?

"How much does this weigh?" Anabel noticed something was wrong and asked.

"Not heavy." Johan held Nebby with one hand and waved dismissively: "Just a few tons."

?!

Everyone looked at Johan with shocked gazes.

A few tons?

Just?

Even if Teacher Johan was a "Fighting Master," this strength was still...

Johan smiled without explaining.

Naturally, he wouldn't tell them that Nebby had "self-adaptation" abilities.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar on the side curled its lips.

Show off all you want - who can out-show you!

Exclusive Z-Crystal.

Gengar showed some envy - it sounded pretty awesome.

Why didn't it have one?

Although it could use Marshadow's exclusive Z-Crystal and signature move Soul-Stealing 7-Star Strike, it still felt unsatisfying.

It felt like all its exclusive Z-Crystals were "stolen."

"Ka-kaah!"

Watch me create an exclusive Z-move too!

Gengar spun its hands, and two peculiar spoons suddenly appeared in its hands.

Destiny's gift!

Transform!

The spoons in its hands slowly bent.

"Ka-kaah~~"

Gengar laughed proudly, having great fun.

Meanwhile, Anabel's Alakazam was frantically looking around, patting itself down while searching.

"Alakazam..."

Where are my Twisted Spoons?

At the same time.

Poni Island, Poni Canyon, Altar of the Sunne.

The four "missing" Island Guardian Deities were busy here.

According to Lunala, that one would probably awaken soon. Lunala would help Nebby quickly complete its transformation, and then they would need to gather the "Ultra Aura" of the Alola region to help Nebby complete its final evolution.

They had been preparing here for some time, and with just a little more, the preparations for activating the altar would be complete.

Tapu Koko and the other Island Guardian Deities looked toward Melemele Island simultaneously, also sensing Ninetales' moonlight.

It's just...

Why did they have the feeling they were about to do useless work?

That wouldn't do!

The four Island Guardian Deities looked at each other, confirming their shared thoughts.

The next day.

Johan came again to the Naganadel habitat on Melemele Island.

As the most honored guest of the Naganadel clan, surrounded by numerous Poipole, he made his way unobstructed to the massive nest built by the Naganadel.

He found the strongest and oldest Naganadel leader.

He inquired about news of Necrozma.

In the anime, Necrozma should have fallen asleep in a Naganadel clan's territory after blocking the impact of a massive meteor.

That would be the clan where Ash's Poipole belonged.

In the games, Necrozma was controlled by the people of Ultra Megalopolis and imprisoned in the Ultra Megalopolis Tower at the center of Ultra Megalopolis.

First, he needed to confirm Necrozma's location.

Ideally, he could invite a sufficiently powerful and aged Naganadel from the clan to serve as a guide.

Combined with Buzzwole and Kartana, when first entering "Ultra Space," they wouldn't be completely in the dark.

"Necrozma?" Hearing Johan's inquiry, the Naganadel leader seemed very surprised.

"If given the chance, you wouldn't want to stay in the Pokémon world forever either - you'd want to return to your homeland, right?" Johan sat on a small stool, looking at the Naganadel leader.

Brief silence.

The Naganadel leader sighed deeply.

"If given the chance, who would willingly leave their homeland?"

# 728: Ninetales, Exclusive Z-Move! (Two-in-One Chapter)

"Are you sure?"

Early the next morning.

Johan, who was washing up in the yard and had just spit out water with white foam still at the corners of his mouth, looked at Tapu Koko beside him with surprise.

An Island Guardian Deity visiting early in the morning was truly rare.

It hadn't shown up when Guzzlord was rampaging a few days ago, nor when Celesteela ascended to heaven, but now it came early in the morning?

More importantly.

Tapu Koko had brought news that it could help Ninetales condense its exclusive Z-Crystal.

"Koko~"

Hearing Johan's questioning, Tapu Koko's eyes immediately widened.

As an Island Guardian Deity, would it lie and deceive people?

Johan rinsed his mouth again, took the towel that Rotom Pokédex handed him, wiped his face, and said with some suspicion:

"What are the requirements?"

"Koko~" Tapu Koko pointed toward the southwest direction, which was toward Poni Island.

"Poni Island?"

Johan was slightly stunned, then immediately understood, "Altar of the Sunne?"

Did Tapu Koko want to "trick" him into going there to make Cosmoem evolve into Solgaleo?

But thinking again.

That wasn't right.

With the Island Guardian Deities' abilities, as long as they activated the Altar of the Sunne, Cosmoem would automatically appear at the Altar of the Sunne, without needing his so-called consent.

In the Adventures manga, after the Island Guardian Deities activated the Altar of the Sunne, Cosmoem, which was originally with Team Skull, immediately appeared at the Altar of the Sunne and completed its evolution.

Moreover...

Cosmoem had just completed its evolution last night at midnight. It hadn't even been a full day. Even if it was a legendary Pokémon, even if it had received Lunala's "light," it shouldn't be able to evolve again so quickly.

Did legendary Pokémon not follow basic principles?

"Anyway, it still needs some time to come over... and Professor Burnet and the others can't open stable 'Ultra Wormholes' that quickly either."

Johan thought to himself and nodded: "Alright, we'll go to Poni Island after we finish breakfast."

"Koko~"

Tapu Koko nodded seriously, then turned into a golden arc of light and disappeared from sight.

Melemele Island, UB Task Force temporary research facility.

Cosmoem lay quietly in a cradle-like device, with various cables connecting the cradle to precise instruments.

Professor Burnet and Lusamine, with her hair tied up, were operating rapidly at the instruments.

The Aether Foundation was participating as members to assist the "UB Task Force."

After all, no organization could compare to the Aether Foundation in research on Ultra Beasts, and only the Aether Foundation could provide the professional equipment the "UB Task Force" needed.

Moreover, after Faba, the "culprit" and Aether Foundation branch chief, disappeared, many of the negative labels originally attached to the Aether Foundation had been largely removed.

With the Aether Foundation providing substantial funding, equipment, and technology, whether the "UB Task Force" or Anabel really couldn't exclude President Lusamine from participating.

And Lusamine's request was actually just one thing.

When the "UB Task Force" prepared to pass through "Ultra Wormholes" to "Ultra Space," Lusamine had to be one of the members.

Such dangerous actions seemed somewhat unreasonable for this distinguished Aether Foundation President Lusamine, but when she said her husband had disappeared into an "Ultra Wormhole," everyone understood.

At this moment, Professor Burnet and Lusamine were trying methods to stabilize "Ultra Wormholes."

Lusamine's eyes held fervor, but Professor Burnet couldn't help frowning.

"Something's not right..." Professor Burnet stopped what she was doing.

"What's wrong?" Anabel asked.

"I feel..." she looked at the instrument screen, "Why do I have the illusion that we're having a two-way reaction with 'Ultra Space'?"

"Two-way reaction?" Anabel looked confused, turning to Lusamine.

Lusamine seemed quite calm, nodding: "It's not an illusion. There really is a 'two-way reaction.'"

Then she explained to Anabel:

"Simply put, while we research 'Ultra Space' and 'Ultra Wormholes' to make 'Ultra Wormholes' more stable, opening passages from their side to ours also becomes easier."

Hearing this, Anabel's expression became somewhat astonished.

"That means the more we research 'Ultra Wormholes,' the more random 'Ultra Wormholes' might open." Professor Burnet summarized.

"This..."

Anabel was momentarily speechless.

Didn't this mean that the more they understood "Ultra Wormholes" and "Ultra Space," the more Ultra Beasts would come to the Alola region through "Ultra Wormholes"?

"But why?" Anabel asked in confusion.

But not just her - neither Professor Burnet nor Lusamine could explain this phenomenon.

Professor Burnet could only speculate:

"Perhaps... while we stabilize 'Ultra Wormholes,' we're actually strengthening the connection between two worlds? So opening 'Ultra Wormholes' becomes easier..."

Lusamine had another theory.

"It's also possible that some creature existing between our world and 'Ultra Space' is playing a role."

An image of an Ultra Beast appeared in her mind.

"So, regardless, we must accelerate our research on 'Ultra Space' and 'Ultra Wormholes.' Even if it accelerates the connection between two worlds, at least we can't remain completely ignorant about 'Ultra Space.'"

After thinking it through, Anabel made a very decisive decision.

The connection between the Pokémon world and "Ultra Space" was already inevitable, and more and more Ultra Beasts had been appearing recently.

Since that was the case, they at least had to ensure they wouldn't be completely in the dark.

"This news should be reported to Teacher Johan as soon as possible." Professor Burnet said.

Anabel nodded, took her phone, and walked out of the research facility.

"I see."

Holding his phone at the Altar of the Sunne, Johan listened to Anabel's report without much surprise.

"Then I'll have to trouble Professor Burnet and President Lusamine to work even harder."

After hanging up.

He looked at the four Island Guardian Deities floating around the Altar of the Sunne with a smile.

The other Guardian Deities were fine, but Tapu Bulu couldn't help trembling when it felt Johan's gaze on it.

This guy... isn't he planning to harm me again?

"Tapu Bulu, have you been sleeping well and eating well lately?" Johan greeted warmly.

"Bulu~!"

Tapu Bulu trembled and quickly flew toward the altar.

Here it comes, here it comes, he's really coming!

Seeing Tapu Bulu's figure, Johan looked at Tapu Koko and the others in confusion: "What's wrong with it?"

Tapu Koko's expression was strange.

Don't you know what's wrong with it?

You're definitely the first to "scare" an Island Guardian Deity like this!

Moreover...

Johan's enthusiastic smile just now was exactly the same as his Gengar's!

Indeed, what kind of trainer would raise what kind of Pokémon.

If Johan knew what the three Island Guardian Deities were thinking, he would definitely argue.

How dare you slander people without evidence?

"Koko~" (Take out your Fairium Z and Z-Ring~)

Tapu Koko changed the subject.

"Here."

Johan was straightforward, taking out the Fairium Z and Z-Ring.

This Fairium Z originally came from Tapu Koko, so it was clear about what Johan possessed.

"Koko~~"

Tapu Koko's power lifted the Fairium Z and Z-Ring, bringing them to the four rather ancient and mysterious stone pillars erected in the center below the Altar of the Sunne.

These pillars were engraved with marks representing each Island Guardian Deity, representing their identities.

"Oowoo~"

Ninetales seemed to sense something, running out of its Poké Ball and looking up at the Island Guardian Deities on the stone pillars.

The four Island Guardian Deities looked at each other, confirming each other's thoughts.

A special dance - the four Island Guardian Deities leaped up, accompanied by pink, cute patterns of Fairy-type energy appearing.

Buzz—

Waves of power spread from the four Island Guardian Deities, Fairy-type power and Ultra Aura power flowing through the stone pillars into the mysterious patterns of the Altar of the Sunne.

"Oowoo..."

At this moment, Ninetales was already quite familiar with the power of Ultra Aura.

Rumble rumble—

The entire Altar of the Sunne made rumbling sounds. On the erected, towering altar statue, the wheel representing the sun in the center slowly opened as large amounts of dust fell.

Hm?

Seeing the Altar of the Sunne about to be activated, Johan was stunned.

Wait.

Upgrading a Z-Crystal at most, plus a Z-Ring - why was the Altar of the Sunne being activated too?

Buzz—

Suddenly, the surrounding space seemed to tremble and distort. The originally bright sky instantly dimmed, and hazy gray mist enveloped the surroundings of the Altar of the Sunne.

"This feeling..." Johan raised an eyebrow.

"Ka-kaah!" Gengar floated out from his shadow.

Reverse World!

Wasn't this the world of its "electronic pet," Giratina's world?

A projection of the Reverse World?

In Johan's and the others' vision, the Altar of the Sunne's original sun pattern had become a crescent moon shape.

The Altar of the Moone!

Space twisted and overlapped, creating convergence.

Brightness and grayness formed—

At this moment, in Johan's vision, he seemed to stand at the "boundary" between two worlds.

On the left was the bright world where the sun's Altar of the Sunne was located, on the right was the gray-white world where the moon's Altar of the Moone was located in the Reverse World.

Both the Altar of the Sunne and Altar of the Moone were activated?

Moreover, the two altars from two worlds seemed to overlap.

A beam of pure white light shot down from the moon symbol opened at the Altar of the Moone, falling on the Fairium Z and Z-Ring surrounded by the four Island Guardian Deities.

If Johan didn't quite understand why the Altar of the Sunne needed to be activated before, now he somewhat understood.

It was to activate the Altar of the Moone, and the Altar of the Moone was more compatible with Fairy-type, more compatible with Ninetales.

Under the moonlight's illumination and the Island Guardian Deities' power infusion.

The Fairium Z and Z-Ring were rendered pure white.

"Oowoo~"

Ninetales seemed to sense this Ultra Aura power change, its tails flowing and fur swaying as pure white moonlight power emanated from Ninetales and also infused into the Fairium Z.

At the same time.

"Cosmo?"

Below the Altar of the Sunne, Nebby Cosmoem suddenly appeared here, under the sunlight shooting down from the Altar of the Sunne.

Hm?

Nebby still came?

It wouldn't really evolve like this, would it?

Johan looked at the Island Guardian Deities still working hard at their special dance.

They were really well prepared.

Both Altar of the Sunne and Altar of the Moone activated simultaneously.

Blazing sunlight, pure white moonlight.

Standing in the middle, Johan seemed to feel the heat from one side and coolness from the other.

"Fine."

Johan knew Nebby's evolution couldn't be avoided.

And the only way to truly calm Necrozma was to let it regain light and restore it to the "Blinding One."

So whether Lunala or Solgaleo, their power was indispensable.

Otherwise, they could only temporarily suppress Necrozma or temporarily seal it, but it would always awaken again someday.

Perhaps due to the moonlight, perhaps Ninetales' influence, or perhaps he had figured it out himself, Johan's heart was very calm at this moment.

Thump thump—

Tapu Bulu's drumbeats became the final drumbeats of the dance "Alola."

Johan looked down.

In his hand was a bracelet different from ordinary Z-Rings, mainly the groove for embedding Z-Crystals had become somewhat different.

Of course, most eye-catching was the Z-Crystal in his palm that he had never seen and completely didn't recognize.

Pure jade-white throughout, with distinct edges and corners, the crystal's center had a crescent moon pattern, yet also seemed like Ninetales' pure light blue eyes.

From this Z-Crystal emanated a unique jade-white glow, exclusive to Johan and Ninetales.

"Really is a Z-Crystal exclusive to our little Ninetales..."

Johan couldn't help sighing, combining the Ultra Aura on Ninetales with its own special characteristics, plus the Altar of the Moone's power, creating a Z-Crystal exclusive to his Ninetales.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar's eyes flickered with some envy in its round eyes.

"Oowoo~"

Ninetales' tail gently wrapped around Johan's arm, as if a special bond formed between them.

Johan's eyes reflected this special Z-Crystal, meeting Ninetales' gaze.

He seemed to immediately understand the power this Z-Crystal represented and its corresponding Z-Move.

This wasn't just power from Ninetales itself, but also proof and crystallization of their journey together, mutual support, and mutual growth.

"'Ninetales Z,' let's call it 'Ninetales Z.'" Johan smiled.

"Oowoo~"

Ninetales' eyes curved as it nodded.

This was a "Ninetales Z" that only he and his Ninetales could use, and could only work when Ninetales used "Moonblast" and "Nature's Madness."

"Using Nature's Madness to gather 'Ultra Aura' or 'light' power, then releasing it?"

Johan gently rubbed his chin.

"Really fucking reasonable..."

This exclusive Z-Move was called—

"Haven't named it yet..."

This really troubled Johan, who was quite self-aware as a "naming disaster."

But regardless.

If he named it himself, he definitely couldn't use names like "Cute Star Flying Crash" or "Ultimate Giant Dragon Earth Shaker" that would make him explode first.

However, Johan and Ninetales already understood this exclusive Z-Move's effects.

Setting aside power increase, it could greatly boost the user's Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed!

It had somewhat "grafted" the effects brought by Nature's Madness.

Furthermore.

Opponents hit had a certain probability of being "frozen," stopped in moonlight, and the opponent's Special Attack would be lowered.

Hm?

Sensing this exclusive Z-Move's characteristics, Johan opened his mouth.

Whenever you see the moon, you'll think of me - Omega-Style Secret Art: Eight Wine Cups?!

Powerful!

Undoubtedly powerful.

Not only did it match Ninetales' own Fairy-type abilities, it even stacked some of Ninetales' Ice-type abilities?

Was this reasonable?

Very reasonable!

As the Altar of the Moone and moonlight faded, Johan and the others looked toward the Altar of the Sunne on the "other side."

They saw the opened sun disc of the Altar of the Sunne shooting flame light that enveloped Nebby Cosmoem, as if some strange change was occurring within.

At the same time.

The Altar of the Moone's phantom slowly dissipated, and the Altar of the Sunne's light illuminated everything.

"Going to evolve?" Johan said softly.

His heart was quite calm at this moment.

Let it evolve if it was going to evolve.

If Solgaleo and Lunala's "light" combined, it could also make Necrozma recover faster.

However, when the Altar of the Sunne's central disc slowly closed and the sun's light gradually faded, the flames and light wrapping Nebby quickly converged and were absorbed.

But what appeared again was still just little Cosmoem.

Only the core within its body looked more full and round, as if it had accumulated tremendous energy.

"Didn't evolve?" Johan was somewhat surprised.

The four Island Guardian Deities, obviously much weaker now, descended from the altar. Hearing Johan's words, Tapu Koko rolled its eyes irritably.

Did they think they were immortals?

Nebby had just evolved last night at midnight, and now they wanted it to complete a double jump and evolve into the legendary Pokémon Solgaleo?

Even with Lunala's moonlight assistance, even with the "light" accumulated by the Altar of the Sunne, it was impossible to make Cosmoem directly evolve into Solgaleo.

What they could do was the same as Lunala - accelerate Nebby's growth as much as possible.

Of course.

More importantly—

"Cosmo~"

Cosmoem slowly descended from the air, settling comfortably in Johan's palm.

Hm?

When catching Cosmoem, Johan felt there was something else in his hand.

Opening it to look.

Another exclusive Z-Crystal?

"Solganium Z?"

Johan looked at Tapu Koko and the others with some realization.

So it was for Solgaleo's exclusive Z-Crystal, while also helping Ninetales condense its exclusive Z-Crystal, and simultaneously greatly shortening Nebby's core energy accumulation process.

"Koko~"

Tapu Koko nodded at Johan.

"Bulu~"

Tapu Bulu was first to ring its bell and leave, followed by the other three Island Guardian Deities also departing after completing their respective "tasks."

They were exhausted.

Time to go back and rest well.

"Ninetales Z, Solganium Z."

Johan looked at the two exclusive Z-Crystals in his hand, suddenly thinking:

"Wait, you turned my Fairium Z into Ninetales Z - shouldn't you compensate me with another Fairium Z?"

Ninetales didn't need it, but our Tinkaton still needed to use it.

A rare Fairium Z was worth at least eight figures.

"Ka-kaah..."

Gengar bit a "handkerchief," looking longingly at the two exclusive Z-Crystals in Johan's hand.

Why don't I have any?

I also want to become shiny...

Just then.

Whoosh—

A pure white figure flashed past Johan at a speed nearly impossible to catch with the naked eye.

"Oowoo!"

Ninetales immediately became serious, a faint ripple spreading from in front of Johan.

Although that figure's speed was indeed exaggeratedly fast, Ninetales remained alert at all times to prevent Johan from being ambushed.

But the other party didn't seem to intend to attack Johan, so it only created a thin layer of ripples.

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar looked at Johan's empty palm and cried out.

It wasn't me!

Somewhat like protesting too much.

However, it really wasn't Gengar this time.

At the edge of the Altar of the Sunne stood a Pokémon with a humanoid body, very slender and tall while presenting a snow-white color.

It wore a golden crown on its head, two thin tentacles extending to its ankles, snow-white long hair, and indifferent, disdainful eyes that highlighted its elegance and arrogance.

UB-02: Beauty, Ultra Beast, Pheromosa!

A very dangerous and powerful Ultra Beast.

The Pheromosa that appeared in the anime not only had powerful strength and exaggerated speed, but also possessed extremely high intelligence, incomparable to a big lump like Buzzwole.

If not for "Bear God" Bewear backing things up, Pheromosa might really have collected many Z-Crystals it liked.

At this moment, it held Ninetales Z and Solganium Z in its two hands respectively, examining them carefully with great pleasure.

The extremely fast figure from before was obviously it.

Pheromosa was an Ultra Beast with incredible speed. According to the Pokédex Johan knew, its speed was faster than all discovered creatures.

Honestly.

Just now Johan and his two Pokémon hadn't paid much attention to their surroundings, so Pheromosa succeeded.

But undeniably, this Pheromosa's speed was indeed exaggeratedly fast.

However, this Ultra Beast's greatest characteristic was its beauty - its appearance that could bewitch all creatures and make them unable to generate much hostility.

Or rather, its appearance combined with the "pheromones" it released could charm all creatures.

It had a feeling of...

No matter what I do, I'll be forgiven because I'm just too beautiful.

This kind of feeling.

"Phero~"

Pheromosa noticed their gazes, slightly raised the corners of its mouth and chin, looked down at them with some disdain, then without entanglement, turned and jumped toward the great canyon below the altar.

Its disdain was clearly evident.

"Good grief." Johan didn't feel nervous, just found it somewhat amusing. "Is this what they call 'longtime goose hunters getting pecked by geese'?"

Two Z-Crystals that were clearly in his hands had actually been stolen by an Ultra Beast?

However...

The exclusive Z-Crystal condensed from his and Ninetales' aura was like Mega Stones and Key Stones - he and Ninetales could sense its location at any time.

Pheromosa couldn't escape.

He then looked at Gengar: "What are you staring at? Aren't you going to chase it?"

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar "oh oh" reacted, its body exploding into pieces with a "bang," black shadows rapidly moving across the bare ground.

"Ninetales."

"Oowoo~"

Ninetales nodded, light blue eyes flashing with brilliant blue light. The originally sunny Poni Canyon suddenly became dim.

A large mass of thick dark clouds covered the canyon above.

Then wind and snow enveloped the great canyon, temperature instantly plummeted, and the canyon gradually dressed in silver.

Bang! Bang!

From the canyon below came collision and fighting sounds.

When Johan and the others reached the canyon bottom, they saw the Pheromosa that had stolen the two exclusive Z-Crystals earlier now surrounded by a group of Jangmo-o and Hakamo-o.

In Pheromosa's hands was an additional Z-Crystal glowing blue-purple - Dragonium Z!

Really fast indeed.

It hadn't been long since it stole the two exclusive Z-Crystals from him, and it had already taken the Dragonium Z guarded by this group of Jangmo-o living at the bottom of Poni Canyon?

And this group of Jangmo-o and Hakamo-o's siege wasn't causing much trouble for Pheromosa.

Even more so.

As the pheromone scent released by Pheromosa gradually spread, many Jangmo-o and Hakamo-o lost their ability to continue fighting.

If not for the suddenly dropping temperature and falling snow making Pheromosa's movements traceable, the Jangmo-o and Hakamo-o probably couldn't have surrounded Pheromosa.

"What are you looking at?"

While Pheromosa entangled with the Jangmo-o and Hakamo-o, Gengar sat on a nearby rock, stroking its chin like Johan, with no intention of intervening.

Hearing Johan's words, Gengar immediately showed a mischievous smile.

"Ka-kaah~"

I think if we give it more time, it might collect more Z-Crystals. Then we can "rob" it - no, then we can take back our Z-Crystals and definitely make a big profit!

Hearing this, Johan couldn't help but laugh and cry.

"You purple fatty, quite wicked..."

But undeniably, Gengar's idea was very constructive.

Look.

Pheromosa had already snatched a precious Dragonium Z.

Unfortunately.

"We don't have much time to waste here. We still need to return to Melemele Island later to prepare for going to 'Ultra Space.'" Johan said.

"Ka-kaah..."

Gengar immediately felt regretful, its face falling.

"Go quickly!" Johan laughed and scolded good-naturedly.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar's body exploded with a "bang" again.

In the snow, Pheromosa moved flexibly, dodging gracefully and lightly, not only unafraid despite being surrounded but actually seeming to enjoy it.

"Phero~"

Pheromosa sang softly, gracefully passing between two Hakamo-o, the pheromones it released causing the two Hakamo-o to become hostile toward each other.

But just as Pheromosa thought it would "play" with its opponents again, suddenly a black shadow appeared from behind it, enveloping it.

"Phero?"

Pheromosa's eyes showed some surprise, looking back during flight.

It saw...

"Ka-kaah~"

Purple fatty Gengar was grinning, opening its sly crimson eyes and raising an eyebrow at it, one hand behind its head, one hand on its stomach, spinning in the air following it (like Stephen Chow flying past the billboard scene from Kung Fu).

"Phero!"

Pheromosa landed lightly, its slender legs leaving two tracks in the snow.

At this moment it realized it might have provoked a troublesome opponent. It immediately lost interest in continuing to "play" with the Hakamo-o, looked deeply at Gengar, then without any reservation, leaped forcefully toward the other side of the great canyon.

But the next second.

What Pheromosa didn't expect was.

When it thought it had escaped and turned its head to look, it again saw that fat, grinning face full of mischief.

What the hell!

As a speed-renowned Pokémon, this was its first time facing a Pokémon that could keep up with its speed.

And so easily at that...

"Phero!"

Pheromosa's eyes became serious, unwilling to admit this fact.

A light pink-white mist immediately emanated from its body, radiating blood-pumping power.

Concentrated pheromones!

But the next instant.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar took a deep breath, and all of Pheromosa's proudest pheromones were sucked into Gengar's stomach in one breath?

And Gengar showed no signs of being affected whatsoever.

How was this possible?!

Pheromosa was full of shock, instinctively stopping in its tracks, staring at the still-grinning Gengar in amazement.

This guy...

Boom!!!

Suddenly.

The rock wall behind Pheromosa exploded.

Roar—!!!

A massive Kommo-o burst through the rock wall, its mace-like tail swinging viciously at it.

Totem Kommo-o!

The master of Poni Canyon!

Stealing the Dragonium Z completely enraged this Totem Kommo-o.

"Phero..."

Having just stopped and barely recovered from shock, Pheromosa had no time to react. Seeing that terrifying tail getting closer, it instinctively closed its eyes.

Terrifying wind scraped painfully at its face.

But the heavy blow it anticipated didn't fall on it as expected.

Pheromosa's long eyelashes trembled as it slowly opened its eyes with confusion, and saw...

That purple fatty was standing between itself and the Totem Kommo-o, one hand blocking the furious tail strike from Kommo-o, the other hand picking its nose.

"Phero..." Pheromosa's eyes were dazed.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar picked its nose, wiped it on Kommo-o's tail, then extended its hand toward Pheromosa.

Hand it over, our Old Johan family's stuff~

But this scene in Pheromosa's eyes...

"Phero...(ω人)"

Pheromosa's originally indifferent, disdainful eyes had now become heart-shaped.

In its eyes now.

Gengar was tall, slender, muscular, brave, just, kind... its entire body seemed to emanate a charming pheromone scent.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar scratched its butt, sniffed it at its nose, then waved it in front of Pheromosa.

Hey! What are you spacing out for? Scared silly?

Good girl, hand over the stuff, save yourself the heartache.

I know how to hit people~

# 729: Enter! Ultra Wormhole! (Two-in-One Chapter)

"Phero..."

Pheromosa stared blankly at the "domineering" Gengar, an uncontrolled blush appearing on its pale cheeks.

"Ka-kaah?"

Are you going to give it or not?

I really won't be polite anymore!

As it spoke, Gengar's expression gradually became serious and fierce.

"Phe, Phero!"

Seeing Gengar's expression change, Pheromosa immediately felt it had become even more masculine.

At the same time, snapping out of its daze, it quickly produced the previously stolen exclusive Ninetales Z and Solganium Z.

In addition.

There was also the Dragonium Z stolen from the Kommo-o clan, and another... Z-Crystal with a special appearance like the Ninetales Z and Solganium Z.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar blinked twice.

There's an unexpected "bonus"?

Not far away, Johan and Ninetales, who were watching this scene, both had somewhat strange expressions.

The human and Pokémon looked at each other, immediately feeling that sensation become even stranger.

Our Gengar seemed to, apparently, apparently... have successfully "attracted" Pheromosa?

A Pheromosa that used its own beauty and pheromones to charm other Pokémon had been attracted by Gengar?

On what basis?

Masculine charm? Its chubby body? An interesting soul?

Something felt weird somewhere, not quite right...

Moreover.

Johan was actually quite clear about his ghost's "preferences."

Mature, alluring, curvaceous things weren't what the ghost liked - it preferred petite and cute things.

So while Gengar normally chased Minccino with such enthusiasm, it was completely unaware of Pheromosa's reaction.

It just felt the guy in front of it was a bit strange, but couldn't say exactly what was strange about it.

However.

While Gengar couldn't sense it, that didn't mean the Totem Kommo-o blocked by Gengar couldn't sense it.

It was currently staring with eyes as big as copper bells.

In its view, these two guys in front of it - one a dark little fatty, one a pale and slender little lady - were definitely accomplices!

One was responsible for sneakily taking away the Dragonium Z guarded by their Kommo-o clan, while the other was responsible for keeping watch and covering the retreat - their cooperation was seamless.

One black, one white, one fat, one thin.

They were simply the Black and White Duo plus Fat and Thin Monks!

More importantly.

These two guys were actually "flirting" right in front of it?!

Kommo-o couldn't see Gengar's face, so it didn't know Gengar's expression, but any normal Pokémon would think this way, right?

This simply touched the reverse scale of this "single dog"!

"Roar!!"

Uncle can endure it, but Auntie can't!!

Dark red airflow, accompanied by violent aura, surged from the Totem Kommo-o.

At the same time, it roared loudly, the intense roar shaking the entire canyon.

Whoosh—whoosh—

At the Totem Kommo-o's call, a Noivern and a Scizor rushed over rapidly from both sides of the canyon.

These were its partners!

Also the opponents that challengers would face when challenging it during the "Island Challenge."

"Phero!"

Pheromosa cried out, pointing at the Kommo-o behind Gengar.

Watch out!

The Kommo-o was swinging its sharp claws, striking toward Gengar.

Dragon Claw!

Detestable guy!

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar turned back to look at the fierce Totem Kommo-o, covering the four Z-Crystals in its hands.

These are my "spoils" - are you trying to snatch them too?

A jet-black orb immediately appeared from Gengar's palm, meeting the incoming Dragon Claw without any retreat.

Bang!!

A violent roar immediately exploded in the canyon.

Large amounts of dust mixed with snow flew up.

"Roar—"

The Totem Kommo-o flew back with a shocked expression, feeling the pain and paralysis from its scale-covered claws, immediately realizing—

This purple fatty... was very strong!

Extremely strong!

At the same time.

"Oowoo—"

Ninetales also held nothing back. Wanton wind and snow howled through the canyon. The extremely cold temperature and the raging blizzard made the approaching Noivern and Scizor feel tremendous pressure.

Coldly glancing at the two Pokémon coming to assist, Ninetales' tails swayed gently.

Do only you have helpers?

The Noivern and Scizor, who weren't as strong as the Totem Kommo-o to begin with, understood that this Ninetales was even stronger than the Totem Kommo-o - completely beyond their ability to handle.

Especially the Flying and Dragon-type Noivern - just this fierce blizzard alone was almost enough to make it lose its fighting ability and consciousness.

The Steel and Bug-type Scizor was slightly better off, but not by much.

Because before it could approach to help the Totem Kommo-o, Gengar could defeat it!

"Ka-kaah! (#`皿)"

The purple fatty looked fierce.

Everything else was fine, but trying to snatch its "spoils" - no way!

Black hole-like energy quickly condensed in its hands, thrown toward the Totem Kommo-o.

Dark Void!

Buzz—

The originally fist-sized black hole suddenly expanded and spread, instantly enveloping the Totem Kommo-o.

When the black hole dispersed.

The Totem Kommo-o was already lying in the snow, sleeping soundly.

"Phero..."

Pheromosa looked at the "disdainful" Gengar with admiration, feeling its figure becoming increasingly tall and mighty.

Gengar looked at Pheromosa suspiciously, confirming it had no intention of snatching the Z-Crystals again, then—

Wiggling its little butt, it floated happily toward Johan.

"Ka-kaah—"

It showed off the four Z-Crystals it had obtained - two originally belonged to Old Johan's family, while the other two were "pure profit"!

"Phero!"

Pheromosa covered its chest with both hands, looking like "It looked at me! It looked at me!"

Johan and Ninetales glanced at Pheromosa standing dazed in place, then looked at each other with strange expressions.

"What a karmic entanglement..."

Not knowing if this phrasing was appropriate, Johan murmured, earning Ninetales' agreement.

With the Totem Kommo-o defeated, the surrounding Jangmo-o and Hakamo-o slowly cleared a path.

If the Dragonium Z had been stolen or pilfered, they would have fought desperately.

But if the Dragonium Z was taken after directly defeating the Totem Kommo-o, that would be in accordance with "Island Challenge" rules - worthy of recognition and respect as a "challenger."

So seeing their actions, Johan also gave up the thought of returning the Dragonium Z.

Although he already had one Dragonium Z, that didn't prevent him from obtaining a second.

He'd always been thinking about selling a Z-Crystal to recoup costs, but always ended up with Z-Crystals his own Pokémon could use.

This time he finally had a duplicate, and it was an extremely rare and valuable Dragonium Z!

Johan was already thinking about what price to set or who to sell it to.

Cynthia already had one.

He didn't know if Elite Four Drake had one, but probably did.

Lance might be the best possibility - he might be hiding some Fire Z, Water Z, Flying Z, but Dragonium Z was uncertain...

At worst.

He could sell it to Raihan, who definitely didn't have one.

Regardless, he was definitely going to make a killing!

"Ka-kaah~ Ka-kaah~"

Just as Johan was thinking about the large sum of money coming soon, Gengar tugged at Johan's clothes.

The Ninetales Z and Solganium Z weren't particularly surprising, but that other pitch-black exclusive Z-Crystal made it quite curious.

It was pinkish and seemed to be a Fairy-type Z-Crystal, but Gengar could sense faint Ghost-type energy waves from it.

So cute and lovely, very suitable for it, Gengar - could this be its Z-Crystal, a Gengar Z?

"This is..." Johan took the pink exclusive Z-Crystal, examined it briefly, and recognized it.

"Mimikium Z?"

Mimikium Z?

Hearing this, Gengar immediately looked disappointed, its ears drooping.

"Ka-kaah...~"

Why is it Mimikium Z?

Johan ignored the "disappointed" purple fatty, saying thoughtfully:

"Looks like before coming to Poni Canyon, Pheromosa first went to the abandoned thrift store and took Mimikyu's Z-Crystal?"

He'd deal with that when he had a chance to meet it again!

He happily put all four Z-Crystals in his pocket.

"Ka-kaah~ Ka-kaah~"

Gengar waved listlessly.

Let's go~ Let's go~ Going back~

Johan and Ninetales turned back together, looking at Pheromosa standing in the wind and snow, then at Gengar floating at the front.

"Tsk..."

Two days later.

Melemele Island, at the Alola Pokémon School playground.

"Ready~"

Professor Kukui held a starting pistol in one hand and covered his ear with the other.

At the starting line on the playground, many Pokémon good at running and sprinting were ready to go.

Kiawe riding a Tauros, Mallow riding a Gogoat, Lana riding a Paldean Aqua Breed Tauros, Sophocles riding a Rhydon.

Lillie riding a Galarian Ponyta.

And Gladion riding Type: Null.

All the kids in the class were riding their respective "mounts."

Lillie looked the most nervous.

However, no longer afraid of Pokémon, she stroked Ponyta's rainbow-colored mane while softly comforting:

"It's, it's fine, we're, we're just participating!"

Whether she was comforting Ponyta or herself was unclear.

The Galarian Ponyta was said to have absorbed the overflowing life energy from a certain forest in Galar, becoming its current appearance, giving off a rainbow unicorn vibe.

However, compared to the surrounding Tauros and Rhydon, Ponyta's size and presence made people want to worry for it.

"Why am I participating in such a competition..." Gladion looked at his excited classmates, unable to help complaining internally.

Although he thought this way, both his actions and expression "betrayed" him.

He actually wanted to try competing like this.

Naturally.

Besides these students, there were two other participants!

One was naturally Johan on his Rotom Bike, and the other was...

Gengar leading a Mudsdale, his expression full of strong confidence.

"Ka-kaah!"

I can even ride Spectrier, so a mere Mudsdale is a piece of cake!

This championship is definitely mine!

"Teacher Johan, you're cheating! This was supposed to be a Pokémon riding competition - how can you ride a bicycle?" Mallow couldn't help complaining.

"Don't treat Rotom like it's not a Pokémon." Johan smiled slightly.

"Rotom, ready at any time, Rotom!"

Rotom spoke from within the bike.

Mallow pouted.

Of course she knew - she'd seen Teacher Johan ride the Rotom Bike before, but...

The Rotom Bike was so fast - wasn't this cheating?

"Ready!"

Professor Kukui shouted.

Bang!

The starting pistol fired suddenly.

"Charge! Tauros!"

"Go! Rhydon!"

"Ring ring! Ring ring! Bike coming through!"

"..."

For a moment, it was truly each showing their own abilities.

"We absolutely won't lose! Charge! Type: Null!" Even Gladion threw himself completely into it, unconsciously breaking into an excited smile.

Seeing their performance, Professor Kukui's smile grew even broader.

Especially the smiles of Lillie, Gladion, and Lana.

"Since Teacher Johan came, the kids smile more and are more enthusiastic about learning..."

As the professor who could best sense the students' changes, how much Professor Kukui hoped Teacher Johan could stay at the Pokémon School forever.

In the end.

Unsurprisingly, Johan with his "Rotom cheat" "bravely won" first place!

Although Kiawe, Mallow, Sophocles and the others cried out "Teacher Johan is cheating," this behavior of not deliberately going easy on them just because they were students actually earned their recognition even more.

Second place went to Gladion and Type: Null.

Although he lost.

Gladion discovered he actually enjoyed this kind of process.

Between trainers and Pokémon, there wasn't just training and battling.

Life was also a very important part.

"You did great, Ponyta~" Lillie smiled broadly as she petted Ponyta. They hadn't come in last, because the last place was...

"Ka-kaah! Ka-kaah!"

Gengar riding on Mudsdale's back was still persisting on the track.

Mudsdale was famous as a draft Pokémon - carrying or dragging heavy objects was naturally no problem for it, but if it was about speed...

Gengar suffered a "Waterloo"!

Came in dead last.

This provided a perfect conclusion to the class's "Pokémon Riding Competition."

"You called me here just to watch this?"

Pushing his bicycle to the shade of a nearby tree, Johan heard a low voice beside him.

Looking toward the sound.

It was Giovanni in a black suit with a strange expression!

"Haha, occasional entertainment and relaxation is also for better work." Johan laughed heartily. Seeing Giovanni appear, he felt... extremely reassured.

This was the helper he had "summoned."

In "Ultra Space," he wasn't sure if he could "summon" legendary Pokémon from the Pokémon world, and didn't know if legendary Pokémon entering "Ultra Space" would cause unnecessary changes.

So... the recently available Giovanni was the perfect choice.

After all, they were going to face the legendary "Blinding One" Necrozma.

If it was "UB: Black," Johan naturally wouldn't be afraid.

But if it was complete Necrozma, he could at least shout—

Giovanni, save me!

"Those three?"

Under the shade at the Pokémon School playground, Johan and Giovanni watched the active kids while chatting casually.

"Recently, Macro Cosmos Corporation in Galar hired our people for some 'dangerous infrastructure construction.' Short-staffed, so I sent them there." Giovanni drank some berry juice.

"Macro Cosmos Corporation? Hiring Team Rocket?"

Johan looked Giovanni up and down.

Was there something wrong?

Giovanni chuckled lightly.

"That guy Rose. Heard the mysterious Dynamax phenomena in Galar are serious, so he's using our Team Rocket people as muscle."

After pausing, he added:

"Then he figured he had Team Rocket dead to rights for wanting to transform, that we wouldn't do anything excessive, especially since he's still the so-called Galar League Chairman."

"I see." Johan nodded in understanding. "Rose really played a good game."

Just without the trio, there was a feeling of... insufficient defensive measures...

Giovanni produced a bag of cookies, saying indifferently:

"Since it's business and a chance for our 'Rainbow Rocket Corporation' to get involved in Galar, naturally there was no reason to refuse."

Looking at the bag of cookies, Johan coughed lightly, politely declining Giovanni's offer.

Giovanni didn't mind either.

These were cookies Matori had put on the plane for him. He figured since they were just sitting there, he'd bring them along - occasionally useful for snacking.

He looked at Johan with some deeper meaning:

"Besides, haven't you been running to Galar frequently lately?"

"What does that have to do with me..."

"Of course it does."

Giovanni smiled: "Every place you go, doesn't something big happen? Go a few more times and Macro Cosmos Corporation and Rose might collapse, then our 'Rainbow Rocket Corporation' can conveniently take over the gap left by Macro Cosmos Corporation's downfall."

Johan's mouth twitched.

Good grief.

Really good grief.

Giovanni, you not going into business earlier was such a waste.

This was planning ahead?

"You're treating me like the 'Grim Reaper's sidekick.'"

"Grim Reaper's sidekick?"

"Cough, like a disaster magnet."

"Isn't that what you are?"

Johan: "..."

If we're going to chat like this, there's no way to continue this conversation.

Giovanni said indifferently:

"Just like this time."

He drank some juice and continued: "Who might you provoke? The 'Blinding One'?"

"It's just possible, probable, and the probability isn't high - not high at all."

Johan spoke off the cuff, looking away. "Besides, Giovanni, aren't you quite interested in the 'Blinding One' too?"

Maintaining contact with Hapu as Island Kahuna was partly for the "Blinding One."

"That was before." Giovanni said flatly.

"Then establishing friendly relations with the newly formed Alola League, even having opportunities to 'develop' the unknown universe - Ultra Space - surely can't be refused?"

"So I came."

Johan spread his hands.

The two fell into brief silence again.

Giovanni suddenly asked: "When?"

"Tonight."

"Tonight?"

"Nighttime... is safer."

"Teacher Johan, is there really no problem?"

Melemele Island, UB Task Force.

Anabel looked at Giovanni, whom Johan had brought, and couldn't help asking.

Others might not know Giovanni's identity, but as Hapu's former subordinate and current International Police executive, how could she not know Giovanni's true identity?

However, recently League Headquarters seemed to have changed its attitude toward Giovanni and Team Rocket.

The most important factor bringing this change was that Teacher Johan seemed to have a good relationship with Giovanni.

Moreover, under Teacher Johan's influence, Giovanni and even Team Rocket not only hadn't caused any major incidents, but were actively transforming.

Naturally, the League was happy to see this.

An evil force outside the rules versus a massive force within the rules - as a League wanting stability and peace, they naturally knew how to choose.

"Don't worry." Johan gave a reassuring look.

If Giovanni was going to betray them, he could have done so when his internal injuries were completely healed - no need to wait until now.

"Alright."

With Teacher Johan's "guarantee," Anabel stopped worrying.

"Teacher Johan, and Mr. Giovanni, these are 'Ultra Space suits' developed by our Aether Foundation, ensuring we won't face danger from simple environmental effects after entering the unknown 'Ultra Space.'"

President Lusamine and Wicke also came over with specially made clothing.

Hearing this, Johan's mind conjured images of Ash and the others in "Ultra Space suits" looking like Power Rangers in battle, feeling somewhat... embarrassing.

Honestly.

Pokémon Sun & Moon really mixed in a lot of things - multiverse settings, "light" Ultraman settings, and Power Rangers-style team deployment visuals.

"What?"

Giovanni, who had received the clothing, looked at Johan strangely.

Hm?

Looking at the clothes in Giovanni's hands, Johan snapped back to reality.

It wasn't the tight suits like Ash and the others wore - these looked much more "normal."

Both Giovanni's and his were black trench coats.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar floated out from behind Johan, pointing at itself with an eager expression.

Is there one for me?

"Uh..." Lusamine was stunned.

Wicke said: "We really didn't prepare Pokémon clothing, because according to our understanding, Pokémon should be able to move freely in 'Ultra Space' too."

Seeing Gengar's ears droop, she quickly added:

"But we do have some test suits - if Gengar doesn't mind..."

"Ka-kaah! Ka-kaah!"

Gengar immediately lifted its head, waving repeatedly.

Don't mind, I absolutely don't mind!

Then...

Gengar squeezed itself into the test suit - the tight suit from Johan's memory that Ash and the others wore.

The purple fatty managed to turn the tight suit into a "ball" shape, standing in front of the mirror and smugly gesturing.

It just felt their clothing was too "ordinary" - this kind perfectly matched its inner vision of "Ultra Space suits."

Two words to describe it:

Perfect!

Johan couldn't help but distance himself from Gengar, pretending not to know this fatty.

Besides Johan and Giovanni, the people entering "Ultra Space" this time also included Anabel and President Lusamine - four people total.

"Considering movement might be inconvenient in 'Ultra Space,' we've arranged 'ride' Pokémon."

Lusamine and the Aether Foundation's preparations seemed quite thorough - as if they'd been preparing for this for a long time.

"I have Dragonite." Johan smiled: "And Gym Leader Giovanni... can ride a Naganadel."

To help Johan, or rather to repay Johan, the Naganadel clan including the leader sent three Naganadel total.

To assist Johan and the others in quickly understanding "Ultra Space."

Additionally, Buzzwole and Kartana would also participate.

And Guzzlord, contained in a Beast Ball, would also be brought back to "Ultra Space" this time.

"Naganadel? That's much more convenient than 'ride' Pokémon." Lusamine finally decided to ride a Naganadel together with Anabel.

"Everyone, if you're ready, I'll open the 'Ultra Wormhole.'" Professor Burnet said with a serious expression.

Hearing this, everyone's expressions became serious.

"Please don't forget the Beast Balls."

Wicke again brought out prepared Beast Balls. "When necessary, Beast Balls can also serve as tools to briefly restrain Ultra Beasts, functioning similarly to Poké Balls."

Five Beast Balls per person.

Currently Beast Balls couldn't be mass-produced. Although they were certainly cheaper than the first one, twenty Beast Balls total were worth at least twenty million Pokédollars...

After changing into their outfits and preparing their respective items.

Both Anabel and President Lusamine seemed somewhat nervous, though one was anxiously nervous while the other was excited nervous.

As for Johan and Giovanni, both appeared quite calm.

Both were confident in their respective strengths, let alone working together.

Even facing legendary-level opponents, both were confident they could dominate.

As long as they didn't directly face complete "Blinding One" Necrozma, or mass Ultra Beast riots in "Ultra Space," they believed they could handle things calmly.

"Professor Burnet, please begin." Johan said.

"Right!"

Professor Burnet looked solemnly at quiet Nebby and pressed the button on the instrument.

Immediately.

Buzz—

Ultra Aura surged.

A spiral "Ultra Wormhole" appeared above the UB Task Force plaza.

"Everyone!" Professor Burnet shouted.

"Let's go!"

Giovanni domineeringly patted the Naganadel leader and took the lead.

This mere "Ultra Space" land would become my "territory"!

Anabel and Lusamine followed closely.

"Draaa—"

Johan on Dragonite's back was responsible for bringing up the rear, with Gengar accompanying nearby.

"Ka-kaah~!"

Ultra Beasts in Ultra Space, are you ready?! I'm coming!

Buzzwole and Kartana followed closely, also entering the "Ultra Wormhole."

Going home!

"Cosmo~"

Quiet Nebby seemed to sense something, flashing to appear in Johan's arms.

Outside the UB Task Force, Pheromosa's eyes held only the "handsome" Gengar. Seeing this scene, it also leaped without hesitation into the "Ultra Wormhole."
