# 730: Why Don't You Two Just Get Together? (Two-in-One Chapter)

Ultra Wormhole.

Space turbulence swirled and converged into a spiral-shaped passage, with Johan and the other four riding Pokémon swiftly shuttling through it.

It had to be said, the Aether Foundation's research on Ultra Beasts and Ultra Space was quite good. Johan and the others, wearing specially made clothing, were completely unaffected by the spatial turbulence of the "Ultra Wormhole."

Moreover, at the moment the "Ultra Wormhole" opened, Cosmoem, which entered together, released a mysterious aura that to some extent isolated the effects of the "Ultra Wormhole" and further stabilized it.

"Buzzwole!"

Buzzwole excitedly shouted.

From its expression, you could tell that "Ultra Space" was approaching.

Soon, in Johan and the others' vision, the vortex ahead came to an end, and a gray, hazy world gradually appeared in their sight.

Buzz—

Without slowing down, after a wave of spatial fluctuation, Johan and the others successfully flew out of the "Ultra Wormhole" and arrived in a dark, gray world.

Everything around them was gray and hazy, with extremely dim lighting. Not only were there no sun or moon in the sky, there weren't even any stars.

If not for some rocks around that emitted faint light, this would be a world completely swallowed by darkness.

Visibility was extremely low.

However, with the help of these glowing stones, they could barely make out their surroundings.

Around them were floating islands without any pattern, suspended haphazardly in the vicinity.

If you didn't know better, you'd think you'd somehow arrived in Giratina's "Distortion World," except even in the "Distortion World" the lighting wouldn't be this dim.

"Where... are we?" Anabel looked around and couldn't help asking.

"Buzzwole?"

Not just Anabel - Buzzwole, Kartana, and the Naganadel all looked confused.

The Naganadel leader explained: "Ultra Space is extremely vast, so even we aren't familiar with every location."

"These islands are all composed of crystals, not soil or metal."

Giovanni, who was crouching on the ground and gently touching the surface, said in a flat tone.

Crystals?

Johan nodded thoughtfully.

If they were precious ores or diamonds, Tyranitar would have already come out, and if they were metal, Tinkaton would definitely have come out too.

But both little ones were currently well-behaved, indicating these were indeed just crystals.

Furthermore.

Here, they seemed unable to feel the passage of stamina or time...

Wait!

Johan suddenly realized something.

"This place is—"

But before he could finish speaking, he heard Giovanni shout in a low voice, "Lusamine, what are you doing!"

He saw.

President Lusamine was standing in front of a huge, strange crystal pillar, slowly reaching out her hand to touch it.

The next second.

Gurgle gurgle—

A sound like flowing water, or perhaps squirming slime, and an Ultra Beast resembling a jellyfish "squeezed" out from the crystal pillar in front of Lusamine.

"UB-01: Symbiont?!" Anabel exclaimed.

The so-called "UB-01: Symbiont" was actually the first Ultra Beast discovered - Nihilego!

Nihilego had a bell-shaped jellyfish-like body, with white six-pointed star markings around its translucent upper bell, bright blue wavy edges around the bell rim, and tentacles hanging down like a skirt or limbs.

"I feel like I..." Lusamine slowly turned back, her face showing a nervous, collapsed yet somewhat excited smile.

Gurgle—

Just as her voice appeared, the Nihilego that emerged from the crystal immediately attached itself to Lusamine!

They'd just arrived in "Ultra Space" and encountered Nihilego, and Lusamine was predictably possessed by it.

This family really had quite the "karmic connection" with Nihilego... Johan unconsciously had this thought.

In the anime, Lusamine was also possessed by Nihilego and taken into "Ultra Space," which led to Ash and Gladion's rescue mission.

And Lusamine's husband Mohn had actually encountered a shiny Nihilego after getting lost in "Ultra Space," lived with it, and even treated it as his daughter, naming it "Lillie."

Finally, when Mohn recovered his memory, that shiny Nihilego named "Lillie" was captured by Gladion.

As for Lillie herself, she had her memories sealed by Faba precisely because she was suddenly attacked by Nihilego, leading to the subsequent series of events.

So.

Lusamine's family really had quite a "karmic entanglement" with Nihilego Ultra Beasts.

At the same time, seeing Nihilego appear completely confirmed Johan's suspicions.

This was the "Ultra Deep Sea" in "Ultra Space," the habitat of Nihilego Ultra Beasts - their territory!

"Oh no! President Lusamine has been parasitized!" Anabel shouted. "UB-01: Symbiont, Nihilego, is said to be able to possess humans and Pokémon, making them violent, but the specific reasons and conditions for possession are currently unknown—"

The UB Task Force had some understanding of Ultra Beasts, but not deep knowledge.

Especially for Nihilego, an Ultra Beast they'd never encountered, all their information came from the Aether Foundation.

"It's tension and fear." Johan supplemented Anabel's "conditions."

"Tension and fear?" Anabel was stunned.

Johan looked back at her: "So Anabel, don't be nervous or afraid. No matter what happens, I'm here."

While speaking, he gestured for Anabel to look around.

When Anabel instinctively looked, her face immediately paled.

At some unknown point.

The gray, hazy world around them was floating with numerous Nihilego, their numbers impossible to estimate.

So many Nihilego...

"Ka-kaah!" Gengar grinned and gave Anabel a thumbs up.

Don't be afraid, we're here.

Anabel was worthy of being someone who could become an International Police Chief Inspector in a short time, independently manage the "UB Task Force," and also serve as a Battle Frontier Brain - her psychological quality was quite strong.

After just a few deep breaths, her expression gradually calmed. She threw out a Poké Ball to summon Alakazam while nodding slightly at Johan.

Strong psychological quality was one aspect, but Teacher Johan's presence also truly gave Anabel fearless confidence.

Her attitude change made the few Nihilego that had been surrounding her slowly back away.

But while Anabel was temporarily fine, Lusamine had already been possessed by Nihilego.

After possessing Lusamine, the Nihilego's color and form immediately underwent tremendous changes.

Its upper bell covered Lusamine's head, and its transparent body still allowed Johan and the others to see Lusamine's expression clearly, but its originally white body had turned deep black, adding several degrees of sinister aura.

Those tentacles even opened eerie eyes, making people shudder.

"Teacher Johan, Mr. Giovanni, Miss Anabel!"

Lusamine looked excitedly at the three of them, still able to speak.

She shouted somewhat manically: "You can explore 'Ultra Space'! I've already found what I wanted! This is the Ultra Beast I've been searching for!"

"President Lusamine! You need to calm down and not be controlled by it!" Anabel shouted.

"Strictly speaking, this isn't control, is it?" Giovanni watched this scene with interest.

"Indeed."

Johan nodded.

"Nihilego releases a type of neurotoxin. Under the toxin's influence, anxiety and tension become happiness and excitement. Not only does Nihilego not control the parasitized host, it amplifies some of the host's deepest true thoughts and provides adequate protection."

Anabel didn't bother questioning why Teacher Johan understood Nihilego so well, just saying:

"Then what should we do..."

Giovanni said:

"If that's the case, then the more we attack this Nihilego, the more it will absorb the parasitized host's energy until they die. But if we don't attack, the host can actually live well?"

Johan truly admired Giovanni.

With just this little information, he'd made such an accurate judgment.

"Exactly, and only after parasitizing does Nihilego's true strength manifest."

"The stronger what the parasitized host desires deep down, the stronger Nihilego becomes?" Giovanni posed it as a question, but his tone was quite certain.

He smiled: "An 'idealistic' Ultra Beast - this kind of ability is truly rare."

Anabel was speechless.

Teacher Johan and Mr. Giovanni, taking turns speaking, had thoroughly analyzed Nihilego.

But weren't they both being too calm...

Although with so many Nihilego around, staying calm and composed was the best choice, were they just going to watch Lusamine be taken away by Nihilego?

But listening to their conversation, it seemed the more they attacked, the more they'd harm President Lusamine, while not taking drastic action would actually better protect President Lusamine?

How contradictory.

Seeming to notice Anabel's expression, Giovanni said flatly:

"Don't be nervous. Normally that's correct, but as long as it's a living creature - whether Ultra Beast or Pokémon - it has limits to what it can bear. Even if it's 'idealistic,' there are still limits."

As he spoke, he looked at Johan.

Johan nodded slightly: "Rock and Poison types."

"As expected."

A smile appeared on Giovanni's face: "No wonder everywhere around here is crystal and no soil."

4x weak to Ground-type moves.

The next moment.

Giovanni threw a Poké Ball at the Nihilego in mid-air.

The Poké Ball traced a straight line through the air at extreme speed, suddenly opening as it approached Nihilego and shooting out red light.

"Nidoqueen, Bulldoze!"

From the red light, a strong, robust Nidoqueen charged out without any hesitation, wrapped in extremely powerful Ground-type energy. Before Nihilego could react at all, it unhesitatingly struck it.

Boom!!

Large amounts of dust flew up.

Johan's expression was strange.

Ball-contained attacks?

Had Giovanni already encountered Red?

This "ball-contained attack" technique was frighteningly skilled.

Moreover, as an old-school trainer, although Giovanni was the Team Rocket boss, his Poké Ball throwing technique probably wasn't inferior to Gold's either.

Among old-school trainers, throwing Poké Balls was a very important skill that could often play crucial roles in sudden wild battles.

Look at this.

It was clearly a Ground-type move, but Giovanni made it feel like aerial combat.

Anabel watched this scene in amazement.

In the rising dust, Lusamine fell from the air.

Under Johan's direction, Naganadel had already positioned itself below the impact point and precisely caught the falling Lusamine.

Bang!!!

The light blue Nidoqueen landed heavily, spreading its arms and roaring domineeringly at the surrounding Nihilego.

The surrounding Nihilego, intimidated by Nidoqueen's presence, retreated another distance. Though they didn't completely withdraw, they no longer dared approach easily.

"Really no need to worry..." Anabel murmured, seeming to somewhat understand why Teacher Johan had called Mr. Giovanni along.

Moreover.

Their earlier back-and-forth conversation, plus the tacit cooperation between them, seemed like partners of many years.

Why don't you two just get together?

Anabel felt like she and President Lusamine were somewhat redundant.

"Ka-kaah?"

Just when all the Nihilego didn't dare approach Nidoqueen, Gengar went against the grain and immediately came to Nidoqueen's side, looking it up and down with increasingly bright joy in its eyes.

"Ka-kaah?!"

It's really you?!

"Roar—"

The previously imposing Nidoqueen, upon being recognized by Gengar, showed an honest, friendly smile and grinned.

It was actually... the Nidoqueen that had once "visited" Johan's house!

After parting back then, they hadn't seen each other for nearly a year.

Unexpectedly, in less than a year, this Nidoqueen had grown to Champion level!

"Oowoo~"

"Cha~"

Ninetales and Tinkaton also ran out from Johan's Poké Balls on their own, surrounding Nidoqueen and looking it up and down.

All old friends!

"Roar..."

Nidoqueen immediately scratched its head embarrassedly.

After nearly a year apart, although its growth rate was fast, these friends seemed to have grown even more astonishingly fast.

Both Gengar and Ninetales had reached levels that even made Nidoqueen feel dangerous, and even Tinkaton felt like an opponent Nidoqueen might not be able to handle.

Back then, these three little ones were no match for it.

Now not only had they completed the reversal, but it was a complete reversal with a huge lead...

But regardless.

The previously agreed "meeting at the summit" was achieved.

Everyone had become a "better" version of themselves!

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar was first to hug Nidoqueen, grinning mischievously as it inquired.

Hehe! Tell us, tell us! How did that Nidoking turn out? How are you doing now?

"Roar!"

Hearing this, Nidoqueen immediately raised its head proudly.

That Nidoking got beaten up by it and became obedient, but it beat him up every time they met. It hadn't seen him for over three months now!

"Oowoo~!"

Even the usually shy and quiet Ninetales felt "satisfied" hearing this and took Nidoqueen's hand.

"Roar!"

Nidoqueen became even more "proud," raising its hand and showing three fingers.

These three fingers indicated the current number of Nidoking it had!

"Ka-kaah?!"

"Oowoo?!"

"Cha?!"

Three?!

The three little ones exclaimed in unison.

Good grief!

The Nidoqueen that was once "dumped" by Nidoking now had three "boyfriends"?

Truly a case of not judging after three days!

No wait.

This was the dragon slayer becoming the dragon!

The four Pokémon immediately started playing around, the joyful atmosphere seeming to forget their current environment.

Johan obviously also recognized this Nidoqueen and was equally surprised.

What surprised him wasn't that Giovanni could train a Nidoqueen to Champion level in less than a year.

Honestly, this would definitely be considered fast for others, but for Giovanni it was actually somewhat slow.

You had to know.

Green, who had obtained Giovanni's "Mysteries of the Earth," had trained an entire team of Champion-level Pokémon in less than a year - the kind that could compete with Red!

As the owner of "Mysteries of the Earth" with massive resources, this wasn't surprising.

What surprised him was.

Was this Nidoqueen Giovanni's second team, third team, or not even on the third team?

And it was already Champion level.

Giovanni's real first team - wouldn't it be six legendaries?

Probably not that exaggerated...

"Its potential and ability are both good, and its mentality is especially excellent. There's still room for improvement." Giovanni said.

Johan clicked his tongue and shook his head.

Listen to that tone.

As if as long as Giovanni was willing to put in the effort to train them, Champion level was guaranteed.

And this seemed to be reality.

So annoying.

Without injuries and slowly mending his relationship with his son, Giovanni seemed to have a tendency to "evolve" into his complete form.

"President Lusamine is fine." After checking Lusamine's condition, Anabel looked up.

Johan nodded, and his conversation with Giovanni was brought back to the present.

He looked around and said: "If nothing unexpected happens, this should be the 'Ultra Deep Sea.'"

Johan had already made this judgment earlier, but Nihilego's appearance and possession of Lusamine had interrupted him.

Ultra Deep Sea?

There wasn't a single drop of water here...

Anabel looked puzzled.

But she quickly accepted it.

"Ultra Space" after all - having differences from the Pokémon world's understanding and definitions was normal.

"So this is the place." The Naganadel leader understood: "It's said that the 'Ultra Deep Sea' is inhabited by a group of strange Ultra Beasts that are very dangerous, so we've never come here."

With Johan's "positioning," the Naganadel leader barely determined their location and the direction they should head.

"Anabel." Johan suddenly spoke again.

"Yes?"

"Earlier, didn't you and Professor Burnet say that 'Ultra Space' and 'Ultra Wormholes' seemed to have a 'bidirectional reaction'?"

Johan looked at the surrounding Nihilego thoughtfully:

"What if a group of Nihilego sensed the thoughts and feelings of people in the Pokémon world, amplified and realized them - wouldn't that explain this phenomenon?"

"I see!"

Anabel immediately understood.

Combined with Nihilego's characteristics and their "idealistic" abilities, it really seemed to make sense.

The more they wanted to investigate "Ultra Space," the stronger this desire became, the more likely it was to trigger Nihilego's traits and resonate across space...

"No wonder we first came here, to the 'Ultra Deep Sea' rather than elsewhere."

Johan nodded: "Of course, President Lusamine's 'desire' might also be one of the important reasons we came here."

Ending their brief discussion, Johan said:

"Let's leave first. Our main purpose this time isn't to explore the connection between 'Ultra Space' and our world."

"Right!"

Anabel had no objections.

Interrupting Gengar and the others' reunion with Nidoqueen, Johan climbed onto Dragonite's back.

"Let's go. First let's find our main target or reach the target location."

With positioning established, the Naganadel leader carried Giovanni and led Johan and the others flying out of the "Ultra Deep Sea."

As long as they didn't fear Nihilego, no matter how many surrounded them, they wouldn't pose any real threat.

They charged straight through.

The Nihilego scattered to avoid them.

"Phero..."

In a corner, Pheromosa watched Giovanni recall Nidoqueen, hostility showing in its eyes.

Why did this guy have such a close relationship with Gengar, laughing and talking!

Teacher Johan's Pokémon Ninetales and Tinkaton were one thing, but this one...

"Phero!"

Pheromosa bit its lip and labeled Nidoqueen as a "love rival"!

The Ultra Deep Sea was vast.

But fortunately Dragonite and the others flew very fast, and they didn't seem to have landed in the center of the Ultra Deep Sea, so after flying for some time, they saw land.

It was just that this flight speed was somewhat taxing for Johan.

Just to quickly resolve the possible or imminent "trouble," he could only try using his own methods to distract himself.

For example...

"You're still not good enough, Gengar. You can't even hypnotize me - what kind of 'Hypnosis Master' are you?"

"Ka-kaah!"

The ghost immediately got angry and gave Johan a "loving lick."

"Numb, numb, so comfortable..." Johan looked "pleased."

Anabel: "..."

She gripped the Naganadel tightly, looking straight ahead.

As if she'd "seen" some "ultimate secret" she shouldn't have seen.

Teacher Johan actually had such "preferences" - would she be "silenced"?

Lusamine gradually woke up during the flight.

She remembered everything that had happened clearly, but the changes had been unexpected.

On one hand was shock at her own true inner thoughts, on the other was surprise at her feeling of "regret."

She seemed...

To really like Ultra Beasts too much.

She couldn't help thinking about capturing a group of Ultra Beasts as a "collection."

Fortunately, reason made her suppress this thought.

"Johan."

Suddenly.

Giovanni's serious voice came as the Naganadel leader descended.

Hm?

Johan and Anabel looked at each other and also descended.

"This is..."

When they landed and saw what was in front of them, they all showed surprise.

"A road?"

A... fairly well-constructed and solid roadway!

However, it seemed to have been unused for a long time, so it appeared somewhat abandoned.

"It seems 'Ultra Space' really does have people, at least beings with intelligence no less than humans." Anabel said.

"This roadway was built long ago. From the degree of abandonment... it's hard to say what the current situation is."

Johan remained relatively composed.

Wasn't this just "Ultra Megalopolis"?

As long as Necrozma wasn't imprisoned in the Ultra Megalopolis Tower, there wouldn't be much of a problem.

Giovanni's mouth curved slightly.

He actually wasn't worried about humans existing in "Ultra Space" - he rather hoped there were humans, because only beings capable of communication could potentially cooperate.

As for the high probability of fighting before cooperation...

Giovanni didn't fear war.

And if they could cooperate with humans in "Ultra Space," their "Rainbow Rocket Corporation" could completely... become a "middleman," or rather a "delivery service."

Other companies earned profits from inter-regional trade, while their "Rainbow Rocket Corporation" could earn massive profits from inter-dimensional trade!

"Let's continue."

Johan waved his hand.

Hoenn region, Mossdeep Space Center.

Steven received information from Molayne at the far-off Hokulani Observatory in the Alola region.

"Solar eclipse?"

"That's right." Molayne's voice carried some strange meaning: "According to our existing information records in the Alola region, there has... never been a solar eclipse phenomenon."

"Never occurred?"

Steven was somewhat surprised. Just as he was about to continue speaking, he heard Molayne say:

"I know, let alone solar eclipses - even total solar eclipses occur in the Pokémon world at least once every two years, just in different observable regions. The interval could be decades or over a century, but—"

"I understand what you mean." Steven was obviously surprised that the Alola region had never experienced a solar eclipse.

But... how was that possible?

Unless it wasn't recorded, but that shouldn't be the case either...

"So I wanted Mossdeep Space Center to confirm whether my observations are accurate."

Steven immediately found Mossdeep Space Center staff and received a definitive answer.

"Observations are accurate."

After pausing, he added:

"And this will very likely be an extremely large-scale total solar eclipse that will cover the entire Alola region. Such a large range is rarely seen in the world."

Molayne nodded.

"I have a feeling... this isn't a very good sign."

Hearing this, Steven suddenly had a thought: "Is Teacher Johan in the Alola region?"

"Teacher Johan?" Molayne was stunned and called his cousin Sophocles, also receiving a positive answer.

"He really is there..."

The two looked at each other through the video, both understanding each other's thoughts.

With Teacher Johan there, something big would probably happen.

But correspondingly.

With Teacher Johan there, this big event would at most be thrilling but safe, or might not even be thrilling at all.

Ultra Space.

A young man with a satellite-dish haircut wearing a white lab coat played with a small laptop in his hands, raising his eyebrows slightly.

"Finally here..."

# 731: Just a Mule

Alola region, Pokémon School.

"Good morning, Professor Kukui." Gladion arrived at the classroom early.

"Morning..." Professor Kukui, curled up under a white coat and wearing a hat, yawned long and said to Gladion.

Hm?

Watching Professor Kukui walk shakily step by step toward the office, confusion appeared in Gladion's eyes.

This wasn't like Professor Kukui's usual style - shouldn't he be energetically shouting "Alola"?

At this time.

Lillie, Kiawe, Mallow, Sophocles, Lana and others also arrived at school, discussing what had happened today.

It seemed...

Overnight, everyone had become lazy and tired - whether their parents, housekeepers, or people they met along the way.

"Let me tell you..."

Little fatty Sophocles, looking like he knew inside information, waved everyone over.

"Do you know about the Manalo Festival?" Seeing everyone gather around, Sophocles lowered his voice.

"Manalo Festival?" The kids looked at each other.

Gladion said flatly: "Every twenty-one years, a 'total solar eclipse' occurs in the Alola region, so every twenty-one years, we hold the Manalo Festival in Alola."

"Total solar eclipse?!" Everyone exclaimed.

Mallow asked curiously: "'Manalo' and 'Alola' - the two words are quite similar."

"'Alola' actually means 'everyone sharing together,' while 'Manalo' means 'you and I living here together.'" Lillie, who seemed to have recently studied this, explained.

"Put together, it means 'we live together and share together.'" Lana's face showed a smile.

"Feels so warm..." Mallow sighed.

Getting everyone's approval, they all unconsciously looked at their own Pokémon.

At this time, Sophocles ran to the podium, moved over a small stool and stood on it, coughed twice to get attention, then said:

"Actually, most of the Manalo Festival solar eclipses are fake!"

"Fake?!"

Everyone was stunned.

"How could there be solar eclipses every twenty-one years so regularly?"

Sophocles, seeing everyone's expressions, looked very satisfied and placed his Togedemaru on the podium.

"That's true..."

They'd heard that in other places, you might not see a solar eclipse once in hundreds of years, but in the Alola region, it happened every twenty-one years...

"Then why do solar eclipses occur? We haven't seen them, but the Island Kahunas and Queens should have seen them." Gladion frowned.

Sophocles grinned: "I don't know the specific reason either. I only know my cousin Molayne observed that a real solar eclipse is about to happen!"

"About to happen?"

"Yes!" Sophocles patted Togedemaru, and the small Electric Mouse Pokémon emitted a faint glow that grew brighter.

No, it wasn't that Togedemaru's light was getting brighter - the surrounding environment was getting darker!

"It's now!" Little fatty Sophocles quickly spread his arms.

A real solar eclipse seemed to be descending!

The kids immediately ran to the windows to look at the sun in the sky, and indeed there was a huge shadow about to cover the sun.

The solar eclipse had arrived without any warning?

Seeing his friends attracted by the solar eclipse, Sophocles puffed his cheeks and ran to the window with Togedemaru in his arms.

"According to my cousin Molayne's guess, our previous solar eclipses were very likely 'artificial.'"

"Artificial? What person could have such powerful strength?"

"Naturally the legendary 'Sun-Devouring Beast'!"

"Sun-Devouring Beast?!"

Instantly, everyone's minds conjured the existence from Alola's ancient history - some called it the "Sun-Devouring Beast," but more people were willing to respectfully call it the "Sun God."

But why would this "Sun God," which was revered as the sun, also "devour" the sun?

The more ancient the era, the less likely legendary Pokémon's "titles" were to be wrong.

There must be a reason...

Lillie said quietly: "I think I heard Teacher Johan mention before that he saw that 'Sun-Devouring Beast' in space."

Clap!

Sophocles slapped his palms together hard.

"Doesn't that match up perfectly!"

UB Task Force.

"The 'Ultra Aura' in the Alola region... is declining at an alarming rate..."

Professor Burnet yawned long, rubbing her messy hair.

Although she knew the matter was important, for some reason, she couldn't muster any energy at all.

"Outside, there's also news of a solar eclipse. How could a solar eclipse occur..." Wicke also completely lost her previous meticulous appearance, looking exhausted.

"Could it be related to Teacher Johan and the others entering the 'Ultra Wormhole'?"

Too coincidental.

Teacher Johan and the others had just entered the "Ultra Wormhole" last night at midnight, and today during the day a solar eclipse appeared, along with a massive decline in "Ultra Aura."

"It's possible..." Wicke nodded with effort.

"Then there should be danger, right?" Professor Burnet looked at Wicke.

"The President might encounter danger." Wicke also looked at her.

After the two struggled for a while, they completely collapsed on the sofa and said in unison lazily:

"It's fine, Teacher Johan is there..."

"It should be around here."

The Naganadel leader's voice echoed in everyone's minds.

Back then, the "Blinding One" had completely scattered its own light to counter a massive meteorite, causing it to fall to the ground.

Since then, all of "Ultra Space" had fallen into terrifying darkness.

Numerous plants and creatures slowly withered in this upheaval, and only some relatively powerful beings could survive in this great disaster and extremely harsh environment.

At that time, the Naganadel leader was still just a weak Poipole.

It vaguely remembered the location.

But the blurriness of memory, the changes of time, and environmental changes made the Naganadel leader uncertain.

"Haven't you thought about trying to awaken it again?" Anabel couldn't help asking.

The Naganadel leader shook its head.

"If it weren't for believing in Johan, I actually wouldn't bring you here." The Naganadel leader said.

"It has done enough for our 'Ultra Space.'"

This seemed to be a kind of tacit understanding among most Ultra Beasts who had witnessed Necrozma shatter the meteorite back then.

Unless it was truly necessary or they were confident, they'd rather let it rest well - rest until it fully recovered, rest until it could bring "Ultra Space" to greatness again.

This made Johan internally complain.

Both crashed into meteorites to save the world - why was the treatment so different?

The "Blinding One" Necrozma was tacitly protected by the Ultra Beasts.

While the "Original One" Arceus nearly got mercury poured down its throat.

One llama, one mule - same experience, different treatment...

"Cosmo!"

Just as Johan and the others continued approaching the location indicated by the Naganadel leader, Nebby Cosmoem in Johan's clothes suddenly called out and floated out on its own.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar tugged at Johan's clothes, pointing toward the pitch-black area in the distant valley.

Good grief, there seems to be something there even blacker than me!

Johan followed Gengar's gaze, his angular face gradually being "swallowed" by darkness, his eyes reflecting a small mountain constructed of pitch-black crystals.

"Ultra Space" was already pitch-black, but some adapted moss-like plants would emit faint light, and some special stones also glowed.

So Johan and the others, having somewhat adapted to the dark environment, could more or less see their surroundings.

But that canyon ahead.

Was completely dark, with no light emerging at all. Any faint glow that "approached" would be drawn in and disappear without a trace.

A pitch-black area, as if hiding something terrifying.

Johan half-closed his eyes.

"Finally found it..."

It wasn't in vain to actively enter "Ultra Space" to search.

Suddenly.

"Cosmo!!"

Nebby called out even more loudly.

The next second.

A huge black sphere appeared in Johan and the others' vision.

The black sphere was like a black hole, absorbing all surrounding light, yet also like a black "light source," emitting and spreading special black "radiance" that quickly spread outward, engulfing everything!

The world that had some faint light quickly fell into extremely black death.

"Alakazam!" Anabel immediately called out.

"Alakazam!"

Alakazam, holding two spoons, immediately burst with bright blue psychic light from its eyes. As the spoons in its hands quickly bent, they emitted brilliant light.

Flash!

However.

The light released by Alakazam seemed to become some kind of catalyst - the speed of the black radiance's spread suddenly accelerated. The originally brilliant light, upon encountering the black radiance, completely disappeared without any struggle.

"Shriek—"

In the thick darkness, a hissing roar rolled forth.

In the dense black area, several colorful triangles appeared.

"So fast, not giving any preparation time..." Johan looked at the darkness rushing like a tide and said softly.

The source of this darkness that quickly devoured light was naturally the legendary "Blinding One" that had lost its radiance - Necrozma!

It would devour and absorb all light it could consume, trying to restore its own power.

Logically speaking.

The slumbering Necrozma should need to sense the aura of Solgaleo and Lunala, sense the "light" on them, before breaking through the darkness to awaken, right?

But it seemed to have awakened early.

Even sparing the faint light from surrounding luminescent moss and stones - truly "desperate for food."

Darkness surged, ruffling Johan's hair.

Johan, riding Dragonite, came to the front of everyone, looking toward that existence vaguely approaching rapidly through the darkness.

"Seems some unexpected changes occurred beyond your predictions." Giovanni, riding the Naganadel leader, landed beside Johan.

Hearing this, Johan grinned without speaking.

Joke - things beyond my expectations are within my expectations!

He half-closed his eyes.

Aura!

Buzz—

The power of Aura immediately spread outward. Darkness could no longer block his "vision," along with a vibrant Viridian Force.

The next second.

What appeared in Johan and Giovanni's "vision" was a being entirely pitch-black, as if composed of inky crystals, radiating terrifying cold aura.

It spread those black crystal claws, its prism-like armor refracting and devouring light. Its head and back were covered with jagged spikes, and its prismatic eyes interwoven with rainbow triangular fragments held intense longing for light.

"Here it comes!" Johan called out softly.

Codename UB: Black, the legendary Cosmog Pokémon - Necrozma!

Ultra Space.

Outside the canyon where black radiance erupted, on a cliff.

A young man with satellite-dish hair wearing a white lab coat, holding a small laptop, stood here, taking binoculars in one hand to observe from afar.

"Very dangerous..." the young man said with a smile.

Behind him were a group of people wearing strange clothing somewhat similar to Gengar's "Ultra Space suit," with special masks.

"Lord Colress, with you taking action, do we need to worry about a few humans?"

If Johan were here, he would definitely be very surprised.

Colress?!

Colress, the top genius scientist of Team Plasma whose status was second only to Ghetsis, was actually in "Ultra Space"?

Wasn't he supposed to be controlled and imprisoned by the League along with Ghetsis?

Moreover, not just Colress - those people behind him were most likely Ultra Megalopolis people living in "Ultra Megalopolis" in "Ultra Space"!

How did these people get mixed together?

"You can't say that." Colress's smile remained unchanged.

"That Teacher Johan and Mr. Giovanni are not to be underestimated in strength - I'm no match for them."

He frankly admitted his inadequacy in strength.

However, the Ultra Megalopolis people behind him weren't surprised by this.

Because Lord Colress's greatest strength lay in his research and invention abilities.

And from his tone, he seemed... to be seeing Teacher Johan for the first time?

"What this guy says might not be completely trustworthy." That Ultra Megalopolis person looked at someone detained nearby.

Faba!

The former branch chief Faba who had fled the Aether Foundation and Aether Paradise after being exposed by Johan!

He now looked quite disheveled, glaring viciously at Colress.

"I asked you to help me, not to—"

Before Faba could finish, Colress waved his hand, and Faba's mouth was immediately gagged.

"Though he's useless, he's still diligent and has mastered some data I haven't encountered. For example..."

Pausing, he looked down and gently slid on his laptop.

"Opening 'Ultra Wormholes' from inside 'Ultra Space' is much easier than from the Pokémon world."

Buzz—

In the distant dark area.

Above.

A spiral "Ultra Wormhole" slowly appeared.

Endless pitch-black once again shrouded the earth.

Ultra Beasts hidden in various corners seemed to recall the great terror of when light disappeared and the sun fell.

"This is the 'Blinding One'?"

Giovanni frowned slightly - it felt... much worse than expected.

This was far inferior to Groudon!

If it was just a legendary Pokémon like this, Johan wouldn't need to call him over.

Seeing Giovanni's expression change, Johan smiled and made a "please" gesture.

Giovanni glanced at him sideways.

How could he not know Johan was definitely holding back information?

So he simply didn't move.

Seeing Giovanni unmoved and not taking the bait, Johan sighed inwardly.

He'd have to go first himself.

Little "UB: Black," come meet your death!

Buzz—

Suddenly an "Ultra Wormhole" opened in the air, and Lunala flew out somewhat confused with spread wings.

"Luna?"

"Shriek!!!"

Seeing Lunala, Necrozma immediately screeched loudly.

Johan's expression also changed.

Oh no!

The opponent's equipment has arrived!

Giovanni, save me!

# 732: Try Throwing a Master Ball? (Two-in-One Chapter)

"Woo!!!"

Lunala apparently hadn't expected that just as it flew out of the "Ultra Wormhole," it would immediately encounter the Necrozma it least wanted to face.

Or rather.

Even Lunala hadn't realized that Necrozma had actually awakened?

"Shriek!!"

Seeing Lunala, Necrozma decisively abandoned Johan and the others, as well as the restless Nebby Cosmoem in his arms, and pounced toward Lunala.

Gorgeous divine light burst from its eye sockets filled with triangular red, yellow, and blue colored patterns, then its originally dim body became as dazzling as daylight in an instant, transforming into countless milky white light beams that shot toward Lunala.

Photon Geyser!

One of Necrozma's signature moves, capable of determining attack type based on whether its highest stat was Special Attack or Physical Attack, but more often dealing mixed damage!

"Woo—"

Illuminated by the brilliant light, Lunala suddenly reacted, its huge bat-like wings flapping and flickering as dark black light surged from its body, trying to resist Necrozma's attack.

Moongeist Beam!

Using a Ghost-type move to counter Necrozma's Psychic-type move.

It had to be said, although Lunala was panicked, its instincts for battle selection were still there.

Boom!!

White light and black radiance collided, erupting in a huge roar accompanied by violent tremors in the air.

Johan frowned deeply.

He had to act quickly, otherwise if Necrozma devoured Lunala, the battle difficulty would...

Although Necrozma was in a just-awakened state, currently as "UB: Black" it only had base stats of 600 points, much weaker than ordinary first-class legendaries, but...

That was when facing other first-class legendaries. If facing Lunala or Solgaleo, it had an innate advantage against them.

Look at this.

"Woo!!"

Lunala blocked Necrozma's attack and, realizing that the current Necrozma was quite weak, suddenly felt like it could handle this.

It immediately spread its wings and soared up, its wings opening to become a pure white moon, with snow-white light forming an impact that struck toward Necrozma.

Moongeist Beam!

"Shriek!!"

However.

Necrozma directly ignored the attack from Lunala, shrieking as it swung its massive claws and flew toward Lunala.

And Lunala's Moongeist Beam landed on Necrozma's pitch-black crystal body, accompanied by a "buzz" sound, directly disappearing without causing much damage to Necrozma.

Prism Armor!

Necrozma's signature ability - when hit by super effective moves, damage is reduced by one-quarter!

And when facing attacks from Lunala and Solgaleo, the damage received was less than half!

The type disadvantage was too severe.

"Gengar!"

Seeing Necrozma already pouncing on the stunned Lunala, Johan called out sharply.

"Shadow Ball!"

"Ka-kaah~!"

When Necrozma and Lunala began fighting, Gengar had already moved between Necrozma and Lunala at Johan's signal.

Crimson light burst from Gengar's eyes as wisps of black Ghost-type mist drifted from its body, quickly spreading to the surroundings while a huge black sphere immediately appeared in its hands.

It hurled it viciously.

Exploding against Necrozma's Prism Armor.

Rumble!!

The Prism Armor rippled with distorted rainbow colors, and the shattered black crystals rapidly recovered at a visible speed.

Necrozma emerged from the black mist, its eyes full of ferocity while showing some wariness.

Just in terms of the threat it posed, this Gengar was even more dangerous than Lunala!

It was precisely due to Gengar's obstruction that Lunala successfully pulled away from Necrozma, calling out to Johan and nodding slightly in acknowledgment.

"Don't clash head-on with Necrozma, you should leave first! Leave this to us!" Johan said.

Hearing this.

Lunala hesitated somewhat.

After all, it was very clear about why Necrozma had fallen into slumber, and understood why Necrozma had become like this. If possible, it was actually willing to help Necrozma.

Moreover, this was after all related to itself and Solgaleo, so to just leave first...

"Shriek!!"

Just during Lunala's brief hesitation, Necrozma ignored Gengar and forcibly broke through the "ghostly aura" surrounding it, bringing its arms together and roaring.

Buzz—

Colorful light gushed from the prismatic crystals on its body, like raindrops, transforming into rainbow-colored lasers that bombarded toward Lunala.

Prismatic Laser!

Necrozma's strongest move!

"Oowoo!!"

Snowflakes suddenly began falling from the air, twisted membranes scattered down, and Ninetales crouched on the ground, its nine tails flowing and spreading, its expression serious as it released its power without reservation, with "Aurora Veil" stretching in front of Lunala.

"Victini, help!" Johan shouted loudly.

"Vii~"

Victini, which had been maintaining its invisible state, immediately made a "V" gesture toward Ninetales, with the "V"-shaped flame on its forehead representing victory.

"Light Screen" also appeared in front of the "Aurora Veil" while granting Ninetales infinite energy enhancement.

Crack crack crack—

Under the terrifying laser bombardment, Light Screen and Aurora Veil shattered in succession, but finally stopped in front of the ice wall that Ninetales had condensed.

Fortunately, it was blocked...

Johan secretly breathed a sigh of relief while glaring at Lunala in annoyance.

Are you leaving or not?!

Who has their own "crystal" disobediently running out to wander around during a team fight?

Being glared at like this by Johan, plus what had just happened, finally made Lunala realize that its presence seemed to be holding them back.

So it finally stopped hesitating.

"Woo!!"

Turning to slash through space, it opened another "Ultra Wormhole" and flew into it.

Johan was about to say not to run to the Pokémon world, but seeing Lunala had already disappeared, he swallowed his words.

Whatever, as long as the "crystal" ran away.

"Shriek!!"

Seeing Lunala drill into the "Ultra Wormhole," Necrozma shrieked and tried to chase after it.

But Gengar appeared in front of it.

"Ka-kaah~"

Where are you going? Let me play with you first~

Shadow Ball!

The pitch-black hole immediately enveloped Necrozma.

"This kind of 'Blinding One' is indeed somewhat disappointing." Giovanni's Poké Ball in his hand shrank.

Just looking at the strength Necrozma was currently displaying, Johan alone would be enough to easily suppress it, without even giving him a chance to act.

However.

If things could be resolved this easily, that would be a good thing.

However.

Giovanni had just put away his Poké Ball when he raised an eyebrow and looked toward a distant cliff.

The next moment.

Whoosh—

A very fast beam of light shot over.

"Shriek!!"

Gengar's Shadow Ball restricted Necrozma, but obviously couldn't defeat it. Countless rainbow-colored lasers gushed out again, tearing the black hole apart.

It glared viciously at Gengar and Ninetales, with the two Pokémon one in front and one behind, blocking its path.

But then Necrozma grabbed at the void in front of it with both hands, its massive claws deeply embedding into the void.

Crack!! Crack crack—

Dense cracks immediately appeared like shattered barriers, and with a "bang" explosion, Necrozma actually forcibly opened an "Ultra Wormhole"!

It was trying to escape!

No, it was trying to chase Lunala!

But Lunala had already left...

"Johan!"

Giovanni's voice suddenly came.

Immediately after.

Buzz—

Bee wings trembled and hummed, a pale green light suddenly shot out, and bright white bee stingers like spears pierced through a rapidly approaching device about the size of two palms.

Beedrill!

Hm?

Following the sound, Johan saw Giovanni's Beedrill, and on Beedrill's sharp long stinger was a pierced... device?!

How could there be a device flying from "Ultra Space"?

Johan, who was focused on Necrozma, hadn't noticed. If not for Giovanni's reminder and Beedrill's timely intervention, he might not have noticed until the device got close.

The two exchanged glances.

Then both looked toward a distant towering cliff.

Zzt zzt zzt—

Golden arcs jumped on the device pierced by Beedrill, and the energy bar display on it had already returned to zero.

"This is..." Johan withdrew his gaze, his pupils contracting slightly.

"Shriek!!"

Necrozma roared again, tearing through space. In the "Ultra Wormhole" it had opened, the other side actually revealed... Lunala?!

"Woo?"

Honestly, Lunala hadn't expected that Necrozma could forcibly intercept it from halfway through the "Ultra Wormhole."

In the vast space, how did it lock onto the coordinates?

"Necro-Lunala Fusion Device!" Johan gritted his teeth.

The device pierced by Beedrill was, as expected, the "Necro-Lunala Fusion Device"!

Created by Colress combining the "Gene Wedge" with data and experience from the fusion of Kyurem, Reshiram, and Zekrom, a device that could "help" Necrozma and Lunala fuse!

But wasn't Colress supposed to have been captured?

Unable to figure this out for now.

Johan only knew.

Due to some unknown reasons, his "crystal"... was about to be stolen!

"Let's go!"

Seeing Lunala and Necrozma disappear into the "Ultra Wormhole," Johan mounted Dragonite and chased after them with Gengar and Ninetales.

Giovanni cast an interested glance toward the distant cliff once more before riding the Naganadel leader and following.

Anabel and Lusamine were currently in a state of confusion, but seeing Johan and Giovanni leave, they still chased after them.

"How terrifying..."

On a cliff in Ultra Space far from the previous battle, Colress, his face pale, took a deep breath.

If not for Necrozma's situation attracting Johan and Giovanni's attention, Colress had no doubt that if the two had chased over, they could have easily dealt with him.

As a scientist, while his strength was quite formidable compared to ordinary trainers, compared to legendary-level trainers like Johan and Giovanni, the gap was far too large.

However, while Colress's face was pale, the excitement in his face and eyes was completely undisguised.

He looked down at the data on his laptop.

"This was a very successful invention!"

The "Necro-Lunala Fusion Device" could indeed help Necrozma and Lunala fuse!

Although Necrozma seemed to already be able to "devour" Lunala, different from the situation with Kyurem, Zekrom, and Reshiram, the "Necro-Lunala Fusion Device" could still assist and accelerate the fusion process.

He looked back at the controlled Faba and smiled:

"I still have to thank you for 'bringing' me to this world. This has given me motivation for research again."

"Mmm! Mmm mmm mmm—" The bound Faba struggled, his eyes full of regret.

After being exposed by Johan that time, he had fled the Aether Foundation and gone to one of his secret research facilities on Melemele Island.

He had originally wanted to gain Lusamine's favor again through brilliant research results on "Ultra Wormholes" and "Ultra Space," so that his punishment wouldn't be too severe.

So he had risked conducting research again, opening an "Ultra Wormhole."

But it seemed...

Something went wrong with the experiment, and he actually received information from the opened passage.

And it was highly classified information about space and the universe, with the other party telling him they could help him further his research.

Faba, who was already at his wit's end, had thus... opened "Pandora's Box."

This person named Colress had actually... come from another universe!

That was a universe without Johan, where Team Plasma had controlled the "Tao Trio" and grown powerful!

Alola region, Altar of the Sunne.

The sun in the sky had already been "devoured" by more than half, and the entire world had become dark.

Professor Burnet, wearing pajamas, scratched her messy hair in distress.

"The cause has been found. There's a small 'Ultra Wormhole' here that's massively absorbing the 'Ultra Aura' from the Alola region..."

Professor Kukui yawned, tears squeezing from his eyes.

"Can, can it be blocked?"

"So troublesome..."

Wicke from the Aether Foundation was brazenly eating snacks. "This can't continue. I feel like I'll gain at least two sizes."

Between lazy and fat, Wicke ultimately wanted to overcome the threat posed by "fat."

"Yeah..." Professor Kukui wiped the tears from the corners of his eyes and looked at his phone. "If this continues, the already poor transportation in the Alola region will be completely ruined."

Except for Ula'ula Island, the entire Alola region could be said to be in chaos.

The Island Kahunas were also trying hard to restrain their inner laziness to maintain order, but with little effect.

"It can't be blocked." Professor Burnet suddenly said. She tried hard to lift her drooping eyelids and pointed to the sky: "The 'Ultra Wormhole' is about to open."

Everyone looked up.

Buzz—

An "Ultra Wormhole" suddenly opened in the sky.

"Shriek—"

A shrieking sound came from within the "Ultra Wormhole."

"Lunala?"

Seeing the Pokémon flying out of the "Ultra Wormhole," Professor Kukui and the others were somewhat surprised.

But immediately after, black lightning burst from the rapidly shrinking "Ultra Wormhole," and a huge pitch-black claw grabbed onto the opening.

"There's another one?!"

Professor Burnet also exclaimed in surprise.

And Lunala had just flown out of the "Ultra Wormhole" when its body uncontrollably flew backward toward the black creature, as if it possessed some kind of magnetism that made it lose control.

When Lunala came into contact with the pitch-black creature.

"Woo—!!!" Lunala let out a painful cry.

"Shriek—"

The pitch-black creature let out a satisfied, excited roar.

Buzz—

Large amounts of "light" immediately burst from Lunala's body, being rapidly absorbed and consumed.

"Lunala's Ultra Aura is rapidly flowing away..." Professor Burnet shouted with what little excitement she could muster.

Immediately after.

The black prismatic creature's body actually separated piece by piece, fitting onto Lunala's body. Each piece of black crystal that fell was accompanied by Lunala's painful cries.

And the sun in the sky was completely covered by shadow at this very moment.

The entire world seemed to fall into darkness, with only the fusing Lunala emitting weak light.

"Tsk, the speed in the 'Ultra Wormhole' was really fast..."

Johan, who flew out of the "Ultra Wormhole" a few steps slower, looked at the scene before him and couldn't help clicking his tongue.

"Still got 'base rushed.'"

Who could have expected that a "Necro-Lunala Fusion Device" would suddenly appear, allowing Lunala, which had already escaped, to be locked onto by Necrozma again.

Giovanni, who flew out right after Johan, frowned and asked:

"Do you know who it was?"

"I have a rough guess." Johan looked at Giovanni with some deeper meaning and said through gritted teeth: "Sooner or later I'll settle accounts with him. Giovanni, are you in?"

Giovanni glanced at him sideways and said nothing.

Johan sighed inwardly.

Giovanni was still the hardest to "fool."

"Shriek!!!"

Lunala, "wearing" the prismatic armor, had completely changed appearance, its crimson eyes sweeping over Johan and the others as it shrieked.

"Dawn Wings" form Necrozma!

"In the end, we still ran into it." Johan shook his head.

Good thing he had "summoned" Giovanni early.

And having "fused" with Lunala, Necrozma finally turned its attention back to Johan, or rather to Nebby in his arms.

Time for a team fight!

Landing on Dragonite's back, Johan took a deep breath.

"Shadow Ball, Moonblast!"

"Ka-kaah!"

Darkness might represent fear for other Pokémon, but for Gengar it was also one of its "home fields"!

"Oowoo—"

The snow-white fur on Ninetales' body emitted gentle white light, becoming another moon under the "total solar eclipse." A cluster of light flew toward the cloudy sky, forming a round moon that scattered down.

Boom!!

Having gained Lunala's power, Necrozma's strength had greatly increased, now no weaker than ordinary first-class legendaries. The prismatic armor on its body twisted in spirals before quickly returning to calm.

"Shriek!"

Roaring wantonly.

The prism on its chest continuously gathered rainbows, and laser beams much stronger than before scattered in all directions, like Arceus's Judgment, falling toward Johan's location from all sides.

"Oowoo!"

Ninetales flashed in front of Johan, ice crystals more brilliant than light screens, distorted and dazzling. Under the continuous bombardment of laser beams, the Aurora Veil twisted and shook.

"Vii!"

Victini made a "yeah" gesture, showing its small fangs as it reached out to touch the ice wall and Aurora Veil, further strengthening them with infinite energy.

Facing the storm-like laser beams, Ninetales continuously maintained the Aurora Veil as an acrid burning smell rose around them.

"The 'mule' is still brutal..." Johan felt the continuously rising temperature around them and murmured softly.

To be able to raise the ambient temperature despite Ninetales' Ice-type power - worthy of being a legendary Pokémon.

"Mmm!"

Nebby in Johan's arms twisted its body, seeming to want to join the battle and help.

"You sit this one out." Johan held the little one down.

Having already lost one "crystal," at least there was still a "backup."

The main base was still there!

Besides.

He wasn't the only one here.

"Tyranitar!"

Behind Johan, Giovanni rolled up his sleeves while calling out in a deep voice.

A burly, robust Tyranitar had already appeared beside him, its black rough armor incredibly hard as it walked step by step toward Necrozma.

After observing earlier, Giovanni had already determined most of Necrozma's basic information, so...

"Shriek!!"

Necrozma gathered rainbow light again, laser beams bombing toward Tyranitar.

Giovanni stood on the earth with a confident smile.

After the battle with Groudon.

His strength, which hadn't improved for years, had advanced again.

So Giovanni realized.

Perhaps.

Fighting legendary Pokémon and engaging with more legendaries would be a good choice, and Johan's rapid strength improvement might also be related to his contact and battles with so many legendaries.

"Mega Evolution!"

The ring in Giovanni's hand burst with brilliant light, quickly connecting with Tyranitar, which also immediately erupted in dazzling evolutionary light.

With Ultra Aura being rapidly absorbed and Z-moves difficult to use, Mega Evolution was unaffected.

Boom boom boom!!

"Bangira?"

The Poké Ball at Johan's waist opened, and his Tyranitar came out on its own, looking at the other Tyranitar that was Mega Evolving and scratching its head lightly.

This guy... feels really strong.

Johan's expression was strange.

First ball-contained attacks, now exploiting the "evolution invincibility" bug.

Giovanni was still skilled at this.

Necrozma's laser light was offset by the Mega Evolution's glow.

"Tyranitar, Payback!"

Mega Tyranitar tore through the rainbow light of super evolution, stepping on continuously rising rocks as it pounced toward Necrozma.

"Shriek!!"

Necrozma immediately felt a huge threat and tried to dodge.

However.

"Gengar!"

With Giovanni not holding back, Johan, who had summoned him, naturally had no intention of continuing to observe.

Gengar no longer held back, fully activating its "ghostly aura."

It immediately appeared to Necrozma's left, with thick Ghost-type energy churning into black smoke as it hurled a pitch-black Shadow Ball, forcing Necrozma to dodge in another direction.

"Oowoo!"

Ninetales appeared gracefully on the other side, a palm-sized pink slate faintly visible on its body. The falling moonlight was something even Necrozma didn't dare take head-on.

So Necrozma tried to dodge upward, pulling away from the distance.

Buzz—

The trembling of bee wings accompanied by slight air vibrations. Before it could fly upward, Necrozma felt a chill on its head and instinctively dove downward.

A pale green arc aimed at vital points was barely dodged.

On all sides were guys that posed great threats to it!

"Four, four legendary Pokémon?"

Professor Kukui in the distance, watching this scene, immediately widened his eyes. Even laziness and exhaustion couldn't block his inner shock.

When had legendary-level become so "common"?

Or was he just ignorant?

Four legendary-level Pokémon appearing at once?

What he wanted to say was actually what Necrozma wanted to complain about at this moment.

When it had awakened before, the Alola region hadn't been this outrageous.

The four Island Guardian Deities plus slates weren't as powerful as them, right?

This was still with it having fused with Lunala. If it hadn't had Lunala, might it have been instantly defeated?

Moreover...

How did these four guys coordinate so seamlessly?

Whether Gengar, Ninetales, Mega Tyranitar, or Beedrill, any of them could be the main attacker, and any of them could restrain it to create opportunities for other Pokémon.

Are you all from the same family?

Bang!!!

Necrozma was swatted away by Mega Tyranitar's claw, crashing hard into an ice wall.

The ice crystals on that wall seemed to come alive, continuously spreading onto its body, as if trying to freeze it solid.

In the blink of an eye, Necrozma was covered by ice crystals.

Of course, completely stopping its movement wasn't realistic, but it could slightly hinder its actions.

"That's about enough." Giovanni loosened his collar tie. "It just awakened not long ago, its energy is severely depleted, plus it just 'captured' Lunala, the compatibility isn't enough, so it can't fully display its strength."

"If we wait for it to rest longer or absorb more aura energy from the Alola region, it won't be so easy to deal with."

Johan nodded, also understanding Necrozma's condition.

Moreover, the longer Lunala was "captured," the greater the harm to Lunala.

After all.

Necrozma had been given too little time, and its opponents... were too strong!

Too well prepared!

"Then... let's finish it off!"

Strike while it's down!

"Tyranitar, Crunch!"

Mega Tyranitar rose from the ground again, stepping on rocks and earth as if riding waves. The moment Necrozma broke free from the ice crystal restraints, it firmly clamped it down and bit viciously at its shoulder.

Crack crack crack!!!

The pitch-black prismatic crystals continuously shattered and repaired!

Mega Tyranitar successfully restrained Necrozma again, holding it tight!

"Beedrill, Swords Dance!"

Buzz—

Green arcs immediately flashed in the air, bright white sharp stingers moving like spears, getting faster and faster while momentum climbed at a terrifying rate.

Crimson compound eyes locked onto the weak points on Necrozma's body.

A power filled with vigorous vitality flowed into its body, making Beedrill's speed soar again, so fast it seemed to vanish into thin air.

Speed is power!

Bang!!!

The terrifying stinger fell.

The black prisms on Necrozma's body shattered and exploded.

"Gengar, full power, Shadow Ball!"

"Ka-kaah—"

The huge black sphere quickly transformed to only half the size of a palm. As Mega Tyranitar and Beedrill's attacks landed, it appeared behind Necrozma with a grinning expression, gently tossing that Shadow Ball, which looked dozens of times smaller, onto Necrozma.

In an instant.

The prismatic armor on Lunala's back cracked, transforming into small black crystal fragments that Gengar inhaled with a single breath.

Necrozma: ???

No.

Are you serious?

"Ninetales, Fairy-type, Moonblast!"

"Oowoo!!"

The Fairy Plate floated out clearly, a round moon seeming to fall from the sky. Snow-white light illuminated the surroundings, dispelling darkness and awakening Lunala.

A few days ago, it was your moonlight that helped me reach legendary status.

Now, I use this moonlight to help you regain consciousness!

"Woo!!"

Lunala struggled up, the large amount of shattered black prisms on its body reducing Necrozma's restraint on it considerably.

"Shriek!!"

Necrozma glared at Mega Tyranitar.

At such close range, with such powerful energy impact, you'll get hurt too!

"Bangira!!"

Mega Tyranitar's eyes flashed with ferocity.

Then you go first!

Light, power, energy - various forces reflected on Necrozma's face, making its expression particularly complex and colorful.

I suspect you deliberately lured me over here to kill me.

And I have evidence!

Boom!!!

A massive impact exploded brilliant fireworks in the dim sky above the Altar of the Sunne.

"Woo—"

Lunala, also affected by the aftermath, flew out somewhat disheveled from the black smoke, with some surprise in its eyes.

If it hadn't trusted Johan, it would have felt earlier that Johan and Giovanni were going to crush it along with Necrozma.

At the same time.

A shattered, crack-covered pitch-black massive figure also crashed down from the rolling smoke, falling into the canyon and stirring up large clouds of white smoke.

Even after suffering such an attack, Necrozma wouldn't lose its fighting ability, and its injuries would rapidly recover under the gathering Ultra Aura of the Alola region.

It's just that with more serious injuries, the recovery speed would be slower.

"Gengar!"

Johan shouted loudly, "Join me in hypnotizing it!"

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar appeared at the bottom of the canyon, in front of Necrozma, meeting Necrozma's complex gaze as it used Hypnosis.

"Shriek..."

Necrozma still wanted to struggle, but suddenly a drowsiness it hadn't felt for a long time swept over it. After barely glancing at Gengar and Johan, it collapsed and fell into deep sleep.

Giovanni also looked deeply at Johan and Gengar.

This kind of hypnosis...

"Oowoo—"

Ninetales immediately landed beside the sleeping Necrozma and breathed out white frost.

Crack crack crack—

Snow-white ice crystals rapidly froze Necrozma.

Once, twice, three times...

Before long, the canyon was buried in ice crystals.

Johan: "..."

"Ninetales, that's enough. If you freeze it more, we won't be able to find it later."

"Oowoo..."

Ninetales looked warily at the thick ice layer.

It will still recover...

"I know, I know." He quickly comforted the little one. "So what we need to do next is help the real 'Blinding One' recover."

"The real 'Blinding One'?"

Giovanni also came to Johan's side. Facing his gaze, he inconspicuously stepped two paces to the side.

Johan: "..."

Giovanni, those two steps... are quite hurtful.

However, when Johan and Giovanni's gazes met, both couldn't help but have the same thought.

Giovanni: Should we try to capture it?

Johan: Try throwing a Master Ball?
