# 733: Blinding One, Ultra Necrozma! (Two-in-One Chapter)

In the end, Johan still overcame those somewhat overly bold thoughts in his mind.

After all, this was Necrozma, theoretically an existence that could match Arceus. Setting aside whether a Master Ball could capture it, even if it was captured, that didn't mean a bond was established or that it wouldn't "betray" them.

When that time came, the trouble would be enormous.

"We can't seal it for long. The Ultra Aura in the Alola region is still continuously draining away." Giovanni said in a deep voice.

"Mm."

Johan nodded.

"So what we need to do next is gather 'light' and inject it into Necrozma's body, allowing it to recover into the true 'Blinding One.'"

"The true 'Blinding One'?" Giovanni frowned. "Are you sure that after it recovers, it won't continue attacking us?"

After the earlier clash and Necrozma's form changes, Giovanni had already realized that the Necrozma they had seen before was far from reaching the level of the "Blinding One."

If it was just Dawn Wings form Necrozma, he and Johan working together could still suppress it.

But if it recovered into the true "Blinding One," it would probably be much more formidable than even Primal Groudon, right?

"It's said that the legendary 'Blinding One' is a kind, gentle, and friendly existence that once brought light to the Alola region. The words 'Alola' and 'Manalo' together meaning 'we live together and share together' actually refers to Necrozma's will."

After pausing, Johan continued:

"However, for safety's sake, if the recovered 'Blinding One' really continues to lose control, I'll invite friends to deal with it together."

This wasn't Ultra Space, but the Pokémon world.

In the Pokémon world, with Johan's network of connections, even the complete "Blinding One" would have to behave obediently.

"Alright."

Giovanni pondered briefly before nodding.

He actually wanted to see what kind of strength the complete Ultra Necrozma, the "Blinding One," truly possessed.

Having witnessed the "super team battle" between Hoopa and Hoopa Unbound, Giovanni was also full of confidence in Johan's friends.

Moreover.

He, Giovanni, wasn't someone who feared difficulties and battles.

If there was an opportunity.

It wouldn't be impossible to spar with Ultra Necrozma.

"How do you plan to do it?"

"Boil Gengar into soup."

"Ka-kaah?! Σ(дlll)"

Gengar nearby pointed at itself in bewilderment.

Me?

Boil into soup?

I don't have bones!

"Cough cough..." Johan waved his hand. "Slip of the tongue, slip of the tongue. I spoke too quickly."

Hearing this, Gengar patted its chest and let out a long sigh of relief.

Nearly scared the ghost to death.

"Actually, the so-called 'light' is the Ultra Aura of the Alola region, and the Ultra Aura of the Alola region originally came from Necrozma, so we just need to return it to it."

It sounded simple, but doing it was obviously not just a matter of talking.

Moreover...

Giovanni frowned.

"If we return all the Ultra Aura of the Alola region to Necrozma, then Ultra Aura and Z-moves won't be able to function, right?"

"Correct."

Johan didn't deny it, but also said: "So we need more 'light.'"

At this time, Professor Kukui, Professor Burnet, Wicke and others, although sluggish, still approached.

They had heard the conversation between Johan and Giovanni.

"More 'light'? We don't even have the sun now. How can we do that?" Professor Burnet scratched her messy hair.

"Who says 'light' necessarily needs the sun, needs Ultra Aura?" A smile appeared on Johan's face.

"'Light' belongs to the 'Blinding One' Ultra Necrozma, but it equally belongs to each of us, every Pokémon."

"When our hearts are filled with light, we become light sources ourselves."

Light belongs to everyone, every Pokémon?

Everyone present was stunned.

Seeing they still didn't understand, Johan continued: "Still don't get it? Manalo Festival, Alola region, 'Alola,' 'Manalo.'"

Professor Kukui was first to react, "You mean..."

He stretched out both hands, touching his index fingers and thumbs together to form a triangular shape.

"So this is the true meaning of the Manalo Festival? The Manalo Festival that occurs every twenty-one years has actually been rehearsing and preparing for this moment?"

Johan gently touched Nebby Cosmoem in his arms.

When he first encountered Solgaleo in space, Johan had been quite surprised.

Although Solgaleo was called the legendary Cosmic Pokémon and being active in space was normal, there were obviously still strange aspects.

Now it seemed.

The "total solar eclipse" that appeared in the Alola region every twenty-one years was actually Solgaleo silently contributing, blocking the sun at that moment, right?

So in ancient times, it was called the "Sun-Devouring Beast."

And now.

It was time to "check the results"!

Although Ultra Aura was still being absorbed by Necrozma, after fusing with Lunala once and being hypnotized and frozen, the rate of Ultra Aura loss gradually slowed, and Professor Kukui and the others' mental states recovered considerably.

"I'll immediately notify the Island Kahunas."

"You finally came."

Johan looked at the four Island Guardian Deities that appeared and said.

"Koko~"

Tapu Koko and the other three Island Guardian Deities looked at each other.

They naturally also sensed the Ultra Aura changes in the Alola region and understood that Necrozma had awakened.

But to truly restore Necrozma, they were still missing a crucial element.

The Sun God, Solgaleo!

Although Nebby had greatly shortened its energy accumulation under Lunala and the Altar of the Sunne, it ultimately still hadn't evolved into Solgaleo. In this situation, its power might...

"Where there's a will, there's a way."

Johan smiled as he touched Nebby, saying to Tapu Koko: "Don't underestimate the Pokémon of the entire Alola region. Their combined power won't be inferior to Solgaleo's."

The four Island Guardian Deities looked at each other and finally all nodded.

No matter what.

The arrow was already nocked on the string and had to be released.

"Melemele Island, Manalo Festival preparations complete, all trainers with Z-moves assembled!"

On the temporarily set up screen, Melemele Island's Island Kahuna Hala stood on the festival stage in Hau'oli City, reporting the situation.

Ula'ula Island's Island Kahuna Nanu also changed from his previous laziness, leading the island's residents.

"Ula'ula Island, ready!"

"Akala Island, ready!"

"Poni Island, ready! We believe that the long night will pass, and a brilliant future awaits us!"

All residents and trainers throughout the Alola region received messages from the Island Kahunas, broadcasts from the Aether Foundation, and emergency notifications from the Alola League.

Whether gathering at festival venues or at their own doorsteps, they looked up expectantly in the darkness.

"Koko~~"

Tapu Koko was first to move.

Firefly-like orange light points scattered from its body, passing through layers of ice crystals to land on the unconscious Necrozma.

Immediately after, the other three Island Guardian Deities also moved, releasing their respective "light" and gathering it on Necrozma.

This seemed to be a signal.

From every corner of the Alola region, these seemingly weak light points and lines began drifting.

One by one, more and more, the Alola region, originally dim under the total solar eclipse, slowly brightened under these light points, showing a hazy radiance.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar also formed a triangle shape with its hands, and pitch-black light points drifted from its body.

"Ka-kaah?"

Eh?

Looking at the black light points drifting from itself, Gengar turned to look at its companions.

Ninetales, Tinkaton, Dragonite and other Pokémon were all fine, even Buzzwole and Kartana emitted orange light points. How come only it emitted black light points?

"Ka-kaah..."

Gengar showed some hesitation.

If Necrozma absorbed these black light points, wouldn't it... suffer from malnutrition?

Whatever.

At worst it would get diarrhea!

"Ka-kaah!"

You can't be picky about my 'light' - you have to accept it all!!

Gengar swallowed a Will-O-Wisp, its whole body glowing as it worked hard to release its black light points.

It's not like I'm the one eating it anyway.

Johan glanced at Gengar with a strange expression.

This purple fatty's 'light' was all black.

Should be fine, right?

Crack!!

The massive ice crystals cracked open, revealing huge fissures as shrieking sounds came from deep within the solid ice.

"Shriek—"

Necrozma, pitch-black all over, gradually gained a thin layer of golden transparent coating under the illumination of this 'light.' As it regained consciousness, its power and aura were rapidly climbing.

"It's working!" Professor Burnet shouted excitedly.

She watched the screen while maintaining her gesture, seeing the Ultra Aura readings at Necrozma's location rapidly soaring.

"But it feels far from enough. This is just making Necrozma stronger..."

Lusamine, who had recovered somewhat, also maintained her gesture, but wasn't optimistic about Necrozma's condition.

"Tapu Koko, help me connect with all the Pokémon in the Alola region."

Johan called up to the four Island Guardian Deities in the sky.

"Koko~"

Tapu Koko and the other Island Guardian Deities didn't hesitate, their eyes glowing faintly as telepathy rapidly spread outward.

Johan's aura also spread, borrowing the Island Guardian Deities' "amplifiers" to let his voice resonate in the hearts of every Pokémon in the Alola region.

"Hello, hello, is Akuya there? Is Akuya there?"

Tapu Koko: "?"

"Cough, testing the mic."

Johan coughed lightly, his expression gradually becoming serious as he quickly thought about how to make the Pokémon of the Alola region understand the situation and contribute their "light."

The next moment.

Johan's expression became serious, his voice deep as he slowly spoke a few words.

"God said, let there be light!"

Wild Pokémon throughout the Alola region left their nests, listening to the voice appearing in their minds and looking at each other in confusion.

Tapu Koko: "..."

The four Island Guardian Deities looked at each other and decisively cut off Johan's speech.

If you can't speak properly, don't make a sound. No one thinks you're mute!

"Koko~~"

Finally, the four Island Guardian Deities personally took action, conveying their respective wills to the wild Pokémon of the Alola region.

Now the wild Pokémon understood.

In the Seafolk Village, Chinchou, Lanturn, Wishiwashi and other Water-type Pokémon released their respective "light."

At Wela Volcano, Magnemite, Magneton, Magnezone, Probopass and other Pokémon shot out electric arc "light."

In Poni Canyon, Jangmo-o, Hakamo-o, and Kommo-o also released their respective "light."

For a moment.

The light points that originally just made the entire Alola region dimly bright rapidly multiplied, quickly gathering in the air and flowing into Necrozma's body.

Boom!!!

The thick ice crystals completely shattered, and Necrozma, covered in fluorescent light all over its pitch-black body, shrieked as its aura rapidly climbed, while its fierce presence made everyone around feel a chill in their hearts.

At this rate, whether Necrozma could recover was uncertain, but they would probably have to face Necrozma's attacks first.

"Woo!"

After emergency treatment, Lunala, having recovered some strength, flew up again, gazing at Necrozma with alert eyes.

Behave yourself, we're helping you!

Lunala tried to communicate with Necrozma, however...

"Shriek!!"

Necrozma shrieked again, its colorful gaze locked tightly on Lunala, eyes filled with desire.

And just then.

"Cha!"

A small figure with pink pigtails, petite and agile, carrying a huge hammer, took three steps in two, stepping on Necrozma's pitch-black body to reach its head.

Tinkaton!

The little one's expression was serious yet excited, holding the big hammer in one hand and grasping a pink Fairy Plate in the other, then...

Pressed the plate onto the hammer.

Buzz—

The entire hammer radiated powerful pink light.

With the "Fairy Plate's" enhancement, Tinkaton's hammer was now even more formidable than the sword and shield of Zacian and Zamazenta!

Aiming at Necrozma's head, it swung the hammer in a full circle and struck down heavily.

Bang!!!

Necrozma, which had just broken free from the ice crystal restraints and was roaring violently, whimpered and fell to the ground, unconscious.

Island Guardian Deities: "..."

Lunala: "..."

Giovanni: "..."

Tinkaton, standing on Necrozma's head, grinned to show its white teeth, smiled at everyone, and rubbed its nose.

"Cha~"

Hehe, showing off, showing off a bit.

"Is this the 'Hammer Sleep Technique' from Johan's 'Five Great Hypnosis Arts'..." Professor Kukui murmured, feeling the back of his head getting cold.

"Continue!" Johan called out loudly.

At the same time, he said to Servine: "Servine, plants are also part of Alola!"

"Servine! (#`皿′)"

Don't teach me, I, I've wanted to do this for a long time!

Rustle rustle—

Poni Canyon was mostly desert with few trees.

But few didn't mean none. Some green plants also scattered weak "light" under Servine's "call."

Hm?

Sensing the changes in the surrounding plant environment, Giovanni couldn't help but look sideways at Servine.

This Servine...

Although its strength wasn't very strong, this ability... made him feel familiar, feel close.

"The same power from the forest?" Giovanni murmured softly.

"Then let me help you out!"

A surge of Viridian Force immediately flowed into Servine's body.

"Servine?"

Suddenly, Servine felt as if it sensed vast forest breath. Its power, its perception and influence over forests and plants... were all rapidly climbing.

This scene made Johan look over.

"'Forest's Blessing' plus 'Viridian Force'?"

So the power most suitable for Servine was indeed "Viridian Force"?

Or was Giovanni's "Viridian Force" simply too powerful?

Servine's strength actually temporarily shot up to Champion level!

Outrageous.

When it came to cheating, it had to be "Viridian Force" - completely ignoring basic principles.

Rustle rustle—

The forest leaves were cheering.

The "light" belonging to plants also drifted bit by bit from the forest.

One forest influenced another forest. Although Servine plus Giovanni's "Viridian Force" expanded their influence, it wasn't enough to cover the entire Alola region. The Island Guardian Deities also contributed to this.

If someone could overlook the Alola region from above at this moment, they would see that in this dim world, the entire Alola region radiated a light full of hope and love.

Stream after stream of light gathered at Poni Island, at Poni Canyon, at Necrozma.

The light screen covering Necrozma became increasingly bright, but under the light screen, its body remained pitch-black.

However, the aura Necrozma currently displayed was already stronger than Lunala's.

"Shriek—"

Necrozma awakened again from unconsciousness, but was immediately knocked unconscious by Tinkaton wielding the "Fairy Plate."

Only this unconscious interval was obviously getting shorter.

"Still not enough." Professor Burnet and Lusamine stared at the screen showing Necrozma's Ultra Aura energy changes and said gravely.

"No." Lusamine shook her head. "The quantity is barely enough, but the quality isn't!"

Without sufficient quality, no matter how much quantity there was, it could only float on Necrozma's surface without truly guiding it into its body.

"About time."

Johan walked to the instruments, the screen showing video communication from each Island Kahuna.

"What should we do?" Hala, holding up his hands, asked everyone's question.

"To completely inject 'light' into Necrozma's body, what we need to do now is use Z-moves. Use Z-moves as carriers to drive 'light' into Necrozma's body!" Johan said.

Z-moves?

Professor Burnet had indeed proposed the theory that Z-moves and the Alola region's Ultra Aura shared the same origin.

"Since Johan says so..." Liza, the Island Queen of Akala Island, showed her Z-Ring and the Z-Crystal embedded in it.

"Then let's do it!" Nanu crossed his arms, his Z-Ring and Z-Crystal glowing.

Led by the Island Kahunas, trainers on each island who could use Z-moves took their positions and performed their respective Z-moves.

"All-Out Pummeling!"

"Black Hole Eclipse!"

"..."

The power of these Z-moves, following the "light," flowed toward Necrozma and poured into its body.

And with the "quality" brought by the Z-move power, finally a few threads of golden light appeared within Necrozma's pitch-black body.

"Shriek!!!"

Necrozma regained consciousness again.

Bang!!

Tinkaton was already prepared when it showed signs of awakening and immediately struck down hard with another hammer blow.

"Shriek..."

Damn it, I'll fight you all...

Knocked unconscious again.

"Not enough! Still not enough!" Professor Burnet shouted. "The 'quality' still isn't enough!"

"Of course it's not enough."

Johan walked toward Necrozma, slowly unbuttoning his clothes.

The Z-moves of Lunala and Solgaleo hadn't been used yet.

Without their Z-move power as guidance, how could "light" be injected into the deepest parts of Necrozma's body?

It's just that Nebby hadn't evolved into Solgaleo yet...

Wonder if we can handle this.

"Lunala!" Johan called out.

"Woo—"

A mass of energy wrapped in fluorescence drifted down from Lunala, landing in Johan's hands. After the glow faded, it revealed an exclusive Lunalium Z!

"Mr. Giovanni..." Johan looked toward Giovanni in the distance.

He took out a glowing Bug Z, his meaning clear without words.

Alright then.

Johan looked at Professor Kukui and tossed the Lunalium Z over.

"Ah? Me? I..." Professor Kukui caught it in panic.

Everyone also cast puzzled glances.

Professor Kukui?

"Come on, explain after this is over." Johan said.

Actually, Professor Kukui was indeed more suitable than Giovanni.

After all, he had Tapu Koko's favor.

Hearing this, Professor Kukui's expression went through various changes - from initial panic, to confusion, to helplessness, and finally a relieved smile.

"True enough..."

"Koko~~"

Tapu Koko noticed this scene and descended its power, temporarily enhancing Professor Kukui's Z-Ring into a Z-Power Ring, allowing Lunala's exclusive Z-Crystal to be embedded.

Professor Kukui took a deep breath.

"Then let's enjoy the battle!"

Hm?

Professor Burnet couldn't help but look over.

Those words, those movements...

"Lunala, Menacing Moonraze Maelstrom!"

"Woo!!"

Lunala transformed into "Full Moon" form again, shrieking as it flew into the air, shooting out six beams of pure white light!

"Beedrill."

Giovanni looked at his old partner and smiled slightly.

"Bee!"

Two incredibly powerful Z-moves poured into Necrozma's body.

Buzz—

The pitch-black color of Necrozma's body was gradually being replaced, but the replacement speed...

"It's going in!" Lusamine exclaimed.

"Shriek!!!"

Necrozma awakened again. This time it wasn't knocked unconscious by Tinkaton, because Necrozma in its current state was no longer something Tinkaton could easily knock out with one hammer.

Brilliant rainbow light gathered madly on Necrozma's head, and the scattered laser light left deep, bottomless black scorch marks around the area.

Prismatic Laser!

"It's transforming, but not fast enough!" Professor Burnet shouted somewhat anxiously.

In this situation, Necrozma would probably sweep them all away with one move before completing its transformation!

"Got it, got it..."

Johan took a deep breath.

Looking at Ninetales beside him, Tinkaton had already returned the "Fairy Plate."

"Ready, Ninetales~"

"Oowoo~"

Ninetales showed no tension, its eyes curving into crescents as its tail wrapped around Johan's arm, standing shoulder to shoulder with him, directly facing the raging Necrozma.

On the arm wrapped by the tail, in the Z-Power Ring, a snow-white transparent Z-Crystal radiated moonlight.

Johan crouched down, gently stroking Ninetales' soft, cool fur. A powerful aura full of life energy immediately surged from both of them, turbulent yet sharp.

The entire Altar of the Sunne seemed enveloped in holy light, bright white and cold.

"How about calling it 'Spiral Flash Super Ring Moon Dance'?"

"Oowoo?"

Ninetales sighed softly, glancing at Johan with some "resentment."

If you can't name things, don't...

"Haha..."

Johan laughed awkwardly.

"Then let's call it—Moon Dance!"

"Oowoo!!"

Ninetales' body immediately burst with moonlight-like snow-white radiance, like a bright moon slowly rising, continuously radiating holy brilliance and dispelling darkness.

Everyone stared blankly at the moon rising into the sky. At this moment, even Lunala the "Moon God's" radiance seemed overshadowed.

"This..."

At this moment, not just Poni Canyon, not just Poni Island, but residents throughout the Alola region seemed to see a full moon slowly rising.

Bright but not glaring, cool but not cold.

Moonlight blessed the earth.

Scattering the purest "light."

On this day, the entire Alola region became "light"!

Johan looked gently into Ninetales' eyes, and at the moment the move was released, they both understood...

Success!

Accept the purest "light" from our hearts, Necrozma!

At this moment, Johan also felt as if he had become the light he had once "dreamed of."

At this moment, we are all light!!

"Shriek—"

Necrozma's eyes widened. The continuously injected "light" rapidly awakened memories buried deep in its heart, quickly suppressing its violent, restless instincts.

Rumble!!!

Massive clouds of dust thundered upward, obscuring everything.

Did we succeed?

This thought couldn't help but surface in everyone's minds.

Buzz—

A dazzling golden beam pierced through the thick smoke, and dawn-breaking light scattered across the earth.

People gazed in wonder at the slowly appearing brilliant radiance.

This was...

Light!

Instantly, enthusiastic cheers erupted throughout the Alola region.

The dust settled.

Necrozma, whose appearance had changed completely, appeared in everyone's sight.

Its body radiated rich golden brilliance, two pairs of spread wings were sacred and beautiful, its body seemed completely composed of golden "light," and its colorful, iridescent eyes showed only gentleness and kindness.

Even Giovanni couldn't help but be somewhat dazzled seeing this being.

"Is this the true 'Blinding One'?"

The true Blinding One, Ultra Necrozma!

"Mmm? Mmm!"

Nebby Cosmoem struggled and floated out, looking at Ultra Necrozma radiating sacred light before it, tilting its small head with confusion in its eyes.

What was I here to do again?

"Shriek—"

Ultra Necrozma's eyes showed some amusement as it waved its claw lightly, and a golden radiance scattered onto Nebby Cosmoem.

Whoosh!!!

Blazing flames immediately surged from Cosmoem's body. In the raging fire like the sun itself, something seemed to have completed its energy accumulation and was undergoing transformation.

The next second.

A large lion-like Pokémon, pure white all over with flowing mane, leaped from the flames.

"Solgaleo?!" Professor Kukui exclaimed.

"So Cosmoem could actually evolve into Solgaleo?" Professor Burnet finally understood why Nebby could open "Ultra Wormholes."

"Roar—!!"

Solgaleo landed, roaring at Ultra Necrozma, then settled beside Johan, the confusion in its eyes even deeper.

What was I supposed to do?

Did I contribute?

Johan smiled and patted Solgaleo's broad body, indicating everything was fine.

Ultra Necrozma's gaze finally fell on Johan.

It nodded slightly.

[Thank you for helping me understand that 'light' doesn't exist in just one Pokémon, a single individual. It comes from every life, every heart filled with hope, joy, and happiness.]

Johan smiled slightly, rubbing Ninetales' head and earning its plaintive whimper.

"You should thank yourself too. You're the one who spread the will of 'Alola' and 'Manalo' throughout the entire Alola region."

If not for Ultra Necrozma's "sharing," the Alola region would probably remain in a dim environment for a long time, just like the current "Ultra Space."

Hearing this, Ultra Necrozma paused, then its eyes became even gentler.

[We live together and share together?]

Its gaze swept across.

As if surveying all the residents, Pokémon, and life throughout the entire Alola region.

[This is a happy world.]

"It's thanks to you and everyone." Johan said.

Ultra Necrozma nodded again.

[Although I'd love to sit down and chat with you about hope, about 'light,' another world needs me, needs us. I want Lunala and Solgaleo to come with me to help that world restore its proper form.]

Johan's expression paused.

Thinking of the earlier "Necro-Lunala Fusion Device" and his suspicions, he quickly said:

"No rush. That world might have experienced some... things even you couldn't predict."

[Oh?]

"How about we sit down and chat first? You just recovered, Nebby just evolved, and Lunala was injured earlier. You all need time to recover."

Johan pulled over Gengar and Ninetales, coughing lightly.

"Cough, I'm not talented, but I know a bit about medicine."

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar opened its mouth and pulled out Revival Herb, Energy Powder, Energy Root, Sacred Ash.

Young man, come pick one! Fair prices, absolutely no second pricing!

# 734: RR Incident? (Two-in-One Chapter)

In the distant Unova region, N gently wiped his forehead, looking at the pastoral scene before him with satisfaction and contentment.

Beep beep—

Suddenly.

His phone rang. Taking it out to see the caller ID, he showed some surprise and quickly answered.

"Teacher?"

"N, long time no see. How have you been lately?" Johan's familiar voice came through the phone.

Hearing this, N immediately showed a satisfied smile and said: "Everything is very good, everyone is doing well, really well, Teacher."

Since following Johan's advice after Team Plasma's downfall, N felt his life had never been so happy. It seemed like every day was sunny and filled with spring warmth.

Moreover.

After Team Plasma's collapse, except for the more extreme members who were imprisoned, most people were dispersed with his assistance. A small portion who truly recognized his views and ideals stayed to help him build ecological zones where wild Pokémon could live, inhabit, and rest.

Working with like-minded people every day, N felt very fulfilled.

Of course.

Not all Team Plasma members were arrested or dispersed. A small portion were still secretly plotting something.

However, under Champion Alder's and the Unova League's suppression, they could hardly cause much trouble anymore.

"Hasn't Mr. Alder come to chat with you?" Johan asked with a smile.

Hearing this, N's face showed some helplessness for the first time as he looked toward where people were busy working.

He saw.

Unova League Champion Alder, seemingly helping his Bouffalant with work, was actually standing there sleeping.

Actually, this wasn't what made N feel helpless. What really made him feel helpless was that Mr. Alder had invited him to join the Unova League more than once.

N understood Mr. Alder's meaning quite clearly - he wanted to train him as the Unova League Champion's successor.

It's just...

N really didn't have much desire for the championship.

Even now, N still hadn't used Poké Balls to capture Pokémon. Those around him were all Pokémon that had been drawn by his influence and became partners working together with him.

Seeing N seem to fall into brief silence, Johan understood the general situation.

After all, it was he, Johan, who had recommended N to Alder.

With N's abilities and his special affinity with Pokémon, he definitely had the potential to become Champion.

Moreover.

As one of the candidates for the "Person of Ideals," N could also borrow Zekrom's power.

For most people, the legendary Pokémon Zekrom was an existence that couldn't be opposed.

With N's abilities, once properly trained to display his strength, plus Zekrom, it would be enough to protect the entire Unova region.

Johan said: "N, everything has two sides. Sometimes you can't just look at one side. If you really can't see clearly, you might as well get deeply involved to understand."

"Get deeply involved?"

"Champion isn't just a representative of power, but more a symbol of spirit, a spiritual totem for trainers in a region. Only then can you mobilize vast resources and influence. If you want to influence an entire region's people, I think Champion would be a good goal."

"Influence... an entire region?"

N looked around.

There weren't many people working with him, but they had already brought very positive influence to many Pokémon.

If he became Champion, using the Champion's identity to drive and change the entire Unova region, then... his "ideal" might not be so unattainable.

N's pale blue eyes flickered, containing some interest while gaining some enlightenment.

So that's why Teacher became the Hoenn League Champion?

That made sense.

Rather than teaching one school, one class, how could that compare to the influence and teaching a Champion could have?

Teacher wanted to use the Champion identity's "spiritual totem" to influence an entire region, even multiple regions' young people...

Great, needs no salt!

"I understand, Teacher!"

"I'll try to get involved, to understand, to do more!"

Johan felt like N had misunderstood something somewhere.

Becoming Champion meant having more "money" to build his "ideal nation."

Whatever, as long as he "understood."

"Have you visited Ghetsis recently?" Johan asked again.

"Yes." N's expression became complex.

Although Ghetsis had been using him, no matter what, Ghetsis was still his adoptive father. N would visit him in the League's prison periodically, even though Ghetsis appeared extremely angry every time he saw him.

"What about Colress?"

N was stunned and said: "As a technical person, Mr. Colress is currently assisting the Unova League with project research. It's said to be quite secret research. My status and clearance... don't allow me to see him."

As expected.

Johan sighed inwardly.

With Colress's abilities, he would be valued talent anywhere.

Previously, the Unova League hadn't used him because some of Colress's research topics and directions were too dark, involving many secrets about Pokémon bodies.

So Colress was called the "Dark Scientist."

But now Colress was serving his sentence. If he still wanted to regain freedom, what research he did wasn't something he could decide himself.

Although this would greatly suppress his talents, he was still rare talent that the League would utilize.

However...

"Are you certain that Colress is under the Unova League's control?" Johan asked for confirmation.

"I..." N was stunned, honestly saying: "I can't be certain, because I can't see him."

"Is Mr. Alder there with you?"

"Uh, yes."

"Let him take the call. I called him but couldn't get through - he's probably sleeping."

N looked at Mr. Alder, who was still blowing snot bubbles, and silently admired how accurately Johan had guessed.

"Alright, Teacher, please wait a moment."

With that, N quickly ran toward Alder. The Bouffalant nearby, who was grazing, looked at its trainer with some "disdain," its tail "smacking" twice against Alder's face.

"Hm? Hm!"

Alder instantly woke up in pain, gasping as he looked at Bouffalant, "What's wrong?"

"Moo~"

Bouffalant casually replied.

Nothing, there was a mosquito~

Alder showed understanding, touching his already red and swollen cheek, laughing loudly: "Is that so? Hahaha— thanks so much, Bouffalant!"

N: "..."

Really... a strange way of getting along.

At this time, Alder also noticed N running over, smiling with his swollen cheek: "What's wrong, N!"

N quickly handed over the phone, saying: "Mr. Alder, it's a call from Johan."

"Johan?"

Alder was stunned, then took it. As soon as the phone touched his swollen cheek, he gasped from touching the wound, then laughed:

"Hahaha— what's up, Johan? What do you need?"

Then he immediately added: "Oh right, I haven't congratulated you on becoming Champion yet. Too bad it's the Hoenn League Champion though..."

Johan laughed dryly, not wanting to chat much with Alder, going straight to the point:

"Mr. Alder, I want to ask, is Colress still under the Unova League's control?"

"Colress?"

Alder directly said: "Of course! He's a dangerous person."

"You're certain?"

"Certain!"

Alder was very confident, then asked back: "What? Did you encounter someone who looks like Colress?"

Johan on the other end rubbed his temples, helplessly muttering: "More than just looks like him..."

"What?" Alder didn't hear Johan's mumbling clearly.

"Nothing." Johan came back to his senses, saying: "It's good that he's still there. I was just confirming."

"Alright, if you need any help, just say so."

"I might really need some later..."

Alola region.

"Confirmed?" Giovanni saw Johan put down his phone and asked after taking a bite of cream cake.

"Mm..." Johan sighed and nodded.

"Doesn't seem like good news?"

For Giovanni, Johan didn't know how to explain, only nodding: "The worst-case scenario."

"The worst?" Giovanni raised an eyebrow.

It really was the worst.

Through that phone call, Johan had confirmed one thing.

The creator of that "Necro-Lunala Fusion Device" was definitely Colress, but not the Colress he and the Unova League had arrested together...

It sounded confusing.

Simply put, there were two Colress!

But how could there be two identical people?

This was due to the damned "multiverse" setting mixed into Pokémon's seventh generation!

In the Pokémon games "Ultra Sun/Ultra Moon," the unprecedented "RR Incident" occurred.

The cause of the "RR Incident" was that the revived Necrozma's powerful force distorted space, and its massive desire for "light" - that enormous evil will - resonated with evil forces from other worlds.

These "evil forces" that responded were evil organizations from various worlds, such as Giovanni, the Rocket Team leader from another world, Ghetsis, the Team Plasma leader from another world, plus Archie, Maxie, Cyrus, Lysandre, and others.

Moreover, these evil organization leaders weren't like those in Johan's world, where most ideals and goals were destroyed or cut short before achievement.

These people had all achieved their respective ideologies in their own worlds!

So their strength would be even greater than what Johan knew, maybe much greater!

If it were just this, it would be manageable.

They were all evil organization leaders from their respective worlds - none would submit to the others. It would be good if they didn't fight each other.

But unfortunately, there was Giovanni in the middle.

With solid strength and powerful charisma, Giovanni forcibly integrated these people into one force, named— Rainbow Rocket!

Their goal was to use Necrozma's space-distorting power, the Aether Foundation's space technology, and massive powerful Ultra Beasts to form a powerful "UB Army."

Rainbow Rocket would use this "UB Army" to conquer all universes!

Of course, this was what Johan called the "worst-case scenario."

Now only one Colress had appeared - it hadn't reached the worst case yet.

If the entire Rainbow Rocket had appeared then, Johan estimated that even he and Giovanni working together might not be able to defeat Necrozma.

The good news was that Necrozma had now recovered as the "Blinding One" and wouldn't randomly distort space or release massive evil thoughts.

The bad news was that with Colress's genius-level abilities, no one knew what he might create.

Maybe...

He could eventually create an "Ultra Beast Fusion Device"?

Combining Guzzlord and Celesteela, eating while producing terrifying combustible gas, then charging out of an "Ultra Wormhole" for a big explosion - probably few Pokémon could withstand that.

Moreover, they needed to remind Ultra Necrozma to be careful.

If it was affected by Colress's "Colress Machine," the destruction caused... would probably be no less than Arceus's awakening incident.

Seeing Johan not speaking, his expression constantly changing but never becoming extremely grave, Giovanni understood.

Johan's "worst" had different levels.

Sometimes, having no money was also a "worst" situation, and might even be the most serious category.

Sometimes, the appearance of a legendary or two was also a "worst" situation, but just calling some people would solve it.

Other times, like this time, Giovanni actually felt that even without him, Johan should be able to handle it. At most it would just take more time and effort. But when Johan contacted him, he also said the situation was very bad.

Believing his words was like believing his nonsense.

Even the "Hoopa Unbound" incident that Giovanni felt was unmanageable was ultimately resolved by Johan, wasn't it?

So.

As long as the world wasn't ending tomorrow, everything was within Johan's "controllable" range.

"Then you'd better be more careful." Giovanni said in a relaxed tone, then picked up another cream cake, saying: "Mm, this tastes good. Pack some for me later."

Since his internal injuries healed, his relationship with his son Silver improved, and he decided to transform Team Rocket, Giovanni felt his appetite had increased considerably. His energy had also become more vigorous, but more inclined toward things like planting flowers and trees.

In summary, he wanted to retire.

Anyway, he had already found Team Rocket's "successor."

Johan looked at him with annoyance.

At this "life and death" moment for the Pokémon world, how had Giovanni become like Gengar, only thinking about eating?

They say "birds of a feather flock together." After being with him for so long, how come Giovanni not only didn't become "concerned about the country and people" like him, but instead became "gluttonous and lazy" like Gengar.

Thinking this, he looked at Gengar.

He saw the purple fatty was showing off its "tea ceremony" again.

Ultra Necrozma, Lunala, and the newly evolved Nebby Solgaleo - none could escape.

The "Energy Root Tea" that could greatly restore vitality, paired with Sinistea and Polteageist, made them not want a second cup.

"Ka-kaah~ Ka-kaah~"

Gengar smiled mischievously as it brought out pastries - cream cakes, energy cubes, macarons, Poffins, and more, everything available.

Pastries with tea, the more you drink the better!

These pastries quickly "conquered" the stomachs of Ultra Necrozma, Lunala, and Solgaleo.

Seeing them eat one piece, the purple fatty secretly made a mark on the ground behind them, recording the "losses."

Johan shook his head silently while saying to Giovanni: "No problem, ten thousand Pokédollars per piece! However many you want! Eat your fill!"

"Are you robbing people?"

Giovanni's eyes widened in annoyance.

Ten thousand Pokédollars per cake?

You really dare to ask for that price.

However, Johan's words completely put Giovanni at ease.

Still thinking about making money meant everything was fine.

What normal person would care about these things in the "worst situation"?

"Giovanni, that's not how you look at it."

Johan licked his lips, "This cake's cream comes from Alcremie during the most beautiful moment of its day, the cake is made by top pastry chef Love Waitress siblings, and the eggs come from the distant, mysterious 'Fiore Region'..."

After "simply" explaining how difficult the cake was to make, Johan's expression became serious as he gritted his teeth and magnanimously decided:

"Forget it! We're close friends - I'll give you half off, five thousand Pokédollars!"

Seeing his appearance, Giovanni was amused despite his annoyance.

But honestly, the taste really was excellent.

Buy some to bring back for Silver...

After brief consideration, Giovanni waved his hand grandly, "I'll regularly order pastries from your shop from now on. Give me a price."

Johan immediately stood up and bowed seriously, "Boss, that'll be one million Pokédollars."

Then he quickly added: "Per month."

"Approved! Have Matori reimburse you!"

"Great! Giovanni, eat as much as you want today, it's all on me, no charge!" Johan was overjoyed.

He suddenly realized.

This regular ordering method... seemed pretty good.

Wonder if Devon Corporation, Aether Foundation and such organizations wanted this. They were all super large companies - their purchasing prices definitely wouldn't be low.

Oh right, get the expenses reimbursed.

"Wait."

Johan suddenly realized.

The Alola League was currently in its initial stages, with only Professor Kukui and a few others. It could be called penniless.

Having them reimburse felt harsh.

If he asked the International Police for reimbursement...

"Seems like I'm currently the highest official of the Alola region's International Police Department?"

Time to write and approve his own receipt again?

Johan thought happily.

One of life's great pleasures was getting reimbursement receipts approved.

An even greater pleasure was approving your own reimbursement receipts!

The sun rose as usual.

Golden light shone on the ocean, creating golden scales, announcing another beautiful day's arrival.

Although the Alola region's communications weren't developed, such a big event had occurred. Yesterday there was a total solar eclipse, two moons overlooking the earth, then a golden sun rising again - it was hard not to attract huge attention.

Professor Kukui as Alola League President, Aether Foundation President Lusamine, and UB Task Force Chief Anabel jointly announced the existence of Ultra Beasts and "Ultra Space" to the entire Alola region and the whole Pokémon world via livestream.

This caused quite a stir.

So besides the Pokémon world, there were other worlds?

Besides Pokémon, there were actually Ultra Beasts?!

Additionally, the "UB Task Force" announced all currently known UBs and their codenames and names, including even UB: Black, Necrozma!

When everyone learned that the legendary "Blinding One" of the Alola region was actually another form of "UB: Black," everyone was shocked again.

Especially when a video titled "That Day, We All Became Light" was posted online, witnessing Necrozma's transformation from "UB: Black" to Ultra Necrozma, the entire internet exploded.

"Holy crap! I want to become light too and defeat darkness together!"

"Yesterday mom asked why I suddenly raised my hands. I said: I want to become light!"

"As long as you believe in light, you can become light!"

"Johan said: Light absolutely doesn't belong to individual entities - it belongs to every life! So we are also light, we are also part of Ultra Necrozma!"

"Wait, Johan isn't surprising, but there's also someone called Mr. Giovanni?!"

Johan's appearance seemed "routine" and normal to many people.

But how come Giovanni, the Gym Leader from the Kanto region, was also there?

Moreover...

"Gym Leader Giovanni, this couldn't be... legendary level?!"

Being able to suppress "UB: Black," ordinary Champion-level Pokémon definitely couldn't do it.

Even if "UB: Black" was weakened, it was still a legendary Pokémon.

"Damn! Two legendaries?!"

"Have Kanto League Gym Leaders already raised the standard to 'legendary' level? What kind of demonic difficulty is this?"

"Gym Leader Giovanni is so strong!"

"Suddenly curious what would happen if Johan VS Gym Leader Giovanni?"

Giovanni had once again gained a wave of reputation in this incident. In most ordinary people's eyes, Giovanni's identity was becoming increasingly legitimate.

Maybe before long, even if the League announced Giovanni was the leader of the evil organization Team Rocket, not everyone would believe it.

This was exactly what Johan had told Giovanni - when everyone thinks you are a certain type of person, what type of person you actually are doesn't matter anymore.

If Giovanni's identity could truly be "whitewashed," then Team Rocket's transformation would undoubtedly become smoother.

This would allow Team Rocket and the League to reach a tacit understanding.

Johan wasn't really paying attention to what was happening outside and online.

At most, he had Rotom note down a few trolls who badmouthed him, then have Gengar crawl through the internet cables to find them at midnight.

Other than that, he wouldn't do anything. Johan considered himself quite kind and friendly.

He was currently telling Ultra Necrozma, Lunala, and Solgaleo about things to be careful about after returning to "Ultra Space."

"Anyway, someone intervened then. I don't know if you sensed anything in that state..."

[At that time, I was only instinctively pursuing 'light.' I really didn't notice or remember anything.]

Ultra Necrozma recalled, finding its memories of the "UB: Black" state very vague. Only when "light" began gathering toward it did its memories become clear.

Johan wasn't surprised and nodded:

"But still be careful. I suspect someone has impure motives and might try to harm you."

Hearing this, Lunala and Solgaleo looked at each other, then both looked at Ultra Necrozma.

With their combined strength... they could probably crush even Arceus, right?

However, Johan's words still made them alert.

No matter what, being careful was never wrong.

"If you encounter something incomprehensible or troublesome, you can try to contact me." Johan said.

The appearance of Colress from another dimension made Johan feel somewhat uneasy.

But he couldn't really go into "Ultra Space" and stay for months or longer, searching for that guy in a world as vast as an ocean.

Colress couldn't possibly be like Necrozma, sleeping in one place.

Moreover, Colress had definitely noticed he'd been discovered then and was probably hiding now.

Johan really didn't have time to waste with him.

Anyway...

If he really wanted to cause trouble, he would definitely show his hand first.

[Alright, we'll be careful.] Ultra Necrozma nodded.

After brief consideration, a golden exclusive Z-Crystal floated from its body.

Hm?

"This is..."

[My Z-Crystal.]

Ultra Necrozium Z?!

Ultra Necrozma's exclusive Z-Crystal?

In Johan's mind appeared Ultra Necrozma's exclusive Z-move—Light That Burns the Sky.

He couldn't help but shudder slightly.

No, this move name was too embarrassing. It wasn't even as good as his "Spiral Flash Super Ring Moon Dance."

However, since it was Ultra Necrozma's exclusive Z-Crystal, he still had to treat it seriously.

Johan solemnly put it in his chest.

It's just that Ultra Necrozma's exclusive Z-Crystal and Z-move seemed to be Psychic-type.

He didn't have any Psychic-type Pokémon at home...

[With this Z-Crystal, we might be able to contact each other even across space.] Ultra Necrozma said solemnly.

"I understand."

[Then we should return to save the other world.]

With these words.

Ultra Necrozma spread its golden wings and, like a giant of light, "whooshed" into the sky.

An Ultra Wormhole opened accordingly.

[Until we meet again.] Lunala followed closely.

Solgaleo looked at Johan reluctantly, but thinking that "Ultra Space" still needed it, its expression became serious.

Its exclusive Z-Crystal was also in Johan's hands - this would be their connection.

Johan waved at them.

Farewell, Ultraman—no, legendary Cosmic Pokémon!

The three legendary Pokémon disappeared into the Ultra Wormhole.

Buzzwole and Kartana returned with them.

As for the Naganadel, they would wait until "Ultra Space" regained light before considering returning.

Because Anabel from the "UB Task Force" was already discussing cooperation with them.

If the Pokémon world wanted to continue exploring "Ultra Space" in the future, cooperating with the Naganadel was undoubtedly the best choice.

Both sides had established basic trust. Decades later, they might be able to go even further.

"Here."

After Ultra Necrozma and the others left, Johan tossed the "Ultra Necrozium Z" to Gengar.

With Gengar's abilities, if Ultra Necrozma wanted to contact him, the "signal" should be better.

Moreover, among his Pokémon, only Gengar and Ninetales knew some Psychic-type moves. Ninetales was now more focused on Fairy and Ice types. As for Gengar, let it figure it out itself. The purple fatty had broad interests anyway.

Even from Mewtwo, it had "learned" Psycho Break.

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar joyfully caught it, grinning so wide it couldn't close its mouth.

Ultra Necrozium Z!

It spat twice and carefully wiped it clean.

"Ka-kaah?"

While cleaning the Ultra Necrozium Z, Gengar tilted its head with some confusion in its eyes.

Eh?

Black fluorescent spots slowly drifted from its body, just like the black "light" that had emerged when it injected "light" into Necrozma earlier.

In the Ultra Necrozium Z, a faint black "light" also vaguely appeared, as if resonating with Gengar's power.

The purple fatty scratched its head, not understanding but feeling amazed.

It felt that the Ultra Necrozium Z seemed to still need "light"?

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar boldly patted its round belly.

Whatever! Since you need it, I'll reluctantly satisfy you!

With that.

It opened its mouth, threw the "Ultra Necrozium Z" inside, and slowly "transmitted" it.

Ultra Space.

Long-awaited light and radiance once again blessed the earth. Where the golden light passed, deserts, wastelands, and barren soil were covered with green grass at visible speed.

The Ultra Beasts in Ultra Space cheered seeing this scene, thanking "light" for its favor once again.

As long as there was light, this barren world would eventually recover!

While all Ultra Beasts were immersed in joy, somewhere in Ultra Space, a device silently absorbed the power of "light."

"So Necrozma's power is the key?" Colress looked excited and immersed.

A new world, new research gave him new direction!

Compared to his original world, compared to the Pokémon world, perhaps... the freer "Ultra Space" was his true home.

"Come on, come on, more, even more!"

Faba, bound nearby, watched this scene with cold laughter in his heart.

He admitted Colress was indeed genius, but some things... only he who had actually operated them understood.

Necrozma's power and Ultra Necrozma's power—could they be the same?

Could extreme evil will be the same as the current warm, gentle sunlight?

Power was key, but the emotions and thoughts contained within that power couldn't be ignored, bastard!

When the time came...

"Let you summon Johan from another world to beat you up! Hmph!"

Faba thought happily, as if he could already see Johan pressing Colress to the ground and beating him.

Keep collecting, keep collecting! If you can, collect even more!

# 735: Again "Locked Health" and "Revival" (Two-in-One Chapter)

Alola region, Melemele Island, Alola Pokémon School.

"Class dismissed!"

Johan announced with a smile.

The little kids below looked reluctant.

In just a few more days, Johan would return to the Kanaz Pokémon Academy in the Hoenn region.

Although they hadn't spent much time together.

They had gotten along very harmoniously, and Johan's teaching methods were very special, giving them a feeling that was both painful and happy.

The painful part was that Johan seemed to really enjoy tests and assessments - a small test every day, a big test every three days, and an ultimate mega test every five days.

The happy part was that everyone could feel their own growth and progress, even feeling it every day.

Now Kiawe and Gladion could already use Z-moves together with their Pokémon.

In terms of battling, Kiawe was indeed quite talented. His personality was somewhat similar to that explosive-haired guy who played with fire, so he had more passion and desire for battles.

Although he was still inferior to Ash, he was adequate as a temporary "rival" for Gladion.

Sure enough, after school each time, Kiawe would challenge Gladion.

And although Gladion was initially disdainful, he gradually came to recognize Kiawe's persistence in battling, often... beating him until he couldn't find north.

However, under the influence of Kiawe, Mallow, Sophocles, Lana, and even Lillie, Gladion had become increasingly childlike in Johan's view.

At least he wasn't always posing and acting cool.

"Where would you like to go today?" Johan asked.

This was when the little ones were happiest - Johan's outdoor mini-classroom!

Although Professor Kukui also taught well, Professor Kukui never took them to experience real wild environments.

Moreover, Professor Kukui had been increasingly busy lately and had even less time for outdoor classes.

Only Johan not only took them to "dangerous" wild environments, but even had an exciting outdoor camping trip once, letting the little ones properly "taste" a night of excitement mixed with tension.

Although some "accidents" seemed to occur more or less every time they went out, because Johan was watching over them, all the "accidents" ultimately led to better outcomes.

This also gave the little ones more interaction with wild Pokémon in the outdoors.

Whether battling, cooperating, or helping each other, it gave them more understanding and knowledge of wild Pokémon.

Now, at least if they got lost in the wild when going out alone, they wouldn't panic and do nothing.

"Let's go to the forest!" Mallow was first to shout.

"Let's go to the beach." Lana also boldly expressed her opinion.

"We haven't been to the beach in a while. Today's weather seems especially suitable for beachcombing..." Sophocles fiddled with his latest invention, the "Tide Meter."

"Beachcombing?"

Johan's eyes lit up slightly.

Beachcombing, forging, horseshoeing - the three great "internet" speed bumps.

"Alright, then get ready. We'll go beachcombing later!" Johan announced.

"Hooray!"

"Long live Johan!"

The little ones immediately cheered. Even Mallow, who had suggested the forest, wasn't opposed to the beach and beachcombing at all.

Collect some shells, scallops and such, and tonight she'd make everyone a pot of pineapple seafood soup!

On the morning beach, with the tide receded, Johan led Gladion and the other kids, carrying their little buckets, to Kala'e Bay on Melemele Island.

When it came to beachcombing, Johan was also a novice. Among them, Lana was the most experienced.

"Before, my dad often took me and my sisters beachcombing together..."

Lana reminisced, "My dad's fishing skills are amazing, but he never catches any fish. He says you absolutely can't go home empty-handed on a trip - beachcombing is the 'angler's' final stubbornness!"

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar covered its mouth with one hand and tugged at Johan's clothes with the other.

Isn't this talking about you?

But Johan nodded seriously with complete agreement.

Anglers never return empty-handed!

Lana's father was truly admirable.

"My dad says if you're beachcombing for the first time without experience, it's recommended to search near the rocks where it's easier to find things. If you're experienced... you can look for holes in the sand on the beach."

Lana began explaining details, "But be careful - some holes are quite dangerous and might hide Pokémon like Cloyster, Krabby, or Staryu. Actually, you need to be careful near rocks too - you might encounter Barbaracle or even Barbaracle!"

Everyone nodded seriously.

If this were the Paldea region, you might even encounter Wiglett and Wugtrio, which were quite dangerous.

"Anyway, everyone can beachcomb but don't leave my sight. If you encounter danger or anything uncertain, notify me immediately." Johan instructed seriously.

Just as he finished speaking, his phone suddenly rang.

The caller ID showed Cynthia.

Seeing the name, Johan couldn't help but smile.

He pressed the answer button.

Seeing his expression, the little ones immediately started teasing:

"Is it our teacher's wife?"

"Johan is smiling so happily, it must be our teacher's wife!"

"Good morning, teacher's wife!"

Johan immediately waved his hand in annoyance, "Go, go, go beachcomb by yourselves."

The little ones were tactful enough to run away with giggles after their teasing.

"You're taking them beachcombing? So energetic." Cynthia's laughter came through the phone.

Johan also smiled, "My summer vacation is almost over. I'm letting them have one last wild time."

"What about you? Getting ready to rest?"

Due to time differences, the day-night difference between the Alola and Sinnoh regions was quite significant.

"Almost."

Cynthia's voice sounded somewhat languid and tired, but her mood seemed pretty good.

"Almost?"

Johan keenly heard something different in Cynthia's words, as if...

"Mm, I'm ready. I can challenge the Champion's Road now."

Champion's Road!

Since the end of the World Coronation Series, Cynthia had been preparing for the Sinnoh League's "Champion's Road."

Now, nearly half a year later, she was finally ready!

Johan's spirits lifted.

Only those who had been through the "Champion's Road" understood just how difficult it truly was.

Even Johan himself could have failed if he hadn't been sufficiently prepared.

However, Johan's preparation time had actually been quite short, even somewhat rushed.

That's why Cynthia, Lance, Steven and others were afraid of disturbing and affecting him, so they didn't bother him until he finished the "Champion's Road."

Since Cynthia had prepared for a long enough time, there was no need to worry about this.

Johan didn't ask meaningless questions like whether she was confident.

With Cynthia's strength and abilities, she had definitely adjusted herself and her Pokémon to their best condition, and her confidence had absolutely reached its peak.

So.

There was no need to worry about her confidence.

But as her boyfriend...

Johan half-closed his eyes and coughed lightly: "What about Flint and the others? Are they there with you?"

Cynthia seemed to vaguely guess what Johan wanted to say and smiled: "They're just about to leave."

"Help me make an appointment with them." Johan's voice carried a slightly hoarse tone.

"Johan, what do you want to do?" Cynthia had put it on speaker, and Flint's voice came through.

Johan chuckled coldly, "What do I want to do? A battle appointment. Don't you love battling me the most? I'm challenging you now - all three of you, together!"

Lucian smiled bitterly, "I don't need to participate, right?"

"No, all three of you together. Let's have a fight - the kind where you can't get out of bed for a month!"

Lucian: "..."

"I'm outta here!"

Lucian grabbed Aaron and dragged Flint away.

Too terrifying.

Too protective of his cub.

No wait, too protective of his wife.

He didn't even dare imagine what they'd become if they let the big sister get hurt on the "Champion's Road"...

Johan chuckled coldly again, "Heh, think you can run? I'll have Dialga, Palkia, and Giratina find you one by one!"

"Alright, they've already run away." Cynthia's voice was gentle as she smiled.

"Lucky they ran fast."

Johan pouted, then quickly asked: "Did I scare them?"

"Definitely." Cynthia said: "With that tone and content you just used, even legendary Pokémon would be scared."

"Nah." Johan waved his hand, "I have good relationships with legendary Pokémon."

"Mm," Cynthia smiled sweetly.

She knew Johan was joking, deliberately helping her relax and reduce psychological pressure.

After a moment of silence, she said softly: "Johan, you don't need to do this. I'm confident."

"You don't understand, my little Cynthia."

Johan used a tone like an experienced person:

"Once you decided to challenge the 'Champion's Road' and they became the Elite Four, the 'war' between you had already begun. I have more experience in this area than you."

Like when he challenged the Hoenn League's "Champion's Road," each one of them - whether Elite Four Glacia or Elite Four Drake - all acted like "you should hurry up and take office."

But when it came to the actual "Champion's Road" battles?

When they really got into it and got heated, each one was more "ruthless" than the last, as if dragging down one or two of your Pokémon would be good.

Hmph.

"This is called 'psychological warfare.' Give them pressure first. Even if they're not afraid, as long as they hesitate even a little bit during battle, that's an opportunity, that's win rate!"

Although she knew Johan was joking, honestly, even when joking, this guy spoke in sets, looking completely serious.

Cynthia said with some teasing: "No wonder people say psychology students are all 'dirty.'"

"Saying that about me really hurts my feelings..."

The two chatted for half an hour until Johan felt Cynthia was getting tired, then said:

"Don't worry, I'll come to the venue to cheer you on, in a way that... can put pressure on people."

"Good..."

Cynthia didn't refuse.

Honestly.

As a "strong woman," suddenly enjoying this feeling of being protected... was actually quite nice.

"Good night."

"Good night... hoo, hoo—"

After saying this, even breathing sounds came from the other end of the phone.

Johan smiled and hung up, putting away his phone.

Turning around, he saw.

The little ones had already collected a large amount of seafood, while his Gengar was teasing - no, messing with - a Toxapex that had appeared on the beach at some point.

Toxapex looked like a spiky dome tent covered in spikes - this was its protective posture. However, to spy on the outside world, its two front tentacles would usually open, revealing the purple body hidden inside.

Toxapex was a Poison and Water-type Brutal Star Pokémon. Johan wasn't unfamiliar with this kind of Pokémon, as he had used it quite often when playing Pokémon battles before.

Moreover, in the Pokémon anime, James had a Mareanie, whose evolved form was Toxapex.

It was said that Toxapex's body contained large amounts of powerful toxins. Even if Wailord was stung by Toxapex's spikes covering its entire body, it would suffer for three days and nights.

If humans were accidentally stung by Toxapex's poisonous spikes, even with timely treatment, there was a high probability of leaving aftereffects.

It was precisely because he was worried that Gladion and the others might accidentally touch dangerous Pokémon like Toxapex and Mareanie with strong toxins that Johan had Gengar "clean up."

Who knew...

Toxapex's powerful toxins had instead become Gengar's... little snacks.

He saw that the Toxapex had lowered all its tentacles, presenting itself like a tent or bunker.

This was exactly Toxapex's signature move and one of the moves that once made it popular in Pokémon battles - Baneful Bunker!

[Baneful Bunker: Blocks the opponent's attack while poisoning opponents who make contact!]

This move was similar to Protect, Detect, and other moves, except it had the additional effect of poisoning the opponent.

Combined with its signature ability "Merciless," the combination with "Baneful Bunker" became extremely frightening.

[Merciless: When attacking an already poisoned opponent, attacks will always hit critical spots!]

It was like having auto-aim as a "sniper."

However.

Such a capable Pokémon, when facing Gengar...

Tap tap tap—

Gengar put its head against Toxapex's "fortress" exterior, making "tap tap" sounds like knocking on a door, completely ignoring the poisonous spikes on Toxapex's folded tentacle shell.

"Ka-kaah?"

Hello? Hello? Is anyone home?

Sensing danger, Toxapex's poisonous spikes immediately released intense toxins.

The result...

Gengar had been waiting for exactly this, opening its mouth on the side to catch it. When the toxins shot out, it swallowed them all without spilling a drop.

The taste was actually pretty good!

Then Gengar continued repeating this action.

Tap tap—

What had Gengar done wrong?

It was just hungry. Consider the psychological trauma area of Toxapex at this moment.

"Johan!"

Gladion suddenly ran over carrying his bucket.

"Hm?"

Just when Johan thought something had happened, Gladion suddenly shouted seriously: "Please battle me!"

Johan: "?"

So sudden and spontaneous?

But it seemed... this spontaneity was something he had taught...

This boomerang had finally come back to hit him.

Johan sighed inwardly.

Looking at Gladion's eager gaze, then at Type: Null beside him, Johan suddenly realized.

Indeed, it was about time.

As a teacher, he shouldn't be stingy with this help.

"Since you want to battle so much, then let's do it." Johan took two steps back on the beach, creating distance from Gladion.

Hearing this, Gladion was stunned.

He seemed not to have expected Johan to actually agree.

After brief surprise, his expression immediately became serious and stern.

He also stepped back a few paces with Type: Null, ensuring enough space for battle, and clenched his fists.

Although Johan had told him to think more like a child.

But after the "Ultra Wormhole" incident ended, his mother seemed to have become somewhat obsessed, constantly talking about knowing their father's situation and wanting to bring him back.

Gladion wanted to help.

He didn't think wanting to help would make him anxious and worried - this was his most genuine inner thought and desire.

And now.

He would work hard toward this goal!

Nearby.

When Kiawe and the others learned Gladion was going to battle Johan, they immediately put down what they were doing and gathered around.

"Go for it, Gladion!" Mallow cupped her hands like a megaphone and shouted.

"Big brother, go for it!" Lillie quietly cheered.

"Gladion, I admit you're quite strong, so... go for it!" Even his "rival" Kiawe was cheering for Gladion.

Johan touched his glasses frame.

How come he felt like the big bad guy?

Thinking this, he threw out a Poké Ball.

"Go, Servine."

Among his Pokémon... it seemed only Servine had even a slight chance of battling Type: Null.

As for Rotom...

Rotom had already switched to its Rotom Referee "equipment."

"First, never act impulsively! Second, never miss judging any bad deed! Third, always referee fairly and beautifully!"

Red and blue flags "whooshed" in its hands.

"Servine!" Servine glared at Johan in annoyance.

You want me to handle this kind of battle?

Even it might not be able to hold back.

Johan conveyed through aura: "No choice, you're more gentle."

Gentle, gentle?

Servine's cheeks turned slightly red, but quickly showed a fierce expression.

"Servine! (#`皿′)"

Just, just because you complimented me doesn't mean I'll hold back! Hmph!

After speaking, it took a battle stance in front of Johan, ready for combat.

When it saw Gladion and Type: Null's expressions, its previous contempt completely disappeared.

Although Servine felt it had a significant strength advantage, Gladion and Type: Null's eyes - their eagerness and seriousness toward battle - made Servine feel they could be called opponents.

"Servine!"

Come on! Let me see where your confidence comes from!

Johan also waved his hand: "If you're ready, then attack."

Gladion and Type: Null looked at each other, shouting: "Johan, be careful!"

With these words.

Type: Null's limbs suddenly moved, kicking up large amounts of sand as it charged straight at Servine.

Good eyes, good fighting spirit!

"Type: Null, X-Scissor!"

"Roar!!"

Pale blue light emerged from the huge axe on Type: Null's head, as if some power was gathering.

Then its claws became like blades, slashing toward Servine.

Making "cross"-shaped strikes!

"Servine." Johan half-closed his eyes, "Vine Whip."

"Servine!"

Two slender but tough vines shot out from behind Servine. One coiled into a shield-like shape in front of it, while the other quickly pierced through the air from another angle, striking Type: Null.

Bang!!

Suddenly hit in the waist, Type: Null's body uncontrollably flew to the side.

"Type: Null!"

"Roar!!"

But even while being knocked away, it still executed X-Scissor, even if... it only left scratches on Servine's vine.

Bang—

Type: Null slid through the sand for some distance before barely stopping.

There was a white mark on its waist where the pain made it squint.

Crack—

A slight sound came from under Type: Null's mask.

This movement was small - neither Gladion nor Type: Null itself noticed, but Johan, with his aura, caught it.

Still not enough...

"Type: Null, Tri Attack!" Seeing Type: Null steady itself, Gladion immediately waved his hand and shouted.

Hearing this, Type: Null showed no discouragement from being knocked away by the vine earlier. Instead, it became even more serious and full of fighting spirit.

Lightning, ice, and fire - three types of energy appeared on Type: Null's two claws and the axe on its head, fiercely attacking Servine.

Honestly.

This fighting style had no tactics or strategy whatsoever.

But it displayed the passionate fighting spirit of Gladion and Type: Null.

Since his student was like this, Johan waved his hand:

"Servine, Leaf Blade!"

"Servine!"

Servine didn't retreat but advanced, green fluorescence appearing on both arms, forming two verdant blades as it rushed toward Type: Null.

Clang!!

Claws and leaf blades made contact in an instant, sparking energy and sparks as Type: Null and Servine faced each other at close range for the first time.

"Roar—"

Type: Null roared with all its might.

It could feel Gladion's desire, could feel Gladion's goal, and all it wanted to do was help Gladion!

Its second claw swung out.

Bang!!

But it was blocked by Servine's other leaf blade.

Two claws against two leaf blades - you don't have a third one, do you?

The huge axe on Type: Null's head chopped down.

Servine's eyes gleamed.

Looking down on who?

"Servine!"

Servine's arms suddenly exerted force. Under Type: Null's stunned gaze, it directly knocked both claws aside, then struck with both blades.

Swoosh—

It seemed slow, but the contact between Type: Null and Servine was actually just an instant, after which they stood with their backs to each other.

"Servine."

Servine stood up expressionlessly, the leaf blades on its arms slowly retracting.

Crack!!

Type: Null's helmet made cracking sounds again.

This time it was more obvious than before - even Gladion heard it, but...

"Roar..."

Type: Null whimpered and collapsed to the ground with a "thud."

This left Gladion with no mind to pay attention to the sounds from Type: Null's body, his pupils contracting sharply.

"Type: Null..."

Is the gap with Johan so large?

Lillie and the others nearby also looked at this scene in surprise.

Among all of them, Gladion was definitely the strongest, but facing Johan... he was defeated so easily?

"No!"

Gladion clenched his fists, the shock and disappointment in his eyes instantly replaced by fire-like radiance.

"We're not finished yet! Stand up, Type: Null!!!"

Type: Null, lying on the ground, faintly heard Gladion's call and felt Gladion's persistence. Its originally somewhat scattered gaze instantly became clear.

"Roar!"

It struggled, gritted its teeth, staggered, and shakily stood up from the sand.

Witnessing this scene, Johan raised an eyebrow with an indescribable expression.

Isn't this... Ash's "health lock cheat" and "revival roar"?

Good, good, good.

Finally, he had "molded" Gladion into Ash's image.

He just wondered what exciting collision would occur when Ash came to the Alola region in the future and encountered such a Gladion.

"That's right, Type: Null! We're not finished yet!"

Boom!!

Type: Null responded to Gladion's call, and a powerful aura suddenly surged from its body, instantly scattering the surrounding sand.

Crack!!

This time the cracking sound was particularly obvious. A fierce crack appeared on Type: Null's helmet.

Moreover, more and more cracks began appearing.

"This is..." Mallow and the others all watched this scene in shock.

Only Lillie seemed to remember something.

"This is Type: Null's true appearance..."

"Roar—!!!"

The roar accompanied swirling air currents as Type: Null's heavy helmet completely shattered into numerous fragments, and the appearance hidden beneath was finally revealed.

Silvally!

This was Type: Null's - no, Silvally's true form!

Nicknamed - Little Arceus!

Gladion was also surprised by what was happening before him.

But he quickly reacted: "Well done, Silvally!"

"Servine?" Servine turned to look at this transformed opponent, vaguely sensing its difference.

"Synthetic Pokémon Silvally!"

Gladion suddenly got excited, producing a disc glowing with red light and throwing it toward Silvally: "Receive the Fire Memory!"

A disc storage slot suddenly opened beside Silvally's head, catching the red disc.

"Transform into a Fire-type beast, burn!!!"

"Roar!!"

Silvally's eyes lit up as it absorbed and used the Fire Memory's power, converting its type to Fire-type!

Moreover, its eyes, tail, and the tips of the hair on its head all turned fire-red.

"Fire Fang!"

Whoosh!!

Silvally's body immediately blazed with surging flames as it turned and pounced toward the somewhat stunned Servine.

"Watch out!" Johan reminded.

Bang—

Servine was knocked flying.

Landing on the sand, it slid for some distance.

Fortunately, its usual training had taught Servine never to underestimate any opponent and to always be ready for opponents to suddenly "lock health and make a comeback," so it avoided the most direct attack.

But burn marks still inevitably appeared on its vines.

"Ser! Vine!" Servine's body immediately surged with even more powerful green fluorescence.

It was angry...

Watching this scene, Johan opened his mouth, then decisively and rationally swallowed his words.

The reason Silvally was called "Little Arceus" was precisely because of its signature ability "RKS System," combined with corresponding "Memory" discs, it could change its type at any time like Arceus with its plates.

Moreover, when Silvally was created, it was modeled after Arceus.

This was why Silvally was called a "legendary Pokémon."

The Aether Foundation was also the only organization besides Team Rocket capable of creating legendary Pokémon.

Gladion and Silvally had ultimately overcome difficulties and completed their return to original form.

However...

"Servine!!"

Servine's tail swung.

A green tornado formed entirely of green leaves roared forth.

It directly swept up the newly Fire-type Silvally.

Leaf Storm!

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar nearby put its hand to its forehead in an observing gesture, sighing as it clicked its tongue.

Except for Johan and Ninetales, not even it could calm down Servine's temper.

Silvally had really made Servine serious.

"Ka-kaah~ Ka-kaah~"

Gengar put one hand on its hip while shaking its head.

Difficult, difficult, this team is getting harder to manage~

Bang—

Silvally was actually carried through the air by the leaves for quite a distance before crashing down into a sand pit, eyes spinning.

"Silvally is unable to battle!" Rotom announced the result.

It was instantly defeated?

Kiawe and the others had just felt their blood boiling - Silvally's transformation, Gladion's excitement, and Silvally actually being able to change to Fire-type had made them feel like maybe... Gladion and Silvally could actually beat Johan.

The result.

Servine got serious and instantly defeated the Fire-type Silvally with one Leaf Storm.

Johan was still so strong...

"Servine!"

Servine turned its head, accepting Johan's "healing service."

Gladion still seemed not to have recovered from the earlier scene.

Johan explained: "Don't think Servine is just like this - it actually acknowledged you."

"Servine! (▼皿▼)"

I did not!

Gladion nodded: "We're fine, Johan."

Losing to Johan, this legendary-level battle Champion - what was there to be disappointed or discouraged about?

Instead, daring to challenge and helping Type: Null break free from its restraints to return as Silvally made Gladion more confident in himself.

"Another 'Champion seedling.'"

Johan was increasingly looking forward to Ash and Gladion meeting.

"Alright, alright, stop making a fuss. Continue beachcombing!" Johan stopped Kiawe, who also wanted to challenge.

If they didn't continue beachcombing, the low tide would end soon and they'd have gained nothing!

Going home empty-handed was absolutely not allowed!

Two days later.

Sinnoh region, Sinnoh League.

"Johan is here!!!"

"Champion Johan is here, run!!!"

"Quick! Quick, go get our [Cynthia's Young Lady]!"
