# 736: The Legendary "Big Three Bosses"!

Sinnoh region, Lily of the Valley Island, Lily of the Valley Conference venue, which was also the starting point of the Sinnoh League's "Champion's Road."

Just like when Johan had challenged the "Champion's Road," the Lily of the Valley Conference venue was now packed with people.

Although Johan's popularity was high throughout the entire Pokémon world, Cynthia's popularity wasn't much lower than his, especially in the Sinnoh region.

Of course.

The people of the Sinnoh region held more or less a bit of "resentment" toward Johan.

He actually stole away our lovely cabbage sister!

Therefore, when Cynthia was preparing to challenge the "Champion's Road," many people at the Lily of the Valley Conference venue held up signs.

For example:

"What's so good about Johan? Aren't we Sinnoh people like Flint (crossed out), Lucian (crossed out), Aaron (crossed out), Volkner (crossed out) - aren't we Sinnoh people good enough?"

Several names with several bright red scratch marks showed the complex feelings of the person holding this sign.

"[Cynthia's Young Lady], what we mean is, if you could bring Johan to Sinnoh, we could reluctantly accept it!"

"You have to clear it faster than Johan! Only then can you gain the family throne!"

Of course, there were also some signs that were more "straightforward," like...

"We love you, our eternal cabbage young lady!"

"Go for it! Sister Cynthia!"

There were also some more... peculiar ones.

Like—

"Let go of that Johan, let me handle it!"

"Miss Cynthia, if you can't 'deal with' Johan, we also know a thing or two about fighting!"

In short.

Various and diverse, everything was there.

The others were manageable, but looking at that first and most prominent sign, Flint and Lucian immediately felt somewhat hurt...

If you're going to cross it out, don't write it in the first place!

But thinking again.

They weren't the only ones crossed out, so they felt better.

At this moment, Cynthia was in the rest room, making final preparations.

Johan and her friends were also here chatting.

"Gengar, remember all those people holding signs later." Johan whispered to Gengar.

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar gave a thumbs up, showing a knowing mischievous smile.

I understand~ Hehehe~

"Look at how they're smiling, they're definitely thinking something bad." Caitlin held Cynthia's arm, full of "hostility" toward Johan.

At this moment, Johan and Gengar's smiles looked like they were carved from the same mold.

Cynthia and Diantha smiled sweetly.

As the Kalos region's movie star and ultimate busy person, Diantha had also managed to make time during Cynthia's challenge of the "Champion's Road."

"How are your preparations going?" Cynthia gently tucked her hair behind her ear and asked.

"Me?" Diantha was slightly stunned.

Johan didn't know, but as a close friend, Cynthia was aware that it wasn't just her - Diantha from the Kalos region was also preparing for the "Champion's Road."

It's just...

In the Kalos region, being a trainer was just a "side job," and since they joined the League later than Hoenn and Sinnoh, their pursuit of the "Champion's Road" wasn't actually that intense.

According to the Kalos League's thinking, not doing the "Champion's Road" was also fine - everyone could just vote internally and raise hands to decide.

So although Diantha said she was preparing for the "Champion's Road," she hadn't stopped filming.

"Kalos isn't like Hoenn or Sinnoh." Diantha said with a smile.

"I want to challenge the 'Champion's Road' too!" Caitlin frowned and muttered.

But the Unova League's "Champion's Road" could be said to rank in the top three for difficulty among all the League regions currently.

No choice.

In regions like Kanto, Johto, Sinnoh, Kalos, etc., the Champion positions were mostly vacant, which was due to the League's lack of successors and also one of the reasons why evil organizations kept popping up in many regions.

But the Unova region was different.

Alder, as a veteran Champion, had lost his strongest partner, but his strength was still not to be underestimated.

He was also currently one of the few Champions still stationed at a League, besides Hoenn and Paldea regions.

This meant that if one wanted to challenge the Unova League's "Champion's Road," Caitlin, as one of the Elite Four, would have to challenge not only the other three Elite Four members but also a Champion. The difficulty was imaginable.

More importantly.

Caitlin's psychic powers were restricted from use in the final showdown of the "Champion's Road."

This was also because Caitlin's control over her psychic powers was insufficient - if used improperly, they could even go out of control.

Moreover, Caitlin was just talking - she wasn't prepared to take on a Champion's responsibilities.

Cynthia smiled and gently touched Caitlin's nose, "If you're willing to apply, they'd definitely be willing to let you try."

With Caitlin's strength and abilities, she definitely had the potential to become a Champion.

If she could completely master her overwhelmingly powerful psychic abilities, she might even have a chance to become one of the outstanding Champions among all regions, and legendary-level battles weren't impossible.

However, having overly strong psychic powers was good, but not entirely good.

So hearing this, Caitlin just stuck out her tongue and stopped talking.

On the other side.

Johan, Lance, and Steven also gathered together.

"Blocked again?" Looking at Lance, whom he hadn't seen for a long time, Johan said with some teasing.

Lance touched his nose, hiding some embarrassment.

If the Unova League's "Champion's Road" belonged to high difficulty, then the Kanto League's "Champion's Road" belonged to hell difficulty, especially for Lance.

No choice.

He had the chance to defeat Lorelei, who countered him most, but didn't have the ability to consecutively challenge Bruno and veteran Elite Four Agatha after defeating Lorelei.

Although there were only three Elite Four members, for Lance, the difficulty was no less than consecutively challenging two Champions.

Moreover.

The difficulty of the Kanto League's "Champion's Road" wasn't just the Elite Four battles.

The strength of wild Pokémon in the Silver Mountain Range could be said to be among the strongest in the entire Pokémon world. Just dealing with the dangers these wild Pokémon might bring wasn't something ordinary people could handle.

Not to mention that after completing the "Champion's Road," one still had to challenge several Elite Four members.

"My suggestion is still to listen to your family's advice," Johan said.

Steven nearby nodded thoughtfully.

Lance's "family" naturally referred to the Dragon-type clan in Blackthorn City, or rather the entire Johto League.

The Johto League suggested that Lance could serve as the Johto League Champion.

But Lance actually didn't want to give up on the more difficult Kanto League.

In Johan's words, he had "masochistic tendencies."

But for the Dragon-type clan and the Johto League, they needed a young generation member like Lance to be stationed there.

"At worst, the Kanto League's Elite Four just won't step down," Johan suggested.

Lance, who had previously shown some resistance, hesitated upon hearing this:

"Would that work?"

Being the Champion of one region while also being an Elite Four member of another region... would that be allowed?

Johan shrugged, "Go talk about it. Maybe both sides won't object."

"That makes sense..."

"But if you want to be Champion of two regions, don't even think about it. The League definitely won't allow that." Johan added.

Lance laughed, "If I can become Kanto League Champion, I'll give up all other positions."

Lance still had deep feelings for Kanto.

"Steven, have you been keeping up with your 'coursework' lately?" Johan looked at his student.

The so-called "coursework" he mentioned didn't refer to study assignments at Kanaz Pokémon Academy.

For Steven, academics in that area posed no difficulty whatsoever.

Whether theoretical knowledge or battle classes.

Even now, the battle class teachers at Kanaz Pokémon Academy were unwilling to battle him.

No choice.

They couldn't win.

This was probably like... those "conceptual gods" in class from short videos.

So Johan's "coursework" referred to the tasks of the "Champion's Office Director" position that Johan had created himself for the Hoenn League.

This was the key to him being able to be a "hands-off boss."

"Uh, it's okay." Steven came back to his senses.

For him, Hoenn League affairs weren't much more difficult than managing Devon Corporation.

After all, Devon was also a very large and complex major company.

He said, "However, Elite Four Drake has been looking for me several times recently..."

"Drake?" Johan was stunned, waving his hand, "It's fine. The old man understands me, he probably won't scold you."

"No." Steven shook his head, somewhat helplessly, "Elite Four Drake asked me when I plan to take over his Elite Four position."

Hearing this, Johan's expression immediately changed.

You crafty old man.

Taking advantage of my absence to poach my people, huh?

"Don't listen to him." Johan spoke righteously and solemnly, "You're still in the learning stage. Don't waste time on the Elite Four position..."

Steven and Lance looked at each other.

These words... why did they sound strange?

But Johan didn't care about them.

If Steven got poached by the old man, who would take over for him later?!

Under the investment of the League, Devon Corporation, and Johan himself, the island's construction had entered a phase of rapid development. Perhaps in less than a year, he could step down from the Hoenn Champion position.

At that time, if Steven was an Elite Four member, promoting him to Champion would involve a bunch of troublesome matters, like... what about the Elite Four position Steven would leave behind?

Give it to Wallace?

That would only work if he was willing to accept it.

If Wallace was willing, he could have competed for Elite Four long ago.

When he, Johan, stepped down, he couldn't leave the Hoenn League with a mess.

So...

He'd have to make the old man suffer a bit more and persist a little longer.

With his robust body, persisting another ten years shouldn't be a problem.

By then, he, Johan, would retire first!

"I think so too. I want to at least finish my studies first." Steven nodded.

"Exactly." Johan patted Steven's shoulder.

"You're just a student. You don't need to bear such great pressure."

When he was ready to "retire," he'd have the dean and director give Steven early graduation, then seamlessly transition to the Champion position. Perfect! Johan calculated in his mind.

Such great pressure?

Lance's expression was somewhat speechless.

With Steven's current "job," his pressure wasn't less than an Elite Four member's, right?

While the long-separated friends were chatting, a Sinnoh League staff member approached.

"Miss Cynthia, it's about time."

"Alright."

Cynthia nodded and stood up. Caitlin and Diantha also let go of her.

Seeing this, Johan also temporarily left Lance and Steven, walking to Cynthia's side and going with her toward the player tunnel exit.

"Don't be nervous. It's actually not difficult." Johan comforted.

Cynthia looked at him with a smile, "Do I look nervous to you?"

Buzz—

A Poké Ball at her waist opened by itself, and Garchomp ran out.

"Garrr!!"

It made fierce, menacing gestures at Johan with its claws.

You underestimate me?!

Garchomp's aura was completely unleashed - definitely peak Champion level!

A flash of surprise appeared in Johan's eyes.

With Garchomp's strength, if it could Mega Evolve with Cynthia, wouldn't that touch legendary level?

Truly worthy of being Cynthia, truly worthy of being Cynthia's Garchomp... Johan sighed inwardly.

"No." Johan shook his head and smiled, "I came to cheer you on, to support you."

When they reached the player tunnel exit, Johan stopped and made a cheering gesture to Cynthia.

And Cynthia, under the spotlight and amid the cheers of countless spectators, walked out of the player tunnel.

"Cynthia!!!"

"Miss Cynthia, we love you!!!"

Amid countless cheers, Cynthia walked to the "Starting Platform" in the center of the venue under the spotlight.

Just then.

"Quick! Look!"

"That, what is that?!"

"Dragons? They look like..."

Above the Lily of the Valley Conference venue, three dragon figures suddenly appeared. Everyone looked up and gasped.

The Renegade Pokémon, Giratina!

The Temporal Pokémon, Dialga!

The Spatial Pokémon, Palkia!

It was actually... the legendary Creation Trio of the Sinnoh region!

They appeared here... to cheer for Miss Cynthia?

This presence...

Was maxed out!

"There seem to be people on the three dragons' backs..."

The spotlight shone over.

They saw.

On Giratina's back was Gengar, legs crossed arrogantly with a "dignified" expression.

On Palkia's back was hammer sister Tinkaton, sitting on her hammer with legs crossed sideways.

On Dialga's back was the bear instructor Urshifu, pretending to be profound but actually snoring, with arms crossed supporting his chin.

"Holy crap..."

"The Big Three Bosses."

In the middle of the three dragons, a black shadow quickly rose and appeared - black and white flowing clouds moved gently in the breeze. It was clearly the "Nightmare Pokémon" Darkrai!

"The Big Three Bosses have four members. This is very reasonable."

Everyone was shocked by this scene.

"That's excessive..." Lance murmured.

"A bit... not quite Teacher's style..." Steven also looked surprised.

At this moment, Lucian, Flint, and Aaron, waiting in the "Elite Four Fortress," nearly fell from their chairs watching the live broadcast.

"Too, too much..." Lucian wiped his forehead.

"What is Johan trying to do? Make us three fight three dragons?" Flint scratched his explosive hair.

Even Aaron, who usually reacted slowly, reacted faster now. The cowlick on his head stood up as he seemed to understand something:

"Oh~ If we had accepted Johan's battle invitation three days ago, we would have faced three dragons~"

Lucian looked at Flint and Aaron with some headache.

Could you two stop saying "fight three dragons"?

What if someone hears?

"Ka-kaah!" Gengar, sitting on Giratina's back, patted Giratina's back and spoke seriously.

Swish—

The three dragons and Darkrai simultaneously took out four flags with the characters "Cyn", "Go", "thi", "a!" written on them.

"Ka-kaah!"

Seeing the order was wrong, Gengar immediately became agitated and shouted.

Then the three dragons and Darkrai, under its direction, switched positions to form... "Cynthia Go!"

The audience confirmed that the three dragons and Darkrai were indeed here to cheer for Miss Cynthia.

Just this formation...

But it didn't prevent them from bursting into enthusiastic cheers.

This spectacle was much grander than when Johan challenged the "Champion's Road"!

Wallace clenched his fist and pounded his palm, looking annoyed and regretful.

With such a good opportunity, how could Johan use it just to "cheer"? He should have confessed, really confessed!

Too bad Johan didn't invite him as a planner, otherwise it would definitely have been more sensational, and Miss Cynthia would definitely have been moved to tears!

Meanwhile.

Dialga: What are you doing here?

Palkia: What? You can come but I can't?

Dialga & Palkia: Hmph (ˉ▽￣～)~~

Palkia: By the way, what are we holding?

Dialga: You ask me, who do I ask?

Palkia: Ask it. It's so happy, seems to understand.

The two dragons looked at Giratina.

"Roar—"

Giratina indeed looked very happy, excitedly calling out.

Giratina: First time seeing so many people, and there's good food later. Happy~

Dialga and Palkia looked at each other.

Palkia: Whatever it is, anyway they said there's a "work meal" later.

Dialga: True, let's just hold them.

Dark mist surged around Darkrai, almost completely enveloping itself.

The three dragons didn't understand, but it knew very well, could read these characters, and understood what they were doing.

So embarrassing...

Without two, no, three boxes of energy cubes later, this wouldn't end!

Cynthia on the "Starting Platform" also stared blankly at this scene. After a brief moment of distraction, she couldn't help but laugh.

She looked at Johan, still standing in the player tunnel, who was covering his forehead with an exasperated expression.

It seemed this "plan" was initiated by Johan but arranged and implemented by Gengar.

Even the idea might have been Gengar's.

After all, it was a bit out of character for Johan but very much in line with Gengar's style.

However...

Although the momentum was a bit over the top and seemed somewhat "silly," Cynthia also felt Johan's thoughtfulness.

They say when a good man is in front of someone he likes, he always acts like a little boy.

This was probably that kind of situation, right?

Silly, but kind of cute...

Seeming to notice Cynthia's gaze, Johan in the player tunnel quickly lowered his hand, forced a smile, and made a cheering gesture.

"Victini, Victory Blessing!"

"Vii~"

The "Victory Star" Victini saw the "light of victory" on Cynthia!

At this moment, Johan felt so embarrassed he could dig a hole in the ground with his toes.

Sure enough, trusting the ghost was my biggest mistake.

Originally, Johan just thought that since he rarely came to Sinnoh, he felt it necessary to communicate with the three dragons and strengthen their friendship.

So Gengar volunteered for this job and said it would give Johan and Cynthia a big "surprise."

Indeed.

Surprising enough...

Even the "Big Three Bosses" came out.

"I shouldn't have thought about asking Palkia to help build a 'space passage.'" Johan realized his "problem."

He had actually planned to have the Spatial Pokémon Palkia build a "space passage" between his island and home.

This way, whether he or his Pokémon wanted to go to the island, it would be incredibly convenient.

Now he'd have to pay some "meal fees" later.

"Sigh..."

Johan, who had sighed, suddenly reacted.

Wait.

Once Cynthia becomes Champion, couldn't he just ask Cynthia for reimbursement?

After all, they're Sinnoh region's three dragons - asking the Sinnoh League for reimbursement should be fine, right?

Thinking that once Cynthia became Champion, plus himself as the Hoenn League Champion, wouldn't that combination be a dual Champion couple?!

Thinking of this, Johan immediately felt much better, and looking at the showing-off Gengar and the Creation Trio in the sky, the embarrassing feeling diminished considerably.

Although some accidents and surprising events had occurred, fortunately Cynthia's "Champion's Road" began normally and smoothly in the end.

It's just that...

The wild Pokémon on the "Champion's Road" and the three people in the "Elite Four Fortress" were quite frightened.

And Cynthia also stepped onto the "Champion's Road" under everyone's attention.

Johan also experienced for the first time the feeling of watching someone else challenge the "Champion's Road."

It felt quite like... watching an outdoor survival livestream.

However, after watching for not long, his phone suddenly rang.

Someone calling at this time?

Taking out his phone, he saw it was... actually Leon.

Seeing the words "Leon," Johan immediately wasn't surprised.

After pressing the answer button, he indeed heard Leon say:

"Johan, I think I'm lost. Where is Sinnoh?"

See.

Johan said irritably, "You have a plane but don't take it, insisting on flying yourself?"

"Not at all. I took a plane, but I think I bought the wrong ticket."

Johan: "..."

Being completely directionally challenged was one thing, but being directionally challenged could affect buying tickets?

Leon had really opened Johan's eyes.

"Where are you now?"

"I don't know." Leon said helplessly, "There's ocean all around. I don't know where I flew."

Johan sighed deeply.

Honestly.

That Rose had trained Leon for so many years without losing him was truly... quite outstanding ability.

"Send me your location."

"Location? Sending a location will take time too, right?"

"Don't worry about it, just send me the location."

"Alright..."

Soon, Rotom received location information from Leon, right in a corner of the sea outside the Sinnoh region.

If he flew a bit further, he'd almost reach Johto.

"Wait for me."

Hanging up the phone.

"Don't know if Leon's luck is good or bad..."

Johan put away his phone, walked out of the venue, and called over Gengar and Giratina, who seemed to be having a bit of a "crowd high" for some reason.

"Come with me."

Two minutes later.

In a corner of the sea outside Sinnoh, Leon, riding on Charizard's back, was looking around bewildered.

Where exactly was this?

Suddenly.

"Roar—!!!"

Leon's Charizard suddenly tensed up all over, becoming nervous.

Sensing Charizard's change, Leon's expression changed. While pressing Charizard's neck to comfort it, he stared intently in the direction Charizard was wary of.

What kind of existence could make his Charizard so nervous?

The next second.

A pitch-black crack appeared in front of Leon.

Then, under the horrified gazes of Leon and Charizard, a black-gray giant dragon roared out from the crack with intimidating presence, making Charizard feel tremendous pressure.

"A legendary Pokémon!" Leon said in a low voice.

Although he didn't know why such a powerful legendary Pokémon would suddenly appear here, he still prepared for battle.

It's just that outside the Galar region, Dynamax couldn't be used, preventing him from displaying his full strength.

"Ka-kaah?"

At this time, a dark ghostly head suddenly poked out from the fierce dragon's head.

"Gengar?"

Seeing this, Leon was stunned.

Then he saw Johan beside Gengar, looking annoyed.

"Johan?"

He looked at the massive Giratina, feeling its aura, opened his mouth, and finally said:

"Getting lost requires such a big spectacle..."

# 737: Champion! Cynthia! (Two-in-One Chapter)

"How did you come all the way from the Galar region?"

Seeing Leon's bewildered expression, Johan couldn't help but ask.

Leon looked at the massive Giratina, then at Johan sitting on Giratina's back with Gengar, marveling at Johan's powerful "network" - truly worthy of being the legendary "Legendary Pokémon Man."

Just getting lost once had summoned a legendary Pokémon - this was...

Too enthusiastic, too much attention!

After hearing Johan's question, Leon gradually came to his senses:

"Last time I couldn't make it to your 'Champion's Road' and watched it with my master. This time for Miss Cynthia's 'Champion's Road,' I wanted to experience it on-site..."

The Galar region didn't have a "Champion's Road" system, because unlike other regions, Galar didn't have Elite Four positions - Chairman Rose could be said to hold all the power.

However, this didn't prevent Leon from wanting to strive for the championship.

To become Galar League Champion, one needed to win the "Champion Cup" and earn the right to challenge the current Champion.

So Leon was not only preparing for the "Pokémon World Championships" but also for Galar region's "Champion Cup."

Thus, he came to Sinnoh to learn.

On one hand, to observe how Cynthia challenged the Elite Four, and on the other, hoping to battle her once after Cynthia's "Champion's Road" ended.

Johan said with some realization:

"Your 'Champion Cup' is about to start too, right?"

Leon had become famous at a young age, making his mark in the Galar region early on. At just ten years old, he had won the Galar League championship.

He received focused training from Rose.

He rarely had any defeats.

Even the genius "Weather Boy" Raihan was completely suppressed when facing Leon.

The "Pokémon World Championships" and "Champion Cup" actually didn't conflict.

Because the Galar League's Champion position was currently vacant - former Champion Peony had already stepped down.

So if one could win the "Champion Cup," they could directly become Galar League Champion.

And as a League Champion, one would directly receive "Master Ball Tier" ranking in the "Pokémon World Championships"!

This was also why so many people recently started challenging for championships and "Champion's Roads."

Of course, even getting "Master Ball Tier" ranking didn't mean direct entry to the final rounds of the "Pokémon World Championships" - those who fought their way up from below could still challenge "Master Ball Tier" members in so-called "Master Replacement Battles."

Leon nodded, "They're all very strong opponents."

Although the Galar League didn't have Elite Four, that didn't mean there weren't Elite Four-level strong trainers.

Actually, quite a few Gym Leaders had Elite Four or near-Elite Four strength.

For example, Leon's rival Raihan, plus Circhester Gym Leader Melony, and Spikemuth Gym Leader Piers.

Even Ballonlea Gym Leader Opal.

This was a veteran strong trainer who had competed with Leon's master Mustard for the championship when young. Although she lost, like Kanto League's Elite Four Agatha... the older they got, the more formidable they became, and her strength hadn't declined.

"You can do it."

Johan was quite confident in Leon's strength.

After all, he was called the "strongest Champion" - this wasn't just from Rose's boasting, but required real hard strength.

Hearing this, Leon smiled. Actually, he was also full of confidence in himself.

"Let's go." Johan waved his hand, "We'll take you there."

Leon looked at the "fierce" Giratina and laughed awkwardly: "Jo-Johan, we can just follow behind..."

He didn't dare ride on Giratina's back - couldn't he see Giratina's man-eating glare?

"That works too. Let's go."

Cynthia's "Champion's Road" was proceeding quite smoothly.

With Garchomp protecting her all the way, the oppressive aura it released - that domineering, tyrannical, fierce presence typical of Dragon-type Pokémon - meant there really weren't many wild Pokémon on the "Champion's Road" who dared to cause trouble.

But this didn't mean it would be completely smooth sailing.

Among the wild Pokémon on the "Champion's Road," there were always some with very powerful strength. Garchomp's behavior was intimidating to weaker wild Pokémon, but to those with considerable strength, it was provocation.

So either there were no battles, or when battles occurred, they were mostly against powerful wild Pokémon that could cause Cynthia some trouble.

Fortunately, Cynthia's own strength was sufficient.

Moreover, she had Pokémon like Milotic and Roserade that could serve as "medics," so her condition was maintained fairly well.

Two days.

She successfully reached the "Elite Four Fortress."

Although it took a bit longer than Johan, in the history of many "Champion's Roads," this could still be considered very fast.

And today, under everyone's attention, she would challenge the four Sinnoh League Elite Four members in the "Elite Four Fortress." They were—

Bug-type Elite Four, Aaron.

Psychic-type Elite Four, Lucian.

Fire-type Elite Four, Flint.

Ground-type Elite Four, Bertha.

The first to accept the challenge was Aaron.

Bug-type Pokémon, although could be considered the most used type by trainers throughout the Pokémon world, few could train Bug-type Pokémon to extremely high levels.

To become an Elite Four member specializing in Bug-type alone, Aaron was unique even in the entire Pokémon world.

This alone showed Aaron's capabilities.

Don't look at his usual absent-minded, slow-to-react appearance - when it came to actual battles, he wouldn't be careless, and moreover...

His demeanor actually made him more appealing to Bug-type Pokémon.

You could often see Aaron standing alone in forests, not battling or exploring, but Bug-type Pokémon like Butterfree and Beautifly would land on him when he extended his hand.

Even more exaggerated.

Beedrill swarms, the "forest tyrants," wouldn't attack Aaron either.

Flint even said Aaron could obtain honey from Beedrill without getting hurt!

As friends, he, Lucian, and Cynthia could often get some precious Beedrill honey from Aaron.

With such Bug-type affinity, Johan suspected he possessed a special ability similar to Phoebe's affinity with Ghost-type Pokémon.

"It's starting."

Lance, sitting in the VIP room watching the livestream with Johan, Steven, Leon, Caitlin, Diantha and others, said.

On the big screen, Cynthia and Aaron were already standing on opposite sides of the battle field under the spotlights. Johan even felt familiar background music playing.

Cynthia VS Aaron!

Just like Johan's time, it was a 6-choose-4 battle.

Aaron's Pokémon were Scizor, Vespiquen, Beautifly, and Heracross.

Among them, Scizor and Heracross could Mega Evolve.

Facing Cynthia, Aaron chose Scizor as his Mega Evolution, because Steel and Bug-type Scizor was only 4x weak to Fire, and among Cynthia's Pokémon... there were no Fire-types.

This was one of Cynthia's shortcomings.

Actually, Johan, Cynthia, Leon, and Diantha all belonged to trainers who didn't specialize in a single type, already having much broader coverage than single-type specialists.

If Aaron faced Flint, he'd be completely countered. Not to mention similar strength - even if Aaron's raw power was stronger, as long as it wasn't too much stronger, he couldn't possibly beat Flint.

But when facing Psychic-specialist Lucian, Lucian would be at a considerable disadvantage.

And when Lucian faced Flint, unless Flint had an explosive performance, Lucian could easily suppress Flint most of the time.

So the three formed a strange circle where Lucian countered Flint, Flint countered Aaron, and Aaron countered Lucian.

Back to the battle on screen.

Bug-types were weak to Fire, Flying, and Rock. Cynthia had no Fire or Rock-types, but she did have Flying-types.

This was quite a pleasant surprise for Johan.

Togekiss!

Nicknamed "Little Airplane."

Cynthia's Togepi had evolved into Togekiss, which was somewhat beyond his expectations, and this Togekiss's strength was already considerable. Combined with its "Serene Grace" ability...

It became Cynthia's "trump card" for suppressing Aaron.

[Serene Grace: Doubles the chance of additional effects when using moves!]

This was an extremely powerful ability. When combined with the move "Air Slash," it presented the true form of the "Air Airplane."

Especially in the hands of someone with good luck - whoever used it knew.

Anyway, when Johan played games before, his "Air Airplane" missing seven consecutive Air Slashes had happened.

But when facing opponents, their six consecutive flinches tortured him to "heavenly bliss."

Simply put, Togekiss with "Serene Grace" was a Pokémon that depended on luck from above.

Coincidentally.

Cynthia plus Togekiss belonged to the type that luck actively fed.

Then everyone saw...

Aaron's Scizor being hard-controlled by Cynthia's Togekiss for six consecutive "Air Slash" flinches.

"Did Johan teach you this move?" Lance's eyes lit up slightly.

You get excited just seeing Flying-types, huh?

Johan said irritably: "Hey, in broad daylight, how can you falsely accuse people, Lance?"

Steven nearby nodded thoughtfully.

"It fits our teacher's tactical style."

Johan: "..."

What kind of impression have I left on you people as a great people's teacher?

But back to the point.

"Togekiss greatly relieved Cynthia's pressure." Leon commented.

Precisely because of Togekiss's presence, Cynthia only paid the "price" of Togekiss's stamina in her duel with Aaron, which greatly reduced pressure for Cynthia's subsequent challenges.

Of course, "losing" Togekiss didn't mean Cynthia's other Pokémon had no stamina consumption.

It's just that such consumption was within acceptable range, and the medicine Cynthia could carry hadn't been used yet, so recovery to full strength would be quick.

Mainly, it was because they were too familiar with each other.

After defeating Aaron, with Aaron's blessing, Cynthia rested briefly before entering the second battle room.

Cynthia VS Lucian!

Lucian's most famous tactic was undoubtedly his "Trick Room tactics," using Bronzong with Slowbro to decent effect.

But for Cynthia, she had a move that could completely counter Lucian's "Trick Room tactics" - Spiritomb!

Ghost and Dark-type Spiritomb was simply Lucian's greatest nemesis, an insurmountable obstacle for him.

In the end, he relied on Mr. Mime's Dazzling Gleam to barely take down Spiritomb.

And in the final phase, it became a duel between Lucian's Mega Gallade and Cynthia's Lucario, with both sides tacitly choosing to clash head-on.

"Lucian is still too focused on tactics." Lance shook his head with some "regret."

Success through tactics, failure through tactics.

Too much like those academic types.

Tactics were certainly good. When facing opponents weaker than oneself or of similar strength, excellent tactics and coordination often had very good effects.

But when facing someone whose tactical understanding wasn't inferior to one's own, or was even better, it was hard to have much effect.

Just like the current Mega Gallade VS Lucario battle.

Clearly Lucian and Gallade were the ones Mega Evolving, but in terms of displayed momentum, the tacit understanding and coordination between trainer and Pokémon, plus some indescribable bonds, they were obviously inferior to Cynthia and Lucario.

Lance, who also emphasized "emotional power," felt Lucian was somewhat like Lorelei.

"Indeed." Leon also agreed.

He was also someone whose battle passion exceeded tactics, who would make on-the-spot decisions and ignore tactics due to battle passion.

In this regard, Steven and Johan were more balanced.

They had the tactics they should have, and the battle passion they should have wasn't lacking either.

Steven spoke: "But you have to admit, Lucian did well in terms of consumption as one of the challenges."

No one denied this.

Because Lucian had "consumed" Cynthia's Spiritomb and Lucario.

Although Lucario hadn't lost its fighting ability, after this battle, given its physical and mental exhaustion, it couldn't be recovered with just medicine.

Most likely, it couldn't participate in subsequent battles.

Having defeated two Elite Four members, Cynthia's Pokémon were nearly half "depleted."

This definitely wasn't good news.

"Lucian needs more responsibility..." Johan half-closed his eyes, rubbing his chin and muttering softly, his eyes showing some "dangerous" light.

However, he still had full confidence in Cynthia.

After all, Cynthia's true ace and strongest Pokémon, Garchomp, hadn't made its move yet.

But about to face Flint, Johan felt somewhat anxious.

Don't look at Flint's usual carefree appearance, or how Johan liked to tease Flint, but regarding Flint's strength, whether Johan or Cynthia, both recognized it greatly.

No exaggeration - if the Sinnoh region didn't have Cynthia, the championship would most likely belong to Flint.

He had such ability and potential.

Moreover.

Flint in casual battles versus Flint in crucial battles were completely different people.

Casual battles: 10% explosive rate.

Crucial battles: 99% explosive rate!

"Miss Cynthia has reached the third room. The opponent she's about to face is - Fire-type Elite Four Flint!!" The host's voice was passionate and energetic.

Cynthia VS Flint!

In Johan's view, this was the most suspenseful battle.

Not that Cynthia would lose, but the suspense was how many of Cynthia's Pokémon Flint could take down, and to what extent he could push Cynthia.

After all, in terms of type matchups, among Cynthia's Pokémon, the advantage against Flint was most severe.

Water and Ground-type Gastrodon, Water-type Milotic, and "Little Land Dragon" Garchomp all heavily countered Flint's Fire-type specialty.

But neither Johan nor most of the audience expected that knowing Flint would probably explode, they didn't expect him to explode right from the start.

"Magmortar, let big sister see our progress - Fire Blast!!"

On screen, Flint excitedly clenched his fist, his fiery red explosive hair like burning flames, his eyes full of desire for battle.

Boom!!!

Starting directly with full-power but low-accuracy Fire Blast, showing Flint's burning heart to the fullest.

At this moment, what Johan, what Creation Trio - none could affect him at all.

He just wanted to battle Cynthia with everything he had.

This was respect for Cynthia!

"Flint really is full of passion." Lance quite approved of Flint.

If Lucian was a representative of calm, tactical thinking, then Flint was a typical emotional, hot-blooded type.

If we had to compare, Flint was actually the same type as Ash.

When hot-blooded and excited, even facing legendary Pokémon, he could battle.

But when lacking passion and battle desire... Pokémon that had fought legendaries could lose to level-five Pokémon fresh from professor labs.

Extremely high ceiling, extremely low floor.

"This guy Flint..." A cold smile appeared on Johan's face.

Decided!

The Galar region's Eternatus incident must be resolved, and Flint would be the "vanguard"!

"Gastrodon, Rain Dance, Muddy Water!" Cynthia appeared much calmer than Johan, her black coat flowing as she gave commands.

Regarding how to battle Flint, if Cynthia claimed second place, not many in the entire Pokémon world would dare claim first.

After all...

Flint and Cynthia's battle record was - 208:0.

"Rain Dance prevents Flint from using Solar Beam and Solar Blade, removing Gastrodon's biggest threat." Steven said.

Water and Ground-type Gastrodon's biggest threat was Grass-type moves.

You had to say Cynthia had experience.

Flint's Magmortar ultimately couldn't avoid defeat.

But Flint wasn't discouraged - instead, his enthusiasm grew even higher.

"Go, Ninetales!"

Flint's second Pokémon was actually a Ninetales, and one with "Drought" ability!

"Drought" directly overrode Gastrodon's "Rain Dance" effect, returning the weather to clear skies.

"Ninetales, Solar Beam!!"

Flint shouted loudly.

Oh no.

This thick-browed, big-eyed guy Flint had actually learned "Sun Team" tactics?

What was the difference between this and hooligans becoming educated?

They'd never seen Flint's Ninetales before...

And Cynthia's response...

"Gastrodon, Protect!"

Used one Protect to withstand Solar Beam.

This showed Cynthia had some preparation for Flint's "Drought" Ninetales and Solar Beam.

"Gastrodon, Toxic!"

After blocking Solar Beam, Cynthia changed tactics.

Then...

Then Lance, Leon, Steven, Diantha, Caitlin and others all looked at Johan with strange expressions.

"Toxic stalling" tactics!

"Hey, the most basic 'toxic stalling' tactics don't need you all looking at me, right?" Johan couldn't stand it.

Diantha smiled sweetly: "Little Cynthia never used these tactics before."

Caitlin muttered: "Birds of a feather flock together."

Johan: "..."

If Flint's "Drought" Ninetales gave people a feeling of... hooligans becoming educated.

Then Cynthia using "toxic stalling" tactics gave the impression that you had to be more ruthless than hooligans to defeat hooligans.

Of course, Cynthia's Gastrodon wasn't just ordinary 'toxic stalling' - it also included Recover for healing, Muddy Water to lower accuracy, highlighting one word... dirty!

"Am I hallucinating? Why do I feel like I'm watching Johan battle?"

"Don't doubt it, I have the same illusion."

"It's over, our Miss Cynthia has been completely corrupted by Johan!"

"Evil Johan, so hateful!!"

"..."

With just "toxic stalling," Johan still had a chance to argue, but with the other supplementary moves plus the earlier "Serene Grace airplane," even jumping into the Yellow River wouldn't wash him clean.

"Whatever."

Johan expressed "giving up."

Anyway, she was his girlfriend - if he taught her, so what?

He was planning to teach much more, not limited to Pokémon knowledge!

Gastrodon with tactics did heavily counter Flint.

But Gastrodon ultimately fell to Flint and his Infernape's iron fists, without even a chance to be recalled and switched.

Because one second Gastrodon had the advantage, the next... it was instantly KO'd by an explosive Infernape's Focus Energy Close Combat combo.

And facing Flint's Infernape, Cynthia sent out her Garchomp for the first time.

She was very clear.

If she let Flint's Infernape continue performing, all her Pokémon except Garchomp might fall.

Rather than let him consume more Pokémon, better to... let Garchomp handle it.

And when Cynthia sent out Garchomp, she also "switched" to "hot-blooded mode."

Head-on clashes!

No tactics whatsoever, but battles that made everyone, all spectators, boil with excitement!

Blade against blade, fist against fist!

And Flint's biggest shortcoming might be that Infernape couldn't Mega Evolve.

Otherwise, with Flint and Infernape's compatibility, their understanding and bonds, plus Mega Evolution, who knows how much stronger they could become.

So.

Infernape and Flint ultimately lost.

But they could also be considered successful.

They greatly consumed Garchomp's stamina and left Cynthia with only her last two Pokémon, one being Garchomp with nearly half its stamina consumed.

And Cynthia still had one more, also the final Elite Four member Bertha to defeat.

In this situation, no one didn't worry for Cynthia.

Even Johan felt a bit concerned.

Bang!!

The cup on the table suddenly exploded, drawing everyone's attention.

Caitlin clenched her small fists, gritting her teeth: "Fire-playing explosive head... you wait for me!"

Bang!!

Looking again at the sound, a huge crack appeared on the table.

Everyone: "..."

This was... trouble.

The VIP room staff quickly called to notify colleagues to come replace things.

"The teacup and table mysteriously broke, come replace them quickly - no need, the ceiling's gone too..."

Under Ninetales' protection, Johan remained relatively "calm." He chuckled coldly: "Calm down, Caitlin. You need to actually get a chance to act."

Cynthia VS Bertha!

They changed to another VIP room.

"Water-type Milotic... against Ground-type Elite Four Bertha should regain some advantage, right?" Lance said somewhat uncertainly.

"Not necessarily." Steven shook his head, "Elite Four Bertha has Quagsire and Whiscash."

Water and Ground-type Quagsire and Whiscash weren't afraid of Milotic.

Johan suddenly said: "So Cynthia's last one definitely won't be Milotic, but Roserade."

Roserade?

Several people were stunned.

Grass-type Roserade did counter Ground-types, but obviously Roserade's resistance wasn't as good as Milotic's, and its body was more fragile.

Moreover...

Caitlin frowned: "I remember Elite Four Bertha has a Mamoswine, right?"

Ice-type was one of Roserade's weaknesses.

Johan nodded, "Right, the goal is to make Elite Four Bertha bring out Mamoswine."

Leon understood, realizing: "Clear obstacles for Garchomp?"

Garchomp was 4x weak to Ice. As long as they could lure out the Ice-type Mamoswine that most countered Garchomp first, then find a way to defeat or weaken it, they could create more opportunities for Garchomp.

And this was an open strategy.

If Bertha didn't bring out Mamoswine, then Roserade might consume more of her other Ground-type Pokémon. Pokémon like Quagsire and Whiscash that were 4x weak to Grass couldn't appear.

But if she brought out Mamoswine...

"This is betting on Garchomp." Diantha sighed.

That's right.

This was betting - betting on whether Garchomp could help Cynthia complete the final victory!

Facts proved.

Johan's judgment was correct. Cynthia's last remaining Pokémon was indeed Roserade!

And after Bertha summoned Quagsire, she had to frown and recall it, replacing it with Mamoswine.

In the end.

Roserade lost its fighting ability, but Mamoswine was also nearly exhausted.

"This is the most crucial moment."

Everyone's expressions became serious.

The final 1V3 - could Garchomp do it?

And next.

Was Cynthia's most representative battle before becoming Champion!

"Garchomp, Mega Evolution!!"

In games, Garchomp's Mega Evolution was a weakening, but in reality, Garchomp's Mega Evolution, especially Cynthia's Garchomp, was a massive strengthening!

As everyone knew, the strength of gains from Mega Evolution depended on the bond between trainer and Pokémon.

This was what many trainers proudly considered "proof."

Johan was among them.

Anyway, so far, Johan hadn't seen any Mega Evolution with stronger gains than his and Gengar's.

And the bond between Cynthia and her Garchomp wasn't inferior to that between Johan and Gengar.

They had lived and grown together since childhood.

Garchomp would never disappoint Cynthia.

"Garrr—!!!"

Mega Garchomp made its powerful entrance!

That terrifying aura was clearly...

Legendary level!

"Ka-kaah~!"

Gengar understood Garchomp too well. It mimicked and transformed into Garchomp's appearance, lowering its voice to a hoarse, deep imitation of Garchomp's tone.

Next, it's my hunting time!

One Dragon Rush, instantly defeating Bertha's weakened Mamoswine!

Another identical Dragon Rush, instantly defeating Bertha's Whiscash!

Then, trading an Earthquake with Bertha's Quagsire before finishing it with another Dragon Rush.

The final Rhyperior caused Cynthia and Mega Garchomp considerable trouble.

But Bertha's loss was in not having a Mega Evolution.

So it was smashed into the battle field by Mega Garchomp's unreasonable Dragon Claw, losing its fighting ability!

Mega Garchomp powerfully swept nearly 1v4!

Helping Cynthia dominantly claim the championship with overwhelming momentum that set hearts racing and blood boiling.

"New monarch crowned! New monarch crowned!"

"Champion Cynthia!!!"

"Miss Cynthia is Champion! We're all Champions!!!"

"Oh no! Oh no! Johan and Miss Cynthia, dual Champions?! One family, two Champions? Invincible..."

"I suggest writing a book now, with their child as protagonist. I've even thought of the title - My Champion Parents!"

"..."

The entire venue, the entire internet erupted and boiled over.

It had to be said, watching a "Champion's Road" was truly exciting.

Compared to Johan's run, while Cynthia's was equally passionate, it lacked that heart-stopping, all-or-nothing, life-hanging-by-a-thread feeling.

"Phew—"

Johan breathed out lightly.

Although he had great confidence in Cynthia, watching until the end, he really sweated for her.

It felt harder than going through the "Champion's Road" himself.

Fortunately, Garchomp was truly fierce.

Champion!

From now on.

Hoenn and Sinnoh could be expensed freely!

"Vii~!"

Victini held its head high proudly.

This time, I made great contributions!

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar crossed its arms with a "praise me" expression.

This time, I was the one who contributed most. Without my opening cheering, hmph~

The main characters hadn't even returned, and the little ones were already claiming credit.

After Cynthia defeated Bertha and registered her and her Pokémon's information, she officially became Sinnoh League Champion!

"That really was spectacular..." Lance and others all felt this way.

One person consecutively challenging and defeating four Elite Four members - this difficulty was truly enormous.

But now Cynthia had "made it to shore." It was their turn now.

Lance, Leon, and Diantha looked at each other and said nothing more.

----------

# 738: Mewtwo: This Time, I Won't Be Human! (Two-in-One Chapter)

One day later, in the Hoenn region, on the small island off the coast of Kanaz City.

"Wow—"

Flint, with his bruised and swollen face, looked at the small island before him in shock, his eyes filled with envy and amazement.

"Teacher Johan actually became an 'island owner'..."

Johan's island had undergone earth-shaking changes once again.

Before Johan became the Hoenn League Champion, the island's development had actually been quite good.

He had planted about two hundred berry trees and raised roughly twenty to thirty wild Pokémon, all of which were Pokémon that could promote the island's "development."

Additionally, he had planted many valuable medicinal plants, such as Energy Root, Revival Herb, and Miracle Berry trees.

Of course, this also included a flower garden.

But even so, even though the planting wasn't particularly dense, the island's coverage was only about one-fifth to one-fourth.

But now?

Ever since Johan had used the reason of a "Pokémon Mental Healing Island" to get the Hoenn League and Devon Corporation to assist in developing the island, in just the half month he spent as a "teaching assistant" in the Alola region, the island's development speed had been extremely fast.

It could almost be said to change every day.

The current island, besides the berry trees and other plants Johan had planted, as well as the grass covering almost the entire island, had also been planted with several different types of forests.

This wasn't like Johan's method of digging up berry tree saplings from everywhere and planting them. Even with Servine's care, half a month wouldn't be enough for them to mature.

But the trees planted this time under the League and Devon's cooperation, while not all berry trees, were all fully grown trees.

This gave the island many shaded areas.

And these shaded areas became habitats for many wild Pokémon.

So the number of wild Pokémon on the island had increased considerably, with the count having broken through two hundred at least. Most were Pokémon that hadn't seen Johan and his team before, and were quite timid, currently hiding in the forests.

Of course, since this was a "Pokémon Mental Healing Island."

After the island was completely built, they would gradually send some Pokémon that might have mental defects or psychological issues to the island.

Perhaps in a year or two, Johan's island would become something like a "Pokémon psychiatric hospital," "problem Pokémon shelter," or "abandoned Pokémon gathering place."

Johan speculated.

Unless they were Pokémon affected by some incident, most Pokémon coming to the island in the future would probably be Pokémon abandoned by trainers or owners.

This was an unavoidable problem in the Pokémon world.

Otherwise, there wouldn't have been the plateau where abandoned Pokémon gathered in the movie "Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel."

After all, in some situations, humans capturing innocent Pokémon was actually very simple.

And compared to proper training, abandonment was truly a very straightforward and simple method.

Of course, one couldn't rule out situations where abandonment was unavoidable or forced, but in Johan's view, these were actually various excuses.

So for these Pokémon in need of help, he wouldn't be stingy with his helping hand.

When necessary, he also wouldn't mind teaching those who abandoned Pokémon a lesson, whether they were ordinary people or trainers.

For innocent Pokémon, this would definitely become a lifelong shadow.

Even more so.

Sometimes abandonment was even a relatively "good" outcome. For those who caused Pokémon injuries due to twisted hearts, he really couldn't tolerate them.

It was precisely because of these various reasons that his island's construction application and reimbursement could be approved within the Hoenn League.

Where there was demand, there would be supply.

Otherwise, did he really think that becoming Champion meant he could do whatever he wanted in the Hoenn League?

And to accommodate various types of Pokémon in the future.

Besides forest areas and planting areas, the Hoenn League and Devon Corporation had also spent considerable money and effort building various habitat areas.

For example, swamp areas, desert areas, grassland areas, rocky areas, and so on.

The current "local boss" of the rocky area was Garganacl.

It was precisely because of this that Flint showed such a shocked expression after seeing it.

Johan's island was definitely not as large as Master Mustard's Isle of Armor, but the advantage of not being so large was strong control over the entire island.

"Can big sister also apply for an island now?" Flint murmured.

Hearing this, Lucian glanced at Flint with annoyance, then distanced himself by two steps.

Don't you know why your face is still bruised and swollen?

Steven nearby smiled and explained: "Teacher built this island to help Pokémon in need, which is why the League strongly supports it."

Lance suddenly understood.

"I see."

As an investigator, Lance had seen too many tragic experiences of Pokémon. For him, even just being abandoned was sometimes a small matter.

Not just the Hoenn region, but the entire Pokémon world needed more places like Johan's "Pokémon Mental Healing Island."

He suddenly sighed: "Teacher Johan truly lives up to Professor Oak's title of 'Mental Health Master'."

Leon said with a complex expression: "I wonder if Teacher Johan would accept Pokémon from other regions in the future."

Like Lance, he had similar experiences.

The Galar particles in the Galar region had been very unstable recently, with wild Pokémon suddenly Dynamaxing frequently.

Although the commotion caused by those Dynamaxed wild Pokémon was quickly suppressed, the ones most hurt were actually those wild Pokémon.

Whether physically or mentally.

But the Galar region obviously didn't have such a place yet.

So if possible, Leon really wanted to send those injured Pokémon here.

"Given Teacher Johan's temperament, he probably won't refuse," Diantha said.

Everyone nodded, then all showed strange smiles, mentally adding a sentence—but the fees probably won't be low.

Teacher Johan's "judging people by their wallets" was somewhat famous.

For the poor, ordinary people, and their Pokémon, Teacher Johan was willing to help for free.

But if someone wasn't short of money, Teacher Johan didn't mind charging just a tiny bit more.

However, everyone understood this.

Which trainer wasn't short of money?

Leon still had small advertisements on his cape.

Moreover, maintaining such a large island would definitely be expensive in the future.

"You can communicate with the teacher about it later. It shouldn't be a big problem," Steven suggested.

Leon smiled and nodded.

Anyway, Chairman Rose wasn't short of money.

"Speaking of which, where is Teacher Johan?" Lucian asked.

Several people were gathered here, but Teacher Johan and big sister Cynthia weren't present.

Diantha smiled and gestured toward the distance, saying: "Johan said he had a surprise for Cynthia."

Caitlin huffed indignantly: "Dog man, always knows how to trick young girls' hearts."

Lucian looked in the direction Diantha indicated. He remembered that area seemed to be a flower field, and suddenly understood: "Teacher Johan is so skilled."

Lance and Leon looked at each other.

Skilled?

Skilled at what?

The two simultaneously looked at Flint.

Bruised and swollen Flint picked his nose: "Of course skilled at battling, what else could it be?"

Lance and Leon suddenly understood.

Nearby, Lucian, Steven, Diantha, and others all held their foreheads.

No wonder you're single.

Though Lance had someone who liked him, and Leon had a childhood friend, dare we ask what the fire-playing explosive-head had?

On the other side.

Cynthia and Johan walked one after the other to the island's flower garden.

Through the diligent efforts of Butterfree and Combee, plus the nourishment of Calyrex's power, this flower garden could now even be called a flower field.

Johan covered Cynthia's eyes and brought her here.

The drifting floral fragrance had already entered her nostrils, and Cynthia roughly guessed something, but her heart still couldn't help rising with anticipation and emotion.

"Here we go~"

Johan released his hands.

Her eyelashes trembled lightly, her bright eyes slowly opened, and what met her gaze was a large field of brightly colored flowers. The gentle breeze passed through, creating ripples of flowers.

Cynthia's face at this moment was like the February sun—bright, charming, and captivating.

Last time in Floaroma Town, Johan had said he would give her a flower field in the future. She hadn't expected to receive this gift right after becoming Champion.

"How is it?" Johan was quite satisfied with the scene before him.

Although there weren't any particularly precious flowers, and he hadn't spent much effort, the result was surprisingly good. When he first saw it, he was also shocked by the scene.

"Actually, this is my real surprise for you. The Champion's Road thing... was all planned by Gengar."

Cynthia stared blankly at the scene before her. In the flower field, Butterfree and Combee were still working diligently.

After a long while, she finally pressed her lips together and nodded vigorously:

"I love it very much."

"I'm glad you like it," Johan smiled.

But he heard Cynthia say seriously: "I like you more."

Hearing this, Johan was slightly stunned, his face reddening slightly, but he still grasped Cynthia's hand and said softly: "I like you too."

The two looked at each other and smiled, both their faces somewhat flushed.

Not far away, Gengar was holding Garchomp, looking like it was afraid of it rushing in.

Who knew that today's Garchomp was acting unusually quiet, not showing its usual aggressive, tooth-and-claw attitude of wanting to tear Johan apart.

"Ka-kaah?" Gengar looked confused.

"Garrr..."

Garchomp crossed its arms and looked up at a forty-five-degree angle.

This "cabbage" it had raised for more than twenty years was finally going to be taken away. If Cynthia was happy, what could it do?

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar, acting like an "experienced person," patted Garchomp's shoulder.

Old shark, I understand you~

"Garrr!"

But the Garchomp that had looked melancholy just a second ago immediately exploded upon hearing this, baring its teeth and claws at Gengar.

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar was startled and quickly assumed a fighting stance with both hands.

Well then.

The compromise and acceptance were all fake—finally couldn't hold it in anymore, right?

Night fell.

On the island, Johan spared no expense. While inviting everyone to play, he naturally also prepared a sumptuous dinner.

On one hand, it was to celebrate Cynthia becoming Champion, and on the other hand, it was to celebrate his island's near completion.

Soon, he would have to run between four places: school, home, the island, and Sinnoh. He'd be quite busy.

"Palkia, is the space tunnel ready?"

Johan looked at the three dragons and Darkrai who were eating heartily, his eyes twitching as he asked.

Ordinary people really couldn't afford to host them—they ate too much!

[Almost done.]

Palkia looked up at Johan, said a sentence, then continued eating.

"It needs to be stable. I don't want to suddenly be transported to some unknown space."

[Leave it to us!]

Dialga immediately guaranteed, but showed no sign of stopping eating.

Johan: "..."

How can I be reassured with you like this?

At this moment, Darkrai wiped its mouth and said: "Don't worry, I supervised the construction. The tunnel built by the three dragons together is very safe. Even if you really get transported, it would be to Giratina's 'Distortion World.' Don't worry."

The world was truly wonderful. Previously, Darkrai and Dialga and Palkia had fought to the death in Alamos Town, with Darkrai nearly dying, but now they could sit together and eat.

However, Darkrai's words did make Johan feel more reassured.

A tunnel built by the three dragons together should be reliable.

Using Giratina's "Distortion World" as the space tunnel's carrier, anchoring space with Palkia's spatial power, and stabilizing the space tunnel with Dialga's temporal power.

If a space tunnel built with the combined power of the three dragons wasn't stable, then Johan really would have wasted all that food.

But honestly speaking...

The three dragons together weren't as reliable as little Hoopa.

If little Hoopa couldn't stay here permanently, he wouldn't have needed to invite the three dragons to work.

"Darkrai, take good care of them."

Darkrai immediately made an OK gesture.

On the other side.

Cynthia, Caitlin, Diantha, and others were also sitting together enjoying the food, "contributed" by the Love siblings, Alcremie, and Mewtwo.

It had to be said that Mewtwo indeed had talent, whether in battle or in cooking.

But...

With so many people suddenly arriving, plus so many Pokémon, the workload...

When Johan came to Mewtwo's side wanting to ask about its condition, the expressionless Mewtwo rolled up the apron it was wearing and slammed it hard on the table.

"This time, I won't be human!"

After throwing it down, it ran off to eat with Gengar and the others.

Johan: "..."

Love siblings & Alcremie: "?"

Johan opened his mouth but didn't know what to say.

Mewtwo had been working as a laborer (crossed out) experiencing the feeling of being human at his place for over a month now. Its work could definitely be called outstanding, especially in using psychic powers in various aspects.

But looking at the current situation, it seemed to think... being human was boring?

Being a Pokémon was better!

But with so many mouths to feed, what to do?

They were all looking at him expectantly!

Could "being human" be chosen at will?

Freely switching forms back and forth?

Johan had to admit that under his "melting pot," Mewtwo had also become "flexible."

Facing those expectant eyes, Johan smacked his lips, picked up the apron Mewtwo had thrown down, put it on, and joined the "labor force" with the Love siblings and Alcremie.

Mewtwo's "metamorphosis" was over, and Johan had to return to "laborer" work.

"Sigh... even Mewtwo has learned bad habits."

Johan looked at Mewtwo, who had already started competing with Gengar for food, and couldn't help smacking his lips.

It's all Gengar's fault!

What kind of team is it leading!

"Do you need my help?" At this moment, seeing this scene, Cynthia gracefully walked over and asked.

Hearing this, Johan's expression immediately changed.

He took out a sign and quickly wrote—Cynthia and Gengar, not allowed near!

He still vividly remembered what happened the last time Cynthia entered the kitchen.

He quickly reassured her: "You go eat obediently. I'll have Rotom help me."

With that, he shouted to the side: "Rotom, oven form!"

"Understood! Roto! Super transformation form!" Rotom shouted in a very chuunibyou manner and dove into the oven.

Seeing this, Cynthia smiled sweetly and didn't insist, obediently returning to her seat to continue eating.

However, while eating, she placed a small bowl beside her. Each time she ate something, she would take two portions, putting one in the small bowl next to her. Soon there was already a small pile.

This silent action made the others at the table unable to help thinking—I shouldn't be here, I should be under the car...

The night was slightly cool.

After eating and drinking their fill, everyone sat directly on the soft grass chatting.

Some chatted about their lives, like Cynthia, Caitlin, and Diantha.

Others talked about Pokémon and battles, like Lance, Flint, and Leon.

Some discussed management and operational knowledge, like Steven and Lucian.

As for Aaron?

Very enthusiastic during meals, he was now silently standing by the pond in a daze, surrounded by some Butterfree and Combee.

He stared blankly at Servine, who was engaged in an energy-law-violating mutual nourishment with the "Miracle Berry tree," not understanding what Servine was doing, just as Servine didn't understand what he was doing.

Of course, there were also Pokémon playing together.

Led by Gengar, the "card players" were engaged in "passionate" Pokémon poker, with Victini dominating.

Led by Tinkaton, the forging group mainly consisted of Metagross, Aggron, Lucario, and other Pokémon, listening to Meltan cheering while watching Tinkaton forge.

It was like scrolling through short videos—they couldn't stop watching when they saw forging.

There were also the "ladies" led by Ninetales and Garchomp, whispering quietly about something, looking exactly like Cynthia, Caitlin, and Diantha.

And there was the still-eating group led by Tyranitar, mainly consisting of it, the three dragons, and Darkrai.

Of course, the largest group was definitely the battle sparring group.

This was the group with the most Pokémon.

Dragonite, Ceruledge, Urshifu, Infernape, Lance's Dragonite, Leon's Charizard, and other Pokémon.

After eating their fill, they needed to battle to digest.

"Teacher Johan."

Leon suddenly scooted over and sat next to Johan.

"Hm?"

Johan, who had just sat down wanting Love sister to give him a massage, turned his head in confusion.

"After your island is built, could some Pokémon from our Galar region also be sent here for you to help care for?" Leon asked.

Johan was stunned, then came to his senses: "The Pokémon that were forced to Dynamax?"

"Yes." Leon showed some helplessness. "These Pokémon are all innocent. They're actually all kind Pokémon."

"Send them over," Johan said directly.

This time it was Leon's turn to be stunned.

He agreed just like that?

Johan smiled: "Like you said, the Pokémon are actually all innocent. Of course I'll help if I can."

Leon was somewhat moved and didn't know what to say for a moment.

After a long pause, he suddenly lowered his voice:

"Teacher Johan, Mr. Peony told me everything."

Johan wasn't surprised by this.

Peony cared about the cause of sudden Dynamax, and Leon was equally concerned. As long as they investigated, they would eventually run into each other.

"Did you find out?"

Leon's expression became serious: "Mr. Peony discovered that those Galar particles indeed come from near Wyndon, but the exact location hasn't been pinpointed yet. We need Professor Magnolia's help."

Johan nodded.

From this situation.

Discovering Eternatus wouldn't take much longer.

If Peony cooperated with Dynamax expert Professor Magnolia, finally locating Eternatus at Macro Cosmos's energy plant probably wouldn't be difficult.

The repair of hammer sister's sword and shield needed to be accelerated.

Though hammer sister didn't need his reminder. The little one was very happy when forging and had been busy with it every day recently.

Moreover, the "Pokémon World Championships" was coming soon. The Galar region couldn't avoid going even if they wanted to, and he had promised Calyrex.

Flint, it's time for you to step up!

Flint, who was discussing battles with Lance, suddenly felt a chill down his back and instinctively looked toward Johan, meeting his gaze.

Touching his still-swollen face, Flint said warily:

"Jo-Johan teacher, battles are fine, but they have to be normal rule battles. For unlimited battles, find Lance!"

Johan smiled "kindly": "What are you thinking? I don't like battles, especially unlimited battles. I was thinking... aren't you bored staying in Sinnoh? How about I take you to Galar for a couple of days?"

Hm?

Flint's eyes lit up.

Lucian nearby was about to speak when he heard Johan say to him:

"Lucian, I'm helping you reduce pressure. You should be more relaxed without this guy around, right?"

"True enough."

Lucian reacted and said to Flint: "Right, you should follow Teacher Johan out to see more of the world."

Flint immediately said: "Good! I'll go to Galar to improve my ranking, and there are master replacement battles coming up."

As an Elite Four member, Flint received an "Ultra Ball Tier" rating in the "Pokémon World Championships."

But "Ultra Ball Tier" also needed to reach a high enough ranking to qualify for challenging "Master Ball Tier" members in so-called master replacement battles.

"Speaking of which, have all the 'Master Ball Tier' candidates been decided?" Johan suddenly asked.

"Teacher Johan, you don't even pay attention?" Flint looked surprised.

Leon said: "Currently, only four people are confirmed for 'Master Ball Tier.'"

"Four people?"

"Teacher Johan, Miss Cynthia who just became Champion, Mr. Alder, and Nemona from Paldea."

Leon named the four people, all regional Champions.

Because of Paldea region's existence, the "Pokémon World Championships" Johan and others were participating in was different from the "World Coronation Series" he remembered.

In this "Pokémon World Championships," there would be a total of sixteen "Master Ball Tier" members!

Among them, nine "Master Ball Tier" positions were allocated first—either regional League Champions or people recommended by various Leagues, representing nine regions.

The remaining seven spots.

Two would be filled by people from the previous tournament who ranked high but hadn't participated much in ranked battles.

The remaining five spots.

Would go to the top five from ranked battle standings.

However.

Even if the final sixteen masters were determined, the spots weren't fixed until the master tournament began.

Because there were so-called "Master Replacement Battles."

"Ultra Ball Tier" players who reached a certain point total or ranking in ranked battles each had one chance to challenge those sixteen "Master Ball Tier" members.

One decisive battle—the winner would advance to "Master Ball Tier" for the final master tournament, while the loser would miss the master tournament.

So although Johan and others had secured "Master Ball Tier" spots now, if they lost in "Master Replacement Battles," they wouldn't qualify for the final master tournament.

The rules were quite complex and cumbersome.

However, these rules gave regional Champions sufficient respect while also giving all players adequate opportunities.

In fact.

Even in "Master Replacement Battles," few people would challenge those who became "Master Ball Tier" as Champions.

After all, a Champion was usually the top combat power of their region, with exceptional strength. Few believed they could defeat a Champion.

At least the success rate was very low.

Unless they knew this Champion very well and had Pokémon types and abilities that heavily countered them.

If Lance became Champion, he'd need to be careful of trainers specializing in Ice and Electric types.

Others like Johan, Cynthia, Alder, and Nemona weren't type-specialist Champions, making them relatively difficult to target.

"What about the Alola League?" Johan thought of Professor Kukui.

Although the Alola League was still just a makeshift organization, since it was a regional League, it should receive proper respect, right?

"I heard the Alola League seems to be recommending someone called the Masked Royal," Flint said, stroking his chin.

Of course.

That was Professor Kukui.

Professor Kukui's Masked Royal actually had considerable popularity and fame, especially among those interested in wrestling.

However, for many trainers, Professor Kukui might indeed become someone challenged in "Master Replacement Battles."

Johan nodded, gaining a general understanding of this "Pokémon World Championships."

The "Pokémon World Championships" would be held in the Galar region and Paldea region.

Actually, Johan was quite curious about the Paldea region.

After all, he hadn't seen ancient or future species Pokémon yet.

He also wondered what the current situation in Paldea was, and what Area Zero was like.

For most trainers, the Paldea region was quite "mysterious."

Unlike the Galar region with Rose's constant promotion, or the Alola region that gradually became a tourist destination, plus the Paldea region being very far away, many people didn't even know about the existence of future and ancient species Pokémon.

"If there's a chance this time, I should go take a look..."

The next day.

After the gathering ended, everyone went their separate ways. Johan specifically booked a return flight for Leon and had Flint escort him to the airport, watching him board the plane before leaving.

Cynthia, having just become Champion, had a pile of Sinnoh League matters that needed her attention.

Even if she wanted to put the burden on Lucian's shoulders, she first had to count how many burdens there were, right?

So Cynthia returned to the Sinnoh region with Lucian last night.

The poor young couple hadn't spent much time together before separating again.

However, Cynthia said that during the "Pokémon World Championships," she would arrive early so she could travel with Johan while learning about other regions' cultures and customs.

They agreed on a "tourism" plan together.

This would just make Lucian suffer more.

Lucian: Looking up at the sky.

Moreover, Johan would also be busy for the next few days.

Because...

Kanaz Pokémon Academy's summer break was over—finally time for the new term!

Apparently.

Due to too many applicants, Kanaz Pokémon Academy had even expanded some classrooms and dormitory buildings during the summer.

It was only because Devon's construction team was capable enough that they managed to complete the expansion in time.

Moreover, Principal Martin seemed to have been "pressured" into recruiting many young but very promising and capable students.

Among those he had specifically mentioned, requiring Johan to personally "handle," was someone from the distant Paldea region—Poppy!

Reportedly, eight-year-old Poppy had already been exceptionally promoted to Elite Four by Nemona, the chairwoman and Champion of the Paldea League!

The youngest Elite Four member in history!

She was also the youngest student in Kanaz Pokémon Academy's history, and the youngest yet strongest student.

When Steven had enrolled, he hadn't been as remarkable as Poppy.

Poppy's enrollment was also why Johan, now serving as Kanaz Pokémon Academy's "poster boy," had to personally appear.

Thinking about it carefully.

Steven specialized in Steel-type, and Poppy also specialized in Steel-type.

Could this perhaps be some kind of "inheritance"?

Coming to the familiar school gate again, Johan couldn't help but sigh.

"It's been a whole year since I came to this world..."

In this year, he and his Pokémon had experienced so many things.

But perhaps it was precisely because of these experiences.

That he and his Pokémon could achieve such growth, and their bonds could become so deep.

"Excuse me... which way to the faculty office?"

At this moment, a voice came from behind Johan.

Looking toward the sound.

He saw a young man wearing a brown vest, with white hair, dressed neatly and looking very spirited.

Looking at the newcomer, Johan was stunned, feeling somewhat familiar but unable to recall where he'd seen him.

But the newcomer clearly recognized him, looking somewhat surprised and excited: "Teacher Johan?"

He stepped forward: "Hello, Teacher Johan. I'm Friede, from the Paldea region!"

Friede?

Rising Volt Tacklers?

Pokémon Horizons?!

Partner Pikachu Captain form?

Friede's appearance suddenly made Johan feel a bit "crashed."

Wasn't "Pokémon Horizons" separate from previous Pokémon storylines?

# 739: The Sudden "Shura Field"!

A team founded by three people.

Each more outrageous than the last.

Our old principal really has an impressive network.

Could he be the legendary "Mr. Face"?

"Teacher Johan!"

Watching their hurried departing figures, Marcel cast a somewhat "pitying" look.

Poor kids, don't blame your senior.

Friede followed Johan all the way, watching his attitude toward students and the students' attitude toward him, and couldn't help sighing inwardly.

Teacher Johan really was an approachable, gentle, and kind good teacher.

Let me wear it?

A hat suitable for Pikachu's head—how could it possibly fit a chubby Pokémon like Gengar?

Moreover.

Gengar's head was full of spikes.

"Gengar!"

"Pika~"

He didn't want to explain, but after thinking about it, he patted Friede's shoulder and said to him and Pikachu:

Arriving at the faculty office.

Because he was busy "taking care of" a little "ancestor."

In the busy office, Principal Martin was crouched in front of an eight or nine-year-old little girl with a face full of smiles, holding toys in one hand and snacks in the other, asking if she needed anything else.

No choice.

The youngest Elite Four member in history—a nine-year-old Elite Four member!

Moreover, it was the first day of school for this nine-year-old Elite Four member, and she wasn't enrolling in elementary school, but in Kanaz Pokémon Academy, which could be considered a "higher education institution."

Johan counted as one, Johan's student Steven counted as one, and then there was no one else.

Faced with this situation, Principal Martin couldn't help but be careful.

However, next to the girl sat someone with crossed legs, looking cool and androgynous.

It was clearly another Elite Four member of the Paldea League, Rika!

She had one hand in her hair, looking helpless as she said: "Principal Martin, you don't need to do this. Poppy is just young in age; it doesn't mean she's unreasonable. If she wants something, she'll tell you herself."

"You don't trust Poppy?" Poppy's expression became serious as she looked at Principal Martin.

Would his faculty office just disappear?

Principal Martin: "..."

If she was just mentally mature, why wouldn't Orange Academy dare to accept her?

And the person he was calling for had actually already arrived at the door.

Seeing Principal Martin being "toyed with" by Poppy, Johan silently shook his head.
