Then he said: "Teacher Friede, please come with me to the principal's office first."

"Alright." Friede glanced at Johan, Poppy, and Rika before following the hurried Principal Martin.

After all, it was indeed the start of school, and Principal Martin's time was quite tight as the head of faculty affairs.

As for communicating more with Teacher Johan... they would be teachers at the same school anyway, so there would be plenty of opportunities.

After the two left.

Poppy and Rika also obediently got down from their respective chairs and looked at him.

Johan smiled slightly and beckoned to them both: "Come on, I'll show you around our academy. Let's not disturb the other teachers' work here."

"Oh!" Poppy became very well-behaved when facing Johan.

Then the three of them toured around the academy.

"Gengar, restrain yourself!" Johan said irritably to Gengar.

"Ka-kaah~(Д)σ"

Gengar pointed at the Sunflora in the bushes over there, with uncontrollable drool almost sliding down from the corner of its mouth.

Haven't seen them in so long, let me go say hello~

Johan didn't listen to its excuses.

Say hello?

You think I didn't see that those Sunflora's seeds have grown another batch, right?

It had been away for a while, and these Sunflora had grown another batch of seeds. Don't just strip them all bare.

With Gengar's departure, the Sunflora all sighed in relief.

Forbidden by Johan, Gengar drooped its ears and floated behind him, not forgetting to wave goodbye to the Sunflora.

"Ka-kaah~"

I'll come collect next time~

Sunflora: d(д)

At the same time, Rika briefly explained why Nemona agreed to send Poppy to Kanaz Pokémon Academy.

Rika certainly wasn't here to study—she was just responsible for bringing Poppy here.

Nemona's meaning was simple.

No matter how strong Poppy was or how mature her mentality, she was still too young and should still receive proper education.

At least.

She should experience the academy atmosphere.

As for why she wasn't sent to Orange Academy.

Because Orange Academy didn't dare accept her.

Their concerns weren't much different from Principal Martin's.

Moreover, Orange Academy had complicated student relationships with various clubs and organizations. It would be easy to really anger Poppy, and that wouldn't be something a few words could calm down.

So Nemona contacted the principal of Kanaz Pokémon Academy.

The old principal naturally said: Come! Welcome!

Thus.

This youngest Elite Four member enrolled at Kanaz Pokémon Academy, becoming the youngest student in the academy's history and also the strongest student upon enrollment.

"The old principal really is..." Johan rarely truly admired someone.

Boss Giovanni counted as one, and this old principal... also counted as one.

Throwing such a big "trouble" at him.

How should Poppy be handled?

However, for the first few days of enrollment...

Senior, Steelix Mega Stone...

As expected of you, Steven!

The Paldea region popularized Terastallization, which Poppy had naturally mastered skillfully, but Mega Evolution was another matter.

"I remember the academy has opened a new 'Mega Class.' You can apply, and if you encounter any problems, you can come find me anytime." Johan said.

With the gradual popularization of Mega Evolution, the demand for Mega Evolution was also increasing.

After all, Mega Evolution didn't have location restrictions like Dynamax, nor did it need charging like Terastallization.

However, the higher the demand, the higher the prices of Mega Stones and Keystones rose, making them unaffordable for ordinary people.

"Mm!" Poppy nodded vigorously.

"By the way."

Johan suddenly remembered something and smiled: "If you need battle training, you can find my 'temporary assistant.'"

"Temporary assistant?"

He looked at Rika with some meaning: "That fire-playing explosive-head."

Flint should be back from escorting Leon to the airport soon. Having him serve as a "teaching assistant" wouldn't be bad—at worst, he'd pay him a salary.

Three thousand Pokédollars would be enough.

Sure enough, after hearing the description "fire-playing explosive-head," Rika's eyes became sharp.

Poppy pouted and very wisely said: "I don't want to battle that guy. Fire-type counters me heavily, and besides... that guy gets too carried away in battles. I'm not Cynthia."

Afterward.

Johan took the two around to see some facilities within the academy.

Such as teaching buildings, breeding houses, battle arenas, training grounds, and so on.

Principal's office.

"Ahaha—it's Friede! That girl Lucca has been praising you non-stop." The old principal with purple eye circles was still enthusiastic.

"Principal."

Friede greeted him very politely, then said: "Teacher often mentions you too."

"What does she say about me?" The old principal asked very curiously.

Hearing this, Friede was momentarily at a loss for words.

Small talk—don't you understand small talk?

And what could she say about you? Friede looked at the old and new injuries on the old principal's face, and the Spinda nearby chewing bamboo leaves...

"Cough, teacher says your health is as robust as ever."

"Hahaha—that girl Lucca really understands me." The old principal laughed with satisfaction.

"Principal, about my request..." After brief hesitation, Friede decided to bring it up himself.

Hearing this, the old principal's expression became serious. After asking Friede to sit down, he said slowly:

"Rising Volt Tacklers Class, is that the name?"

"That's right."

The old principal's fingers lightly tapped on the desk.

Seeing this, Friede's face tightened, his brow furrowing.

Seeing his expression, the old principal immediately smiled: "Don't be nervous. I discussed this with your teacher long ago and already agreed to your request."

Friede, as a young person with strong abilities who was also a Pokémon Professor, was definitely rare talent.

People who could achieve sufficient accomplishments in both training and research weren't many.

Professor Oak counted as one, Professor Kukui (if his public identity counted) was one, Professor Sycamore counted as half.

Teacher Johan could also count as one.

Although Teacher Johan wasn't yet a Pokémon Professor, his achievements in Pokémon psychology were unmatched in the entire Pokémon world, and becoming a Pokémon Professor was just a matter of time.

Therefore, in the old principal's eyes, Friede was completely a "little Johan"!

Friede's request was actually to establish a "Rising Volt Tacklers Class"—a class that existed with "outdoor training" as its curriculum and main direction.

The appearance of such a class could greatly close the gap between "academy types" and "traveling types," and could be considered a new type of "teaching method."

However.

As an academy, student safety always had to be the first priority.

Could Friede alone really take care of so many students?

Food, clothing, shelter, and transportation—this wasn't just about taking them out.

Moreover.

Although Friede's strength wasn't weak, situations where he couldn't be everywhere at once couldn't be ruled out.

After briefly explaining his thoughts to Friede, the old principal looked at him.

"So principal, what you mean is..." Friede naturally understood these concerns, so he asked back.

"Small classes, elite training, and you also need to show me what you've prepared. Food, clothing, shelter, and transportation—I need to see everything." The old principal counted off item by item.

When it came to students, the old principal was still very responsible.

At the same time, he added: "And at most one month before you have to come back."

"As for students, you need to invite them yourself. You can't force them—you need their own agreement."

"Of course."

He, Friede, couldn't do something like forcing students.

"Then that's settled." The old principal nodded. "The academy will give you some financial support, but the rest is up to you."

"That's enough!"

"Also..."

The old principal paused, then smiled: "This is your first time being a teacher, right? As for how to guide students... when you have time, you can consult Teacher Johan."

"I definitely will." Friede also smiled—this was exactly what he hoped for.

"May I boldly ask why you want to establish such a class?" The old principal asked curiously.

This wasn't exactly an easy job.

Friede and the Pikachu on his shoulder looked at each other, then laughed heartily: "Because we want to fly higher than the sun together and see the whole world!"

"What does that... have to do with establishing a class?"

"Good things need to be shared, Principal."

Friede said seriously: "And I think I also need to pass on some of my thoughts and ideas, just like my teacher passed them to me, just like Teacher Johan's students are spread throughout the Pokémon world!"

"Good aspirations."

The old principal sighed inwardly—truly worthy of being "little Johan."

Returning to Hoenn, returning to school... after the start of the new semester, Johan's days seemed to gradually return to peace.

However, as Champion, although he had become a hands-off boss under Steven and Glacia's "efforts."

That didn't mean he truly didn't need to worry about anything.

Sometimes, he still had to represent the League in handling some tricky matters.

Fortunately, Groudon and Kyogre were both very well-behaved now, so it didn't take up too much of Johan's time.

On this day, Johan was reading a book in a café when he suddenly heard a familiar voice.

"Mew~"

An ethereal, light call sounded near his ear.

Hearing this voice, Johan's previously relaxed expression immediately changed dramatically.

Oh no!

Sure enough.

As soon as this voice appeared.

Terrifying psychic power fluctuations immediately erupted from his kitchen, and a silver-white figure wrapped in powerful psychic energy flashed over.

The next second.

In front of Johan.

Mewtwo, still wearing an apron that it hadn't had time to remove, and Mew, who had gained two extra pounds, both looked at him simultaneously.

Their expressions were different.

But the feeling they gave Johan was...

This was bad.

Could this be... the feeling of a Shura field?!

# 740: Johan: I'm at the Bottom? (Two-in-One Chapter)

"Ka-kaah?"

Sensing the commotion, Gengar poked its head out from upstairs.

When it saw the two sides causing the disturbance, Gengar felt its little brain shrink slightly.

Oh no!

Mew hadn't come for so long that it had subconsciously overlooked this problem.

"Mew?"

The round, cute Mew looked at the fierce-looking Mewtwo in front of it, tilting its head with deep confusion.

It sensed its own aura from Mewtwo, giving it the feeling of seeing its own child.

Thinking of this, Mew's little face immediately turned pale.

Could this be what they showed on TV—suddenly becoming a parent?

It never expected such a melodramatic plot would happen to itself?

While Mew could sense the aura on Mewtwo that was similar to its own, Mewtwo could naturally also sense the similarities between Mew and itself.

Actually, Mewtwo had always been curious.

Logically speaking, its displayed strength wasn't weak—even the scientists who created it and Giovanni called it the "strongest Pokémon," so it was somewhat curious about how exactly it had been created.

However, under Johan's guidance, Mewtwo had gradually stopped caring so much about this matter.

But unexpectedly.

Right here, in Johan's café, it encountered its "original" as a "clone."

It turned out to be such a chubby, round, very cute little fat cat?

This somewhat caused Mewtwo's self-perception to deviate and waver.

For some reason.

When Mewtwo saw Mew, especially seeing Mew in this appearance, anger welled up from the bottom of its heart—anger at its failure to live up to expectations.

The so-called "strongest Pokémon" itself had an original that looked so... harmless?

Even part of its previously established self-recognition collapsed.

"Mew?"

Mew blinked its round, big eyes, looking toward Johan with confusion mixed with unease.

Who is it?

And Mewtwo also suddenly looked at Johan.

Compared to Mew's gentleness, Mewtwo's aura seemed quite frightening.

Just with one look, powerful psychic currents immediately swirled around Johan, and the tables and chairs in the café behind him were instantly blown away.

It was fortunate the café wasn't open yet, otherwise this one look would have scared countless customers.

"Is it the 'original' I was copied from? You know it?"

This situation...

Though clearly very dangerous, a scene suddenly flashed through Johan's mind.

On one side was an aggressive and domineering strong woman, on the other was a gentle and quiet white moonlight...

Fortunately, Johan quickly suppressed this strange feeling.

He hurriedly released his aura to soothe Mewtwo's emotions while explaining:

"Mewtwo, listen to me..."

"I won't listen!"

Johan: "..."

You little rascal, your wings have grown hard, haven't they?

At this moment, Mew suddenly reacted.

"Mew~"

It sensed the differences between itself and Mewtwo, and also confirmed that... this wasn't its child, but its clone!

A clone~

This made Mew immediately breathe a long sigh of relief.

But the word "clone" made Mewtwo explode with rage.

After all.

Although Mewtwo was Mew's clone, inheriting Mew's powerful DNA, it wasn't just Mew's DNA—it also contained genes from many powerful Pokémon, and even human genes.

Mewtwo was created as the "strongest Pokémon," and its most powerful aspect was its combat ability.

This was also what Mewtwo was most proud of.

Plus, Mewtwo, which had been infused with so many genes, was inherently a Pokémon with a rather volatile personality. It was currently on the verge of an explosive rage, and if Johan weren't here, it might have already exploded.

But hearing Mew's words, it really did explode.

"As my so-called 'original,' you're too disappointing!"

A pitch-black sphere immediately appeared in Mewtwo's hand, terrifying power condensing at this moment as it unhesitatingly threw it directly at Mew.

Johan, who also heard Mew's "relieved" words, felt his heart skip a beat.

Just ask—if he were a "clone," upon hearing the original so obviously relieved to say he was the other's clone, could he hold back?

Anyway, with Mewtwo's personality, it absolutely couldn't tolerate this.

So.

When hearing Mew's words, Johan also moved at the first moment.

"Ninetales!"

He shouted loudly.

"Oowoo~!"

Like Gengar, Ninetales had also noticed the commotion here. Upon hearing Johan's voice, it slightly raised its head, tails flowing, eyes flashing with azure light as ice crystals quickly constructed an ice wall in front of Mew.

Boom!!!

The Shadow Ball from Mewtwo directly shattered Ninetales' ice wall, but it also gave Mew enough reaction time.

It flicked its tail and nimbly dodged the Shadow Ball that broke through the ice wall.

The café was immediately blasted with a large hole, raising clouds of dust.

Mew's gaze toward Mewtwo gradually became unfriendly.

It didn't like fighting, but that didn't mean it couldn't fight!

"Mew~!"

Mew flicked its tail again, flying toward the door, flying toward the sky.

Mewtwo glared "viciously" at Johan.

"You're taking its side?!"

There was even a hint of grievance in its voice.

This made Johan, who had just prepared to explode upon seeing the café blasted with a big hole, immediately lose momentum.

Wait.

It seems like I'm the victim here, right?

"Hmph!"

Mewtwo snorted coldly. Without waiting for Johan to speak, its entire body erupted with terrifying psychic power as it charged directly out of the café, chasing after Mew.

Boom!!

The café, which already had a big hole blasted in it, was once again pierced through from bottom to top by Mewtwo.

Johan: "..."

Johan looked up at the broken hole and the blue sky above it, not knowing what to say for a moment, opening his mouth.

My little ones at home are so capable of causing trouble, yet I've managed to protect this place.

But.

After protecting it for so long, you still blew it up?

Johan looked at Gengar.

"Ka-kaah!"

Noticing Johan's gaze, Gengar immediately startled, raising both hands to indicate—

This wasn't my doing!

Johan gritted his teeth, threw out a Poké Ball to summon Dragonite, mounted it while saying:

"Don't let them get away! They have to pay compensation!"

"Draaa!!"

Dragonite's eyes lit up, gently flapping its wings to disperse the dust.

Can I fly at full speed?

"Fly!"

Johan held tightly to the harness.

The café was a small matter, but if Mewtwo and Mew really let loose and started fighting in Kanaz City, Mewtwo's counterattack would be reenacted!

"Draaa!! (ˊˋ)"

Taking off!!

"Wow—Teacher Johan's house exploded?"

"What? Teacher Johan's house is gone?"

"Ah? Teacher Johan has no home?"

"Hm? Teacher Johan is gone?"

The café explosion wasn't small, and although many passersby didn't see Mewtwo and Mew, they saw the café explosion. Everyone couldn't help taking photos and posting them online.

At this moment, Johan was clinging tightly to Dragonite's back, his face pale.

"Draaa—"

Dragonite was surrounded by pale green fluorescence, its straight-line speed pulled almost to the extreme.

Even though Mew and Mewtwo were very fast, when they weren't flying at full speed, Dragonite in this state quickly caught up with them.

"Stop!"

Johan gritted his teeth, spreading his aura power to convey his meaning to the two.

At the same time, his aura also clearly sensed Mewtwo and Mew's states of mind.

Mewtwo was filled with anger, plus some... jealousy.

While Mew originally didn't have much intent to be angry—it held no hostility toward Mewtwo, but with Mewtwo persistently attacking like this, even Mew was getting a bit angry.

"Mew!"

Mew formed a Shadow Ball and hurled it at Mewtwo, who was charging at it and couldn't dodge in time.

It had to be said.

Mew, which had existed for so long, even if it didn't like fighting, its experience accumulated over the years made its reactions and abilities in battle no worse than Mewtwo's.

Buzz—

But just then, as Mew's Shadow Ball was about to hit Mewtwo, Mewtwo's body suddenly burst with colorful rainbow light.

The powerful force blocked Mew's Shadow Ball.

Seeing this scene, Mew was stunned, and Johan was also somewhat surprised.

"Mega Evolution?"

Mewtwo was holding a Mega Stone in its hand, and surging power transformed it into Mega Mewtwo X!

The physically-oriented Mega Mewtwo became even more robust, with distinct muscles and armor-like structures appearing on its chest and limbs.

Having completed Mega Evolution, Mewtwo swung its arm, directly deflecting Mew's Shadow Ball, then charged at Mew again.

"You're too weak!"

While charging, Mewtwo didn't forget to taunt.

An artificially created Pokémon that could Mega Evolve—this was probably Mewtwo's most overpowered aspect.

Mega Mewtwo X's speed suddenly increased, appearing in front of Mew in the blink of an eye, throwing a punch directly at its face.

"Mew!"

This time Mew couldn't dodge in time and was punched in the face by Mega Mewtwo X. After crying out in pain, it was sent flying.

"Dragonite!"

Johan quickly called out.

"Draaa—"

Dragonite's speed increased again, with blue and white interweaving as it appeared in Mew's flight path. The soft little one landed solidly in Johan's embrace.

"Mew~"

Feeling Johan's embrace, Mew immediately showed a pitiful expression.

Who did it provoke?

It just wanted to get some snacks and download some TV shows...

Mewtwo being cloned wasn't its doing.

Seeing this scene, Mega Mewtwo X's expression became serious as it looked at Johan and said in a deep voice:

"So you really choose to help it?"

Hearing this, Johan immediately felt a headache coming on.

This was exactly what he found most troublesome.

Between Mewtwo and Mew, helping either would make the other feel wronged.

If they were two ordinary Pokémon, he could first use physical methods to make them calm down.

But Mewtwo and Mew—how could he use physical methods to make them calm down?

But if he let them continue fighting...

Below, in Kanaz City, many League police were already gathering and evacuating citizens.

And now the most important thing was.

After seeing its "original," especially thinking this chubby, round, cute Mew made it doubt both Mew and itself, plus some inexplicable emotions, Mewtwo couldn't listen to anything he said.

But no matter what.

First minimize the possible danger and trouble!

If this continued, even Rayquaza would think its territory was being invaded.

If Rayquaza joined in too, things would become truly difficult to resolve.

"Gengar!" Johan called out.

"Ka-kaah~!"

Gengar suddenly appeared behind him, spreading its arms as thick black mist surged from its body, seeming to construct a dark cloud in the sky that covered a large area.

Mega Mewtwo X looked at this scene with disappointment, disappointedly looking at Johan and Gengar, allowing the black mist to engulf it.

In the end, you still choose to attack me?

This result made Mewtwo feel more disappointed—even despairing—than seeing this kind of Mew or hearing Mew's word "clone."

Buzz—

Spatial power suddenly fluctuated.

The black mist came quickly and disappeared just as fast.

When the black mist cleared.

Mewtwo found itself in another world.

The Distortion World!

"Roar—"

Not far away, Giratina, who had been drinking tea and "peeping," was startled, but sensing Johan and Mewtwo's auras, its expression immediately became serious.

It roared once.

Flapping its demon-like wings, it came to Johan's side.

Giratina, Mew, Gengar, Ninetales, Johan...

Mega Mewtwo X silently watched this scene.

This was the formation and lineup Johan used to deal with other legendary Pokémon, right?

Now it was its turn?

Mewtwo took a deep breath, forcing itself to rally.

"Then come! Let me see your strength..."

As soon as it finished speaking.

It saw Johan seriously take out his Keystone.

Going to Mega Evolve?

Gengar?

That made sense...

After all, the opponent was itself.

But then it saw.

The colorful rainbow light bursting from Johan's Keystone didn't fall on Gengar, but on it!

Hm?

A Mega Stone Y flew out from Mewtwo's body.

"Mewtwo!"

Johan shouted:

"Feel my thoughts for yourself!"

Buzz—

The Mega Stone trembled, and Mewtwo quickly shed the Mega Evolution brought by Mega Stone X, while Mega Stone Y connected with Johan's Keystone.

For a moment.

Between Mewtwo and Johan, through Mega Evolution, their wills, thoughts, and ideas interacted.

Since Mewtwo wouldn't listen, then feel it yourself!

'Where do you come from?'

'I don't know.'

'What is the meaning of your existence?'

'I'm not clear... but I'm searching.'

'Who are you?'

'Mewtwo!'

'Who is Mewtwo?'

'That's me!'

The simplest three questions, also the three questions that troubled Mewtwo most. Johan, borrowing the mental connection brought by Mega Evolution, asked Mewtwo again.

And Mewtwo went from initial confusion, to gradual awakening, to certainty, and finally to firmness and decisiveness.

These were the questions Mewtwo had asked when it first met Johan.

They were also the answers Mewtwo had slowly comprehended and found in its contact with Johan.

'So what relationship does Mew have with you?'

'I...'

For a moment, Mewtwo didn't know how to answer this question.

Was there a relationship?

There was... after all, Mew was its "original," and it was just Mew's "clone."

But it also seemed there wasn't much relationship.

Mew was Mew, and it was Mewtwo.

Johan asked again.

'Can Mew Mega Evolve?'

'I don't know...'

'It can't.'

'Then...'

'Why can you?'

'I don't know...'

'Because you are already a separate, independent individual. You have your own thoughts, you have your own ideas, you belong to yourself. Who are you? You are Mewtwo!'

'I am... Mewtwo!'

Buzz—

Mewtwo's body once again burst with the rainbow light of Mega Evolution, brilliant radiance completely enveloping it.

When the light faded, what appeared again was Mega Mewtwo Y!

"Mew?"

Mew looked strangely at this scene, tilting its head. Why could Mewtwo evolve twice?

So amazing, so impressive!

When Mega Mewtwo Y looked at Johan and Mew again, its eyes were obviously much calmer.

After all, Mewtwo had independent thinking ability—it was just somewhat overwhelmed upon first seeing Mew.

This was, after all, its "original" that it had been searching for.

Moreover, it learned that Johan had actually known of Mew's existence long ago, and with their relationship, Johan seemed to want to protect Mew.

Finally, with Mew's statement about "clone," it completely lost control.

When Mega Mewtwo Y looked at Johan again, it saw disappointment and regret in his expression.

Hm?

Mewtwo was stunned.

Ninetales' mouth corner slightly raised—it knew Johan was about to "work his magic."

Johan said: "I thought we already had sufficient understanding, I thought you had already found the answer, found yourself, found direction..."

"I..."

Johan raised a hand to stop it from speaking and continued: "I'm a bit disappointed, Mewtwo."

"I thought that between us, like between Gengar and me, without saying much, you would understand my thoughts. But... sigh."

Johan looked up and sighed deeply.

"It's not that I..."

Johan interrupted it again: "I was wrong, Mewtwo."

"No! I was wrong!" Mewtwo said quickly, looking like it was afraid Johan would interrupt it again.

Hearing this, Johan secretly breathed a sigh of relief.

Good, he didn't have to turn to ash.

"Alright, then you were wrong. I forgive you."

Mewtwo: "?"

"Mew?"

Mew looked blankly at this scene.

This was the same guy who had been so aggressive and fierce just now?

Now so "obedient"?

Mew couldn't help looking at Gengar and Giratina.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar stroked its round chin with a look of sudden understanding.

So this is how Johan secretly manipulated us all along~

So from an observer's perspective, this is how things develop~

Indeed, observers see clearly.

Giratina felt something was off somewhere, but couldn't quite put its finger on it. It seemed... anyway, something was very wrong! Very wrong!

It thought of a type of person it had seen on TV, or rather a term—player!

Suddenly Johan's gaze swept over, and Giratina couldn't help but shudder.

Oh no! It seemed to know a secret it shouldn't know. Would it be silenced?

What was originally just a problem of unclear communication was now resolved much faster than expected through Johan's counter-manipulation.

Of course, Mewtwo still didn't have much good feeling toward Mew, especially seeing Mew that had gained two pounds.

Mainly, it was anger at its failure to live up to expectations.

Others hoped their sons would become dragons, at most hoping their fathers would become dragons—Mewtwo hoped its "original" would become a dragon.

Moreover, after recognizing that it was an independent individual, perhaps originating from Mew but now completely independent, it felt mostly relieved.

So Mewtwo immediately made a decision... help Mew lose weight!

Regarding this, Gengar said it could make a plan, while Mew was somewhat resistant.

Why lose weight when everything was fine?

Actually, Johan also quite liked the current chubby Mew, but... it really didn't look good. What if the "Tree of Beginning" got diabetes?

Moreover, when Johan and the others returned to see the café left in half ruins, his entire mood soured.

He glared angrily.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar pouted, put its hands on its hips, and whistled innocently as if it had nothing to do with this.

Seeing this, Mew quickly imitated, pouting and trying to whistle, though it didn't learn well and came out broken.

"Mew~ Mew~"

Mewtwo couldn't learn to do this like them. Looking at Gengar, then at Johan, it didn't know what to say for a moment.

Johan gritted his teeth and said irritably: "Work to pay off the debt!"

Mewtwo's eyes widened.

Work?

It would never work in this lifetime!

But seeing Johan's unyielding appearance, Mewtwo immediately backed down, though still saying aggressively:

"Fine, I'll work!"

It said this while taking out an apron and walking toward the kitchen.

Johan shook his head.

A few walls, a few tables and chairs in exchange for such a "laborer" like Mewtwo wasn't a bad deal.

He took out his phone.

"Hello, Devon construction team? My house was demolished. Yes, the café here. Please help me repair it. Okay, I'll wait for you..."

Just as he hung up, another call came in.

"Johan, what's the situation?"

Drake's voice came through.

It seemed the commotion caused by Mewtwo and Mew was too big, even alerting Drake and the others.

That made sense too.

After all, this was a collision between Mewtwo and Mew. If Johan hadn't stopped them, Kanaz City might have been completely destroyed.

Hearing Drake's somewhat heavy voice, Johan said in an extremely calm tone: "Oh, it's nothing. Two little ones at home had a small disagreement."

Small disagreement?!

A trouble that could have directly destroyed Kanaz City actually originated from a small disagreement between Johan's Pokémon?

Drake was silent for quite a while before slowly saying:

"Johan, you must live a long life."

"Garruu!"

Urshifu crossed its arms with a serious and earnest expression.

"Mew~"

Mew had a bitter expression as it flew around the island for exercise.

It couldn't help asking itself—why? Why did it need to lose weight?

More importantly...

Could this really help lose weight?

Flying around the "Tree of Beginning" every day didn't seem to help with weight loss...

"Garruu!"

Take a break!

Urshifu looked at the stopwatch in its hand and called for a training halt.

"Mew~!"

Mew immediately cheered and flew toward the dining table in the center of the island.

The reason it was willing to cooperate was because there would be delicious food after finishing, right?

Moreover, downloading many episodes would take considerable time.

"Mew?"

Flying over the lake, Mew noticed Servine sitting cross-legged by the "Miracle Berry tree" at the pond's edge.

Mew sensed the connection between Servine and the "Miracle Berry tree."

It felt a bit like the feeling between itself and the Tree of Beginning.

"Mew~"

Mew's eyes rolled as it came to Servine's side.

"Servine?"

Servine looked puzzledly at Mew.

"Mew~"

Mew gestured with its hands, and immediately aura power appeared in its hands as it began demonstrating.

"Servine!"

Servine's eyes brightened slightly—it understood Mew's meaning.

This was teaching it how to better establish a connection with the "Miracle Berry tree"!

Then, under Mew's guidance, Servine's connection with the "Miracle Berry tree" gradually became more intimate.

"Mew~"

Mew's eyes rolled again, showing some pained expression as it slowly lifted a pale green orb of light with both hands and injected it into the "Miracle Berry tree."

The next second.

The "Miracle Berry tree" rapidly grew at a visible speed, continuously sprouting branches and buds. In just a few breaths, it had grown nearly a full circle larger!

Servine, having established a closer connection with the "Miracle Berry tree," also gained huge benefits.

And like violating conservation of energy, the two mutually reinforced each other. With their connection becoming closer, they continuously gained benefits simultaneously.

It was like injecting the first powerful force into a perpetual motion machine.

"Mew..."

Mew's expression seemed to become much more listless.

Just as it arrived at the dining table, seeing Mew's "listless" appearance, Mewtwo, who was cooking, nodded with satisfaction.

It seemed this guy wasn't as "hopeless" as imagined.

Not bad.

Mewtwo's attitude toward Mew improved again.

Let's add a little to their meal at noon today, Mewtwo thought.

Clang! Clang! Clang!

Tinkaton forged vigorously. It gritted its teeth and suddenly shouted:

"Cha!!"

Clang!!

A heavy hammer fell, and brilliant golden sparks scattered instantly.

Then violent vibrations erupted from beside Tinkaton, strange power spiraling upward, seemingly accompanied by two clear wolf howls.

"Cha!!"

Tinkaton excitedly wiped the sweat from its forehead, its pink face flushed red as it looked brightly at the sword and shield before it.

Success!

"Meltan!"

Meltan's excitement wasn't much less than Tinkaton's. It had watched Tinkaton restore these bit by bit, and it had contributed considerably. The metal for repairs was collected bit by bit by it.

Now, finally restored!

"They're not fighting again, are they?"

Sensing the commotion, Johan hurried over anxiously, discovering it wasn't Mewtwo and Mew fighting again, but commotion from Tinkaton.

"Could it be..."

"Cha!"

Tinkaton immediately called out to Johan.

Restored!

The sword and shield were restored!

Johan was somewhat surprised.

So fast?

Coming closer, he saw a small sword and small shield lying quietly in front of Tinkaton, emitting faint light with no trace of rust, restored to their originally divine appearance.

"These are the sword and shield?"

Honestly, Johan was seeing the rust-free sword and shield for the first time without the two dogs biting them.

Johan wanted to reach out and touch them, but thinking better of it, he stopped.

Based on past experience, if he touched them, these sword and shield might have various problems. Better leave it to hammer sister.

Without Johan saying much, Tinkaton was already somewhat eager to put down its hammer and reach for the sword and shield.

This was rare for it to put down its own hammer.

Then nothing happened.

The sword and shield didn't change, nor did they become the form when bitten by the two dogs as Johan had imagined.

"Phew..."

Johan sighed in relief.

Good that nothing happened.

"Cha."

Tinkaton looked satisfiedly at the sword and shield pair, very pleased with its craftsmanship.

It patted its own shoulder.

As expected of me.

It's just...

Tinkaton's eyes showed some strange expression. This sword and shield somehow felt like... like there should be some response or something.

Never mind.

It could tinker with them next time.

Tinkaton admired them contentedly.

With the sword and shield restored, it was time to go to the Galar region. Perhaps Zacian and Zamazenta had already sensed it.

Although school had started several days ago, there were still many things at school.

Moreover, Poppy still needed time to adapt.

Yesterday he heard from Principal Martin that Friede wanted to establish some "Rising Volt Tacklers Class" and hoped he could help oversee it.

Apparently, Friede had used his years of work savings plus the school's stipend to build an airship.

If conditions were suitable, he could have Friede give him a ride, saving some money.

He just wondered if he could meet Liko and whether he'd see the sleeping Terapagos in her pendant.

Johan was quite curious about this crystal turtle that looked very valuable at first glance.

After all, if Terapagos "assisted," Terastallization could apparently be used freely.

"Dinner's ready!"

Mewtwo's voice suddenly rang in their minds.

Dinner! Dinner!

Not being active about meals means there's something wrong with your thinking!

"Exercise is this effective?"

Seeing Mew's somewhat listless appearance, Johan was surprised.

Was Urshifu this capable?

It could even train Mew?

"Ceruledge, are the wild Pokémon on the island okay?"

At the dinner table, Johan asked.

"Goka!"

Ceruledge's armor clanged as it indicated that with it watching, there were naturally no problems.

Now Ceruledge had returned to its "main job." The wild Pokémon on the island were all under its care and would give it face.

"Get ready. Our island might welcome a batch of new friends." Johan instructed.

Once the island construction was complete, crops needed planting, but Pokémon needing help also had to be helped.

"Goka."

Ceruledge nodded, indicating it understood and would make arrangements.

Afternoon, at school.

"Teacher Johan!"

Flint suddenly approached Johan, asking anxiously: "When are we going to Galar? I can't wait to compete in ranked battles!"

"What's your rush?" Johan said irritably.

"I have to rush! My ranking keeps dropping!" Flint took out his phone, showing the rankings.

According to the "Pokémon World Championships" rules.

"Master Ball Tier" was the top 16.

"Ultra Ball Tier" was ranks 17-200.

"Great Ball Tier" was ranks 201-2000.

"What rank are you now?" Johan couldn't help asking.

"101. I've already dropped to 101st place."

"What about me?" Johan was somewhat curious.

"'Master Ball Tier' isn't currently ranked since there aren't enough people yet. But according to competition rules, since Teacher Johan has never participated in competitions before and has no master points, you'll probably be at the bottom."

"At the bottom?"

Johan was stunned.

He was actually at the bottom?

"But Cynthia isn't also..."

"Big sister has participated in many competitions before. Her points are much higher than yours, Teacher Johan."

Flint said with a strange expression:

"The 'Baby Cup' doesn't give points."

Johan: "..."

----------

# 741: The Brave Olivine!

Seven days later.

"This ship... is quite impressive."

On an open area of Kanaz Pokémon Academy stood a massive airship, with the lower half having a ship's structure.

Above it was a large hot air balloon-like flying device, which also served as the ship's main cabin.

At the very top were wings representing flight, which could effectively help with changing direction and stable flight.

Friede smiled and scratched his nose, saying somewhat proudly:

"This was originally Old Man Randall's 'Olivine,' but through our joint efforts, it's been transformed into what it is now. We call it the 'Brave Olivine'!"

Johan nodded, gently running his hand along the ship's edge. This was almost identical to the Rising Volt Tacklers' vessel from "Pokémon Horizons" in his memory.

Not only could it fly, but as a ship it could also navigate on seas and lakes.

It was truly amphibious.

If there was any difference, it was probably just the Kanaz Pokémon Academy logo added to the hull.

In the Pokémon world, airships weren't uncommon.

Team Plasma's massive "Plasma Frigate" was the most exaggerated, Team Rocket also had many flying vehicles, and there were even aerial fortress-like craft confiscated from that famous "Pokémon collector."

Though not uncommon, the construction cost was definitely not cheap.

As a Pokémon Professor, Friede had put all his earnings from working at Exceed Corporation into this, but it still wasn't enough without Kanaz Pokémon Academy's stipend to complete the renovation.

It was renovation, not construction.

Being able to complete the renovation was thanks to Mr. Randall contributing the "Olivine."

"Have you test flown it?" Johan asked, feeling somewhat envious.

Compared to this airship, his own flying vehicles seemed rather modest.

Inside were facilities like a control room, medical bay, kitchen, observation deck, dormitories—everything was complete.

Even more so.

When the airship's "wings" fully extended, they could transform into a very sturdy battle field, and the deck had enough space for training and daily activities.

"Of course!" Friede was very satisfied with his "Brave Olivine."

This airship wasn't just fully functional with complete equipment—more importantly, its flight energy source was fire!

Besides the coal consumption needed for regular operations, during major energy demands like takeoff and acceleration, it could be completely supplemented by Fire-type Pokémon flames.

As a "Battle Pokémon Professor," besides his signature Captain Pikachu, Friede's most iconic Pokémon was actually a Charizard!

As a trainer born in Kanto, Charizard and Friede shared a deep bond and could be considered his current strongest combatant.

The daily coal and heat requirements could be satisfied by a Coalossal and a Larvesta.

"Teacher Johan, let me introduce my friends."

Just as several "Rising Volt Tacklers Class" members were preparing to board, Friede smiled and said.

"This is Mr. Randall, the owner of the Olivine, who was once an excellent actor."

Randall was an elderly man who looked somewhat like a Drampa, holding a fishing rod and giving off a very gentle feeling.

Don't be fooled by Randall's seemingly frail appearance now—he was famous for being robust in his youth.

Moreover, under those loose clothes... he actually still maintained a robust, even exaggerated physique, giving off a Master Roshi vibe.

His principle was to be quiet when appropriate, but absolutely not stand by when action was needed.

"Mr. Randall, Ginji, I know about him." Johan smiled.

Hearing this, Randall was stunned and somewhat surprised. "I didn't expect Teacher Johan to know about Ginji..."

Ginji was the protagonist's name from the "Battle with Sharpedo" movie series that Randall had starred in.

"I heard Teacher Johan also enjoys fishing? We should fish together sometime if there's a chance..." The old man seemed happy and actively extended an invitation.

Fishing?

Johan's eyes became serious. "We definitely need to have a proper match."

When it came to fishing, he was a professional!

"This is Orla, our 'Brave Olivine's' mechanic, responsible for regular maintenance. Actually, the 'Brave Olivine's' renovation was mainly completed by her."

Orla wore practical work clothes, had her brown hair tied up, and greeted Johan with a straightforward personality.

"The famous Teacher Johan, eh? Finally seeing you in person."

Johan: "..."

Honestly, Friede's "Rising Volt Tacklers Class" really had a One Piece feel to it, even having a mechanic.

"Hello, Miss Orla." Johan nodded. "Regarding forging and repairs, I think... perhaps one of my Pokémon could have many common topics with you."

"Really?" Orla's eyes immediately lit up.

In such a Pokémon world with highly advanced technology, everyone became trainers, so there weren't many people who liked mechanics. Having a Pokémon to exchange ideas with was already quite fortunate.

Johan smiled noncommittally, thinking: Just hope hammer sister doesn't dismantle the ship.

"Oh, Teacher Johan, don't let Friede fool you. This guy made me stay on the ship as a mechanic because he couldn't afford the airship renovation costs." Orla whispered a reminder.

Friede: "..."

"Ahem, this one, this is our chef, Mr. Murdoch. The food he makes is delicious!"

Friede immediately changed the subject, introducing a dark-skinned, robust man.

It was hard to imagine this man would be an enthusiastic and attentive chef.

Murdoch extended his hand to Johan, saying warmly: "Teacher Johan, if there's anything you'd like to eat, just tell me anytime. I don't know your taste preferences or if you have any dietary restrictions..."

He immediately began asking about Johan's food preferences.

Friede whispered: "Murdoch, Teacher Johan's cooking skills are also famous."

"Oh?!"

Murdoch became even more excited. "Is that so? Then we definitely need to have a good chat about cuisine sometime!"

"I know a little, just a little bit." Johan said modestly.

Now Mewtwo was doing all the cooking at home—Johan hadn't been in the kitchen for most of a week.

Although the café was blown up by Mewtwo and Mew, having Mewtwo take over cooking wasn't entirely a bad thing for Johan.

"And this one is our doctor, Miss Mollie."

Friede introduced the last person.

A girl wearing a fashionable pink vest, pencil skirt, black stockings, with pink shoulder-length hair, giving off a... spirited young woman vibe.

Compared to Randall, Murdoch, and Orla, Mollie's expression seemed much colder and calmer.

She had her hands in her pockets, nodded at Johan, and said flatly: "Teacher Johan, I know you. You appear often in our family group chat. Our family has many fans of yours, or rather supporters."

Actually, Mollie's full name should be Joy Mollie.

That's right, she was a member of the Joy family, and her mother was a Nurse Joy.

Because of Johan's reputation among the Joy clan, Mollie often saw photos of Nurse Joys from around the world with Teacher Johan in the family group chat.

Hearing this, Johan adjusted his glasses somewhat awkwardly. "Ahem, Miss Mollie, hello."

Although Mollie had a cold personality and was somewhat... antisocial compared to other Joys, in such a large Joy family, there would always be some Joys with different personalities.

There was even that Investigator Joy who owned a Latias.

Mollie said flatly: "Actually, I'm also your fan."

"Ah, really?"

She really didn't seem like it at all—she showed no reaction of a fan meeting their idol, just like meeting a stranger.

But Mollie nodded seriously. "Not because of Teacher Johan's tactics with Blissey, but because of your attitude toward Pokémon, toward wild Pokémon that need help. This is something I need to learn."

Regarding Pokémon, Mollie's attitude was actually the same as most Nurse Joys, even more serious than most.

Johan's behavior in helping Pokémon in need made Mollie very approving of him.

"I see..."

After introducing the crew members, Friede said:

"Since everyone's here, if Teacher Johan is ready, we can depart anytime!"

For safety considerations and to let the academy better understand this "Rising Volt Tacklers Class," Johan would board the ship as a teacher representative for a not-so-short voyage.

Based on this, they would evaluate the feasibility and safety of the "Rising Volt Tacklers Class."

"Wait a moment. There are still a few people coming—they should arrive soon."

In the distance, several figures were running over.

"Teacher Johan!!"

Soon.

They reached the airship.

They were Johan's students Roxanne, Flannery, Penny, and the excited Flint.

"Are we finally going to Galar?"

Flint was nearly dying of anxiety. In just one week, his ranking had already dropped from 101st to 146th place.

As someone wanting to challenge "Master Ball Tier," this ranking made him increasingly anxious.

Finally leaving!

Johan also gave them a simple introduction.

Roxanne was serious, earnest, and rigorous—very suitable as the actual examiner for this "inspection," collecting and recording information about the "Rising Volt Tacklers Class" and "Brave Olivine."

Penny was going to Galar, to her homeland, so someone needed to show the way.

Moreover, Penny's computer skills could ensure the accuracy of Roxanne's data collection.

As for Sonia...

After summer vacation ended, she hadn't reported to school yet, saying her grandmother Professor Magnolia had given her some difficult task that would keep her busy for a while longer.

And Flannery and Flint...

Cough, these two were completely the "stress test" personnel for this "inspection team."

Only by putting enough pressure on the "Brave Olivine" could they examine its upper and lower limits.

Thus.

All personnel were finally assembled.

Everyone boarded the "Brave Olivine."

"Destination: Galar region!"

Captain Friede announced the direction.

"Pika!"

The partner Pikachu wearing a captain's hat gripped its hat tightly and declared—

Takeoff!!

The distance between Galar and Hoenn regions wasn't short.

Moreover, Friede's "Brave Olivine" wouldn't fly at full throttle, which was naturally good news for Flint, but somewhat rushed for the inspection team that needed to conduct their "examination."

However, the inspection team had work to do, while Flint and Flannery...

Well.

After the airship took off and flew into Hoenn's waters, the two got over their initial excitement and ran to the battle field formed by the ship's tail wing to battle.

Honestly.

Such a high-altitude battle field was indeed somewhat intimidating.

Looking down, there was a tremendous drop. People with acrophobia would definitely have their combat effectiveness reduced by 30% on such a battle field.

This reminded Johan of the scene in the manga where Boss Giovanni had his final battle on an airplane.

However, Flint and Flannery, these two single-minded individuals, had no such concerns.

As two trainers specializing in Fire-type Pokémon, their battle was truly... all flames and black smoke. People who didn't know might think meteors were falling from the sky.

As for their strength levels...

There was still some gap between Flannery and Flint.

Although Flannery's strength had improved tremendously since Johan first met her, she had now become a qualified Gym Leader and taken over as Lavaridge Gym Leader.

She also had guidance from her grandfather, the former Elite Four member.

But Flannery only had a decent ranking among Hoenn League's Gym Leaders. Having a gap with Elite Four member Flint was inevitable.

In this "Pokémon World Championships," Flannery was rated as "Ultra Ball Tier" with her Lavaridge Town Gym Leader position, ranking in the 500s.

Because like Johan, she didn't have many competition points.

However...

Having a strength gap was one thing, but their battle was still very passionate and seemed evenly matched.

This fully proved.

Flint was also typically someone who was strong against strong opponents and weak against weak ones.

"Torkoal, Overheat!"

"Rapidash, Flamethrower!"

Boom!!

Scorching flames erupted on the battle field.

Fortunately, this battle field on the airship wasn't completely without protection—invisible barriers completely blocked the two streams of fire within the barriers.

"Such passion..." Friede said with twitching lips.

Penny sat to the side collecting data, while Roxanne held a notebook, seriously writing notes.

Mechanic Orla was currently constantly checking and maintaining.

Truly battling above while maintaining below.

"What talent..." Johan looked at Orla's nimble, busy figure and couldn't help muttering.

Being able to renovate a ship into such an airship with energy, power, infrastructure, and entertainment facilities all complete.

No wonder Friede wanted to "bind" such talent to the ship through debt.

"Orla, I think..." Johan suddenly spoke: "How about collecting the energy aftermath from battles on this field and converting it into the airship's power?"

"Eh?"

Busy Orla wiped her forehead and turned to look at Johan in surprise.

"Good idea!"

Then she stroked her chin thoughtfully, muttering to herself: "But this doesn't seem like an easy task..."

Johan smiled and threw out a Poké Ball.

"Cha?"

Tinkaton appeared on the deck.

"This child might be able to help you."

"Cha?"

Tinkaton looked at the airship and immediately had glowing eyes, as if seeing another fun "toy."

"And this guy too."

Johan also brought out Rotom.

"Rotom!"

"Great!" Orla became interested, slapping her fist into her palm. "Let's get to work!"

"Draaa—"

Outside the airship.

Dragonite flew by happily.

If anyone was happiest about taking the airship to Galar, it was definitely Dragonite.

Flying freely in the sky to its heart's content.

But...

Letting Dragonite fly freely had one problem...

Suddenly, ship doctor Mollie's voice came over the broadcast.

"Large storm clouds ahead. Warning, large storm clouds ahead!"

Johan: "..."

This was one of the main reasons Johan usually didn't like riding Dragonite for travel except in emergencies.

Not just because of the speed.

But because...

He never knew what he'd encounter when traveling on Dragonite.

Although he wanted to give Friede's "Brave Olivine" a bit of stress testing, this kind of "stress test" seemed a bit much.

Friede pulled down his goggles and shouted into the intercom: "Prepare yourselves—we're going through!"

"Are you crazy?"

Orla nearby exclaimed.

Friede grinned: "Only this way can we show Teacher Johan the safety of our 'Brave Olivine'! I believe in you, Orla!"

Although being trusted was something to be happy about...

"It's not you who has to work hard..."

Orla complained irritably, then immediately led Tinkaton and Friede's Charizard toward the airship's engine room.

Rumble!!

Dark clouds gathered, and a bright lightning bolt struck down, illuminating the sky golden.

Seeing this scene, Flint and Flannery, who were battling, simultaneously cried out:

"No way—"

This journey began with such exclamations.

Three days later.

"From the current situation..."

"The 'stress test' held up."

Roxanne and Penny simultaneously made their respective judgments.

"We made it to Galar alive..."

"I'm still alive..."

Flint and Flannery sat back-to-back, collapsed on the deck.

Heaven knows what they'd experienced in these short three days.

They thought the initial storm clouds would be the biggest trouble, but who knew...

They also encountered migrating flocks of Fearow, whose sharp beaks nearly turned the "Brave Olivine" into a sieve.

They also encountered blizzards, tornadoes, heavy rain, and more.

Most exaggerated of all...

They actually encountered a meteor shower!

Not the kind of meteor shower you watch from afar, but the kind where fireballs directly crashed down from overhead!

More accurately, it was a meteorite shower!

Heavens.

Flint had rarely seen meteor showers in his lifetime, but this time he encountered a meteorite shower?

Teacher Johan said to have him and Flannery do some stress testing for the "Brave Olivine."

Wasn't this stress testing them instead?

"In Galar region, encountering meteorite showers is quite normal." Johan smacked his lips.

In Galar, meteorite showers were normal, right?

Too bad they didn't find any "Wishing Stars."

"Um... Teacher Johan, we've also reached Galar. How about recalling Dragonite?" Friede said with some lingering fear.

Even he felt somewhat overwhelmed after encountering so many consecutive events.

"You're right."

Johan nodded.

Otherwise, they might encounter a beam of Galar particles flying toward the "Brave Olivine" next.

Hearing this, everyone including Friede visibly relaxed.

"Galar region... where should we go first?" Friede asked.

Johan looked at his phone.

"Let's go to... Spikemuth first."

Somehow Peony had ended up in Spikemuth. They'd meet up with him first, then bring in Leon.

With the combined power of three Champions and one Elite Four, carrying sword and shield, bringing Calyrex—no need for much reasoning, they'd charge straight to Wyndon's energy plant.

Now that Johan was Champion, his own strength wouldn't falter when facing first-class legendaries.

Having worked hard to achieve such strength, if he remained timid, wouldn't that effort be wasted?

With sword and shield in hand, summoning Zacian and Zamazenta, calling Calyrex, with the strength of himself, Peony, Leon, and Flint—couldn't they overwhelm one Eternatus?

Johan—only fights crushing victories!

"Understood!"

From summer to autumn, the weather gradually became cooler.

In the blue sky above, several Corviknight soared past with "caw caw" calls, seemingly bringing autumn's desolation.

Whoosh—

A stone suddenly flew through the air, nearly hitting a Corviknight, scaring the birds into frantically flapping their wings to fly away.

"Cha..."

Tinkaton tilted its head.

Eh?

Missed?

Had it been too long since practice, getting rusty?

"Oowoo~"

Ninetales had its tail wrapped around Johan's arm, nodding slightly at him.

"Galar region! This lord has finally arrived!"

Looking at the dilapidated, graffiti-covered Spikemuth, Flint showed no awareness as he stood at the town entrance laughing loudly, provoking several leather-clad, tattooed or spike-wearing thugs to roll up their sleeves and angrily approach.

Seeing this, Flint wasn't intimidated. "Hey! Teacher Johan, I'm going to do ranked battles!"

Flint waved at Johan.

He didn't even check his phone's "matching system" notification that his opponent was only "Poké Ball Tier," not even "Ultra Ball Tier."

For current Flint, even the smallest mosquito was still meat!

Rotom Phone also suddenly floated out.

"Battle invitation received, Rotom!"

Battle invitation?

Johan, who had just landed, was stunned.

He was "Master Ball Tier"—anyone who could send him a battle invitation had to be at least "Ultra Ball Tier" and within the top 100. Even current Flint couldn't challenge him.

Johan initially wanted to refuse directly.

With his current ranking, even if he was at the bottom of "Master Ball Tier," he could directly ignore ranked battles. At worst, he'd just fight a few matches during "Master Replacement Battles."

But after thinking about it, he asked:

"What's the opponent's rank?"

"Ultra Ball Tier, 22nd place! Rotom!"

22nd place?

It couldn't be Peony, could it?

"Who is the opponent?"

"Username: Isle of Armor Master, Mustard!"

Johan: "?"

Although Spikemuth was the Galar region town closest to the Isle of Armor, did the matching system have such a wide range?

It could even match across the sea?

"Decline!" Johan decisively chose to refuse.

No way.

Master Mustard definitely treated this ranked battle like a game to "climb ranks" and would definitely get serious—too troublesome.

Even if he really wanted to fight, he'd find someone outside the top 100 to bully a bit.

"How about this one? This 'Ultra Ball Tier' 189th place dares challenge 'Master Ball Tier'? While waiting for Mr. Peony, farming some points wouldn't be bad..."

# 742: Protect! The World's Best Miss Marnie! (Two-in-One Chapter)

The sky was a crystal clear blue, and the gentle breeze carried a scent unique to Spikemuth as it brushed against their faces, accompanied by some commotion.

Flint and Flannery had already started their ranked battles, and the disturbance they caused had attracted quite a few Spikemuth "thugs" to gather.

Johan suddenly realized.

Wait.

I'm already "Master Ball Tier"—why am I still doing ranked battles?

But then he thought about it.

Rather than being at the bottom in "Master Replacement Battles" and potentially facing challenges from many powerful trainers, it would be better to...

Score a few points now, at least not to be at the bottom of "Master Ball Tier"—that would look bad.

Johan didn't think that with his current fame and strength, no one would dare challenge him in "Master Replacement Battles."

The upcoming "Master Ball Tier" would almost certainly all be Champion-level people, and those challenging in "Master Replacement Battles," even if not Champion-level, would definitely be close to Champion-level.

What was there to not dare challenge?

Moreover, there were quite a few people like Lance, Flint, and Leon who just liked challenging strong opponents for the thrill and excitement—only this way could these people unleash even stronger power.

To avoid more "big troubles" later, dealing with some "small troubles" now wasn't unacceptable.

While Peony hadn't arrived yet...

That works too.

After brief consideration, Johan said to Rotom: "Accept it. At most it'll be Marnie."

Since returning from the Alola region, through the academy's start of term, until now, his Pokémon hadn't battled for quite a while.

"Understood, Rotom! Accepting the challenge!"

The League's matching mechanism was actually quite humane.

It didn't forbid "cross-tier" challenges.

Like Flint, who had just accepted a challenge from "Poké Ball Tier"—emphasizing that even mosquito meat was still meat.

However, cross-tier challenges might seem like bullying "little kids" to outsiders, but for Flint and Johan, it wasn't a problem.

Additionally, "cross-tier" battle matching required challenges and agreement from both parties, to avoid certain people specifically targeting those with lower point rankings to farm points.

Moreover.

For "cross-tier" challenges, whether high-ranked challenging low-ranked or vice versa.

If the high-ranked person won, their gained points would be halved, and the low-ranked person's lost points would be similarly reduced.

But if it was reversed and the low-ranked person won, the gained points would directly double, or even more!

From such rules and systems, the League was actually encouraging low-ranked people to challenge high-ranked ones.

It also gave those with strong abilities but initially low rankings a faster climbing speed.

It had a feeling of... compensation points.

Of course, if people of the same "tier" within a certain range matched simultaneously, both parties' agreement wouldn't be needed.

"Several more 'Poké Ball Tier' and 'Great Ball Tier' challenges received, Rotom!"

Rotom Phone had just accepted an "Ultra Ball Tier" challenge according to Johan's wishes, and now there were so many "Poké Ball Tier" and "Great Ball Tier" ones?

"Spikemuth really lives up to its reputation..." Johan sighed.

Truly unconventional.

His "Master Ball Tier" status felt like it had no prestige at all in Spikemuth.

"Rotom, set it up—block all challenges below 'Ultra Ball Tier.'" Johan said.

Although he didn't mind bullying "little kids," he still wanted some face... cough, definitely not because winning against below "Ultra Ball Tier" gave zero points.

"Understood!"

Meanwhile.

In a factory converted into a "cheering venue" in Spikemuth, a black-haired girl was sitting sideways on a sofa, legs crossed, fiddling with her phone.

She wore a black studded jacket over a pink dress and black studded boots, giving off a dark, problem-child vibe.

Her black hair had bangs with seven strands on one side, while the other side was tied with a hair band. Combined with her cute appearance and fair skin, she also had a rock singer, energetic girl feeling.

This girl was Spikemuth's biggest idol, Marnie, sister of Spikemuth Gym Leader Piers, and the object of worship for Galar region's troublesome group "Team Yell."

Marnie's light blue eyes looked at her phone screen. When she saw the words "Challenge Accepted," she was briefly stunned.

A "Master Ball Tier" guy actually accepted her challenge?

Marnie had actually just wanted to try it out—after all, a "Master Ball Tier" trainer suddenly appearing in Spikemuth was quite surprising.

In the current Pokémon world, there were only so many people with "Master Ball Tier" ranking. Who would suddenly come running to Spikemuth?

Moreover, a "Master Ball Tier" trainer actually didn't maintain their dignity and accepted a challenge from someone like her who was nearly at the bottom of "Ultra Ball Tier"?

Who was so shameless?

Could it be Leon?

Had he already climbed to "Master Ball Tier"?

She'd only tried for fun, but since the other party accepted...

Marnie's eyes focused as she put away her phone and stood up, tidying her clothes and skirt slightly.

No matter what, since "Master Ball Tier" could accept her challenge, it was an opportunity for her. Even if she lost, she wouldn't lose many points, and she could test how big the gap was between herself, who had finally reached "Ultra Ball Tier," and "Master Ball Tier."

In the same factory, several Team Yell members holding posters and megaphones were also messing with their phones.

"Eh? 'Master Ball Tier'? Came to our Spikemuth?"

"Definitely wants to battle Piers or Miss Marnie. No way, we need to challenge him quickly!"

"Right, right! Everyone apply to challenge! Protect the world's best Miss Marnie!"

"Miss Marnie stood up!"

"So cute..."

"Where is Miss Marnie going?"

"Quick! Quick, follow her! Yell, start yelling!"

Marnie quickly walked out of the factory, heading toward the venue arranged by the matching mechanism.

Cheers came from behind her.

"Miss Marnie, do your best!"

"We'll always support you and yell for you!"

Team Yell members holding cheering posters and megaphones, speakers chased after her.

Team Yell, as the name suggested, was an organization born to yell.

Or more accurately, an organization specifically to yell and cheer for Miss Marnie. They couldn't be considered an evil organization—they were even more pathetic than the Alola region's "Team Skull."

For Team Yell, as long as you support Miss Marnie, we're friends. But if you battle Miss Marnie, we're enemies!

Protect the world's best Miss Marnie!

Hearing the crazy shouting fans behind her, Marnie's fair face felt somewhat hot.

Although she'd long adapted to Team Yell's existence... every time she heard this yelling and cheering, she still felt troubled and somewhat embarrassed.

But Team Yell's existence also made Marnie feel that at least their Spikemuth had its own power, letting her feel at ease.

This was a rather contradictory psychology.

But who made Spikemuth a forgotten, even abandoned place?

As Piers' sister, Marnie shouldered the great mission of bringing glory back to Spikemuth.

She had to make a name in this "Pokémon World Championships," had to become a famous trainer like Teacher Johan who could drive an academy, a city, or even a region.

That way, no one would be unaware of Spikemuth's existence anymore!

Marnie also silently encouraged herself.

Spikemuth's status in the Galar region could be said to have no status at all.

Because what the Galar League currently promoted was Dynamax and professional battle stadiums.

As everyone knew, Dynamax conditions were very harsh—not only requiring a Dynamax Band but also needing to be in specific locations to Dynamax.

In the Galar region, besides some outdoor environments, most cities where Dynamax was possible had specific stadiums.

Like Wyndon Stadium, Motostoke Stadium, and so on.

Stadiums let trainers and Pokémon safely Dynamax without worrying about causing destruction, while also providing audiences with good viewing platforms.

So besides older leagues and regions like Kanto and Johto, the Galar region had the most intense battle atmosphere.

Galar League Chairman Rose also used this method to increase Galar region's fame, attracting more trainers to battle, thus promoting Galar region's economic development.

But Spikemuth was awkward.

Because Spikemuth had no power spots, Dynamax was impossible, putting it somewhat out of step with the entire Galar region.

Over time, Spikemuth and its residents became somewhat self-destructive or xenophobic, believing outsiders were hostile and contemptuous toward Spikemuth.

This led to Spikemuth becoming what it was now—the entire town surrounded by spiked metal fencing.

It was also an important "cradle" for troublesome organizations like "Team Yell."

Spikemuth Gym Leader Piers also believed that even without using Dynamax, one could become a top trainer.

In such an environment and atmosphere, Miss Marnie, discovered to have outstanding talent, unknowingly shouldered Spikemuth's future burden.

Marnie quickly arrived at the battle venue arranged by matching.

A... battle field within Spikemuth, covered in graffiti and somewhat run-down.

"Sorry, are you the challenger?"

A sudden voice made Marnie instinctively freeze, warily turning her head toward the wall.

She saw a black-haired young man in black clothes, dressed very properly and wearing monocle glasses, looking quite refined and polite.

This person...

When Marnie saw the speaker's appearance, her heart trembled, and her eyes showed some shock.

Teacher Johan?!

Marnie was slightly dazed.

She had previously thought about becoming someone like Teacher Johan, using her own abilities and strength to make Spikemuth as famous throughout the Pokémon world as Kanaz Pokémon Academy.

She hadn't expected...

The "Master Ball Tier" trainer who came to Spikemuth was actually Teacher Johan?!

Actually, Johan was also somewhat surprised.

It was actually Marnie!

Piers' sister, and also a quite popular character from the "Pokémon Sword/Shield" games. Even in the real world, she had many fans.

Speaking of which.

This was Spikemuth—encountering Marnie wasn't surprising.

But... Marnie had actually reached "Ultra Ball Tier," which was quite surprising.

You had to know that as a Gym Leader, Flannery only started at "Great Ball Tier." Reaching "Ultra Ball Tier" was quite difficult.

After all, if you really ranked all the powerful trainers in the entire Pokémon world, Gym Leaders being outside the top 200 was too normal...

He'd originally guessed it might be Piers.

But with Piers' strength, reaching the top 100 should still be possible.

But Johan thought again.

This "Pokémon World Championships" was being held in Galar and Paldea regions. Trainers from these two regions had inherent ranking and climbing advantages.

Plus Marnie was originally a hardworking person, and if Team Yell interfered, reaching "Ultra Ball Tier" wasn't impossible.

But as more people climbed ranks, maintaining the tier would probably be difficult.

The Team Yell members who came with Marnie had originally wanted to see who dared battle Miss Marnie, wondering if they should deal with the opponent first... But seeing Johan:

"Oh no! It's actually Miss Marnie's idol, Teacher Johan!"

"Damn! This is dangerous—Teacher Johan is famously the 'Baby Trainer Killer'!"

"No wonder a 'Master Ball Tier' person would accept an 'Ultra Ball Tier' challenge—it's Teacher Johan, so that makes sense!"

"It's over! Miss Marnie, our Miss Marnie, wuu wuu—"

Idol?

As someone of common birth, Johan was actually an idol to many ordinary-born trainers.

Although Marnie was a Gym Leader's sister, due to Spikemuth's situation, she actually faced much more pressure than ordinary trainers.

Hearing Team Yell's "wailing" behind her, Marnie felt her cheeks burn, but her face remained expressionless.

"Ahem." Johan coughed lightly. "How about... we call it off? I'm good friends with your brother..."

If he "bullied" Marnie, wouldn't Piers come looking for him desperately later?

But if he forfeited, wouldn't he... become the first "Master Ball Tier" trainer with negative points?

Hearing this, Marnie immediately put aside all her thoughts and said seriously:

Seeing Marnie's serious eyes, then looking at the constantly yelling, noisy, wailing Team Yell members behind her, Johan nodded slightly:

Marnie had already ignored Team Yell behind her, looking at Johan with a straight face:

"This is Spikemuth—Dynamax is impossible. Neither my brother nor I have good feelings about Dynamax, so... if possible, I hope to see your enhancement method, Teacher Johan!"

Dynamax... I haven't used it either.

Gigantamax Gengar, Gigantamax Urshifu, and Dynamax Tyranitar... that Godzilla vibe.

As for other enhancement methods...

They could provide referees anytime and livestream filming.

To ensure fairness, all ranked battles in this tournament would be livestreamed and recorded in the League's database, searchable and viewable by anyone on the League's official website.

But this referee and filming job...

"Let me handle it, Rotom!"

Rotom Phone immediately flew out of Johan's pocket, then... with a flying kick, directly booted away the Rotom drone that had just landed.

The Rotom drone spun circles in the air, silently producing a question mark above its head.

?

"Hm? Am I seeing this right? Teacher Johan?"

"'Master Ball Tier' VS 'Ultra Ball Tier'? First time in this tournament, eh?"

"Oh no! Teacher Johan ran to Galar region to beat up 'babies'!"

"The opponent is Miss Marnie?! Teacher Johan actually bullied our Miss Marnie?"

"Protect! The world's best Miss Marnie!"

After all, just the title "'Master Ball Tier' VS 'Ultra Ball Tier'" was most attractive among the many simultaneous matches.

Such high-level matches weren't viewable anytime.

When people entering the broadcast discovered the battlers were Teacher Johan and Miss Marnie, word spread, and viewer numbers kept skyrocketing.

Meanwhile, Johan and Marnie had both prepared their Pokémon.

"Go, Morpeko!"

It stood on two feet with hands in pockets, showing a cute smile and two round little teeth—a harmless appearance.

"Peko~ (.o)"

"Servine."

After much consideration, since he'd promised not to hold back, he decided not to hold back...

"Leaf Storm."

"Servine!"

Servine's expression immediately became serious, surging with powerful green Grass-type energy. Countless leaves formed from nothing, swirling into a terrifying leaf tornado sweeping toward Morpeko.

That terrifying airflow, the surging leaf tornado...

Morpeko, running energetically on its "wheel," saw this scene...

"Damn, facing such cute Miss Marnie, can't Teacher Johan show mercy?"

They saw.

Z-Move?!

A rock band?

The least afraid of Ghost-types.

Annoying!

Take my Obstruct!

"Spikemuth Evil Rock Group"?

Buzz—

Dark Void!

Hypnosis effect—outstanding!

This...

Gengar happily floated to where Obstagoon had been standing, one hand supporting the microphone stand, the other gripping the microphone in a very "professional" pose, ready.

Where's the accompaniment?

What are you standing around for?

Continue the music, continue dancing!

Very problematic!

Run!

As for Johan and the others, they had already entered a room with quite good soundproofing inside the gym, isolated from the noisy rock music outside, completely unaware of what was happening outside.

The four sat down.

Marnie was still pondering Johan's earlier words, somewhat "absent-minded."

With sword and shield in hand, plus Calyrex waiting to be summoned, and himself, Peony, and Leon—three Champions.

With such a hand of "cards," could Eternatus still defeat him instantly?

Mission accomplished!

Piers glanced at Johan. "We only discovered it was you battling because we heard the commotion."

Why bring this up again?

Beep beep—

Champion Cup?

Right.

Plus Lance, Diantha, and others who were preparing.

Leon should also be making his push for Champion.

Time to play the trap card "Team Rocket Trio."

Since they were preparing to take initiative, Johan naturally made multiple arrangements.

Peony was just the obvious card.

Playing cards.

You needed magic cards, trap cards, and monster cards.

Seeing Johan unwilling to elaborate, Peony didn't ask further.

After all, such matters were quite secretive.

At Galar region's "Galar Mine No. 2," the Team Rocket trio wearing work clothes and safety helmets were "digging" away.

Then they ended up mining here.

Even during crew filming, life was more comfortable than here.

"I heard Pichu evolved into Pikachu, and the crew is looking for new actors, meow~" Meowth said with some sadness.

"Evolved?!"

Both Jessie and James showed shocked expressions.

That mischievous yet capable Pichu had actually evolved into Pikachu?

Then both became somewhat sad.

After all, they were the leads, the partners, loving and fighting in the show.

Though usually bullied badly, they had indeed built deep friendship and affection.

"Definitely not the same."

"Now I kind of miss it."

Jessie and James said.

Professor Oak's lab?

Jessie and James exchanged glances.

That was a very "dangerous" place.

But anyway...

Even more.

If...

given the chance, maybe they could invite it to join them?

Let the bullet fly?

Gengar earnestly singing on stage, with Team Yell members fallen all over the ground.

Peony quickly left.

Behind him came Piers' teeth-grinding roar.

Then Johan's roar.

"Gengar—save me—!!"

Night fell.

Galar region, Wyndon.

Wyndon was a city with considerable historical atmosphere, located in the center of the entire Galar region, once the most prosperous city in Galar region.

"From this angle, Wyndon really is spectacular." Flint stood with Johan on the "Brave Olivine's" deck, looking down at the entire city from above.

Then Flint became excited.

Such a large city—without thinking, there must be many experts inside, incomparable to that "broken place" Spikemuth.

On the lake, they could avoid most land Pokémon.

Lake of Outrage?

However.

Rose?

Dinner?

"Should I bring Pokémon?"

"Hm?"
