# 744: Rose's Probing

"The visitor comes with ill intent."

Looking at the woman before him, Johan immediately recognized her—it was Rose's prized discovery in the Galar region, his chief secretary Oleana.

She was also Rose's right-hand woman.

It wasn't an exaggeration to say that Rose's ability to simultaneously hold the important positions of Galar League Chairman and Macro Cosmos Group President was largely due to Oleana's contributions.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar whispered by Johan's ear.

We're the ones who came here.

Johan glanced at his purple fatty. I told you to watch less TV.

However, facing an invitation from the Galar League Chairman, Johan didn't have much reason to refuse, especially since...

They were providing food!

So Johan followed Oleana to the luxurious restaurant atop Wyndon Tower.

The enormous restaurant was empty, but the lights were bright, and while the décor wasn't particularly extravagant, it exuded the unique historical atmosphere of the Galar region.

When Johan followed Oleana here, he saw a middle-aged man wearing a brown-gray suit with a large belly, standing by the massive floor-to-ceiling windows, gazing out at the entire city—or rather, the entire Galar region.

However, compared to the Galar region's tallest building, the "Rose Tower," Wyndon's Wyndon Tower still fell a bit short.

"Chairman Rose, Teacher Johan is here," Oleana said.

Hearing this, Rose, who had been standing by the window with his hands in his pockets, turned around. His face bore a warm but confident smile as he said:

"Teacher Johan, I finally get to meet you in person. I apologize for not being able to personally invite you, as I was just finishing up some work—this was my oversight."

As he spoke, Rose even bowed slightly with sincere apology.

"Chairman Rose is too kind. I've long admired the Chairman—this is my first time meeting you in person," Johan replied with a standard smile.

After the pleasantries, the two stood by the massive floor-to-ceiling windows.

Rose spoke again: "This was once the most central and prosperous city in the entire Galar region. To the left is the Galar region's largest 'Galar Mine,' which has provided this city and the entire Galar region with a steady supply of minerals and energy."

He then looked toward the other side and continued:

"And to the right is the recently developed and excavated 'Galar Mine No. 2,' which will continue to supply the entire Galar region with minerals and energy materials, essentially continuing the legacy as 'Galar Mine' approaches depletion."

He looked at Johan with a smile and asked:

"Teacher Johan, do you think our Galar region can discover a third massive mine?"

Before Johan could respond, Gengar tugged at his clothes, then touched its own belly, showing a "withered" expression.

"Ka-kaah~"

I'm hungry~

Seeing this, Johan said somewhat "embarrassedly": "Sorry, Chairman Rose, my Gengar..."

Rose was also stunned for a moment, then quickly realized, "I should be the one apologizing. But I've already had Oleana make preparations—it should be ready soon."

As they spoke, Oleana had already brought the restaurant staff pushing food carts into the room.

Smelling the aroma, Gengar's eyes immediately lit up as it floated over.

Johan swept his hand across the Poké Balls at his waist, and his Pokémon appeared one by one.

"Chairman Rose is treating us today, everyone—don't be shy."

"Draaa~!"

"Garrr!!"

Hearing that someone was treating them, the little ones immediately became ravenous and excited, especially Tyranitar.

Seeing this scene, Oleana's eye twitched.

This was going to be trouble.

But when Chairman Rose was treating guests, there was no reason not to let them eat their fill, right?

Rose also brought the topic back, "Teacher Johan, you should understand that resources are limited. Under intensive development, no resource can last a hundred years."

"The Galar region isn't small—perhaps we can discover other mines later, but what about hundreds of years from now, or even a thousand years?"

Johan finally spoke, smiling: "The concerns Chairman Rose has seem far too distant, don't they?"

Rose smiled slightly and sat across from Johan. "One who lacks foresight will have immediate troubles."

"But in all things, excess is as bad as deficiency."

Actually, Johan didn't think there was anything wrong with Rose worrying about the Galar region's future resource depletion.

It was just that Rose was thinking too far ahead—so far that from their current perspective, they couldn't even see what that time would look like.

Would people from a thousand years ago have imagined that modern society would become so advanced?

A thousand years was an incredibly long and distant time for humanity.

Perhaps by then, humans would have discovered new energy sources? From space, or from the void, or even... infinite energy?

Looking at a thousand years in the future with current technology and understanding would inevitably make everything seem problematic.

If he were considering decades or even over a century into the future, Johan wouldn't find anything wrong with that.

Rose was simply thinking too far ahead.

It was precisely because of this that Rose wanted to capture Eternatus, using its infinite energy to provide the entire Galar region with a continuous energy supply.

Rose smiled without saying more.

He believed that his foresight wasn't necessarily something everyone could understand.

"Actually, when I was young, my father was just an ordinary miner, and I was just a penniless kid. Every day, my biggest concern was what to eat for the next meal."

If Johan remembered correctly, Chairman Rose's father was indeed an ordinary miner, but he encountered an accident while mining ancient energy in the Galar region and never returned.

It was precisely because of this childhood trauma that Rose didn't want anyone else to experience the same tragic fate, which led to his plan to harness infinite energy.

Rose continued:

"Now, as Galar League Chairman, I naturally have to consider more distant matters from the Galar region's perspective. After all, thinking more ahead is never wrong."

Johan shrugged and stopped arguing with Rose, focusing on eating instead.

It had to be said, Rose certainly had style—this restaurant's food was excellent, completely comparable to his own cooking, and you could tell at a glance that it was expensive.

Seeing Johan stop talking, Rose also politely stopped speaking further.

The two began eating quietly.

Compared to their calm side, the other side was much more lively.

"Garrr!"

Tyranitar held minerals in one hand and half a roasted lamb chop with the other, alternating between lamb and minerals—typical side dish with main course.

Although minerals were delicious and satisfied its daily needs, occasionally improving its diet was quite nice.

"Ka-kaah~ Ka-kaah~"

Compared to it, Gengar had to consider much more.

While eating, it also had to direct Oleana and the chefs.

Serve more dishes, keep serving—don't stop~

All the restaurant's chefs were currently busy, sweating profusely.

Honestly, even when the restaurant was at full capacity, they had never been this busy.

No, they were more than twice as busy as during full capacity.

And more importantly...

They were running out of prepared ingredients!

The only consolation was perhaps that these "customers" weren't picky about the dishes.

"It seems Teacher Johan has quite an appetite."

Rose's own appetite was substantial, but he found it somewhat surprising that when he finished eating, Teacher Johan was still eating with relish.

"I've always had a good appetite. You sleep well when you eat well," Johan said without any embarrassment.

Rose gently wiped his mouth with a napkin. "Dining with Teacher Johan is truly a delightful experience."

Johan's peripheral vision glanced toward Gengar and the others, smiling: "Same here."

"Actually, I invited Teacher Johan here today mainly because there's something I wanted you to know," Rose said.

Finally getting to the point.

After all that small talk, he was finally going to reveal the reason for this dinner invitation.

Johan put down his knife and fork, wiped his mouth, and assumed a listening posture.

Rose slowly said:

"I have a 'premonition' that something major may happen in our Galar region in the near future."

Hearing this, Johan raised an eyebrow.

Something major?

Did he mean the Eternatus awakening incident?

Rose continued: "I know Teacher Johan has considerable experience and ability in 'handling' certain major events—more precisely, in handling events related to legendary Pokémon."

"Not at all, that's just others exaggerating. I just have a few methods," Johan gestured with his pinky finger.

"But Teacher Johan, you know I like to consider things comprehensively, so this is within my preparation range."

His fingers lightly tapped the table.

"Therefore, I hope that if such a major event really occurs, Teacher Johan, you could leave the matter to our Galar League to handle ourselves."

Listening to Rose's words, Johan suddenly understood.

I see...

In Rose's plan, after he awakened Eternatus, Leon would capture it.

At that point, as long as Leon successfully captured Eternatus, the Galar League would completely possess and control this powerful Pokémon capable of producing infinite Galar particles, and the Galar region wouldn't need to worry about energy for the next thousand years.

So Rose was worried that after Eternatus awakened, the "famous" Teacher Johan would act first and capture Eternatus, making all his efforts benefit someone else.

From this, it wasn't hard to see that Rose was quite confident in the strength of Leon, whom he had trained.

But clearly, he overlooked a Champion's sense of responsibility toward their region.

Under Rose's gaze, Johan said very naturally:

"Of course, I'm not someone who likes trouble. If the Galar League and Chairman Rose can solve problems yourselves, I certainly wouldn't force my way in."

Hearing this, Rose smiled.

But then Johan continued:

"I came to Galar partly for the 'Pokémon World Championships,' and partly because I promised some friends certain things."

"Friends?"

"Very good friends."

"If there's anything I can help with, please feel free to ask," Rose said politely.

"It's fine." Johan waved his hand with a smile. "It's just a 'small matter.' Chairman Rose, you know I've always... respected promises between friends."

Rose was somewhat puzzled by Johan's words.

Did this mean... Johan considered him a friend, so he was promising what he'd just agreed to?

Or did it mean...

Johan offered no explanation.

Could he really tell Rose that he'd already promised Calyrex and the sword and shield duo that he'd help them deal with Eternatus, so Rose would have to wait in line?

Anyway, he'd given his meaning. Whether Rose could understand it depended on him.

Johan stood up, putting down his napkin: "Regardless, thank you for your hospitality tonight, Chairman Rose. If there's nothing else, we'll take our leave."

"Gengar, Tyranitar, that's enough—let's go!"

Pulling along the still reluctant little ones, Johan quickly left.

The ingredients were all gone—were you planning to eat the serving carts too?

Watching Johan and his group quickly leave, Rose straightened his suit, though his large belly was still hard to hide.

"Chairman, according to the schedule, you should be on a diet," Oleana said.

"Haha, I know, I know," Rose replied dismissively.

With that, he waved his hand: "Let's go."

"Chairman, I'm afraid you'll need to pay the bill first."

"Pay the bill?"

Rose looked at Oleana strangely.

Oleana managed his meal expenses, and he couldn't remember the last time he'd paid a bill himself.

Oleana brought over the check, saying: "Sorry, because the bill exceeded the limit I applied for you this week."

Exceeded the limit?

Rose took it and glanced over it.

His eye immediately twitched slightly.

"Ha, haha, now I really... need to diet..."

After leaving Wyndon Tower, Johan prepared to find Flint and the others.

He figured Flint was probably at some battle venue fighting others to gain points.

But after leaving Wyndon Tower and walking just two streets, at a corner outdoor noodle shop, he saw Flint and others eating with their heads down, and...

"Bruno?"

That robust figure, that towering pile of "Rage Candybar" that stood out—who else could it be but Kanto Elite Four Bruno?

"Yo! Johan, long time no see. Want a candybar?"

Seeing Johan, Bruno greeted him enthusiastically and offered him a candybar.

Before Johan could respond, Flint said gloomily:

"Bruno, you don't know—Teacher Johan probably ate his fill already. Chairman Rose specially invited him to dine at a high-end restaurant."

"Oh?" Bruno was somewhat surprised.

When did Johan get involved with Galar League Chairman Rose?

Smack!

Johan irritably smacked Flint on the head: "When did you learn to be sarcastic? Is it my fault for not treating you to dinner?"

As he spoke, he took a bag from Gengar's hands and placed it on the table.

"Here, don't say I didn't bring you food."

Seeing this, Flint immediately beamed: "I knew Teacher Johan wouldn't 'eat alone'! There's even roasted lamb chops?"

He immediately prepared to dig in.

Compared to him, Flannery and Roxanne were much more restrained. As for Penny, she had already been taken away by Peony.

"Eh? Why are there bite marks?"

Looking at the bite marks on the roasted lamb chop, Flint asked curiously.

Johan glanced at his purple fatty.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar was looking up at a forty-five-degree angle, picking its teeth.

"You should be grateful for having food—you're being picky? If you don't want it, I'll feed it to the dogs."

"Eat eat eat!!"

He immediately started gnawing on it.

"By the way, Bruno, what brings you here...?"

"Gaining points."

Bruno seemed uninterested in the so-called delicacies Johan brought, focusing on his pile of "Rage Candybar." Facing Johan's question, he answered matter-of-factly.

"What's your current ranking?" Johan couldn't help asking.

"Twenty-four," Bruno said somewhat mumbledly.

"Twenty-four?!"

Johan hadn't even spoken when Flint, who was gnawing on Gengar's leftovers, jumped up first.

As fellow Elite Four members, although Bruno could be considered half a senior, they were actually not more than ten years apart in age—they could barely be considered peers.

But now Bruno was ranked twenty-fourth, and him?

After eating some "bad points" in Spikemuth, his ranking not only hadn't risen but seemed to be continuing to drop.

Flint hadn't felt anything without comparison.

But once there was comparison, he immediately felt something was wrong.

"What's wrong?" Bruno showed his white teeth in a smile.

"No, nothing," Flint shook his head, then suddenly suggested: "By the way, Bruno, aren't you going to challenge Teacher Johan? Beating 'Master Ball Tier' gives lots of points~"

Bruno rumbled: "No thanks."

He wasn't stupid.

Fighting current Johan had low win probability. Rather than challenging Johan now, he might as well wait for the "Master Replacement Battles."

It wasn't time to "fight desperately" yet.

Johan couldn't help wanting to flick Flint's forehead.

You're trying to play mind games with others?

Johan asked again: "Bruno, have you fought Raihan?"

"No," Bruno said helplessly. "I originally wanted to come to Wyndon to fight Raihan, but that guy is really working hard to gain points—he's already climbed to fifteenth place recently."

"Fifteenth place?!" Flint jumped up again.

Didn't that mean he was already in the final sixteen?

Johan was also somewhat surprised.

But thinking about it carefully, it made sense.

Raihan was already quite strong, and being in the Galar region locally, gaining points would undoubtedly be much easier. The earlier you gain points, the higher your ranking naturally becomes.

"Yeah," Bruno continued. "But that guy has been preparing for the Galar League's 'Champion Cup' recently, so he's temporarily refusing all matches and challenges."

Compared to rankings, Raihan was still more obsessed with fighting Leon.

"Then Bruno, aren't you considering fighting Flint?" Johan asked with interest.

Hmm?

Flint's eyes lit up.

Bruno glanced at him: "Him? His points are too low now."

Flint: (╥﹏╥)

"Besides, I've made an appointment with Marshal from the Unova League. I don't have time to fight Flint either," Bruno added.

"Marshal?"

Fighting specialist vs fighting specialist—this battle should be quite interesting.

"When? Tomorrow?"

"Right, tomorrow, at Wyndon Stadium!"

Johan and Flint exchanged glances.

Johan: Sounds entertaining, worth watching.

Flint: There'll definitely be experts in the audience—I'll pick a couple to challenge!

# 745: Johan: In the End, I Still Silently Bear Everything

The next day.

Wyndon Stadium was packed to capacity.

Although the most grand "Champion Cup" of the Galar region was currently taking place at Wyndon Stadium, this still didn't dampen the Galar residents' enthusiasm for battles.

This was the atmosphere Rose had cultivated in the Galar region over the years—passion for battles.

Moreover, the "Champion Cup" at Wyndon Stadium hadn't reached its peak excitement yet, but at Wyndon Stadium today, there would be Elite Four-level battles! Battles between the top fifty of "Ultra Ball Tier"!

Kanto League Elite Four Bruno VS Unova League Elite Four Marshal!

And both were Fighting-type Elite Four members.

The battle would undoubtedly be spectacular.

Indeed, it was exactly so.

After all, a battle between two Fighting-type Elite Four members would inevitably be the most direct, fist-to-fist collision.

Amid the enthusiastic cheers, Elite Four Bruno swung his arm and shouted: "Hitmonchan, Thunder Punch!"

Marshal also took his stance, shouting without backing down:

"Sawk, Close Combat!"

The two Pokémon, Hitmonchan and Sawk, fiercely crashed into each other, fist against fist, creating massive air waves accompanied by flying dust, earning even more excited and passionate cheers from the audience.

There was one thing Johan really admired about Rose.

Because Rose was truly willing to invest heavily in stadiums.

The collision between Elite Four members' ace Pokémon, even just the aftershocks of their clash, wasn't something ordinary buildings could withstand.

But what about Wyndon Stadium?

Not only was the entire stadium's structure solid and made of hard materials, with the collision causing little damage to the field itself, but there was also the massive protective barrier enveloping the entire stadium's battle field.

The aftershocks from the impacts struck the surrounding protective barriers, only creating ripples and white light without causing any wavering in the barriers.

This wasn't just Wyndon Stadium alone—all stadiums throughout the entire Galar region were at least of this scale and protection level.

The investment cost was astronomical.

But it was precisely because of such massive stadiums, stadiums where audiences could watch with peace of mind, that Galar region residents could safely watch matches, enjoy the competition and passion, and make Pokémon battles flourish throughout the Galar region.

After all, these stadiums were prepared and built for the even more dynamic Dynamax battles.

Moreover, the Galar region was also the first to completely automate and mechanize referees.

The vast majority of referees throughout the entire Galar region had been taken over by Rotom.

Except for a small portion of high-level matches that needed professional referees for supervision and judgment, most matches could be handled by Rotom.

This was also thanks to the discovery and promotion of Rotom as a Pokémon species.

If you really counted it, Johan could also be considered one of the "Rotom promoters."

At this moment, in the VIP box of Wyndon Stadium, Johan, Flint, Flannery, Roxanne, and a group from the Unova region were all watching the battle.

Flint was obviously the most excited, standing by the floor-to-ceiling window with clenched fists, wishing he could replace one of them and battle the other.

Compared to him, Johan and the others, as well as the group from the Unova region, appeared much calmer.

"Teacher Johan, who do you think will win between Marshal and Bruno?" Shauntal, sitting on the sofa with her black stocking-clad legs crossed, holding a notebook and writing, suddenly asked.

She gently pushed her glasses with a curious expression.

Hearing this, Johan smiled: "You shouldn't ask me that—you should ask Mr. Alder."

Everyone looked toward Alder.

Alder: "ZZZ"

Johan: "..."

He could fall asleep even when his own disciple was battling another Elite Four member?

Caitlin beside them curled her lips: "Don't you know what state Mr. Alder is in?"

Johan was already used to the "attitude" in Caitlin's words, so he directly ignored her, making Caitlin grind her teeth in frustration as some fruits around them began floating.

"Bruno is still at a disadvantage for appearing too early," Johan muttered softly.

"Appearing too early?"

However, his words were still quite clear in the box, and Grimsley asked in confusion.

"Cough." Johan coughed lightly without explaining much.

Could he really tell them that because Bruno appeared when it was only the first generation, Fighting-type Pokémon were limited, so besides Fighting-type Pokémon, he had also captured quite a few Rock-type Pokémon?

Like Onix, Golem, and such?

Of course, Bruno's massive Onix was no simple matter.

It was just that when facing Fighting-type Pokémon, Rock-type Pokémon were still at a disadvantage.

"However, most likely, Bruno still has a higher chance of winning," Johan finally said.

Bruno's ace was a Machamp with the "No Guard" ability, while Marshal's ace was a Conkeldurr with the "Guts" ability.

More importantly, Johan noticed that Bruno was already wearing a "Dynamax Band" on his wrist, while Marshal wasn't.

This created a gap between the two sides.

Moreover, if we really talked about raw strength, Bruno's abilities were indeed somewhat stronger than Marshal's.

"Good! Then I'll bet against you—I bet Marshal wins!" Caitlin suddenly said.

"A bet?" Johan looked at her strangely, scanning Caitlin up and down. "What's the wager?"

Before Caitlin could answer, Johan's phone suddenly rang.

The caller ID showed Cynthia.

Johan immediately walked aside and pressed the answer button.

"Finished with work?"

After becoming Champion, Cynthia still had quite a few matters to handle. After all, she wasn't like Johan, who had Glacia to back him up, plus Steven to delegate to, allowing him to be a hands-off boss.

Although the Sinnoh League had Lucian and Bertha, Cynthia was still somewhat more responsible than Johan.

So originally the two had agreed to come to the Galar region together, but because Cynthia hadn't finished her work while Johan had to inspect the "Rising Volt Tacklers Class," he came to Galar first.

"Almost done. I can go to Galar in the next couple of days," Cynthia's voice sounded somewhat lazy.

"Did you leave everything to Lucian?"

"Mm."

Johan smiled knowingly.

The capable bear more responsibility.

The two didn't chat for long.

When Johan hung up and turned around, he saw...

Fruits, bowls, vases, even coffee tables and chairs were all floating behind him, looking ready to smash toward him.

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar stood behind him with one hand forward and one back in a defensive stance, its chubby black face looking vigilant.

Behind these floating objects was Caitlin with her hair floating up, glaring at him with gritted teeth and eyes full of "resentment."

Johan: "..."

After all this time, she still hasn't accepted reality?

He waved his hand, "showing off" the phone in his hand, raising an eyebrow.

Cynthia called me first—this round, I win.

Caitlin gritted her teeth even harder.

"Alright, stop fooling around."

Johan pushed away the objects floating in mid-air, patted Gengar's head, telling the purple fatty to stop pretending.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar scratched the back of its head with a silly laugh.

Caitlin suddenly pointed at Johan: "I know what to bet now!"

"If I win, you have to accept my challenge!"

Hm?

Johan looked somewhat surprised.

Caitlin challenging him?

Was this a battle for Cynthia?

Caitlin continued: "If you win, I'll accept your challenge!"

Hearing this, Johan was immediately amused: "So either way, we're going to fight? What's your current ranking?"

Caitlin raised her head proudly.

"'Ultra Ball Tier' twenty-fifth place! You 'Master Ball Tier' bottom-dweller!"

The little girl had quite a temper and was really good at being hurtful with her words.

Flint, Grimsley, Flannery, and others looked like they were watching a show.

Speaking of which, Johan had known Caitlin for quite a while now. This little girl had been clinging to Cynthia and harboring great hostility toward him, yet the two had never actually battled face-to-face.

He lightly rubbed his chin.

"Alright, I accept your challenge."

The points from "Ultra Ball Tier" twenty-fifth place weren't low—this was different from Flint, that troublesome guy with low points. Winning against him wasn't very meaningful.

If he took Caitlin's points this time, Johan didn't think he'd still be at the bottom of "Master Ball Tier."

As long as he wasn't at the bottom, even second-to-last was acceptable to Johan.

"It's settled!" Caitlin clenched her small fists, and the floating objects in the box slowly returned to their original positions.

This result was somewhat beyond everyone's expectations while also making them feel anticipation and excitement.

Caitlin VS Teacher Johan?

At first glance, it seemed like Teacher Johan had much better odds, but if Caitlin's psychic powers were used freely... there was still some suspense.

The people in the box were still quite enthusiastic about battles.

Especially being able to see Champion VS Elite Four—this was even rarer than Elite Four VS Elite Four.

Pop~

The snot bubble hanging from Alder's nose suddenly burst, and the old man slowly awakened: "Battle? What battle? Johan, are you going to battle someone?"

Everyone looked toward Caitlin.

Alder laughed heartily: "Oh, it's Caitlin. I thought you were going to battle this old man."

At the same time, Bruno and Marshal's battle finally reached its final stage.

Bruno took out a Poké Ball to recall his Machamp from the field. The "Dynamax Band" on his wrist injected energy into the Poké Ball, which immediately began expanding and growing larger at a visible rate.

Finally, it was thrown out amid the audience's cheers and eager gazes.

Bang!!

The Machamp that reappeared on the field was surrounded by large amounts of red clouds, its body rapidly growing larger in just a few brief moments.

Gigantamax!

The already robust Machamp, after Gigantamaxing, not only grew larger but its muscle definition became even more pronounced. Its four thick arms and fists seemed covered with golden lava-like patterns, red clouds swirling around its waist while its eyes turned golden-red.

At first glance, it looked like an Ultraman with two extra arms, accompanied by flashing lightning.

"Roar——!!!"

The terrifying roar stirred up massive air waves.

Machamp was already a Pokémon with tremendously powerful strength, and after Gigantamaxing, its power received an extremely exaggerated boost.

According to the Pokédex, when large ships run aground, Gigantamax Machamp can carry them to shore to help them escape.

But the Pokédex also said that whether Gigantamax or Dynamax, only the Pokémon's size appears to grow larger—there isn't much actual change in their existence.

However, the Pokédex... just take a look at it. Who playing Pokémon would actually take the Pokédex seriously?

"Marshal is in danger," Flint said.

Indeed, Marshal had no "Dynamax Band" and couldn't Dynamax, while Conkeldurr couldn't Mega Evolve either. Relying purely on Z-moves wouldn't be threatening enough against Gigantamax Machamp with doubled HP.

Even Alder didn't object to Flint's words.

The old man chuckled: "Whether you can get a 'Dynamax Band' also depends on luck."

Bruno traveled everywhere for training and had already come to the Galar region before, obtaining a Dynamax Band through fortunate circumstances.

While Alder and others, including Alder himself, still didn't have Dynamax Bands.

After all, making "Dynamax Bands" required "Wishing Stars," and those weren't available at all times.

Although the Galar League had some stock, they couldn't just give one to everyone who came to the Galar region by asking Rose—even if the Galar region was wealthy, it couldn't withstand such squandering.

However, battles had winners and losers—that was normal.

"Machamp, G-Max Chi Strike!!" Bruno threw a heavy punch and shouted loudly.

"Roar——!!!"

Pokémon capable of Gigantamaxing all had their own exclusive G-Max moves, which was also an advantage that Gigantamax-capable Pokémon had over those that could only undergo regular Dynamax.

Rumble——

An incredibly heavy punch landed, shaking the entire stadium as waves of dust and shockwaves frantically battered the barriers.

This time, even with the stadium's sturdy barriers, they wouldn't stop shaking.

This showed just how strong the impact from Bruno's Gigantamax Machamp was.

"Truly worthy of being an Elite Four from the Kanto region..." Johan sighed inwardly.

In this match, even if Bruno hadn't used Gigantamax, he probably would have had no problem defeating Marshal.

However, using Gigantamax was also showing respect for Marshal.

The strength of the Kanto region's Elite Four was indeed solid.

"Conkeldurr is unable to battle, so the winner is Bruno from the Kanto region!"

The Rotom referee announced the final result.

The audience cheered that they'd had a great time watching.

But before some audience members could prepare to leave, the stadium management hurriedly announced another important matter.

"Everyone! Please don't rush to leave, because there's another battle coming up!!"

Another battle?

The audience became interested again.

"Who's battling who?"

"Any battle that needs to use Wyndon Stadium must involve strong opponents, right?"

"Could it be another pair of Elite Four members?"

"You think Elite Four battles are that common? If it weren't for the 'Master Championships,' seeing an Elite Four battle today would have been enough."

Facing the audience's inquiries, the management only wanted to say:

"I can only tell everyone that you are truly... blessed today!!"

Thud! Thud!

On the big screen, two portraits appeared side by side.

On the left was "Ultra Ball Tier" twenty-fifth place, one of the Unova League Elite Four, Caitlin!

On the right was the currently bottom-ranked "Master Ball Tier" Hoenn League Champion, Teacher Johan!

Huh?!

When the audience saw the portraits on both sides of the big screen and their respective rankings, they all perked up.

"Am I seeing this right? Teacher Johan?"

"Teacher Johan battling Miss Caitlin?"

"I never thought that after watching an Elite Four battle, there would be something even more exciting—there really are more experts!"

"Hey? Wait! Doesn't Teacher Johan only fight in the 'Baby Cup'?"

"Is there a possibility that Elite Four members are also 'babies' in Teacher Johan's eyes?"

Having just watched a battle between Elite Four members, now they could see a Champion versus Elite Four battle?

No wonder the management said they were blessed.

If it weren't for the "Pokémon World Championships," where could you see such exciting matches every day?

That's why the "Pokémon World Championships" was the grandest tournament in the entire Pokémon world.

That's why even through joint hosting, Rose fought for this venue quota.

Just two or three battles like this could stimulate countless economic activity.

After a complete "Pokémon World Championships," who knows how much the Galar region's economy would grow.

"After Teacher Johan and Miss Caitlin's battle ends," Flint grinned, looking around at everyone in the box, "does anyone want to battle this master?"

He really felt somewhat restless.

Grimsley shook the dice in his percussion instrument, got two "ones," and immediately indicated: "Your points are too low."

Shauntal smiled: "As for me, you'll have to wait until I finish writing this section—after midnight tonight would work."

Flint: "..."

One "despised" his low points, the other said to wait until after midnight?

Battle a Ghost-type Elite Four member at midnight?

Flint felt a bit scared.

And seriously suspected Shauntal was planning to use him as material for writing something.

How about finding Champion Alder?

Alder: "ZZZ"

Flint: "..."

He scratched his head and sighed deeply: "I really want to battle."

Flint inexplicably missed his big sister.

Even getting beaten up by big sister would be good...

At the contestant tunnel, declining the "competition uniform" sent by stadium staff, Johan and Gengar stood at the exit of the contestant tunnel, glancing at a box above the stadium.

By the window of the box stood Rose and Oleana.

"Are they there?" Johan asked.

Gengar, making binoculars with its hands, nodded.

"Ka-kaah~!"

There! There!

Johan took out his phone and sent an "OK" emoji to both the Team Rocket trio and Looker, who were preparing to infiltrate.

After putting away his phone, Johan and Gengar looked at each other and sighed lightly: "We really have sacrificed too much."

"Ka-kaah~ Ka-kaah~"

Gengar nodded vigorously, deeply agreeing with Johan's words.

To create more time and opportunities for the "infiltration team," he had ultimately silently "borne" everything.

After solving the Eternatus problem later, he'd have to get Leon to reimburse him.

Otherwise, he didn't necessarily have to accept Caitlin's challenge.

Gengar clenched its fist.

Reimbursement! Must get thorough reimbursement!

# 746: Cheater VS Cheater!

"Ladies and gentlemen, you are truly blessed again today!"

Wyndon Stadium's circular stands were packed to capacity, with waves of enthusiastic cheers from the audience.

"Go Teacher Johan!!"

"Miss Caitlin, knock out Teacher Johan!"

It had to be said that the cute-looking and noble-tempered Caitlin also had considerable popularity.

Standing in the contestant tunnel, Caitlin ignored all the cheers. She took a deep breath, clenched her small fists, her eyes determined.

As a psychic, controlling her own emotions had always been Caitlin's weakness.

However, after years of training and getting along with Cynthia, her self-control abilities had improved significantly. She no longer needed her butler Darach to constantly accompany her.

And now she was gradually adjusting her state to optimal condition.

Even beyond optimal.

Perhaps because she was finally going to battle her "love rival" Johan, Caitlin's mental state at this moment was even better than usual, and her control over her psychic powers had advanced further.

Caitlin's bright eyes sparkled, psychic light dancing in her eyes. Feeling her own condition, the corners of her mouth slightly lifted:

"This time I'll definitely show you how powerful I am!"

Meanwhile, in the VIP box.

Shauntal spoke with interest: "Caitlin's strength has improved significantly recently."

This statement earned considerable agreement from fellow Elite Four member Grimsley.

"The frequency and severity of her losing control have also been much better than before."

"Losing control?" Flannery and Roxanne looked at each other in confusion.

"As a psychic with overly powerful psychic abilities, Caitlin's psychic powers can lose control if she has excessive emotional fluctuations," Shauntal briefly explained.

Actually, not many people knew about this matter.

However, everyone in the box at this moment was part of the League's inner circle, so there was nothing to hide.

"Does Teacher Johan know?" Roxanne couldn't help asking.

Grimsley smiled: "Seeing how calmly Teacher Johan faced those floating objects earlier, he definitely knows about it."

"So those floating objects earlier were caused by Miss Caitlin's psychic powers? I thought they were Miss Caitlin's Pokémon," Flannery whispered quietly.

"If she loses control, so what? With Teacher Johan's abilities, even if Caitlin loses control, he can handle it. How much damage could it cause?"

Having witnessed Teacher Johan punch the Creation dragons and kick Hoenn's two idiots, Flint waved his hand dismissively, thinking it was no big deal.

"Mm," Shauntal also remembered the scene when Teacher Johan faced the out-of-control Kyurem, nodding: "It should be fine. If Caitlin loses control, at most... this stadium will lose half of itself."

Flint: "?!"

His eyes widened: "How much?!"

This stadium had just demonstrated its ability to withstand the aftershocks of collisions between Elite Four ace Pokémon, and Caitlin losing control could destroy half of it?

Grimsley said: "That's just Shauntal's conservative estimate."

Flint: "..."

If Caitlin's psychic powers weren't so hard to control...

Although Caitlin's control over her psychic abilities was strengthening, her psychic powers were also continuously growing stronger.

Otherwise, Alder wouldn't need to search everywhere for his successor—Caitlin with full control over her psychic powers would be the perfect candidate.

On the other side, in the contestant tunnel, Johan put away his phone and prepared to enter.

Facing Psychic-type Pokémon, his team had quite a few ways to deal with them.

As for Caitlin being a psychic...

Who wasn't an "ability user" these days?

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar stopped playing with Marshadow and dove into the shadows together.

As Johan and Caitlin took the field respectively, the audience's cheers once again swept over like a tide.

Champion! Champion! Champion!

No matter which region, the word "Champion" carried tremendous appeal and popularity, especially when this Champion was the legendary Teacher Johan.

But before Johan could steady himself, he immediately felt a powerful psychic force rushing toward him.

When Caitlin, the "humanoid psychic Pokémon," seriously focused on battle, the oppressive feeling brought by that invisible psychic power was quite strong.

"This 'hostility' is pretty intense," Johan muttered to himself.

The Rotom referee warily looked around, confirming that no Rotom Pokédex had run out to kick it away, before raising the flag in its hand.

"Please prepare, both contestants!"

According to the "Pokémon World Championships" rules, during the point-climbing phase, 1v1, 2v2, or 3v3 rotation modes could be chosen.

Generally speaking, in non-official but important venues, most chose 2v2 rotation mode, while in official venues, 3v3 rotation mode was adopted.

When all of one side's Pokémon lost their ability to battle, the match would end.

As the Rotom referee took position, the big screen also lit up with three unopened Poké Balls for each person, representing the number of Pokémon each could use and the remaining number of Pokémon.

A stream of pure light blue psychic power carried a Poké Ball floating out from Caitlin's body, floating to the center of the field before opening.

"Go, Gothitelle!"

Gothitelle was one of Caitlin's signature Pokémon, a very typical Unova region Psychic-type Pokémon, with a status similar to Hoenn's Gardevoir and Kanto's Alakazam.

However, compared to Gardevoir and Alakazam, Gothitelle was also a typical "slow" Pokémon, commonly called a Trick Room user.

Its "Shadow Tag" ability was the same as Mega Gengar's ability, capable of preventing opponents from switching.

In higher-level battles, restrictions on switching had greater impact.

As Caitlin summoned Gothitelle, Johan also threw out his Poké Ball, which opened with a "click" in mid-air, revealing a massive creature in the red light.

"I choose you, Tyranitar!"

"Garrr!!!"

The imposing roar immediately awed the entire venue, as the majestic Tyranitar heavily crashed onto the field.

Dark and Rock-type Tyranitar!

Facing Psychic-type Pokémon, Dark-type Pokémon were undoubtedly an excellent choice.

But for Caitlin...

"Hmph, Dark-type..." Caitlin looked down disdainfully.

As both sides summoned their Pokémon and prepared, the Rotom referee's flag suddenly dropped.

"Battle begin!"

Hum—

Just as the flag dropped, Caitlin and Gothitelle's eyes simultaneously glowed with psychic light blue aura, then a stream of psychic power burst from Gothitelle's body before quickly disappearing.

Caitlin didn't speak, but... the battle had already begun!

Telepathy!

What move was used?

Not only were the audience members completely puzzled, even Johan couldn't guess what Caitlin had commanded Gothitelle to do at this moment.

After all, many Psychic-type moves actually looked quite similar before they actually attacked the opponent.

For example, Psychic, Psyshock, Telekinesis, and so on.

Who could tell which was which?

Caitlin shot Johan a challenging "guess if you can" look.

"Heh." Johan chuckled lightly.

Acting like no one else could do it!

Johan's eyes also gleamed with a faint light as his aura power spread out, his voice resonating from the bottom of Tyranitar's heart.

"Dragon Dance!"

No matter what psychic move the opponent used, self-enhancement was never wrong!

"Garrr!!"

Tyranitar's tail heavily struck the ground, raising large clouds of dust with a "bang" while Tyranitar's aura began rapidly climbing.

At this moment, the audience all had question marks above their heads.

What was this?

A battle?

What moves did both sides use?

Were they fighting a "silent battle"?

Fortunately, Wyndon Stadium's announcer immediately updated both sides' information.

"Everyone! Miss Caitlin is a powerful psychic, most skilled at silent battles that make opponents unable to figure out her moves!"

"At the same time, Teacher Johan is also said to be an 'ability user,' known as the 'Aura Guardian,' possessing powerful 'Aura Power' and also capable of silent battles!"

Upon hearing this, the audience suddenly understood.

But then they became troubled again.

So... how were they supposed to watch this battle?

Perhaps some trainers with stronger abilities and more experience could tell what moves both sides used, but... the vast majority couldn't understand!

In the online livestream, everyone started playing a "game" called "Guess What Move Was Used."

Tyranitar's Dragon Dance was relatively easy to guess, but Gothitelle's move was really hard to figure out.

Seeing Tyranitar's Dragon Dance, Caitlin's expression became more serious, psychic fluctuations continuing to flash in her eyes.

Hum—

Another wave of psychic power surged from Gothitelle's body.

The next second.

Bang!!

In front of Tyranitar, a surge of powerful psychic energy exploded. If not for Johan and Tyranitar's quick reaction speed, that psychic power would have exploded right in Tyranitar's face.

But even so, Tyranitar still inevitably retreated several steps.

Psyshock!

No.

Johan couldn't help looking toward the referee Rotom.

The opponent's cheating—can't you see?

How could Psychic-type moves hit Dark-type Tyranitar?

Gothitelle couldn't even learn Miracle Eye!

The Rotom referee just wanted to say: I can't see it.

"Tsk."

Although he knew Dark-type might not be that effective against Caitlin, Johan still couldn't help wanting to complain internally: Cheater!

With Caitlin's psychic powers, she definitely used some special technique or method to let Gothitelle attack Tyranitar.

Since the opponent was cheating, he couldn't be blamed then...

"Tyranitar, Roar!" Johan's aura conveyed the meaning.

"Garrr—!!"

Tyranitar waved its hand, its temper as the Desert Tyrant rising, eyes fierce as it roared out rolling black sound waves spreading in all directions.

Bang!!

Heavy sound-like vibrations exploded at Gothitelle's dress hem, making its face show some pain.

At the same time, Tyranitar immediately started its heavy steps, accompanied by large clouds of rising dust, charging straight toward Gothitelle.

Hum—

Another wave of psychic power, and from beneath Gothitelle's feet, thread-like strange energy fields immediately spread out.

Psychic Terrain!

Meanwhile, the sandstorm stirred up by Tyranitar was blocked by the psychic barrier surrounding Gothitelle.

To actually ignore the charging Tyranitar and choose to set up Psychic Terrain?

Where did that confidence come from?

But soon, Johan and Tyranitar knew where Caitlin's confidence came from.

Just as the fierce Tyranitar was about to impact Gothitelle, a mysterious psychic power suddenly exploded within Tyranitar's body, yet Gothitelle showed no movement.

"Future Sight?" Johan realized.

So the move Caitlin and Gothitelle used at the very beginning was Future Sight?

Caitlin's golden hair flowed as she lifted her chin slightly, her face showing some pride.

Don't underestimate me, bastard!

Did you really think I came without any tactical preparation?

"Gothitelle, Hypnosis!" Caitlin spoke for the first time, raising her arm in cool command.

Letting Tyranitar charge over was all to create better conditions for Hypnosis!

Moreover, Caitlin had a little trick up her sleeve.

Although she spoke aloud, she had actually already commanded Gothitelle to use Hypnosis through telepathy, so when she spoke, Gothitelle had already moved.

She was targeting that brief moment when Tyranitar was hit by Future Sight!

"Tyranitar!"

Johan suddenly roared.

"Crunch!"

Hmm?

Both speaking at the same time made all the audience subconsciously freeze.

How did the originally silent battle become a vocal one again?

And...

Strange hypnotic beams burst from Gothitelle's eyes, but after entering Tyranitar's eyes, they seemed to sink like stones into the sea. It even saw a trace of fierce mockery in Tyranitar's eyes.

Mockery?

"Garrr!!"

Tyranitar's feet didn't even stumble slightly. Future Sight's impact seemed to cause no significant damage, and that Hypnosis had no effect whatsoever.

"Ha! Using Hypnosis on a Hypnosis Master's Pokémon?"

"Using Hypnosis in front of the Mind Master? Too disrespectful to those four words 'Mind Master'!"

"Miss Caitlin's Gothitelle is in danger!"

Dark energy constructed a fierce giant maw in front of Tyranitar, and under Gothitelle's horrified gaze, it bit down viciously.

Bang!!!

One bite.

Gothitelle cried out in pain, eyes rolling back as it fell to the ground, unable to battle!

One-shot KO!

"Garrr—!!"

Tyranitar spread its arms, roaring excitedly as yellow sand flew.

Supremely domineering!

Caitlin's face still showed some bewilderment.

She obviously didn't understand why Future Sight seemed to fail to hinder Tyranitar's actions, nor why Hypnosis had no effect on Tyranitar...

But if she could understand what the "Johan family's hypnosis" meant in terms of quality, trying Gengar and Ninetales' hypnosis a few times, she would understand.

Moreover, if Caitlin's psychic powers could enhance her own Pokémon's psychic abilities, even letting them ignore Dark-type Pokémon's immunity to Psychic-type Pokémon, how could Johan's aura power have no effect?

Johan's aura power could even forcibly pull Dragonite out of its Outrage state—what was a mere Hypnosis?

Cheating? Who didn't have that ability?

As for Future Sight's attack effect... taking it head-on wasn't difficult for Tyranitar.

"Come back, Gothitelle." Caitlin took a deep breath and recalled Gothitelle.

After looking deeply at Johan and Tyranitar, she took out her second Poké Ball.

Lifted by psychic power, it flew into the field and opened, immediately releasing a powerful psychic aura.

Hum—

As Caitlin's second Pokémon entered, a black force field immediately spread rapidly, covering the entire field.

Trick Room!

After Trick Room was established, that Pokémon fully revealed its form.

Reuniclus!

Another of Caitlin's signature Pokémon.

Great, great, great—now we're not playing by the rules, using Trick Room before the Pokémon even fully appears?

Moreover, Reuniclus was floating in mid-air using psychic power, showing no intention of coming down, with Trick Room's enhancement plus Psychic Terrain continuously providing mental power...

"Tyranitar, Rock Slide—knock it down for me!"

"Garrr!!"

Tyranitar's tail slammed the ground hard, making the flying yellow sand even more violent, yet still unable to cause much impact on Reuniclus. But rocks immediately appeared on the cracked ground.

As Tyranitar's tail swung, those rocks immediately flew toward the airborne Reuniclus.

This move was "learned" from Tinkaton!

Tyranitar was confident.

Caitlin snorted coldly, bathed in psychic blue aura with golden hair flowing, lightly raising her arm.

Reuniclus's small face immediately became serious as both arms pressed down from above.

Hum—

Instantly, a powerful gravitational force came from the ground. The rocks Tyranitar's tail had launched hadn't even reached Reuniclus before falling uncontrollably halfway, smashing into the field and breaking into pieces.

Johan half-closed his eyes.

Gravity?

Heavy Space?!

Caitlin glanced at Johan, raising her arm with fingers spread, then slowly closing them.

Reuniclus immediately formed a green glowing orb in front of it, and with Trick Room's speed enhancement plus Gravity's boost, it flew rapidly toward Tyranitar.

Energy Ball!

At the same time, thick vines emerged from the ground, quickly wrapping around Tyranitar's body, restricting its movement.

Grass Knot!

This was planning to use psychic powers' aerial advantage, plus Trick Room and Gravity's restrictions on Tyranitar, along with Energy Ball and Grass Knot grass-type moves to deal with Tyranitar?

Johan instantly understood Caitlin's plan.

It had to be said, because Wyndon Stadium was prepared for Dynamax battles, its height was much greater than ordinary stadiums, giving Reuniclus and Caitlin plenty of room to maneuver.

And Gravity plus Trick Room meant Tyranitar would find it extremely difficult to counterattack, only able to passively take hits...

"Tyranitar, use the terrain!" Johan immediately decided, conveying his meaning through aura.

Understanding Tyranitar glared fiercely at the airborne Reuniclus, then punched the ground hard.

Rumble—

Instantly, the entire field shook violently.

The next second, the ground in front of Tyranitar cracked open, and a massive rock was directly pried up like a huge wall, standing between Reuniclus and Tyranitar.

Bang!!

Energy Ball smashed into that upturned ground and exploded, raising large clouds of dust.

At the same time, the already wild dust storms grew at a very visible speed, wave after wave of sandstorms rising and dancing in the field, greatly reducing visibility across the entire field.

The audience could barely see what was happening in the field, only able to look at the two trainers giving silent commands.

Looking left, then right.

One had golden hair flying, bathed in blue light, even seeming to levitate.

The other wasn't bad either—eyes glowing blue, clothes fluttering, aura power spreading across the field.

This... didn't really feel like watching a Pokémon battle anymore.

Instead, it felt more like watching a sci-fi movie "ability user" showdown?

Scarlet Witch VS Doctor Strange?!

But soon, changes appeared on the field.

The flying sandstorm gathered into two roaring sand dragons, lunging toward Reuniclus.

But this didn't seem threatening enough to Reuniclus—before they could get close, they were directly destroyed by brutal psychic power.

Fortunately, after the sandstorm scattered, it quickly gathered again.

Reuniclus simply ignored the two sand dragons, forming two Energy Balls in its hands and hurling them toward Tyranitar's previous position.

Bang! Bang!

Caitlin watched the wild sandstorm before her, her expression cold.

No matter how Tyranitar concealed its position, it couldn't escape psychic lock-on, so...

Rumble!!

Suddenly, the entire field shook violently again.

No! This time, the entire stadium seemed to be shaking, and audience members felt their seats slightly numb.

And the next moment, all the audience widened their eyes, gaping with mouths open, pointing at the field, their throats only able to make "ka-ka" sounds without knowing what to say.

Because under these audience members' gaze, from within that flying, spreading powerful sandstorm, a fire-red giant rock spear seemingly wrapped in magma rose at a terrifying speed, tearing through the rolling dust and striking the airborne Reuniclus!

Boom!!

The scorching heat and the air waves from the rapid piercing dispersed the surrounding dust, creating a vacuum area out of thin air.

"This, this is..."

"This move, could this move be..."

"It can't be Groudon's Precipice Blades?!"

That fire-red burning giant rock pillar, that conspicuous and sudden piercing speed, that method ignoring gravity suppression and flying ability...

"Garrr!!!"

Tyranitar, pulling its fists from the ground, grinned and roared again.

That's right.

Precipice Blades!

You can fly, you know how to fly?

Then fly! Keep flying if you can!

Boom!!

The fire-red rock pillar that pierced Reuniclus exploded at its tip with unreasonable golden-red flames, scattering like fireworks.

Johan's lips slightly curved.

Heavy Space?

In the face of absolute "massiveness," Heavy Space and flying were useless!

He looked toward Caitlin and suddenly felt his heart skip a beat.

He saw Caitlin's face full of shock, then an incredibly powerful psychic force burst from her body, even directly dispersing a small portion of Tyranitar's sandstorm.

Her half of the field suddenly fell into a violent psychic storm.

Johan gently pushed his glasses.

Did she really lose control just like that?

# 747: Godzilla? Gomora? (Two-in-One Chapter)

Is Caitlin going to lose control and go berserk?

Looking at Caitlin's appearance and feeling the increasingly powerful psychic force emanating from her, Johan even had a feeling close to directly facing the "rampaging" Mewtwo from some time ago.

It had to be said that the Pokémon world was truly magical—a human's psychic power could actually reach such an exaggerated degree.

Even Sabrina, in a pure comparison of psychic powers, couldn't match Caitlin.

Sabrina's strength lay in her control over her psychic abilities, which was much stronger than Caitlin's.

However, when Caitlin's cold gaze turned toward him again, Johan breathed a slight sigh of relief.

Good.

It was just a psychic outburst, not a complete loss of control.

But if this psychic power were applied to a Psychic-type Pokémon, its strength would probably receive a tremendous boost.

A floating Poké Ball recalled Reuniclus.

Both Gothitelle and Reuniclus had lost their ability to battle. What was Caitlin's final Pokémon?

The answer was soon revealed.

Another Poké Ball flew out and opened in the field.

What appeared was still a humanoid Pokémon.

Its appearance resembled a noblewoman wearing a blue hat and pink dress, with a claw-like structure extending from the top of the hat. Overall, it had a delicate appearance, but if you looked carefully, there was also a strange, witch-like eeriness.

It was clearly Hatterene, a signature Psychic-type Pokémon of the Galar region!

Its status was equivalent to Hoenn's Gardevoir and Unova's Gothitelle.

Moreover, Hatterene wasn't just a pure Psychic-type Pokémon—like Gardevoir, it also had Fairy-type abilities.

In the Galar region, Hatterene was also known as the "Forest Witch."

It was said that in forests, it would continuously release mental power that caused headaches in people. Even Pokémon would feel uncomfortable when sensing this mental power.

So if you accidentally entered a forest without any signs of life in the Galar region, you needed to be careful, as there was a high possibility you'd entered Hatterene's territory!

Additionally, there were no male Hatterene—the corresponding male Pokémon was Grimmsnarl.

Johan was somewhat surprised that Caitlin's final Pokémon was actually Hatterene.

Because Hatterene, besides the Galar and Paldea regions and some remote, mysterious places, hadn't appeared in other regions yet.

So Caitlin capturing a Hatterene, and what appeared to be a strong one at that, meant Caitlin had most likely visited the Galar region herself.

That also meant...

Snap!!

Caitlin reached out and caught Hatterene's returning Poké Ball.

Her wrist turned slightly.

The light pink silk sleeve slid down her arm like white lotus root, revealing the "Dynamax Band" beneath!

Seeing that "Dynamax Band," Johan's mouth twitched slightly.

Champion Alder has misled me!

Didn't he say there wasn't time to get "Dynamax Bands" for the Unova League members?

How does Caitlin have one?

As expected of a rich young lady...

Hum—

Recalling Hatterene, the power from the "Dynamax Band" burst forth, activating the energy nodes beneath Wyndon Stadium. The Poké Ball in her hand immediately began expanding rapidly.

Seeing this scene, the audience immediately cheered excitedly.

Dynamax again!

The reason Dynamax could have such a big impact in the Galar region was partly due to the benefits it brought, but the visual impact of Pokémon becoming gigantic was also a very important factor.

Caitlin shot Johan a challenging look before throwing out the massive Poké Ball again.

Rumble—

A stream of dark red energy burst forth instantly, red aura swirling, red lightning dancing. The reappearing Hatterene immediately grew rapidly under this power, with the sky also covered by red clouds forming a strange vortex.

Gigantamax!

Like Bruno's Machamp earlier, Hatterene was also a Pokémon capable of Gigantamax!

"Hatter—"

The low voice accompanied by waving blue tentacles brought both physical oppression from its form and energy oppression from its psychic powers.

It had to be said, whether Dynamax or Gigantamax, the direct visual impact they brought was incomparable to other enhancement methods.

"Garrr..."

Tyranitar raised its head, looking at the massive Gigantamax Hatterene with its mouth slightly agape.

I'm... so big...

The big guy's head was now thinking... could one Precipice Blades skewer it?

However, the seemingly massive Hatterene's speed wasn't slow at all.

After all, Trick Room's field was still active, plus Psychic Terrain's enhancement and Caitlin's psychic boost—Gigantamax Hatterene's current strength was extremely exaggerated.

"Hatter!!"

Blue giant arms struck down from above toward Tyranitar, wrapped in extremely powerful psychic and fairy power, even accompanied by countless surging dark red lightning.

G-Max Terror!

This was Gigantamax Hatterene's exclusive G-Max move. After hitting the opponent, it would cause them to fall into a confused state!

"Garrr!"

Looking at the terrifying lightning falling fiercely, Tyranitar showed no fear, spreading its arms wide, stirring up terrible dust storms, and roaring.

Johan's eyes were deep, immediately judging what Caitlin's move was.

So before Gigantamax Hatterene's attack landed, a beam of red light immediately shot out, recalling Tyranitar into its Poké Ball.

However, Johan wasn't switching Pokémon—he was using his "Dynamax Band" for the first time!

His wrist turned, revealing the "Dynamax Band" beneath his sleeve.

Instantly, a large amount of Galar particles released strange red light, again activating the energy nodes beneath Wyndon Stadium. The Dynamax particle power made the Poké Ball in Johan's hand become incredibly massive!

Seeing this scene, the audience immediately erupted.

Dynamax too!

Teacher Johan actually had a "Dynamax Band" too?!

Didn't this mean it had become a collision between Dynamax and Dynamax?

Rumble—

The ground beneath shook with a "rumble."

The audience and everyone else felt nothing unusual, thinking it was normal, but Johan, standing on the field, unconsciously frowned.

Aura power was the ability most capable of sensing Pokémon and creature emotions and feelings, aside from the "Power of Transcendence."

His aura power was constantly spread out to counter Caitlin's psychic abilities.

Just now, when he used the "Dynamax Band" and activated massive Galar particles, he inexplicably felt a palpitation, a... faint tremor from the bottom of his heart.

As if something beneath his feet had awakened!

This made Johan's heart chill.

He vaguely realized what it was.

Today, there had been successive Dynamax transformations of Machamp, Hatterene, and now Tyranitar, activating too many Galar particles. Especially Tyranitar's Dynamax seemed to have absorbed large amounts of Galar particles.

Such massive energy fluctuations—could they have stimulated the sleeping Eternatus in Rose's energy plant?

Fortunately, that feeling came quickly and disappeared just as fast.

Johan quickly refocused.

First, finish this battle.

Even if Eternatus was really about to awaken, this would actually save him considerable trouble.

He threw out the enlarged Poké Ball.

Rumble—

The entire field shook violently again. Under the audience's shocked gazes, Tyranitar, bathed in Galar particles, continuously grew larger, finally transforming into a massively exaggerated giant monster with red clouds above its head, surrounded by red lightning, radiating a violent dark red aura.

Dynamax Tyranitar!

"Garrr—!!"

Experiencing Dynamax for the first time, Tyranitar was extremely excited, roaring imposingly at the Gigantamax Hatterene.

Dynamax Tyranitar was imposing in stature, its head nearly touching Wyndon Stadium's dome. Under the protection of the Dynamax barriers covering the field, it roared and stomped the ground, raising rolling clouds of dust.

And Gigantamax Hatterene's G-Max Terror was successfully neutralized by Johan's Dynamax move.

At least Tyranitar didn't fall into a confused state.

However, Hatterene's G-Max Terror's Fairy-type energy attack still successfully hit Dynamax Tyranitar, causing it tremendous pain.

But this pain not only didn't intimidate Tyranitar—it made it even more ferocious, its aura climbing madly.

Weakness Policy!

Compared to Mega Evolution, another advantage of Dynamax was that Pokémon didn't need to carry Mega Stones and similar items, so they could still carry one item.

What was the most suitable item for Dynamax Tyranitar?

Undoubtedly the "Weakness Policy"!

Tyranitar already had many weaknesses, making "Weakness Policy" more likely to activate. Fairy-type was exactly one of Tyranitar's weaknesses, directly triggering the "Weakness Policy" item and greatly enhancing Dynamax Tyranitar's Attack ability!

"Ka-kaah!!"

From Johan's shadow, Gengar poked its head out, biting a handkerchief with eager, envious eyes.

Dynamax!

It had wanted to try this for so long but never had the chance—Tyranitar got to experience it first.

How envious!

The battle continued.

"Tyranitar—"

Johan called out again, clenching his fist as his emotions were somewhat stirred by Tyranitar's Dynamax.

No wonder the Galar region's residents had such high enthusiasm for battles due to Dynamax.

He looked at the Dynamax Tyranitar, feeling the intense visual impact, thinking... this was basically a one-to-one recreation of Godzilla!

The aura boost that Dynamax brought to Tyranitar was too exaggerated.

"Max Darkness!"

"Garrr!!"

Dynamax Tyranitar fiercely lunged at Gigantamax Hatterene, terrifying Dark-type energy gathering madly in Tyranitar's mouth.

Looking at the massive Tyranitar, Caitlin's pretty face was tense.

She obviously hadn't expected Johan to also have Dynamax hidden, and the visual impact of Dynamax Tyranitar had shocked her too.

But facing Dynamax Tyranitar's attack, Caitlin wouldn't choose to sit and wait for defeat.

Once more—G-Max Terror!

Boom!!!

Two incredibly massive Pokémon collided.

Gigantamax Hatterene's fairy power surged wildly while Dynamax Tyranitar bit toward Hatterene relentlessly.

From this posture, Dynamax Tyranitar didn't look like Godzilla anymore—it was more like Gomora.

The Dynamax battle between the two had essentially become a collision between monsters.

Johan suddenly had a rather bold idea.

As everyone knew, except for Gigantamax Pokémon, Dynamax Pokémon would convert their moves into more powerful Max moves based on the original move's power after using moves.

For example, Tyranitar's Max Darkness was the manifestation of Dark-type moves after Dynamax.

It also had special effects, capable of lowering the opponent's Special Defense.

If Tyranitar used Rock-type moves, it would become Max Rockfall. If it used Ground-type moves, it would become Max Quake.

Then... what if Dynamax Tyranitar used Precipice Blades?

This wasn't simply a move of one attribute, but a move that Tyranitar learned from Groudon, combining its own Stone Edge, Earth Power, and some magma-manipulating techniques to "simulate."

A combination move formed by multiple move attributes combined with Dynamax—what would it become?

Max Precipice Blades?

Then an even bolder idea arose in Johan's mind.

What if... Groudon underwent Dynamax and then used Precipice Blades?

Then Johan immediately realized this idea was too dangerous and quickly suppressed it.

Boom!!!

Massive rumbling accompanied by terrifying energy swept out, frantically battering Wyndon's Dynamax barriers, making them emit mournful "humming" sounds. Many audience members' faces turned pale with fright.

This was much more impactful than Bruno's Gigantamax Machamp earlier!

The shock it brought was also much greater.

Was this the impact brought by a Champion's Dynamax?

The audience witnessed this shocking scene, unable to speak for a long time.

Until the terrifying commotion subsided.

Until the final result appeared.

The Rotom referee tremblingly floated out, looking at the two Pokémon that had ended their Dynamax, secretly breathing a sigh of relief.

"Hatterene is unable to battle. All three of Caitlin's Pokémon are unable to battle, so the winner is... is Johan!"

When announcing the result, the Rotom referee felt a powerful psychic force lock onto it.

Based on its strong professional ethics, it managed to announce the final result.

After the announcement, the Rotom referee quickly transformed into a drone and flew away.

This place is dangerous!

Not suitable for lingering—quick escape!

After Tyranitar returned to normal size, it had quite a few injuries. Although its current strength had reached Champion level, Caitlin's Pokémon had her psychic enhancement, which in some ways wasn't weaker than some weaker Champion-level Pokémon.

It was just that in terms of type advantages, it had a significant edge.

Moreover, the initial Dragon Dance and the later triggered "Weakness Policy" made Tyranitar's Attack ability explosive.

"Garrr!!" Tyranitar excitedly waved its fists.

Great!

So great!

But soon, Tyranitar noticed the constantly fluctuating psychic energy around Caitlin, who was biting her lip, and also noticed Johan's gaze.

Understanding, Tyranitar showed some realization.

The next moment.

"Garrr!"

Tyranitar cried out in "pain," clutching its chest and kneeling on one knee, its expression fierce yet "anguished."

It had to be said, Tyranitar was really getting "better with practice." Under Johan and Gengar's influence, its acting skills had finally improved, looking somewhat convincing.

Seeing Tyranitar kneel on one knee, Caitlin, who was biting her lip, was briefly stunned.

Then she glared fiercely at Johan before turning and quickly running back to the contestant tunnel without even shaking hands.

Regardless... at least Caitlin's psychic powers were controlled in the end and didn't explode, which made Johan completely relax.

This battle had been quite nerve-wracking.

But after taking Caitlin's points, he shouldn't still be at the bottom of "Master Ball Tier," right?

Caitlin, who had run back to the contestant lounge feeling wronged, was now hugging her knees and secretly wiping tears.

Feeling down, she took out her phone and sent Cynthia a message—

"Sorry Cynthia, I lost you..."

In the box above Wyndon Stadium.

Rose stood with his hands in his pockets by the floor-to-ceiling window, smiling:

"What a spectacular battle."

The audience's cheers were still continuing.

Only Dynamax battles full of visual impact could make all the audience this excited, right?

Otherwise, why would he have spent so much effort building these stadiums in the Galar region?

Tap tap tap tap—

The sound of high heels clicking rapidly approached from far to near. Oleana, looking serious, quickly came behind Rose and said gravely:

"Chairman Rose, news from the energy plant—the sudden surge of Galar particles means the energy storage probably... won't last much longer. They're asking whether to shut down energy input and cut losses in time."

Rose's eyes became deep.

Wasn't this exactly what he was waiting for?

The "Pokémon World Championships" could stimulate regional economy, which was certainly one reason he fought for the Galar region to become a venue.

But another important reason was that the use of Dynamax, especially by powerful trainers and Pokémon, could further stimulate that guy's awakening.

This was what he wanted to see.

"No need, let them continue," Rose said.

Oleana nodded. She wasn't actually surprised by this result.

Only she knew what Chairman Rose was really planning to do.

If successful, it would undoubtedly benefit the entire Galar region for over a thousand years!

"Never mind." Rose smoothed his hair. "I'll go take a look myself."

But Oleana blocked his way.

Hmm?

Rose wasn't angry, still smiling as he looked at Oleana.

Oleana stood firm, saying:

"Chairman Rose, you've already delayed enough time today. You should head to Wyndon now to host the 'Champion Cup'!"

Quickly determining the Champion was necessary to truly shoulder the responsibility of capturing that guy.

Oleana continued: "As for the energy plant, let me go."

Rose pondered briefly, understanding that Oleana's words were the most correct choice.

Having Leon become Champion was also a very important part of his plan.

Once Leon became Champion, then he would cooperate with Leon to capture Eternatus. Not only would the Galar region benefit greatly, but Leon's strength would inevitably skyrocket.

Then, even in the "Pokémon World Championships," Leon would have a high probability of winning!

Then their Galar region would truly be great again.

This was Rose's series of plans.

If all went smoothly, they could even leap to become second only to the Kanto region.

"Alright." Rose nodded, smiling: "Then I'll trouble you, Oleana."

Oleana swept back her hair, saying nothing.

But in her heart: Chairman Rose's plan, I will do everything I can to help him complete it!

Wyndon, energy plant.

Oleana walked quickly into the energy plant with a stern face, followed by many factory workers reporting the situation to her.

"Miss Oleana, it really won't work. The energy storage can't hold on. If this continues, in less than a day..."

"One day?"

Before the person could finish, Oleana interrupted rudely: "One day isn't enough. I don't care what methods you use—you must hold on for at least three more days!"

Three days...

All the workers showed bitter expressions.

Was this something they could hold on to just by wanting to?

Coming to the deepest part of the energy plant, after crossing the bridge was the most important energy storage.

However, what surprised Oleana and everyone was that by the important energy storage, there were actually two people and a Meowth and a Wobbuffet, holding hammers and tapping away with "ding ding dang dang" sounds.

After finishing, they all slid down the energy storage wall and sat on the ground.

"That scared me..." Jessie wiped sweat from her forehead.

"How did it suddenly become so terrifying?" James was pale-faced.

Just recently, they had quietly snuck to this most secret part of the energy plant. Then suddenly, that energy storage erupted with extremely terrifying aura.

If they hadn't hidden behind Wobbuffet, just sensing that aura up close would have knocked them unconscious.

Then Meowth discovered that cracks had appeared on the energy storage!

How could that work?

Just the aura had nearly knocked them out—what if it actually escaped?

So under Meowth's guidance, the trio grabbed hammers and sealed up that crack.

"This is really a dangerous mission," James said with lingering fear.

"This shows Teacher Johan's trust in us, meow!" Meowth insisted bravely.

"That's true." Jessie and James looked at each other.

This might be their chance for promotion and a raise!

Oleana and a group of energy plant workers witnessed this scene.

What was this?

Oleana looked toward the supervisor.

The supervisor was sweating profusely, sternly rebuking: "You three! Do you know what you just did—"

Before he could finish, another worker quickly ran over, holding a small computer displaying energy storage data.

"O-Oleana! The, the data has dropped!"

The energy values in the storage, which had already exceeded limits, had actually fallen back!

This...

Everyone looked at each other in confusion.

Who were these three people?

They could actually do this to such a degree?

Who could have predicted this...

Oleana's eyes lit up, looking at the three with eyes... like seeing her past self hiding in the laboratory, buried in research and looked down upon by others. A feeling of unrecognized talent immediately arose in her heart.

"You three!"

The trio, who had just been immersed in the joy of promotion and raises, jumped with a start, only then noticing so many people on the bridge opposite.

Disaster—they were in trouble!

Oleana's lips slightly curved: "You did very well! From now on, you're in charge of energy storage repairs! And your positions..." She looked around at the surrounding "useless" people. "Now you're supervisors!"

Supervisors?!

Oleana continued: "As long as you can make the energy storage hold for three more days, I'll report to Chairman Rose and have you promoted to important executives of the energy company!"

Having been rained on herself, she'd let others get less rain.

Was this "promotion and raises"?

The trio looked at each other.

They immediately stood up and saluted.

"Understood!"

"Got it!"

"Mission will be completed, meow!"

"So~nansu~! ∠(°ゝ°)"

Teacher Johan had them infiltrate the energy plant to investigate unstable factors inside.

But now... how had they inexplicably become supervisors of the energy plant?

At this rate, wouldn't they become the boss in a while?

Two days later.

Wild Area outside Wyndon, Lake of Outrage.

"So this is that 'Brave Olivine'?" Cynthia lightly brushed her golden hair, looking with some curiosity at the massive airship stopped in Lake of Outrage, with several Gyarados circling around it.

She had arrived in the Galar region last night. After resting for one night, as agreed, she would start traveling with Johan today, touring some unique or exclusive sights of the Galar region.

It was just that Johan was still monitoring the situation with Eternatus in Wyndon's underground energy plant, so it wasn't convenient to go too far from Wyndon in the short term.

So they decided to first visit the famous "Wild Area" of the Galar region.

The "Wild Area" was said to be very vast, home to large numbers of wild Pokémon, with extremely beautiful natural environments—a holy land for trainers with sufficient strength.

There were also some famous "scenic spots," with Lake of Outrage being one of them.

Legend said Lake of Outrage was home to large numbers of Dragon-type Pokémon, including even pseudo-legendary Dragon-type Pokémon!

There was even a post on the League's official website claiming someone had photographed the shadow of the Galar region's pseudo-legendary Pokémon Dreepy at Lake of Outrage at night.

That post remained highly popular to this day.

This also led many trainers to come to Lake of Outrage to try their luck—what if they encountered that pseudo-legendary Dreepy?

The result was that many trainers only discovered after reaching Lake of Outrage that the wild Pokémon here were truly very high level, and Dragon-type Pokémon had really... terrible tempers.

Gradually, Lake of Outrage was marked as a "danger zone."

"It looks pretty good, doesn't it?" Johan naturally took that soft, white hand.

Cynthia glanced at him lightly without pulling away, but suddenly asked:

"You fought Caitlin?"

"You know about it?"

Since there were broadcast recordings anyway, Johan didn't think he could hide it from Cynthia, nor did he want to.

Cynthia sighed lightly: "Actually, I didn't really want to see you two battle."

"That little girl complained to you? I actually had reasons..." Johan wanted to "argue," but Cynthia said quietly: "That girl said she lost me."

Johan: "?!"

"I didn't bet you!"

"Mm." Cynthia nodded, believing this point. She smiled: "Actually, I was thinking... I'm looking forward to fighting you in the 'Master Tournament.'"

Johan: "..."

Being playful again.

What a scare.

However, battling Cynthia... Johan wasn't actually that resistant anymore. After all, in the "Youth Masters," they had fought in the end.

But last time, they hadn't clearly defined their relationship.

In the Pokémon world, lovers fighting was very normal.

Winning or losing determined family dominance or submission!

"It would be best if we could fight in the final," Johan said.

"That difficulty is still considerable..." Cynthia lightly played with her hair. "Did you know Lance became Johto Champion?"

"Lance? So fast?" Johan looked surprised.

Then he waved his hand: "Eh, just Dragonite boy—piece of cake!"

"Diantha also became Kalos Champion," Cynthia said.

Diantha's appointment news was known by very few people. Even she hadn't had time to attend Diantha's inauguration.

It was said that because the Kalos League was too lazy to go through all those procedures, they ended up taking the "simplified process."

"Just a movie star!" Johan said stubbornly.

"The Kanto League finally decided to have Elite Four Agatha represent them."

"Elite Four Agatha?" Johan looked puzzled, but after thinking carefully, it made sense.

Excluding Lance, among Agatha, Bruno, and Lorelei, only Agatha was most qualified.

As long as it wasn't Red and Blue, no problem, Johan thought.

"I heard Giovanni, the Gym Leader who has a good relationship with you, also registered," Cynthia added.

Johan: "???"

This time Johan really couldn't help but question it.

Wait!

Boss Giovanni also registered for the "Pokémon World Championships"?

A dignified Team Rocket boss coming to register for such a League tournament?

Did he really get addicted to the taste of "fame"?

Was he planning to use this tournament to make himself and Rainbow Rocket more acceptable to more people?

Johan really regretted recommending this "fame-based" path to Boss Giovanni.

Damn, Boss Giovanni seemed to be getting addicted!

"There are also Pryce, Master Mustard, and other veterans who reportedly registered too."

Johan: "..."

After a long silence, Johan finally said quietly:

"Looking at it this way, this 'Pokémon World Championships' is at quasi-hell difficulty level..."

"Quasi-hell?"

Cynthia looked curious.

If this was only "quasi-hell" level, what would count as hell level?

Of course Johan wouldn't say that if "complete Red" entered, it would become hell level.
