# 748: I Don't Think You Can Stop Me Either!

"Teacher Johan, it's getting harder and harder to hold on!"

James hid in a corner of the energy plant, looking at the energy storage that kept making "buzzing" sounds, under tremendous pressure.

"If you can't hold on, then don't." Teacher Johan's voice from the phone sounded like heavenly music to James's ears.

"But, how much longer can you guys hold out?" Johan asked again.

The professional engineers at Rose's energy plant couldn't even last half a day, yet the Team Rocket trio had managed to hold on for almost three days.

Johan was somewhat surprised by the trio's abilities, but considering their "special characteristics," it seemed somewhat natural.

"At most..." James looked toward Meowth and Jessie. Meowth struggled to hold up three fingers, but Jessie pressed one back down. James immediately said somewhat uncertainly: "At most we can hold on for two more days..."

"Two days?"

Johan was stunned.

They could still hold on for two days?

What exactly would I need to have you do that wouldn't be wasting your talents?!

"Then hold on just a little longer. I'll notify you after I resolve the current situation."

Johan said, then quickly added: "It won't be long."

"Okay, Teacher Johan." James breathed a sigh of relief, but also added: "However, Teacher Johan, recently for some reason, the energy storage's activity level keeps getting higher and stronger. We might not be able to control it..."

There was no choice about that.

Recently, more and more people had come to the Galar region to participate in the "Pokémon World Championships," and there were more and more Dynamax transformations, making Eternatus accumulate power faster and faster.

Moreover, the Galar League's "Champion Cup" had been proceeding intensely these past two days.

Those contestants and Gym Leaders from the Galar region almost all had "Dynamax Bands," with several or even dozens of Dynamax transformations happening almost daily. The stimulation to Eternatus was naturally enormous.

He heard that today was the final stage of the "Champion Cup." Leon's Gigantamax Charizard would probably further stimulate Eternatus.

Let's try to cut through the mess quickly and directly resolve the root of the problem before Rose returns!

"I understand," Johan said. "If you encounter trouble, find an employee named Looker."

"Looker?"

"Just tell him I sent you to find him. Of course, if there's no problem, there's no need to find him."

"O-okay..."

After hanging up the phone.

"What's wrong?"

On the vast grasslands of the Wild Area, Cynthia sat cross-legged on a picnic blanket, revealing her fair ankles. She supported her chin with one hand, her deep eyes watching Johan as he walked back.

"Nothing." Johan smiled, then hesitated before saying somewhat embarrassedly:

"Well... this time I might drag you into some trouble..."

"Trouble?" Cynthia blinked, smiling gracefully. "I'm actually more concerned about what you've prepared for dinner today."

Hearing this, Johan was stunned. "This isn't a small trouble."

Cynthia gently played with her hair. "Being with you, isn't that normal?"

Johan: "..."

That made so much sense that he didn't know how to refute it for a moment.

Never mind, it's all the same anyway.

He would take action!

Johan, wearing an apron, walked toward Cynthia with ceramic dishes from the picnic table. "This beautiful lady, please enjoy."

Cynthia looked at the colorfully arranged vegetables in the ceramic plate, her eyes sparkling. "This dish is beautifully made..."

Johan shook his head and sighed.

Facing Cynthia's puzzled gaze, he suddenly smiled: "Too bad it's not as beautiful as the person who'll taste it."

Cynthia paused with the fork in her hand, gave Johan a gentle glare, then curved her lips: "I think so too."

Then she added: "However, I think the person who made it is also a tiny bit better than it."

Johan's eyes widened. "Just a tiny bit?"

He pointed toward the other side, in the direction of Gengar and Garchomp. "Some Pokémon have already been completely won over by my 'charm.'"

He could see the two Pokémon fighting over a plate, dumping the food from the plate into their mouths from left and right.

Crunch—crunch—

Chewing.

Gengar & Garchomp: (=ω=)

Cynthia's face showed amusement as she gently tucked her golden hair behind her ear, forked a piece of vegetable, and slowly chewed.

After a while, she finally breathed out, her face glowing faintly as she said softly:

"Very, very delicious!"

Although it was just vegetables, it gave her a feeling like... when she was small, rolling up her pants legs with Gible to catch small fish in the irrigation ditches—that cool, comfortable, joyful, and free feeling.

This feeling was like...

"It seems like you added—"

"Mint. I added mint."

Johan smiled as he sat beside Cynthia, gently wiping some residue from the corner of her mouth.

The intimate gesture made Cynthia's fair face flush again, and that expression made Johan tease: "Hey, my apple seems to have ripened."

Cynthia gave him an annoyed look.

After brief hesitation, her head quickly moved close to Johan, then moved away even faster.

Johan only felt... his cheek being touched by something soft, moist, and cool.

Oh no!

Johan, who prided himself on having a thick skin, felt his face uncontrollably becoming somewhat heated, unable to suppress it.

Cynthia blinked her eyes, teasingly asking: "Why is your face red?"

"It's wax I applied for cold protection, no..." Johan coughed twice, realizing he was getting his references a bit too advanced.

"Recently it's really... summer vacation is over but the sun is still so strong. The weather's a bit hot, haha..."

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar put its hand over its eyes and looked up at the sky...

Eh? Aren't we hiding under a big tree? And there are clouds all over the sky...

Johan pressed down on Gengar's head, pushing it directly back into the shadows.

"Well then." Johan clapped his hands. "I also made specially prepared chilled berry juice. Want to try some?"

Cynthia couldn't help but laugh, watching Johan "bully" Gengar to cover his embarrassment with amusement. She was already used to this kind of playful interaction—it was probably how the bond between Johan and his Pokémon manifested.

Her eyes were gentle, her smile elegant: "Sure."

The two people and Pokémon picked up their juice. Johan thought for a moment and said:

"To summer, to youth!"

Cynthia and the Pokémon's expressions were somewhat strange.

Wasn't that a bit too literary?

After Johan finished speaking, he had a similar feeling. After brief consideration, he raised his glass again:

"To Lucian!"

Cynthia couldn't help but laugh out loud, but still chimed in: "To Lucian!"

"Ka-kaah!"

"Shaka!"

The Pokémon all raised their glasses, celebrating Lucian's "sacrifice."

Galar region, Wyndon City, Wyndon Stadium.

"Now is my Champion Time!!"

That cape covered in small advertisements fluttered up as Leon struck his signature pose of pointing to the sky with one hand, finally shouting out the "Champion Time" he'd thought about for so long.

Whoosh—!!

But the audience ate up Leon's routine, erupting in extremely intense cheers.

His opponent Raihan, as a popular streamer, had support second only to Leon. The final duel between the two was everyone's favorite "brotherhood battle."

Weather boy Raihan VS Galar's son Leon!

The final showdown of the Galar League "Champion Cup"!

For a moment, the event's popularity even overshadowed the "Pokémon World Championships."

But that was normal.

After all, as the "Pokémon World Championships" progressed, the Galar region and Dynamax were becoming known to more and more people. This battle, destined to feature Dynamax clashes, naturally drew increasing attention.

Listening to the tsunami-like cheers around him, looking at his best friend and rival standing opposite him, Leon's mind flashed back to the conversation Chairman Rose had with him before the finals began.

In the dimly lit contestant tunnel.

Chairman Rose stood to the side with a smile, greeting the confident Leon.

The two had a brief exchange before the match began.

Rose first affirmed Leon's strength and effort, then suddenly shifted the conversation to the "disaster" the Galar region was about to face.

When Leon heard the word "disaster," his expression was very surprised.

After all, they were currently in the "Pokémon World Championships" phase. If the Galar region erupted with a major "disaster" at this time, the blow to the entire Galar region would be enormous.

After all, the "Master Tournament" didn't have just the Galar region as a venue—there was also the Paldea region...

Rose heavily patted Leon's shoulder.

"But if we can get through this, what awaits our Galar region and Galar League will be a thousand years of glory!"

"I have high hopes for you, Leon. This 'disaster' will be your greatest test."

This simple pat on the shoulder made Leon feel tremendous pressure.

It was as if what rested on his shoulder wasn't a hand, but the entire future of the Galar region.

"Why bring this up suddenly now, Chairman Rose..." Leon asked with some helplessness in his smile.

He was about to participate in the final battle!

"Because..."

Rose paused.

Then smiled wistfully: "Whether you call it time not waiting for anyone, or say it's to make you look further ahead, from some point on, the responsibility on your shoulders has always been there."

After speaking, Rose turned and left.

"Although I'd love to watch you be 'crowned,' as I said, time waits for no one."

He waved with his back to Leon.

"Don't disappoint me, Leon."

Watching Rose's departing figure, Leon could clearly feel Rose's trust, but sometimes, this kind of trust was actually also a kind of pressure.

His chaotic thoughts settled.

Leon, wearing his competition uniform, gently patted his cheeks, his eyes gradually becoming determined.

"You can do this, Leon!"

Defeat Raihan, win the championship, then... carry the entire Galar region on your shoulders!

"Crunch, crunch—"

The last small cookie was thrown into Johan's mouth under Victini's gaze, making a crisp sound.

"You've eaten enough already. Look at your little belly."

Johan gently scratched Victini's nose, pointing at its already bulging little tummy.

"Vii~~"

Victini laughed sheepishly, feeling quite embarrassed as it turned invisible and hid.

Clapping his hands, Johan stood up, stretching long with "pop pop pop" sounds from his body.

"That's about enough. Time to make our move," Johan said.

"Now?"

Cynthia was holding a tablet showing the "Champion Cup" final battle between Leon and Raihan.

"Right now." Johan nodded definitively. "Any later... things will become much more troublesome."

Once Rose returned from the "Champion Cup," facing this forceful League Chairman, Johan, as Hoenn League Champion, would be... somewhat passive in terms of status.

A few days ago, Eternatus might still have been in a half-awake state.

But after these past few days of accumulation, Eternatus was probably about ready to fully awaken.

More importantly...

Under Johan's direction, today's Wyndon Stadium was unused and had no audience. Even if Eternatus revived, it wouldn't cause any casualties.

To close down Wyndon Stadium's usage in such a major environment as the "Pokémon World Championships," Johan had also put in some effort and used some "privileges."

Of course, the "Champion Cup" finals did indeed temporarily attract a lot of "attention." Audiences who couldn't attend in person would stay home to watch the livestream.

This was also a very important reason.

"Okay~"

Cynthia wrinkled her little nose but immediately put away the tablet and obediently walked to Johan's side.

Johan grinned.

At least two Champions—couldn't they handle a mere Eternatus?

"Let's go, Wyndon Stadium!"

"Cha!"

Tinkaton stuffed a mouthful of cake, clapped its hands, picked up its hammer and the sword and shield, and called out excitedly.

Let's go!

Central Galar region, Wyndon Stadium.

"Inspector Johan, Wyndon Stadium lockdown complete!"

A young man with short red hair wearing beige and red work clothes reported with some excitement and reverence in his expression.

"You're... Hop?" Johan remembered seeing him on Master Mustard's island.

"I didn't expect Teacher Johan to still remember me." Hop scratched the back of his head somewhat embarrassedly.

In Johan's impression, Hop and Gloria from the anime were the two people in charge of the "Project Dreamcatcher," with their signature Pokémon being two Urshifu. They should be students of Master Mustard.

And even Goh had participated in "Project Dreamcatcher."

He hadn't expected the two had actually joined the International Police.

And had become one of the people in charge of the Galar International Police branch.

"Well done." Johan patted Hop's shoulder.

Then asked: "What about the energy plant?"

"Gloria is handling that side," Hop said. "However... the Macro Cosmos Group people are reacting very strongly. I'm worried the lockdown might not succeed..."

As he spoke, Hop looked worried.

Although they were International Police, Macro Cosmos Group's influence throughout the entire Galar region was really too great. With just Gloria alone, Hop worried she couldn't suppress it.

"It's fine."

Johan and Cynthia walked toward the energy plant.

The energy plant was actually not far from Wyndon Stadium, but the truly massive part of the energy plant was its underground space, extending all the way beneath Wyndon Stadium.

"What exactly are you trying to do?! This is Wyndon's energy plant, even affecting the entire Galar region's energy supply. If something goes wrong, can you take responsibility?"

Before even reaching the energy plant entrance, they could hear voices from outside.

From the other party's tough tone and attitude, they seemed extremely angry about the energy plant being sealed off.

At this time, Johan and Cynthia walked over.

"Teacher Johan!"

"Officer Johan!"

"Champion Cynthia!"

Gloria and Officer Jenny from Wyndon all breathed sighs of relief seeing Johan's arrival.

The arrival of two Champions also weakened the shouting from the energy plant side.

But the other party still stiffened their neck, struggling: "E-e-even if it's Teacher Johan and Champion Cynthia, one Hoenn League Champion and one Sinnoh League Champion don't have the authority to seal off our Macro Cosmos Group's energy plant, right?"

"No."

Johan smiled as he took out credentials: "Sorry, I'm police."

As International Police Inspector, this identity was sometimes more useful than being Champion.

"Now we suspect your energy plant is hiding an extremely dangerous Pokémon. For the safety of all Wyndon and the Galar region, we're now sealing you off for investigation. Any objections?"

"I, you..." The person suddenly didn't know what to say.

Where would an extremely dangerous Pokémon come from?

Johan waved his hand: "Now we suspect this person may be related to hiding dangerous Pokémon. As an important suspect, arrest him."

"Yes!"

Two International Police officers immediately responded, directly handcuffing the person.

"I'm not, I didn't, I..."

The other energy plant employees, seeing Teacher Johan being so forceful, were immediately overwhelmed and didn't dare speak up.

The International Police and Officer Jenny's side immediately gained confidence with Johan and Cynthia's arrival.

"Don't let anyone else enter the energy plant. Control everyone who comes out, then keep them away from this area."

"Yes!"

After giving these instructions, Johan and Cynthia walked into the energy plant under everyone's reverent gazes.

After the two walked around the corner, Cynthia teased: "Officer Johan, such authority."

Johan smiled as he took Cynthia's hand: "Handsome, right?"

"Handsome~ Officer Jenny was looking at you with complete admiration."

Johan immediately felt the hand in his tighten, quickly coughing: "Cough cough, Rotom, navigation, navigation. Let's head straight to the energy storage!"

"Beginning navigation, Rotom!"

Seeing Johan's somewhat embarrassed expression, Cynthia showed a mischievous smile.

"How do you have an internal map of the energy plant?"

"I have my ways... okay, I planted undercover agents," Johan compromised.

"Undercover agents? You're really getting more like International Police."

The two strolled leisurely through the complex interior of the energy plant.

Rumble—

The closer they got to the interior, the more both could faintly feel the ground shaking and a vague sense of oppression.

Feeling this aura, Cynthia finally understood what Johan meant by "not a small matter."

Another legendary Pokémon?

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar poked its head out of the shadows with a puzzled expression, lightly scratching its rear and sniffing.

What was this somewhat familiar aura? It seemed very similar to something it had eaten before?

Soon, the two reached the deepest part of the energy plant.

"Why didn't we encounter anyone along the way?" Cynthia asked curiously.

"Because... them."

Johan pointed ahead at the neatly dressed Team Rocket trio.

Seeing Johan, the trio immediately rushed over with tears streaming down their faces: "Teacher Johan, you're finally here!"

The next second, they were all hanging on Johan, each telling their own hardships during this time.

Johan looked pleadingly at Cynthia, who covered her mouth laughing and took a step back.

Why hadn't they encountered anyone?

Of course, because the Team Rocket trio, as supervisors, had given the factory workers the day off as much as possible according to Johan's wishes.

Minimize unnecessary casualties.

"Alright, alright, I know it wasn't easy for you. I'll report this when we get back—promotion! Raise!"

"Really?!" ×3

"So~nansu?! ∠(°ゝ°)"

"Really." Johan nodded. "Now you should evacuate too. There's going to be quite a commotion here."

Hearing it would be unsafe, the trio immediately fled.

"Goodbye Teacher Johan! Goodbye... Officer Lady Cynthia—!!"

"Officer Lady?" Cynthia blinked her lively eyes.

"Cough, cough cough..."

"However, I remember them—they're Team Rocket people, right?"

"They've reformed. Actually, they're very capable people. Having them do anything feels like wasting their talents."

Johan took out the ID card the trio had given him and swiped open the energy plant's storage door.

"Mm... their ice cream is delicious." Cynthia lightly licked her lips, saying somewhat temptingly.

"Next time I'll have them make some for you..."

Hiss—

The storage door slowly opened.

A stream of dark red Galar particles immediately rushed toward them.

"Ka-kaah!"

"Shaka!"

Gengar and Garchomp simultaneously positioned themselves in front of Johan and Cynthia, taking different stances.

Garchomp swung its scythe arms, slicing the dark red Galar particles in half.

And Gengar... opened its mouth wide.

Vacuum absorption!

Garchomp: "?"

"Is that the thing?" Cynthia squinted her eyes, speaking heavily while locking her gaze on the energy storage containing Eternatus.

Even though Cynthia wasn't an ability user, she could clearly feel the oppressive force emanating from within.

"Should be..."

As Johan spoke, a voice came, attracting both their attention.

At the other end of the energy storage, Rose stood wearing his signature gray suit with hands in pockets, expression calm, by the railing.

He said flatly: "Teacher Johan, I already discussed this with you. The Galar League will handle matters here ourselves. I didn't expect you to still come..."

Why was Rose here?

Johan was somewhat surprised.

The "Champion Cup" finals—as League Chairman, Rose wasn't at the scene for the award ceremony, not taking the newly promoted League Champion to register, but came to the energy plant instead?

And hadn't the energy plant been sealed off?

Seeming to see Johan's confusion, Rose smiled: "I believe in Leon, so I came. As for how I got in... this is my energy plant after all."

After all, this was such an important place and Rose's territory. Arranging one or two secret passages would be no difficulty for Rose.

Johan understood.

Then he also stepped forward, smiling:

"Sorry, Chairman Rose. Before having dinner with you, I had already promised someone else that I'd come deal with this guy."

As he spoke, Johan slowly loosened his collar, slowly rolled up his sleeves, his clear footsteps echoing in the chamber as he stared at Rose, speaking slowly but forcefully:

"At the same time, I don't think you can stop me either!"

# 749: Oh No! Encountered a Natural Enemy!

"As expected! The legendary hero wasn't just one person—at least... not only one person!"

Sonia's eyes sparkled as she looked at the fallen rocks on the cliff face before her, revealing two blurred figures behind them.

After returning to the Galar region during summer vacation, to test the results of her studies abroad, her grandmother Professor Magnolia had assigned her a new "homework."

Figure out the history of the hero who once fought against the "Darkest Day" and dispelled it.

Because the Galar region was currently experiencing continuous Pokémon Dynamax phenomena, similar to the situation when the "Darkest Day" descended, Professor Magnolia suspected there might be some connection.

Perhaps it was a sign, or perhaps it was itself related to the "Darkest Day."

So she had Sonia investigate this history.

But as Sonia's investigation and research deepened, she discovered an unknown secret.

The hero who dispelled the "Darkest Day" wasn't just one person!

The sculpture before her confirmed her speculation.

However, due to the passage of time, plus the mountain's burial and blockade, those two figures appeared especially blurred.

She could only determine they weren't human-shaped!

"Hmm?"

Sonia noticed a broken stone tablet in the corner of the collapsed rocks, with some text vaguely carved on it.

"This is..."

After confirming no more rocks would collapse, Sonia quickly stepped forward.

"Good thing I learned some ancient script from Teacher Johan, Miss Cynthia, and Steven..."

Sonia's greatest gain from studying at Kanaz Pokémon Academy in Hoenn was ancient script!

Teacher Johan had close relationships with the ancient Regis, always able to roughly interpret some content from the Regi stone tablets, while Miss Cynthia was an ancient mythology and history scholar with vast knowledge. Teacher Johan could also always borrow materials and resources for her.

Combined with her mutual learning and discussion with Steven, she now had some ability to recognize ancient script.

"Ancient king? Sword and shield... Slum... Slumbering... sleeping guardians..."

Sonia frowned.

Although she could interpret part of the content, most of the text on the stone tablet was already very blurred, and much of the content was actually difficult for her to determine.

"Slumbering... Slumbering Weald?"

Sonia's eyes lit up. "The sword and shield are sleeping in Slumbering Weald? Then who is this ancient king referring to? That legendary hero?"

Just then, Sonia suddenly looked up, her gaze trembling, mouth slightly open.

She saw a meteor trailing red light streak across the sky, falling from the night sky, its target seemingly...

"The direction of Wyndon!"

Wyndon City, Wyndon Stadium.

"Let us congratulate Mr. Leon for winning the championship of this 'Champion Cup'! And congratulate Mr. Leon for becoming the new Champion of our Galar region!!!"

The host's passionate words, accompanied by Leon placing his Poké Ball into the machine to complete information registration, spread throughout the entire venue.

Boom!!!

The massive Wyndon Stadium immediately erupted in extremely enthusiastic cheers.

"Champion! Champion! Champion!!"

"Unbeatable Leon! Unbeatable Leon!!"

"As long as we have our Champion, there's nothing we need to worry about!"

If even the Champion couldn't solve something, then the Galar region would truly be in danger.

The word "Champion" held extremely important meaning for any region.

Leon had already been given the title of "unbeatable" under Rose's promotion, and was even hailed as the historically strongest Champion of the Galar region.

In such circumstances, Leon's championship victory could be said to be what everyone expected.

Although everyone acknowledged Raihan's strength was formidable, compared to Leon, he was indeed somewhat weaker...

Just after Leon registered his information, suddenly a dark red meteor streaked across the sky above, attracting everyone's attention.

"A meteor! It's a meteor!"

Leon frowned, looking toward the direction where the meteor was falling.

Where was that?

Although he couldn't be certain where it was, his intuition told him this wasn't a good omen.

"Roar—!!"

Charizard in its Poké Ball also seemed to sense something and came out on its own, roaring toward the direction where the meteor fell.

Seeing this, Leon's mind stirred, thinking of what Chairman Rose had said earlier.

Was this... the massive crisis that could affect the entire Galar region?

Whoosh—

His cape fluttered as Leon leaped onto Charizard's back.

"Let's go!"

If it really was a disaster that could harm the entire Galar region, then as the newly appointed Champion, he would spare no effort!

With the red glow spreading after that meteor fell, even he couldn't possibly get lost.

"This is the responsibility of being Champion!"

Wyndon City, Wyndon Stadium.

In the dim night, a dark red meteor fell straight toward the stadium. The dark red light continuously expanded, and the burning meteor seemed to contain some strange, eerie power.

Boom!!!

A huge commotion erupted within Wyndon Stadium. The solid stadium floor was directly smashed with a massive crater, creating a direct passage to the energy plant beneath Wyndon Stadium!

The tremendous commotion from the meteor's impact directly triggered Wyndon Stadium's self-protection mechanism, and the Dynamax energy barrier immediately activated!

"A me-meteor?"

Outside Wyndon Stadium, the International Police and League Police Officer Jenny who had sealed off Wyndon Stadium and the energy plant according to Johan's instructions looked at this scene in shock.

"So it was a meteor... no wonder Teacher Johan had us seal off Wyndon Stadium..." Hop murmured.

"But... why do I have a bad feeling about this?" Officer Jenny was equally impressed, but her heart tightened, and that bad feeling grew stronger.

"That meteor seems to contain some kind of power." After her reminder, Hop also frowned.

Within Wyndon Stadium's Dynamax energy barrier, as the meteor fell, a dark red energy was gradually spreading.

Meanwhile, in the underground energy plant, in the chamber where Johan, Cynthia, and Rose stood near the energy storage.

Johan and Cynthia looked somewhat surprised at the fallen meteor.

How could there be a meteor?

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar poked its head forward. The hole where the meteor crashed directly pierced through the energy plant and Wyndon Stadium!

Hey! I can see Wyndon Tower now!

"Shaka!"

Garchomp warily stared at the fallen meteor that was still steaming, and the energy storage that had begun shaking.

The meteor's fall gave it a feeling that... something had completely awakened.

Johan also felt this sensation.

He frowned, staring at the energy storage that had cracked with fissures, beams of dark red light shooting out, murmuring: "Cosmic Power?"

Eternatus was originally a Pokémon from outer space. Back then, a meteor's fall had brought it and the endless "Darkest Day."

Eternatus's power included force from the "cosmos."

Previously when Johan played the game and used Eternatus, he liked to first use Cosmic Power to continuously stack Eternatus's defensive power.

Now this meteor's fall was clearly different from the anime plot in his memory.

This... was caused by Eternatus?

"You're right, Teacher Johan." Rose didn't seem surprised by the meteor's fall. He strolled leisurely by the railing, smiling: "But there's no longer any need for me to stop you."

As his words fell—

Crack!!

The energy storage lost its support and cracked with huge fissures. Accompanied by red light sweeping like a tide, a beam of extremely powerful red energy burst forth.

The next second, terrifying air waves accompanied by massive impact surged and echoed in the vast space.

"Shaka!!"

Garchomp stood alone in front of Johan and Cynthia, swinging its scythe arms to split the rolling air waves into four pieces.

Then, on the broken energy storage, a massive dark red Pokémon resembling an ancient dragon opened a pair of white-spotted eyes, surveying its surroundings emotionlessly and imperiously.

"This is..." Seeing that creature, Cynthia's pupils contracted slightly.

Garchomp's scales stood up, feeling the extremely strong oppressive force from a fellow Dragon-type Pokémon.

At least a legendary Pokémon!

"Eternatus—!!!"

The blue-red fierce skeletal dragon raised its head and roared, seemingly announcing its return.

"Eternatus!!" Rose spread his arms wide, his eyes full of fanatical fervor. "It is the 'Darkest Day'! I call it—Eternatus! Possessing infinite energy, it's the energy source for our Galar region's next thousand years!"

"'Darkest Day'? Eternatus..." Cynthia repeated.

Her contact with Sonia had given Cynthia some understanding of Galar region's past history. The "Darkest Day" had left a significant mark in Galar region's history.

Her visit to the Galar region this time also involved investigating and understanding the "Darkest Day."

She hadn't expected to encounter it directly.

"Eternatus!!!"

Eternatus roared again, ignoring everyone around it, gathering energy and charging straight upward.

But soon Eternatus's movement stopped.

Because Wyndon Stadium's fully activated Dynamax barrier blocked it. Eternatus could only wander within the Dynamax barrier, unable to leave.

"I told you long ago, Teacher Johan—we Galar people can solve our own problems." Rose remained very calm and composed.

Currently, everything about Eternatus was within his expectations.

What needed to be done next was actually just waiting.

Waiting for Leon's arrival, waiting for Leon to defeat and capture Eternatus—then the entire Galar region's future would be secure!

But after Rose said so much, Johan just nodded, not even bothering to acknowledge him, his hand lightly sweeping across his waist.

"Oowoo—"

Ninetales landed gracefully, snowflakes beginning to fall, white crystalline ice slowly adhering to surrounding structures.

"Draaa~(ˊˋ)"

Dragonite flapped its small wings, the stirred wind immediately made the snowflakes dance, and the temperature plummeted.

However, when Dragonite saw Eternatus flying above, its spirits suddenly lifted. Its round belly shook, but its energy became excited.

A dragon!

"Cha!!"

Tinkaton directly landed on Dragonite's neck, carrying a massive metal hammer that seemed to shimmer with flowing light, as if some strange change had occurred, containing a different kind of power.

Fusion!

Giant Dragon Heavy Hammer Knight!

Besides them, there was also—

"Vii~!"

Victini made a "V" gesture and revealed itself. From Johan and Cynthia, it saw the "light of victory."

Infinite-energy Eternatus?

Victini was the true infinite Pokémon!

"Ninetales, Blizzard!"

Howling cold wind wrapped in extremely cold snowflakes roared up, instantly condensing into a raging snow tornado under Wyndon Stadium's Dynamax barrier, heading toward Eternatus.

Johan directly ignored Rose and launched an attack at Eternatus.

Seeing this scene, Rose's expression finally darkened.

"Copperajah, Ferroseed!"

He threw out two Poké Balls, summoning his two signature Pokémon.

It had to be said that although Rose was Galar League Chairman rather than Champion, famous for his outstanding administrative and management abilities, Rose's strength wasn't actually weak.

In his youth, Rose had also narrowly lost in the "Champion Cup," taking second place and losing the qualification to challenge the Champion.

Somewhat similar to... the current Raihan.

Of course, that "Champion Cup" couldn't compare to the current one.

But Rose still had some strength.

That made sense too—Champion Peony's brother wouldn't lack talent, and being able to find talent like Leon showed strong judgment while naturally requiring some personal strength.

But...

Rose's strength was only relative to other trainers.

"Goka!"

A ghostly blue flame appeared. The Copperajah and Ferroseed Rose had just summoned immediately had flames rise from their bodies, both Pokémon crying out in pain.

"Garruu!"

Then with two "bang bang" sounds, one punch and one kick sent Ferroseed flying and kicked Copperajah away.

Ceruledge stood with twin swords lowered, ghostly blue dancing in its eyes.

Urshifu stood with one foot raised, its fur flowing like clouds.

Johan looked down at Rose disdainfully.

"I told you—you can't stop me."

"You!"

Rose was furious.

Hadn't he heard before that Teacher Johan wasn't very talkative?

Why was he so domineering today?

Could it be because Cynthia was here?

"Chairman Rose!"

At this time, Oleana led a group of Macro Cosmos Group combat personnel and finally arrived.

Previously Johan had been somewhat surprised why Rose was here while Oleana wasn't—now it seemed she'd gone to find reinforcements.

In the anime, Rose had indeed arranged quite a few Macro Cosmos Group combat personnel, but they were directly steamrolled by Raihan's Duraludon.

But scanning the faces behind Oleana... Johan's expression became somewhat strange.

There were actually familiar ones!

Whoa!

Among them were quite a few "Rainbow Rocket Group" external contractors.

"Let me handle this," Cynthia said softly.

"No need." Johan waved his hand, saying to the people behind Oleana: "Take them down."

Huh?

Oleana was stunned.

Who was he talking to?

The next second, Oleana heard uniform voices from behind her:

"Yes!"

Accompanied by some commotion, almost all the Macro Cosmos Group combat personnel were subdued.

Oleana's eyes widened.

How was this possible?

Were all these people undercover agents arranged by Teacher Johan?

Cynthia was also somewhat surprised, and her thoughts were actually similar to Oleana's. She quietly asked: "These people..."

"They're all our people," Johan gave a reassuring look.

Macro Cosmos Group had brought in Team Rocket people themselves—didn't they know he was Team Rocket's highest-ranking advisor?

No, wait.

He should say he was one of the directors of "Rainbow Rocket Group"!

"Let's focus on dealing with Eternatus!" Johan said.

"Right!" Cynthia nodded.

"Eternatus—!!!"

In the raging blizzard, the blue-red skeletal dragon struggled to release dark red energy beams.

Eternatus, already covered in ice crystals, shot beams from its chest's core energy area, directly shattering the blizzard.

However, just as it broke free from the blizzard's restraints, it saw a grinning ghost face appear before it.

Then a pitch-black sphere instantly enveloped it.

No energy attack, but drowsiness uncontrollably assaulted its consciousness.

Dark Void!

"Ninetales, Earth Power!" Johan rapidly commanded all his Pokémon through aura power.

"Oowoo!"

Ninetales, having broken free from the blizzard, crouched on all fours, the earth's pulse gathering power into its body.

Meanwhile, the black hole dissipated. As expected, Eternatus didn't fall asleep, just had brief mental sluggishness.

But this sluggishness was enough for Johan and Cynthia.

"Dragonite—"

"Garchomp—"

The two looked at each other, both seeing absolute confidence in the other's face.

They waved simultaneously.

"Dragon Rush!" ×2

"Draaa!!"

"Shaka!!"

Left and right, Dragonite and Garchomp both manifested blue-purple dragon auras, charging together at Eternatus.

"Victini, Helping Hand!"

"Vii!"

Victini's forehead ignited with a "V"-shaped flame, showing its small fangs as it made "yeah" gestures toward Dragonite and Garchomp.

The light of victory was already shining!

Bang! Bang!

Two extremely powerful impacts struck Eternatus hard, accompanied by Eternatus's shriek.

Its massive body immediately crashed down from the air.

It had to be said that in non-competitive situations, Victini was definitely a top-tier "cheat."

Cynthia's Garchomp, without Mega Evolution, had strength infinitely close to legendary level but hadn't quite reached legendary tier.

Johan's Dragonite, although it had grown further over time, especially after encountering Necrozma, only had the level of an ordinary Champion's ace Pokémon. Without entering "Outrage state," it still had some distance from legendary level.

But after Victini's helping hand enhancement, both Garchomp and Dragonite's explosive power increased significantly.

Thud—

Thud—

Garchomp and Dragonite, the two Dragon-type Pokémon, steadied themselves and looked at each other.

Garchomp showed a fierce grin, Dragonite showed a silly grin, and the two Pokémon tacitly raised their hands for a light fist bump.

"Draaa!!"

But after the bump, Dragonite immediately regretted it and cried out in pain, blowing on its fist.

This guy had either scythes or spikes on its hands!

Seeing Garchomp grin even more fiercely, Dragonite rolled its eyes in annoyance.

It felt like Garchomp was becoming more and more like its own Gengar.

Of course, while Dragonite and Garchomp were fist-bumping, Tinkaton had already jumped off Dragonite's back and stood on Eternatus's skeletal head.

"Eternatus..."

Eternatus's mood wasn't good at the moment.

It had finally awakened, and without bothering with these people, it had tried to leave, only to be blocked by a barrier.

That was already bad enough.

Then it suffered a series of attacks.

First a blizzard bath, as if worried it hadn't woken up properly after sleeping so long.

Then a black hole to the face, as if concerned it hadn't slept enough.

Next came "bang bang" two punches, leaving it unsure whether it was asleep or awake.

Now, finally reacting, Eternatus was filled with rage.

It violently shook its head, slightly lifting it. Its eyes full of violence were just about to look at those Pokémon that had punched it, when it saw a head hanging upside down in its field of vision, with two pink pigtails gently swaying.

"Cha~"

Tinkaton smiled at Eternatus.

Awake now?

No, you should sleep.

Bright metallic light flashed briefly.

A hammer came crashing down toward its head.

A hammer?

It, the mighty Eternatus, could be taken down by a hammer?

Huh?

Just as this thought arose, Eternatus suddenly felt a familiar yet strange sensation from that falling hammer.

This feeling...

Images of a Pokémon holding a sword and another carrying a shield flashed through its mind.

It was them!

From that hammer, Eternatus felt the same sensation as those sword and shield!

Hum—

In Eternatus's vision, that already substantial hammer seemed to instantly grow longer and larger, expanding more than tenfold!

Thud!!

The giant hammer crashed down heavily.

Eternatus: Stars, hehe, so many stars...

Huh?

Even Johan was somewhat surprised.

Was that an illusion just now?

Visually, Tinkaton's hammer didn't seem to change, but in his aura sensing, the massive hammer seemed somewhat different?

Behemoth Blade, Behemoth Bash, Behemoth... Hammer?

"Look out!" Cynthia's sudden warning pulled Johan back from his confusion.

Several dark red energy masses burst from Eternatus's body.

Landing on the Pokémon of nearby Macro Cosmos Group combat personnel...

A Garbodor, surrounded by red clouds, rapidly expanded into a massive Gigantamax Garbodor!

Another dark red energy mass hit Rose's Copperajah, which also quickly completed Gigantamax transformation!

Instantly, numerous Dynamax and Gigantamax Pokémon appeared!

At the same time, two energy masses shot toward Johan and Cynthia's location.

Cynthia's expression was serious as she moved extremely quickly to stand in front of Johan, spreading her arms with a determined, imperious expression.

No one could "bully" Johan in front of her!

However, Cynthia was fast, but someone was even faster—Gengar!

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar burst from the shadows, mouth wide open.

Like in Fall Guys, "nom nom" two bites swallowed both dark red energy masses.

Eternatus: "?"

Rose: "?"

Oleana: "?"

"Burp~"

Gengar patted its belly, letting out a burp with pink mist.

The purple fatty showed a mischievous smile, picked at its teeth with a finger, then flicked its pinky at Eternatus.

"Ka-kaah?"

Got more?

"Impossible..." Rose muttered in disbelief.

Eternatus's eyes widened, feeling...

Oh no! Encountered a natural enemy!

# 750: The Team Fight Can Be Lost, But Gengar Must Die! (Two-in-One Chapter)

"Eternatus—!!!"

Although Gengar had swallowed the Dynamax energy released by Eternatus, the scattered Dynamax energy still caused quite a commotion.

Boom!!

Boom!!

The Dynamax and Gigantamax Pokémon that had lost control began wreaking havoc on the energy plant.

In a short time, the others couldn't handle such problems at all.

Johan and Cynthia had to split their Pokémon and attention to deal with these troubles.

Although Eternatus was still the most important, if too much destruction occurred, it would inevitably affect some people inside or nearby.

And more importantly, although Eternatus had been knocked down from the air by Johan and Cynthia's smooth combo, this didn't mean Eternatus was weak.

It was just because Eternatus had just awakened, and its first thought wasn't to fight anyone, but to quickly leave and restart the "Darkest Day"—that's why it fell for Johan's trick.

Ultimately, Eternatus was also an extremely powerful legendary Pokémon.

Just looking at its base stats, it had a whopping 690 points in its normal form!

That was 10 points higher than normal Rayquaza or Dusk Mane/Dawn Wings Necrozma, and 10 to 20 points higher than most "first-tier legendaries."

Although you couldn't judge legendary Pokémon solely by base stats, in many cases, base stats did represent many things.

Moreover, Eternatus was the energy source of Dynamax and Gigantamax in the Galar region, an existence on par with Necrozma and Terapagos.

And now, Eternatus was truly furious.

"Eternatus!!"

Its skeletal tail swept violently, driving back Dragonite, Garchomp, and Tinkaton, then gathered energy again and flew up.

"Now it's getting serious!" Johan said gravely.

"Yes!"

Cynthia nodded, seriously taking out a lipstick—a gift from Johan. She wasn't taking it out to touch up her makeup, but because at the end of the lipstick was embedded a brilliant pearl.

A Key Stone!

"Garchomp—"

Cynthia called out softly, and brilliant rainbow light burst from the Key Stone at the end of the lipstick.

"Shaka!!!"

Garchomp immediately responded, spreading its arms and roaring. The Mega Stone it carried resonated with the Key Stone in Cynthia's hand.

Mega Evolution!

"Ka-kaah! Ka-kaah!"

Seeing Garchomp about to Mega Evolve, Gengar immediately waved at Johan.

I want to evolve too!

Johan glanced at Gengar, then at Cynthia and Garchomp...

He hadn't even taken out his Key Stone yet.

"Eternatus!!!"

Eternatus, which had flown back into the air, burst with dark red light from its chest, and rich Dynamax energy immediately spread out, filling Wyndon Stadium and the energy plant almost instantly.

The Key Stone in Cynthia's hand and the Mega Stone on Garchomp immediately dimmed.

Huh?

Both Cynthia and Garchomp were stunned.

The Mega Evolution was interrupted?

"How is this possible?" Cynthia said in amazement. This was her first time experiencing a Mega Evolution being interrupted.

Johan had also taken out his Key Stone, similarly feeling that the Key Stone's surface seemed covered by a layer of dark red energy—extremely rich Galar particles.

Not just the Key Stone—Johan could also feel the dimming of the Z-Crystals on him.

"The Dynamax energy is too strong, blocking the power of Mega Evolution and obscuring the power of 'light,'" Johan shook his head.

That meant when facing Eternatus, neither Mega Evolution nor Z-moves could be used.

Unsurprisingly, Terastallization probably couldn't be used either.

Although Johan's Tera Orb hadn't been recharged since the last Hoopa incident.

"Can't use enhancements?" Cynthia's expression was grave.

Dynamax also couldn't be used in front of Eternatus, or who knew if Dynamax Pokémon could maintain their self-control, or if they'd just destroy wildly like those forced Dynamax Pokémon.

Even if they could Dynamax or Gigantamax, facing Eternatus's "Dynamax Cannon" would be no different from suicide.

The pressure of facing Eternatus increased dramatically!

"Perhaps some special methods might work..." Johan smiled helplessly.

He knew fighting Eternatus wouldn't be simple.

Without enhancements, their strength was greatly reduced.

"Special methods?"

Johan pursed his lips, not saying more—he couldn't say more.

Perhaps something like Ash's bond-evolved Greninja could work, not needing Key Stones or Mega Stones, relying purely on the power of bonds.

Even if Eternatus's Dynamax energy was strong, it couldn't obscure the power of bonds.

Eternatus coiled under Wyndon Stadium's Dynamax barrier, its body making chain-like "clatter clatter" sounds. It suddenly raised its head, and under the night sky swirling with dark red vortexes, crystalline strange light points scattered down.

Eternatus, bathed in the light points, had its aura rapidly climbing.

Cosmic Power!

"No matter what, we can't let this guy keep powering up!" Johan said gravely.

If Eternatus continued powering up until it maxed out its stats, even if Zacian and Zamazenta came, it would be difficult.

"Gengar, full-power Shadow Ball!"

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar could feel Johan's pressure and immediately stopped fooling around, floating into the air surrounded by black mist, condensing a massive black sphere.

"Ninetales!"

Johan looked at Ninetales beside him, who also looked over.

Earth Power had already ended, and Ninetales had gained tremendous enhancement, its eyes sparkling with flowing light. Among its snow-white fur, a palm-sized stone tablet faintly glimmered.

"Blizzard!"

"Oowoo—"

Even without Mega Evolution, even without exclusive Z-moves, Gengar and Ninetales were... still legendary-tier!

Boom!!

A massive rumbling erupted from Eternatus, and thick smoke immediately spread.

"Tsk," Johan clicked his tongue with some frustration.

Others might not have seen clearly, but he noticed.

Before Gengar and Ninetales' attacks landed, Eternatus had deployed a transparent barrier in front of itself at extreme speed.

As its revival progressed, Eternatus's reaction speed and battle instincts were gradually recovering.

"Garchomp!" Cynthia also called out, but Johan raised his hand to stop her.

Facing Cynthia's somewhat puzzled gaze, Johan's expression suddenly changed as he turned and embraced his little cabbage.

"Watch out!"

Earlier, it was because of distraction that he'd almost fallen for Eternatus's Dynamax energy. Now, with his mind highly focused, Johan keenly noticed Eternatus's change.

Crack—

Wyndon Stadium's Dynamax barrier shattered completely, and massive tremors stirred up powerful shockwaves.

Witnessing this scene, Rose's eyes widened.

His proud stadium Dynamax barrier, which could block Dynamax Pokémon impacts, had... just shattered like that?

He had specifically reinforced the barrier's strength!

If Johan knew Rose's thoughts at this moment, he'd definitely scoff.

Stadium Dynamax barrier?

He was just afraid he couldn't afford to pay for it, otherwise, during his battle with Caitlin, he could have blown up this barrier!

If human technology could really be powerful enough to contain legendary Pokémon, what would be the point of Pokémon?

Eternatus's actions weren't finished.

After Wyndon Stadium's Dynamax barrier shattered, a black vortex immediately appeared above Wyndon, with countless Dynamax energies converging toward the vortex, forming a swirling mass of black and red energy!

Throughout Wyndon, everyone suddenly stopped what they were doing and looked up at the sky.

They saw the vortex expanding again and again, quickly spreading across almost all of Wyndon's sky, even trending toward covering the entire Galar region.

The Darkest Day!

Descending once more!

Even more chilling was that in that sky-covering massive vortex, a huge purple-red monster like a war fortress revealed its form.

"Wh-what is that?!"

"That... that can't be a Pokémon, right? So huge..."

The black vortex swallowed Eternatus, with surging dark red energy constantly churning, forming extremely powerful impacts.

Fortunately, Johan reacted quickly enough to prevent himself and Cynthia from being injured by this impact.

Eternatus's appearance also underwent earth-shaking changes under the black vortex's shroud.

What revealed itself in that vortex was a colossal creature a full hundred meters tall!

Its skeletal frame had extended infinitely, coiling into a disc shape, and its head had grown into a dragon claw with five fingers, with fierce white-spotted eyes flickering above.

"Holy..." At some battle venue in Wyndon, Flint spoke dumbly.

This couldn't be the guy Teacher Johan was preparing to have him deal with, right?

Good thing big sister came—Teacher Johan found him annoying and didn't bring him along...

What luck!

"This couldn't be the terrifying Pokémon that could endanger the entire Galar region that Johan mentioned, could it?" Alder also woke from his nap in shock.

"It's the 'Darkest Day'! It really is the 'Darkest Day'!" Peony's expression changed dramatically. After settling Penny at the Pokémon Center, he immediately rushed toward Wyndon Stadium.

Wyndon Stadium.

"This thing..." Cynthia's face also showed deep surprise.

Johan released her, took a deep breath, and said gravely: "This is Eternatus's true form, and also the source of its power to make Pokémon Dynamax. In this state, it should be called 'Eternamax'!"

"Eternamax?"

"Eternamax is Eternatus's most fundamental power. Like Gigantamax, it makes its size and power surge dramatically, and the Dynamax energy vortex it forms will make all Pokémon gradually lose themselves in Dynamax power..."

Rumble!!

Dark red storms accompanied by countless thunderbolts churned in the sky. The hundred-meter-tall Eternamax Eternatus let out a bone-chilling shriek, its massive body covering nearly half of Wyndon!

Under those five heads' imperious gazes, Pokémon throughout Wyndon continuously underwent uncontrolled Dynamax, and every trainer's heart filled with irrepressible fear and terror.

This was the legendary Pokémon that had gathered all the Galar particles of the entire Galar region.

Eternamax Eternatus!!

"Eternatus—!!!"

Eternamax Eternatus's claw-like head suddenly opened wide, letting out a high-pitched howl. The dark red vortex behind it collided again, a storm following, and the entire sky seemed to tremble.

"So it can still do this, so it can be like this!"

Rose showed uncontainable fanaticism, staring fixedly at Eternamax Eternatus. "So this is your true appearance? It's really... too beautiful..."

"Chairman Rose! We need to go! Chairman Rose!"

Oleana was sweating profusely, horrified by what they had revived, but still pulled Rose to retreat.

If they didn't leave now, that thing's fury definitely wasn't something ordinary people could withstand!

Rose was still immersed in Eternamax Eternatus's power, but Oleana was already regretting it.

But while Rose and Oleana could leave, Johan and Cynthia definitely couldn't.

On one hand, as Champions—even if not Champions of the Galar region—they couldn't retreat in such circumstances.

On the other hand... Eternamax Eternatus had already firmly locked onto them. They couldn't leave even if they wanted to!

It was just that while they could still fight normal Eternatus, this Eternamax state...

Johan looked at Cynthia.

Before he could speak, Cynthia said firmly: "You're not leaving, and I won't leave either!"

As she spoke, she took out a hair tie, determinedly tying up her waterfall-like golden hair.

Johan took her hand, indicating: "I'm not asking you to leave. I already anticipated this situation..."

You anticipated this?

"Then what should we do?"

"Heh."

Johan chuckled lightly.

What to do?

"Beat it up thoroughly, then capture it!" With some dominance, Johan said confidently.

Beat it up?

How?

Although Gengar and Ninetales weren't weak—both legendary-tier—without enhancements, facing Eternamax Eternatus was still somewhat inadequate, right?

Eternamax Eternatus had an exaggerated base stat total of 1125 points!

Even Arceus and the Original Dragon would weep at such stats.

"It would be fine if it didn't go Eternamax, but since it has, that's perfect!"

Cynthia was even more confused.

Johan said to Tinkaton: "Hammer sis, time to invite our friends out!"

"Cha!"

Hearing this, Tinkaton grinned and immediately threw out a brand-new sword and shield, which fell toward Johan.

Huh?

Johan was slightly stunned.

Just taking them out would be fine—why throw them at him?

But since they were thrown over, Johan caught them.

"Sword and shield?"

Hum—

The sword and shield in Johan's hands seemed to sense Eternamax Eternatus's aura, or perhaps because Johan had infused them with aura power—they burst with blue and red dual-colored light.

Eternatus, coiled in the night sky, immediately made "clatter clatter" sounds, suddenly raising its five heads to look toward the Wild Area.

Then they saw two streams of light, one blue and one red, ignoring the vast distance, ignoring the rich Dynamax energy, crossing thunder and storm to arrive!

Bang!!

The two streams of light fell like meteors, appearing before Johan and Cynthia.

They were two canine-like Pokémon, covered in battle scars with sharp gazes!

Hundred-battle heroes!

"They are..." Cynthia said incredulously.

"Legendary Pokémon. Zacian and Zamazenta!"

Facing their old enemy, Zacian and Zamazenta unhesitatingly burst with two streams of energy, rushing toward Eternamax Eternatus in the sky.

Bang!!

The powerful impact made Eternatus's five claw-like heads whimper in pain.

[We're here!] Zacian's voice rang in Johan's mind.

[Thank you, Aura Guardian.] Zamazenta's voice followed.

They saw the sword and shield in Johan's hands, now completely restored.

These were their most familiar weapons, the source of their power.

"Good that you're here." Johan smiled as he offered the sword and shield.

Zacian and Zamazenta looked at each other, then respectively bit toward the sword and shield in Johan's hands.

"Awooo—!!"

Upon contact with the sword and shield, both wolves howled, blue and red auras surging around them.

Hum—

Under the auras, Zacian and Zamazenta's appearances immediately underwent significant changes!

"This is their true form," Johan explained.

Behemoth Blade and Behemoth Bash were the best methods for dealing with Eternamax Eternatus!

So Johan had made such preparations...

Cynthia nodded.

That made sense.

Given Johan's personality and his relationships with those legendary Pokémon, knowing Eternatus posed such a huge threat, it would be surprising if he hadn't made such preparations.

But then, massive amounts of Dynamax particles again surged toward Eternamax Eternatus in the vortex.

Its injuries rapidly healed, and it opened its claws, releasing an extremely terrifying beam.

Hyper Beam!

"Awooo!!"

Zamazenta leaped up, the shield on its head bursting with dark red light, a barrier immediately expanding but shattering in moments.

Zacian's expression was stern, the sword in its mouth immediately expanded into a massive azure sword, slashing at the incoming beam.

Instantly, the beam and sword collided violently, countless energies scattering. Just the dispersed aftershocks destroyed Wyndon Stadium's reinforced buildings completely.

Bang!!

Zacian staggered as it landed.

The Hyper Beam's impact also completely dissipated.

But whether Zacian or Zamazenta, their expressions remained very serious.

[It's stronger!] Zacian said gravely.

Stronger?

Only they, who had once fought Eternatus, had the most authority on this matter.

[This is troublesome,] Zamazenta's voice was also heavy.

Johan suddenly seemed to think of something, crouching to look down below.

There was the crater left by the meteor that had initially awakened Eternatus.

If there was one biggest variable today... it might only be this seemingly inconsequential meteor.

Indeed!

In the charred meteor crater, a meteor radiating dark red light and filled with rich Dynamax energy had shed its outer shell, revealing its true form.

A meteor nearly identical in origin to Eternatus!

It had provided Eternatus with even more powerful Dynamax energy!

He'd thought it was just Eternatus's Cosmic Power enhancement, but now it seemed...

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar suddenly put its hand to its ear, making a listening gesture.

The next second, its eyes lit up as it put its finger in its mouth and whistled.

"Whistle~~"

In the distance came neighing sounds.

Neigh—

Then came the gradually clearer sound of hooves from far to near.

Clip-clop, clip-clop, clip-clop—

At the distant horizon, where darkness met earth, one black and one white horse neighed and flew through the air.

On the white Glastrier sat a majestic king with a green crown and white cloak.

Calyrex!

"Here it comes," Johan said softly.

It was the true first "client" who had "commissioned" Johan's help in this incident!

Neigh—

Spectrier neighed, stepping on shadows and quickly coming to Gengar's side.

Gengar joyfully grabbed the reins and mounted Spectrier.

Ghost-horse fusion!

[Sorry, my reaction was somewhat slow. I'm late.] Calyrex said apologetically to Johan, Cynthia, Zacian, and Zamazenta.

"You're here now, that's what matters."

[King of Galar.] Zacian and Zamazenta nodded in acknowledgment.

"Who is it?" Cynthia asked.

"Calyrex, the King of Galar," Johan briefly introduced.

[Former king,] Calyrex corrected.

"I see... it's Calyrex."

Cynthia understood.

When Sonia was studying in Hoenn, she'd chatted with her about some of Calyrex's history. That history was even more obscure than Zacian and Zamazenta's, and Sonia had only recently learned of Calyrex's name.

[It's grown stronger.]

At this time, Calyrex also noticed Eternatus's change.

"Ka-kaah!!"

Gengar, riding on Spectrier's back, shouted confidently.

Whether it got stronger or not, beat it up and we'll know everything!

Johan smiled knowingly.

"Gengar's right."

He stepped forward, directly facing Eternatus, his voice resolute:

"No matter what..."

"It's time for an Eternamax team battle!"

"Eternatus—!!"

Regardless, it wasn't just Johan's side feeling pressure. Eternatus in the vortex also felt pressure from Zacian, Zamazenta, Calyrex, and that ghost.

It roared.

At the center of its coiled body, the energy core radiating brilliant red light burst with even more dazzling brightness.

In the center of its fierce five-clawed heads, massive amounts of poison frantically gathered.

"Here it comes again!" Cynthia warned.

"Awooo—"

Zamazenta, as the "main tank," again raised its shield to meet it.

Poison?

"Ka-kaah!"

Leave it to me!

Gengar pulled Spectrier forward first.

Zacian and Zamazenta were still hesitant, but Calyrex trusted Gengar and Johan completely. Upon hearing Gengar's words, it immediately raised its hand and grasped the air.

A snow-white spear materialized from nothing.

"Oowoo~~"

Ninetales swished its tail, and large amounts of ice crystals quickly adhered to the white spear, its length and hardness rapidly expanding.

Ice Lance!

"Gengar!"

Eternatus's toxic impact fell like meteors. Gengar pulled Spectrier directly under the toxins, opening its mouth wide—making Johan's eye twitch.

It was one thing to directly eat other guys' poison attacks, but Eternatus's poison really couldn't be casually consumed!

Fortunately, Gengar wasn't stupid. It didn't directly intercept the toxins but used... Vacuum Wave to the side!

The rest was Zamazenta's job.

Although both Zamazenta and Zacian had gained Steel typing after becoming the Shield Hero and Sword Hero, theoretically immune to Poison-type moves, Eternatus's poison...

The massive shield was raised, and the toxins continuously made "hissing" corrosion sounds beneath it.

When the shield shattered, a slash struck from behind Zamazenta.

Behemoth Blade!

"Garchomp, Dragon Rush!"

"Lucario, Aura Sphere!"

"Victini, Helping Hand!"

Boom!!!

Massive rumbling erupted in the air again. Multiple attacks landed, and Eternatus's body inevitably made collapsing, cracking sounds.

"Eternatus!!!"

Eternatus roared again.

It realized this wouldn't work!

Zacian and Zamazenta went without saying—old enemies who countered it well.

The white-horse-riding Calyrex was the same.

Plus that ghost that always gave it "surprises"...

And those two humans with their other Pokémon—those attacks might not be fatal, but they hurt.

Moreover, that seemingly small and cute thing with the "V" on its forehead on that man's shoulder—its presence boosted all the Pokémon's strength by a level!

This team fight... was clearly ganging up on it!

Clatter clatter—

Eternatus's skeletal, chain-like body rapidly repaired itself, while its five claw-like heads quickly reached down toward the ground.

"Watch out!"

But Eternatus's target wasn't Johan and the others—it was that meteor!

The energy contained within had been fully activated after its Dynamax energy catalysis.

This meteor's appearance was its chance to turn the tables!

Otherwise, even if its body could take more hits, it was hard to say whether it would give out first or they would.

However, when the massive shadow descended...

Neigh—

Spectrier's neigh—stepping on shadows, it appeared with Gengar beneath Eternatus's five claws.

"Ka-kaah~!"

Gengar made a face at Eternatus.

Then, under Eternatus's incredulous gaze, it grabbed the meteor containing Dynamax energy and "nom" threw it into its mouth in one bite.

Eternatus: "?"

No way.

Are you really my natural enemy?

"Eternatus—!!!"

Eternatus's core again burst with dazzling light, rich Dynamax energy rapidly gathering into terrifying radiance.

Dynamax Cannon!

Gengar: "!!!"

Oh no, it's really angry—time to run!

Gengar pulled Spectrier and quickly fled.

But Eternatus was completely furious this time, directly ignoring Zacian, Zamazenta, and Calyrex.

Despite their attacks, despite their energy constantly impacting it, it just stared fixedly at Gengar.

You!

This team fight—I can lose!

But you, Gengar, must die!

Johan: "..."

The last one who could attract this much aggro in team fights was a guy called Swift Scout.

But you know what, just like his Gengar—equally sneaky.

Had Gengar really eaten that meteor?

No.

Gengar didn't dare eat it—it just hid it.

But now...

"Whew—" Johan took a deep breath, then let it out slowly.

Eternatus had lost its rationality. This situation was definitely favorable for their side, but the premise was that Gengar had to hold out until Eternatus fell.

But now, the Dynamax Cannon had already locked onto Gengar!

The incredibly terrifying energy was right at hand.

The stirred energy and storm had completely shattered even the surrounding space.

Gengar had once asked Johan: if the world were about to be destroyed and only you standing up would give even a tiny chance to save it, would you stand up?

Johan said: impossible—such a hypothesis doesn't exist. I have so many friends.

Gengar said: what if—just like how I eat ten thousand meals, there's always once I'll get a stomachache.

After brief thought, Johan answered: yes!

Gengar was puzzled—this doesn't match our family's "philosophy."

Johan smiled and said: sometimes, some people always have to protect something. If you don't want to protect anything, then "home" doesn't exist.

Right.

Sometimes, you have to work hard to protect something...

Johan and Gengar looked at each other.

They simultaneously grinned, showing identical smiles.

A mere Eternatus wants to take down this old man?

Bah!!

Hum—

Johan and Gengar simultaneously burst with brilliant rainbow light.

Cynthia beside them said in shock: "Mega Evolution?"

Wasn't it impossible to use Key Stones and Mega Stones?
